english_text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
nagamese_text: Abraham laga chokra, David laga chokra, Jisu Khrista laga purbo khandan laga likhi kene rakha kitab.

english_text: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
nagamese_text: Abraham, Isaac laga baba hoise, aru Isaac, Jacob laga baba hoise, aru Jacob, Judah aru tai laga bhai-kokai khan laga baba hoise.

english_text: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
nagamese_text: Judah pora Perez laga baba, aru Zerah pora Tamar laga baba, Perez pora Hezron laga baba hoise, aru Hezron, Ram laga baba hoise.

english_text: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
nagamese_text: Ram, Amminadab laga baba hoise, aru Amminadab, Nahshon laga baba hoise, aru Nahshon, Salmon laga baba hoise.

english_text: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
nagamese_text: Salmon, Boaz laga baba hoise, etu to Rahab logot pora hoise, aru Boaz, Obed laga baba Ruth logot pora hoise, aru Obed, Jesse laga baba hoise.

english_text: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
nagamese_text: Jesse, Raja David laga baba hoise, aru David, Solomon laga baba, Uriah laga maiki logot pora hoise.

english_text: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
nagamese_text: Solomon pora Rehoboam laga baba hoise, aru Rehoboam pora Abijah laga baba hoise, aru Abijah pora Asa laga baba hoise.

english_text: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
nagamese_text: Asa pora Jehoshaphat laga baba hoise, aru Jehoshaphat pora Joram laga baba hoise, aru Joram pora Uzziah laga baba hoise.

english_text: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
nagamese_text: Uzziah pora Jotham laga baba hoise, aru Jotham pora Ahaz laga baba hoise, aru Ahaz pora Hezekiah laga baba hoise.

english_text: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
nagamese_text: Hezekiah pora Manasseh laga baba hoise, aru Manasseh pora Amon laga baba hoise, aru Amon pora Josiah laga baba hoise.

english_text: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
nagamese_text: Josiah pora Jechoniah aru tai laga bhai-kokai khan laga baba hoise jitia taikhan ke Babylon desh te dhurikene loi jaise.

english_text: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
nagamese_text: Babylon te loija pichete, Jechoniah pora Shealtiel laga baba hoise, aru Shealtiel pora Zerubbabel laga baba hoise.

english_text: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
nagamese_text: Zerubbabel pora Abiud laga baba hoise, aru Eliakim pora Azor laga baba hoise.

english_text: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
nagamese_text: Azor pora Zadok laga baba hoise, aru Zadok pora Achim laga baba hoise, aru Achim pora Eliud laga baba hoise.

english_text: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
nagamese_text: Eliud pora Eleazar laga baba hoise, aru Eleazar pora Matthan laga baba hoise, aru Matthan pora Jacob laga baba hoise.

english_text: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
nagamese_text: Jacob pora Joseph laga baba hoise, jun laga maiki Mary asele, jun pora Jisu ke jonom dise, aru Khrista koi kene matise.

english_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, sob khandan Abraham pora loi kene David tak choudah khandan thakise, aru David pora loi kene jun khan ke Babylon te loi jaise aru Jisu Khrista laga jonom etu tak choudah khandan thakise.

english_text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista laga jonom eneka pora hoise. Tai laga ama, Mary Joseph ke shadi kori bole kotha milai loise, kintu tai duijon shadi nohua age te, Pobitro Atma dwara bacha pet te bukhi ja jani jaise.

english_text: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
nagamese_text: Kintu Joseph, tai laga mota, ekjon dharmik manu asele aru sob manu age te taike bodnam nadibo nimite, tai lukaikene taike chari bole bhabona kori loise.

english_text: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai eitu khan bhabi thakise, Probhu laga ekjon sorgodoth tai laga sapna te ahise, aru eneka koise, “Joseph, David laga chokra, Mary ke tumi laga maiki kori bole bhoi na koribi, kele koile juntu ekjon bacha tai laga pet te bukhikena ase etu Pobitro Atma pora ase.

english_text: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
nagamese_text: Tai ekjon chokra bacha ke jonom dibo, aru tumi tai laga naam Jisu rakhibo, kelemane Tai he Tai laga manu khan ke taikhan laga paap pora bachai lobo.”

english_text: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
nagamese_text: Isor pora bhabobadi khan dwara kowa kotha khan pura hobole karone eitu khan sob tineka he hoi jaise. Eneka likha ase,

english_text: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
nagamese_text: “Huni bhi, ekjon kumari maiki pora tai laga pet te bacha bukhi bo aru ekjon chokra ke jonom dibo, aru taikhan Tai laga naam Immanuel” rakhibo- etu motlob ase, “Isor amikhan logote ase.”

english_text: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Joseph ghumai thaka pora uthijaise aru ki kotha Isor laga sorgodoth pora hukum dise tai etu manise aru Mary ke tai laga maiki bonai loise.

english_text: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai laga maiki pora bacha jonom nohua tak, tai laga usorte janai aru tai bacha laga naam Jisu matise.

english_text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,
nagamese_text: Jitia Herod raja thakise, etu somoite Judea desh laga Bethlehem town te Jisu jonom hoise. Aru gyaan thaka manu khan purab phale thaka desh pora jonom laga kotha huni kene Jerusalem te ahise,

english_text: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
nagamese_text: aru eneka hudise, “Yehudi khan laga Raja hobole jonom huwa to kot te ase? Kilekoile amikhan Tai laga tara purab te dikhise, aru amikhan Taike aradhana kori bole ahise.”

english_text: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Herod raja etu hunise, tai aru tai logote Jerusalem te thaka khan sob laga mon chinta hoise.

english_text: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Herod raja pora mukhyo purohit aru niyom likha manu khan ke eke logote mati kene hudise, “Khrista to kun jagate jonom hobo?”

english_text: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,
nagamese_text: Taikhan taike koise, “Judea laga Bethlehem te, kele koile etu he bhabobadi khan pora Isor kotha te likhise,

english_text: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”
nagamese_text: ‘Kintu tumi Bethlehem, Judah desh te thaka, Apnikhan Judah desh laga cholawta khan pora komti nohoi, Kilekoile apnikhan majot pora ekjon raja ulabo, Jun Ami laga Israel manu khan ke Rokhiya kori cholai loijabo.’”

english_text: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete, Herod pora lukaikene gyaani manu khan ke kotha korise aru tara ki homoi te ulaise etu bhal pora jani loise.

english_text: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete tai gyaani manu khan ke Bethlehem te eneka koi kene pathaise, “Jabi aru bhal pora etu bacha ke bisari bhi. Kitia apnikhan taike pabo, amike kobi, kele koile Moi bhi ta te jai kene Taike aradhana koribo.”

english_text: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.
nagamese_text: Raja laga kotha khan huna pichete, taikhan jai jaise, aru sabi, taikhan juntu tara purab te dikhise etu eke tara aru dikhise aru taikhan etu tara laga piche jaise. Etu tara taikhan age-age jai kene bacha thaka jaga uporte rukhi jaise.

english_text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan tara ke dikhise, taikhan bisi khushi hoi kene rukhibo.

english_text: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ghor bhitor te ghusi se chutu bacha ke Tai laga ama Mary pora dhuri thaka dikhise. Taikhan athukari kene Taike aradhana korise. Taikhan khushi pora taikhan laga khajana khan khuli kene suna, aru dhona, aru bhal gundh laga tel khan daan korise.

english_text: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor pora taikhan laga sapna te Herod logote wapas najabi koi kene hoshiar kori dise, etu nimite dusra rasta pora taikhan nijor desh te wapas jai jaise.

english_text: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan jai ja-a pichete, Isor laga sorgodoth sapna te ahikena Joseph ke koise, “Uthibi, bacha aru ama ke loi kene Egypt te polai jabi aru ami nokuwa tak ta te thakibi, kele koile Herod Raja pora etu bacha ke mora bole bisari bole ase.”

english_text: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,
nagamese_text: Titia utu rati te, Joseph uthikena bacha aru ama ke loi kene Egypt desh te polai jaise.

english_text: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
nagamese_text: Tai Herod namora tak ta te he thakise. Juntu kotha Isor laga bhabobadi pora koi disele, etu pura hoi jaise, “Egypt pora Ami laga chokra ke mati loise.”

english_text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.
nagamese_text: Jitia Herod gyaani manu khan pora taike thogaise koi kene janise, tai bisi khong uthise. Etu nimite tai laga sipahi khan ke pathaikena jiman dui saal pora niche mota bacha Bethlehem te ase, sobke morai dibole hukum dise. Kilekoile utu somoite Jisu jonom koi kene dui saal ase koi kene Herod khobor paikena thakise.

english_text: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,
nagamese_text: Bhabobadi Jeremiah pora ki kotha koi dise eitu khan sob pura hoi jaise, juntu eneka likha asele,

english_text: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”
nagamese_text: “Ramah town te ekta awaj hunise, Bisi mon dukh koi kene kandi thakise, Rachel tai laga bacha nimite kandi thakise, Aru kunke bhi tai laga mon shanti koribo diya nai kele koile taikhan nathaka hoi jaise.”

english_text: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia raja Herod mori jaise, sabi, Isor laga ekjon sorgodoth, Joseph to Egypt te thaka somoite tai laga sapna te ahise,

english_text: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”
nagamese_text: aru eneka koise, “Uthikena bacha aru tai laga ama ke loi kene Israel desh te jabi, kele koile jun manu bacha ke mora bole thakise taikhan morise.”

english_text: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Joseph uthikena, bacha aru ama ke loi jaise, aru Israel laga desh te jaise.

english_text: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tai hunise Herod laga chokra Archelaus he Judea laga raja ase, titia, tai ta te jabole bhoi hoi jaise. Hoilebi Isor pora tai laga sapna te hoshiar kori dise, aru etu jaga chari kene, tai Galilee jagate jaise.

english_text: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.
nagamese_text: Aru Nazareth laga sheher te jaise aru ta te thaki jaise. Eneka pora, juntu bhabobadi khan pora Isor laga kotha koi dise etu pura hoi jaise, juntu asele, Taike Nazareth laga manu koi kene matibo.

english_text: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
nagamese_text: Etu somoite Baptizma diya John ahise aru Isor laga kotha prochar kori kene Judea laga sunsan jagate ahise,

english_text: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
nagamese_text: aru eneka koise, “Mon ghura bhi, kele koile sorgo laga rajyo to usorte ahi jaise.”

english_text: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bhabobadi Isaiah pora tai laga he kotha koi diya eneka likha ase, “Ekjon kunba sunsan jaga pora hala kori ase, ‘Isor laga rasta taiyar koribi, Tai laga rasta sidha koribi.”

english_text: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
nagamese_text: Etiya, John to uth janwar laga chuli pora bona kapra lagai aru komor te chamra laga peti pora bandhe. Aru tai pango aru jongol laga mou pani he khai.

english_text: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
nagamese_text: Titia Jerusalem sheher, aru pura Judea desh, aru Jordan Nodi laga sob jaga pora manu khan taike lok kori bole ahe.

english_text: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga paap shikar kora pichete, John pora Jordan Nodi te taikhan ke baptizma di thakise.

english_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
nagamese_text: Kintu tai logot bisi Pharisee aru Sadducee khan baptizma lobole ahi thaka dikhise, aru tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan saph laga bacha khan, kun koise tumikhan Isor laga khong pora polabo karone?

english_text: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, mon ghura laga bijon apnikhan laga kaam pora dikhai dibi.

english_text: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan laga monte ‘Amikhan laga purbojo Abraham ase’ eneka nabhabi bhi. Moi tumikhan ke koi ase Isor to etu pathor khan loi kene Abraham laga khandan bonabo pare.

english_text: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
nagamese_text: Kintu sob ghas khan kati bole kuthar to age pora taiyar hoi kene ase. Juntu ghas bhal phol nadhure etu ghas ke katikena jui te phelai dibo.

english_text: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Moi to tumikhan ke pani pora he baptizma dibo. Kintu Jun ami laga pichete ahi ase, Tai to ami pora bisi hokti thaka ase, Tai laga chapal moi dhori bole layak nai. Tai tumikhan ke Pobitro Atma aru jui pora baptizma dibo.

english_text: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
nagamese_text: Tai dhaan kati bole dao loi kene ahi ase, sob dhaan ke dhaan ghor te joma kori kene ghas khan ke kitia bhi khotom nohobole jui te phelai dibo.”

english_text: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu Galilee jaga pora ulaikena baptizma lobole Jordan Nodi te John logot ahise.

english_text: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
nagamese_text: Hoilebi John to Jisu ke rukhabole bisi kosis korise, aru eneka koise, “Ami he Apuni laga hath pora baptizma lobo lage, hoilebi Apuni he moi logote ahise?”

english_text: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taike eneka koise, “Etiya karone to eneka koridi bhi, kele koile Amikhan bhi dharmikta kaam sob pura korile he thik ase.” Etu pichete John pora kotha mani loise.

english_text: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu baptizma loi kene pani pora ulaise, sorgo pora ekta pohor ahise aru Isor laga Atma kopu chiriya nisena hoi kene Tai uporte rukhi jaise.

english_text: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete, sabi, ekta awaj sorgo pora koise, “Etu Ami laga bisi morom thaka Putro ase. Ami Tai uporte bisi khushi ase.”

english_text: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu ke Atma pora ekta sunsan jagate loi jaise juntu jagate saitan pora taike porikha koribo.

english_text: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
nagamese_text: Aru chalis din aru chalis rati Jisu upwas korise, etu karone Tai bhuk lagi jaise.

english_text: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
nagamese_text: Titia porikha kora jon ahikena Taike eneka koise, “Apuni Isor laga Putro ase koile, etu pathor khan ke roti hobole kobi.”

english_text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taike jowab dikena koise, “Isor kotha te eneka likhi kene ase, ‘Manu to khali bhaat khaikena jinda nathake, kintu Isor laga mukh pora ula kotha te he jinda thakibo.’”

english_text: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
nagamese_text: Etu pichete saitan pora Jisu ke pobitro sheher te loi jaise aru mondoli laga sob pora uporte khara koribo dise,

english_text: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
nagamese_text: aru Taike koise, “Apuni Isor laga Putro ase koile, yate pora nijorke nichete phelai dibi, kele koile Isor laga kotha te eneka likha ase, ‘Tai pora Tai laga duth khan ke hukum dikene Apuni ke bachai lobo,’ Aru, ‘Taikhan laga hath pora Apuni ke dhuri lobo, Aru Apuni laga theng ke pathor pora bhi jokhom nahobo.’”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike eneka koise, “Aru Isor kotha te etu bhi likhi kene ase, ‘Apuni laga Probhu Isor ke porikha na koribi.’”

english_text: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
nagamese_text: Aru, saitan pora Jisu ke untcha pahar te loi jaise aru Taike prithibi laga rajyokhan laga dangor mohima thaka dikhai dise.

english_text: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
nagamese_text: Saitan pora Taike koise, “Apuni moike athukari kene aradhana korile, eitu khan sob ami Apnike di dibo.”

english_text: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu pora taike koise, “Yate pora jai jabi, Saitan! Kilekoile Shastro te eneka likhi kene ase, ‘Tumikhan khali Probhu, tumi laga Isor ke he aradhana koribi, aru khali Taike he sewa koribi.’”

english_text: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
nagamese_text: Titia saitan Taike chari kene jai jaise, aru sabi, sorgodoth khan ahi kene Taike modot korise.

english_text: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
nagamese_text: Jitia John ke dhurise koi kene Jisu khobor paise, Tai Galilee jagate wapas jai jaise.

english_text: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
nagamese_text: Tai Nazareth sheher chari kene Galilee Samundar laga usorte thaka, Capernaum town te jaise, etu jaga to Zebulun aru Naphtali laga majot te ase.

english_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
nagamese_text: Isaiah bhabobadi dwara Isor kotha pora kowa pura hobole karone eitu khan sob eneka hoise,

english_text: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
nagamese_text: “Zebulun laga mati aru Naphtali laga mati, Sagar phale, Jordan paar kori kene, Porjati khan laga Galilee!

english_text: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
nagamese_text: Utu manu khan jun andhera te bohi thake taikhan dangor ekta ujala dikhise, Aru jun khan mora laga chaya aru jagate bohi thake, Taikhan uporte ekta pohor dikhai dise.”

english_text: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
nagamese_text: Utu somoi pora he Jisu prochar kori bole shuru hoise aru koise, “Mon ghura bhi, kele koile sorgo laga rajyo to usor hoise.”

english_text: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Galilee Nodi phale berai thakisele, Tai Simon junke Peter koi, aru tai laga bhai Andrew khan ke maas dhora jaal loi kene samundar te phelai thaka dikhise, kele koile taikhan maas dhora manu thakise.

english_text: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Ahibi, Ami laga piche koribi, aru Moi tumikhan ke manu dhori bole bonai dibo.”

english_text: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
nagamese_text: Loge-loge taikhan laga maas dhura jaal khan phelai dise aru Jisu laga piche kori bole shuru hoise.

english_text: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu ta te pora jai thakise, tai duijon bhai ke dikhise, James, Zebedee laga chokra, aru tai laga bhai John Tai ekta naw te taikhan laga baba Zebedee logote maas dhura jaal khan milai thakise. Jisu taikhan ke matise,

english_text: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
nagamese_text: Aru etu loge-loge taikhan laga naw aru baba ke chari kene Jisu laga piche korise.

english_text: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu Galilee laga sob jagate berai jaise, synagogue khan te sikhaise, aru rajyo laga susamachar prochar korise, aru sob kisim laga ghao bemar aru bemar manu khan ke changai korise.

english_text: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
nagamese_text: Tai laga khobor sob Syria jagate punchi jaise, aru manu khan Jisu usorte kisim-kisim bemar pora dukh pai thaka khan, gaw bhitor te bhoot huma khan, murgi-bemar thaka khan, aru jothor bemar thaka khan sobke loi kene anise. Aru taikhan ke Jisu pora changai kori dise.

english_text: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
nagamese_text: Aru Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, aru Jordan pora bhi dur thaka sob jaga pora manu khan Jisu logot ahise.

english_text: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
nagamese_text: Bhir bisi dangor hoija pora, Jisu to ekta tilla uporte uthijaise. Tai ta te boha pichete, tai laga chela khan bhi Tai usorte ahise.

english_text: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu pora Tai laga chela khan ke eneka koi kene sikhaise,

english_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: “Atma te dukhia thaka khan dhonyo ase, Kilekoile sorgo laga rajyo taikhan nimite ase.

english_text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
nagamese_text: Dukh koi kene thaka khan, taikhan dhonyo ase, Kilekoile taikhan laga mon aram kori dibo.

english_text: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
nagamese_text: Nomro hoi kene thaka khan dhonyo ase, Taikhan prithibi laga adhikari hobo.

english_text: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
nagamese_text: Dharmikta nimite bhuk aru pyaas thaka khan dhonyo ase, Taikhan ke bhorta kori dibo.

english_text: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
nagamese_text: Dayalu thaka manu khan dhonyo ase, Taikhan daya pabo.

english_text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
nagamese_text: Mon sapha thaka khan dhonyo ase, Taikhan Isor ke dikhibo.

english_text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
nagamese_text: Shanti nimite kaam kora khan dhonyo ase, Taikhan ke Isor laga bacha khan koi kene matibo.

english_text: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: Dharmikta nimite dukh pai thaka khan dhonyo, Sorgo laga desh to taikhan nimite ase.

english_text: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan dhonyo ase jitia Ami laga naam nimite manu khan pora tumikhan ke gali dibo, dukh digdar dibo aru misa misi bodnam dibo.

english_text: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
nagamese_text: Monte bisi khushi hobi kele koile sorgote tumikhan nimite bisi dangor inam rakhi kene ase. Jun bhabobadi khan tumi laga age te ahisele, taikhan ke bhi eneka dukh digdar dise.

english_text: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan etu prithibi laga nimok nisena ase. Kintu nimok laga swadh haraise koile, kineka tai laga swadh to arubi anibo? Etu to eku kaam laga nohoi jai, kintu etu ke phelai dibo aru manu khan pora chipai dibo.

english_text: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan etu prithibi laga puhor ase. Ekta sheher ke pahar uporte bonaile lukabo napare.

english_text: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi manu khan tai laga saaki julai kene kiba ekta dabba pora bondh kori kene narakhe, kintu etu saaki ke khamba te rakhikena pura ghor ke ujala kori bole diye.

english_text: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga pohor ke eneka ujala kori dibi manu khan age te, titia taikhan tumi laga bhal kaam khan sob dikhi jabo aru tumi laga Baba Isor jun sorgote ase, Taike mohima dibo.

english_text: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
nagamese_text: Moi Isor laga niyom aru bhabobadi khan ke khotom kori dibo nimite ahise eneka nabhabi bi. Moi khotom kori dibole aha nohoi, kintu eitu khan sob pura kori dibo nimite ahise.

english_text: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase jitia tak prithibi aru akas khan khotom nohoi, ekta dagi nohoile ekta chutu kotha bhi naharabo, jitia tak etu kotha khan sob pura nohoi.

english_text: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, kun pora etu niyom aru hukum khan bhangabo aru dusra khan ke bhi eneka kori bole sikhabo, taikhan laga naam bhi sorgo laga rajyo pora hatai dibo. Kintu kun pora etu hukum aru niyom sob rakhe, taike sorgo laga rajyote mohan matibo.

english_text: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, tumikhan laga dharmikta to niyom likha khan aru pharisee khan pora bhi bhal hobo lage, eneka nohoile tumikhan sorgo laga rajyote ahibo na paribo.

english_text: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’
nagamese_text: Tumikhan hunise utu purana somoite eneka koi dise, ‘Morai diya kaam na koribi,’ aru, ‘Jun pora manu ke morai taikhan Isor laga bisar te ahibo.’

english_text: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, sob manu jun khan tai nijor bhai ke gusa kore, tai logot Isor laga bisar ahibo, aru nijor bhai ke eneka kowa khan to sabha age te bisi digdar hobo, ‘Tumi kaam nathaka manu!’ Aru tai norok laga jui te juli bo jodi ekjon pora tai bhai ke eneka koi, ‘Tumi murkho manu!’

english_text: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jitia tumi Isor laga age te daan dibole ane, aru bhai ke kiba biya korise koi kene monte ahise koile,

english_text: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
nagamese_text: tumi laga dhun khan bedi usorte chari dibi. Aru poila jai kene tumi laga bhai logote mon milai lobi, etu pichete ahikena Isor ke daan dibi.

english_text: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
nagamese_text: Kunba tumike bisar ghor te loijabo koi ase koile, naja-a age te tai logote kotha milai lobi, kele koile ekbar bisar ghor te jaise koile tai pora tumike ukil laga hathte di dibo, aru ukil pora tumike sipahi khan logote di dibo aru sipahi khan pora tumike bondhi ghor te rakhidibo.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Ami tumikhan ke koidi ase, tumi bondhi ghor pora bahar naulabo jitia tak tumi laga dhar sob tirai nadibo.

english_text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’
nagamese_text: Tumikhan eneka kowa hunise, ‘Bebichari na koribi.’

english_text: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koidi ase, jun manu ekjon mahila ke biya kaam kori bole bhabi loi, tai mon bhitor te bebichar kori loise.

english_text: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
nagamese_text: Jitia ekta suku pora tumike biya kaam koribo di ase, utu suku ke ulaikene dhur te phelai dibi. Kilekoile gaw te ekta biya saman nimite pura gaw norokte ja pora to, ekta suku nathaki kene jinda thaka he bhal hobo.

english_text: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga ekta hath pora paap kaam kori ase koile, etu ke kati kene phelai dibi. Kilekoile pura gaw norokte ja pora, ekta hath nathaki kene jinda thakile he bhal ase.

english_text: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’
nagamese_text: Eneka bhi koi kene ase, ‘Jun mota tai laga maiki ke chari bole mon ase, tai pora chari diya laga chithi likhi kene tai laga maiki ke dibole lage.’

english_text: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke etu koidi ase, jun mota dusra maiki logote bebichar kori bole tai laga maiki ke chari diye, taike bebichari maiki bonai di ase. Aru jun manu pora etu chari diye maiki ke shadi koribo, tai bhi bebichar kori loise.

english_text: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’
nagamese_text: Aru, tumikhan poila jamana te huni kene thakibo, ‘Misa kotha nimite kosom nakhabi, kintu ji kosom Probhu logote korise etu purah koribi.’

english_text: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, tumi laga kosom nimite, sorgote thaka laga naam nalobi, kele koile etu Isor laga singhason ase;

english_text: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
nagamese_text: prithibi laga naam nalobi, kele koile etu Isor laga theng rakha jaga ase; Jerusalem laga naam nalobi, kele koile etu mohan Raja laga desh ase.

english_text: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
nagamese_text: Aru nijor laga naam loi kene kosom nakhabi, kele koile tumi nijor laga chuli ke boga nohoile kala kori bole hokti nai.

english_text: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi laga kotha ‘Hoi to, hoi' kobi, aru ‘Nohoi to Nohoi’ kobi. Kintu etu pora aru bisi kotha kora khan to sob biya khan pora ase.

english_text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’
nagamese_text: Tumikhan hunise eneka koi kene ase, ‘Suku laga bodli suku, aru daat laga bodli daat.’

english_text: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi koi ase, tumike kunba golti kora manu ke badla lobole na koribi. Hoilebi, jun manu tumike mukh laga ekta phale thapor mare, tumi laga dusra phale bhi mari bole dibi.

english_text: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.
nagamese_text: Kunba manu bisar ghor te jabole itcha hoi aru tumi laga kapra pindhi loi, taike apuni laga chador bhi di dibi.

english_text: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
nagamese_text: Kunba manu khan pora tumike ek kilometer jabole koile, tumi tai logote dui kilometer jabi.

english_text: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
nagamese_text: Jun manu tumike kiba mangile taike di dibi, aru jun manu tumike kiba dhar lobole mange, taike mana na koribi.

english_text: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
nagamese_text: Tumikhan hunise eneka koi kene, ‘Tumi laga ghor usorte thaka manu ke morom koribi aru tumi laga dushman ke ghin koribi.’

english_text: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, tumi laga dushman ke morom koribi, aru jun khan tumike dukh-digdar di ase, taikhan nimite prathana koribi,

english_text: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.
nagamese_text: eneka korile tumikhan sorgote thaka Baba laga bacha khan hobo. Kilekoile Tai laga suryo to biya manu aru bhal manu ke bhi diye, aru borkhon pani to biya manu aru bhal khan ke bhi diye.

english_text: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
nagamese_text: Jitia tumikhan khali morom kora khan ke morom kore, etu to ki labh pabo? Kilekoile poisa utha manu khan bhi eneka kore nohoi?

english_text: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
nagamese_text: Tumikhan khali tumi laga bhai khan he mane koile, etu kori kene tumi ki dangor kaam korise? Isor ke najana khan bhi dusra khan ke eneka kore nohoi?

english_text: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, tumikhan ekdom thik hobo lage, jineka tumikhan laga sorgo Baba Isor thik ase.

english_text: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Etiya bhal pora bujhi lobi, tumikhan manu ke dikha bole nimite bhal kaam na koribi, nohoile sorgote thaka Baba Isor pora tumikhan ke eku inam nadibo.

english_text: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
nagamese_text: Jitia tumikhan kunba ke modot di ase koile, sob manu ke hunai kene hala na koribi, kele koile Pharisee khan bhi manu khan ke dikha bole nimite mondoli khan te aru rasta khan te hala kore. Hosa pora Moi koidi ase, taikhan laga inam taikhan paikena ase.

english_text: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan jitia daan diye, tumi laga dyna hath ki kori ase tumi laga baya hath ke janibole nadibi,

english_text: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
nagamese_text: titia tumi daan diya to kun bhi najanibo. Kintu tumi laga Baba jun sob sai ase tumike lukai kene inam dibo.

english_text: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.
nagamese_text: Jitia tumikhan prathana kore, kopoti khan kora nisena nahobi, kele koile taikhan mondoli khan te aru rasta kinar khan te dikha bole karone prathana kore. Hosa pora Moi koidi ase, taikhan laga inam to taikhan pabo.

english_text: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
nagamese_text: Kintu, jitia tumikhan prathana kore, ghor bhitor dorja bondh koribi aru lukai kene tumi laga Baba ke prathana koribi. Titia tumi laga Baba jun tumike sai ase, Tai tumike inam dibo.

english_text: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.
nagamese_text: Jitia tumikhan prathana kore, Porjati khan nisena bisi kotha nakobi, kele koile taikhan bhabe eneka koile taikhan laga kotha huni lobo.

english_text: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan nisena na koribi, kele koile tumi laga Baba tumi ki mangi bole ase etu age pora jani ase.

english_text: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, eneka prathana koribi: ‘Amikhan laga Baba jun sorgote ase, Apuni laga naam pobitro hoi kene untcha hobi.

english_text: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga sorgo ahibole dibi. Apuni laga itcha hobole dibi, etu prithibi te jineka sorgote ase.

english_text: Give us today our daily bread.
nagamese_text: Amikhan ke hodai din laga kha luwa dibi.

english_text: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga dhar khan maph kori dibi, Jineka ami pora amikhan laga dhar thaka khan ke maph kori dise.

english_text: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
nagamese_text: Amikhan ke porikha te giri bo nadibi, kintu biya jon pora amikhan ke bachai lobi.’

english_text: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jitia tumikhan pora dusra manu khan laga golti khan maph kore, tumi laga sorgote thaka Baba bhi tumikhan ke maph kori dibo.

english_text: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tumikhan dusra manu khan ke maph nakore, tumi laga sorgote thaka Baba bhi tumikhan laga golti maph nakoribo.

english_text: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.
nagamese_text: Jitia tumikhan upwas rakhe, kopoti khan kora nisena mon dukh laga chehera nadikhabi, kele koile taikhan to manu khan ke dikhabo nimite taikhan laga chehera biya kori kene dikhai, aru taikhan nijor laga inam pai loise.

english_text: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
nagamese_text: Kintu, jitia tumi upwas rakhe, tumi nijor laga matha te tel hali lobi aru chehera ke dholai lobi,

english_text: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
nagamese_text: titia manu khan tumike saikene najanibo tumi upwas kori ase, kintu khali tumi laga Baba he janibo; aru tumi laga Baba jun sob sai ase, Tai he tumike inam dibo.

english_text: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;
nagamese_text: Nijor nimite eku dhun joma na koribi, juntu jagate tumi laga sob dhun puka aru kira pora khotom kori dibo, aru jun jagate chor khan bhangai kene chor kori lobo.

english_text: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, nijor laga sob dhun sorgote joma koribi, juntu jagate napuchibo aru pukakhan pora khotom nakoribo, aru chor khan bhanga bole na paribo.

english_text: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jun jagate tumi laga dhun ase, ta te tumi laga mon bhi thakibo.

english_text: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
nagamese_text: Suku to tumi laga gaw te saaki nisena ase. Etu nimite, jitia tumi laga suku to thik thakibo, tumi laga gaw purah te puhor thakibo.

english_text: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tumi laga suku te letera thakibo, tumi laga pura gaw bhi letera thakibo. Etu nimite, juntu pohor tumi bhitor te ase, etu to andhera ase koile, utu andhar to kiman bhi dangor ase!

english_text: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
nagamese_text: Kun manu bhi duita malik ke sewa koribo na paribo, kele koile tai ekjon malik ke morom koribo aru ke ghin koribo, nohoile ekjon ke mon dibo aru dusra ke mon nadibo. Tumi Isor aru dhun ke sewa koribo na paribo.

english_text: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Moi koi ase, nijor laga jibon nimite chinta na koribi, ki khabo nohoile- nohoile tumi laga gaw nimite, nohoile ki kapra pindhibo. Kha luwa pora bhi jibon to dangor nohoi naki, aru kapra pora bhi tumi laga gaw he dangor nohoi naki?

english_text: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
nagamese_text: Akas uporte chiriya khan ke sabi. Taikhan kheti bhi nakore, aru kheti bhi nakate, nohoile taikhan laga ghor te joma nakore, kintu tumi laga sorgote thaka Baba pora taikhan ke sob khilai. Tumikhan etu chiriya khan pora bhi bisi dangor ase nohoi?

english_text: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan jun bisi chinta kore, etu pora tumikhan laga jibon ke lamba koribo pare naki?

english_text: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
nagamese_text: Tumikhan kele kapra nimite iman chinta kori ase? Kheti te phul thaka khan laga bhabi sabi, taikhan kineka phule. Taikhan eku kaam nakore, aru kapra bhi nabonai.

english_text: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
nagamese_text: Titia bhi Ami koi ase, Solomon ekjon dangor raja hoi kene bhi, taike eitu khan nisena kapra lagai diya nai.

english_text: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi Isor pora kapra pindhai dibole pare, etu kheti te thaka phul khan jun aji ase aru kali kati kene chulah te julai diye, titia hoile Tai tumikhan ke bhi bisi kapra pindhai dibo na paribo naki, tumi komti biswas thaka manu khan?

english_text: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bisi chinta kori kene eneka nakobi, ‘Amikhan ki khabo?’ Nohoile, ‘Amikhan ki pindhibo?’

english_text: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor najana khan pora eitu khan he bisare, aru sorgote thaka Baba Isor pora tumikhan ki lage, Tai sob jani ase.

english_text: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
nagamese_text: Kintu poila Tai laga sorgo rajyo aru dharmikta bisaribi aru eitu khan sob saman tumikhan ke Tai pora dibo.

english_text: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, kali nimite chinta na koribi, kele koile kali to tai nijor he chinta koribo. Hodai dinte tai nijor laga biya din thake.

english_text: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
nagamese_text: Dusra ke bisar na koribi, tinehoile tumike bhi bisar nakoribo.

english_text: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
nagamese_text: Ki kotha pora tumi bisar kore, tumike bhi etu pora bisar koribo, aru ki loi kene tumi hisab-kitab kore, tineka he tumike bhi hisab-kitab hobo.

english_text: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
nagamese_text: Kintu kele tumi laga bhai laga suku te sukha pata chutu thaka to sai ase, hoilebi tumi nijor laga suku te dangor khuri thaka to nadikhe?

english_text: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
nagamese_text: Nohoile kineka tumi laga bhai ke koi, ‘Amike tumi laga suku te sukha pata chutu thaka to sapha koribo dibi,’ jitia apuni nijor laga suku te ekta dangor khuri thaki kene?

english_text: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.
nagamese_text: Tumi kopoti khan! Poila nijor laga suku te dangor khuri thaka to sapha kori lobi, aru etu pichete tumikhan bhal pora dikhi kene bhai laga suku te sukha pata chutu thaka to sapha kori bole paribo.

english_text: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
nagamese_text: Juntu pobitro ase eitu khan kutta khan ke nadibi, aru tumi laga heera moti loi kene jongol gahori khan ke nadibi. Kilekoile taikhan laga theng pora chipai dibo, aru ghurikena tumikhan laga gaw ke kamuri kene tukra kori dibo.

english_text: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
nagamese_text: Mangi bhi, aru tumikhan ke dibo. Bisaribi, aru tumikhan pai jabo. Dorjate maribi, aru tumikhan nimite khuli dibo.

english_text: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jun mange, taikhan pai; aru jun bisare, taikhan pai; aru jun dorjate mare, taikhan nimite khuli diye.

english_text: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi kunba manu ase naki tumikhan majote, jun laga bacha pora khabole roti mangile, tai laga baba pora pathor diye naki?

english_text: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
nagamese_text: Nohoile bacha pora maas khabole mangile, tai laga baba pora saph dibo naki?

english_text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, tumikhan kiman biya hoilebi nijor bacha ke bhal saman khan diye, tinehoile tumi laga Baba kun sorgote ase, Tai aru bisi bhal saman tumikhan manga to nadibo naki?

english_text: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, sob te, dusra manu khan pora tumi ki lage, thik eneka tumi bhi dusra khan ke koribi, kele koile etu to niyom pora aru bhabobadi khan pora koi diya ase.

english_text: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.
nagamese_text: Ekdom huru rasta pora ghusi bhi. Kelemane juntu dorja bisi dangor hoi, etu to khotom kori diya rasta te loijai, aru bisi manu etu rasta te jabole kore.

english_text: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jibon laga rasta to bisi huru ase aru dorja ekdom chutu ase. Etu nimite khali kunba khan he etu rasta pai.

english_text: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
nagamese_text: Misa bhabobadi khan pora hoshiar thakibi, jun khan mer nisena kapra pindhi kene dikhai, kintu bhitor te taikhan ekdom bhuk lagi thaka rong kutta janwar khan ase.

english_text: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga kaam laga phol pora tumikhan jani jabo. Dusra manu kata ghas pora angur ke joma nakore, aru nohoile kata ghas pora dimoru khan ulai naki?

english_text: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, sob bhal ghas khan bhal phol dhure, kintu biya ghas khan biya phol dhure.

english_text: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
nagamese_text: Ekta bhal ghas pora biya phol dhoribo napare, nohoi lebi ekta biya ghas pora bhal phol dhoribo napare.

english_text: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
nagamese_text: Juntu ghas bhal phol nadhure etu ghas ke katikena jui te phelai dibo lage.

english_text: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete, tumikhan tai laga phol pora jani jabo.

english_text: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Sob manu jun Moike ‘Probhu, Probhu’ koi kene mate, taikhan sorgo desh te huma bole nohoi, kintu jun manu sorgote thaka Baba Isor laga itcha kore, taikhan he huma bole paribo.

english_text: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’
nagamese_text: Bisi manu khan utu dinte kobo, ‘Probhu, Probhu, amikhan Apuni laga naam te bhabobani kora nai naki, aru Apuni laga naam te biya atma khan ke khedai diya nai naki, aru Apuni laga naam te asurit kaam khan kora nai naki?

english_text: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
nagamese_text: Titia Ami Khuli Kena taikhan ke koi dibo, ‘Moi tumikhan ke kitia bhi jana nai! Moi laga usor pora jai jabi, tumikhan biya laga niyom kora khan!’

english_text: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, sob manu jun Ami laga kotha khan hune aru eitu khan sob mane, taikhan ekjon gyaani manu nisena ase jun pathor uporte ghor bonaise.

english_text: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
nagamese_text: Bisi dangor hawa aru pani ahikena, aru purah pani pora bhorta kori loise, hoilebi etu ghor ke gira bole para nai, kele koile etu ghor to pathor uporte bonaise.

english_text: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu Ami laga kotha hune aru namane taikhan murkho manu ase jun balu laga uporte ghor bonai.

english_text: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”
nagamese_text: Dangor borkhon ahise, aru ban pani pora bhorta hoi jaise, aru hawa pora etu ghor ke hilai kene girai dise, aru pura ghor ke khotom kori diye.”

english_text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
nagamese_text: Etu pichete jitia Jisu etu kotha khan koi kene khotom korise, Tai pora sikhai diya kotha huni kene sob manu asurit hoi jaise.

english_text: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Tai sikhai diya to niyom likha khan pora sikha nisena nohoi, kintu ekjon adhikar thaka manu nisena koi thakise.

english_text: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu pahar pora namikene ahise se, dangor manu laga bhir pora Tai laga piche korise.

english_text: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
nagamese_text: Aru sabi, ekjon korhi bemar thaka manu Jisu laga usorte ahise aru Tai age te matha jhukikena eneka koise, “Probhu, Apuni itcha ase koile, Apuni moike sapha kori bole paribo.”

english_text: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
nagamese_text: Jisu tai usorte jai kene taike chuikena koise, “Moi laga itcha ase. Sapha hobi.” Aru etu loge-loge tai laga bemar sapha hoi jaise.

english_text: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu taike koise, “Sabi, etu kunke bhi nakobi. Kintu jabi aru tumi laga purohit khan ke dikhai dibi aru Moses pora hukum diya kori lobi, titia etu dusra khan nimite tumi laga gawahi hobo.”

english_text: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Capernaum jagate ahi loise, ekjon Rome laga henapoti Tai usorte ahise aru koise,

english_text: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”
nagamese_text: “Probhu, ami laga kaam kora nokor jothor bemar koi kene ghumai ase aru tai bisi dukh te ase.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi ahibo aru taike bhal kori dibo.”

english_text: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
nagamese_text: Kintu henapoti pora taike eneka jowab dise, “Probhu, Apnike ami laga ghor te mati bole sorom ase, kintu khali Apuni laga kotha koi dibi aru ami laga nokor to bhal hoi jabo.

english_text: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami bhi ekjon adhikari thaka manu ase, aru ami nichete sipahi khan ase. Ami taikhan ke eneka hukum diye, ‘Jabi’, aru tai jai, aru dusra ekjon ke, ‘Ahibi,’ aru tai ahe, aru nokor ke, ‘Eneka koribi,’ aru tai kore.”

english_text: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Jisu etu hunise, Tai asurit hoi jaise aru Tai laga piche aha manu khan ke koi, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Moi kitia bhi etu nisena iman dangor biswas thaka manu purah Israel desh te dikha nai.

english_text: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, purab aru paschim desh khan pora bisi manu ahibo, aru taikhan aram kori kene Abraham, Isaac, aru Jacob, usorte sorgo laga rajyote bohibo.

english_text: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
nagamese_text: Kintu rajyo laga bacha khan ke andhera jagate phelai dibo, juntu jagate khali daat kamurikena kanda he thakibo.”

english_text: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu etu henapoti ke koise,“Jabi! Jineka tumi biswas korise, etu nisena he hobo dibi.” Aru thik utu homoi te tai laga nokor bhal hoi jaise.

english_text: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu pora Peter laga ghor te ahise, Peter laga maiki laga ama bukhar pora bemar hoi kene ghumai thaka dikhise.

english_text: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora tai laga hath choise aru titia bemar taike chari kene jaise. Etu pichete tai uthikena Jisu ke kha luwa sewa kori bole shuru hoijai.

english_text: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,
nagamese_text: Jitia saam hoi thakise, manu khan Jisu usorte biya atma humai kene thaka manu khan ke loi kene anise. Tai laga kotha pora sob biya atma khan ke khedai dise aru sob bemar thaka manu khan ke changai kori dise.

english_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
nagamese_text: Etu nisena juntu kotha khan bhabobadi Isaiah koi dise, eitu khan sob purah hoi jaise, “Tai nijor he amikhan laga sob bemar khan loi loise aru amikhan laga sob ghao khan nijor bukhi loise.”

english_text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu pora Tai usorte dangor bhir joma hoi kene dikhise, Tai dusra khan ke Galilee laga Samundar laga dusra phale jai jabi koi kene hukum dise.

english_text: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete niyom likha manu Tai logote ahise aru koise, “Shika manu, Apuni kot jai ami bhi Apuni pichete jabo.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Shial khan chenda bhitor te thake, chiriya khan pata pora bona ghor te thake, kintu Manu laga Putro nimite thaki bole jaga nai.”

english_text: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
nagamese_text: Jisu laga ekjon chela pora taike koise, “Probhu, moike poila ekbar ghor te jai kene ami laga baba ke kobor dikena ahibole dibi.”

english_text: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taike koise, “Moi laga piche koribi, aru mora manu khan ke taikhan nijorke kobor dibole dibi.”

english_text: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu naw bhitor te bohi loise, tai laga chela khan sob Tai piche korise.

english_text: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
nagamese_text: Aru sabi, ekta dangor andhi nodi pora uthibole shuru hoise, aru purah naw to hawa aru pani pora hiliai thakise. Kintu Jisu to ghumai thakise.

english_text: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
nagamese_text: Titia chela khan Tai usorte ahise aru eneka koi kene uthai dise, “Probhu, amikhan ke bacha bhi; amikhan mori bole ase!”

english_text: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan biswas komti thaka khan kele bhoi khai ase? Etu pichete Tai uthikena nodi aru hawa pani ke hukum dise. Titia sob chup-chap hoi jaise.

english_text: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
nagamese_text: Kintu sob manu asurit koi kene koise, “Etu ki kisim laga manu ase, hawa aru pani tak Tai laga kotha mane?”

english_text: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu samundar paar kori kene Gadarene laga desh te punchise, duijon manu jun logote biya atma ghusikena thakise, Jisu ke lok korise. Taikhan koboristan pora ulaikena ahise aru bisi khechera huwa pora manu khan etu rasta pora nabira hoise.

english_text: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”
nagamese_text: Sabi, taikhan hala kori kene koise, “Amikhan Apuni ke ki kori dibo, Isor laga Putro? Apuni homoi napuncha age te aha laga motlob to amikhan ke bisi dukh dibole ase naki?”

english_text: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.
nagamese_text: Utu somoite dur nohoi kene kunba gahori dana khai thakisele.

english_text: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”
nagamese_text: Aru biya atma khan Jisu ke anurodh kori kene koise, “Apuni amikhan ke khedai dibole ase koile, amikhan ke gahori khan laga gaw te ghusi bo dibi.”

english_text: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jabi!” Etu hukum diya pichete sob biya atma khan ulaise aru gahori laga gaw bhitor te ghusi jaise; aru sabi, etu sob gahori pahar upor pora polaikena nodi te girikena panite dubi mori jaise.

english_text: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.
nagamese_text: Kintu juntu gahori saithaka manu khan sheher te polaikena sob manu khan ke khobor dise.

english_text: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.
nagamese_text: Sabi, pura sheher laga manu khan Jisu ke lok kori bole ulai ahise. Jitia taikhan Jisu ke dikhise, taikhan Jisu ke anurodh korise aru etu jaga pora jai jabole koise.

english_text: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu naw te uthi loise aru nodi paar korise, aru tai nijor laga town, Capernaum te ahi jaise.

english_text: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”
nagamese_text: Sabi, manu khan ekjon jothor bemar thaka manu ke chatai te ghumai thaka ke loi anise. Jitia Jisu taikhan laga biswas dikhise, tai jothor bemar manu ke koise, “Putro, mon dangor koribi. Tumi laga paap sob maph kori dise.”

english_text: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”
nagamese_text: Titia sabi, niyom likha manu khan taikhan majote koise, “Etu manu Isor laga biya kotha koi ase.”

english_text: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan laga bhabona janikena koise, “Tumikhan ki hisab te mon bhitor te biya kotha bhabona kori ase?

english_text: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, kuntu he asan ase, ‘Tumikhan laga paapkhan sob maph kori dise,’ na, ‘Uthibi aru berabi’ etu thik ase?

english_text: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan ke jonai dibole, Manu laga Putro ke etu prithibi te adhikar dikena ase manu laga paapkhan maph kori bole,...” Etu pichete Tai etu manu ke koise, “Uthibi, tumi laga chatai lobi, aru nijor laga ghor te jabi.”

english_text: He arose and departed to his house.
nagamese_text: Titia etu manu uthise aru nijor ghor te jai jaise.

english_text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
nagamese_text: Jitia manu khan etu dikhise, taikhan asurit hoise aru Isor ke mohima dise, jun he manu khan ke eneka adhikar dise koi kene.

english_text: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu jaga paar hoi kene jai thakise, tai Matthew koi kene ekjon manu ke dikhise, jun poisa utha laga jagate kaam kori thakise. Tai pora taike koise, “Ami laga piche koribi.” Aru tai uthise aru Jisu laga piche korise.

english_text: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise, jitia Jisu Matthew laga ghor te bohi kene bhat khabole hoise, sabi, bisi poisa utha manu khan aru dusra paapi manu khan bhi ahise aru Jisu aru tai laga chela khan sob eke logote khaise.

english_text: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
nagamese_text: Jitia kunba Pharisee khan etu dikhise, taikhan Jisu laga chela khan ke hudise, “Kile apnikhan laga malik to poisa utha aru dusra paapi manu khan logote milikena khai ase?”

english_text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu hunise, Tai koise, “Jun laga gaw sob thik ase, taike bemar bhal kora manu nalage, khali jun khan bemar ase taikhan ke lage.

english_text: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan jabi aru sikhibi Isor laga kotha te etu laga motlob ki ase: ‘Ami to tumikhan boli diya to nalage, hoilebi daya kora to Moi laga itcha ase.’ Kilekoile Ami dhormik khan ke mati bole aha nohoi, kintu paapi manu khan karone ahise.’”

english_text: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”
nagamese_text: Aru ek din, John laga chela khan Tai logote ahikena koise, “Kile Pharisee aru amikhan upwas kore, kintu Apuni laga chela khan to nakore?”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jawan dise, “Shadi te aha khan mon dukh hoi kene shadi kora jon logote thake naki? Kintu utu din ahibo jitia shadi kora jonke taikhan pora loijabo, aru etu pichete taikhan upwas lobo.

english_text: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
nagamese_text: Kun manu bhi ekta notun kapra ke purana kapra logote silai kene nalagai, kele koile etu kapra laga silakhan sob ulai jabo, aru bisi biya pora phati jabo.

english_text: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”
nagamese_text: Nohoi lebi manu khan purana angur ros ke notun chamra laga jola te nadhale. Nohoile, chamra jola to phati jabo, aru angur ros to pura giri jabo aru chamra jola pura biya hoi jabo. Hoilebi, taikhan notun chamra jola te notun angur ros hale, eneka hoile duita bhi bhal thakibo.”

english_text: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai eitu khan taikhan ke koi thakise, sabi, ekjon sahab ahise aru Jisu age te matha jhukise. Tai koise, “Moi laga chukri etiya mori jaise, kintu Apuni ahibi aru tai uporte Apuni laga hath lagai dibi, aru tai jinda hoi jabo.”

english_text: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu uthise aru tai logote jaise, aru Tai laga chela khan bhi piche ahise.

english_text: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
nagamese_text: Sabi, ekjon mahila jun baroh saal pora khun jai thaka bemar pora dukh pai thakise, tai Jisu laga piche ahikena Tai laga kapra kinar te chuise.

english_text: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu mahila pora tai nijorke koise, “Khali Tai laga kapra chuile, ami bhal hoi jabo.”

english_text: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu piche ghurise aru taike saikene koise, “Chukri, mon dangor kori lobi; apuni laga biswas pora bhal hoise.” Aru utu homoi te etu mahila ke changai paise.

english_text: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu utu daruga laga ghor te punchise, aru Tai pora basuri baja manu khan aru dangor bhir joma hoi kene hala kori thaka dikhise.

english_text: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Jai jabi, kele koile etu chukri mora nai, kintu tai ghumai ase.” Kintu etu manu khan Jisu ke hasi di thakise.

english_text: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.
nagamese_text: Jitia joma koi kene thaka manu khan sobke bahar te pathai dise, Tai ghor bhitor te ghusi se aru etu chukri ke hath pora dhurise, aru etu chukri uthijaise.

english_text: The report of this went out into all that land.
nagamese_text: Aru etu laga khobor utu desh sob te punchi jaise.

english_text: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”
nagamese_text: Jisu jitia berai jai thakise, duijon andha manu tai piche korise. Taikhan hala kori kene koise, “Amikhan ke daya koribi, David laga Putro!”

english_text: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu ghor te punchise, andha khan tai usorte ahise. Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan biswas kore na nai ami etu koribo pare koi kene?” Taikhan koise, “Hoi, Probhu.”

english_text: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taikhan laga suku chuise, aru koise, “Tumikhan laga biswas hisab te hoi jabi,”

english_text: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
nagamese_text: aru taikhan laga suku khuli jaise. Jisu pora taikhan ke kara pora hukum dikene eneka koise, “Sabi etu kotha khan kunke bhi janibo nadibi.”

english_text: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu duijon manu bahar te ulai jaise aru sob desh te etu laga khobor koi dise.

english_text: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
nagamese_text: Tai duijon jai thaka somoite, sabi, ekjon bhoot atma ghumai kene ghunga thaka manu ke Jisu usorte anise.

english_text: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
nagamese_text: Jitia bhoot atma ke khedai dise, tai kotha kori bole parise. Sob manu dikhi kene asurit hoise, aru koise, “Eneka asurit kaam to kitia bhi Israel desh te dikha nai!”

english_text: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Pharisee khan eneka koise, “Bhoot atma laga cholawta huwa nimite, tai bhoot atma ke kheda bole pari ase.”

english_text: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
nagamese_text: Jisu sob sheher khan aru bosti khan te berai kene jaise. Tai mondoli khan te jai kene rajyo laga susamachar khan sikhai thakise aru sob biya bemar khan ke bhal korise.

english_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai manu joma koi kene thaka dikhise, Tai bisi morom lagise, kele koile taikhan bisi dukh aru chinta hoi kene thakise, jineka mer khan laga ekjon rokhiya nathaka nisena.

english_text: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu taikhan laga chela khan ke koise, “Dhan bisi pakki kene ase, kintu kati bole manu komti ase.

english_text: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, joldi Probhu ke prathana kori bhi, titia Tai kaam kori bole manu khan ke pathai dibo.”

english_text: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
nagamese_text: Jisu tai laga baroh ta chela khan sobke matise aru taikhan ke atma khan kheda bole aru sob bemar khan bhal kori bole adhikar dise.

english_text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
nagamese_text: Etiya etu baroh ta chela khan laga naam khan eneka thakise. Poila, Simon -junke Peter koi kene mate-, aru tai laga bhai Andrew; James, Zebedee laga chokra, aru tai laga bhai John;

english_text: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
nagamese_text: Philip, aru Bartholomew; Thomas, aru Matthew ekjon poisa utha manu; James, Alphaeus laga chokra, aru Thaddaeus;

english_text: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
nagamese_text: Simon ekjon Zealot, aru Judas Iscariot, jun Jisu ke thogabo.
