nagamese_text: Jitia tai kotha kori thakise, sabi, ekta ujala badal taikhan ke bondh kori dise, aru etu badal pora ekta awaj ulaikena eneka koise, “Etu Moi laga bisi morom Putro ase, jun uporte moi bisi khushi ase. Tai laga kotha huni bhi.”

english_text: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
nagamese_text: Jitia tinjon chela khan etu hunise, taikhan bisi bhoi kori kene matite girise aru nijor chehera mati phale saise.

english_text: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu ahise aru taikhan ke chui kene koise, “Uthibi aru bhoi na koribi.”

english_text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete taikhan suku uthaikene saise, kintu taikhan khali Jisu he nohoile dusra kunke bhi dikha nai.

english_text: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan jitia pahar upor pora nami ahi thakise, Jisu taikhan ke hukum dise, eneka koi kene, “Etu laga sapna kunke bhi nakobi jitia tak Manu laga Putro mora pora arubi jinda nohoi jai.”

english_text: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
nagamese_text: Tai laga chela khan Taike eneka koi kene hudise, “Tenehoile kele kunba niyom likha manu khan Elijah he poila ahibo lage koi?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dikene koise, “Elijah hosa pora bhi ahibo aru sob to thik kori dibo.

english_text: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Elijah to poila pora ahi jaise, kintu taikhan taike chini bole para nai. Ulta, tai uporte ki kori bole itcha thakise taikhan etu kori dise. Thik eneka he, Manu Laga Putro bhi taikhan laga hathte bisi dukh pabo.”

english_text: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
nagamese_text: Titia he chela khan bujise Tai John Baptizma laga kotha taikhan ke kori thakise koi kene.

english_text: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan manu joma hoi thaka jagate ahise, ekjon manu Tai usorte ahise, Tai age te athukari se,

english_text: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Probhu, moi laga chokra uporte daya koribi, kele koile tai pagla hoi kene ase, aru bisi dukh pai ase. Kilekoile tai khali jui uporte giri thake, aru khali panite ghusi thake.

english_text: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
nagamese_text: Moi taike Apuni laga chela khan usorte ani sele, kintu taikhan bhal kori bole para nai.”

english_text: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dikene koise, “Biswas nathaka aru biya jamana laga manu khan, aru kiman deri nimite Moi tumikhan logote thakibo lagibo? Kiman deri tumikhan ke dhorjo koribo? Taike Moi laga samne te anibi.”

english_text: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora bhoot atma ke khedai dise, aru etu atma tai laga gaw pora ulai jaise, aru utu somoite etu chokra to bhal hoi jaise.

english_text: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu laga chela khan lukai kene Taike koise, “Kile amikhan bhoot ke kheda bole para nai?”

english_text: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Kile mane tumikhan laga biswas komti thaka nimite. Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, jodi tumikhan sorso dana nisena hoilebi biswas thakile, tumikhan etu pahar ke kobo, ‘Yate pora hati kene ta te jabi,’ aru etu hati jabo, aru tumikhan nimite eku bhi napara kaam nohobo.

english_text: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan sob to, prathana aru upwas pora nohoile dusra eku pora na paribo.”

english_text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Galilee te thakise, Jisu Tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Manu laga Putro ke manu khan laga hath di dibo,

english_text: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan pora Taike morai dibo, aru tin dinte Taike mora pora uthai dibo.” Etu huni kene chela khan bisi mon dukh hoise.

english_text: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Capernaum jagate punchise, ekjon manu jun dui taka chandi poisa utha manu Peter usorte ahise aru koise, “Apnikhan laga Shika manu to dui taka chandi poisa to diye na nai?”

english_text: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Hoi.” Jitia Peter ghor te ghusi loise, Jisu taike poila kotha korise, eneka koi kene, “Tumi ki bhabe, Simon? Kun logot pora prithibi laga raja khan poisa uthai? Taikhan laga bacha khan pora na dusra khan pora?”

english_text: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai koise, “Dusra khan pora,” Jisu taike koise, “Tinehoile bacha khan nimite ene to eku daam nai.”

english_text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan nimite poisa utha manu ke paap koribo nadibo, etu nimite nodi te jabi, ekta maas dhura kata phelabi aru juntu maas ke poila pai etu ke loi kene anibi. Jitia tumi maas laga mukh khuli loi, ta te charta chandi pabo. Lobi aru jai kene poisa utha manu ke tumi aru Ami nimite bhi dibi.”

english_text: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
nagamese_text: Utu somoite Jisu laga chela khan Tai usorte ahise aru koise, “Tinehoile kun sorgo laga rajyote sobse dangor ase?”

english_text: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them
nagamese_text: Jisu pora Tai usorte ekta bacha ke mati kene taikhan majote bohise,

english_text: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, jitia tak apuni chutu bacha khan nisena nohoi, tumikhan ekjon bhi sorgo laga rajyote ghusi bole na paribo.

english_text: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jun manu nijorke ekta bacha nisena chutu koribo, tai he sorgo laga rajyote sobse dangor ase.

english_text: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
nagamese_text: Jun manu chutu bacha khan ke etu nisena Moi laga naam te ahibole diye tai Moike pai jai.

english_text: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi etu bacha khan majote ekjon bhi Moike biswas kore, aru kunba manu utu bacha ke paap kaam kori bole diye koile, utu manu nimite dangor pathor tai laga gola te bandhi kene nodi te dubi le he bhal hobo.

english_text: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
nagamese_text: Etu prithibi laga manu khan ke bisi morom lage, juntu kaam khan nimite taikhan paap kori ase. Eitu khan sob purah hobo lage, kintu utu manu khan uporte aru dangor sajai hobo jun etu paap kaam hobole di ase.

english_text: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumi laga hath nohoile theng nimite tumike girai de koile, etu ke kati dibi aru tumi laga gaw pora phelai dibi. Tumi nimite duita hath aru theng thaki kene norokte ja pora to gaw te hath nohoile theng nathaki kene sorgote ja to he bhal hobo.

english_text: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumi laga suku nimite paap koribo diye koile, ulai dibi aru tumi laga gaw pora phelai dibi. Kilekoile tumi nimite duita suku thaki kene norokte ja pora to gaw te ekta suku thaki kene sorgote ja he bhal hobo.

english_text: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Hoshiar thakibi, etu chutu bacha khan eku kaam nai koi kene nabhabi bhi. Kilekoile Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, taikhan laga sorgodoth khan pora Moi laga sorgote thaka Baba laga chehera hodai sai thake.

english_text: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Manu laga Putro to harai ja khan nimite ahise.

english_text: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?
nagamese_text: Tumikhan ki bhabona ase? Jodi ekjon manu logote eksoh mer khan ase, aru ekta harai jaise koile, tai ninyanve mer khan ke pahar te chari kene, ekta harai ja ke bisaribo nohoi?

english_text: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.
nagamese_text: Jodi tai pai jai, Moi hosa pora koi ase, utu ninyanve mer khan pora bhi harai ja ekta pai ja-a nimite bisi khushi hobo.

english_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.
nagamese_text: Thik etu nisena, Sorgote thaka Baba laga itcha nohoi eitu khan nisena ekjon chutu hoile bhi harai jabole.

english_text: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumi laga bhai pora tumi uporte paap korise koile, jabi aru tai laga golti koi dibi, tai aru tumi ekla duijon majote. Jodi tai tumi laga kotha hune koile, tumi laga bhai ke jiti loise.

english_text: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi tai tumi laga kotha nahune koile, ekjon duijon ke tumi logote loijabi, eneka hoile duijon tinjon manu pora ki hoise, eitu khan taikhan laga mukh pora jani jabo.

english_text: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi taikhan laga kotha khan bhi nahune koile, girja ke etu laga kotha to koi dibi. Jodi tai girja laga bhi kotha nahune koile, taike ekjon Porjati aru poisa utha manu nisena chari di bhi.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
nagamese_text: Moi hosa pora koi ase tumikhan ke, ki jinis khan prithibi te bandibo etu sorgote bhi hobo; aru ji jinis khan prithibi te chari bo etu sorgote bhi hobo.

english_text: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Aru bhi Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koise, jodi duijon majote mon mili kene ki karone hoile bhi mangise koile, taikhan nimite Moi laga Baba jun sorgote ase eitu khan kori dibo.

english_text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile juntu jagate duijon tinjon Moi naam te joma kore, taikhan majote Moi ase.”

english_text: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Peter ahise aru Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, kiman bar moi laga bhai ami uporte paap kaam koribo aru taike maph dibo? Sat bar tak?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi tumike sat bar tak koribo kowa nai, kintu sattar laga sat bar tak.

english_text: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
nagamese_text: Etu karone sorgo laga rajyo to ekjon raja nisena jun tai laga kaam kora manu logote hisab-kitab kori bole itcha kori loise.

english_text: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai hisab-kitab kori bole shuru hoise, tai usorte ekjon nokor ke loi anise, jun tai logot pora dos hajar talent pabo thakise.

english_text: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai logote eku pora bhi baki tirabole thaka nai, etu pora malik pora tai aru tai laga maiki bacha khan aru taikhan logot ki thakise etu sob bikiri koridi kene dhar tirabole hukum dise.

english_text: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
nagamese_text: Etu huni kene nokor matite girise aru malik age te athukari kene mangise, ‘Malik, amike olop somoi dibi, aru ami apuni ke sob tirai dibo.’

english_text: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.
nagamese_text: Aru malik tai laga kotha huni kene morom lagi jaise, aru tai laga dhar maph kori dise aru taike chari dise.

english_text: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’
nagamese_text: Kintu, jitia etu nokor bahar te ulaise, tai logote ek sou denarii dhaar luwa nokor ke dikhise. Tai utu nokor ke gola te jor pora dhori kene eneka koise, ‘Moi laga ki dhar ase etu tirabi.’

english_text: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete utu nokor nichete girise aru taike kandi kene maph mangise, eneka koi kene, ‘Amike olop somoi dibi, aru ami apuni ke sob tirai dibo.’

english_text: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.
nagamese_text: Kintu utu age laga nokor to eneka kori bole itcha thaka nai. Ulta, tai jaise aru bondhi ghor bhitor te hali dise, jitia tak tai laga dhar natirai.

english_text: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.
nagamese_text: Etu karone jitia dusra nokorkhan etu dikhise, taikhan bisi mon biya hoise, aru jai kene malik ke ki hoise etu sob koi dise.

english_text: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete etu nokor laga malik taike matise, aru koise, ‘Tumi mon kala thaka nokor, moi tumi laga dhar khan sob maph kori dise, kele koile tumi kandi kene moike maph manga nimite.

english_text: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
nagamese_text: Tumi bhi nijor manu ke daya koribo para nai, jineka moi tumi uporte daya korise?’

english_text: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.
nagamese_text: Aru malik gusa thakise aru taike sajai diya manu laga hathte dise, jitia tak tai baki khan natirai.

english_text: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”
nagamese_text: Etu nisena Moi laga sorgote thaka Baba bhi tumikhan ke eneka koribo, jitia tak tumikhan nijor bhai kokai khan ke maph nakoribo.”

english_text: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise, jitia Jisu eitu khan koi kene khotom hoise, tai Galilee pora ulaise, aru Jordan nodi laga paar thaka Judah jagate ahise.

english_text: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.
nagamese_text: Aru bisi manu khan tai laga piche-piche ahise; aru Tai ta te taikhan ke changai korise.

english_text: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
nagamese_text: Pharisee khan bhi tai usorte ahise, taike porikha kori bole lagise, aru taike koise, “Ki nimite hoile bhi ekjon manu tai laga maiki ke chari bole niyom ase na nai?

english_text: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
nagamese_text: Aru Tai jowab te taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan Isor kotha te purah nai, Tai jun prothom te sristi bonaise, taikhan ke mota aru mahila bonaise?

english_text: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?
nagamese_text: Aru koise, ‘etu nimite ekjon manu baba aru ama ke chari bo, aru tai laga maiki logote jabo: aru tai duijon ekta sharir hoi jabo.’

english_text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
nagamese_text: Eneka pora taikhan aru duita nohoi, hoile bhi ekta sharir hoijai. Etu nimite Isor ki eke logote milai dise, manu khan etu ke alag na koribi.”

english_text: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan koise, “Tinehoile kele Moses koise chara-chari laga ekta kagos likhi bole, aru taike chari dibole?”

english_text: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.
nagamese_text: Tai taikhan ke koise, “Kilekoile tumikhan laga mon to bisi tan ase etu nimite Moses pora tumikhan laga maiki chari dibole koise: hoile bhi age te eneka thaka nai.

english_text: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
nagamese_text: Aru Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, jun bhi tai laga maiki ke chari bo, khali bebichar kotha karone chari kene, aru dusra ke shadi koribo, tai bebichar laga kaam kore: aru jun utu pora chari diye maiki ke shadi koribo, tai bebichar laga kaam kore.”

english_text: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”
nagamese_text: Tai laga chela khan taike koise, “Ekjon manu tai laga maiki logote eneka ase koile, shadi nakora he bhal ase.”

english_text: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi tai taikhan ke koise, “Sob manu khan etu kotha ke lobole na paribo, khali taikhan ke chari kene jun khan ke etu dise.

english_text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ta te kunba hijira khan asele, jun khan taikhan laga ama laga pet pora he eneka jonom hoise: aru ta te kunba hijira thakise jun khan ke manu khan pora hijira bonaise: aru ta te kunba hijira khan thakise jun khan sorgo laga desh nimite nije ke hijira bonaise. Tai jun etu ke lobole pare, taike lobole dibi.”

english_text: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete, dusra khan pora Tai usorte chutu-chutu bacha khan ke anise, Tai laga hath taikhan uporte rakhi kene asirbad koribo nimite, kintu chela khan pora taikhan ke gali dise.

english_text: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi Jisu pora baroh jonke koise, “Bacha khan ke ahibole dibi, Ami logote ahibole taikhan ke narukhabi, kele koile sorgo laga rajyo taikhan nisena pora he ase.”

english_text: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu pora taikhan uporte hath rakhise aru taikhan ke asirbad dise, aru ta te pora jai jaise.

english_text: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
nagamese_text: Sabi, ekjon manu Jisu usorte ahise aru hudise, “Shika manu, moi anonto jibon pabo nimite ki bhal kaam koribo lagibo?”

english_text: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Tumi kele Moike bhal to ki ase koi kene hudi ase? Khali Ekjon he bhal ase, kintu jodi tumi sorgote ghusi bole mon ase koile, Isor laga niyom khan mani bhi.”

english_text: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’
nagamese_text: Etu manu Taike koise, “Kuntu niyom?” Jisu koise, “Morai nadibi, bebichar kaam na koribi, chor nakuribi, misa gawahi nadibi,

english_text: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”
nagamese_text: Ama aru baba ke sonman koribi, aru ghor usorte thaka manu ke morom koribi jineka nijorke kora nisena.”

english_text: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
nagamese_text: Aru etu jawan manu pora Taike koise, “Eitu khan sob ami mani loise. Aru ami ki koribo lagi ase?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Jodi tumi pura thik hobole itcha ase koile, jabi, tumi logote ki ase sob bikiri kori dibi aru gorib manu khan ke di dibi, aru sorgote tumi laga dhun sompoti pabo; aru ahibi, Ami laga piche koribi.”

english_text: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia etu jawan Jisu ki koise huni loise, tai mon dukh hoi kene jai jaise, kele koile tai logote bisi dhun sompoti thakise.

english_text: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
nagamese_text: Jisu tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, ekjon dhuni manu nimite sorgo laga rajyote ghusi bole digdar ase.

english_text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Arubi Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, ekjon dhuni manu Isor laga rajyote gusa pora to ekta uth bhiji laga chenda bhitor pora paar kori kene ghusa to he asan hobo.”

english_text: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”
nagamese_text: Jitia chela khan etu hunise, taikhan bisi asurit hoise, eneka koi kene, “Tinehoile kunkhan he bachibo?”

english_text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan ke saise aru koise, “Manu khan nimite etu napara kaam ase, kintu Isor nimite sob pare.”

english_text: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”
