nagamese_text: Etu pichete, utu malik tai nijor laga chokra ke pathai, eneka koi kene, ‘Taikhan Moi laga chokra ke sonman koribo.’

english_text: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia kheti kora manu khan tai laga chokra ke dikhise, kheti kora khan nijor majote koi, ‘Malik hobole thaka to etu ase. Ahibi, amikhan taike morai dibo aru tai laga sompoti laga malik hoi jabo.’

english_text: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.
nagamese_text: Eneka hoi kene taikhan pora taike dhori loise, aru angur laga kheti te loi kene morai de.

english_text: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
nagamese_text: Etiya, jitia utu kheti laga malik ahe, Tai pora utu kheti kora manu khan ke ki koribo?”

english_text: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke koise, “Tai utu manu khan ke biya pora khotom kori dibo, aru kheti to dusra khan ke kheti kori bole di dibo, aru taikhan pora Taike kheti kata somoite taikhan laga kheti te ula bostu ani dibo.”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan kitia bhi Isor kotha pura nai, ‘Ekta pathor junke ghor bona manu pora phelai diye, Etu pathor he sob ghor laga asol pathor hoijai. Etu to Isor pora he ase, Aru etu to amikhan laga suku te ekdom bhal ase?’

english_text: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
nagamese_text: Etu karone Ami tumikhan ke koi ase, tumikhan logot pora Isor laga rajyo to loijabo aru utu desh ke di dibo jun bhal phol dhure.

english_text: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
nagamese_text: Jun khan etu pathor uporte giri bo tai bhangi kene mihin hoi jabo. Kintu jun manu uporte etu giri bo, taike chipai dibo.”

english_text: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
nagamese_text: Jitia mukhyo purohit aru Pharisee khan Tai laga dristanto hunise, taikhan bujhi jaise Tai taikhan laga kotha kori ase koi kene.

english_text: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke dhori bole bisari thakise, kintu taikhan manu khan ke bhoi khai thakise, kele koile manu khan Jisu ke ekjon bhabobadi ase koi kene mani thakise.

english_text: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise aru taikhan ke dristanto pora kotha korise, eneka koi kene,

english_text: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,
nagamese_text: “Sorgo laga rajyo eneka ase jineka ekjon raja pora tai chokra laga shadi nimite kha luwa khan taiyar korise.

english_text: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.
nagamese_text: Raja pora nokorkhan ke pathaikena shadi te mata manu khan ke bisari bole dise, kintu kunbi ahibole mon thaka nai.

english_text: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’
nagamese_text: Aru bhi raja pora tai laga dusra nokorkhan ke eneka koi kene pathaise, ‘Jai kene shadi te mata manu khan ke kobi, “Sabi, Ami pora kha luwa bonai kene ase. Moi laga bhal guru aru mosto saguli khan ke morai dise, aru sob to taiyar hoi kene ase. Shadi laga kha luwa kori bole ahibi.’”

english_text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan mon diya nai aru jai jaise, kunba kheti kori bole, aru kunba nijor dukan te jai jaise.

english_text: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.
nagamese_text: Aru kunba to raja laga nokorkhan ke dhori loise, aru sorom dibole laga kaam korise, aru morai dise.

english_text: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
nagamese_text: Raja bisi khong uthise, aru tai laga sipahi khan ke pathaise aru tai laga nokor ke morai diya manu khan ke morai dise aru taikhan laga sheher ke julai dise.

english_text: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete tai laga nokorkhan ke koise, ‘Shadi laga kha luwa taiyar hoise, kintu jun manu khan ke matise, taikhan shadi te ahibole thik nohoi.

english_text: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
nagamese_text: Etu nimite rasta khan te jabi aru tumikhan junke lok pai taikhan sobke shadi laga bhat khabole mati bhi.’

english_text: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete raja laga nokorkhan rasta khan te jaise aru jiman bhal aru biya manu khan ke lok paise, taikhan sobke joma kori kene anise, aru shadi laga ghor te manu khan pora bhorta hoise.

english_text: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia raja ahikena manu khan ke saise, tai ekjon manu ke shadi laga kapra napindi kene thaka dikhise.

english_text: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.
nagamese_text: Aru raja pora taike koise, ‘Sathi, tumi shadi laga kapra napindi kene kineka yate ahise?’ Kintu etu manu eku bhi kobole para nai.

english_text: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete raja pora tai laga nokorkhan ke koise, ‘Etu manu laga theng aru hath bandhi bhi, aru andhera jagate phelai dibi, juntu jagate tai khali kandi thakibo aru daat kamuri thakibo.’

english_text: For many are called, but few chosen.”
nagamese_text: Bisi manu khan ke mati sele, kintu khali kunba khan ke he basi loise.”

english_text: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete kunba Pharisee khan jaise aru Jisu ke Tai nijor laga kotha pora phasai dibole taikhan kotha kori thakise.

english_text: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete taikhan laga chela aru Herod laga manu khan ke milai kene Jisu logote pathaise. Taikhan koise, “Shika manu, amikhan jane Apuni to hosa ase, aru Apuni Isor laga hosa rasta pora sikhai diye. Kun laga kotha bhi apuni hisab nakore, kele koile Apuni to manu laga chehera nasai.

english_text: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
nagamese_text: Tinehoile amikhan ke kobi, Apuni ki bhabe? Caesar ke poisa diya to thik niyom ase na nai?”

english_text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan laga biya chal jani jaise aru koise, “Tumi kopoti khan kele Moike porikha kori ase?

english_text: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
nagamese_text: Amike kar diya laga chandi poisa to dikha bhi.” Etu pichete taikhan ekta chandi poisa anikena Jisu ke dise.

english_text: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke dikhai kene koise, “Etu kun laga noksa aru naam ase?”

english_text: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke koise, “Caesar laga.” Etu pichete Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tinehoile ki to Caesar laga ase etu taike dibi, aru ki to Isor laga ase eitu khan Isor ke dibi.”

english_text: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan asurit hoise. Etu pichete taikhan Jisu ke chari kene jaise.

english_text: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,
nagamese_text: Eke dinte kunba Sadducee khan, jun khan punoruthan te biswas nakore, taikhan Jisu usorte ahise. Taikhan Jisu ke eneka hudise,

english_text: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’
nagamese_text: “Shika manu, Moses pora koise, ‘Jodi kunba manu bacha nathaki kene mori jai, tai laga bhai to tai laga maiki ke shadi koribo lage aru tai laga kokai nimite bacha jonom dibo lage.’

english_text: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
nagamese_text: Etiya, taikhan majote satta bhai kokai khan thakise. Poila, dangor kokai shadi korise aru mori jaise. Bacha nathaka karone, etu maiki ke mora manu laga dusra bhai nimite rakhidise.

english_text: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete dusra bhai bhi eneka he korise, aru dusra bhai bhi, eneka kori kene pura sat-ta bhai koikai shadi korise.

english_text: After them all, the woman died.
nagamese_text: Sob bhai kokai khan morija pichete, utu maiki bhi mori jai.

english_text: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
nagamese_text: Etiya, mori kene jinda huwa dinte, sat-ta bhai kokai majote, tai kun laga maiki hobo? Kilekoile taikhan sob etu maiki ke shadi kori sele.”

english_text: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan ke jowab dikene koise, “Tumikhan golti ase, kelemane tumikhan shastro najane aru Isor laga hokti bhi najane.

english_text: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile mori kene jinda huwa manu khan shadi nakore aru shadi nimite nadiye. Hoilebi, taikhan duth khan nisena sorgote thake.

english_text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
nagamese_text: Kintu, mori kene jee utha laga kotha to, tumikhan Isor laga kotha koi diya te pura nai naki, eneka koi kene thaka,

english_text: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
nagamese_text: ‘Moi Abraham, Isaac, aru Jacob laga Isor ase?’ Isor to mora manu khan laga Isor nohoi, kintu jinda manu khan laga Isor ase.”

english_text: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.
nagamese_text: Jitia joma hoi kene thaka manu khan Jisu laga sikhai diya kotha hunise, taikhan asurit hoise.

english_text: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Pharisee khan Jisu pora Sadducee khan laga mukh chup kori diya hunise, taikhan eke logote mili kene joma hoise.

english_text: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan majote, ekjon ukil, Jisu ke porikha kori bole ekta kotha hudise-

english_text: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
nagamese_text: “Shika manu, sob niyom laga majote, kuntu niyom he sob pora dangor ase?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “‘Tumi laga Isor ke pura mon pora, aru pura atma, aru pura bhabona pora morom koribi.’

english_text: This is the first and great commandment.
nagamese_text: Etu he sob pora dangor aru poila niyom ase.

english_text: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
nagamese_text: Aru dusra niyom to eneka ase- ‘Nijorke morom kora nisena tumi laga ghor usor manu khan ke bhi morom koribi.’

english_text: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
nagamese_text: Jiman niyom aru bhabobadi khan laga kotha khan ase, etu duita niyom uporte khara ase.”

english_text: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,
nagamese_text: Etiya, jitia Pharisee khan sob joma hoi kene thaka somoite, Jisu taikhan ke ekta kotha hudise.

english_text: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Tumikhan Khrista ke ki bhabe? Tai kun laga Putro ase?” Taikhan koise, “David laga Putro.”

english_text: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tinehoile kineka kori kene David to atma te Taike probhu koi kene mate, eneka koi kene,

english_text: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?
nagamese_text: ‘Isor pora moi laga Probhu ke koise, “Moi laga dyna hathte bohibi, Jitia tak Moi tumi laga dushman khan ke tumi laga theng nichete na ane’”?

english_text: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
nagamese_text: Jodi David pora Khrista ke ‘Probhu’ matise, tinehoile kineka Tai David laga chokra hobo?”

english_text: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.
nagamese_text: Kun bhi Jisu ke ekta jowab bhi dibole para nai, aru utu din pora kun bhi Taike ekta kotha bhi nahuda hoise.

english_text: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu tai laga chela aru joma hoi kene thaka manu khan ke kotha korise.

english_text: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Niom likha khan aru Pharisee khan Moses boha jagate bohe.

english_text: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
nagamese_text: Etu karone taikhan ki hukum diye tumikhan etu koribi, aru sai thakibi. Kintu taikhan laga kaam hisab te na koribi, kele koile taikhan mukh pora koi, hoile bhi kaam pora nakore.

english_text: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan juntu saman bhari hoi eitu khan bandhi diye aru bukhi bole digdar hoijai, aru manu khan laga kandha te rakhi diye. Kintu taikhan nijor laga anguli bhi uthabole itcha nakore.

english_text: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,
nagamese_text: Taikhan dikha bole nimite he bhal niyom khan kore. Kilekoile taikhan matha te chamra laga boksa dangor bonai kene bandhe, aru taikhan kapra laga rusi khan dangor kore.

english_text: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,
nagamese_text: Taikhan bisi sonman pa-a jagate kha luwa kora khushi pai, aru mondoli te bisi sonman pa jagate bohe.

english_text: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.
nagamese_text: Aru bajar te taikhan ke ekdom salam diya aru ‘Rabbi’ koi kene manu khan pora mata khushi pai.

english_text: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan ke ‘Rabbi’ koi kene matibo dibo nalage kele koile khali ekjon he Shika manu ase, aru tumikhan sob bhai kokai ase.

english_text: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan ke ‘Baba’ koi kene matibo nadibi, kele koile tumikhan laga khali ekjon he Baba Isor ase, jun sorgote ase.

english_text: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan ke ‘Shika manu’ koi matibo nadibi, kele koile tumikhan laga hikhok to Khrista he ase.

english_text: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan majote kun bisi dangor ase tai to tumi laga nokor hobo.

english_text: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
nagamese_text: Jun khan nijorke uthai thake taike nomro kori dibo, aru jun khan nijorke nomro koribo taike uthai dibo.

english_text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.
nagamese_text: Kintu, O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Tumikhan dusra manu khan nimite sorgo rajyo bondh kori diye. Kilekoile tumikhan nijor naghuse, aru ghusi bole thaka dusra khan ke bhi ghusi bole nadiye.

english_text: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan bidhowa khan ke thogai kene taikhan laga ghor chingi loi. Etu pichete girja te jai kene manu khan ke dikha bole lamba prathana kore. Tumikhan uporte sobse biya sajai hobo.

english_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan samundar pora aru dusra desh khan te jai kene tumikhan laga dhorom mani bole mon ghura bo diye, aru jitia tai tumikhan laga niyom to mani loi, tumikhan taike poila pora bhi aru bisi norok laga bacha bonai de.

english_text: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
nagamese_text: Tumikhan ke hai ase, tumikhan andha hoi kene rasta dikhai thaka khan, tumikhan jun koi, ‘Jun manu mondoli laga naam loi kene kosom khai, etu eku nohoi. Kintu jun manu mondoli laga suna chandi laga naam loi kene kosom khai, tai etu kosom rakhibo lage.’

english_text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
nagamese_text: Tumi murkho aru andha manu khan! Kuntu sob pora dangor ase, suna chandi na utu mondoli jun pora suna chandi khan ke pobitro bonai?

english_text: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’
nagamese_text: Aru, ‘Jun manu bedi laga kosom khai, etu eku nohoi. Kintu jun manu Isor laga bedi te daan thaka laga kosom khai, tai etu kosom manibo lagibo.’

english_text: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
nagamese_text: O Tumikhan murkho aru andha manu khan! Kuntu sob pora dangor ase, utu daan khan na Isor laga bedi jun pora etu daan ke pobitro bonai diye?

english_text: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jun manu Isor laga bedi laga kosom khai, tai etu aru etu logote thaka sob saman khan laga kosom khai loi.

english_text: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.
nagamese_text: Jun ekjon mondoli laga kosom khai, tai etu mondoli aru mondoli ghor te thaka Isor laga kosom khai loi.

english_text: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.
nagamese_text: Aru jun sorgo laga kosom khai, tai Isor laga singhason aru Tai usorte boha khan sob laga kosom khai loi.

english_text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan pudina, aru pata, aru dhaniya laga dos bhag di thake, aru bisi ujon thaka niyom, faisla, maph, aru biswas laga kotha khan ke chari diye- eitu khan bhi kori bole laga asele, hoilebi dusra khan bhi nakorikena nacharibo lage.

english_text: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!
nagamese_text: Tumikhan andha cholawta khan, jun khan makhi dikhile ghin lage, aru ekta uth-janwar ke khai loi.

english_text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan kup aru thali laga bahar phale sapha kori thake, hoile bhi bhitor te to joborjosti pora luwa aru lalchi pora bhorta ase.

english_text: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
nagamese_text: Tumi andha Pharisee, poila kup aru thali laga bhitor te ki ase etu ke sapha koribi, titia eitu khan laga bahar khan bhi nijor pora sapha hoi jabo.

english_text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan chuna mara pathor laga kobor nisena ase, juntu bahar pora sundur dikhe, hoile bhi bhitor te mora manu khan laga hardi khan, aru sob moila khan pora bhorta ase.

english_text: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
nagamese_text: Thik eneka nisena tumikhan bhi bahar pora manu khan usorte hosa te thaka nisena dikhe, hoilebi bhitor te misa misi aru paap pora bhorta ase.

english_text: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,
nagamese_text: O niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan, tumi kopoti khan ke hai ase! Kilekoile tumikhan utu bhabobadi khan laga kobor khan bonaise, aru utu dharmikta te thaka manu khan laga pathor laga kobor ke sundur pora korise,

english_text: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’
nagamese_text: Aru koise, ‘Amikhan baba laga baba khan laga homoi te amikhan thakise koile, amikhan etu bhabobadi khan laga khun phelai diya te bhag nolobole thakise.’

english_text: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
nagamese_text: Eneka pora tumikhan nije pora he koi ase tumikhan taikhan laga bacha khan ase jun khan pora bhabobadi khan ke morai dise.

english_text: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite tumikhan baba laga baba khan laga hisab ke tumikhan bhorta koribi.

english_text: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?
nagamese_text: Tumikhan saph khan, saph laga khandan khan, kineka pora tumikhan norok laga sajai pora polabole paribo?

english_text: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, sabi, Ami tumikhan ke bhabobadi aru gyaani aru niyom likha khan ke pathai ase. Kunba khan ke tumikhan pora morai dibo aru Cross uporte maribo, aru kunba khan ke tumikhan Isor laga kotha kora ghor te tumikhan pora chabuk pora maribo aru ekta sheher pora dusra sheher laga bahar te khedai dibo.

english_text: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.
nagamese_text: Eneka pora tumikhan uporte prithibi te jiman hosa te thaka khan ase taikhan laga khun ahibo, hosa te thaka Abel laga khun pora shuru kori kene Barachias laga chokra Zacharias laga khun tak, junke tumikhan pobitro jaga aru bedi majot te morai disele.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora ami tumikhan ke koidi ase, eitu khan sob aji-kali laga yug uporte ahibo.

english_text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
nagamese_text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, tumi jun khan bhabobadi khan ke morai diye aru jun khan ke tumikhan logot pathai diye taikhan ke bhi tumikhan pathor mari dise! Kiman bar Moi tumi laga bacha khan ke milai dibole itcha thakise, jineka ekta murgi ama tai laga bacha khan ke tai laga pakhi nichete joma kore, kintu tumikhan ahibole itcha thaka nai!

english_text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
nagamese_text: Sabi, tumikhan laga ghor pora tumikhan ke ekla chari dibo.

english_text: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, etiya pora tumikhan Amike nadikhibo jitia tak tumikhan eneka nakoi, ‘Tai asis te ase jun Probhu laga naam pora ahise.’”

english_text: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
nagamese_text: Jisu mondoli laga bahar te ulaikene nijor rasta te jai thakise. Tai laga chela khan Tai usorte ahikena mondoli ghor dikhai thakise.

english_text: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai jowab dise aru taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan etu sob dikhi ase na nai? Moi hosa pora koi ase, etu sob pathor khan matite phelai dibo. Ekta pathor bhi ekta uporte thakibo nadibo, sobke bhangai kene girai dibo.”

english_text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Oliv Pahar te bohi thakise, Tai laga chela khan lukai kene ahise, eneka koi kene, “Amikhan ke kobi, eitu khan kitia hobole ase? Apuni aru ahibole thaka aru etu duniya laga somoi khotom hobole laga din to, kineka pora amikhan ke dikhai dibo?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Hoshiar thakibi, kun pora bhi tumikhan ke thogabole nadibi.

english_text: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bisi manu ami laga naam loi kene ahibo. Taikhan kobo, ‘Moi Khrista ase,’ aru bisi manu khan ke thogai dibo.

english_text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan larai kora aru larai hobole thaka laga khobor hunibo. Hoilebi tumikhan chinta na koribi, kele koile prithibi khotom nohua age te eitu khan sob purah hobo lage.

english_text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.
nagamese_text: Ekta desh pora dusra desh ke bhirodh koribo, aru ekta rajyo pora dusra rajyo ke hinsa koribo. Utu somoite bisi jagate khabole nathakibo aru mati khan bisi hili bo.

english_text: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan sob to bacha jonom hobole nimite bikhabole shuru huwa he ase.

english_text: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete tumikhan ke taikhan pora saja dibo aru morai dibo. Tumikhan ke sob desh khan pora Ami laga naam nimite ghin koribo.

english_text: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete bisi manu laga biswas harai jabo, aru ekjon-ekjon ke thogabo aru ghin koribo.

english_text: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.
nagamese_text: Misa bhabobadi khan bisi ulabo aru bisi manu ke thogai dibo.

english_text: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile niyom namana khan bisi hoi jabo, aru bisi manu laga morom to thanda hoi jabo.

english_text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun hekh tak biswas te thakibo, taikhan he bachibo.

english_text: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
nagamese_text: Etu sorgo rajyo laga bhal khobor to pura prithibi te ekta gawahi hoi kene pura desh te prochar koribo. Etu pichete hekh din to ahibo.

english_text: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jitia tumikhan ghin laga kaam pora khotom kori diya dikhibo, juntu kotha bhabobadi Daniel pora koi disele, tumikhan pobitro jagate khara kori kene dikhibo”- kun puri ase tai bujhi lobi,-

english_text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
nagamese_text: “Etu pichete jun khan Judea te ase taikhan ke pahar uporte polabole dibi,

english_text: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
nagamese_text: jun manu ghor uporte ase, taike ghor laga saman khan lobole nichete jabole nadibi,

english_text: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
nagamese_text: aru jun kheti te ase taike ghor te jai kene chador lobole nadibi.

english_text: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!
nagamese_text: Kintu, utu dinte jun khan pet te bacha nohoile bhi dudh khai thaka bacha khan logote ase, taikhan bisi dukh pabo!

english_text: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,
nagamese_text: Prathana koribi eneka to thanda din nohoile Bisram dinte eitu khan nahobole nimite.

english_text: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete dangor dukh digdar din ahijabo, etu somoite kitia bhi napa laga dukh khan pabo, aru etu nisena dukh kitia bhi aru nahibo.

english_text: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.
nagamese_text: Jitia tak utu din khotom nahobo, ekjon manu bhi nabachibo. Kintu basi luwa manu khan laga prathana pora he etu dukh din khan ke khata kori dibo.

english_text: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete jodi kunba pora tumike koi, ‘Sabi, Khrista yate ase!’ Nohoile bhi, ‘Tai ta te ase!’ Taikhan ke biswas na koribi.

english_text: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
nagamese_text: Kile mane misa Khrista aru misa bhabobadi khan ahibo aru asurit kaam khan kori kene dikha bo, tumikhan ke thogabo, parile Isor pora basi kene thaka khan ke bhi.

english_text: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.
nagamese_text: Sabi, Ami tumikhan ke etiya pora he eitu khan koi dise.

english_text: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jodi taikhan pora tumikhan ke koi, ‘Sabi, Tai eku bhi nathaka jagate ase,’ eneka jagate najabi. Nohoile bhi, ‘Sabi, Tai ghor bhitor te ase,’ eneka khan biswas na koribi.

english_text: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jineka bhijili purab pora ujala hoi aru phat kori kene paschim tak jule, thik etu nisena Manu laga Putro bhi eneka ahibo.

english_text: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.
nagamese_text: Juntu jagate janwar khan mori kene thake, etu jagate mangso kha chiriya khan joma hoi.

english_text: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
nagamese_text: Kintu loge-loge dukh digdar din khan pichete, suryo to andhera hoi jabo, aru chand to ujala nadiya hoi jabo, aru tara khan akas pora giri jabo, aru sorgo laga hokti to hili jabo.

english_text: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Manu laga Putro aha din laga chihna akas te dikhai dibo, aru sob prithibi laga jati khan kandibo. Taikhan Manu laga Putro ke purah hokti aru dangor mohima pora akas laga badal te aha dikhibo.

english_text: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.
nagamese_text: Tai pora Tai laga sorgodoth khan ke dangor bajana pora awaj kori kene prithibi te pathabo, aru taikhan Isor pora basi luwa manu khan ke prithibi laga char kona pora joma kori lobo.

english_text: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.
nagamese_text: Etu dristanto to dimoru laga ghas pora sikhi lo bhi. Jitia tai laga daal khan norom hoijai aru notun pata khan ulai ahe, titia tumikhan jani jai gorom din ahi ase.

english_text: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.
nagamese_text: Thik eneka, jitia eitu khan dikhibo, tumikhan jani jabi Manu laga Putro to dorja usorte punchi ase.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.
nagamese_text: Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, etu yug khotom nohobo jitia tak eitu khan sob pura hoi najai.

english_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
nagamese_text: Akas aru prithibi to harai jabo, kintu Moi laga ekta chutu kotha bhi naharabo.

english_text: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
nagamese_text: Kintu kitia utu din aru somoi ahibo, kun bhi najane, sorgodoth khan bhi najane, nohoile Putro bhi najane, khali Baba ekla he jane.

english_text: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
nagamese_text: Kineka Noah laga dinte hoise etu nisena Manu laga Putro aha din bhi eneka hobo.

english_text: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile utu somoite bhi, Noah pora naw bhitor te naghusa din tak, manu khan nisa-pani khai thakise, shadi kori thakise aru shadi koridi thakise,

english_text: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan eku jani kene thaka nai aru jitia ban-pani ahise, taikhan sobke pani pora loi jaise- etu nisena Manu laga Putro aha din bhi etu nisena ahibo.

english_text: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete duijon manu kheti te thakibo- ekjon ke loijabo, aru ekjon ke chari dibo.

english_text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.
nagamese_text: Duijon maiki mil te chawal khundi thakibo- ekjon ke loijabo, aru ekjon ke chari dibo.

english_text: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
nagamese_text: Etu karone nijor jagate taiyar hoi kene thakibi, kele koile tumi najane kuntu dinte tumi laga Probhu ahibo.

english_text: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu jani kene thakibi, jodi ghor laga malik to kuntu somoite chor ahibo etu jani thakile, tai to taiyar hoi kene thaki bole asele aru etu chor ke tai laga ghor bhitor te ghusi bole nadibo thakise.

english_text: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.
nagamese_text: Etu karone tumikhan bhi taiyar thakibi, kele koile Manu laga Putro to tumikhan nabhaba somoite ahibo.

english_text: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, kun sob pora thik aru gyaan thaka nokor ase, junke tai laga malik pora biswas rakhi kene tai kha luwa thik somoite dibole aru ghor laga kaam sabole nimite rakhikena ase?

english_text: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.
nagamese_text: Utu nokor asis pabo jitia tai laga malik ahikena taike kaam kori thaka dikhibo.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase utu malik pora Tai laga ki ase etu sob utu nokor laga jimedari te rakhidibo.

english_text: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi etu biya nokor mon bhitor te koi, ‘Moi laga malik to deri pora ahibo,’

english_text: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
nagamese_text: aru tai dusra nokorkhan ke mari bole shuru hoijai, aru modhu kha manu khan logote mili kene nisa-pani khai,

english_text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
nagamese_text: aru tai nabhaba aru najana somoite tai laga malik ahijai.

english_text: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete tai laga malik taike saja dibo aru dhongi manu khan logote rakhidibo, aru ta te khali kanda aru daat kamura he hobo.

english_text: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
nagamese_text: Aru, etu somoite, sorgo laga rajyo to dosta chukri nisena ase jun taikhan laga saaki loi kene taikhan laga mota hobole thaka khan ke lok kori bole jaise.

english_text: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
nagamese_text: Pans jon to murkho thakise aru pans jon to gyaani thakise.

english_text: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile utu pansta chukri taikhan laga saaki to loise, kintu taikhan tel lobole borton to pahori jaise.

english_text: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi utu pansta gyaani chukri khan to borton te tel hali kene taikhan logot saaki bhi loi jaise.

english_text: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan logot shadi kori bole thaka mota ahibole deri hoise, taikhan sob neendh lagi kene ghumai jaise.

english_text: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
nagamese_text: Kintu rati laga majote ta te ekta awaj hunise, ‘Sabi, shadi koribo thaka mota ahise! Jabi aru taikhan ke lok koribi.’

english_text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete chukri khan sob uthi kene taikhan laga sakhi julai se.

english_text: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
nagamese_text: Kintu murkho chukri khan gyaani chukri khan ke koise, ‘Amikhan ke apnikhan laga tel olop dibi kelemane amikhan laga saaki to bhuti jabole ase,’

english_text: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
nagamese_text: Kintu utu gyaani chukri khan jowab dikene koise, ‘Amikhan aru apnikhan nimite bhi napuncha hoi jabo, etu pora to jai kene tel bikiri kora manu pora nijor nimite kini lobi.’

english_text: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan kini bole jaise, shadi kora mota khan punchi kene ghor bhitor te jaise, aru jun khan taiyar thakise taikhan logote shadi kori bole jaise, aru dorja bondh kori dise.

english_text: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete utu murkho chukri khan ahi kene koise, ‘Malik, malik, amikhan nimite bhi dorja khuli bhi.’

english_text: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
nagamese_text: Kintu tai jowab dikene koise, ‘Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Moi tumikhan ke najane.’

english_text: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
nagamese_text: Etu karone saikene thakibi, kele koile kuntu din nohoile bhi kuntu somoite Manu laga Putro wapas ahibo tumikhan najane.

english_text: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
nagamese_text: Kile mane etu to ekjon manu safar te jai thaka nisena ase. Tai nijor laga nokorkhan ke matise aru taikhan ke Tai laga dhun khan dise.

english_text: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
nagamese_text: Ekjon ke pansta talents dise, dusra ke duita talents dise, aru ekjon dusra ke ekta talent dise. Tai sobke taikhan laga kaam hisab te dise, aru joldi kori kene taikhan laga safar nimite ulai jai.

english_text: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
nagamese_text: Jun manu ke pansta bordan disele tai jai kene kaam te cholai se aru tai aru bhi pansta bordan bisi paise.

english_text: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena junke duita bordan disele tai bhi duita bordan aru bhi paise.

english_text: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
nagamese_text: Kintu juntu nokor ke ekta bordan disele, tai jai kene mati khundi kene malik pora diya poisa to rupai dise.

english_text: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bisi din pichete nokorkhan laga malik to wapas ahe aru taikhan ke bordan diya laga hisab khan mange.

english_text: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
nagamese_text: Pansta bordan pa-a nokor ahi kene aru bhi pansta bordan bisi kori kene tai laga malik ke dise. Tai koise, ‘Malik, apuni amike pansta bordan dise. Kintu sabi, moi etu dui guna bisi kori dise.’

english_text: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
nagamese_text: Tai laga malik taike koise, ‘Bisi bhal korise, bhal aru imandar nokor! Tumi bisi imandar pora kaam khan korise. Moi tumike sob kaam khan sabole jimedari di ase. Ahibi aru tumi laga malik logote khushi koribi.’

english_text: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
nagamese_text: Dusra nokor junke duita bordan disele tai ahikena koise, ‘Malik, apuni amike duita bordan dise. Kintu sabi, moi aru duita bisi bordan kori dise.’

english_text: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
nagamese_text: Tai laga malik taike koise, ‘Bisi bhal korise, bhal aru imandar nokor ase! Tumi bisi imandar pora kaam khan korise. Moi tumike sob kaam khan sabole jimedari di ase. Ahibi aru tumi laga malik logot te khushi koribi.’

english_text: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete ekta bordan pa-a nokor ahikena koise, ‘Malik, moi jani ase apuni bisi kara manu ase. Apuni juntu jagate bijon naphelai ta te guti khan joma kore, aru juntu jagate kheti nakore ta te kheti kate.

english_text: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
nagamese_text: Moi bhoi khai thakise, etu karone moi jai kene mati bhitor te lukai kene rakhise. Sabi, apuni ki dise etu yate ase.’

english_text: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai laga malik jowab dikene taike koise, ‘Tumi mon kala aru alsi kora nokor, tumi jani ase, moi juntu jagate bijon naphelai ta te guti khan joma kore, aru juntu jagate kheti nakore ta te kheti kate.

english_text: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
nagamese_text: Etu karone moi laga poisa to poisa ghor te dise koile bhal hobole thakise, aru jitia moi wapas ahibo moi laga poisa logote munafa bhi pabo thakise.

english_text: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, tai laga hath pora bordan khan loi lobi aru jun logote dosta bordan ase taike di dibi.

english_text: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jun manu khan bisi ase- taike aru bhi dibo- ekdom bhorta pora aru bhi dibo. Kintu jun manu khan logote eku bhi nai, taikhan logote ki ase eitu khan bhi tai pora chingi loi lobo.

english_text: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
nagamese_text: Etu kaam nathaka nokor ke andhera jagate phelai dibi, juntu jagate khali kandi thaka aru daat kamuri thaka he hobo.’

english_text: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
nagamese_text: Jitia Manu laga Putro tai laga mohima aru pura sorgodoth khan logote ahibo, etu pichete Tai laga mohima laga jagate bohibo.

english_text: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
nagamese_text: Tai laga age te sob desh khan joma hobo, aru Tai manu khan ke ekjon pora dusra jonke alag koribo, jineka roikhya pora mer aru saguli ke alag kori diye.

english_text: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
nagamese_text: Tai mer khan ke Tai laga dyna hath phale rakhibo aru saguli khan ke baya hath phale rakhibo.

english_text: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Raja pora Tai laga dyna hathte thaka manu khan ke koise, ‘Ahibi, Moi laga Baba pora tumikhan ke asis dikene ase, juntu rajyo tumikhan nimite prithibi bona somoite rakhi sele, etu tumikhan laga hoise.

english_text: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Moi bhuka thakise aru tumikhan Moike khilai se; Moi pyaas lagi thakise aru tumikhan Moike pani khabole dise;

english_text: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’
nagamese_text: Moi eku kapra pindhi kene thaka nai aru tumi moike pindhibole dise; Moi bemar aru bondhi ghor te thakise aru tumi moike sabole ahise.’

english_text: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?
nagamese_text: Etu pichete dharmik khan Taike jowab dikene kobo, ‘Probhu, amikhan kitia Apuni bhuk lagi thaka dikhise aru khilai se? Nohoile Apuni pyaas laga homoi te Apuni ke pani dise?

english_text: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan kitia Apuni ke nachina manu ase koi kene loi jaise? Nohoile bhi kapra pindhibole nathaka dikhi kene kapra pindhai dise?

english_text: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan kitia Apuni ke bemar ase nohoile bhi bondhi ghor te ase koi kene Apuni usorte ahise?

english_text: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Raja pora jowab dikene taikhan ke kobo, ‘Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, ki kaam tumi Moi laga bhai khan nimite korise, tumi Moi nimite he korise.’

english_text: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Tai bhi kobo Tai laga baya hath phale thaka manu khan ke, ‘Moi laga usor pora dur hoi jabi, tumi paap manu khan, khotom nohua jui te jabi juntu jaga biya atma aru tai laga duth khan nimite bonaise,

english_text: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
nagamese_text: kele koile Moi bhuk lagi thakise, kintu tumikhan Moike eku bhi khabole diya nai; Moi pyaas lagi thakise, kintu tumikhan Moike pani bhi khabole diya nai;

english_text: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
nagamese_text: Moi nachina manu thakise, kintu tumikhan Moike mata nai; kapra pindhibole thaka nai, kintu tumikhan Moike kapra pindhi diya nai; bemar aru bondhi ghor te thakise, kintu tumikhan Moike sabole aha nai.’

english_text: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete taikhan bhi jowab dikene kobo, ‘Probhu, amikhan kitia Apuni ke bhuka, pyasa, bahar manu, kapra pindhibole nathaka, bemar, bondhi ghor te, eneka kora dikhise aru Apuni ke sewa kora nai?

english_text: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Tai jawab dikene kobo, ‘Hosa para Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, ji kaam tumi Moi laga manu khan nimite kora nai tumi Moi nimite bhi kora nai.’

english_text: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu eneka koise, “Eitu khan kitia bhi khotom nohua saja pabo, kintu dharmik khan anonto jibon pabo.”

english_text: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu sob kotha khan koi kene khotom korise, Tai chela khan ke koise,

english_text: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
nagamese_text: “Tumikhan jani kene ase dui din pichete Nistar utsov din ahi ase, aru Manu laga Putro ke Cross te morai dibole di dibo.”

english_text: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete mukhyo purohit aru bura khan sob ahikena moha purohit Caiaphas laga ghor te eke logote joma hoise.

english_text: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob kineka kori kene Jisu ke dhoribo aru chalak pora Taike morai dibo, etu bhabona kori thakise.

english_text: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taikhan majot te eneka koi thakise, “Utsov laga somoite nohoi, nohoile etu nimite manu khan majote jhagara ulabo pare.”

english_text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Bethany bosti te ekjon bemar manu Simon koi kene tai laga ghor te thakise,

english_text: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.
nagamese_text: aru Tai mez te bohi thakise, ekjon mahila Jisu usorte bisi daam laga tel ke ekta mati laga kolsi te hali kene anise, aru tai Jisu laga matha te hali dise.

english_text: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Jisu laga chela khan etu dikhise, taikhan ghusa hoi kene koise, “Eneka nuksan kora laga motlob to ki ase?

english_text: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”
nagamese_text: Eitu ke bisi daam pora bikiri kori kene gorib manu khan ke dibo paribole thakise.”

english_text: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu, etu sob jani kene, taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan kele etu mahila ke digdar di ase? Tai moi nimite bhal kaam kori dise.

english_text: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile tumikhan logote gorib manu khan to hodai thakibo, kintu Moi tumikhan logote hodai nathakibo.

english_text: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
nagamese_text: Kitia etu mahila pora Moi laga gaw uporte te tel hali dise, tai Moike kobor te nadhala age te taiyar koridi ase.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, jitia etu bhal khobor pura prithibi te prochar hobo, etu mahila pora ki korise tai laga yaad te etu kotha koribo.”

english_text: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
nagamese_text: Etu pichete baroh jon chela majote ekjon chela, Judas Iscariot, tai mukhyo purohit khan logot jaise,

english_text: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Apuni khan moike ki dibole itcha kori ase, jodi moi apnikhan nimite Jisu ke thogai diye?” Titia taikhan trista chandi laga sikka ulaikene taike dise.

english_text: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
nagamese_text: Aru utu somoi pora Judas to kineka kori kene Jisu ke thogai dibo etu bisari thakise.

english_text: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”
nagamese_text: Etiya, khomir nathaka roti laga nakha-a utsov laga poila dinte Jisu laga chela khan eneka koi kene ahise, “Apuni kuntu jagate amikhan Nistar purbb laga khana kori bole nimite jaga taiyar koribo dibo itcha ase?”

english_text: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Sheher te jai kene kunba ekjon manu logote jabi aru taike kobi, ‘Malik pora koise, “Moi laga somoi usor hoi ase. Moi tumi laga ghor te Nistar purbb khana Moi laga chela khan nimite rakhibo.”’”

english_text: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.
nagamese_text: Aru chela khan eneka he korise aru taikhan Nistar purbb nimite khana taiyar kori loise.

english_text: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
nagamese_text: Jitia saam hoise, Jisu tai laga baroh jon chela khan logote khabole bohise.

english_text: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan khai thakise, Jisu koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, tumikhan majot te ekjon pora Amike thogai dibo.”

english_text: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan huni kene bisi mon dukh hoise, aru sob chela khan ekjon pichete ekjon eneka hudibole shuru hoise, “Probhu, hosa pora moi nohoi na?”

english_text: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dikene koise, “Etu ekjon kun Moi logote mili kene ekta thali te khaise, tai pora he Moike thogai dibo.

english_text: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
nagamese_text: Manu laga Putro jabo lagibo, jineka Tai nimite Isor kotha te likhi kene ase. Kintu utu manu ke bisi hai ase jun pora Manu laga Putro ke thogabole ase! Tai nimite to jonom nohua he bhal hobole ase.”

english_text: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”
nagamese_text: Etiya Judas, kun Jisu ke thogabole thakise, jowab dikene koise, “Rabbi, hosa pora moi nohoi na? Jisu taike koise, “Tumi nijor pora he koi dise.”

english_text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan khai thakise, Jisu roti loi kene Isor ke asirbad dikena bhangai se. Aru chela khan ke dikene koise, “Lobi, aru khabi. Etu Moi laga gaw ase.”

english_text: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,
nagamese_text: Titia, Jisu kup to loise aru Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru taikhan ke eneka koi kene dise, “Tumikhan sob etu kup pora pi lobi.

english_text: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu Moi laga khun dwara vachan ase, etu pora sob manu paap pora khyama pabo.

english_text: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Baba laga rajyote Moi etu notun angur phol laga ros tumikhan logot napia tak, etu angur ros to aru napibo.”

english_text: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan atma laga gana kori loise, taikhan ulaikene Oliv Pahar te jaise.

english_text: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan sob aji rati moi nimite biswas te giri jabo, kele koile Isor kotha te eneka likhi kene ase, ‘Moi mer roikhya kora manu ke morai dibo Aru sob mer khan alag-alag jagate polai jabo.’

english_text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi mora pora uthija pichete, Moi tumikhan laga age Galilee te jabo.”

english_text: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter jowab dikene Jisu ke koise, “Jodi sob manu Apuni ke chari le bhi, moi Apuni ke kitia bhi nacharibo.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumike koi ase, aji rati te, murga phojurte hala nakora age te, tumi Moike tin bar najane kobo.”

english_text: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
nagamese_text: Peter Jisu ke koise, “Jodi moi Apuni logote moribo lage koile bhi, moi kitia bhi Apuni ke najane nakobo.” Aru sob chela khan bhi eneka eke kotha koise.

english_text: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu taikhan logote Gethsemane koi kene ekta jagate jaise, aru chela khan ke koise, “Yate bohi thakibi Moi jai kene ta te prathana koribo.

english_text: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora Peter aru Zebedee laga duita chokra khan ke Tai logote loi jaise aru bisi chinta hoi kene mon dukh kori jaise.

english_text: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi laga atma to bisi mon dukh ase, mori jabo nisena tak. Yate thakibi aru Moike rukhi thakibi.”

english_text: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu olop age te jaise, aru matha niche kori kene prathana korise. Tai koise, “Moi laga Baba, jodi Apuni itcha hoile, etu kup to Moi usor pora hatai dibi. Kintu, Moi laga itcha pora nohoi, hoile bhi Apuni laga itcha pora he.”

english_text: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu ahi kene chela khan ke ghumai thaka dikhise, aru Peter ke koise, “Tumikhan Moi nimite ek ghanta bhi rukhibole para nai?

english_text: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
nagamese_text: Sai thakibi aru prathana kori thakibi, titia tumikhan porikha te nagiribo nimite. Atma to hosa pora bhi itcha ase, kintu mangso to komjur ase.”

english_text: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”
nagamese_text: Tai aru dusra bar prathana kori bole jaise, Tai koise, “Moi laga Baba, jodi etu Moi nakha tak Moi pora paar nohoi koile, Apuni laga itcha hobi.”

english_text: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
nagamese_text: Tai aru bhi ahi kene taikhan ke ghumai thaka dikhise, kele koile taikhan laga suku neendh pora bhari hoi kene thakise.

english_text: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ke aru chari kene aru tin bar ula prathana kori bole jaise, aru age nisena he koise.

english_text: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu ahikena Tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Tumikhan aru bhi ghumai kene aram kori ase? Sabi, somoi to ahi ase aru Manu laga Putro ke thogai kene paapi manu laga hathte dibole ase.

english_text: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
nagamese_text: Uthi bhi, amikhan jabo. Sabi, kun moike thogabole ase, tai usorte ahi ase.”

english_text: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai kotha kori thakise, titia, Judas, baroh jon chela khan majote ekjon ahise. Tai logote bisi manu khan talwar aru lathi dhori kene thakise, mukhyo purohit aru cholawta khan pora pathaise.

english_text: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
nagamese_text: Titia etu manu kun Jisu ke thogai dibole thakise tai pora ekta chihna kori kene koise, “Kunke moi chuma dibo, tai he ase. Taike dhori bhi.”

english_text: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
nagamese_text: Loge-loge tai Jisu usorte ahise aru koise, “Salam, Rabbi!” Aru tai Jisu ke chuma dise.

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Sathi, tumi ki kori bole ahise etu kori lobi.” Etu pichete taikhan ahise, Jisu uporte hath lagaise, aru dhuri loise.

english_text: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
nagamese_text: Sabi, ekjon kun Jisu usorte thakisele tai laga hath khuli se, aru tai laga talwar ulaikene moha purohit laga nokor ke marise aru tai laga kaan kati dise.

english_text: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taike koise, “Tumi laga talwar kote pora ulaise ta te wapas rakhibi, kun manu talwar uthabo tai etu talwar pora khotom hoi jabo.

english_text: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi tumikhan bhabe Moi Baba ke mati bona paribo, aru Tai baroh sorgodoth khan laga legion ekbar pora pathai dibo koi kene?

english_text: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
nagamese_text: Kintu eneka hoile Isor kotha ki likha ase etu kineka purah hobo, yate ki hoi ase etu sob nohoile?”

english_text: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.
nagamese_text: Utu somoite Jisu manu khan ke koise, “Tumikhan talwar aru lathi loi kene Moike dhori bole ahise naki, jineka ekta chor ke dhuribole aha nisena? Hodai Moi mondoli te bohi kene sikhai thakise, aru tumikhan utu somoite Moike dhura nai.

english_text: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan sob purah hoise, tineka hoile bhabobadi khan pora Isor kotha te likhi kene thaka khan pura hobo nimite.” Etu pichete sob chela khan Jisu ke chari kene polai jaise.

english_text: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
nagamese_text: Jun khan Jisu ke dhori kene loi jaise, aru Caiaphas ekjon maha purohit laga usorte loi jaise, juntu jagate niyom likha khan aru bura manu khan joma hoi kene thakise.

english_text: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter dur pora Jisu laga piche korise aru moha purohit laga bisar kora jagate jaise.

english_text: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

english_text: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward
nagamese_text: Taikhan ekjon bhi pa-a nai, etu laga age te bisi misa laga gawahi dibole khan thakisele. Kintu pichete khali duijon he age te ahise,

english_text: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”
nagamese_text: Aru koise, “Etu manu koise, ‘Moi etu Isor laga girja ghor ke bhangai kene aru tin dinte bonai dibo pare.’”

english_text: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”
nagamese_text: Utu dangor purohit khara kori kene Taike koise, “Apuni logote eku jowab nai? Eitu khan ki ase taikhan pora Apuni uporte gawahi di thaka to?”

english_text: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu chup chap thakise. Aru dangor purohit Taike koise, “Moi jinda Isor laga naam pora apuni ke hukum di ase, Apuni amikhan ke kobi Apuni Isor laga Putro, Khrista to ase na nohoi.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Tumi nijor pora he koi dise. Kintu Moi tumike koi ase, etiya pora tumikhan Manu laga Putro ke Hokti laga dyna hathte bohi thaka dikhibo, aru akas laga badal uporte aha dikhibo.”

english_text: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete moha purohit bisi ghusa hoi kene tai laga kapra phataise, aru koise, “Etu manu Isor laga bodnam korise! Amikhan aru ki etiya gawahi lage? Sabi, etiya amikhan sob Isor laga bodnam huni loise.

english_text: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan laga ki bhabona ase?” Taikhan jowab dikene koise, “Tai to mora he thik hobo.”

english_text: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
nagamese_text: Etu pichete taikhan Jisu laga chehera te thuki se aru Taike marise, aru kunba khan to thapor marise,

english_text: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
nagamese_text: eneka koi kene, “Amikhan ke bhabobani koribi, tumi Khrista. Kun pora tumike mari ase?”

english_text: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”
nagamese_text: Etiya, Peter to ghor bahar te bohi thakise, aru ekjon nokor chukri tai usorte ahise aru koise, “Tumi bhi Jisu logote Galilee te thakise.”

english_text: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
nagamese_text: Kintu tai sob laga usorte nohoi koise, “Tumi ki laga kotha kori ase moi najane.”

english_text: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
nagamese_text: Jitia tai dorja laga bahar te ulaise, dusra ekjon nokorni taike dikhise aru manu khan ke koise, “Etu manu bhi Nazareth Jisu logote thakise.”

english_text: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”
nagamese_text: Tai aru bhi nohoi koi kene kosom khaise, “Moi etu manu ke najane!”

english_text: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”
nagamese_text: Aru olop deri pichete jun khan ta te khara thakise, taikhan ahikena Peter ke koise, “Hosa pora tumi bhi taikhan majote ekjon ase, tumi laga kotha kora pora he bujhi jaise.”

english_text: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete tai kosom dise aru khaise, “Ami etu manu ke najane,” aru loge-loge murga hala korise.

english_text: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Peter Jisu pora ki hoise le etu yaad korise, “Murga hala nakora age te tumi Moike tin bar najane kobo.” Eneka hoi kene tai bahar te ulaise aru bisi mon tita hoi kene kandise.

english_text: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.
nagamese_text: Kitia phojur hoise, sob moha purohit khan aru bura khan mili kene Jisu ke morai dibole kotha milai thakise.

english_text: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke bandi kene loi jaise, aru Governor Pilate laga hathte dise.

english_text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Judas, jun pora Jisu ke thogaise, Jisu ke bodnam kora dikhise, aru tai mon ghurai kene trista chandi laga sikka moha purohit khan aru bura khan ke eneka koi kene wapas kori dise,

english_text: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
nagamese_text: “Moi ekjon eku golti nathaka laga khun ke thogai dise.” Kintu taikhan koise, “Utu ki ase amikhan nimite? Nijor pora sai lobi.”

english_text: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.
nagamese_text: Titia tai chandi laga sikka khan mondoli te phelai dise, aru bahar te ulai jai kene nijorke fansi lagai kene mori jaise.

english_text: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
nagamese_text: Titia moha purohit khan chandi laga sikka khan loi kene koise, “Etu chandi laga sikka khan tijori te rakhibole niyom nai, kelemane etu sikka khun laga daam te diya hoise.”

english_text: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob eke logote mili kene kotha korise aru etu poisa loi kene mati kinise aru etu jaga to nachina manu khan laga kobor nimite rakhise.

english_text: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, aji tak etu mati ke, “Khun laga Kheti” koi kene rakhi ase.

english_text: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,
nagamese_text: Jeremiah bhabobadi pora ki kotha koi disele etu sob purah hoi jaise, “Taikhan trista chandi laga sikka loise, aru Israel laga bacha khan pora tai uporte etu daam rakhidise,

english_text: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
nagamese_text: aru taikhan etu loi kene mati kini loise, Probhu pora jineka moike koi diya nisena.”

english_text: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu Governor usorte khara korise aru tai pora Jisu ke hudise, eneka koi kene, “Apuni Yehudi khan laga Raja ase naki?” Jisu taike jowab dise, “Apuni he koise.”

english_text: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia moha purohit aru bura khan pora Jisu ke doshi dise, Tai eku jowab diya nai.

english_text: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Pilate Jisu ke koise, “Apuni uporte bodnam khan ani kene diya to Apuni huna nai naki?

english_text: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taike jowab diya nai, Taike bodnam kora khan ke bhi, titia Governor etu dikhi kene bisi asurit lagise.

english_text: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.
nagamese_text: Etiya dangor kha luwa laga niyom hisab te manu khan nimite Governor pora taikhan ke bondhi ghor pora chari dibole mon kore taikhan basi lobo pare.

english_text: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.
nagamese_text: Etu somoite taikhan logote ekjon bisi biya koidi Barabbas koi kene thakise.

english_text: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan sob eke logote joma hoise, Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan nimite kunke chari dibo? Barabbas na Jisu junke Khrista mate?”

english_text: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Pilate jani thakise taikhan Jisu ke ghin kora nimite tai laga hathte dise.

english_text: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tai bisar kora jagate bohi thakise, tai laga maiki pora kotha pathai kene koise, “Etu golti nathaka manu logote eku na koribi, kelemane moi aji Jisu laga sapna dikhi kene bisi dukh pai ase.”

english_text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.
nagamese_text: Titia mukhyo purohit khan aru bura khan pora ta te joma thaka manu khan ke Barabbas ke chari dibole nimite koise, aru bodli te Jisu ke morai dibole mangise.

english_text: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
nagamese_text: Titia governor pora jowab dikene taikhan ke koise, “Etu duijon majot te moi pora junke kunke chari dibole tumikhan laga itcha ase?” Taikhan koise, “Barabbas.”

english_text: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
nagamese_text: Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Tinehoile moi etu Jisu kun Khrista ase koi tai logote ki koribo?” Taikhan sob jowab dise, “Taike Cross te morai dibi.”

english_text: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Kile, Tai ki laga golti kaam korise?” Kintu taikhan jor pora hala kori kene koise, “Taike Cross te mari dibi.”

english_text: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Pilate dikhise tai aru eku kori bole napara hoise, aru manu khan pora dangor jhagara ulai dibo koi kene jani loise, etu pora tai manu khan usorte hath dhulaise aru koise, “Etu manu laga khun nimite moi laga eku golti nai, tumikhan nijor pora he sai lobi.”

english_text: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”
nagamese_text: Sob manu khan jowab dikene koise, “Tai laga khun to amikhan aru amikhan laga bacha khan uporte ahibole dibi.”

english_text: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
nagamese_text: Titia Barabbas ke taikhan nimite chari dise kintu tai Jisu ke mari kene dukh diya pichete Taike Cross te morai dibo khan nimite di dise.

english_text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
nagamese_text: Titia Governor laga sipahi khan Jisu ke Governor logote loi jaise jun jagate sipahi khan joma kori kene thakise.

english_text: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu laga kapra ulai dise aru sundur rong laga kapra Taike pindhai dise.
