english_text: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
nagamese_text: Tai achanak ahikena tumikhan ghumai thaka pai jabo pare.

english_text: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
nagamese_text: Etu pora Moi tumikhan ke ki koise, Moi sobke koi ase; Hoshiar hoi thakibi!”

english_text: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.
nagamese_text: Dui din pichete Khomir Nathaka Roti laga Purbb hobole asele. Aru prodhan purohit khan aru niyom likha khan kineka kori Taike thogai dikene morai dibole bisari asele.

english_text: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan apaste eneka koi thakise, “Purbb dinte eneka nohobo lage, kelemane manu majote gondugol kori biya hoi jabo.”

english_text: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Bethany te Simon junke korhi bemar thakise, tai laga ghor te kha luwa kori bole bohi asele, ekjon mahila ekta alabaster daba te bisi daam laga abhishek kora shudh tel loi anise. Aru tai etu khuli kene Jisu laga matha te hali dise.

english_text: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?
nagamese_text: Kintu kunba biya paikene ekjon-ekjon ke koise, “Kile etu abhishek tel borbad kori ase?

english_text: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu tel bikiri korile tin-sou dinar pora bhi bisi pabo, aru loi kene dukhiya khan ke dibo pare.” Eneka hoi kene taikhan tai bhirodh te kotha korise.

english_text: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Taike chari- dibi, tumikhan kele taike digdar kori ase? Tai Moi karone bhal kaam korise.

english_text: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
nagamese_text: Dukhiya khan hodai tumikhan logote thakibo, aru jitia itcha hoi, taikhan ke bhal kaam koribo pare, kintu Moi hodai tumikhan logote nathakibo.

english_text: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.
nagamese_text: Tai ki koribo pare, etu tai kori dise. Moike matite moidam diya age te tai tel loi kene Moi laga gaw te haali kene abhishek kori dise.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, pura prithibi te susamachar prochar kori juwa te etu mahila kori diya laga kotha bhi taike yaad thakibo karone kobo.”

english_text: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
nagamese_text: Titia Iscariot Judas baroh jon majot te ekjon asele, Jisu ke dhori dibole prodhan purohit khan logote jaise.

english_text: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
nagamese_text: Aru etu huni kene taikhan bisi khushi hoi kene taike poisa dibole koi dise, karone tai etu somoi pora Taike dhori dibole bhal somoi sai thakise.

english_text: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”
nagamese_text: Khomir nathaka Roti Purbb laga prothom din, jitia taikhan Nistar laga mer bacha ke bolidan di thakise, Tai chela khan Taike hudise, “Kun jagah te amikhan Nistar purbb nimite taiyar kori bole Apuni laga itcha ase?”

english_text: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,
nagamese_text: Aru Tai duijon chela ke pathai kene koise, “Sheher te jabi, aru ekjon ekta kolsi te pani loi juwa pai jabo, tai piche-piche jabi.

english_text: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
nagamese_text: Aru kot te tai jabo ta te tumi bhi jabi, aru jai kene ghor malik ke kobi, ‘Shika manu koise, “Alohi khan karone jagah kot te ase? Ami laga chela khan logote kot te Nistar khabo?’”

english_text: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”
nagamese_text: Titia tai sapha kori rakhi thaka uporte ekta kamra dikhai dibo, ta te amikhan karone taiyar kori kene rakhibi.”

english_text: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.
nagamese_text: Titia tai laga duijon chela sheher te ahise, aru jineka Tai taikhan ke koise thik tineka paise aru taikhan Nistar nimite taiyar kori rakhise.

english_text: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
nagamese_text: Jitia saam hoise, Jisu aru chela baroh jon ahise.

english_text: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan khai asele titia Jisu koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, tumikhan majote ekjon jun Moi logote kha luwa kori ase tai Moike thogai dibo.”

english_text: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan bisi mon dukh hoise, aru Taikhan ekjon-ekjon kori sob Taike hudise, “Etu moi ase?”

english_text: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
nagamese_text: Tai taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Etu baroh jon te ekjon ase, jun Moi logote eke thali te bhi jai kene khai ase.

english_text: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Manu laga Putro nimite jineka Isor laga kotha te likhi rakhise, tineka hoi ase. Kintu jun pora Manu laga Putro ke thogai di dise, taike hai ase! Tai to jonom nohoile he tai nimite bhal hobo asele.”

english_text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan khai thakise, titia Jisu roti loise aru dhonyabad diya pichete bhangai se, aru taikhan ke eneka koi kene dise, “Lobi aru khabi. Etu Ami laga gaw ase.”

english_text: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai kup loi kene Isor ke dhanyavad dise aru taikhan ke dise. Aru taikhan sob etu pora pi loise.

english_text: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Etu khun to bisi manu karone Moi bahai diya khun laga vachan ase.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, Isor laga rajyote notun angur phol laga ros napiya tak Moi aru etu napibo.”

english_text: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
nagamese_text: Aru titia taikhan gana kori loise, taikhan Oliv Pahar te jai jaise.

english_text: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan sob Moike charikena jai jabo, etu Isor kotha te likha ase, ‘Moi roikhya ke maribo Aru mer khan ephale-uphale hoi jabo.’

english_text: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi jee utha pichete tumi pora age Galilee te jai jabo.”

english_text: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter Taike koise, “Jodi sob manu giri le bhi, moi to nohobo.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi tumike hosa kobo, aji rati murga duibar hala nakora age te tumi tin bar Moike najana kobo.”

english_text: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai aru jor pora koise, “Jodi Apuni logote moribo koile bhi, moi Apuni ke kitia bhi najana nokobo.” Aru sob chela khan bhi tineka koise.

english_text: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Gethsemane naam ekta jagate ahise, aru Jisu Tai chela khan ke koise, “Moi prathana kori thaka somoite yate bohibi.”

english_text: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai Peter, James aru John ke loi kene tai logote jaise, aru Tai bisi dukh aru chinta bhabona hoise.

english_text: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Ami laga atma bisi dukh hoise, mori bole nisena. Na ghumai kene yate rukhi thakibi.”

english_text: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.
nagamese_text: Titia olop dur jai kene, Jisu niche giri prathana korise, jodi parile etu somoi ke Tai pora dur kori dibole.

english_text: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai koise, “Abba, Baba Apuni to sob koribo pare. Moi pora etu kup hatai dibi. Hoile bhi Ami laga itcha nohoi kintu jineka Apuni laga itcha ase, eneka koribi.”

english_text: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?
nagamese_text: Titia Tai ahikena tinjon to ghumai thaka paise aru Peter ke koise, “Hey Peter, tumi ghumai jaise? Tumi ek-ghanta bhi rukhibo napare?

english_text: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan porikha te nagiribo karone na ghumai kene prathana kori thakibi, Atma to taiyar ase kintu gaw to komjur ase.”

english_text: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai jai kene age te kowa nisena koi kene prathana korise.

english_text: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Tai wapas ahise, arubi tinjon ke ghumai thaka paise kelemane taikhan laga suku nindh pora bhorta asele. Aru Taike ki jowab dibo najana hoi thakise.

english_text: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
nagamese_text: Titia tin-bar ahi kene taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan etiya bhi aram pora ghumai ase? Hoise! Somoi ponchise. Sabi! Manu laga Putro ke dhori kene paapi khan laga hathte di dibole hoise.

english_text: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
nagamese_text: Uthibi, amikhan jai jabo, sabi, Moike thoga manu usor ase.”

english_text: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.
nagamese_text: Aru tai etu kotha koi thaka somoite, Judas baroh jon te ekjon to, prodhan purohit, likha manu aru bura khan pora pathai diya talwar, lathi aru bisi manu loi ahise.

english_text: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”
nagamese_text: Taike thogai diya manu taikhan ke ekta chihna disele, “Junke moi chuma dibo, etu ase, Taike dhori lobi, aru dhuri kene loijabi.”

english_text: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Judas ahise, tai joldi ahi kene Jisu ke koise, “Rabbi,” aru Taike chuma dise.

english_text: They laid their hands on him and seized him.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ahi kene hath pora Taike dhori loise.

english_text: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te usorte khara thaka ekjon talwar ulaikene moha purohit laga nokor uporte cholai dise, aru tai laga kan kati dise.

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Tumikhan Moike daku bhabi kene Moike dhori bole talwar aru lathi loi ahise?

english_text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”
nagamese_text: Moi hodai din mondoli te tumikhan logote bohi prochar kori thakise, aru tumikhan Moike dhora nai, kintu Shastro te likha pura hobo karone eneka hoise.”

english_text: They all left him, and fled.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu laga chela khan sob Taike chari kene polai jaise.

english_text: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,
nagamese_text: Aru ekjon jawan chokra kapra napindi kene bodon te ekta mihin kapra lagai kene Jisu laga piche kori ahi thakise. Aru kunba manu khan pora taike dhori loise,

english_text: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.
nagamese_text: kintu tai pindhi thaka mihin kapra chari dise aru eku kapra napindhi kene polai jaise.

english_text: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan Jisu ke loi kene moha purohit logote jaise, aru ta te prodhan purohit khan, niyom likha khan aru bura khan sob joma hoise.

english_text: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter dur hoi kene Tai piche-piche ahi moha purohit laga veranda te nokorkhan logote jui thapi thakise.

english_text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
nagamese_text: Titia prodhan purohit aru sob maha sabha Taike morai dibole Jisu laga bhirodh misa kotha bisarise kintu eku pa-a nai.

english_text: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
nagamese_text: Kelemane bisi manu Tai bhirodh te misa kotha koi dise, kintu taikhan laga kotha thik mila nai.

english_text: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,
nagamese_text: Titia kunba khara hoi kene Tai bhirodh te misa kotha di koise.

english_text: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”
nagamese_text: “Tai eneka kowa amikhan hunise, ‘Moi manu hath pora bonai rakha etu mondoli ke bhangai dikene, aru tin dinte dusra juntu hath pora bona nohoi, etu ke bonai dibo.”

english_text: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.
nagamese_text: Kintu titia bhi taikhan laga kotha thik milabo para nai.

english_text: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
nagamese_text: Aru moha purohit taikhan majote uthi kene Jisu ke hudise, “Apuni eku bhi nokobo? Manu khan Apuni bhirodh te ki koi ase?”

english_text: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai ekdom chup thakise. Aru eku jowab diya nai. Aru moha purohit Taike hudi koise. “Apuni Dhoinyo Jon laga Putro Khrista ase?”

english_text: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Moi ase; Aru tumikhan dikhibo Manu laga Putro ke dikhibo Jitia Tai hokti laga dyna hath phale bohibo Aru akas laga badal pora ahi thaka dikhibo.”

english_text: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?
nagamese_text: Titia moha purohit bisi ghusa hoi kene tai laga kapra phatai kene koise, “Etiya amikhan ki gawah dibo lage?

english_text: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan bhi Isor laga ninda kowa hunise. Apuni khan ki bhabi ase?” Aru taikhan sob taike morai dibo lage koise.

english_text: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.
nagamese_text: Titia kunba Tai uporte thuki se, aru tai laga mukh dhakai dise, aru Taike marikena koise, “Bhabobani kobi!” Aru daruga khan bhi Taike loi jaise aru thapor marise.

english_text: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te Peter nichete bohi asele aru moha purohit laga nokorni ta te ahise.

english_text: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”
nagamese_text: Aru taike koise, “Tumi bhi Nazareth Jisu logote asele nohoi?”

english_text: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai nohoi koise, “Moi najane, tumi ki koi ase moi bujhi panai.” Aru tai bahar ulai jaise.

english_text: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”
nagamese_text: Aru etu nokorni taike aru dikhi kene usor thaka khan ke koise, “Etu manu bhi taikhan logot ekjon ase!”

english_text: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”
nagamese_text: Kintu tai nohoi koi dise, aru olop, pichete ta te khara thaka ekjon pora Peter ke koise, “Hosa ase, tumi bhi taikhan majote ekjon ase, kelemane tumi bhi Galilee manu ase.”

english_text: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai shrap di kosom khai koise, “Apuni jun laga kotha koi ase moi etu manu ke najane.”

english_text: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.
nagamese_text: Aru titia dusra bar murga hala korise. Titia Peter Jisu kowa kotha ke bhabona korise, “Murga duibar hala kora age te tumi Moike tin-bar najane kobo,” aru titia tai etu kotha bhabi kene kandise.

english_text: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.
nagamese_text: Dusra din phojur huwa loge-loge mukhyo purohit khan pora niyom likha khan, bura khan aru pura sabha manu khan kotha milai kene Jisu ke bandi Pilate laga hathte di dise.

english_text: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
nagamese_text: Pilate pora Jisu ke hudise, “Tumi Yehudi laga raja ase?” Tai jowab di taike koise, “Apuni kowa to ase.”

english_text: The chief priests accused him of many things.
nagamese_text: Aru purohit khan Taike bisi kotha te bodnam lagaise.

english_text: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate Taike koise, “Apuni eku jowab nadibo? Sabi taikhan Tumi laga bhirodh te ki bodnam lagai ase?”

english_text: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu eku kowa nai, karone Pilate bisi asurit hoise.

english_text: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.
nagamese_text: Aru etu purbb somoi ekta manu bondhi te thaka ke chari dibole niyom thake, kunke taikhan chari dibole itcha kore.

english_text: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te Barabbas naam ekjon manu morai diya taikhan logote bondhi te asele aru jun he bhirodh kori kene manu morai disele.

english_text: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
nagamese_text: Titia bhir pora taike binti korise jineka niyom kori ahise tineka kori dibi koi kene jor pora hala korise.

english_text: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
nagamese_text: Kintu Pilate taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Moi tumikhan nimite Yehudi laga Raja ke chari dibo naki?”

english_text: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai jani asele mukhyo purohit khan he Taike suku joli kene dhori taike di dise.

english_text: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.
nagamese_text: Kintu mukhyo purohit khan pora Barabbas taikhan ke dibi koi kene manu khan ke chukuli kori dise.

english_text: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”
nagamese_text: Aru Pilate koise, “Tinehoile moi tumikhan Yehudi laga Raja Taike ki kori dibo?”

english_text: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”
nagamese_text: Etu karone taikhan aru hala kori koise, “Taike Cross te mari dibi!”

english_text: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Kile, Tai ki biya kaam korise?” Kintu taikhan aru bisi jor pora hala kori kene koise, “Taike ke Cross te mari dibi.”

english_text: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
nagamese_text: Karone Pilate bisi manu ke khushi kori dibo itcha pora Barabbas ke taikhan nimite chari dise, aru Jisu ke chabuk mari kene Taike Cross te mari bole di dise.

english_text: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
nagamese_text: Titia sipahi khan Taike raja laga darbar -kuntu ke Praetorium koi- ta te loi jaise aru pura platon joma kori loise.

english_text: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan begoni rong kapra Taike pindhai dise, aru katta thaka laga mukut bonai kene Tai laga matha te rakhidise.

english_text: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
nagamese_text: Aru Taike eneka koi thakise: “Salam, Yehudi laga Raja!”

english_text: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ekta lathi loi kene Tai matha te mari thakise, aru Tai upor thuk phelaise aru athukari kene taike sonman kora nisena kori thakise.

english_text: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Taike dhamali kori loise, Taike age te begoni rong kapra pindhai diya to ulaikene Tai nijor kapra lagai dise, aru Taike Cross te mari dibole bahar te loi jaise.

english_text: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Cyrene desh laga Alexander aru Rufus laga baba Simon, jun desh pora ahi asele, taike joborjosti Jisu laga Cross ke loi jabole dhori loise.

english_text: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan Taike Golgotha- naam motlob ase, “Matha Hardi laga jaga”- ta te loi anise.

english_text: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.
nagamese_text: Taike tita pani draikha ros logot milai kene khabo dibole bisarise, kintu Tai etu khanai.

english_text: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.
nagamese_text: Aru Taike Cross te mari dise, aru chithi kheli kene Tai laga kapra bhag kori loise kun ki pabo koi kene.

english_text: It was the third hour when they crucified him.
nagamese_text: Aru tin ghanta somoite taikhan Taike Cross te mari dise.

english_text: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai matha uporte Tai laga golti likhi dise, “Yehudi Khan Laga Raja” koi kene.

english_text: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.
nagamese_text: Aru Rome sipahi khan pora duita chor bhi Cross te mari dise, ejkon Tai dyna phale, aru dusra Tai laga baya phale.

english_text: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”
nagamese_text: Aru Taike golti thaka khan logote ginti kori loise koi kene Shastro te likhi diya kotha pura hoise.

english_text: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,
nagamese_text: Aru rasta te aha juwa kori thaka khan sob nijor laga matha hilai kene hinsa korise, “Ha! Tumi mondoli bhangai dikene, aru tin dinte bonai dibo kowa manu.

english_text: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”
nagamese_text: Cross pora niche nami ahi bhi aru nije ke bachai lobi!”

english_text: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
nagamese_text: Tineka mukhyo purohit khan bhi niyom likha khan logote mili Taike hinsa kori koise, “Tai dusra ke to bachai thake, kintu Tai nije ke bachabo napare.

english_text: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.
nagamese_text: Israel laga Raja Khrista etiya Cross pora niche namibi, amikhan bhi dikhi kene biswas kori bole,” aru junke Tai logote Cross te disele taikhan bhi Taike ninda korise.

english_text: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
nagamese_text: Aru titia choi ghanta somoi hoise, ta te pura desh te baroh baji pora tin baji tak andhera hoi jaise.

english_text: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
nagamese_text: Aru tin baji laga homoi te Jisu jor pora hala kori koise, “Eloi, Eloi lama sabachthani?” Motlob ase, “Ami laga Isor, Ami laga Isor, kele Apuni Amike chari dise?”

english_text: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
nagamese_text: Jun manu khan Tai usorte khara asele, taikhan etu huni kene koise, “Sabi Tai Elijah ke mati ase.”

english_text: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”
nagamese_text: Titia kunba ekjon polaikena spanj jinis ani kene tenga panite bhi jaise aru ekta nol pora Taike khabole dise, aru koise, “Tai ekla ke chari bhi aru sabi, Elijah ahikena Taike namai dibo na nai amikhan sabo!”

english_text: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu jor pora hala kori Tai laga atma di dise.

english_text: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
nagamese_text: Titia girja laga porda upor pora niche tak phati kene dui tukra hoise.

english_text: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
nagamese_text: Ekjon henapoti Tai samne te khara thakisele. Jitia Jisu saas charikena morise, etu dikhi kene tai koise, “Hosa ase, etu manu he Isor laga Putro ase.”

english_text: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
nagamese_text: Ta te kunba mahila khan asele jun dur pora sai thakise, Mary Magdalene, aru Mary -chutu James aru Joses laga ama,- aru Salome.

english_text: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Galilee te thakisele, eitu khan Tai laga piche-piche ahi Taike sewa kori thakisele, aru bisi mahila khan bhi asele, jun Tai logot te Jerusalem te ahise.

english_text: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
nagamese_text: Aru saam hoise, etu Taiyar Din asele, Bisram din laga ek din age.

english_text: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
nagamese_text: Arimathea nogor te thaka manu Joseph ahise. Tai sabha laga dangor manu asele, aru tai Isor laga rajyo aha rukhi thaka manu asele. Tai mon dangor pora Pilate logote jai kene Jisu laga gaw mangise.

english_text: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.
nagamese_text: Pilate asurit hoise, Tai joldi morise koi kene, aru henapoti ke mati ani kene Jisu morise na nai etu hudise.

english_text: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai henapoti pora jani loise, titia Jisu laga gaw Joseph ke dibole koi dise.

english_text: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
nagamese_text: Aru Joseph pora Jisu laga gaw namai kene bhal norom kapra pora bandi kene, Taike pathor pora bona kobor te rakhidise, aru kobor laga dorjate ekta pathor pora bondh kori dise.

english_text: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.
nagamese_text: Aru Mary Magdalene aru Joses laga ama Mary bhi Jisu laga gaw kot te rakhise etu ahikena saise.

english_text: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Bisram din khotom hoise, titia Mary Magdalene, James laga ama Mary aru Salome taikhan logot mitha sugandh thaka tel khan anise, Jisu ke abhishek kori dibole.

english_text: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
nagamese_text: Aru hapta laga prothom din te ekdom phojurte suryo ula loge-loge taikhan kobor te ahise.

english_text: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan majot eneka kotha koi thakise, “Kun pora amikhan nimite kobor laga dorja pora pathor hatai dibo?”

english_text: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia taikhan ta te punchikena saise, etu dangor pathor to hati kene thaka paise.

english_text: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
nagamese_text: Aru kobor bhitor te jai kene taikhan jawan manu ekjon lamba boga kapra pindhi kene dyna phale bohi thaka paise, titia taikhan bisi bhoi khaise.

english_text: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!
nagamese_text: Kintu tai taikhan ke koise, “Bhoi na koribi. Tumikhan Nazareth Jisu ke bisari ase, junke Cross te mari disele. Tai jee uthijaise. Tai yate nai. Taike kote rakhise etu jagah sabi.

english_text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan jai kene Tai chela khan aru Peter ke koi dibi, ‘Tai tumikhan laga age Galilee te punchi ase, ta te tumikhan Taike pai jabo, jineka Tai tumikhan ke koisele.’”

english_text: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan kobor pora ulaikene polai jaise, kelemane taikhan kapi aru hairan hoise, taikhan kunke bhi eku kowa nai kelemane taikhan bhoi lagi sele.

english_text: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
nagamese_text: Titia hapta laga prothom din te, Tai jee uthija-a pichete, Tai sob pora age Mary Magdalene, jun pora Tai sat-ta bhoot ulai disele, etu ke dikhai dise.

english_text: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
nagamese_text: Aru Mary Magdelene jai kene Jisu laga chela khan ke koi dise, jun khan bisi mon dukh hoi kene kandi thakisele.

english_text: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan Jisu jinda hoise koi kene hunise, aru taike dikhise, kintu taikhan biswas kora nai.

english_text: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Tai alag chehera hoi kene duijon chela ke dikhai dise, jitia taikhan dusra desh te jai asele.

english_text: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
nagamese_text: Tai duijon Jerusalem te wapas jai kene taikhan ke koise, kintu taikhan pora duijon ke biswas kora nai.

english_text: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
nagamese_text: Pichete jitia egaroh jon chela khan khabole bohi asele, Jisu ahi kene taikhan ke dikhai dise, aru taikhan mon tan huwa aru biswas nathaka karone taikhan ke galise. Kelemane Tai jee utha pichete jun khan pora Taike dikhise koise eitu khan laga kotha biswas kora nai.

english_text: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan prithibi sob te jai kene sob sristi khan ke etu susamachar jonai dibi.

english_text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
nagamese_text: Jun manu biswas kore aru baptizma lobo, taikhan bachibo kintu jun biswas nokorile taike nosto kori dibo.

english_text: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
nagamese_text: Aru biswas kora khan logote etu chihna thakibo, taikhan Moi laga naam te bhoot khan ke khedai dibo aru taikhan alag-alag bhasha te kobo.

english_text: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan saph ke uthai lobo, aru taikhan jodi jeher khai le bhi eku biya nohobo, taikhan bemar manu uporte hath rakhile bhal hoi jabo.”

english_text: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
nagamese_text: Titia Probhu Jisu taikhan logote kotha kowa pichete Taike sorgote uthai loi jaise, aru Isor laga dyna hathte bohi jaise.

english_text: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan jai kene sob jagah te prochar kori jaise, aru Probhu pora taikhan logote ki kaam korise aru vachan dise, etu ke loi proman kori jai thakise.

english_text: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
nagamese_text: Bisi manu khan pora kotha aru kaam khan laga khisa joma kori kene likhibo nimite kosis korise, juntu amikhan majot te pura hoise

english_text: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
nagamese_text: jineka pora amikhan laga hathte dise jun khan shuru te nijor suku pora dikhise aru kotha laga noukar khan asele.

english_text: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami etu bisi bhal nisena dikhi ase, bhal pora bisari kene sob kotha aru kaam khan to shuru pora apuni ke hisab-kitab pora likhi ase mohan Theophilus,

english_text: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
nagamese_text: eneka hoile tumi janibo etu bostu laga asol kotha juntu apuni ke sikhai dise.

english_text: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
nagamese_text: Aru Herod pora Judea laga raja thaka somoite Abijah laga dol pora Zachariah naam laga ekjon purohit thakise. Tai laga maiki to Aaron laga khandan pora asele aru tai laga naam Elizabeth asele.

english_text: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
nagamese_text: Aru tai duijon Isor usorte bisi bhal thakise, aru Probhu pora ki koi sob kotha to sapha pora mani thake.

english_text: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan bacha thaka nai, kelemane Elizabeth to bacha pabole napara maiki thakise, aru tai duijon laga umor bhi bisi hoi jaise.

english_text: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
nagamese_text: Etiya eneka hoise, jitia Zechariah tai Isor usorte tai laga purohit kaam khan kori asele, juntu kaan khan tai laga dol khan pora kore.

english_text: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
nagamese_text: Titia, purohit laga niyom hisab te, taike Isor laga pobitro ghor bhitor te jai kene dhup aru dhona julabole chithi pora basi se.

english_text: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
nagamese_text: Jitia dhona juli jaise etu homoi te sob manu khan bahar te prathana kori thakise.

english_text: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
nagamese_text: Titia Probhu laga sorgodoth tai usorte ahise, aru jun jagate dhona julai se etu laga dyna phale khara korise.

english_text: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Zechariah etu dikhise tai bisi chinta hoise aru tai uporte bisi bhoi ahi jaise.

english_text: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, sorgodoth koise, “Bhoi na koribi Zechariah, tumi laga prathana huni loise. Tumi laga maiki Elizabeth pora ekjon chokra pabo. Aru tumi tai laga naam John rakhibo.

english_text: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan anond aru bhal lagibo, aru bisi manu khan tai laga jonom te khushi koribo.

english_text: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
nagamese_text: Aru tai Probhu usorte bisi dangor hobo. Tai kitia bhi draikha-ros nakhabole lage, tai ama laga peth te thaka homoi pora he Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi jabo.

english_text: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.
nagamese_text: Aru tai Israel laga bacha khan ke Probhu Isor logote wapas anibo.

english_text: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
nagamese_text: Elijah laga atma aru takot pora Probhu laga kaam te tai he age kori kene loijabo. Aru jun dharmikta laga kotha namani kene ase taikhan laga mon ghurai dibo nimite aru baba khan laga mon taikhan laga bacha khan phale ghurai dibole, aru jun Probhu ahibole ase Tai nimite rasta taiyar kori bole.”

english_text: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
nagamese_text: Zechariah pora sorgodoth ke koise, “Moi etu hobo koi kene kineka janibo? Kelemane moi bura hoise aru moi laga maiki bhi umor bisi hoise.”

english_text: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth taike jawab dikene koise, “Moi Gabriel ase, jun Isor usorte khara kore. Amike tumi logote kotha kobole pathaise, aru etu bhal khobor to tumike kobole nimite.

english_text: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
nagamese_text: Aru etu nimite, sob kaam to nohua tak tumi chup thakibo aru kotha ulabo na paribo, kelemane tumi moi laga kotha biswas kora nai, etu sob to tai laga thik homoi te pura hobo.”

english_text: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
nagamese_text: Aru manu khan Zechariah nimite rukhi thakisele, aru taikhan chinta-bhabona korise jitia tai mondoli ghor bhithor te deri korise.

english_text: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tai bahar te ulai ahise tai kotha kobole para nai, titia taikhan bhabise taike Isor pora kiba ekta dikhaise; aru tai manu khan ke ishara pora dikhai di thakise, aru kotha koribo naparikena he thaki jaise.

english_text: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
nagamese_text: Aru etu sob to tai laga sewa kora homoi pura aru khotom hoise, titia tai ghor te jai jaise.

english_text: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
nagamese_text: Aru etu din piche, tai laga maiki Elizabeth bacha bukhi se, aru pans mohina tak tai nije ke lukai kene rakhise, aru koi thakise,

english_text: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
nagamese_text: “Isor ami uporte eneka korise, aru ami uporte Probhu he daya korise, manu usorte sorom nathakibo nimite.”

english_text: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,
nagamese_text: Aru Elizabeth peth te bacha bukha choi mohina huwa homoi te, Isor pora sorgodoth Gabriel ke Galilee, juntu ke Nazareth mate, etu jagate pathaise,

english_text: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
nagamese_text: ekjon kumari mahila logote, jun Joseph koi kene ekjon manu logot shadi kori bole laga kotha milikena asele, aru jun David ghor manu asele; aru etu kumari laga naam Mary asele.

english_text: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
nagamese_text: Aru tai logote ahikena, sorgodoth koise, “Salam tumike, jun uporte Isor laga morom ahise! Probhu tumi logote ase.”

english_text: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
nagamese_text: Aru tai etu kotha khan huni kene chinta hoise aru tai bhabi thakise etu kineka laga salam ase.

english_text: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth taike koise, “Bhoi na koribi, Mary, tumi to Isor usorte morom paise.

english_text: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
nagamese_text: Aru tumi ekjon chokra bukhi bo, aru Tai laga naam ‘Jisu’ rakhibo.

english_text: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,
nagamese_text: Tai bisi mohan hobo aru Taike Sobse Mohan laga Putro eneka matibo. Aru Probhu Isor taike, tai laga purbo David laga singhason dibo.

english_text: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai hodai nimite Jacob laga ghor cholai thakibo, aru Tai laga rajyo kitia bhi khotom nahobo.”

english_text: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
nagamese_text: Aru Mary pora sorgodoth logote koise, “Etu kineka hobo, kelemane moi kun manu ke bhi najane?”

english_text: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth he taike koise, “Pobitro Atma tumi logote ahibo, aru Sobse Mohan takot pora tumike bondh kori dibo. Etu nimite juntu pobitro bacha jonom hobole ase, Taike Isor laga Putro matibo.

english_text: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
nagamese_text: Aru sabi tumi laga ghor manu Elizabeth bhi tai laga buri umorte chokra pabole ase. Aru tai bacha bukha choi mohina chuli asele, tai junke dusra khan pora bacha bukhibo napara mahila koi thakisele.

english_text: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor nimite eku napara nai.”

english_text: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
nagamese_text: Aru Mary koise, “Sabi moi Probhu laga ekjon mahila noukar ase. Apuni ki koi ase etu nisena hobole dibi.” Titia sorgodoth jai jaise.

english_text: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
nagamese_text: Etu huwa pichete, Mary tara-tari kori kene pahar desh te jaise, Judah laga sheher ekta te.

english_text: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
nagamese_text: Aru Zechariah aru Elizabeth laga ghor te ghusi kene salam dise.

english_text: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise jitia Mary pora Elizabeth ke salam dise, tai laga pet bhitor te bacha thaka to khushi pora hili se, aru Elizabeth to Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoise.

english_text: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
nagamese_text: Aru tai khushi pora hala kori kene koise; “Sob maiki bhitor te tumi ekjon asirbad thaka ase, aru jun he apuni laga bhitor te ase etu bhi asirbad ase.

english_text: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
nagamese_text: Aru etu moi logote kineka hoise, moi laga Probhu laga ama moi logote ahise.

english_text: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
nagamese_text: Aru sabi, apuni laga salam jitia moi kan pora hunise, moi laga bhitor te bacha thaka to khushi pora hili se.

english_text: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
nagamese_text: Aru etu manu asirbad ase jun to kotha khan purah hobo koi kene biswas korise, juntu kotha to Probhu pora taike koise.”

english_text: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
nagamese_text: Titia Mary koise, “Moi laga jibon Probhu ke mohima kore,

english_text: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
nagamese_text: Aru moi laga Atma khushi kori ase jun Isor he moi laga Tran-korta ase.

english_text: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai upor pora, sobse mamuli maiki ekjon, tai laga noukar ke saise. Aru sabi, etiya pora sob manu khan moike asirbad ase kobo.

english_text: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Mohan Isor pora moi nimite dangor kaam kori dise aru tai laga naam to pobitro ase.

english_text: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga morom to etiya pora loi kene aha din tak jun manu taike bhoi kore tai logote ase.

english_text: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
nagamese_text: Tai laga hath pora bisi dangor kaam korise. Aru jun manu tai laga monte phutani bhabona kore taikhan ke alag kori diye.

english_text: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan bohi kene raj kora jaga pora nichete girai dise. Aru jun chutu hoise eitu khan ke uthaise.

english_text: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
nagamese_text: Aru bhuka thaka khan ke bhal saman pora bhorta kori dise, Aru dhun manu khan ke khali kori dise.

english_text: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga noukar, Israel ke modot korise, tai laga morom to yaad korise,

english_text: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai kotha korise moi khan baba laga baba khan ke- Abraham aru tai laga bacha khan logote hodai nimite.”

english_text: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
nagamese_text: Aru Mary Elizabeth logote tin mohina tak thakise aru etu pichete tai laga ghor te jai jaise.

english_text: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
nagamese_text: Aru Elizabeth nimite bacha pabole laga homoi ahi jaise aru tai ekjon chokra ke jonom dise.

english_text: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
nagamese_text: Tai laga ghor manu aru usorte thaka khan Probhu pora kiman dangor aru morom kaam korise etu dikhi kene tai logote khushi korise.

english_text: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
nagamese_text: Aru bacha ath din hoi thaka homoi te taikhan bacha ke sunnot kori bole anise, aru tai laga baba Zechariah laga naam te rakhibole thakise.

english_text: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
nagamese_text: Hoilebi tai laga ama pora koise, “Nohoi. Taike John laga naam pora he matibo.”

english_text: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan koise, “Apuni laga ghor manu bhitor te kun bhi etu naam thaka manu nai.”

english_text: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan tai laga baba ke hath dikhai kene ki mati bole mon ase etu hudise.

english_text: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
nagamese_text: Tai laga baba pora likhi bole saman mangise aru likhise, koise, “Tai laga naam to John ase.” Titia taikhan sob asurit hoi jaise.

english_text: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
nagamese_text: Aru achanak pora tai laga mukh khuli se aru tai laga jiba to hili se, aru tai Isor ke asirbad dise.

english_text: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
nagamese_text: Sob Judea laga jagate etu laga kotha he koi thakise, aru jiman manu taikhan usorte thakise, taikhan sob bhoi hoise.

english_text: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
nagamese_text: Jun manu etu kotha khan hunise etu sob taikhan nijor laga monte rakhise, aru koi thakise, “Etu bacha kineka hobo?” Kelemane Isor laga hath tai logote asele.

english_text: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
nagamese_text: Titia tai laga baba Zechariah ke Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoise aru tai koise,

english_text: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
nagamese_text: “Asirbad hobo Probhu, Israel laga Isor, Kelemane Tai modot kori bole ahise, aru Tai laga manu khan nimite ki bhabise etu purah hoise.

english_text: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan nimite Tai laga noukar David laga porial te ekjon mukti laga seing ulai dise,

english_text: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
nagamese_text: Jineka tai purana homoi te pobitro bhabobadi laga mukh pora koisele.

english_text: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
nagamese_text: Biya pora mukti pabo aru taikhan laga hath pora amikhan ke bachai lobo.

english_text: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
nagamese_text: Tai eneka kori kene amikhan baba laga baba khan uporte morom to dikhai dibo. Aru tai laga ki pobitro vachan dise etu yaad koribo.

english_text: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
nagamese_text: Aru juntu kosom Abraham amikhan baba laga baba khan logote khaise, etu dibo nimite

english_text: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan ke dushman laga hath pora bachai kene ulai luwa nisena amikhan taike bhoi nakori kene tai laga sewa koribo,

english_text: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
nagamese_text: Pobitrota te aru sapha pora taike hodai mohima koribo.

english_text: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
nagamese_text: Aru apuni ke, oh bacha, sob pora dangor bhabobadi matibo kelemane apuni Probhu laga age te jabo aru rasta taiyar koribo.

english_text: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
nagamese_text: Tai laga manu khan ke poritran laga gyaan dibole, taikhan laga paap pora maph pai ja-a dwara.

english_text: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,
nagamese_text: Aru etu sob to purah hobo kelemane amikhan laga Isor to morom aru nomro ase. Etu nimite uporte thaka ujala bhi amikhan ke modot kori bole ahibo,

english_text: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
nagamese_text: Aru jun andhera te bohi ase aru mora-laga chaya te bohi kene ase taikhan uporte ujala thakibo; amikhan laga theng to shanti laga rasta te bera bole dibo.”

english_text: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
nagamese_text: Aru bacha to dangor hoise aru atma te takot hoise, aru tai jongol te thakise jitia tak tai nijorke Israel manu usorte ahi dikhai diya nai.

english_text: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
nagamese_text: Aru etu din khan te eneka hoise, Caesar Augustus pora ekta hukum ulaise dise, etu duniya laga manu khan sob sorkari kagos te naam likhi kene nijor laga ginti kori lobole.

english_text: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
nagamese_text: Aru poila dinte hoile, jitia Quirinius pora Syria jaga laga governor thakise, etu homoi pora naam likha shuru hoise.

english_text: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
nagamese_text: Aru sob manu nijor laga naam likhi bole nijor desh te jaise.

english_text: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,
nagamese_text: Aru Joseph bhi Galilee pora jaise, Nazareth aru Judea laga sheher pora, David laga sheher pora juntu ke Bethlehem mate, kelemane tai bhi David laga ghor manu ase aru tai laga khandan pora ahise.

english_text: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
nagamese_text: Tai Mary ke loi kene naam likhi bole jaise, jun tai logote shadi kori bole laga kotha milai kene thakise, aru tai bacha bukhi thakise.

english_text: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan Bethlehem te thakise, bacha ke jonom hobole homoi ahi jaise.

english_text: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
nagamese_text: Aru tai chokra ke jonom dise, tai laga poila bacha, aru kapra tukra khan pora bandi kene, taike khair te ghumai dise, kelemane aram kora ghor te taikhan thaki bole jaga thaka nai.

english_text: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
nagamese_text: Aru etu jagate, kunba mer rokhiya khan thakise. Aru rati te taikhan kheti te mer khan ke rukhi thakise.

english_text: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
nagamese_text: Aru Probhu laga sorgodoth taikhan usorte ahise, aru Probhu laga mohima taikhan uporte dise, aru taikhan bisi bhoi lagise.

english_text: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth pora taikhan ke koise, “Bhoi na koribi, huni bhi, kelemane, moi dangor khushi kotha anise, aru etu sob manu nimite hobo.

english_text: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile aji laga dinte, David laga sheher Bethlehem te, tumikhan nimite, ekjon jonom hoise, jun Tran-korta Probhu Khrista ase!

english_text: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan ke etu chihna di ase: tumikhan ekjon bacha kapra laga tukra khan pora bandi kene khair uporte ghumai kene pabo.”

english_text: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
nagamese_text: Aru achanak pora etu sorgodoth logote bisi duth khan ulaikena ahise, aru Isor ke dhanyavad dikena koi thakise,

english_text: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
nagamese_text: “Sob pora untcha te thaka Isor ke mohima hobi, Aru prithibi te kun logot Tai khushi pai, Taikhan uporte shanti hobole dibi.”

english_text: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia sorgodoth khan sorgote jai jaise, rokhiya khan ekjon-ekjon ke koise, “Ahibi amikhan Bethlehem te jabo, aru ki hoise etu sabo, juntu kotha Probhu koi amikhan ke janibo dise.”

english_text: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan joldi jai kene Mary aru Joseph ke lok paise aru khair te ghumai thaka bacha ke lok paise.

english_text: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan bacha ke sai loise, taikhan jai kene etu bacha laga sob kotha manu khan ke koise.

english_text: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan pora utu bacha laga kotha koise sob manu ke koise, etu huni kene taikhan sob asurit hoise.

english_text: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Mary to etu kotha sob tai laga monte he rakhise.

english_text: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
nagamese_text: Aru saguli roikhya khan, ki kotha taikhan ke sorgodoth khan pora koise aru taikhan ki hunise etu loi kene Isor ke dhanyavad dikene wapas jaise.

english_text: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia ath din pura hoise, tai laga sunnot niyom kora dinte, aru titia tai laga naam Jisu koi kene matidise, juntu naam sorgodoth pora matidise jitia Tai ama laga peth te hoi thakise.

english_text: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
nagamese_text: Aru jitia sapha kora laga din paar hoise, Moses laga niyom hisab te, taike Jerusalem te Isor usorte dibole nimite anise.

english_text: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
nagamese_text: -Aru etu Isor laga niyom te likhi kene ase, “Jiman mota ama laga pet pora ulai ahise, tai Probhu usorte pobitro matibo”-,

english_text: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
nagamese_text: Aru boli dibole nimite juntu Probhu laga niyom te koise, “Ek jora kopu chiriya aru duita chutu kobutar.”

english_text: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
nagamese_text: Aru sabi, Jerusalem te ekjon manu thakisele, tai laga naam Simon ase, tai dharmik jon asele aru Isor ke aradhana di thaka manu asele. Tai Israel nimite mon aram pabole bisara manu thakise; aru Pobitro Atma tai logote thakise.

english_text: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
nagamese_text: Aru Pobitro Atma pora taike dikhai dise, tai mora nadikhibo, jitia tak tai Probhu laga Khrista ke nadikhibo.

english_text: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
nagamese_text: Aru tai Atma te hoi kene mondoli te ahise; aru jitia Jisu laga ama baba pora taike anise; ki niyom ase etu hisab te tai uporte kori bole nimite.

english_text: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga hathte bacha ke uthaikene Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru koise,

english_text: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
nagamese_text: “Etiya apuni laga noukar ke shanti pora etu prithibi chari kene jabole dibi Probhu, apuni laga kotha hisab te.

english_text: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
nagamese_text: Moi laga suku pora apuni laga poritran dikhise,

english_text: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
nagamese_text: Apuni sob to taiyar kori dise apuni laga manu khan usorte:

english_text: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
nagamese_text: Porjati khan ke dikhai dibole nimite ekta ujala ahise, aru Israel manu khan nimite mohima hobole nimite.”

english_text: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
nagamese_text: Aru tai ki koise etu huni kene tai laga ama aru baba asurit hoise.

english_text: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
nagamese_text: Aru Simeon taikhan ke asirbad dise, aru bacha laga ama Mary ke koise, “Sabi, etu bacha ke Israel laga manu khan ke uthai dibo nimite rakhise; aru ek din asurit kaam to kotha namana khan ke dikhai dibo.

english_text: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
nagamese_text: Aru ekta talwar apuni laga atma te maribo- kelemane bisi manu laga monte bhabona kosi thaka to ulai ahibo.”

english_text: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
nagamese_text: Anna bhi ekta bhabobadini thakise, Phanuel laga chukri aru Asher laga jati pora asele. Tai umor bhi bisi hoi jaise, aru tai sat saal tak tai laga mota logote thakise,

english_text: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
nagamese_text: Aru chaurasi saal tak tai ekjon bidhowa thakise. Tai kitia bhi mondoli chara nai, rati aru din tai prathana aru upas te he sewa kori thakise.

english_text: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan usorte ahise, tai Isor ke dhanyavad dibole suru hoise, aru sob manu khan ke etu bacha laga kotha koi dise, kelemane taikhan sob udhar pabo nimite Jerusalem te rukhi thakise.

english_text: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Probhu laga niyom te sob kaam khotom hoise, taikhan Galilee te wapas jaise, juntu jaga Nazareth te asele, taikhan nijor laga bosti.

english_text: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
nagamese_text: Aru bacha Jisu to dangor aru takot hoise, gyaan pora bhorta koi kene, aru Isor laga morom Tai laga uporte thakise.

english_text: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
nagamese_text: Aru hodai saal, Tai laga ama baba Jerusalem te Nistar Laga Utsov nimite jai thake.

english_text: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai baroh saal hoi jaise, taikhan hodai nisena, dhanyavad dibole nimite jaise.

english_text: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia dhanyavad diya aru kha-luwa laga homoi to khotom koi kene paar hoise, jitia taikhan ghor te jai thakise, Jisu to Jerusalem te thaki jaise. Aru tai laga ama aru baba etu jana nai.

english_text: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan bhabise Jisu taikhan logote he eke logote jai ase, aru eneka pora ek din laga safar kori loise. Aru etu pichete taike ghor manu aru sathi khan majote bisari bole shuru hoise.

english_text: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Taike pa-a nai taikhan aru Jerusalem te ghuri kene jaise aru taike bisari bole shuru hoise.

english_text: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.
nagamese_text: Aru tin din pichete Taike mondoli te paise, sikhai diya manu khan majote bohi kene taikhan ki koi ase etu huni thakise aru kiba kibi hudi thakise.

english_text: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
nagamese_text: Aru jiman manu Tai laga gyaan aru kotha hunise, sob manu khan bisi asurit hoi jaise.

english_text: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Taike dikhise, taikhan sob asurit hoi jaise, Tai laga ama pora koise, “Putro, amikhan ke kele eneka korise? Sabi, Apuni laga baba aru moi bisi chinta pora Apnike bisari thakise.”

english_text: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Tai pora koise, “Kile Moike bisari ase? Apnikhan najane naki Moi laga Baba ghor te Moi thaki bole lage koi kene?”

english_text: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Tai ki koise etu kotha taikhan bujhi bole para nai.

english_text: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete taikhan logote Nazareth te ahi jaise, aru taikhan laga kotha mani kene thakise. Tai laga ama to sob kotha tai laga mon bhitor te he rakhise.

english_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu tai laga gyaan aru buddhi te bisi bari kene jaise, aru Isor aru manu logot te morom paise.

english_text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
nagamese_text: Jitia Tiberius Caesar pondro saal raj kori thaka homoi te, aru Pontius Pilate pora Judea laga governor thaka homoi te, aru Herod bhi Galilee laga ekjon sthaniya cholawta thakise, aru tai laga kokai Philip bhi eturaea aru Trachonitis laga cholawta thakise, aru Lysanias bhi Abilene laga ekjon cholawta thakise,

english_text: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
nagamese_text: Jitia Annas aru Caiaphas, moha purohit thakise, titia Isor Zechariah laga chokra jongol te thaka homoi te, Isor laga kotha tai logote ahise.

english_text: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
nagamese_text: Aru tai Jordan laga sob jagate jai kene prochar korise, baptizma pora mon ghura bole aru paap pora maph pabole nimite.

english_text: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
nagamese_text: Aru Isaiah bhabobadi pora likha kotha kowa nisena, “Jongol pora ekta awaj mati ase, ‘Probhu nimite rasta taiyar koribi, aru Tai laga rasta to sidha koribi.

english_text: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
nagamese_text: Sob bhoyam khan bhorta hoi jabo, Aru sob pahar khan ke niche anibo, Aru biya rasta khan sob sidha hoi jabo, Aru tan rasta khan norom hoi jabo,

english_text: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
nagamese_text: Aru sob manu jati Isor laga poritran dikhibo.’”

english_text: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
nagamese_text: Aru titia John pora baptizma lobole aha manu khan ke koise, “Saph laga khandan khan! Isor laga ahibole thaka khong pora polabole kun tumikhan ke polabole koise?

english_text: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
nagamese_text: Etu karone, mon ghurai kene bhal phol ulabi, aru nijor logote koi nathakibi, ‘Moi khan logote baba Abraham ase,’ kelemane moi tumikhan ke koi ase, Isor to Abraham nimite etu pathorkhan pora bhi bacha khan uthabole pare.

english_text: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”
nagamese_text: Hoilebi etu kuthar to taiyar ase, ghas laga jor te laga bole nimite. Etu nimite, juntu ghas to phol nadhure etu kati kene jui te julai dibo.”

english_text: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
nagamese_text: Titia manu khan taike hudibole shuru hoise, “Titia hoile amikhan ki kori bole laga?”

english_text: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ke koise, “Jun logote duita kapra ase ekta kapra to dusra ke dibi jun logote nai, aru jun logote kha luwa ase etu bhi eneka he koribi.”

english_text: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
nagamese_text: Aru poisa utha manu khan bhi baptizma lobole ahise, aru taikhan pora koise, “Shika manu, amikhan ki kori bole lage?”

english_text: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan ke kiman poisa uthabole nimite koise etu pora aru bisi nauthabi.”

english_text: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
nagamese_text: Aru ta te kunba sipahi thaka khan pora hudise, “Aru amikhan ki kori bole lage?” Tai taikhan ke koise. “Tumikhan joborjosti pora kun logote bhi poisa nolobi, aru misa pora manu ke naphasa bhi, aru ki pai etu logote he khushi thakibi.”

english_text: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
nagamese_text: Etiya manu khan bisi rukhi thakise aru monte John to Khrista hoi na nohoi etu asurit hoi kene bhabona kori thakise.

english_text: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
nagamese_text: John he sobke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke pani pora baptizma dise, kintu moi pora bhi dangor ekjon ahi ase, moi Tai laga juta laga rusi khuli bole bhi layak nohoi. Tai he Pobitro Atma aru jui pora sobke baptizma dibo.

english_text: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
nagamese_text: Dhaan laga katha Tai laga hathte ase. Etu pora ekdom sapha kori kene dhaan to dhaan ghor te joma koribo. Kintu chamra to jui thaka jui te phelabo.”

english_text: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ke kisim kotha sob te mon dangor kori dise aru John eneka Isor kotha prochar kori dise.

english_text: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia John pora Herod raja ke tai laga kokai Philip laga maiki Herodias logote golti kaam kora nimite kotha koise, aru tai ki biya kaam khan korise eitu khan sob koi dise,

english_text: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
nagamese_text: Tai etu biya kaam khan logote aru etu bhi milai dise: John ke bondhi ghor te rakhidise.

english_text: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,
nagamese_text: Etu homoi ahi jaise, jitia sob manu baptizma loise, Jisu bhi baptizma korise, aru prathana kora homoi te sorgo khan khuli jaise.

english_text: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai uporte kopu chiriya nisena Pobitro Atma ahise, aru sorgo ekta awaj kotha koise, “Tumi Moi laga Putro ase, junke moi morom kore, Moi Tumi laga uporte bisi khushi ase.”

english_text: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te Jisu tis-saal umor thakise jitia Isor kaam shuru korise. Tai Joseph laga chokra thakise,

english_text: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
nagamese_text: Matthat laga chokra, aru Levi laga chokra, Melchi laga chokra, aru Jannai laga chokra, aru Joseph laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
nagamese_text: Mattathias laga chokra, Amos laga chokra, Nahum laga chokra, Esli laga chokra, aru Naggai laga chokra.

english_text: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
nagamese_text: Maath laga chokra, Mattathias laga chokra, Semein laga chokra, Josech laga chokra aru Joda laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
nagamese_text: Joanan laga chokra, Rhesa laga chokra, Zerubbabel laga chokra, Salathiel laga chokra aru Neri laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
nagamese_text: Melchi laga chokra, Addi laga chokra, Cosam laga chokra, Elmadam laga chokra aru Er laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
nagamese_text: Joshua laga chokra, Eliezer laga chokra, Jorim laga chokra, Matthat laga chokra aru Levi laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
nagamese_text: Simeon laga chokra, Judah laga chokra, Joseph laga chokra, Jonam laga chokra aru Eliakim laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
nagamese_text: Melea laga chokra, Memna laga chokra, Mattatha laga chokra, Nathan laga chokra aru David laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
nagamese_text: Jesse laga chokra, Obed laga chokra, Boaz laga chokra, Salmon laga chokra aru Nahshon laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
nagamese_text: Amminadab laga chokra, Admin laga chokra, Arni laga chokra, Hezron laga chokra, Perez laga chokra aru Judah laga chokra

english_text: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
nagamese_text: Jacob laga chokra, Isaac laga chokra. Abraham laga chokra, Terah laga chokra aru Nahor laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
nagamese_text: Serug laga chokra Reu laga chokra, Peleg laga chokra, Eber laga chokra aru Shelah laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
nagamese_text: Cainan laga chokra, Arphaxad laga chokra, Shem laga chokra, Noah laga chokra aru Lamech laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
nagamese_text: Methuselah laga chokra, Enoch laga chokra, Jared laga chokra, Mahalaleel laga chokra, aru Cainan laga chokra,

english_text: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
