nagamese_text: Titia Jisu ghuri kene Peter ke saise, aru titia Peter Jisu kowa kotha to monte ahise, jitia Jisu koisele, “Tumi tin bar Moike ashikar kobo aru titia murga hala koribo.”

english_text: He went out, and wept bitterly.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter bahar te jai kene tai laga mon tita hoi kene bisi kandise.

english_text: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
nagamese_text: Aru titia sipahi khan Jisu ke biya kotha koi kene mari bole shuru hoise.

english_text: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu laga suku te kapra bandi kene, koise, “Bhabobani koribi! Kun pora tumike marise koi sabi?”

english_text: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan bisi bodnam aru biya kotha kori kene Jisu ke sorom khilai se.

english_text: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia din hoise, bura manu khan ahi kene joma hoise, aru mukhyo purohit khan aru niyom likha khan, aru Jisu ke sabha te loi jaise,

english_text: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Jodi tumi Khrista hoi, amikhan ke kobi.” Kintu Tai koise, “Jodi Moi tumikhan ke koi, tumikhan kitia bhi biswas nokorile;

english_text: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
nagamese_text: aru Moi tumikhan ke hudile, tumikhan kitia bhi Moike jowab dibole na paribo.

english_text: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya pora Manu laga Putro ke Isor laga dyna hathte bohi thaka dikhibo.”

english_text: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan koise, “Etu karone, tumi Isor laga Putro hoi naki?” Aru Tai koise, “Tumikhan he koi ase, Moi nohoi.”

english_text: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
nagamese_text: Taikhan apaste koi thakise, “Amikhan etu kotha age te aru ki janibole gawahi lagi ase? Amikhan tai laga nijor mukh pora etu kotha huni loise.”

english_text: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
nagamese_text: Titia sob manu uthi kene Jisu ke Pilate laga age te anise.

english_text: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan shuru hoise, aru koise, “Etu manu desh ke biya kori ase, aru Caesar ke saman dibole mana kore, aru tai nijorke Khrista, ekjon raja ase koi.”

english_text: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate pora Jisu ke hudise, “Tumi Yehudi manu laga Raja ase naki?” Kintu Tai jawab dise, “Tumi nijor etu koi ase.”

english_text: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate pora mukhyo purohit khan aru manu khan ke koise, “Moi etu manu uporte eku golti nadikhe.”

english_text: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan etu mana nai aru, koise, “Tai manu khan ke loi kene pura Judea te sikhai kene berai thake, Galilee pora shuru kori kene yate Jerusalem te bhi sikhai.”

english_text: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Pilate etu hunise, titia tai hudise Jisu to Galilee laga ase naki koi kene.

english_text: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai janise Jisu uporte niyom chola bo nimite Herod laga hathte he adhikar ase, tai Herod usorte Taike pathai dise, Herod tai nijor bhi Jerusalem te thakise.

english_text: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Herod pora Jisu ke dikhise, tai bisi khushi paise, kelemane tai Jisu ke bisi din pora sabole mon thakise, aru tai Jisu pora kiba ekta asurit chihna kora to sabole mon thakise.

english_text: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
nagamese_text: Titia Herod pora Jisu ke bisi kotha hudise, kintu Tai eku jowab diya nai.

english_text: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
nagamese_text: Titia mukhyo purohit khan aru niyom likha khan age te khara hoise, aru Taike biya bebohar kori kene sorom khilai se.

english_text: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
nagamese_text: Titia Herod aru tai laga sipahi khan bhi milikena Jisu ke bisi ninda korise aru sorom khilai se. Taike raja laga bhal kapra lagai dise, aru Pilate usorte wapas pathai dise.

english_text: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
nagamese_text: Thik etu dinte Pilate aru Herod bhal sathi hoi jaise, kintu olop din age te tai duijon bhitor te kotha namila thakisele.

english_text: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate pora mukhyo purohit khan, cholawta khan aru niyom likha khan ke matise,

english_text: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan etu manu ke moi logote anise aru koise tai pora manu khan ke phuslai ase, aru tumikhan usorte Ami taike hudise, kintu tumikhan Tai uporte ki arop lagai ase, moi etu manu uporte eku biya dikha nai.

english_text: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
nagamese_text: Aru Herod bhi Tai uporte eku golti dikha nai, etu karone tai bhi Jisu ke amikhan logote pathai dise, aru sabi, taike mora laga sajai dibole nimite eneka eku kaam kora nai.

english_text: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi taike sajai dibo, aru chari dibo.”

english_text: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jerusalem te jitia dangor utsov hoi, niyom pora duijon bhitor te ekjon bondhi ghor te thaka manu ke chari bole lage.

english_text: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan sob hala kori kene koise, “Etu, manu ke sajai dibi aru bodli te Barabbas ke chari dibi!”

english_text: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
nagamese_text: -Barabbas ke bondhi ghor te rakhise kelemane tai manu ke morai disele aru sheher te jhagara ulabole dise.-

english_text: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
nagamese_text: Aru Pilate pora manu khan ke aru kotha koise, tai Jisu ke chari bole mon thakise.

english_text: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan aru bhi hala kori kene koise, “Cross te morai dibi, Cross te morai dibi.”

english_text: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
nagamese_text: Pilate pora tin bar taikhan logote koise, “Kile, etu manu pora ki biya kaam korise? Moi Tai uporte eku golti dikha nai juntu pora Taike morai dibo lagise. Etu karone Taike sajai dikena chari dibo.”

english_text: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob awaj uthaikene khong pora mangise, aru jor pora hala kori thakise Jisu ke Cross te morabo lage koi kene.

english_text: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Pilate taikhan laga kotha mani loise.

english_text: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
nagamese_text: Barabbas ke bondhi ghor pora ajad kori dise, jun manu ke morai diya aru biya kaam kora ekjon dokait thakise. Kintu Jisu ke taikhan hathte di dise.

english_text: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.
nagamese_text: Aru Pilate laga ghor pora manu khan Jisu ke bahar te loi jaise, aru ekjon manu Simon, Cyrene sheher pora aha ke dhurikena, tai uporte Cross dikena Jisu pichete te jabo dise.

english_text: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te, bhir te manu khan aru maiki khan bisi mon dukh pora Tai usorte kandi thakise, aru Tai laga piche kori thakise.

english_text: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora ghurikena taikhan ke koise, “Jerusalem laga mahila khan, Moi nimite nakandibi, kintu tumikhan nijor nimite aru bacha khan nimite kandibi.

english_text: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
nagamese_text: Kelemane sabi, eneka din ase jitia taikhan kobo,’ ‘Dhonyo ase bacha nathaka mahila khan aru jun laga pet pora bacha jonom huwa nai, aru dudh khila nai.

english_text: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan pahar ke kobo, ‘Amikhan uporte giri bhi,’ aru pahar khan girikena ‘amikhan ke bondh kori dibi.’

english_text: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
nagamese_text: Jodi ghas pata khan hara thaka homoi te eneka kore, tenehoile ghas sukhi ja-a somoite ki halat hobo?”

english_text: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
nagamese_text: Aru duijon dokait ke Jisu logote loijai kene Cross te morai dise.

english_text: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
nagamese_text: Jitia etu jagate ponchise, etu jaga laga naam to “Matha laga Hardi,” mate, taikhan ta te Jisu ke Cross te mari dise, aru duijon dokait ke bhi Jisu laga dyna aru baya phale Cross te mari dise.

english_text: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu koise, “Baba, taikhan ke maph kori dibi, taikhan ki korise etu taikhan najane.” Pichete taikhan Jisu laga kapra to chithi kheli kene bhag korise.

english_text: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
nagamese_text: Sob manu rukhi kene sai thakise. Aru titia cholawta manu khan Jisu ke sorom khilai kene koise, “Tai dusra ke bachaise. Etiya nijorke bachai lobi, jodi Tai Isor laga Khrista, basi luwa jon to ase koile.”

english_text: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
nagamese_text: Sipahi khan bhi Jisu ke sorom khilai se, aru tita pani dise,

english_text: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Apuni jodi Yehudi khan laga raja ase koile, nijorke bachai lobi.”

english_text: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
nagamese_text: Tai uporte ekta kotha likhi dise, “Jisu Yehudi khan laga Raja.”

english_text: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
nagamese_text: Titia ekjon dokait Jisu usorte Cross te thaka pora sorom khilai se Jisu ke koise, “Tumi Khrista nohoi naki? Tumi nijorke bachai lobi aru amikhan ke bhi bachai lobi.”

english_text: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra ekjon pora tai laga sathi ke koise, “Tumi Isor ke bhoi nalage naki, amikhan biya kaam kora nimite nijor sajai pai ase?

english_text: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
nagamese_text: Aru etu amikhan pabo lage, amikhan ki biya kaam korise etu hisab te he sajai pai ase. Kintu etu manu eku golti kora nai.”

english_text: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Jisu, moike yaad koribi jitia Apuni Paradise te jabo.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taike koise, “Moi hosa koise, tumi aji Ami logote Paradise te thakibo.”

english_text: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
nagamese_text: Kintu baroh baji homoi te, achanak etu sob jagate andhera ahi jaise.

english_text: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
nagamese_text: Suryo andhar hoi jaise aru Jerusalem mondoli laga purdah phati jaise.

english_text: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete jor pora awaj ulaikena Jisu koise, “Baba Apuni laga hathte Moi laga Atma di ase.” Etu koi kene Tai laga saas to chari dise.

english_text: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia henedhikari pora etu dikhise, tai Isor ke mohima dise, aru koise, “Hosa pora Tai ekjon dharmik manu thakise.”

english_text: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
nagamese_text: Jiman bhir etu sabole ahise, taikhan ki hoise etu dikhise, aru bisi mon dukh hoi kene nijor chati te marikena jai jaise.

english_text: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun manu Taike bhal pora jane, aru jiman mahila khan Galilee pora Tai logot ahise taikhan dur pora ki hoi ase etu sai thakise.

english_text: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te ekjon manu Joseph koi kene jun sabha te ekjon hisa thaka manu asele aru tai bhal aru dharmik manu asele.

english_text: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.
nagamese_text: -Tai sabha laga dusra manu khan logote kotha mila nai.- Tai Arimathea sheher laga Yehudi manu thakise, aru tai bhi Isor laga rajyo ahibole nimite rukhi thakise.

english_text: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
nagamese_text: Tai Pilate, usorte jai kene Jisu laga gaw mangise.

english_text: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
nagamese_text: Aru tai Cross pora gaw namaise, aru sapha mihin kapra pora Jisu laga gaw to bandi dise, aru pathor katikena kobor bonai rakha jagate Jisu ke rakhise, jun jagate kitia bhi manu ke rakha nai.

english_text: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
nagamese_text: Titia Jugut Din punchise, aru Bisram din shuru hobole asele.

english_text: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.
nagamese_text: Aru Galilee pora jiman khan Jisu piche kori thakise, taikhan jai kene kobor ke saise jun jagate Jisu laga gaw rakhise.

english_text: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
nagamese_text: Aru mahila khan wapas jai kene mitha sugandh tel aru dawai khan Jisu laga gaw te laga bole nimite jugut korise. Aru taikhan niyom hisab te Bisram din to pobitro rakhikena aram korise.

english_text: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
nagamese_text: Etiya hapta laga poila din te, etu mahila khan kobor usorte ahise, mitha sugandh tel aru dawai jugut kori kene anise.

english_text: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan dikhise kobor bondh kori kene rakha pathor to hataikena ase,

english_text: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
nagamese_text: kintu taikhan bhitor te jai kene Probhu Jisu laga gaw to dikha nai.

english_text: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise, jitia kobor te Jisu laga gaw dikha nai, taikhan asurit hoise. Aru achanak pora, duijon manu boga kapra lagai kene taikhan usorte khara hoise.

english_text: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
nagamese_text: Aru, mahila khan bhoi lagikena matha niche kori kene matite girise, etu manu khan pora mahila khan ke hudise, “Tumikhan jinda manu ke mora khan majote kele bisari ase?

english_text: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
nagamese_text: Tai yate nai, kintu jinda hoise! Yaad koribi kineka Tai tumikhan ke koisele Galilee te thaka homoi te,

english_text: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
nagamese_text: koisele Manu laga Putro kineka paapi manu hathte di dibo aru Taike Cross te morai dibo, aru tin dinte Tai aru bhi jinda hoi jabo.”

english_text: They remembered his words,
nagamese_text: Titia mahila khan Jisu laga kotha monte yaad ahise,

english_text: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
nagamese_text: aru jitia kobor pora wapas jaise, taikhan jai kene egaroh jon chela aru sob manu khan ke khobor di dise.

english_text: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
nagamese_text: Aru Mary Magdalene, Joanna, aru Mary James laga ama aru mahila khan jai kene chela khan ke khobor di dise.

english_text: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu khobor to chela khan misa bhabise, aru mahila khan kowa kotha to biswas kora nai.

english_text: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi Peter to uthi kene, Jisu laga kobor te polaikene jaise, aru usor pora saise aru khali Jisu ke bandi rakha mihin kapra he dikhise. Aru tai bahar te ulaikena ki hoise etu bhabise.

english_text: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Aru ek din, duijon manu ekta bosti te jai thakise. Jerusalem pora sath mil dur thaka Emmaus bosti te.

english_text: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
nagamese_text: Etu din khan te ki hoise eitu khan sob laga kotha khan koi kene jai thakise.

english_text: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise, taikhan kotha patikena jai thaka homoi te, Jisu taikhan usorte achanak pora ahi kene taikhan eke logote jai thakise.

english_text: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan suku pora Jisu ke chini bole para nai.

english_text: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan ki kotha patikena mon dukh pora jai ase?” Taikhan khara hoi jaise, mon dukh pora.

english_text: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
nagamese_text: Kintu ekjon Cleopas pora Jisu ke hudise, “Apuni Jerusalem te ekla ahise naki aru ki hoise etu najane?”

english_text: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke hudise, “Yate ki hoise?” Taikhan koise, “Nazareth Jisu laga kotha, kun ekjon manu thakise, aru asurit kaam aru kotha para Isor usorte aru sob manu nimite Tai ekjon dangor bhabobadi thakise,

english_text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
nagamese_text: Aru mukhyo purohit khan aru cholawta khan pora Taike dhorise aru bodnam kori kene Cross te morai dise.

english_text: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi khan biswas kori thakise Tai he Israel manu ke mukti dibo. Kintu etu sob pura hoi kene, aji tin din hoi jaise.

english_text: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
nagamese_text: Kintu kunba mahila khan kobor te joldi jai kene, amikhan ke ahi kene asurit kotha koise.

english_text: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan Jisu laga gaw to kobor bhitor te dikha nai, taikhan sorgodoth khan ke darshan korise koise aru Jisu jinda ase koise.

english_text: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan logote thaka kunba kobor sabole jaise aru jineka mahila khan pora koise eneka he dikhise, kintu Jisu ke ta te dikha nai.”

english_text: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “O murkho aru mon chutu kori thaka khan jun khan bhabobadi khan pora ki koise etu sobke biswas kore!

english_text: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
nagamese_text: Etu dorkar thaka nai naki Khrista dukh paikena, aru bhi Isor laga mohima te huma bole?”

english_text: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
nagamese_text: Moses pora suru kori kene aru kiman bhabobadi khan thakise, taikhan ke ki pobitro kotha te Tai nimite likha ase etu bujhi bole dise.

english_text: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
nagamese_text: Taikhan jabole thaka bosti te ponchise, aru Jisu age te jabo nisena korise.

english_text: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan pora Taike anurodh kori kene koise, “Amikhan logote thakibi, aji laga din to khotom hobole hoise.” Aru Jisu taikhan logote thaki bole jaise.

english_text: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoise, jitia taikhan eke logote bohise, Tai roti loise, aru asirbad korise, aru bhangi kene taikhan ke dise.

english_text: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan laga suku khuli se, aru taikhan Taike chini paise, aru Jisu taikhan usor pora Atma hoi kene jai jaise.

english_text: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan ekjon-ekjon logote kotha patise, “Moi khan laga mon to joli thaka nai naki, jitia Tai amikhan logote ahi thakise, aru jitia Isor laga kotha to puri kene hunai sile?”

english_text: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te taikhan uthise, aru Jerusalem te wapas jaise. Egaroh chela khan eke logote joma hoi thakise, aru dusra khan bhi eke logote thakise.

english_text: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
nagamese_text: Aru koise, “Hosa pora Probhu jinda hoise, aru Simon usorte ahise.”

english_text: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
nagamese_text: Titia rasta te ki hoise etu sob taikhan ke koi dise, kineka Jisu amikhan ke dikhai dise jitia Tai roti bhangise.

english_text: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu kotha khan koi thakise, Jisu taikhan majote ahikena khara hoi kene koise, “Tumikhan uporte shanti thakibi.”

english_text: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan asurit hoise, aru bisi bhoi lagise, taikhan bhabise ekjon bhoot taikhan laga usorte ahise.

english_text: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan kele bhoi lagise, aru kele monte alag bhabona kori ase?

english_text: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
nagamese_text: Ami laga hath aru theng to sabi, etu Moi he ase. Moike chui kene sabi kele atma to mangso aru hardi nathake, kintu Moi logot eitu khan thaka tumikhan dikhi ase.”

english_text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai etu kotha koise, Tai laga hath aru theng taikhan ke dikhai dise.

english_text: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
nagamese_text: Aru etu homoi te taikhan bisi asurit aru khushi pora biswas nakora nisena hoi jaise, Tai aru taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan logote kiba khabole ase naki?”

english_text: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Jisu ke jolai rakha maas khabole dise,

english_text: He took them, and ate in front of them.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan usorte Jisu etu loi kene khaise.

english_text: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Etu Ami laga kotha ase, Ami jinda thaka homoi te tumikhan ke ki koisele, Moses laga kitab te aru bhabobadi khan aru Bhajan Geet te Ami nimite ki likha ase, etu sob pura hobo lage.”

english_text: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
nagamese_text: Titia Isor laga kotha bujhi bole taikhan laga dimag khuli dise, etu pichete Jisu taikhan ke koise,

english_text: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
nagamese_text: “Etu nimite Isor kotha te eneka likha ase: Khrista dukh pabo, aru mora pora tin dinte jee uthibo;

english_text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: aru mon ghura bole aru paap pora khyama pabole sob desh te prochar koribo, Jerusalem pora shuru hobo.

english_text: You are witnesses of these things.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan etu sob laga gawahi hobo.

english_text: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke Baba pora ki kosom dise, etu te pathai ase. Kintu tumikhan Jerusalem chari kene najabi jitia tak sorgo laga takot tumikhan uporte nahe.”

english_text: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taikhan ke olop dur Bethany te loi jaise, aru Tai laga hath uthaikene, taikhan ke asirbad korise.

english_text: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
nagamese_text: Etiya eneka hoise, jitia Tai pora taikhan ke asirbad kori thakise, etu somoite badal ahikena Jisu ke uthaikene sorgote loi jaise.

english_text: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke mohima kori thakise, aru khushi anondo pora Jerusalem te wapas jaise,

english_text: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan mondoli te jai kene Isor ke dhanyavad aru aradhana kori thakise.

english_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
nagamese_text: Shuru te Kotha asele, aru Kotha to Isor logote thakise, aru Kotha he Isor ase.

english_text: The same was in the beginning with God.
nagamese_text: Etu shuru pora Isor logote he thakise.

english_text: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
nagamese_text: Sob jinis Tai pora he bonaise, aru ki bonaise Tai nathaki kene eku bhi bona nai.

english_text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
nagamese_text: Tai logote jibon asele, aru jibon to manu khan laga pohor asele.

english_text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
nagamese_text: Aru pohor to andhera te ujala korise, aru andhera to pohor ke jitibo para nai.

english_text: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
nagamese_text: Isor pora pathai diya ekjon manu asele, jun laga naam John thakise.

english_text: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
nagamese_text: Tai gawahi hoi ahise, pohor laga kotha jonai dibole, aru sob Tai dwara biswas kori bole.

english_text: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
nagamese_text: John nijor to pohor nohoi, kintu tai pohor laga gawahi dibole ahise.

english_text: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
nagamese_text: Sob manu ke pohor dibole asol pohor duniya te ahi thakise.

english_text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
nagamese_text: Tai duniya te thakisele, aru Tai he duniya bonaise, kintu duniya pora Taike janibo para nai.

english_text: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
nagamese_text: Tai nijor manu khan majote ahise, kintu Tai nijor manu khan pora Taike luwa nai.

english_text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
nagamese_text: Kintu jiman jon pora Taike grohon korise, Tai he taikhan ke Isor laga bacha hobole adhikar dise, jun Tai naam pora biswas kori loise.

english_text: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
nagamese_text: Taikhan jonom to khun pora bhi nohoi, mangso pora bhi nohoi, aru mangso itcha pora bhi nohoi, kintu Isor laga itcha pora ase.

english_text: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
nagamese_text: Aru Kotha to gaw mangso hoi kene amikhan majote thakise. Amikhan Tai laga mohima dikhise, eneka mohima juntu Baba pora tai laga ekjon morom thaka Putro ke dise, aru etu anugraha aru hosa pora bhorta ase.

english_text: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
nagamese_text: John pora Tai laga gawahi dikene eneka koise, “Etu he ekjon ase Jun nimite moi koise, ‘Jun moi laga piche ahi ase, Tai to moi pora bhi bisi dangor ase, kelemane moi laga age pora Tai thakise.’”

english_text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai bhorta hoi thaka pora amikhan anugraha uporte anugraha paise.

english_text: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kelemane niyom to Moses dwara anidise. Kintu anugraha aru hosa to Jisu Khrista pora he anise.

english_text: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
nagamese_text: Isor ke kun bhi kitia bhi dikha nai. Ekjon Isor, jun Baba laga usorte bohi ase, etu ke he Tai dikhai dise.

english_text: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
nagamese_text: John laga gawahi etu ase, Yehudi khan Jerusalem sheher pora Levi dol laga purohit khan ke pathaise taike hudibole, “Apuni kun ase?”

english_text: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
nagamese_text: Tai shikar kori kene koise- “Moi Khrista nohoi.”

english_text: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan hudise, “Nohoile apuni kun ase? Apuni Elijah ase?” Tai koise, “Moi nohoi.” Taikhan koise, “Apuni bhabobadi ase?” Aru tai jawab dise, “Nohoi.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
nagamese_text: Arubi taikhan taike hudise, “Apuni kun ase? Kilekoile amikhan ke pathai diya khan ke jowab dibo lage. Apuni nijorke kun ase koi?”

english_text: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Ami ekta awaj ase, juntu jongol te hala kori koi ase: ‘Probhu laga rasta sidha koribi,’ Jineka bhabobadi Isaiah pora likhise.”

english_text: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te Pharisee khan pora kunba manu khan ke pathaise.

english_text: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan taike hudise, “Jodi apuni Khrista nohoi, Elijah bhi nohoi, aru bhabobadi bhi nohoi, to kele apuni baptizma di ase?”

english_text: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
nagamese_text: John taikhan ke jawab dise aru koise, “Moi pani pora baptizma di thaka he ase. Kintu tumikhan majote ekjon khara ase, Junke tumikhan najane.

english_text: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
nagamese_text: Jun moi pichete ahi ase moi Tai laga juta laga rusi bhi khuli bole layak manu nohoi.”

english_text: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
nagamese_text: Etu sob to Jordan nodi laga dusra phale thaka Bethany te hoise, kun to jagate John baptizma di thakise.

english_text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
nagamese_text: Dusra dinte Jisu tai logote ahi thaka dikhikena John koise, “Sabi, Isor laga Mer bacha, kun pora etu duniya laga paap uthai loi jabole ase!

english_text: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
nagamese_text: Etu he ase, Kun laga kotha moi age pora koi dise, ‘Ekjon ami laga piche ahi ase, Jun he moi pora bhi dangor ase, kelemane moi pora poila Tai thakisele.’

english_text: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
nagamese_text: Moi bhi Taike najane. Kintu Israel manu khan logot Taike prokahit kori dibo karone moi pani pora baptizma di ahise.”

english_text: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
nagamese_text: Aru John etu gawahi dikene koise, “Atma he paro nisena sorgo pora ahikena Tai uporte bohi juwa moi dikhise.

english_text: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
nagamese_text: Moi Taike najane kintu Jun he moike pani pora baptizma dibole pathaise, Tai he moike koise, ‘Jun uporte Atma ahi thaki juwa tumi dikhibo, Tai he Pobitro Atma pora baptizma dibo thaka to ase.’

english_text: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
nagamese_text: Aru moi etu dikhi kene gawahi di ase, etu he Isor laga Putro ase.”

english_text: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
nagamese_text: Dusra dinte John pora tai laga duijon chela ke loi kene khara thakise.

english_text: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu berai kene aha dikhi kene tai koise, “Sabi, Isor laga Mer bacha!”

english_text: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
nagamese_text: Titia duijon chela etu huni kene Jisu laga piche korise.

english_text: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu ghuri saise aru tai duijon ke dikhi kene hudise, “Tumikhan ke ki lage?” Taikhan koise, “Rabbi, Apuni kot te thaki ase? - Etu motlob to Shika manu- Apuni kot te thake?”

english_text: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Ahi kene sabi.” Taikhan jai kene Tai kot te thaki ase etu dikhise, aru etu din Tai logote thaki jaise, aru etu somoi to dos ghanta nisena asele.

english_text: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
nagamese_text: Duijon majote kun John laga kotha huni kene Jisu logote jaise, etu ekjon to Simon Peter laga bhai Andrew thakise.

english_text: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
nagamese_text: Tai Simon ke bisari kene koise, “Amikhan Messiah ke pai loise,” motlob ase Khrista.

english_text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
nagamese_text: Aru taike loi kene Jisu logot anise, aru Jisu taike saikene koise, “O Jonah laga Putro Simon, tumike Kefa matibo” - dusra naam ase Peter.

english_text: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
nagamese_text: Dusra din Jisu to Galilee jagate jabole mon thakise, titia Tai Philip ke lok paise aru taike koise, “Ami laga piche koribi.”

english_text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
nagamese_text: Philip to Bethsaida nogor laga manu asele, juntu sheher to Andrew aru Peter laga sheher asele.

english_text: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Philip pora Nathaniel ke paise, tai koise, “Moses laga kitab te aru bhabobadi khan he jun laga kotha likhi rakhise, etu amikhan pai loise: etu Joseph laga chokra Nazareth Jisu he ase.”

english_text: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Nathaniel taike koise, “Bhal bostu Nazareth pora ulabo naki?” Philip pora taike koise, “Ahibi aru sabi.”

english_text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu pora Nathaniel Tai phale aha dikhi kene koise, “Sabi, etu hosa te Israel manu ase, tai thogai diya manu nohoi!”

english_text: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
nagamese_text: Nathaniel Taike koise, “Apuni moike kineka jane?” Jisu taike jowab di koise, “Philip pora tumike mata age te tumi dimoru ghas niche bohi thaka Moi dikhise.”

english_text: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
nagamese_text: Nathaniel Taike jowab dise, “Rabbi, Apuni Isor laga Chora ase! Apuni Israel laga Raja ase!”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab te taike koise, “kelemane Moi tumike koise, ‘Moi Tumike dimoru ghas nichete bohi thaka dikhise’ kowa karone tumi biswas korise? Tumi etu pora bhi bisi dangor kaam dikhibo.”

english_text: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taike koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, tumikhan sorgo khuli diya, aru Isor laga duth khan pora Manu laga Putro uporte aha juwa kora dikhibo.”

english_text: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
nagamese_text: Tin din pichete, ta te shadi thakise, Cana nogor laga Galilee te, aru Jisu laga ama bhi ta te thakise.

english_text: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.
nagamese_text: Aru etu shadi te Jisu aru Tai chela khan ke bhi matise.

english_text: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
nagamese_text: Jitia draikha ros khotom hoise, Tai ama pora Taike koise, “Taikhan logote draikha ros aru nathaka hoise.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taike koise, “Mahila, Moi nimite aru tumi nimite etu ki ase? Ami laga somoi puncha nai.”

english_text: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
nagamese_text: Tai ama pora nokorkhan ke koise “Ki hoile bhi Tai tumikhan ke koribi kobo, etu he koribi.”

english_text: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
nagamese_text: Titia pathor pora bona choita pani kolsi Yehudi khan laga niyom hisab te dhulai thaka ekta jagate rakhi thakise, ekta kolsi to dui-tin metre nisena lamba thakise.

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Kolsi te pani bhorai dibi.” Taikhan eneka bhorai dise.

english_text: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai nokorkhan ke koise, “Etu olop ulai lobi aru loijai kene kha luwa saithaka manu ke dibi.” Aru taikhan eneka korise.

english_text: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
nagamese_text: Titia kha luwa sa manu pora etu pani ke khai saise jun to draikha ros hoise, hoilebi etu kot pora ahise jana nai, kintu nokorkhan jun he pani anidise taikhan to jani thakise, aru kha luwa sa manu shadi koribo thaka mota ke matise.

english_text: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
nagamese_text: Aru koise, “Sob manu prothom te bhal draikha ros diye, aru jitia bhal to khai loi kene nisa hoijai etu pichete he sosta laga draikha ros diye, kintu apuni to bhal ros etiya tak bhi rakhi ase.”

english_text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora Galilee laga Cana te etu prothom chihna kori kene Tai nijor mohima dikhai dise, aru chela khan Taike biswas korise.

english_text: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Tai laga ama aru bhai aru chela khan ke loi kene Capernaum te namise, aru ta te taikhan olop din thakise.

english_text: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Yehudi khan laga Nistar din usor ahi thakise, aru Jisu Jerusalem te jaise.

english_text: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
nagamese_text: Aru mondoli bhitor te bail guru aru mer khan aru kabotar bikiri kori kene toka-poisa bodla-bodli kori thaka paise.

english_text: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai ekta chabuk bonai kene mondoli pora bail guru aru mer khan sob bahar te khedai dise, aru toka-poisa bodla-bodli kori thaka khan laga poisa sob phelai dise, aru taikhan laga mez bhi ultai dise.

english_text: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai paro bikiri kori thaka khan ke koise, “Tumikhan etu sob yate pora loijabi. Ami laga Baba laga ghor ke bajar jaga nabona bhi.”

english_text: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai laga chela khan yaad ahise ki likha asele, “Tumi laga ghor nimite josh pora he moike khotom koribo.”

english_text: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi cholawta khan Taike koise, “Apuni ki chihna amikhan ke dikha bo, kele koile Apuni etu kaam khan kori ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Etu mondoli ke khotom kori dibi, aru Moi etu ke tin dinte aru khara kori dibo.”

english_text: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan laga cholawta khan koise, “Etu mondoli bona bole chheyalis saal lagise, aru Apuni tin dinte etu khara kori dibo?”

english_text: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
nagamese_text: Kintu, Tai nijor gaw laga mondoli koi thakise.

english_text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.
nagamese_text: Karone, jitia Tai mora pora punoruthan hoise, Tai chela khan yaad ahise, ki Tai etu taikhan ke koise, aru Jisu taikhan ke kowa kotha ke bhi aru shastro kitab ke bhi biswas kori loise.

english_text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Nistar purbb somoite Jerusalem te ahise, bisi manu Tai kori diya asurit kaam ke dikhi kene Tai naam pora biswas kori loise.

english_text: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu Tai nijor pora taikhan ke biswas kora nai kelemane Tai taikhan sobke jani asele,

english_text: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
nagamese_text: aru kunbi manu laga gawahi Taike kobo nalage kelemane manu bhithor te ki ase sob Tai jane.

english_text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
nagamese_text: Pharisee khan majote ekjon Yehudi cholawta thakise, jun laga naam Nicodemus asele.

english_text: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
nagamese_text: Tai rati te Jisu logote ahi Taike hudi kene koise, “Rabbi amikhan jane Apuni Isor pora aha ekjon hikhok ase, kelemane Isor Tai logote nathakile kunbi Apuni pora chihna dikhai diya khan koribo na paribo.”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab di koise, “Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, jodi kun bhi notun jonom noloile, Tai Isor laga rajyo dikhi napabo.”

english_text: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
nagamese_text: Nicodemus Taike koise, “Ekjon manu, bura huwa pichete aru kineka jonom lobo paribo? Tai kineka nijor ama pet te dusra bar ghusi kene jonom lobo?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Moi hosa pora tumikhan ke koi ase, jitia tak ekjon pani aru Atma pora jonom nolobo, tai Isor rajyote ghusi bona paribo.

english_text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
nagamese_text: Jun mangso pora jonom hoise, etu mangso ase, aru jun Atma pora jonom hoise etu Atma ase.

english_text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
nagamese_text: Moi ‘tumikhan notun jonom lobo lage’ kowa karone asurit nohobi.

english_text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
nagamese_text: Hawa jun phale jabole mon ase, ta te jai thake, aru tumi etu awaj huni thake, kintu etu kot pora ahise aru kot phale jabole ase etu najane, etu karone jun Atma pora jonom hoise, tineka he ase.”

english_text: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
nagamese_text: Nicodemus jowab dikena Taike koise, “Etu kineka hobo paribo?”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab dise, “Tumi Yehudi laga hikhok hoi kene bhi etu kotha bujhi bo napare?

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
nagamese_text: Moi tumike hosa kobo, Amikhan ki jane etu he koi, aru ki dikhise etu gawahi diye, kintu tumikhan Ami laga gawahi lobo napare.

english_text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
nagamese_text: Jitia Moi tumikhan ke duniya laga kotha koise, aru tumikhan biswas kora nai, jodi Moi sorgo laga kotha koile tumikhan biswas koribo?

english_text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
nagamese_text: Aru kun bhi sorgote juwa nai, ekla Jun he sorgo pora ahise- Manu laga Putro.

english_text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
nagamese_text: Aru jineka Moses pora jongol te saph ke upor uthai dise, tineka Manu laga Putro ke bhi uporte uthabo lagibo.

english_text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jun Taike biswas koribo, nost nohobo kintu anonto jibon pabo.

english_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor duniya ke eneka morom korise, Tai nijor laga ekjon he thaka Putro ke di dise, tinehoile jun Taike biswas koribo, khotom nahobo, kintu anondo jibon pabo.

english_text: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor duniya ke khotom kori bole nijor Putro ke patha nohoi, kintu etu karone ase, Tai karone he duniya bachibole.

english_text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
nagamese_text: Jun Taike biswas koribo taike eku golti nadibo, kintu jun Taike biswas nakoribo, etu ke golti kori dibo, kelemane Tai Isor laga ekjon thaka Putro laga naam te biswas nakora hoise.

english_text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
nagamese_text: Aru golti karone bisar to etu ase, puhor to duniya te ahise, kintu manu to puhor pora bhi andhera ke bisi morom kore, kelemane taikhan laga kaam biya ase.

english_text: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
nagamese_text: Jun biya kaam kore, tai puhor ke ghin kore, aru puhor usorte na ahe, tai ki kaam korise etu ke khuli dikhi najabo nimite.

english_text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
nagamese_text: Kintu jun hosa te thake, taikhan to Isor laga itcha pora he kori ase koi kene dikhai dibo karone puhor usorte ahe.”

english_text: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu aru Tai chela aru Judea desh te jai jaise, aru Tai ta te taikhan logote thaki kene baptizma di thakise.

english_text: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
nagamese_text: Aru John bhi Salim usor Aenon te baptizma di thakise, kelemane ta te bisi pani thaka karone, aru taikhan ahi baptizma loi thakise.

english_text: for John was not yet thrown into prison.
nagamese_text: Aru etu somoi tak te John ke bondhi ghor te loi janai.

english_text: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
nagamese_text: Ta te John laga chela khan Yehudi manu ekjon logote Yehudi khan sapha kora niyom laga kotha nimite mon namili kene thakise.

english_text: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan John logote ahi taike koise, “Rabbi, jun Jordan nodi paar te apuni logote thakise, jun nimite apuni kotha koi dise, sabi, etu manu baptizma di thakise, aru sob Tai logote ahijai ase.”

english_text: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
nagamese_text: John jowab dise aru koise, “Sorgo pora manu ke nadile, tai ekubi napabo.

english_text: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
nagamese_text: Apuni khan nijor ami laga gawahi dibo pare kele koile moi age te pora he koi dise, ‘Moi Khrista nohoi’ kintu ‘Tai laga age te pathai diya he ase.’

english_text: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
nagamese_text: Jun logote shadi kora maiki ase tai he shadi kora mota ase. Aru shadi kora mota laga sathi khan pora tai usorte khara koribo aru tai laga awaj huni kene bisi khushi pabo, etu nisena ami laga khushi bhi etu pora pura hobo.

english_text: He must increase, but I must decrease.
nagamese_text: Jisu he dangor hoi jabo lage, kintu moi komti hoi jabo lage.

english_text: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
nagamese_text: Jun upor pora ahise, etu he sob laga upor ase. Jun prithibi pora ahise etu prithibi laga ase, aru prithibi laga kotha koi thake. Jun sorgo pora ase, tai he sob laga upor ase.

english_text: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai ki dikhise aru hunise etu laga gawahi dise, kintu kunbi Tai laga gawahi ke grohon kora nai.

english_text: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
nagamese_text: Jun Tai koi thaka grohon kori loi, etu manu to Isor hosa ase koi kene jani loise.

english_text: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kunke Isor pathai, tai he Isor laga kotha khan koi diye. Kelemane Tai Atma ke napikena nadiye.

english_text: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
nagamese_text: Baba pora Putro ke morom kore, aru sob bostu Tai hathte di dise.

english_text: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
nagamese_text: Jun Putro ke biswas korise anondo jibon tai laga hoise, kintu jun Putro ke biswas nakore, tai to jibon nadikhibo, kintu Isor laga khong tai uporte thaki jabo.”

english_text: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Jisu jani loise Pharisee khan pora Tai he John pora bhi bisi manu ke baptizma dikene chela bonai loise koi kene,

english_text: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
nagamese_text: - kintu Jisu pora nohoi kene Tai laga chela khan he baptizma di thakise-

english_text: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai Judea desh chari kene Galilee jaga phale jai jaise.

english_text: He needed to pass through Samaria.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai Samaria jaga paar kori kene jabo dorkar thakise.

english_text: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
nagamese_text: Karone Tai Samaria laga nogor, Sychar te ahise, etu jaga to Jacob pora tai laga chokra Joseph ke diya jaga usorte thakise.

english_text: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
nagamese_text: Ta te Jacob laga kuha bhi thakise. Aru Jisu safar kora pora hairan koi kene etu kuha usorte bohi jaise, aru etu somoi baroh baji nisena asele.

english_text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
nagamese_text: Titia ekjon Samaria laga mahila pani lobole ahise, aru Jisu taike koise, “Moike pani khila bhi.”

english_text: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te Tai chela khan to kha luwa kini bole nogor te jai kene asele.

english_text: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
nagamese_text: Titia Samaria laga mahila Taike koise, “Kineka Apuni Yehudi hoi kene moi Samaria mahila ke pani khila bhi koi kene mangi ase?” Kelemane Yehudi khan Samaria manu khan logote eku bhi lenden nakore.

english_text: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab di koise, “Jodi tumi Isor laga daan ke janile, aru kun pora tumike koi ase, ‘Moike pani khila bhi,’ titia tumi Tai logote mangibo, aru Tai tumike jibon laga pani dibole asele.”

english_text: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
nagamese_text: Mahila pora Taike koise, “Sahab, Apuni logote pani ulabole baltin nai, aru kuha bhi ghalta ase. To jibon pani kot pora Apuni logote ase?

english_text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”
nagamese_text: Kile, Apuni to amikhan laga baba Jacob pora bhi dangor ase naki, jun he etu kuha amikhan ke dise? Aru tai nijor bacha khan aru nijor pala janwar sob etu te khabole dise?”

english_text: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab di koise, “Jun bhi etu pani khabo aru bhi pyaas lagi jabo,

english_text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
nagamese_text: kintu jun bhi etu pani khabo jun to Moi pora dibo, tai kitia bhi aru pyaas nalagibo. Kintu junke Moi pani dibo tai karone ekta dhara hoi anonto jibon tak bahi thaki jabo.”

english_text: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
nagamese_text: Etu mahila Taike koise, “Sahab, moi aru pyaas nalagibole aru pani lobole iman dur nahibole etu pani moike dibi.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Jabi, aru tumi laga mota ke yate loi anibi.”

english_text: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
nagamese_text: Etu mahila koise, “Moi laga mota nai.” Jisu taike koise, “Tumi ‘moi laga mota nai’ kowa to thik koise.”

english_text: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane tumi pans-ta mota thakisele, aru etiya jun logote tumi thaki ase etu bhi tumi laga mota nohoi kowa, tumi hosa koise.”

english_text: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
nagamese_text: Aru mahila pora Taike koise, “Sahab, moi janise Apuni ekjon bhabobadi ase.”

english_text: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
nagamese_text: Ami laga baba khan etu porbot pora aradhana kori thakise, aru Apuni koi ase manu khan aradhana kori bole jaga to Jerusalem he hoi.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “O mahila, Ami laga kotha biswas koribi, tumikhan etu porbot te bhi aru Jerusalem sheher te bhi Baba ke aradhana kori bole napara somoi ahi ase.

english_text: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan najana ke aradhana kore, amikhan to junke aradhana kore jani kene kore, kelemane poritran to Yehudi pora ase.

english_text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
nagamese_text: Kintu somoi ahi ase, aru etiya ahise, hosa te aradhana kora khan atma pora Isor ke aradhana hobo lage, Baba eneka khan ke he bisare, jun atma te aradhana kore.

english_text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
nagamese_text: Isor to Atma ase, aru kun Taike aradhana koribo atma aru hosa te aradhana koribo lage.”

english_text: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
nagamese_text: Etu maiki Taike koise, “Moi jani ase Massiha ahibo kotha to, junke Khrista koi, jitia Tai ahibo, Tai sob kotha amikhan ke koi dibo.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi he tai ase, ekjon tumi logote kotha kori ase.”

english_text: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai laga chela khan Tai kunba mahila logote kotha kora dikhi kene asurit hoise, kintu kun bhi Tai ki lage aru kele Jisu tai logot te kotha kori ase koi kene huda nai.

english_text: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga pani daba chari kene, etu mahila nogor te dauri jaise, aru manu khan ke koise.

english_text: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”
nagamese_text: “Ahibi aru ekjon ke sabi, moi ki korise etu sob Tai koi dise, etu Khrista kowa to nohoi na?”

english_text: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan town pora ulaikene Tai logote ahise.

english_text: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
nagamese_text: Etu somoite Tai chela khan Taike koise, “Rabbi, kiba khabi.”

english_text: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan najana kiba kha luwa Ami logote ase.”

english_text: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
nagamese_text: Titia chela khan apaste kotha korise, “Kunba pora khabole kiba Taike dise na, diya nai?”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Ami laga kha luwa to Moike pathai diya laga itcha ke pura kori diya to he ase.

english_text: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
nagamese_text: Kile tumikhan nokoi, ‘Kati bole aru bhi char mohina baki ase’? Sabi, Moi tumikhan ke koi ase, suku uthaikene kheti ke sabi, eitu khan kati bole paaki kene boga hoi jaise!

english_text: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
nagamese_text: Aru jun dhaan katikena nijor mojdur pabo, aru phol khan sob joma kori kene anonto jibon karone rakhidibo, titia jun manu bijon hissi dise aru jun dhaan katise, tai duijon mili anondo kori thaki jabo.

english_text: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
nagamese_text: Kelemane, ‘Ekjon bijon hissi dise, aru dusra kati thake’ kowa kotha to hosa ase.

english_text: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan pora hissi kene narakha jagate kati bole Moi tumikhan ke pathai ase. Dusra khan pora hissi dise, aru tumikhan to taikhan laga kaam ke bhag luwa he ase.”

english_text: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”
nagamese_text: Aru etu sheher te thaka Samaria manu khan Taike biswas kori loise, kelemane etu mahila he eneka koise, “Moi age te ki korise sob Tai moike koi dise.”

english_text: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
nagamese_text: Karone jitia Samaria manu khan Tai logote ahise, taikhan pora Taike arubi taikhan logote thakibi koi kene binti korise, etu pora Tai ta te dui din rukhi jaise.

english_text: Many more believed because of his word.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai kotha pora bisi manu biswas kori loise.

english_text: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan etu mahila ke koise, “Etiya to amikhan apuni kowa karone nohoi, kintu amikhan nijor kaan pora Taike huni loise, aru jani loise, Tai he hosa ase, duniya laga Tran-Korta ase.”

english_text: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
nagamese_text: Aru dui din pichete Tai ta te pora Galilee jagate jai jaise.

english_text: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jisu Tai nijor koisele, ekjon bhabobadi tai nijor desh te hoile sonman napai.

english_text: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Galilee te ahise, Galilee manu khan pora Taike khushi paikena grohon korise, ki kaam Tai purbb somoite Jerusalem te korise, taikhan etu sob dikhise kele koile taikhan bhi purbb te jaisele.

english_text: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai aru Galilee te thaka Cana te ahise, kot te Tai pani pora draikha-ros bonai disele. Ta te ekjon daruga laga chokra Capernaum te bemar thakisele.

english_text: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Judea pora Galilee te ahi ahise koi kene tai hunise, tai binti loi kene Tai logote ahise, aru tai laga chokra ke bhal kori dibi koise, kelemane tai mori bole hoi thakise.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taike koise, “Jitia tak tumikhan chihna aru asurit kaam nadikhibo, titia tak biswas nokorile.”

english_text: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
nagamese_text: Daruga pora Taike koise, “Sahab ami laga bacha namora age te ahibi.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Jabi. Tumi laga chokra jinda ase.” Etu manu Jisu taike kowa ke biswas korise, aru jai jaise.

english_text: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
nagamese_text: Kitia tai rasta te thakise, tai laga nokorkhan polai ahi taike lok paise aru koise, apuni laga chokra jinda hoise.

english_text: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai taikhan ke hudise, thik ki somoite chokra to bhal hoise. Aru taikhan koise, “Juwa kali thik ek baji somoite bukhar taike chari jaise.”

english_text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
nagamese_text: Titia tai jani loise, etu somoi Jisu taike kowa thik somoite asele, “Tumi laga chokra jinda ase.” Aru tai aru tai ghor manu sob biswas kori loise.

english_text: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora Judea ke chari kene Galilee te ahise, titia tai etu dusra chihna kori dikhai diya asele.

english_text: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Etu din pichete Yehudi khan laga purbb thakise, aru Jisu Jerusalem te jaise.

english_text: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
nagamese_text: Jerusalem te mer laga duar mata usorte ekta pukhuri asele, etu Ibrani kotha te Bethesda koi, ta te pansta veranda bonai rakhi sele.

english_text: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
nagamese_text: Ta te andha, lengra, aru jothor- rugi bemar thaka khan etu pukhuri laga pani hili bole laga asha te bohi rukhi thake.

english_text: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
nagamese_text: Kelemane olop somoi pichete ekjon sorgodoth ahikena etu pukhuri te pani ke hilai diye, aru kun sob pora prothom te panite jabo, tai laga bemar bhal hoi thake.

english_text: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
nagamese_text: Ta te ekjon manu artis-saal pora bemar hoi kene thakisele.

english_text: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu taike dikhise aru tai ta te bisi din bemar pora eneka thaka jani loise, Tai koise, “Tumi bhal hoi jabole mon ase?”

english_text: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
nagamese_text: Bemar manu taike jowab dise, “Sahab, pani hila somoite moike loi jabole kun bhi nai, aru moi ta te jai thaka te dusra moi pora poila jai thake.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Uthi kene tumi laga charpai uthai loijai jabi.”

english_text: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.
nagamese_text: Aru etu kowa loge-loge te etu manu bhal hoi jaise, aru nijor chatai uthai loi aha juwa korise. Aru etu Bisram din asele.

english_text: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
nagamese_text: Karone Yehudi cholauta khan pora jun bhal hoise etu manu ke koise, “Aji to Bisram din ase, tumi laga charpai uthai loi juwa to niyom nohoi.”

english_text: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’”
nagamese_text: Kintu tai taikhan ke koise, “Kun moike bhal korise, tai moike koise, ‘Tumi laga charpai uthai loijai jabi.’”

english_text: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan hudise, “Tumike ‘tumi laga charpai uthai loijabi’ kowa kun ase?”

english_text: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
nagamese_text: Kintu bhal hoija-a manu to etu kun ase jana nai, kelemane ta te bhir asele, etu karone Jisu ta te pora piche hati jaisele.

english_text: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Jisu mondoli te taike paikene koise, “Sabi, tumi to bhal hoise! Aru etu pora bhi biya tumi uporte nahibo karone aru paap na koribi.”

english_text: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
nagamese_text: Etu manu Yehudi cholawta khan logote jai kene taike changai kori diya to Jisu ase koi dise.

english_text: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
nagamese_text: Karone Yehudi cholawta khan Jisu ke tarona di thakise, aru Taike morai dibole bisari thakise, Tai Bisram dinte etu kaam kori diya karone.

english_text: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Ami laga Baba etiya tak kaam kori ase, aru Moi bhi kaam kori ase.”

english_text: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
nagamese_text: Karone Yehudi cholawta khan Taike morai dibole aru bisi jor korise, kelemane Tai Bisram din laga niyom bhangai diya ekla he nohoi kintu Isor ke Tai laga Baba kowa aru Tai nijorke Isor logot borabar kora karone.

english_text: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, Putro nijor eku koribo napare, kintu ki kaam khan Baba kori thaka Tai dikhe, eitu khan he Putro bhi kori thake.

english_text: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Baba pora Putro ke morom kore, aru ki kaam Tai kore sob to Putro ke dikhai diye, aru etu pora bhi dangor kaam khan Putro ke dikhai dibo aru tumikhan asurit hoi jabo.

english_text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
nagamese_text: Kelemane jineka Baba mora manu ke uthai diye aru jibon diye, tineka he Putro bhi Tai junke bhal pai taike jibon diye.

english_text: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Baba nijor to bisar nakore, kintu bisar kori bole sob kaam Putro ke di dise.

english_text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
nagamese_text: Karone jineka sob manu Baba ke sonman kore, tineka Putro ke bhi sonman koribo, jun Putro ke sonman nakore, Taike pathai diya Baba ke bhi sonman nakore.

english_text: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo jun Moike huni kene Moike pathai diya ke sonman koribo, anondo jibon tai laga hoise, aru saja laga kotha nai, kintu mrityu ke paar kori kene jibon te jai jaise.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, mora manu Isor laga Putro laga awaj hunibo, aru jun huni lobo eitu khan jinda hobole somoi ahi ase, aru etiya ahise.

english_text: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
nagamese_text: Kelemane jineka Baba nijor te jibon rakhe, tineka Putro ke bhi, Tai jibon rakhibole adhikar dise.

english_text: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu he Manu laga Putro ase, etu karone bisar laga adhikar bhi Taike dise.

english_text: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
nagamese_text: Tumikhan etu kotha karone asurit nohobi, kelemane kobor khan te thaka sob pora Tai awaj huni kene bahar te ulai jabo.

english_text: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
nagamese_text: Aru jun bhal kaam korise, eitu khan jibon karone punoruthan hobo, jun biya kaam korise, eitu khan sajai nimite punoruthan hobo, eneka somoi ahi ase.

english_text: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
nagamese_text: Moi nijor eku koribo napare. Jineka Moi hune, eneka bisar kore, aru Moi laga bisar hosa ase, kelemane Moi nijor itcha te nohoi kintu, Moike patha Moi Baba laga itcha te he kore.

english_text: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi nijorke sakhi dile, Moi laga sakhi hosa nohoi.

english_text: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
nagamese_text: Ekjon ase kun Ami laga kotha ke sakhi diye, aru Moi jane, tai pora Ami laga sakhi diya to hosa ase.

english_text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan John logote manu pathaise, aru tai hosa sakhi dise.

english_text: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi manu pora sakhi nalage, kintu Moi tumikhan laga udhar nimite etu koi ase.

english_text: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
