nagamese_text: John to joli thaka aru jiliki thaka saaki ase, aru tumikhan tai puhor te ekbar khushi pora thaki jabo mon kori sele.

english_text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi laga sakhi he John laga sakhi pora dangor ase, kelemane kaam ke pura kori bole Baba he Moike dise, kuntu kaam Moi kori ase, etu pora Baba he Moike pathaise koi kene Moike sakhi di ase.

english_text: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
nagamese_text: Aru Moike pathai diya Baba Tai nijor Moike sakhi dise, tumikhan to kitia bhi Tai awaj huna nai, aru Tai roop bhi dikha nai.

english_text: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan Tai laga kotha monte narakha hoise, karone junke Tai pathaise etu ke bhi tumikhan biswas kora nai.

english_text: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Shastro te anondo jibon ase bhabikena bisari thake, aru etu kotha khan he Moike sakhi di ase,

english_text: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan jibon pabo karone Ami logote ahibole mon nai.

english_text: I don’t receive glory from men.
nagamese_text: Moi manu pora adar nabisare,

english_text: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan Isor ke morom nakora etu Moi jane.

english_text: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
nagamese_text: Ami Moi laga Baba laga naam to ahise, aru tumikhan Moike grohon nakore. Jodi kunba tai nijor naam te ahile, tumikhan etu ke to grohon kori lobo.

english_text: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
nagamese_text: Kineka tumikhan biswas koribo jitia Isor pora aha sonman ke nabisare kene nijor apaste he bisari thake?

english_text: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
nagamese_text: Moi Baba usorte tumikhan ke golti lagabo eneka nabhabi bhi. Tumikhan ke golti kora to Moses ase, junke tumikhan asha rakhise.

english_text: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan Moses kowa biswas kori thakise koile, Moike bhi biswas koribo, kelemane tai Moi nimite likhise.

english_text: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi tumikhan tai likha ke biswas nakore, to tumikhan Ami laga kotha kineka biswas koribo?”

english_text: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan huwa pichete, Jisu Galilee Nodi laga dusra phale jai jaise, juntu ke Tiberias Samundar bhi koi.

english_text: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
nagamese_text: Titia bisi manu Tai piche kori ahise, kelemane Tai bemari khan ke asurit chihna kaam kori diya karone.

english_text: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu tilla te uthise, aru Tai chela khan logote ta te bohi jaise.

english_text: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
nagamese_text: -Aru titia Yehudi khan laga Nistar purbb punchi asele.-

english_text: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Tai laga suku uthaikene saise, Tai phale dangor bhir ahi thaka dikhise, aru Tai Philip ke koise, “Manu khan pora khabo karone amikhan kot pora roti kinibo paribo?”

english_text: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
nagamese_text: -Kintu Tai Philip laga mon sabole tineka he koisele, kelemane Tai nijor ki koribo lage sob jane.-

english_text: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”
nagamese_text: Philip Taike jowab dise, “Duisoh dinari laga roti pora ekjon ke olop-olop dile bhi naponchibo.”

english_text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
nagamese_text: Tai chela pora ekjon Simon Peter laga bhai, Andrew Taike koise.

english_text: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
nagamese_text: Yate ekjon lora ase, tai logote pansta roti aru duita huru maas ase, kintu iman bisi manu karone etu pora ki koribo paribo?

english_text: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu koise, “Manu khan ke bohai dibi.”- Etu jagah te ghas bisi thakisele. Karone manu khan ke bohai dise, aru eitu khan ginti korise aru pans hajar nisena thakise.

english_text: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu roti loi kene dhanyavad dise aru chela khan ke sob logot bhag kori bole dise, aru tineka maas ke bhi, aru jiman lage iman taikhan ke dise.

english_text: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan khai loise Tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Bachi juwa kha-luwa ke joma kori lobi, kelemane eku bhi nuksan hobo nalage.”

english_text: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan joma kori loise, aru pans-ta roti khai kene tukra bachi thaka ke baroh-ta tukri bhorta joma kori loise.

english_text: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
nagamese_text: Titia manu khan Tai asurit kaam kori diya ke dikhi kene koise, “Etu duniya te ahibole thaka bhabobadi to hosa te bhi etu ase.”

english_text: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
nagamese_text: Karone manu khan ahi Taike joborjosti dhori kene raja bonai dibole bhabi thaka Tai jani kene ekbar aru Tai ekla pahar te jai jaise.

english_text: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.
nagamese_text: Jitia saam hoise, Tai chela khan nodi kinar te jaise.

english_text: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
nagamese_text: Aru naw te jai kene nodi paar Capernaum town phale jaise, etu somoi andhera hoise, aru Jisu titia bhi taikhan logote aha nai.

english_text: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
nagamese_text: Titia andhi karone samundar te hawa mari bole lagise.

english_text: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan laga naw to tin nohoile chari mile nisena chari jaise titia taikhan Jisu panite khujkari kene naw usorte aha dikhise aru taikhan bhoi khaise.

english_text: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi ase! Bhoi nokoribi.”

english_text: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike naw te lobole taiyar hoise, aru joldi etu naw kot te jabole ase ta te punchi jaise.

english_text: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra din bhi manu khan samundar paar te thaki jaise, taikhan ta te ekta naw he dikhise, aru Jisu to taikhan logote etu naw te ja-a nai, khali chela khan he jaise.

english_text: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, Tiberias phale pora dusra nawkhan bisi ahise, kun to jagate Probhu he roti loi Isor ke dhanyavad dikene taikhan roti khai sele.

english_text: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
nagamese_text: Jitia manu khan ta te Jisu aru chela khan ke pa-a nai, taikhan aru naw te uthijaise, aru Jisu ke bisari kene Capernaum phale ahise.

english_text: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
nagamese_text: Aru nodi paar te Taike paikene koise, “Rabbi, Apuni kitia yate ahi jaise?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Moi Tumikhan ke hosa kobo, tumikhan chihna dikha karone nohoi, kintu tumikhan pet bhorta roti khabo para karone Moike bisari ase.”

english_text: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
nagamese_text: Nost hobole laga kha luwa karone kaam na koribi, kintu juntu kha luwa anondo jibon tak thakibo, jun to Manu laga Putro he Tumikhan ke dibole ase, etu karone porishram koribi, kelemane Baba Isor he Tai uporte mohor lagai loise.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike koise, “Isor laga kaam kori bole amikhan ki koribo lage?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab te koise, “Etu he Isor laga kaam ase: Junke Tai pathaise, Taike biswas koribi.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan Taike koise, “Tinehoile Apuni amikhan ke ki chihna dikha bo, juntu saikene amikhan Apuni ke biswas kori lobo? Apuni ki koribo?

english_text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga baba khan jongol te manna khaise, ‘Tai he khabole sorgo pora dise, Shastro te eneka likha ase.’”

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, sorgo pora roti tumikhan ke diya to Moses nohoi, kintu Moi laga Baba he hosa laga roti tumikhan ke dise.

english_text: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga roti etu ase, jun sorgo pora ahi kene duniya ke jibon di thake.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike koise, “Sahab, etu roti hodai amikhan ke di thakibi.”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi he jibon roti ase; jun Moi logote ahe tai kitia bhi bhukh nalagibo, aru jun Moike biswas koribo tai kitia bhi aru pyasa nohobo.

english_text: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan Moike dikhi paise, kintu biswas nakore, etu Moi tumikhan ke koi dise.

english_text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
nagamese_text: Baba pora jun khan Moike dise, taikhan sob Moi logote ahibo aru kun Moi logote ahibo, taike Moi kitia bhi nacharibo.

english_text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Moi nijor itcha te nohoi, kintu Moike pathai diya laga itcha pora kori bole Moike sorgo pora niche anise.

english_text: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
nagamese_text: Aru Moike pathai diya Jon laga itcha etu ase, Tai kun pora Moike ki dise, eitu khan ekjon bhi naharaikena, hekh dinte sobke uthabo.

english_text: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Ami laga Baba laga itcha etu ase, jun Putro ke dikhibo, aru Taike biswas koribo, etu anondo jibon pabo aru Moi hekh dinte taike uthai lobo.”

english_text: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan Tai bhirodh kotha korise, kelemane Tai koise, “Sorgo pora aha roti Moi he ase.”

english_text: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan majote eneka hudi thakise, “Etu Joseph laga chokra Jisu nohoi, jun laga ama baba amikhan jane? Tai kele eneka koi ase, ‘Moi sorgo pora ahise’?”

english_text: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
nagamese_text: Karone Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan apaste kotha na koribi.

english_text: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.
nagamese_text: Moike pathai diya Moi laga Baba he loi ani nadile, kun bhi Moi logote ahibo na paribo, aru Moi hekh dinte taike uthai dibo.

english_text: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.
nagamese_text: Bhabobadi khan pora likha eneka ase, ‘Aru taikhan sobke Isor pora sikhai lobo.’ Kun pora Baba laga kotha hunise aru sikhi loise taikhan he Moi logote ahibo.

english_text: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
nagamese_text: Kun bhi Baba ke dikha nai, khali Tai Jun Isor pora ahise- Tai he Baba ke dikhise.

english_text: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, jun Moike biswas koribo, tai anonto jibon pabo.

english_text: I am the bread of life.
nagamese_text: Jibon laga roti Moi ase.

english_text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.
nagamese_text: Tumi baba laga baba khan jongol te manna khaise, aru morise.

english_text: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
nagamese_text: Etu roti to sorgo pora nichete ahise, aru manu khan etu khabo hoile bhi namoribo.

english_text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
nagamese_text: Sorgo pora aha jibon laga roti Moi ase. Jodi kunba etu roti khabo, tai anondo jibon pabo, aru ki roti jibon karone Moi duniya ke dibole ase, etu Moi laga mangso ase.”

english_text: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
nagamese_text: Etu huni kene Yehudi khan apaste kotha namila hoise, “Etu manu kineka kori Tai mangso amikhan ke khabole dibo paribo?”

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, tumikhan Manu laga Putro laga mangso aru Tai laga khun jodi nakhabo, tinehoile tumikhan logote jibon nathakibo.

english_text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
nagamese_text: Jun Moi laga mangso khabo, aru Moi laga khun khabo, anonto jibon tai laga ase, aru Moi hekh dinte taike uthai lobo.

english_text: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Moi laga mangso he asol kha luwa ase, aru Moi laga khun bhi asol laga khun ase.

english_text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
nagamese_text: Jun Moi laga mangso khabo aru Moi laga khun khabo tai Moi logote ase, aru Moi tai logote ase.

english_text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.
nagamese_text: Jivit Baba he Moike pathaise, aru Moi Baba karone jivit ase, tineka jun Moike khabo, tai bhi Moi karone jivit hobo.

english_text: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
nagamese_text: Etu to sorgo pora aha roti ase, tumikhan laga baba khan manna khaise aru mori jaise, jun bhi etu roti khabo, tai anonto tak jinda thakibo.”

english_text: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
nagamese_text: Tai etu kotha khan sob Capernaum laga mondoli te thaka somoite manu khan ke sikhai thakise.

english_text: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
nagamese_text: Karone Tai chela khan jitia etu hunise taikhan koise, “Etu kotha to bisi digdar kotha ase, eitu khan to kun mani bole paribo?

english_text: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai chela khan etu kotha patise, Jisu jani kene taikhan ke koise, “Etu kotha karone tumikhan thogar lagise?

english_text: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
nagamese_text: Aru jodi Manu laga Putro age te thaka jagate wapas uporte juwa tumikhan dikhile kineka hobo?

english_text: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
nagamese_text: Jibon di thaka to Atma ase, gaw to eku labh nai, Moi tumikhan ke kowa khan to atma ase, aru jibon bhi ase.

english_text: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan majote kunba biswas nakora ase.” Kelemane Jisu he shuru pora jani ase, kun biswas nakore aru kun Taike thogai dibole ase.

english_text: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai koise, “Etu karone, Moi tumikhan ke koise, jitia tak Baba pora bordan nadibo kun bhi Moi logote ahibo na paribo.”

english_text: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha karone Tai chela khan bisi Taike chari kene wapas jai jaise.

english_text: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu pora baroh jonke koise, “Tumikhan bhi wapas jabole mon kora nai na?”

english_text: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kintu Simon Peter Taike jowab dise, “Probhu amikhan kun logote jabo? Anondo jibon laga vachan to Apuni logote ase,

english_text: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
nagamese_text: aru amikhan biswas kori ase, aru jani ase, Apuni he Isor laga Pobitro Jon ase.”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Moi he tumikhan baroh jonke basi loise nohoi, aru tumikhan majote ekjon saitan ase?”

english_text: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
nagamese_text: Tai Simon laga chokra Iscariot Judas laga kotha koi asele, kelemane tai he Taike thogai dibole jon ase, baroh jon majote ekjon tai asele.

english_text: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan huwa pichete, Jisu Galilee te berai thakise, kelemane Yehudi khan Taike morai dibole thaka karone Tai Judea phale berabo mon kora nai.

english_text: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
nagamese_text: Yehudi khan laga Tombu laga Purbb din bhi usor ahi ponchise.

english_text: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
nagamese_text: Karone Tai bhai khan Taike koise, “Etu jaga chari kene Judea te jai jabi, Apuni ki kaam kori ase etu Apuni laga chela khan bhi dikhi bole dibi.

english_text: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jun bhi tai nijor naam ke untcha koribo mon kore, tai lukai kene nakore. Jodi Apuni etu kaam korise koile, Apuni nijorke dikhai dibi duniya ke.”

english_text: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jisu laga nijor bhai khan bhi Taike biswas kora nai.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi jabole laga thik somoi huwa nai, kintu tumikhan karone hodai somoi taiyar ase.

english_text: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
nagamese_text: Prithibi tumikhan ke ghin no koribo, kintu Moike ghin kore kelemane Moi taikhan laga biya kaam ke gawahi diye.

english_text: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan purbb te jabi; Moi to etiya etu purbb te najabo, kelemane Moi laga somoi pura huwa nai.”

english_text: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
nagamese_text: Tai taikhan ke etu sob koi dise, aru Tai Galilee te thaki jaise.

english_text: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai bhai khan juwa pichete Tai bhi khula-khula nohoi, kintu lukai kene purbb te jaise.

english_text: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
nagamese_text: Titia, Yehudi cholawta khan Taike purbb te bisarise aru koise, “Tai kot te ase?”

english_text: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
nagamese_text: Aru manu khan majote Tai nimite kotha namila bisi ulaise. Kunba koi, “Tai bhal manu ase.” Kintu dusra khan koise, “Nohoi, kintu Tai manu khan ke ulta loijai.”

english_text: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Yehudi cholawta khan ke bhoi pora kun bhi Tai laga kotha khuli kene kowa nai.

english_text: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia purbb laga adha somoi jaise to Jisu mondoli te ahikena sikhabole shuru hoise.

english_text: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
nagamese_text: Aru Yehudi cholawta khan asurit hoise, koise, “Kineka etu manu Shastro jane, pora likha nathaki kene bhi?”

english_text: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Moi sikhai di thaka kotha khan to Moi pora nohoi, kintu Moike pathai diya pora ase.

english_text: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba Isor laga itcha te jabo mon korile, etu kotha to Isor pora ahise na Moi nijor khushi pora ase, tai nijor janibo.

english_text: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
nagamese_text: Kun nijor khushi pora kobo etu tai nijorke prosansa kori ase, kintu jun taike pathai diya ke prosansa kore, etu hosa ase aru tai monte adharmikta nathake.

english_text: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
nagamese_text: Moses tumikhan ke niyom dise nohoi? Kintu tumikhan kun bhi niyom ke mana nai. Kile tumikhan Moike morai dibole bisari thake?”

english_text: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
nagamese_text: Bhir khan jowab di koise, “Tumi logote bhoot ase. Kun apnike morai dibole bisari ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi ekta kaam kori dise, aru tumikhan sob asurit korise.

english_text: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
nagamese_text: Moses tumikhan ke sunnot laga hukum dise, etu to, Moses pora nohoi kintu baba laga khandan khan pora ahise aru tumikhan Bisram dinte sunnot kori thake.

english_text: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
nagamese_text: Jodi ekjon manu Bisram dinte sunnot kori kene Moses laga niyom nabhangai, to kele tumikhan Moike ghusa kore kelemane Moi Bisram dinte manu ke bhal kora nimite?

english_text: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
nagamese_text: Chehera saikene bisar na koribi, kintu dharmikta pora bisar koribi.”

english_text: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
nagamese_text: Titia Jerusalem pora aha kunba koise, “Taikhan pora morai dibole bisari thaka to etu manu nohoi?

english_text: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
nagamese_text: Kintu sabi, Tai to khula-khula kotha koi ase aru kunbi Taike eku nokoi, Tai he Khrista ase koi kene Yehudi cholawta khan bhi jani loise?

english_text: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
nagamese_text: Etu manu kot pora ase, amikhan etu jani ase. Kintu jitia Khrista ahibo, Tai kot pora ase etu kun bhi najanibo.”

english_text: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu mondoli bhitor te jor pora hikai se aru koise, “Tumikhan Moike jane, Moi kot pora ahise. Hoilebi Moi nijor khushi pora aha nohoi kintu Jun he Moike pathaise Tai hosa ase, Junke tumikhan najane.

english_text: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
nagamese_text: Moi Taike jane, kelemane Moi Tai pora ahise, aru Tai he Moike pathaise.”

english_text: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
nagamese_text: Karone, taikhan Taike dhori bole kosis korise, kintu kun bhi Tai uporte hath diya nai, kelemane Tai somoi napuncha karone.

english_text: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
nagamese_text: Aru bisi manu Taike biswas kori loise, aru taikhan koise, “Jitia Khrista ahibo, Tai etu manu pora kori diya pora bhi bisi asurit kaam nakoribo naki?”

english_text: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
nagamese_text: Manu khan Jisu laga kotha koi thaka etu Pharisee khan jani kene, mukhyo purohit khan aru Pharisee khan Taike dhori bole daruga khan ke pathai dise.

english_text: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi olop somoi karone tumikhan logote ase, pichete jun Moike pathaise Tai logote jai jabo.

english_text: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Moike bisaribo, aru napabo, aru kot te Moi jabo ta te tumikhan ahibo na paribo.”

english_text: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi cholawta khan kotha korise aru taikhan majote hudise, “Tai kot te jabole ase, aru ki karone amikhan Taike napabo? Tai Yunani khan ephale-uphale hoi thaka khan ke sikhabole jai jabole ase?

english_text: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”
nagamese_text: Tai kowa etu ki kotha ase, ‘Tumikhan Moike bisaribo, kintu Moike napabo, aru kot te Moi jabo ta te tumikhan ahibo na paribo’?”

english_text: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
nagamese_text: Aru purbb laga ses dinte, juntu dangor din ase, Jisu uthi kene jor pora koise, “Jodi kunba pyasa ase, tai Moi logote ahi kene khabi.

english_text: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
nagamese_text: Jun Moike biswas koribo, tinehoile Shastro te kowa nisena, nodi jinda laga pani tai laga pet pora bohi ahibo.”

english_text: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai Atma laga kotha koi thakise, juntu biswas kora khan pabole thakise, aru Tai nijor mohima te juwa nai kelemane Pobitro Atma etiya tak Taike diya nai.

english_text: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
nagamese_text: Titia bhir pora kunba etu huni kene, “Asol bhabobadi etu he ase” koise.

english_text: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
nagamese_text: Aru dusra koise, “Etu he Khrista ase.” Kintu kunba koise, “Khrista to Galilee pora ahibo naki?”

english_text: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
nagamese_text: Khrista to David laga khandan pora aru Bethlehem bosti kot te David thakisele, ta te pora ahibo eneka Shastro te kowa nohoi?”

english_text: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai karone manu khan dui bhag hoi jaise.

english_text: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
nagamese_text: Aru kunba Taike dhori bole hoise, kintu kunbi Tai uporte hath diya nai.

english_text: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
nagamese_text: Titia daruga khan wapas mukhyo purohit khan aru Pharisee khan logote ahise, aru taikhan pora koise, “Kile tumikhan Taike loi aha nai?”

english_text: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
nagamese_text: Daruga khan jowab dise, “Kunbi Tai nisena kotha nakoi.”

english_text: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
nagamese_text: Titia Pharisee khan taikhan ke jowab dise, “Kile, tumikhan bhi thogai te giri ase?

english_text: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?
nagamese_text: Kunba cholawta khan aru Pharisee khan Taike biswas kori luwa nohoi na?

english_text: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”
nagamese_text: Kintu niyom najana etu bhir manu khan to shrapit hoise.”

english_text: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
nagamese_text: Nicodemus jun he rati te Jisu logote ahise, tai pora taikhan ke koise,

english_text: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
nagamese_text: “Amikhan laga niyom hisab te manu laga kotha nahuna age te golti lagabo pare naki?”

english_text: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan taike jowab dise, “Tumi bhi Galilee manu ase? Sabi aru bisaribi, kelemane Galilee pora kun bhabobadi bhi naulabo lage.”

english_text: Everyone went to his own house,
nagamese_text: Aru sob manu nijor-nijor ghor te jai jaise.

english_text: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu Oliv pahar te jai jaise.

english_text: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
nagamese_text: Ekdom phojurte Tai aru mondoli te ahise, aru sob manu khan ahise; Tai bohi kene taikhan ke sikhai thakise.

english_text: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
nagamese_text: Titia niyom likha khan aru Pharisee khan pora ekjon mahila ke loi anise junke bebichari kaam te dhorise, aru taike taikhan majot te khara kori dise.

english_text: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Jisu ke hudise, “Shika manu, etu mahila ke bebichari kaam te dhorise.

english_text: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
nagamese_text: Aru niyom te pathor pora eneka khan ke mari dibi koi kene Moses he hukum di rakhise; kintu Apuni ki kobo?”

english_text: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Jisu ke porikha lobole he Taike eneka hudise, kintu eku bhi nahuna nisena Tai niche jhuki kene anguli pora matite kiba likhi thakise.

english_text: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan hudi thakise, titia Tai sidha khara hoi kene koise, “Tumi laga majote kun paap kora nai, tai he sob pora poila pathor taike maribi.”

english_text: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
nagamese_text: Tai arubi niche jhuki kene anguli pora matite likhi thakise.

english_text: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan majot sobse bura khan pora shuru kori kene ekjon pichete ekjon kori kene jai jaise. Aru ta te Jisu ekla thaki jaise, aru utu mahila jun majot te khara thakise.

english_text: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu sidha khara hoi kene taike koise, “Mahila, kot te ase tumike golti diya khan? Kunbi tumike golti diya nai?”

english_text: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Kunbi nai, Probhu.” Jisu koise, “Moi bhi tumike golti nadibo. Jabi aru paap na koribi.”

english_text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi he duniya laga puhor ase; jun Ami laga picha koribo, tai andhera te najabo, kintu jibon laga puhor pabo.”

english_text: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
nagamese_text: Pharisee khan Taike koise, “Apuni nijorke sakhi di ase; Apuni laga sakhi hosa nohoi.”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Jodi Moi nijor karone sakhi dile bhi, Moi laga sakhi hosa ase. Kelemane Moi kot pora ahise aru kot te jabole ase etu Moi jane, kintu tumikhan to Moi kot pora ahise aru kot te jabole ase najane.

english_text: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan to mangso hisab bisar kore; Moi kunke bhi bisar no kore.

english_text: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi bisar kore, Ami bisar kora hosa ase kelemane Moi ekla nohoi, kintu Moi Baba logote ase, jun Moike pathaise.

english_text: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan niyom te bhi likha ase duijon laga sakhi to hosa ase koi kene.

english_text: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
nagamese_text: Moi nijorke sakhi di ase, aru Baba jun Moike pathaise Tai bhi Amike sakhi di ase.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike koise, “Tumi laga Baba kot te ase?” Jisu koise, “Tumikhan Moike bhi aru Moi laga Baba ke bhi najane; jodi tumikhan Amike janile, Ami laga Baba ke bhi janibole asele.”

english_text: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
nagamese_text: Tai etu kotha mondoli ghor te bhandar jaga pora koi thakise, aru kun bhi Taike dhora nai kelemane Tai somoi puncha nai.

english_text: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai taikhan ke koise, “Moi to jai jabo, aru tumikhan Moike bisaribo aru tumikhan nijor paap pora mori jabo. Moi kote jabo, ta te tumikhan ahibo na paribo.”

english_text: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
nagamese_text: Karone Yehudi cholawta khan koise, “Tai nijorke namorabo na? Etu karone Tai koi ase, ‘Kot Moi jabo tumikhan ta te ahibo na paribo’?”

english_text: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
nagamese_text: Karone Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan to niche pora ase; Moi to upor pora ase. Tumikhan to etu prithibi laga ase; Moi etu prithibi laga nohoi.

english_text: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Moi koise tumikhan nijor paap pora mori jabo. Kelemane MOI ASE etu koi kene tumikhan biswas nokorile, tumikhan nijor paap pora mori jabo.”

english_text: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike koise, “Apuni kun ase?” Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Ki Moi tumikhan ke shuru pora koise etu ase.”

english_text: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
nagamese_text: Moi bisi kotha kobole aru bisar kori bole ase tumikhan karone. Kintu Moike pathai diya to hosa ase; aru Tai pora Ami ki hunise, etu he Moi prithibi ke koi thake.”

english_text: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
nagamese_text: Taikhan bujhi bo para nai Tai Baba laga kotha taikhan ke koise koi kene.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jitia tumikhan pora Manu laga Putro ke upor latkai dibo, titia tumikhan jani lobo MOI ASE, aru Moi nijor eku nakore, kintu jineka Baba he Moike sikhai, etu he Moi koi thake.

english_text: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
nagamese_text: Tai Moike pathaise aru Tai Moi logote thake, Tai Moike ekla nachare, kelemane Moi hodai Tai itcha he kori thake.”

english_text: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu kotha koi dise, bisi manu Taike biswas kori loise.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu pora Taike biswas kori luwa Yehudi khan ke koise, “Tumikhan Ami laga kotha mani thakile tumikhan Ami laga hosa chela hoise;

english_text: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
nagamese_text: aru tumikhan hosa ke jani lobo, aru hosa he tumikhan ke ajad kori dibo.”

english_text: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan Taike koise, “Amikhan Abraham laga khandan ase, kitia bhi kun laga nokor thaka nai; kineka Apuni koise, ‘Tumikhan ke ajad kori dibo’?”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, jun bhi paap te thakise tai paap laga noukar ase.

english_text: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
nagamese_text: Aru noukar to hodai ghor te nathake, kintu Putro to hodai thake.

english_text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
nagamese_text: Karone, jodi Putro pora tumikhan ke ajad kori dile, tumikhan hosa pora ajad hoise.

english_text: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Abraham laga khandan ase etu Moi jane, kintu tumikhan Moike morai dibole bisari ase, kelemane Ami laga kotha karone tumikhan monte jagah nai.

english_text: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
nagamese_text: Moi pora kowa kotha khan sob Moi laga Baba logote dikhise; karone tumikhan bhi tumikhan baba pora ki hunise, etu he koribi.”

english_text: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Taike jowab dise aru koise, “Amikhan laga baba to Abraham ase.” Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jodi tumikhan Abraham laga bacha khan hoile, tumikhan Abraham laga kaam khan koribi.

english_text: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
nagamese_text: Etiya tumikhan Moike morai dibole bisari ase, ekjon manu kun tumikhan ke hosa koi dise juntu kotha khan Moike Isor pora hunai se. Abraham tineka kora nai.

english_text: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan to tumikhan baba khan laga kaam kori thake.” Taikhan pora Taike koise, “Amikhan bebichar kaam pora jonom luwa nohoi; amikhan Baba ekjon he ase; Isor.”

english_text: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jodi Isor tumikhan laga Baba hoile, tumikhan Moike morom koribo, kelemane Moi Isor pora ahise, Moi nijor pora aha nohoi, kintu Tai Moike pathaise.

english_text: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
nagamese_text: Kile tumikhan Ami laga kotha bujhi bo napare? Tumikhan Ami laga kotha nahuna nimite ase.

english_text: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan to tumikhan baba, bhoot laga ase, aru tumikhan tai itcha he kori bole bhal pai. Tai shuru pora khun kora ase aru tai hosa te khara nathaka karone tai logote hosa nai. Kitia tai misa koi, tai nijor mon pora koi thake, kelemane tai misa ase aru misa khan laga baba ase.

english_text: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
nagamese_text: Kintu, Moi hosa koi, tumi Moike biswas nakore.

english_text: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
nagamese_text: Kun Moike paap laga galti dibo pare? Jodi Moi hosa koi, to tumikhan Moike kele biswas nakore?

english_text: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
nagamese_text: Jun Isor pora ahise tai Isor kotha khan huni; kintu etu nimite tumikhan to taikhan laga kotha nahune, kelemane tumikhan Isor laga nohoi.”

english_text: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan Taike jowab di koise, “Amikhan hosa kowa nohoi Apuni Samaria manu ase aru Apuni logote ekjon bhoot ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Moi logote bhoot nai, kintu Moi Ami laga Baba ke sonman kore, aru tumikhan Moike bodnam kori ase.

english_text: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi nijor mohima nabisare; etu bisari thaka aru bisar kori thaka ekjon ase.

english_text: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, jodi kunba Ami laga kotha hune, tai kitia bhi mrityu nadikhibo.”

english_text: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan Taike koise, “Etiya amikhan jani loise, Tumi logote bhoot ase. Abraham aru bhabobadi khan bhi mori jaise; aru Apuni koise, ‘Jodi jun Ami laga kotha ke rakhi lobo, tai mrityu nadikhibo.’

english_text: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
nagamese_text: Apuni amikhan laga Baba Abraham kun mori jaise, tai pora dangor ase naki? Bhabobadi khan bhi mori jaise. Apuni nijorke kun koi kene bhabi ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Jodi Moi nijorke mohima korile, Ami laga mohima eku nai; kintu Moike mohima kora Ami laga Baba he ase- junke tumikhan Isor koi kene mate.

english_text: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Taike najane, kintu Moi Taike jane. Aru jodi Moi koi, ‘Moi Taike najane’, tumi nisena Moi bhi misa hoise, kintu Moi Taike jane aru Tai laga kotha mane.

english_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan laga baba Abraham to Moi laga din dikhi bole asha te anondo kori ase, aru Tai dikhi paise aru khushi korise.”

english_text: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan Taike koise, “Apuni pachas saal bhi huwa nai, aru Apuni Abraham ke dikhise?”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, Abraham age pora, MOI ASE.”

english_text: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Taike mari dibole pathor uthaise; kintu Jisu Tai nijor lukai kene mondoli pora bahar ulai jaise.

english_text: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu jai thaka homoi te, jonom pora andha thaka ekjon ke Tai lok paise.

english_text: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai chela khan Taike hudise, “Rabbi, kun paap korise, etu manu na tai baba ama khan karone jonom pora tai andha hoise?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Etu manu laga paap bhi nohoi, Tai baba-ama khan laga bhi nohoi, kintu tai karone Isor laga kaam dikhai dibole nimite.

english_text: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
nagamese_text: Din thaka homoi te he kun Moike pathaise Tai laga kaam kori thakibo lage. Kelemane rati ahi ase.

english_text: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Moi prithibi te ase, Moi he prithibi laga puhor ase.”

english_text: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai etu sob koi diya hoise, Tai matite thuki kene buka bonai loise, aru etu buka pora andha manu laga suku te lagai dise.

english_text: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taike koise, “Jabi, aru Siloam pukhuri te dhui lobi,” -juntu laga motlob ase “pathai diya.” Karone tai jaise, aru dhui dise, aru dikhibo parikena wapas ghurai ahise.

english_text: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
nagamese_text: Karone tai laga ghor usor manu khan kunkhan pora taike age te bhikh mangi thaka dikhi thakise, etiya taike dikhi kene koise, “Etu manu to rasta te bohi bhikh mangi thaka to nohoi?”

english_text: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
nagamese_text: Kunba koise, “Etu tai ase.” Dusra koise, “Nohoi, kintu tai nisena ase.” Kintu tai koise, “Etu moi ase.”

english_text: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan taike hudise, “Kineka tumi laga suku khuli jaise?”

english_text: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
nagamese_text: Tai jowab dise, “Jun laga naam Jisu ase Tai mati buka bonai kene moi laga suku te lagai dise, aru moike koise, ‘Siloam te jabi aru dhui dibi.’ Aru moi jai kene dhui dise, aru moi dikhibo paise.”

english_text: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan taike koise, “Tai kot te ase?” Tai jowab dise, “Moi najane.”

english_text: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
nagamese_text: Taikhan jun andha asele etu ke Pharisee khan logote loi anise.

english_text: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
nagamese_text: Etu Bisram din asele jitia Jisu mati pora buka bonai kene tai laga suku bhal kori disele.

english_text: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
nagamese_text: Titia Pharisee khan bhi taike aru hudise. Tai taikhan ke koise, “Tai ami laga suku te mati lagai dise aru etiya moi dikhise.”

english_text: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.
nagamese_text: Karone kunba Pharisee khan koise, “Etu manu to Isor pora nohoi kelemane Tai Bisram din ke namane.” Kintu kunba koise, “Kineka paapi manu eneka asurit kaam kori dikha bo paribo?” Aru taikhan bhag hoise.

english_text: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan aru andha manu ke hudise, “Tumi Tai karone ki kobo, kun tumi laga suku khuli dise?” Andha manu koise, “Tai to bhabobadi ase.”

english_text: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
nagamese_text: Kintu Yehudi cholawta khan etu manu age te andha thakise aru etiya dikhibo pari ase koi kene biswas kora nai, jitia tak tai baba ama ke mati ani kene huda-hudi kora nai.

english_text: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan tai ama baba ke hudise, koise, “Etu tumikhan laga chokra jonom pora andha asele? Aru kineka kori etiya dikhi ase?”

english_text: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
nagamese_text: Tai ama baba taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Amikhan jane etu amikhan laga chokra ase aru jonom pora andha thakise.

english_text: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan etu najane tai kineka kori etiya dikhibo pari ase, aru kun tai laga suku khuli dise. Tai jawan hoise, taike hudi bhi. Tai nijor koi dibo.”

english_text: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
nagamese_text: Tai ama baba khan Yehudi khan ke bhoi pora tineka koise, kelemane Yehudi khan age pora eneka koi kene ase jodi kunba Khrista naam kobo, etu manu laga naam mondoli pora ulai dibo.

english_text: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone, tai baba ama koise, “Tai jawan hoise, taike hudi bhi.”

english_text: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan dusra bar etu andha thaka manu ke mati ani kene taike koise, “Isor ke mohima koribi. Amikhan jane etu to paapi manu ase.”

english_text: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
nagamese_text: Tai jowab di koise, “Moi najane jodi Tai paapi manu ase. Ekta kotha moi jani ase; moi andha asele, aru etiya dikhi ase.”

english_text: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan taike koise, “Tai tumike ki korise? Kineka kori tai tumi laga suku khuli dise?”

english_text: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
nagamese_text: Tai taikhan ke koise, “Moi poila pora apuni khan ke koi dise, aru apuni khan huna nai! Kile apuni khan aru hunibo mon kori ase? Apnikhan bhi Tai chela hobole mon ase naki?”

english_text: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan taike gali dikene koise, “Tumi to Tai laga chela ase, kintu amikhan to Moses laga chela ase.

english_text: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
nagamese_text: Amikhan jane Isor pora Moses logote prothom te kotha korise kintu etu manu to amikhan najane Tai kot pora ahise.”

english_text: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
nagamese_text: Tai taikhan ke jowab di koise, “Etiya to asurit hoi ase, Tai kot pora ahise moi najane, hoilebi tai pora he ami laga suku bhal kori dise.

english_text: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
nagamese_text: Amikhan jane Isor paapi manu ke nahune, kintu kun Isor ke thik mane aru Tai itcha kore, eitu khan ke Tai hune.

english_text: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
nagamese_text: Prithibi shuru pora etiya tak kun bhi jonom pora andha manu suku bhal kori diya huna nai.

english_text: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
nagamese_text: Jodi etu manu Isor pora aha nohoile, Tai eku bhi koribo na paribo.”

english_text: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
nagamese_text: Taikhan taike jowab di koise, “Tumi to hosa ke paap pora jonom hoise, aru tumi amikhan ke sikhabole ase?” Titia aru taikhan taike khedai dise.

english_text: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
nagamese_text: Aru etu manu ke taikhan mondoli pora ulai dise koi kene Jisu hunise. Jitia Jisu taike lok paise, Tai hudise, “Tumi Manu laga Putro ke biswas kore?”

english_text: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
nagamese_text: Tai jowab dikene koise, “Aru Tai kun ase, Probhu, moi Taike biswas koribo karone?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu taike koise, “Tumi Taike dikhi loise, aru tumi logote kotha kori thaka etu he Tai ase.”

english_text: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Probhu, moi biswas korise” aru Taike aradhana korise.

english_text: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Moi etu prithibi ke bisar kori bole ahise, jun manu nadikhe taikhan dikhi pabole, aru jun manu dikhe taikhan ke andha kori dibole.”

english_text: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
nagamese_text: Kunba Pharisee jun khan Tai logote asele taikhan etu kotha huni kene taike koise, “Amikhan bhi andha ase naki?”

english_text: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jodi tumikhan andha thakise koile, tumi laga paap nathakibole asele, kintu etiya tumikhan koi ase, ‘Amikhan dikhi ase,’ karone tumikhan laga paap thaki jabo.”

english_text: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
nagamese_text: “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, kun mer rakha dorja pora na ghusikena dusra rasta pora ghusi bo etu to chor aru dokait ase.

english_text: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun dorja pora ghusi bo tai he mer laga roikhya ase.

english_text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
nagamese_text: Tai karone dorjate rukhi thaka manu pora dorja khuli dibo. Aru mer khan tai laga awaj hunibo, aru tai nijor mer khan laga naam mati kene bahar te loijai thake.

english_text: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia tai mer khan ke bahar kori loise, tai eitu khan laga age jai thake, aru mer khan piche ahi thake, kelemane eitu khan tai laga awaj jane.

english_text: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan najana manu laga piche najabo, kintu polai jabo, kelemane taikhan eitu khan laga awaj nachine.”

english_text: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora etu dristanto taikhan ke koise, kintu taikhan Tai ki koise etu laga motlob bujhi bo para nai.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke aru koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, Moi he mer khan laga dorja ase.

english_text: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
nagamese_text: Moi pora age te jiman ahise, sob chor aru dokait ase, kintu mer khan pora taikhan ke huna nai.

english_text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
nagamese_text: Moi he dorja ase, jodi kunba Moi dwara ghusi bo, tai poritran pabo, aru bhitor bahar aha juwa koribo, aru dana pabo.

english_text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
nagamese_text: Chor khali chor kori bole nohoi kintu morai dibole aru biya kori bole ahe. Moi aha to taikhan jibon pabole aru etu ke bhi bisi bhorta thaka jibon dibo karone ahise.

english_text: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
nagamese_text: Moi bhal mer roikhya ase. Bhal mer roikhya to mer khan karone nijor jibon di diye.

english_text: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi ekjon hajira kora manu to roikhya nohoi, aru mer khan laga malik bhi nohoi. Tai kitia rong kutta aha dikhe, mer khan ke chari kene polai jai, aru rang-kutta he mer khan ke dhori loijai, aru mer khan ke ephale-uphale polabo diye.

english_text: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai hajira kora manu ase etu karone polai jai, tai mer khan karone chinta nathaki.

english_text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
nagamese_text: Moi bhal mer roikhya ase, aru Moi nijor mer khan ke jane, aru Moi laga mer khan bhi Moike jane.

english_text: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
nagamese_text: Jineka Baba Moike jane, Moi bhi Baba ke jane, aru Moi mer khan karone Moi laga nijor jibon di ase.

english_text: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
nagamese_text: Aru Ami laga dusra mer khan bhi ase jun khan etu mer ghor te nathake. Taikhan ke bhi Moi anibo lage, aru taikhan Moi laga awaj hunibo, aru titia sob mer khan ekta hoi jabo aru mer roikhya bhi ekjon he thakibo.

english_text: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
nagamese_text: Moi laga Baba Moike etu nimite morom kore: kelemane Moi nijor laga jibon dise aru bhi wapas loi lobo karone.

english_text: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
nagamese_text: Kun bhi etu Moi pora chingibo napare, kintu Moi he nijorke di ase. Ami laga jibon dibole aru loi lobole bhi Moi adhikar ase, etu hukum Moi laga Baba pora paise.”

english_text: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha karone Yehudi khan laga majote aru kotha namila hoise, aru apaste bhag hoise.

english_text: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
nagamese_text: Aru bisi manu koi, “Tai logote bhoot ase, aru tai pagala ase. Kile apuni khan tai laga kotha huni ase?”

english_text: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
nagamese_text: Aru dusra koise, “Etu kotha eneka manu laga nohoi jun logote bhoot thakise. Bhoot pora andha laga suku khuli dibo pare naki?”

english_text: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Aru etu somoite Jerusalem sheher te Samarpan laga Purbb asele. Aru etu thanda din thakise,

english_text: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
nagamese_text: aru Jisu to Solomon laga veranda kowa jagate aha juwa kori thakise.

english_text: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
nagamese_text: Titia kunba Yehudi khan Taike gheri loise, aru koise, “Apuni kiman deri amikhan ke chinta te rakhibole ase? Jodi Apuni Khrista ase koile amikhan ke koi dibi.”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Moi tumikhan ke koi dise, aru tumikhan biswas kora nai. Ki kaam Moi laga Baba naam te kori ase, etu he Moi laga sakhi di ase.

english_text: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan biswas nakore kelemane tumikhan Ami laga mer nohoi.

english_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
nagamese_text: Ami laga mer khan Ami laga awaj hune; Moi taikhan ke jane, aru taikhan Ami laga piche ahe.

english_text: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
nagamese_text: Aru Moi taikhan ke anondo jibon diye, aru taikhan kitia bhi namoribo, aru kun bhi taikhan ke Ami laga hath pora chingi loijabo na paribo.

english_text: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
nagamese_text: Ami laga Baba, Jun he etu sob Moike dise, Tai sob pora dangor ase, aru kun bhi Baba laga hath pora taikhan ke chingibo na paribo.

english_text: I and the Father are one.”
nagamese_text: Moi aru Moi laga Baba ekjon ase,

english_text: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan Taike mari bole pathor uthaise.

english_text: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Moi pora tumikhan ke Moi laga Baba laga bhal kaam bisi dikhai dise. Kuntu kaam karone tumikhan Moike pathor mari bole hoise?”

english_text: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
nagamese_text: Yehudi khan Taike jowab dise, “Bhal kaam karone amikhan Apuni ke pathor mari bole nohoi, kintu Isor ke ninda kora, aru tumi manu hoi kene, nije ke Isor bonai thaka karone.”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise, “Etu tumikhan niyom te likha nai, ‘Moi koise, “Tumikhan bhi Isor ase’”?

english_text: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
nagamese_text: Jodi Tai tumikhan ke Isor koile, jun khan logote Isor laga kotha ponchise, - aru Shastro laga kotha khan to bhangi jabole nohoi,-

english_text: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
nagamese_text: tumikhan Taike koi ase jun Baba he alag bonai kene duniya te pathai dise, ‘Tumi ninda kori ase,’ kelemane Moi koise, ‘Moi Isor laga Putro ase’?

english_text: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi Ami Baba laga kaam nakore, to Moike biswas na koribi.

english_text: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi Moi kaam kori thakile bhi, tumikhan Moike biswas nokorile, kaam to saikene biswas kori lobi, titia tumikhan jani lobo aru biswas kori lobo Baba pora Moi bhitor te ase aru Moi Tai bhitor te ase.”

english_text: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan aru bhi Taike dhori bole korise, kintu Tai taikhan hath pora ulai jaise.

english_text: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai Jordan nodi paar jaga, kot te John prothom baptizma di thakisele, ta te jai kene thaki jaise.

english_text: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
nagamese_text: Titia bisi manu Jisu logote ahi koise, “John to eku chihna dikha diya nai, kintu John pora etu manu laga ki kotha koise, etu sob hosa ase.”

english_text: Many believed in him there.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te bisi manu Taike biswas kori loise.

english_text: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
nagamese_text: Ekjon bemar thaka manu Lazarus koi kene thakise. Tai, aru bhoini Mary aru Martha khan laga bosti naam to Bethany thakise.

english_text: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.
nagamese_text: Aru etu Mary he asele jun pora age te itra tel loi kene Probhu ke abhishek kori kene tai laga chuli pora Jisu laga theng mussi dise, aru bemar Lazarus to tai laga bhai asele.

english_text: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
nagamese_text: Karone tai bhoini khan pora manu pathai kene koise, “Probhu, kunke Apuni morom kore, tai bemar ase.”

english_text: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu kotha hunise, Tai koise, “Etu bemar to mori jabole laga bemar nohoi, kintu Isor ke mohima aru Manu laga Putro ke mohima hobo karone ase.”

english_text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
nagamese_text: Jisu to Martha aru tai bhoini aru Lazarus ke bhi morom kori thakisele.

english_text: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Tai hunise Lazarus bemar ase koi kene, Jisu kot te thakise ta te dui din aru rukhi jaise.

english_text: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
nagamese_text: Titia etu pichete, Tai laga chela khan ke koise, “Ahibi, amikhan Judea te aru jabo.”

english_text: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
nagamese_text: Tai chela khan Taike koise, “Rabbi, aji kali Yehudi khan Apuni ke pathor mari bole bisari ase, aru Apuni ta te jabole ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Kile dinte baroh ghanta nathake naki? Jodi kunba dinte beraile tai thogar nakhai, kelemane tai duniya laga ujala ke pai thaka karone.

english_text: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi kunba rati te beraile, puhor tai logote nathaka karone thogar khai.”

english_text: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
nagamese_text: Tai eitu khan kotha koi diya pichete, eneka koise, “Amikhan laga sathi Lazarus ghumai ase, kintu Moi taike uthai dibole jabo.”

english_text: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai chela khan koise, “Probhu, jodi tai ghumi ase koile, tai basi jabo.”

english_text: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
nagamese_text: Jisu tai mori bole laga kotha he koise, kintu taikhan to aram pora ghumai thaka kotha he bhabise.

english_text: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu taikhan ke sidha koi dise, “Lazarus mori jaise.

english_text: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
nagamese_text: Moi khushi ase, tumikhan karone, Moi ta te thaka nai, etu karone tumikhan biswas kori lobo. Kintu amikhan tai logote jabo.”

english_text: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
nagamese_text: Titia Thomas, junke Didymus bhi koi, tai sathi chela khan ke koise, “Ahibi amikhan bhi jabo Jisu logote moribo karone.”

english_text: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
nagamese_text: Karone jitia Jisu ahise, Tai janise Lazarus ke kobor te rakhi diya char din hoise.

english_text: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
nagamese_text: Aru Bethany to Jerusalem usor ase, dui kos he dur nisena te ase.

english_text: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
nagamese_text: Aru Yehudi khan bisi Martha aru Mary logote ahise, tai bhai karone mon aram kori dibole.

english_text: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
nagamese_text: Jitia Martha hunise Jisu ahi ase, tai lok pabole jaise, kintu Mary to ghor te bohi thakise.

english_text: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
nagamese_text: Martha pora Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, jodi Apuni yate thakile, moi laga bhai namoribole asele.

english_text: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya bhi, moi jane Apuni Isor ke ki mangile Isor pora etu Apuni ke dibo.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Tumi laga bhai aru jinda hoi jabo.”

english_text: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
nagamese_text: Martha Taike koise, “Moi jane tai aru jee uthibo hekh dinte.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi, he punoruthan aru jibon ase; jun Moike biswas koribo, jodi tai morile bhi, jinda hobo;

english_text: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
nagamese_text: Aru jun bhi jinda thake aru Moike biswas kore tai kitia bhi namoribo. Tumi etu kotha biswas kore?”

english_text: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
nagamese_text: Tai Jisu ke koise, “Hoi, Probhu, Moi biswas ase Apuni Khrista ase, Isor laga Putro, jun duniya te ahibole thaka jon ase.”

english_text: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai etu koi diya pichete, tai jai jaise aru lukai kene tai bhoini ke koise, “Shika manu yate ahi ase, aru apuni ke mati ase.”

english_text: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.
nagamese_text: Tai etu huna logote uthi kene Tai logote jaise.

english_text: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
nagamese_text: Titia tak Jisu to bosti te puncha nai, kintu kot te Martha Taike lok korise ta te he thakise.

english_text: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
nagamese_text: Titia jun Yehudi khan tai laga ghor te thakise aru tai laga mon aram koridi thakisele, taikhan Mary to joldi uthi kene juwa dikhise, aru tai kobor te jai kene kandibole jai ase bhabise aru tai laga piche korise.

english_text: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Mary to Jisu thaka jagate ponchise, tai Jisu ke dikhi kene Tai theng te giri kene koise, “Probhu, jodi Apuni yate thakile, ami laga bhai namoribole asele.”

english_text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
nagamese_text: Kitia Jisu tai kanda dikhise, aru Yehudi khan tai logote aha khan kanda dikhise, Tai Atma te bisi bhabise aru mon chinta hoise;

english_text: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
nagamese_text: aru Tai koise, “Tumikhan taike kot te rakhise?” Taikhan Taike koise, “Probhu, ahi kene sabi.”

english_text: Jesus wept.
nagamese_text: Jisu kandise.

english_text: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan koise, “Sabi kiman morom kore ase Lazarus ke!”

english_text: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan kunba koise, “Tai age te andha manu laga suku bhal kori diya Tai etu manu na hoi, etu manu ke namoribo dibo para nai?”

english_text: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu bisi mon dukh hoi kobor te ahise, etu ekta gufa asele, aru ekta pathor pora dhaki rakhi thakise.

english_text: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Pathor ke hatai dibi. Martha, mori juwa laga bhoini, Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, etiya to pucha gundai thakibo, char din hoise.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Kile, Moi tumike kowa nohoi, jodi tumi biswas korile, tumi Isor laga mohima dikhibo?”

english_text: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan pathor ke hatai dise, Jisu Tai suku upor uthai koise, “Baba, Moi Apuni ke dhanyavad di ase, Apuni Ami laga prathana huni luwa karone.

english_text: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
nagamese_text: Moi jane, Apuni Moike hodai hune kintu Ami usorte thaka khan karone Apuni he Moike pathaise, etu jani kene biswas koribo karone Moi etu koi dise.”

english_text: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai etu koi diya pichete, Tai jor pora hala kori koise, “Lazarus, ulai ahibi!”

english_text: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
nagamese_text: Titia mora manu ulai ahise; aru bhori aru hath kapra pora bandi kene aru Tai mukh ekta gamcha pora dhaki asele, Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Khuli dibi aru taike jabo dibi.”

english_text: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
nagamese_text: Titia bisi Yehudi khan jun Mary logote ahise aru Jisu kaam kori diya dikhi kene biswas kori loise.
