english_text: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan kunba Pharisee khan logote jai kene Jisu kaam kori diya sob koi dise.

english_text: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
nagamese_text: Karone mukhyo purohit khan aru Pharisee khan sabha te joma hoi kotha korise, “Amikhan ki korile bhal hobo? Etu manu bisi asurit kori ase.

english_text: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan Taike eneka kori thakibo dile, sob manu Taike biswas kori jabo, aru Rome laga cholawta khan ahikena amikhan laga jagah aru jati duita ke bhi amikhan laga hath pora loi lobo.”

english_text: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan majote sabha laga ekjon manu Caiaphas asele, jun etu saal pora moha purohit laga kaam shuru korisele, tai pora taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan eku najane.

english_text: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
nagamese_text: Sob desh nost huwa pora to ekjon mori juwa he bhal hobo, etu bhi tumikhan na bhabe.”

english_text: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
nagamese_text: Etu tai nijor pora kowa nohoi. Kintu etu saal pora tai moha purohit kaam korise, etu karone tai bhabobani korise Jisu he etu jati manu karone moribo;

english_text: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
nagamese_text: Aru khali etu jati karone he nohoi, kintu Isor laga khandan khan, ephale-uphale hoi thaka khan sobke bisari ekta kori bole ase.

english_text: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan etu din pora Taike morai dibole bisari thakise.

english_text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
nagamese_text: Karone, Jisu to aru Yehudi khan majote khula nabera hoise, kintu ta te pora jongol usorte Ephraim koi kene thaka ekta town te Tai chela ke loi ta te thaki jaise.

english_text: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
nagamese_text: Aru Yehudi laga Nistar usor asele, titia bosti pora bisi manu nijorke pobitro kori bole Nistar age te Jerusalem jaise.

english_text: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ta te Jisu ke bisarise, aru mondoli te joma hoi kene koise, “Apnikhan ki bhabi ase? Tai etu purbb te nahibo?”

english_text: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
nagamese_text: Aru mukhyo purohit khan aru Pharisee khan pora hukum di rakhise, Tai kot te ase etu janile khobor dibole, Taike dhori bole karone.

english_text: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
nagamese_text: Titia, Nistar laga choi din age te Jisu Bethany te ahise, utu jaga juntu te Lazarus thake, kunke Tai mora pora jinda korise.

english_text: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Tai karone rati laga kha luwa bonai dise, aru Martha sewa korise, kintu Lazarus bhi ta te ekjon mez te Jisu logote bohi asele.

english_text: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
nagamese_text: Titia Mary pora adha liter jiman bisi daam laga tel ani kene Jisu laga theng te lagai dise, aru tai nijor chuli pora Tai theng ke mussi dise, aru litra tel laga sugandh pora pura ghor bhorta hoise.

english_text: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai laga chela ekjon, Judas Iscariot, jun Taike thogabole ase, koise,

english_text: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
nagamese_text: “Kile etu tel tin sou dinari pora bikiri kori kene dukhiya khan ke diya nai?”

english_text: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
nagamese_text: Tai etu kowa to dukhiya khan nimite chinta karone kowa nohoi, kintu tai chor asele. Taikhan laga poisa jola bhi tai logote ase, aru ta te ki halibo tai etu pora chor kori kene loi thakise.

english_text: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
nagamese_text: Karone Jisu koise, “Tai ekla ke chari dibi. Ami laga moidam diya din karone rakhibo dibi.

english_text: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane dukhiya khan tumikhan laga logote hodai thakibo, kintu Moi tumikhan logote hodai nathakibo.”

english_text: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
nagamese_text: Titia bisi Yehudi manu khan janise Jisu ta te ase, aru taikhan ahise, Jisu ekla karone aha nohoi, kintu junke Tai mora pora jinda korise, Lazarus, ke bhi sabole ahise.

english_text: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
nagamese_text: Kintu prodhan purohit khan Lazarus ke bhi morai dibole bhabisele;

english_text: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
nagamese_text: kelemane Yehudi khan bisi manu tai karone jai jaise, aru Jisu ke biswas kori loise.

english_text: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
nagamese_text: Dusra din dangor bhir purbb te ahise. Jitia taikhan hunise Jisu Jerusalem te ahi ase,

english_text: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
nagamese_text: Taikhan palm ghas laga daal ulai ani kene Taike lok kori bole ahise aru jor pora koise, “Hosanna! Probhu laga naam loi kene aha Israel laga Raja, dhoinyo ase.”

english_text: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu ekta gadha puwali paikene etu uporte bohi jaise; jineka likha ase,

english_text: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
nagamese_text: “Bhoi nokoribi, Zion laga swali, sabi, tumi laga Raja ahi ase, gadha bacha uporte bohi kene.”

english_text: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
nagamese_text: Tai chela khan bujibo para nai shuru te; kintu jitia Jisu mohima hoise, taikhan bhabona ahise, etu Tai nimite likha asele, aru manu khan Tai uporte eneka kori diya bhabona ahise.

english_text: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
nagamese_text: Titia bhir khan gawahi dise taikhan bhi Tai logote he thakise jitia Tai Lazarus ke kobor pora ulabi koi kene matise aru mora pora jinda kori dise.

english_text: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
nagamese_text: Karone dangor bhir Taike lok kori bole ahise, kelemane taikhan hunise Tai etu chihna dikhaise.

english_text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
nagamese_text: Titia Pharisee khan apaste kotha korise, “Sabi, tumikhan eku bhi koribo na paribo; sabi, duniya Tai piche jai ase.”

english_text: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
nagamese_text: Titia aradhana kori bole purbb te aha khan majote kunba Yunani khan bhi asele.

english_text: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan Philip logote ahise, jun Galilee jagate Bethsaida town laga manu ase, aru taike hudise, “Sahab, amikhan Jisu ke sabole mon korise.”

english_text: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
nagamese_text: Philip ahikena Andrew ke koise; Andrew Philip logote jaise, aru taikhan Jisu ke koi dise.

english_text: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu taikhan ke jowab dise aru koise, “Etu somoi Manu laga Putro ke mohima hobole ahise.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
nagamese_text: Hosa Moi tumikhan ke kobo, jitia tak ekta gehu dana matite giri kene namore, etu eneka he thake; kintu jodi etu mori jai, titia bisi dana ulai thake.

english_text: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
nagamese_text: Jun nijor jibon morom kore tai harai dibo; kintu jun etu duniya te nijor jibon morom nokorile, tai anondo jibon karone bachibo.

english_text: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
nagamese_text: Jodi kun Moike sewa kore, taike Ami laga piche ahibole dibi; aru Moi kun jagate thakibo ta te Ami laga noukar bhi thakibo. Jodi kun Moike sewa koribo, Baba bhi taike sonman koribo.

english_text: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.
nagamese_text: Etiya Ami laga Atma bisi chinta ase aru Moi ki kobo? Baba, Moike etu somoi pora bachabi’? Kintu etu somoi karone he Moi ahi ponchise.

english_text: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”
nagamese_text: Baba, mohima hobi Apuni laga naam.” Titia sorgote ekta awaj ahi koise, “Moi etu age te mohima korise, aru bhi mohima kori dibo.”

english_text: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
nagamese_text: Titia ta te khara thaka khan huni koise bhijili marise. Dusra pora koise, “Sorgodoth Tai logote kotha kori ase.”

english_text: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Etu awaj Moi karone nohoi, kintu tumikhan nimite ase.

english_text: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
nagamese_text: Etiya etu prithibi ke bisar kori ase; Etiya etu prithibi laga raja ke hatai dibo.

english_text: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Moike etu prithibi pora uthai loijabo, Moi logote sob manu ke tani loijabo.

english_text: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai koise etu dikha bole kineka pora tai moribo.

english_text: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”
nagamese_text: Titia bhir khan Taike koise, “Amikhan niyom te likha janise, Khrista hodai thakibo. Kineka Apuni koi ase, ‘Manu laga Putro ke upor loijabo? Kun etu Manu laga Putro ase?’”

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu Taikhan ke koise, “Olop somoi karone puhor tumikhan logote ase. Jitia tak tumikhan logote puhor ase titia tak berai thakibi, andhera tumikhan logote napuncha age te, aru jun andhera te berai thake, tai kot te jai najane.

english_text: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
nagamese_text: Jitia tak tumikhan logote puhor ase, puhor ke biswas koribi titia tumikhan puhor laga bacha khan hobo.” Jisu eitu khan koise aru taikhan pora luki jaise.

english_text: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
nagamese_text: Aru Tai Taikhan ke bisi asurit chihna dikhaise, hoilebi taikhan Taike biswas kora nai.

english_text: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
nagamese_text: Etu sob hoise Isaiah bhabobadi pora kowa pura hobole karone eitu khan sob hoise: “Probhu, kun amikhan koi diya kotha biswas korise, Aru Probhu laga hath kunke dikhai dise?”

english_text: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:
nagamese_text: Karone Taikhan biswas koribo para nai, Isaiah bhi koise,

english_text: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
nagamese_text: “Tai he taikhan laga suku andha kori dise, aru Tai he taikhan laga mon tan kori dise; Nohoile taikhan suku pora sabo pare aru mon pora bujhi bo pare, Aru taikhan ghuri bo, Aru Moi taikhan ke bhal kori dibo.”

english_text: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
nagamese_text: Isaiah etu kotha koise kelemane tai Jisu laga mohima dikhise aru Tai nimite koise.

english_text: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
nagamese_text: Kintu eneka hoilebi, bisi Yehudi cholawta khan Jisu ke biswas kori loise; kintu Pharisee khan karone, taikhan grohon kora nai, taikhan mondoli pora ulai dibo bhoi pora khuli dikhai diya nai.

english_text: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan Isor prosansa pora to manu laga prosansa he bhal pai thakise.

english_text: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu jor pora koise, “Kun Moike biswas kore, Moike he biswas kora nohoi kintu Moike pathai diya ke biswas kore,

english_text: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
nagamese_text: aru jun Moike dikhise Moike pathai diya ke bhi dikhise.

english_text: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
nagamese_text: Moi prithibi te puhor hoi ahise, jun Moike biswas kore tai andhera te nathakibo.

english_text: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba Moi laga kotha huni kene namane, Moi taike bisar nakore; kelemane Moi prithibi ke bisar kori bole aha nohoi, kintu prithibi ke bacha bole he ahise.

english_text: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.
nagamese_text: Jun Moike grohon nakore, aru Moi laga kotha ke grohon nakore, taike bisar kori bole ekjon ase, motlob ji kotha Moi koi dise etu he hekh dinte taike bisar koribo.

english_text: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Moi nijor pora kotha kowa nohoi, kintu Baba jun he Moike pathaise, Tai he Moike hukum dise ki jonai dibo lage aru ki kobo lage.

english_text: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
nagamese_text: Moi jane Tai laga hukum anonto jibon ase, etu Moi thik pora jani ase- etu karone jineka Baba pora Moike kotha koi, eneka he Moike koidi thake.”

english_text: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
nagamese_text: Etiya Nistar purbb din age te, Jisu jani jaise Tai etu duniya chari kene Baba logote jabole somoi ahise. Kunkhan Tai logote duniya te thakise, eitu khan ke Tai morom kori ahise, aru tineka hekh tak morom korise.

english_text: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan eke logot te rati laga kha-luwa kori thakise, titia Simon laga chokra Iscariot Judas laga monte bhoot ghusi se, Jisu ke thogai bole nimite.

english_text: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
nagamese_text: Jisu jani thakise Baba he sob jinis khan Taike dise, aru Tai Isor pora ahise aru Isor logote wapas jabole ase.

english_text: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
nagamese_text: Tai kha luwa somoite uthi kene Tai nijor kapra ulai rakhi kene ekta gamcha loise aru Tai laga nijor komor bandi loise.

english_text: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai borton te pani hali kene chela khan laga theng dhui dise aru gamcha Tai komor te bandi thaka ke loise aru taikhan laga theng mussi dise.

english_text: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai Simon Peter logote ponchise, Peter Taike koise, “Probhu, Apuni ami laga theng dhubo?”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab di koise, “Moi ki kori ase etu etiya tumi najane, kintu etu pichete tumi jani jabo.”

english_text: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
nagamese_text: Peter Taike koise, “Apuni ke ami laga theng dhubo nadibo,” Jisu taike koise, “Jodi Moi tumike nadholaile, tumi Moi phale eku bhi hisa nai.”

english_text: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
nagamese_text: Simon Peter Taike koise, “Probhu, khali ami laga theng he nohoi, kintu hath aru matha bhi dhui dibi.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Jun gaw dhui loise tai to khali theng he dhuile hoise, dusra sob sapha ase, aru tumikhan sapha ase; kintu tumikhan sob nohoi.”

english_text: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
nagamese_text: - Kelemane Jisu jani thakise kun Taike dhori bole ase; etu karone Tai koise,“Tumikhan sob sapha nohoi.”-

english_text: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai taikhan laga theng dhuwa hoise, Tai nijor kapra lagai loise aru bohi jaise, aru taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan bujhi se Moi tumikhan karone ki korise?

english_text: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Moike ‘Shika manu,’ ‘Probhu,’ eneka koi aru tumikhan thik koi ase, kelemane Moi etu he ase.

english_text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi Shika manu aru Probhu hoi kene tumikhan laga theng dhuile, tumikhan bhi ekjon-ekjon laga theng dhubo lage.

english_text: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Moi tumikhan ke motlob dikhai dise, tumikhan bhi tineka kori thakibi.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, ekjon nokor to tai malik pora dangor nohoi; aru khobor diya manu ekjon khobor pathai diya manu pora dangor nohoi.

english_text: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan eitu khan jane, aru mani thakile tumikhan asishit hobo.

english_text: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan sob laga kotha kowa nohoi; Moi junke basi loise taikhan he jane- kintu Shastro he pura hobo karone eneka hoise: ‘Kun Ami logote bhaat khai ase, etu he Moike laat marise.’

english_text: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke etiya etu nohua age te koi diya to, etu kitia hobo, tumikhan biswas koribo MOI ASE.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
nagamese_text: “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, kun Moi patha diya ke grohon kore, tai Moike grohon kori ase, aru jun Moike grohon korise, tai Moike patha Jonke grohon kori loise.”

english_text: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu sob kowa hoise, Tai Atma te bisi dukh hoise. Tai gawahi dikene koise, “Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo tumikhan majote ekjon Moike thogai dibole ase.”

english_text: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
nagamese_text: Chela khan ekjon-ekjon ke saise, asurit hoi kene etu kun hobo hudise.

english_text: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
nagamese_text: Kintu ekjon chela junke Jisu morom kore, tai Jisu laga usorte mez te matha niche kori bohi thakise.

english_text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
nagamese_text: Karone Simon Peter taike ishara kori kene koise, “Tai kun laga kotha koi ase amikhan ke koi dibi.”

english_text: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
nagamese_text: Titia tai Jisu laga chati usorte niche kori kene Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, etu kun ase?”

english_text: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
nagamese_text: Jisu koise, “Etu junke Moi roti bhi jai kene dibo etu he tai ase.” Aru Tai ekta roti uthaikene bhi jaise aru Simon laga chokra Iscariot Judas ke dise.

english_text: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai etu roti luwa pichete Saitan tai laga monte ghusi jaise, titia Jisu taike koise, “Tumi ki kori bole ase joldi koribi.”

english_text: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
nagamese_text: Kintu mez usorte boha khan kunbi Tai etu kotha kele koise etu bujibo para nai.

english_text: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
nagamese_text: Kunba bhabise, Judas hathte poisa laga jola thaka karone, Jisu taike koise, “Kiba kinibi amikhan lage purbb karone,” nohoile dukhiya khan ke kiba dibole.

english_text: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai roti loise, tai joldi bahar te ulai jaise, aru etu somoi rati asele.

english_text: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
nagamese_text: Karone, jitia Judas ulai jaise, Jisu koise, “Etiya Manu laga Putro mohima hoise, aru Tai dwara Isor mohima hoise.

english_text: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
nagamese_text: Isor pora taike mohima koribo Tai nijor aru Taike joldi mohima hobo dibo.

english_text: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
nagamese_text: Chutu bacha khan, Moi olop somoi tumikhan logote ase. Tumikhan Moike bisaribo, aru Moi Yehudi cholawta khan ke kowa nisena, ‘Moi kot te jai ase, ta te tumikhan ahibo na paribo. Etiya Moi pora tumikhan ke koi ase.

english_text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke notun hukum di ase, tumikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi; Moi tumikhan ke morom kora nisena, tumi bhi ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi.

english_text: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone sob manu pora tumikhan to Moi laga chela ase koi kene jani lobo, jodi tumikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom korile.

english_text: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
nagamese_text: Simon Peter Taike koise, “Probhu, Apuni kote jabole ase?” Jisu taikhan koise, “Moi kote jabole ase, tumi etiya Moi laga piche ahibo na paribo, kintu pichete tumi Ami laga piche ahibo.”

english_text: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
nagamese_text: Peter Taike koise, “Probhu, kele, moi etiya Apuni laga piche ahibo napare? Moi to Apuni karone nijor jibon bhi dibo.”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Tumi Moi nimite tumi nijor jibon dibo? Hosa pora Moi tumike kobo, jitia tak tumi tin bar Moike najane nokoi, titia tak murga hala nokorile.”

english_text: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
nagamese_text: “Tumi laga mon chinta nohobi. Tumi Isor ke biswas koribi, aru Moike bhi biswas koribi.

english_text: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
nagamese_text: Ami laga Baba laga ghor te jagah bisi ase, jodi nohoi, to Moi tumikhan ke koi dibo, kelemane Moi tumikhan karone jagah taiyar kori bole jai ase.

english_text: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi Moi jai kene tumikhan karone jagah taiyar kori loile, Moi aru ahikena tumikhan ke loijabo, aru kot te Moi thakibo ta te tumikhan ke bhi thakibo dibo.

english_text: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Moi kot te jai ase etu rasta jani kene ase.”

english_text: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
nagamese_text: Thomas pora Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, amikhan najane Apuni kot te jai ase, tinehoile amikhan kineka rasta janibo?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moi he rasta ase, aru hosa ase aru jibon ase; kun bhi Baba logote jabo napare Moi pora nohoile.

english_text: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan Moike janile, Moi laga Baba ke bhi janibole asele. Aru etiya pora tumikhan jani loise, aru Taike dikhi loise.”

english_text: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
nagamese_text: Philip pora Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, amikhan ke Baba dikhai dibi, etu he amikhan karone kafi hobo.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Philip, Moi iman din tumikhan logote ase tumi etiya bhi Moike janibo para nai? Jun Moike dikhise tai bhi Baba ke dikhi loise. Kineka tumi koi ase, ‘Amikhan ke Baba dikhai dibi’?

english_text: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan biswas nakore Moi Baba logot aru Baba Moi logote ase kowa to? Ki kotha Moi tumikhan ke koise, Moi nijor khushi pora kowa nohoi, kintu Baba he Ami logote thake aru Ami dwara Tai laga kaam kori thake.

english_text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
nagamese_text: Moi Baba logote ase koi kene biswas koribi, aru Baba Ami logote ase koi kene biswas koribi, nohoile kaam khan saikene hoile bhi Moike biswas koribi.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
nagamese_text: Hosa, pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, jun Moike biswas koribo, tai Moi ki kaam korise, tai bhi koribo, aru tai etu pora bhi bisi dangor kaam koribo kelemane Moi Baba logote jai ase.

english_text: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Ami laga naam pora ki mangibo, eitu khan sob Moi koribo, Putro nimite Baba mohima hobo karone.

english_text: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan Moi laga naam pora mangibo, Moi etu kori dibo.

english_text: If you love me, keep my commandments.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan Moike morom kore, Ami laga hukum khan manibo,

english_text: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
nagamese_text: Aru Moi pora Baba ke prathana koribo, aru Tai tumikhan karone aru dusra ekjon Modot Diya Jon pathai dibo, Tai hodai tumikhan logote thaki jabo-

english_text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
nagamese_text: etu hosa laga Atma ase. Duniya pora Taike janibole para nai kelemane etu Taike nadikhe, aru najane. Kintu tumikhan to jane, kelemane Tai tumikhan logote thake aru tumikhan bhitor te thake.

english_text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke anath hobo nadibo; Moi tumikhan logote wapas ahibo.

english_text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
nagamese_text: Olop homoi karone etu duniya te Moike nadikhibo, kintu tumikhan to Moike dikhibo. Kelemane Moi jinda ase, tumikhan bhi jinda thakibo.

english_text: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
nagamese_text: Utu din tumikhan janibo Moi Baba logote ase, aru tumikhan Ami logote aru tumikhan logote Moi ase.

english_text: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
nagamese_text: Kun pora Ami laga hukum khan loi ase aru cholai thake, taikhan he Moike morom kora khan ase, aru kun Moike morom kore, Baba bhi taike morom koribo, aru Moi taike morom koribo aru taike Moi nijor dikhai dibo.”

english_text: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
nagamese_text: Judas -Iscariot nohoi- Jisu ke koise, “Probhu, kele Apuni nijorke amikhan logot dikhai dibo, kintu prithibi ke nohoi, etu kineka hobo?”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dikena taike koise, “Jodi kun bhi Moike morom kore, tai Ami laga kotha rakhibo. Moi laga Baba taike morom koribo, Ami duijon bhi tai logote ahibo aru tai logote Ami laga ghor bonabo.

english_text: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
nagamese_text: Jun Moike morom nakore, tai Ami laga kotha khan ke narakhe, aru ki kotha tumikhan huni loise, etu Ami laga kotha nohoi kintu Baba laga ase, Jun pora Moike pathaise.

english_text: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
nagamese_text: Moi eitu khan sob kotha koi dise, tumikhan logote thaka somoite.

english_text: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
nagamese_text: Kineka, Modot Diya Jon, Pobitro Atma, jun Baba he Ami laga naam pora pathai dibo- Tai sob apnikhan ke sikhai dibo, aru ki Moi apnikhan ke koise etu sob apnikhan ke aru bhi monte ahibo dibo.

english_text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan ke shanti rakhidibo; Moi apuni ke Ami laga shanti di ase. Moi diya to prithibi pora diya nisena nohoi. Tumi laga mon chinta nohobi aru bhoi nokoribi.

english_text: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
nagamese_text: Moi eneka kuwa apnikhan hunise, ‘Moi jai ase, aru Moi apuni khan logote wapas ahibo.’ Jodi apnikhan Moike morom kore, apnikhan etu pora khushi hobo lage, Moi Baba logote jai ase, kelemane Moi nohoi kintu Baba he dangor ase.

english_text: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
nagamese_text: Etu sob huwa age te Moi apnikhan ke koidi ase, jitia etu sob hoi jabo, titia apnikhan biswas kori lobo.

english_text: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan logote bisi kotha nakoribo, kelemane etu prithibi laga cholawta ahi ase. Tai Moike eku koribo na paribo,

english_text: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
nagamese_text: kintu Moi Baba ke morom kora prithibi ke jonai dibo karone aru jineka Baba he Moike hukum dise eitu khan sob kori thake, uthibi Amikhan yate pora jai jabo.”

english_text: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
nagamese_text: “Moi asol angur ghas ase, aru Moi laga Baba he bagan kora jon ase.

english_text: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
nagamese_text: Moi pora ula daal juntu te jodi phol naulai, Tai etu hatai diye; aru kuntu daal pora phol dibo, Tai etu pora aru bisi phol dibo karone bhal pora sai rakhi diye.

english_text: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke koi diya kotha pora tumikhan sapha hoise.

english_text: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
nagamese_text: Ami logote thakibi, aru Moi bhi tumi logote thakibo. Jodi daal to ghas te nathakile nijor phol dibo napare, tineka tumikhan bhi Ami logote nathakile phol dibo na paribo.

english_text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
nagamese_text: Moi angur ghas ase aru tumikhan daal khan ase. Jun Ami logote thake aru Moi tai logote thake, tai bisi phol dibo, kelemane tumikhan Moi pora alag hoi kene eku koribo napare.

english_text: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba Ami logote nathake, taike phelai dibo, aru ekta daal nisena, sukhi jabo, aru manu pora etu joma kori kene jui te di dibo, aru eitu khan ke jolai diye.

english_text: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan Moi logote thake, aru Ami laga kotha tumikhan logote thake, tumi ki lage etu mangibi, titia etu tumikhan karone kori dibo.

english_text: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga phol bisi ulaile Baba laga mohima hobo, aru etu pora tumikhan Ami laga chela koribo paribo.

english_text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
nagamese_text: Jineka Baba Moike morom korise, tineka Moi bhi tumikhan ke morom korise. Ami laga morom te thakibi.

english_text: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumi Ami laga hukum manile, Ami laga morom te thakibo, jineka Moi Baba laga kotha mani ahise aru Taike morom kori ahise.

english_text: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
nagamese_text: Moi etu kotha tumikhan ke etu karone koise, Ami laga anond tumikhan logote thaki bole, aru tumi laga anond pura hobo karone.

english_text: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
nagamese_text: Etu Ami laga hukum ase, tumikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi jineka Moi tumikhan ke morom kore.

english_text: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
nagamese_text: Kunba tai sathi khan karone nijor jibon diya- etu pora dangor morom aru nai.

english_text: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
nagamese_text: Tumi Ami laga sathi ase jodi tumi Moi diya hukum mani thakile.

english_text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
nagamese_text: Aru Moi tumikhan ke nokorkhan namatibo, kelemane nokor tai malik ki kore najane. Kintu Moi tumikhan ke sathi koise, kelemane Moi ki kotha Ami laga Baba pora hunise etu sob tumikhan ke koi dise.

english_text: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Moike basi luwa nohoi, kintu Moi he tumikhan ke basi loise, aru tumikhan ke tel lagai kene pobitro kori loise, tumikhan phol dhora to hodai thaki bole karone. Eneka hoile, tumikhan Ami laga naam te Baba ke mangibo, aru Tai etu tumikhan ke dibo.

english_text: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
nagamese_text: Etu hukum Moi tumikhan ke di ase, tumikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi.

english_text: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
nagamese_text: Jodi duniya pora tumikhan ke ghin korile bhi tumikhan jani ase, etu tumikhan age te Moike ghin korise.

english_text: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumikhan duniya laga ase, titia duniya pora tai nijor nisena morom kori bole thakise. Kintu tumikhan duniya laga nohoi, kintu Moi he etu duniya pora tumikhan ke basi loise, kelemane duniya tumikhan ke ghin kore.

english_text: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
nagamese_text: Ami pora kowa kotha yaad koribi, ‘Ekjon nokor tai laga malik pora dangor nohoi.’ Jodi taikhan pora Amike dukh dise koile, taikhan pora tumikhan ke bhi dukh dibo; jodi taikhan Ami laga kotha manile tumikhan laga kotha bhi manibo.

english_text: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi karone etu sob tumikhan uporte koribo, kelemane taikhan Moike pathai diya ke najane.

english_text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi nahile aru taikhan ke nokoile, taikhan laga paap nathakibo asele, kintu etiya taikhan nijor paap karone eku bahana nai.

english_text: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
nagamese_text: Jun Moike ghin korise tai Ami laga Baba ke bhi ghin korise.

english_text: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.
nagamese_text: Jodi Moi kun pora bhi koribo napara kaam kori dikhai diya nai koile taikhan laga paap nathakibo asele, kintu etiya taikhan Moi kori diya khan ke dikhise, aru Moi aru Moi laga Baba ke bhi ghin korise.

english_text: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
nagamese_text: Aru etu taikhan laga niyom te likha ase, ‘Taikhan Moike eku golti nathaki kene ghin korise,’ etu pura hoi jabo karone hoise.

english_text: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
nagamese_text: Jitia Modot Diya Jonke Moi tumikhan logote pathabo Jun ase Baba pora aha hosa Atma, etu he Amike gawah dibo.

english_text: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan bhi gawah ase kelemane shuru pora tumikhan Ami logote ase.

english_text: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
nagamese_text: “Tumikhan nagiribo karone Moi etiya sob koi ase.

english_text: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
nagamese_text: Taikhan tumikhan ke mondoli khan pora ulai dibo. Kintu somoi ahi ase, jitia tumikhan ke morai diya khan bhabibo taikhan Isor ke sewa te daan di ase.

english_text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.
nagamese_text: Taikhan tineka sob koribo kelemane taikhan Baba aru Moike najana.

english_text: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke eitu khan sob koi dibo, eneka hoile jitia taikhan laga somoi ahibo, tumikhan bhabona ahibo Moi tumikhan ke koi diya to. Kintu Moi shuru te etu kotha tumikhan ke kowa nai, kele koile Moi tumikhan logote he thaka karone.

english_text: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi etiya Moike pathai diya logote jai ase, kintu kun bhi eneka Moike huda nai, ‘Apuni kot te jabole ase?’

english_text: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke etu kotha kowa karone, tumikhan mon dukh hoise.

english_text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi tumikhan ke hosa kobo, Moi jaile tumikhan karone bhal hobo. Karone jodi Moi najaile, Modot Diya Jon to tumikhan logote nahibo, kintu Moi ja pichete he, Moi Taike tumikhan karone pathai dibo.

english_text: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Tai ahibo, Modot Diya Jon pora prithibi ke paap laga golti, dhormik kaam laga aru Isor pora bisar kora sob prithibi ke jonai dibo-

english_text: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
nagamese_text: Paapkhan bhi, kelemane taikhan Moike biswas nakora karone;

english_text: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
nagamese_text: aru dhormik kotha bhi, kelemane Moi Baba logote jai ase aru tumikhan Moike aru nadikhibo;

english_text: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
nagamese_text: aru bisar kotha bhi, kelemane etu duniya laga cholawta khan ke bisar kori loise.

english_text: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
nagamese_text: Moi etiya bhi tumikhan ke bisi kotha kobole ase, kintu tumikhan etiya etu dhorjo koribo na paribo.

english_text: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi jitia, Hosa laga Atma ahibo, Tai tumikhan ke sob hosa rasta dikhai dibo, kelemane Tai nijor pora eku bhi nokobo. Kintu Tai ki hune, Tai etu he kobo, aru ki ahibole ase etu sob tumikhan ke koi dibo.

english_text: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
nagamese_text: Tai Moike mohima koribo, kelemane Tai Ami laga kotha loi kene tumikhan ke jonai dibo.

english_text: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
nagamese_text: Sob bostu kuntu Baba laga ase, etu sob Moi laga ase. Etu karone, Moi koise Atma pora Moi laga kotha loi kene tumikhan ke sob jonai dibo.

english_text: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
nagamese_text: Olop somoi pichete tumikhan Moike nadikhibo, aru olop somoi pichete tumikhan Moike aru dikhibo.”

english_text: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai chela te kunba ekjon-ekjon kotha korise, “Tai amikhan ke ki koi ase, ‘Olop pichete tumikhan Moike nadikhibo, aru olop somoi pichete tumikhan Moike aru dikhibo,’ aru ‘kelemane Moi Ami laga Baba logote jai ase’?

english_text: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan koise, “Etu Tai ki koi ase, ‘Olop somoi’? Amikhan najane.”

english_text: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
nagamese_text: Jisu janise taikhan Taike hudibole mon kori ase, aru Tai koise, “Tumikhan apaste ‘olop somoi pichete tumikhan Moike nadikhibo, aru olop somoi pichete tumikhan aru Moike dikhibo’ kowa laga kotha ke huda-hudi kori ase?

english_text: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumikhan ke kobo, tumikhan kandibo aru dukh koribo, kintu duniya to khushi koribo. Tumikhan mon dukh koribo, kintu tumikhan mon dukh kora to khushi te bodli hoi jabo.

english_text: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
nagamese_text: Jitia maiki jonom dibole somoi ahijai, tai mon dukh kori thake, kelemane tai dukh somoi ahise, kintu jitia tai bacha ke jonom pai loi, tai dukh sob pahori jai kelemane ekjon etu duniya te jonom huwa karone.

english_text: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
nagamese_text: Karone tumikhan etiya mon dukh kori ase, kintu Moi tumikhan ke aru lok pabo, aru tumikhan mon khushi pabo, aru tumikhan laga anond kun bhi chingi loi najabo.

english_text: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
nagamese_text: Aru etu dinte tumikhan Moike eku bhi namangibo. Hosa, Moi tumikhan ke kobo, jodi tumikhan Ami laga naam pora Baba logote kiba mangile, Tai tumikhan ke dibo.

english_text: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
nagamese_text: Etiya tak tumikhan Ami laga naam te eku bhi manga nai. Mangibi, aru tumi pai jabo, aru tumi laga khushi pura hoi jabo.

english_text: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
nagamese_text: Moi etu tumikhan ke dristanto pora koi ase, kintu Moi tumikhan ke dristant nohoi kene khula- khuli pora Baba laga kotha kobole somoi ahi ase.

english_text: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
nagamese_text: Etu dinte tumikhan Ami laga naam pora mangibo, aru Moi tumikhan karone Baba pora mangibo kowa nohoi,

english_text: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
nagamese_text: kelemane Baba nijor tumikhan ke morom kore, kele koile tumikhan Moike morom korise, aru Moi Baba pora ahise koi kene tumikhan biswas korise.

english_text: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
nagamese_text: Moi Baba pora ahise, aru Moi duniya te ahise. Aru bhi, Moi duniya chari kene Baba logote jabole ase.”

english_text: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
nagamese_text: Tai chela khan koise, “Sabi, etiya to Apuni dristanto pora nohoi kintu khula-khuli koi ase.

english_text: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan jani loise Apuni sob jane koi kene, aru kunbi Apuni ke eku hudibole dorkar nai. Eitu khan nimite, amikhan biswas kori ase Apuni Isor pora ahise.”

english_text: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke hudise, “Tumikhan etiya biswas kori ase?

english_text: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
nagamese_text: Sabi, etu somoi ahi ase, hoi ahi jaise, jitia tumikhan sob ephale-uphale hoi kene nijor ghor te jai jabo, aru Moike ekla chari dibo. Hoilebi Moi ekla nohoi kelemane Baba Moi logote ase.

english_text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan ke etu kotha koi dise karone apnikhan Moi pora shanti pabo. Etu prithibi te dukh pabo, kintu mon dangor koribi, Moi prithibi uporte jiti loise.”

english_text: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
nagamese_text: Jisu pora etu sob kotha koi diya pichete Tai sorgo phale saikene prathana korise, “Baba, somoi ahi ponchise, Putro pora Apuni ke mohima koribo karone Chora ke mohima kori dibi-

english_text: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
nagamese_text: Apuni pora he sob manu uporte Taike adhikar dise aru etu pora he jun khan Apuni pora Taike dise, taikhan sobke anonto jibon pabo nimite.

english_text: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Etu he anonto jibon ase: taikhan pora Apuni he hosa Isor ase koi kene janibole, aru Jisu Khrista ke Jun Apuni pathai dise.

english_text: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
nagamese_text: Moi etu prithibi te Apuni ke mohima kori dise. Moi kaam khotom hoise juntu Apuni Moike kori bole dise.

english_text: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
nagamese_text: Etiya, Baba etu duniya bona age te Moi Apuni logote mohima te thaka nisena, etiya Apuni logote mohima hobole dibi.

english_text: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
nagamese_text: Moi Apuni laga naam taikhan ke dikhai dise, jun khan Apuni he duniya pora Moike dise. Taikhan Apuni laga asele aru Apuni he taikhan ke Moi logote dise aru taikhan Apuni laga kotha mani loise.

english_text: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
nagamese_text: Etiya taikhan jani loise, sob to Apuni Moike dise, sob Apuni pora ahise koi kene,

english_text: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.
nagamese_text: kelemane ki kotha Apuni Moike dise, Moi taikhan ke koi dise. Aru taikhan etu grohon kori loise, aru Moi, Apuni pora aha jani loise, aru Apuni he Moike pathaise etu ke biswas kori loise.

english_text: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan karone prathana kori ase. Moi etu duniya karone kora nai, kintu jun khan Apuni Moike dise, kelemane taikhan Apuni laga ase.

english_text: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
nagamese_text: Aru Ami laga ki ase, sob Apuni laga ase aru ki Apuni laga ase, sob Ami laga ase, aru Moi etu pora mohima hoise.

english_text: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
nagamese_text: Etiya Moi duniya te bisi din nathakibo, kintu eitu khan to duniya laga manu ase, aru Moi to Apuni logote ahi ase. Pobitro Baba, Apuni naam pora rakhi lobi jun khan Apuni Moike dise, taikhan ekta hobo dibi jineka Amikhan bhi ekta ase.

english_text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
nagamese_text: Jitia tak Moi taikhan logote ase, Moi Apuni laga naam pora, ki Apuni Moike dise eitu khan roikhya korise. Aru taikhan kunke bhi harai diya nai, khali khotom hobo thaka ke nohoile, jineka Shastro te likha ase etu pura hobo karone.

english_text: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya Moi Apuni logote ahi ase, aru Ami laga khushi taikhan monte pura hobo karone Moi etu duniya te thaka somoite koi dise.

english_text: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
nagamese_text: Moi Apuni laga kotha taikhan ke koi dise, aru duniya pora taikhan ke ghin korise, kelemane jineka Moi duniya laga nohoi tineka taikhan bhi duniya laga nohoi.

english_text: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan ke etu duniya pora uthai loijabi koi kene Apuni ke prathana kora nohoi, kintu taikhan ke biya jon pora bachai rakhibi koi kene binti kori ase.

english_text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
nagamese_text: Taikhan duniya laga nohoi, jineka Moi duniya laga nohoi.

english_text: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ke hosa dikena alag kori lobi. Apuni laga kotha to hosa ase.

english_text: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
nagamese_text: Jineka Apuni Moike duniya te pathaise, tineka Moi bhi taikhan ke duniya te pathai dise.

english_text: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan karone Moi nijorke alag rakhise, taikhan bhi nijorke hosa pora alag rakhibo karone.

english_text: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
nagamese_text: Moi khali etu karone binti kora nohoi, kintu taikhan ke bhi, jun khan taikhan kotha pora Moike biswas koribo sob karone binti ase,

english_text: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
nagamese_text: taikhan ke bhi ekta hobole dibi, jineka Apuni, Baba, Moi logote ase, aru Ami Apuni logote ase, eneka taikhan bhi Amikhan logote thaki bole, eneka pora duniya biswas koribo Apuni he Amike pathaise koi kene.

english_text: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
nagamese_text: Aru mohima juntu Apuni Moike dise, Moi taikhan ke di dise, karone taikhan bhi ekta hobole nimite, jineka Amikhan ekta ase.

english_text: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan logote aru Apuni Ami logote- taikhan ekta hobole, aru Apuni he Moike pathaise koi kene prithibi he janibole, aru Apuni Moike morom kora nisena, taikhan ke bhi morom korise.

english_text: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
nagamese_text: Baba, Ami laga itcha ase jun khan Apuni Moike dise, taikhan bhi kot te Moi thakibo ta te Moi logote thaki bole, tinehoile taikhan Moi laga mohima ke dikhibo, kele koile duniya bona age te Apuni Moike morom kori ahise.

english_text: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
nagamese_text: Dharmik Baba, prithibi Apuni ke jana nai, kintu Moi Apuni ke jane; aru eitu khan to Apuni pora Moike pathaise koi kene jani loise.

english_text: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
nagamese_text: Aru Moi Apuni naam taikhan ke koi dise, aru koi thakibo, juntu morom Apuni Moike dise, etu morom taikhan monte thaki bole, aru Moi taikhan logote thaki bole.”

english_text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu etu kotha koi diya pichete, Tai chela khan ke loi Kidron Bhoyam kinar pora jaise, ta te ekta bagan asele, juntu jagate Tai aru chela khan jaise.

english_text: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
nagamese_text: Titia Judas, jun Taike thogai dibole ase, tai bhi etu jagah jani thakise, kelemane poila bhi Jisu Taikhan ke loi ta te jai thakisele.

english_text: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
nagamese_text: Titia Judas, sipahi aru mukhyo purohit aru Pharisee aru adhikari khan sakhi, mashal, aru hathiar khan loi kene ahise.

english_text: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu, etu sob jinis Tai upor ahibo thaka jani kene, Tai taikhan logote ahikena hudise, “Apnikhan kunke bisari ase?”

english_text: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Taike jowab dise, “Nazareth Jisu ke.” Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Moi ase.” Kintu Judas, Taike thogai dibole aru dhoribo thaka manu bhi sipahi khan logote khara thakise.

english_text: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.
nagamese_text: Karone jitia Tai taikhan ke koise, “Moi ase,” taikhan pichete hati kene matite giri jaise.

english_text: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai aru taikhan ke aru hudise, “Kunke tumikhan bisari ase?” Aru taikhan koise, “Nazareth Jisu ke.”

english_text: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Moi tumikhan ke koise Moi ase. Jodi tumikhan Moike bisari ase koile, poila eitu khan ke jabo dibi.”

english_text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
nagamese_text: Etu pura kori bole karone hoise jun to kotha Tai age te koisele; “Apuni Moike diya khan, Moi ekjon ke bhi harai diya nai.”

english_text: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
nagamese_text: Titia Simon Peter logote talwar thakise, aru tai etu ke ulaikene moha purohit nokor laga dyna kaan kati dise. Etu nokor laga naam Malchus asele.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
nagamese_text: Karone Jisu Peter ke koise, “Tumi laga talwar nijor jagate rakhi dibi. Juntu kup Baba he Moike dise, Moi etu pora khabo nalage naki?”

english_text: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
nagamese_text: Titia Rome laga sipahi khan aru taikhan laga sahab aru Yehudi khan laga adhikari khan Jisu ke dhori loise aru Taike bandhi loise.

english_text: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
nagamese_text: Aru prothom te, Taike loi kene Annas logote jaise, jun Caiaphas laga sasur asele, jun he etu saal pora moha purohit kaam kori asele.

english_text: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
nagamese_text: Aru poila dinte Yehudi khan ke nirdes diya, jun koise sob manu nost huwa pora ekjon mori juwa he bhal ase kowa to etu Caiaphas he asele.

english_text: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
nagamese_text: Kintu Simon Peter aru dusra ekjon chela bhi Jisu ke piche kori ahise. Aru etu chela to moha purohit logote chihnaki thakisele, karone tai Jisu logote moha purohit laga veranda te jaise;

english_text: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
nagamese_text: kintu Peter to dorja laga bahar te khara hoise. Titia dusra chela jun he moha purohit logote chihnaki ase, bahar jai kene dorja rukhi thaka mahila ke koi kene Peter ke bhitor loi anise.

english_text: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
nagamese_text: Titia etu nokorni jun he dorja ke sai thakise, tai Peter ke koise, “Apuni bhi etu manu laga chela nohoi?” Tai koise, “Moi to nohoi.”

english_text: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
nagamese_text: Etu jagate nokorkhan aru adhikari khan khara asele, aru taikhan thanda laga karone jui thapi thakise, aru Peter bhi taikhan logote khara kori jui thapi thakise.

english_text: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
nagamese_text: Titia moha purohit Jisu ke tai chela khan laga kotha aru tai laga updesh laga kotha hudise.

english_text: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab dise, “Moi khuli kene jogot ke koi dise, Moi hodai mondoli te aru mondoli te, kot te Yehudi khan joma kori thake, ta te sikhai thakise, aru eku bhi lukai kene kowa nai.

english_text: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
nagamese_text: Kile tumikhan Moike hudi ase? Hudi bhi jun hunise Moi taikhan ke kowa kotha khan. Sabi, taikhan sob jani ase Moi ki koise.”

english_text: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu koise, ta te thaka ekjon adhikari khara kori thaka pora Jisu ke thapor mari koise, “Kile Apuni moha purohit ke eneka jowab dibo?”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab dise, “Jodi Moi biya kotha koile, etu biya kotha laga sabut dibi, kintu jodi etu thik ase koile tumi Moike kele marise?”

english_text: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
nagamese_text: Titia Annas pora Tai hath bandi kene moha purohit Caiaphas logote pathai dise.

english_text: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
nagamese_text: Simon Peter khara hoi kene jui thapi thakisele. Titia taikhan koise, “Apuni bhi Tai chela te ekjon nohoi?” Tai koise, “Moi to nohoi.”

english_text: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
nagamese_text: Maha purohit laga ekta nokor jun laga kaan Peter he kati dise, etu khandan manu ekjon koise, “Apuni bhi Tai logote thaka moi bagan te apuni ke dikha nohoi?”

english_text: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
nagamese_text: Peter aru nohoi koise aru etu kowa logote, ekta murga hala korise.

english_text: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Jisu ke Caiaphas logote prodhan sorkari kendra te loi jaise. Kintu etu somoi phojur asele, aru taikhan prodhan sorkari kendra te loi juwa nai kelemane Nistar khabole thaka karone taikhan letera hoi jabo bhabona laga bhoi pora.

english_text: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
nagamese_text: Pilate taikhan logote ahikena koise, “Tumikhan etu manu ke ki golti lagai kene yate anise?”

english_text: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan taike jowab di koise, “Jodi Tai biya kaam nakorile, amikhan Taike apuni usorte loi nahibole asele.”

english_text: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”
nagamese_text: Karone Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Loijabi tumikhan Taike, aru tumikhan laga niyom hisab pora Taike bisar koribi.” Yehudi khan taike koise, “Amikhan laga niyom te kunke bhi mora bole adhikar nai.”

english_text: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
nagamese_text: Jisu Tai nijor kineka kori mori bole ase, Tai nijor koi diya ke pura hobo karone etu eneka hoise.

english_text: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate prodhan sorkari kendra jagate ahi kene Jisu ke matise, aru Taike koise, “Apuni Yehudi laga Raja ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike jowab dise, “Etu kotha tumi nijor koi ase, na kunba Ami laga kotha tumike koise?”

english_text: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
nagamese_text: Pilate jowab dise, “Moi Yehudi ase, na nohoi? Tumi laga jati aru mukhyo purohit khan he Apuni ke moi laga hathte dise. Apuni ki korise?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
nagamese_text: Jisu jowab dise, “Moi laga rajyo etu duniya laga nohoi. Jodi etu duniya laga hoile, manu pora Moike dhori kene Yehudi khan ke nadibo karone, Ami laga nokorkhan lorai koribo asele. Kintu Moi laga rajyo to yate nohoi.”

english_text: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
nagamese_text: Karone Pilate Taike koise, “Tinehoile, Apuni ekjon Raja ase?” Jisu jawan dise, “Apuni thik koise, Moi raja ase. Kelemane etu karone, Moi jonom loise aru ahise, hosa laga gawahi dibo nimite. Karone, jun manu hosa te thake Ami laga awaj huni thake.”

english_text: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
nagamese_text: Pilate Taike koise, “Hosa to ki ase?” Aru tai etu koi kene Yehudi khan logote aru jaise aru koise, “Moi to Tai uporte eku golti paa nai.

english_text: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan niyom te Nistar Purbb te moi pora ekjon ke tumikhan karone chari dibole ase, karone moi tumikhan Yehudi laga Raja ke chari dile tumi laga itcha hobo?”

english_text: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan aru bisi hala kori koise, “Etu manu nohoi kintu Barabbas ke dibi.” Barabbas ekjon dokait asele.

english_text: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate pora Jisu ke loijai kene chabuk maribo dise.

english_text: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
nagamese_text: Aru sipahi khan kata mukut bonaise. Aru Jisu laga matha te hali dise aru begoni rong laga kapra Taike pindhai dise.

english_text: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai usorte ahi kene, salam korise aru Taike thapor marikena koise, “Yehudi laga Raja!”

english_text: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate aru bahar ahikena Taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, moi Tai pora eku golti pa-a, nai karone tumikhan ke jonai dibole Taike loi kene tumikhan logote ahi ase.”

english_text: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu kata mukut aru begoni rong kapra lagai kene bahar te ulai ahise. Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, etu manu yate ase!”

english_text: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
nagamese_text: Jitia mukhyo purohit khan aru adhikari khan Jisu ke dikhise, taikhan jor pora hala kori koise, “Taike Cross te morai dibi, Taike Cross te morai dibi!” Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan he Taike loijai kene morai dibi, kelemane moi to Tai pora eku golti paa nai.”

english_text: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
nagamese_text: Yehudi khan taike jowab dise, “Amikhan bhi niyom ase, aru etu niyom hisab te Tai moribo lage, kelemane Tai nijorke Isor laga Putro kowa karone.”

english_text: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
nagamese_text: Karone jitia Pilate etu kotha hunise, tai aru bisi bhoi khai jaise.

english_text: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
nagamese_text: Aru tai prodhan sorkari kendra te jaise, aru Jisu ke koise, “Apuni kot pora ahise?” Kintu Jisu taike eku jowab diya nai.

english_text: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
nagamese_text: Titia Pilate Taike koise, “Apuni moike eku nakobo? Apuni najane moi Apuni ke chari dibole bhi adhikar ase, aru Apuni ke latkai dibole bhi adhikar ase?”

english_text: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Apuni ke upor pora hokti nadile Ami logote eku adhikar nathakibole asele, karone jun Moike dhori kene tumi laga hathte dise etu manu laga paap bisi hoise.”

english_text: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
nagamese_text: Etu jowab pora Pilate Taike chari dibole bhabi loise, kintu Yehudi cholawta khan hala kori koise, “Jodi apuni etu manu ke chari dile, apuni Caesar laga sathi nohoi. Kun tai nijorke raja koribo kosis kore, tai Caesar bhirodhi ase.”

english_text: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Pilate etu kotha hunise, tai Jisu ke loi bahar ulaise, aru bisar kora singhason te bohise, utu jagah ke “Pavement” mate, kintu Ibrani kotha te “Gabbatha” koi.

english_text: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
nagamese_text: Etu somoi to Nistar Purbb laga taiyari kora din asele, aru baroh baji asele, aru tai Yehudi khan ke koise, “Sabi, tumikhan laga Raja!”

english_text: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan hala kori, “Taike loijabi, Taike loijabi; Taike Cross te morai dibi!” Pilate taikhan ke koise, “Kile tumikhan laga Raja ke moi Cross te dibo?” Mukhyo purohit khan koise, “Amikhan Caesar nohoile dusra raja nai.”

english_text: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
nagamese_text: Titia tai Jisu ke Cross te dibole taikhan hathte di dise, karone taikhan Jisu ke loi jaise.

english_text: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
nagamese_text: Aru Jisu nijor Cross loi kene ekta jagah te jaise juntu ke “Matha laga Hardi jaga” koi, jun to Ibrani kotha te “Golgotha” koi.

english_text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
nagamese_text: Ta te taikhan Jisu ke Cross te dise, aru dusra duijon ke bhi ekjon ephale aru dusra uphale korise, aru Jisu ke majote dise.

english_text: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
nagamese_text: Aru Pilate ekta dosh potro likhi kene Cross te dise, aru eneka likha asele: NAZARETH LAGA JISU, YEHUDI KHAN LAGA RAJA.”

english_text: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
nagamese_text: Karone, bisi Yehudi khan etu porhise, kelemane Jisu ke latkai diya jaga to sheher usorte thakise. Aru etu chihna ke Ibrani, Latin aru Yunani pora kotha te likhi rakhise,

english_text: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
nagamese_text: Titia mukhyo purohit khan aru Yehudi khan Pilate ke koise, “Eneka nalikhibi, ‘Yehudi laga Raja,’ kintu Tai he nijor he koi, ‘Moi Yehudi laga Raja ase.’””

english_text: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
nagamese_text: Pilate jowab dise, “Ki Moi likhise, etu likhi dise.”

english_text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
nagamese_text: Jitia sipahi khan Jisu ke Cross te latkai dise aru Tai kapra khan char bhag kori sob sipahi ekta-ekta bhag loise, aru Tai kurta bhi, kintu kurta to silai nathaka, upor pora niche tak bona asele.

english_text: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
nagamese_text: Karone taikhan apaste kotha korise, “Amikhan etu kurta to naphatai kene chithi kheli koribo, kun naam te ulabo tai he loi lobo.” Kelemane Shastro te likha ase, “Taikhan Ami laga kapra bhangai loise Aru Moi laga kurta loi chithi kheli loise.” Karone sipahi khan etu kori loise.

english_text: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
nagamese_text: Ta te Jisu Cross usorte Tai laga ama aru ama laga bhoini, Clopas laga maiki Mary, aru Mary Magdalene khara asele.

english_text: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Tai laga ama aru Tai morom kori thaka chela khara thaka dikhi kene Tai laga ama ke koise, “Mahila, sabi, apuni laga chokra!”

english_text: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai chela ke bhi koise, “Sabi, apuni laga ama!” Aru etu somoi pora chela pora taike nijor ghor te loi jaise.

english_text: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”
nagamese_text: Etu pichete, Shastro te likha khan sob pura hoise janikena Jisu koise, “Moi pyaas lagise.”

english_text: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
nagamese_text: Ta te ekta daba te tenga pani bhorta rakhi asele, taikhan kopas te tenga pani bhi jai kene Tai mukh te dise.
