english_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu etu tenga pani loise, Tai koise, “Etu pura hoise.” Aru Tai matha niche kori Tai atma di dise.

english_text: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
nagamese_text: Titia Yehudi khan, kelemane etu taiyar kora din asele, karone gaw to Bisram dinte Cross te narakhi bole - kelemane etu Bisram din to khas din asele,- Pilate logote hudise theng bhangai dibole aru taikhan ke namai dibole.

english_text: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
nagamese_text: Titia sipahi khan ahi prothom laga theng bhangai dise, aru dusra laga bhi junke Jisu logote latkai disele.

english_text: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Taikhan Jisu usorte ahise, Tai mori juwa dikhikena Tai laga theng bhangai diya nai.

english_text: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, sipahi ekjon tai laga jathi loi kene Tai laga pet te ghusai dise, aru khun aru pani ulaise.

english_text: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
nagamese_text: Aru jun dikhise tai gawahi dise, aru tai laga gawahi to hosa ase. Tai jane tai hosa koise, karone tumikhan bhi biswas koribi.

english_text: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro te “Tai laga hardi ekta bhi na bhangabo, etu pura hobo karone eneka hoise.”

english_text: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
nagamese_text: Aru, dusra Shastro te koise, “Taikhan nijor jathi pora mari diya ke nijor sabo.”

english_text: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
nagamese_text: Etu sob huwa pichete, Arimathia laga manu Joseph, jun Jisu laga chela asele, -kintu Yehudi khan ke bhoi pora lukai thakise-, Pilate logote ahi Jisu laga gaw ke loi jabole mangise. Pilate taike dibole hukum dise. Karone Joseph ahikena Jisu laga gaw loi jaise.

english_text: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
nagamese_text: Nicodemus bhi ahisele, age te jun manu rati te Jisu logote ahisele. Tai myrrh aru aloe khan anise, aru etu to milai kene eksoh pound nisena thakise.

english_text: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Jisu laga gaw loi kene Yehudi laga moidam diya niyom hisab te mihin kapra loi mitha sugandh tel pora milai loise.

english_text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
nagamese_text: Aru kun jagate Jisu ke latkai dise, ta te ekta bagan thakise, aru etu bagan te ekta notun kobor thakise, kitia bhi nachola laga thakise.

english_text: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.
nagamese_text: Aru etu din Yehudi khan laga taiyari din asele, aru etu kobor bisi dur bhi nohoi, karone taikhan Jisu ke ta te he rakhidise.

english_text: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
nagamese_text: Hapta laga prothom dinte, arubi andhera thaka homoi te, Mary Magdalene kobor te ahise, aru kobor pora pathor ke hatai diya dikhi paise.

english_text: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
nagamese_text: Titia tai dauri ahikena Simon Peter aru dusra chela junke Jisu morom kore, taikhan ke koise, “Manu khan Probhu ke kobor pora uthai loi jaise, aru amikhan najane Taike kote loi rakhidise.”

english_text: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter aru dusra chela duijon ulaikene kobor te jaise.

english_text: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.
nagamese_text: Aru duijon polai jai asele, hoilebi dusra chela he Peter pora age kobor te ponchise.

english_text: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.
nagamese_text: Aru tai jhuki kene bhitor te saise, aru mihin kapra thaka paise, kintu tai bhitor te juwa nai.

english_text: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
nagamese_text: Titia Simon Peter tai piche-piche ahise, aru kobor bhitor te jaise. Tai mihin kapra ta te thaka paise

english_text: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
nagamese_text: aru Tai matha bandi rakha kapra dikhise. Etu kapra to mihin kapra logote nohoi kintu alag jagate bhal pora lipai kene thaka paise.

english_text: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
nagamese_text: Titia dusra chela jun prothom kobor te ponchise, aru bhitor jaise aru dikhi kene biswas korise.

english_text: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan etiya tak Tai mora pora jee uthijabo lage, eneka Shastro te kowa ke bujha nai.

english_text: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
nagamese_text: Titia chela khan nijor ghor te wapas jai jaise.

english_text: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
nagamese_text: Kintu Mary to kobor bahar te khara kandi thakise, aru jhuki kene kobor bhitor te saise.

english_text: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth duijon ujala kapra pindhi kene kuntu jagate Jisu laga gaw rakhise, ta te ekjon matha phale aru dusra Tai theng phale thaka paise.

english_text: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan taike koise, “Mahila, kele tumi kandi ase?” Tai taikhan ke koise, “kelemane ami laga Probhu ke uthai loi jaise, aru taikhan Taike kot te rakhidise moi najane.”

english_text: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
nagamese_text: Tai etu koi kene piche phale saise, aru Jisu ke ta te khara dikha paise, kintu tai etu Jisu ase koi kene jana nai.

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Mahila kele tumi kandi ase? Tumi kunke bisari ase?” Tai maali ase bhabi kene Taike koise, “Sahab, jodi apuni Taike loi jaise koile Taike kot te rakhidise moike koi dibi tinehoile moi Taike loijabo.”

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Mary.” Tai piche ghuri kene Taike koise Ibrani kotha pora koise, “Rabboni”- mane “Shika manu”.

english_text: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Moike na chubi, kelemane Moi etiya Baba logot uporte juwa nai kintu Ami laga bhai khan logote jai kene koi dibi, Moi Ami laga Baba aru tumikhan laga Baba, Ami laga Isor aru tumikhan laga Isor, Tai logote uporte jai ase.”

english_text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
nagamese_text: Mary Magdalene ahi kene chela khan ke koise, “Moi Probhu ke dikhise,” aru Tai he taike etu sob kotha koise koi kene.

english_text: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
nagamese_text: Karone, hapta laga prothom din laga saam te chela khan joma korise, taikhan Yehudi khan ke bhoi pora dorja bondh kori rakhise, titia Jisu ahi taikhan majote khara hoise, aru taikhan ke koise, “Shanti hobi tumikhan.”

english_text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
nagamese_text: Aru etu kowa pichete Tai hath aru Tai panjar taikhan ke dikhai dise. Titia taikhan Probhu ke dikhi anondo korise.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu koise, “Shanti hobi tumikhan. Jineka Baba he Moike pathaise tineka Moi tumikhan ke pathai ase.”

english_text: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Jisu etu koi dise, Tai pora taikhan ke phuki dise, aru koise, Tumikhan “Pobitro Atma grohon kori lobi.

english_text: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan kun laga paap ke khyama kori dise, taikhan khyama pai jabo; aru tumikhan jun laga paap rakhidibo, etu paapkhan thaki jabo.”

english_text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu pora baroh jon logote aha somoite Thomas Didymus to chela thaka nai.

english_text: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
nagamese_text: Dusra chela koise taike, “Amikhan Probhu ke dikhise.” Kintu tai taikhan ke koise, “Jitia tak moi Tai hathte gojal daag nadikhibo, aru nijor anguli pora gojal laga chenda te hath na nadhalibo, moi biswas nakoribo.”

english_text: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
nagamese_text: Aru ath din pichete Tai chela khan ghor te joma thakisele, aru Thomas bhi taikhan logote thakise. Jisu ahise aru dorja bondh thakise, aru taikhan majote khara koi kene koise, “Shanti hobi tumikhan.”

english_text: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
nagamese_text: Titia Tai Thomas ke koise, “Tumi laga anguli yate loi anibi aru Ami laga hath sabi. Aru tumi laga hath loi yate anibi, aru Ami laga panjar te halibi aru abiswasi nathakibi, kintu biswas koribi.”

english_text: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
nagamese_text: Aru Thomas Taike koise, “Ami laga Probhu aru ami laga Isor.”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “kelemane tumi Moike dikhi kene biswas korise. Dhonyo ase jun khan dikhi nai, aru biswas kori loise.”

english_text: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
nagamese_text: Jisu aru bhi bisi chihna Tai chela khan usor pora kori dise, etu kitab te nalikha aru bhi bisi ase,

english_text: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
nagamese_text: kintu etu sob likhi rakhise, kelemane, Jisu he Khrista, jun Isor laga Putro ase etu biswas kori bole, aru biswas pora Tai naam te jibon pabo karone ase. Amen.

english_text: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
nagamese_text: Etu huwa pichete, arubi Jisu Tai nijor chela khan ke dikhai dise Tiberias nodi kinar te. Tai eneka taikhan ke dikhai dise:

english_text: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
nagamese_text: -Simon Peter aru Didymus kowa Thomas, aru Galilee jaga laga Cana town pora Nathaniel aru Zebedee laga duijon chokra aru Tai chela khan kunba eke logote asele.

english_text: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
nagamese_text: Simon Peter taikhan ke koise, “Moi maas dhori bole jai ase.” Taikhan koise, “Amikhan bhi apuni logote jabo.” Titia taikhan joldi jai kene ekta naw te bohi jaise, kintu etu rati taikhan eku bhi pa-a nai.

english_text: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
nagamese_text: Jitia phojur hoise, Jisu nodi kinar te khara thakise, hoilebi chela khan etu Jisu ase koi kene jana nai.

english_text: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
nagamese_text: Karone Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Jawan khan, khabole kiba ase?” Taikhan Taike koise, “Nai.”

english_text: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai taikhan ke koise, “Naw laga dyna phale tumikhan jal hali dibi, titia tumikhan kiba pabo.” Titia taikhan jal hali dise, aru maas bisi dhori luwa karone tanibo para nai.

english_text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
nagamese_text: Titia juntu chela ke Jisu morom kore, tai pora Peter ke koise, “Etu Probhu ase.” Jitia Simon Peter etu kotha hunise, tai laga bahar kapra pindhi loise- kelemane tai kapra nalagai kene thakise- aru samundar te jap marise.

english_text: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra chela khan chutu naw te ahise- kelemane taikhan kinar te jabole bisi dur nohoi, dui-sou hath lamba nisena he ase- aru taikhan maas bhorta thaka jal ke tani ani loise.

english_text: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan joldi matite ahi jaise, taikhan jui laga koila te maas rakhi thaka, aru roti dikhise.

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taikhan ke koise, “Tumikhan etiya dhori luwa pora maas olop anibi.”

english_text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
nagamese_text: Simon Peter naw te jai kene dangor maas pora bhorta thaka jal ke matite tani anise; ta te bisi thakise hoilebi jal to phata nai.

english_text: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
nagamese_text: Jisu pora taikhan ke koise, “Ahibi aru nashta kori lobi.” Kintu ekjon chela khan bhi Taike hudibo mon dangor kora nai, “Apuni kun ase?” Kelemane Tai he Probhu ase koi kene taikhan jani loise.

english_text: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
nagamese_text: Jisu ahise aru roti aru maas loi kene taikhan ke dise.

english_text: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
nagamese_text: Etu tin bar asele Jisu Tai mora pora ji uthija pichete chela khan ke nijor dikhai dise.

english_text: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
nagamese_text: Jitia nashta kori loise, Jisu Simon Peter ke koise, “Simon Peter, Jonah laga chokra, tumi eitu khan pora bhi Moike bisi morom kore?” Peter Tai koise, “Hoi Probhu moi Apuni ke morom kora Apuni jane.” Jisu taike koise, “Ami laga mer khan ke khila bhi.”

english_text: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
nagamese_text: Tai taike aru koise dusra bar, “Simon Jonah laga chokra, tumi Moike morom kore?” Peter Taike koise, “Hoi Probhu, Apuni he jane moi Apuni ke morom kore.” Jisu taike koise, “Ami laga mer khan ke roikhya koribi.”

english_text: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
nagamese_text: Tai taike koise tin bar, “Simon Jonah laga chokra, tumi Moike morom kore?” Peter udas hoise kelemane Jisu taike tin bar kowa karone, “Moike morom kore?” Tai koise, “Probhu, Apuni he sob jane, moi Apuni ke morom kore.” Jisu taike koise, “Ami laga mer khan ke khila bhi.

english_text: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
nagamese_text: Hosa pora Moi tumike kobo, tumi jawan somoite tumi nijor komor bandi kot te jabole mon kore ta te jai thakisele, kintu jitia tumi bura hoi jabo, tumi hath uthaikene dusra pora tumike kapra pindhai aru tumi kot te jabole mon nakore ta te loijabo.”

english_text: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
nagamese_text: Titia Jisu etu kowa motlob to Peter kineka moribo aru Isor ke mohima kori bole ase, etu dikhai dibole kowa hoise, aru Tai Peter ke koise, “Ami laga piche koribi.”

english_text: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
nagamese_text: Titia Peter ghuri piche saise, aru junke Jisu morom kore etu chela jun bhoj kora somoite thik Jisu laga chati usorte jhuki kene hudise, “Probhu, Apuni ke thogai dibole thaka kun ase?”

english_text: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
nagamese_text: Karone Peter taike dikhi kene Jisu ke koise, “Kintu Probhu, etu manu kineka hobo?”

english_text: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
nagamese_text: Jisu taike koise, “Jodi Moi kobo Moi aru wapas naha tak, taike thaki bole dibo mon korile tumi ki hoise? Tumi Ami laga piche koribi.”

english_text: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
nagamese_text: Karone etu chela namoribo koi kene bhai khan majote kotha kori thakise, kintu Jisu taike etu chela namoribo kowa nai kintu, “Jodi Moi aru naha tak taike thaki bole dibo mon korile, tumi ki hoise?”

english_text: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
nagamese_text: Etu chela he ase jun pora etu kotha ke gawahi dise, aru etu kotha ke likhi diya hoise, aru tai laga gawahi hosa ase, etu amikhan jani ase.

english_text: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
nagamese_text: Kintu aru bhi bisi kaam ase, Jisu kori diya, jodi etu sob kotha ekta-ekta kori likhi jabo koile, ami laga bhabona te kitab likhi bole etu duniya te jagah napabo.

english_text: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
nagamese_text: O Theophilus, moi laga prothom kitab te, Jisu pora ki hikai se aru ki korise,

english_text: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
nagamese_text: Taike sorgote loi najuwa din tak, aru Pobitro Atma laga hokti pora Jisu nijor basi luwa apostle khan ke hukum diya khan laga likhi dise.

english_text: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
nagamese_text: Tai bisi dukh kori kene morise aru wapas jee uthija-a pichete, Tai chalis din tak hosa pora jinda hoise koi kene dikhai dise, aru Isor rajyo laga kotha taikhan ke koi dise.

english_text: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
nagamese_text: Tai jitia taikhan logote thakise, tai hukum dise Jerusalem chari kene najabole, aru Baba laga itcha rukhi thaki bole juntu laga kotha Tai koise, “Tumikhan etu kotha moi pora huni loise

english_text: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
nagamese_text: John to pani pora Baptizma dise, kintu tumikhan to olop din pichete Pobitro Atma pora baptizma pabo.”

english_text: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu aru chela khan eke logot joma korise, titia taikhan eneka hudise, “Probhu Apuni etu homoi te Israel laga rajyo wapas dibo naki?”

english_text: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai taikhan ke koise, “Etu tumikhan janibole din aru homoi aha nai, Baba he nijor adhikar aru hokti pora koribo.

english_text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan hokti pabo, jitia Pobitro Atma ahibo, aru tumikhan Moi laga gawahi dibo, Jerusalem te, aru Judea aru Samaria te aru prithibi laga sob jagate.”

english_text: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
nagamese_text: Jitia Probhu Jisu taikhan ke etu kotha khan koi dise, aru taikhan upor phale sai thakise, titia Taike uporte uthai loi jaise, aru badal ahi kene taike bondh kori dise aru taikhan laga suku pora eku nadikha hoi jaise.

english_text: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Jisu ke sorgote loijai thaka to sai thakise, achanak pora, duijon manu boga kapra lagai kene taikhan usorte khara hoi jaise.

english_text: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai duijon pora koise, “Galilee laga manu khan, tumikhan kele sorgo phale saikene khara kori ase? Jisu junke sorgote loi jaise, Taike sorgote loi juwa dikha nisena aru Tai wapas eneka aha dikhibo.”

english_text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
nagamese_text: Titia chela khan Jerusalem sheher te ahise, Oliv Pahar pora, jun to Jerusalem pora ekta Bisram din nisena dur te ase.

english_text: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ponchi kene upor kamra te jaise, aru ta te Peter, James, John, aru Andrew, Philip aru Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, Alpheus laga chokra James, Simon Zealot aru James laga chokra Judas khan bohi thakise.

english_text: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob eke mon hoi kene prathana korise, ta te mahila khan bhi thakise, aru Jisu laga ama Mary aru Tai bhai khan bhi thakise.

english_text: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
nagamese_text: Aru etu homoi te eksoh bis nisena bhai khan joma thakise, titia Peter koise,

english_text: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
nagamese_text: “Bhai khan, Shastro te ki likha ase etu pura hobo lagibo, Pobitro Atma dwara David laga mukh pora Judas nimite koi disele, jun he Jisu ke dhoribole manu khan ke loi anise.

english_text: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Judas bhi amikhan logote ginti korise, aru Isor laga kaam kori bole tai laga bhag bhi thakise.”

english_text: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.
nagamese_text: - Ekjon manu tai laga letera kamai pora kheti kinise, aru etu jagate tai poila matha ulta kori kene girise, aru tai laga pet phati jaise, aru pet nari sob bahar te ulai jaise.

english_text: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
nagamese_text: Aru Jerusalem sheher te thaka manu sob etu kotha janise, aru titia taikhan nijor kotha pora etu kheti laga naam “Akeldama,” rakhidise juntu laga motlob ase, “Khun laga Kheti.”-

english_text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
nagamese_text: “Kelemane Bhajan Geet laga Kitab te likha ase, ‘Tai laga kheti khali hoi jabo, Ta te kunke bhi thaki bole nadibi,’ Aru ‘kunba pora tai laga kaam to loi lobole dibi.’

english_text: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
nagamese_text: Etu dorkar ase, kelemane, Probhu Jisu thaka homoi pora Tai naja tak kunkhan amikhan logote thakise,

english_text: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
nagamese_text: shuru pora John ke baptizma diya homoi aru Jisu ke amikhan logot pora uthai loi naja tak- etu majot pora, ekjon manu amikhan logote mili kene Tai arubi jee uthija-a laga gawahi kori bole lage.”

english_text: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan duijon manu ke age te rakhise, Joseph junke Barsabbas aru Justus bhi mate, aru Matthias.

english_text: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan prathana kori kene koise, “Apuni, Probhu, sob manu laga mon jane, etu nimite duijon majote kunke basi loise etu jonai dibi

english_text: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
nagamese_text: kun he sewa laga jaga lobo juntu Judas pora chari kene nijor jagate jai jaise.”

english_text: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan chithi korise, aru chithi te Matthias laga naam ulaise, aru egaroh jon chela majote tai bhi ginti hoi jaise.

english_text: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
nagamese_text: Jitia Pentecost din ahise, biswasi khan sob ek jagah te joma hoise.

english_text: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
nagamese_text: Aru achanak ta te awaj ekta sorgo pora ahise, aru taikhan bohi thaka pura ghor to bhorta hoi jaise.

english_text: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan age te juli thaka jui nisena ulaise, aru ekjon-ekjon uporte bohi jaise.

english_text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan sob Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoise aru alag kotha pora kobole shuru hoise, Atma pora taikhan ke dusra bhasa pora kobole sikhai dise.

english_text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
nagamese_text: Aru Jerusalem te Isor jana Yehudi manu khan thakise, aru akas nichete thaka sob desh pora ahikena ta te thakise.

english_text: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia etu awaj ulaise, ta te manu khan sob ahi kene asurit lagise kelemane taikhan nijor laga kotha pora koi thaka hunise.

english_text: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan sob asurit hoi jaise; aru taikhan koise, “Sabi, etu kotha koi thaka khan Galilee manu khan nohoi naki?

english_text: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
nagamese_text: Tenehoile kineka taikhan laga mukh pora amikhan ki kotha koi kene jonom korise etu kotha koi ase?

english_text: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
nagamese_text: Parthia laga aru Mede aru Elam laga, aru kun Mesopotamia te thake, Judea aru Cappadocia, Pontus aru Asia te,

english_text: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
nagamese_text: Phrygia aru Pamphylia, Egypt aru Cyrene usorte Libya, aru Rome phale jai thaka manu khan,

english_text: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
nagamese_text: aru Yehudi aru proselyte khan, Crete manu khan aru Arab manu khan, taikhan Isor laga dangor aru asurit kaam kora to amikhan laga bhasa pora koi thaka to hunise.”

english_text: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob asurit pora bhabona kori kene, aru ekjon-ekjon ke koise, “Etu laga ki motlob ase?”

english_text: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra biswasi khan pora sorom khilai kene koise, “Taikhan nisa pani kori kene ase.”

english_text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter egaroh jon logote khara hoi kene jor pora taikhan ke koise, “Judea laga manu khan aru Jerusalem te thaka khan, apnikhan etu jani lobi, aru moi ki koi ase etu bhal kori kene huni lobi.

english_text: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu manu khan to apuni khan pora bhabona kora nisena nisa pani khai kene thaka nohoi, kelemane etiya phojur nou-baji he ase.

english_text: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
nagamese_text: Kintu etu kotha bhabobadi Joel pora koise:

english_text: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
nagamese_text: ‘Eneka hekh dinte hobo, Isor pora koise, Moi laga Atma sob manu uporte di dibo Tumikhan laga chokra chukri khan pora bhabobani koribo, Aru jawan manu khan darshan pabo, Aru bura manu khan sapna dikhibo.

english_text: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
nagamese_text: Aru Moi laga noukar aru mahila noukar khan uporte Moi laga Atma di dibo, aru taikhan bhabobani kobo.

english_text: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
nagamese_text: Moi akas Aru prithibi te asurit kaam dikhai dibo, Khun aru jui aru dhuwa laga bhap.

english_text: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
nagamese_text: Titia suryo to andhera hoi jabo Aru chand to khun nisena dikhibo, Probhu laga dangor mohima din naha age te eitu khan sob hobo.

english_text: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
nagamese_text: Aru jun manu hekh homoi tak Probhu laga naam loi kene thake tai bachi jabo.’

english_text: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
nagamese_text: Israel laga manu khan, etu kotha huni bhi, Nazareth Jisu eneka manu thakise junke Isor pora tumikhan nimite pathai dise dangor aru asurit kaam kori bole nimite, aru etu sob Isor pora Probhu Jisu ke loi kene korise, aru etu sob tumikhan pora dikhise.

english_text: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
nagamese_text: Tai Jisu to, Isor pora kineka age pora bhabona korise aru tai laga gyaan pora, Jisu ke biya manu hathte di dise, aru tumikhan Taike gojal mari kene ekta Cross te morai dise.

english_text: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
nagamese_text: Tai ekjon ase junke Isor mora pora jinda kori dise, mora pora taike chari dise, kelemane Taike mora pora aru bandhi rakhibole para nai.

english_text: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
nagamese_text: Kelemane David Tai nimite koise, ‘Moi Probhu ke hodai moi laga chehera usorte dikhe, Tai moi laga dyna hathte thake, moi biya rasta te najabo nimite.

english_text: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, moi laga mon khushi ase aru moi laga jiba pora dhanyavad kore. Aru, moi laga gaw bhi biswas te jinda thakibo.

english_text: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Apuni moi laga jibon Hades te chari nadibo, Aru Apuni laga Pobitro Jonke puchibo nadibo.

english_text: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
nagamese_text: Apuni moike jibon laga rasta dikhai dise; Aru apuni laga usorte moike khushi pora bhorta kori dibo.’

english_text: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi apuni khan ke etu kobole pari ase ki amikhan laga purush-Baba David pora ki kaam korise, aru tai morise aru taike kobor dise, aru tai laga kobor aji tak amikhan logote ase.

english_text: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, tai ekjon bhabobadi thakise aru jani thakise Isor tai logote kosom khaise, tai laga khandan pora ekjon ulabo aru uthaikene Tai laga singhason te bohai dibo.

english_text: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
nagamese_text: Aru aha dinte ki hobole ase etu sob to dikhi kene, tai Khrista mora pora jinda huwa laga kotha koise, ‘Taike Hades te bhi chari diya nai, aru Tai laga gaw bhi puchi janai.’

english_text: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
nagamese_text: Jisu ke Isor he jinda kori dise, aru amikhan sob Jisu jee-utha laga gawahi ase.

english_text: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Taike Isor laga dyna hathte bohai kene uthai dise aru Baba Isor pora Tai laga Pobitro Atma amikhan uporte di dise, juntu apnikhan dikhi ase aru huni bole pari ase.

english_text: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand
nagamese_text: Kelemane David to sorgote uthai loi juwa nai, kintu tai nije koise, ‘Probhu he moi laga Probhu ke koise, “Ami laga dyna hathte bohibi,

english_text: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
nagamese_text: Jitia tak tumi laga dushman khan ke tumi laga theng rakha jaga bonai nadiye.’”

english_text: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Israel te jiman ghor ase etu jani lobi, Isor pora Taike Probhu aru Khrista bonai dise, etu Jisu, junke tumikhan Cross te morai dise.”

english_text: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
nagamese_text: Jitia etu kotha hunise, taikhan monte jokhom paise, aru Peter aru ta te thaka apostle khan ke koise, “Bhai khan, amikhan ki koribo?”

english_text: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter taikhan ke jowab dise, “Mon ghura bhi, moi koi ase, aru baptizma koribi, sob manu, Jisu Khrista naam pora, nijor laga paap nimite, titia tumikhan Pobitro Atma laga inam pabo.

english_text: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu Isor laga kosom apuni aru apuni khan laga bacha khan nimite ase, aru Probhu Isor pora junke matibo, taikhan nimite bhi ase.”

english_text: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
nagamese_text: Tai aru bisi kotha pora gawahi dikena taikhan ke samjai se, aru koise, “Nijorke biya manu khan pora bachai rakhibi.”

english_text: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan sob huni kene baptizma loise, aru tin hajar jon thaka biswasi khan logote aru bhi ginti kori loise.

english_text: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan apostle khan pora ki sikhai dise etu kotha khan koi jai thakise aru ekjon-ekjon logote girja kori thakise, aru roti bhangai kene prathana te thakise.

english_text: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
nagamese_text: Aru sob logote bhoi ahi jaise, aru apostle khan dwara asurit kaam korise.

english_text: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
nagamese_text: Aru biswasi khan logote mili kene thakise, aru sob kaam mili kene kori thakise.

english_text: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan nijor dhun-sampoti aru saman sob bikiri kori kene kunke lage taikhan ke bhag kori dise.

english_text: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
nagamese_text: Aru hodai din ekta bhabona loi kene mondoli te kaam kore, aru ekjon-ekjon logote khushi aru mon sapha pora ghor te roti bhangai kene,

english_text: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
nagamese_text: aru hodai Isor ke dhanyavad kori kene, aru sob logot pora morom paikene thakise. Aru hodai jiman Probhu logot biswas kori loi, taikhan majote ginti hoi thakise.

english_text: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
nagamese_text: Ek din, tin baji homoi te, Peter aru John prathana kori bole mondoli te jai thakise.

english_text: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
nagamese_text: Titia ta te ekjon manu ama laga pet pora bera bole napara thakise, aru manu khan pora hodai taike bukhi kene mondoli laga dorja Sundur koi kene mata jagate rakhi diye, taike mondoli te aha manu khan pora poisa mangibo nimite.

english_text: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
nagamese_text: Tai kitia Peter aru John ke mondoli bhitor te jai thaka dikhise, taikhan ke poisa mangise.

english_text: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter aru John taike bhal kori saise aru koise, “Amikhan phale sabi.”

english_text: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
nagamese_text: Titia etu bera bole napara manu taikhan ke saise, aru bhabise kiba taikhan pora pabo.

english_text: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter koise, “Suna aru chandi moi logot nai, kintu ki moi logot ase, etu moi tumike dibo. Nazareth laga Jisu Khrista naam pora koi ase, uthi kene berabi.”

english_text: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
nagamese_text: Aru Peter tai laga dyna hath dhori kene khara kori bole dise, aru etu homoi te theng laga hardi khan te takot ahi jaise.

english_text: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
nagamese_text: Titia etu manu khara hoi kene bera bole shuru hoise; aru taikhan logote mondoli bhitor te jaise, kudi kene aru berai kene Isor ke dhanyavad dise.

english_text: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
nagamese_text: Aru sob manu taike berai kene Isor ke dhanyavad kora dikhise.

english_text: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
nagamese_text: Aru manu khan taike dikhi kene jani loise tai kun ase, tai jun mondoli laga Sundur dorjate bhik mangi thake; aru tai logot ki hoise etu dikhi kene taikhan bisi asurit hoi jaise.

english_text: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
nagamese_text: Aru tai Peter aru John logote jai thaka karone, sob manu polai ahi kene Solomon laga veranda kowa jagate joma hoise aru taikhan bisi asurit pora sai thakise.

english_text: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
nagamese_text: Jitia Peter etu dikhise, tai manu khan ke koise, “Israel laga manu khan, etu dikhi kene kele iman asurit lagi ase? Aru kele amikhan ke eneka sai ase, amikhan laga hokti pora nohoile amikhan bisi bhal manu huwa pora taike berabo paribole diya nisena?

english_text: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
nagamese_text: Abraham laga Isor, Isaac aru Jacob laga Isor, amikhan baba khan laga Isor, Tai laga noukar Jisu ke mohima kori dise, tumikhan taike swekar kora nai aru Pilate laga hathte di dise, jitia Pilate pora Jisu ke chari dibo koise etu bhi tumikhan mana nai.

english_text: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Pobitro aru dhormik ekjon ke luwa nai, aru manu morai diya ekjon ke chari dibole binti korise.

english_text: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jibon diya ke morai dise, junke Isor he mora pora aru jinda kori dise- aru amikhan utu laga sakhi ase.

english_text: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
nagamese_text: Etiya, Jisu laga naam te aru biswas pora apnikhan junke dikhi ase taike takot kori dise. Jisu laga naam te aru Tai dwara thaka biswas pora etu manu ke apuni khan sob usorte pura bhal kori dise.

english_text: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bhai khan, moi jane apuni khan najani kene kori dise, aru tumikhan laga cholawta khan bhi eneka korise.

english_text: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
nagamese_text: Kintu ji kotha Isor he tai laga bhabobadi khan mukh pora koi dise, Tai laga Khrista dukh pabo, aru Tai etu purah kori dise.

english_text: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,
nagamese_text: Mon ghura bhi, aru, titia nijor paap pora maph pabo,

english_text: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,
nagamese_text: Probhu laga asirbad apuni khan logote notun kori kene ahibo; aru Tai apuni khan nimite basi kene rakhi diya ekjon, Jisu Khrista ke pathai dibo.

english_text: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
nagamese_text: Taike sorgote loi najabo jitia tak sob kaam pura nohoi, aru ji kotha Isor pora Tai laga pobitro bhabobadi khan laga mukh pora koi disele etu pura nohua tak.

english_text: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
nagamese_text: Moses pora amikhan baba laga baba khan ke koise, ‘Probhu Isor pora tumikhan nimite bhai khan majot pora moi nisena ekjon bhabobadi ulai dibo, aru tai ki kotha kobo etu tumikhan sob hunibo.

english_text: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
nagamese_text: Aru kun etu bhabobadi laga kotha nahunibo, etu bhabobadi pora taike manu laga majot pora khotom kori dibo.’

english_text: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.
nagamese_text: Aru Samuel pora loi kene jiman bhabobadi khan tai pichete ahise, taikhan sob pora etu din laga kotha he koise.

english_text: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’
nagamese_text: Apuni khan bhabobadi khan laga bacha khan ase, aru Isor pora apnikhan laga baba khan logote kowa nisena, Abraham ke koise, ‘Aru tumi laga bijon pora duniya te sob parivar asishit hobo.’

english_text: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”
nagamese_text: Jitia Isor pora Tai laga noukar ke mora pora jinda kori dise, Tai pora Taike tumikhan usorte poila pathai dise, tumikhan laga biya kaam pora ghurai kene loi anibo aru asirbad dibo nimite.”

english_text: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
nagamese_text: Jitia Peter aru John duijon pora manu khan logote kotha kori thakise, purohit khan aru mondoli laga henedhikari khan aru kunba sadducee khan taikhan duijon logot te ahise.

english_text: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
nagamese_text: Taikhan bisi chinta hoi jaise, kelemane Peter aru John duijon to Jisu mora pora jinda uthijaise koi kene manu khan ke sikhai thakise.

english_text: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan duijon ke dhori kene dusra din phojur tak bondhi ghor te rakhidise, kelemane saam hoija karone.

english_text: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
nagamese_text: Kintu jiman manu etu kotha hunise taikhan Jisu ke biswas korise; aru biswas kora manu khan sob milai kene panch hajar nisena hoi jaise.

english_text: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra dinte cholawta aru bura manu khan aru niyom likha khan sob Jerusalem te joma hoise.

english_text: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
nagamese_text: Aru Annas moha purohit bhi ta te thakise, aru Caiaphas, John aru Alexandra aru jiman dangor purohit sob joma hoise.

english_text: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Peter aru John ke taikhan laga majote rakhise, taikhan ke hudise, “Kun laga takot aru kun laga naam pora tumikhan etu korise?”

english_text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,
nagamese_text: Titia Peter, Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi kene, taikhan ke koise, “Apuni cholawta khan, aru bura manu khan,

english_text: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
nagamese_text: amikhan ke ekta bemar manu ke bhal kaam kori diya nimite hudi ase koile, kineka kori kene tai bhal hoise?

english_text: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan aru Israel laga manu sob pora jani lobi, Nazareth Jisu Khrista naam pora, kunke tumikhan Cross te morai dise, kintu mora pora Taike Isor jinda kori dise, Tai laga naam pora etu manu bhal hoi kene tumikhan usorte khara ase.

english_text: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista etu pathor ase junke apuni khan pora phelai dise, ghor bona manu khan, kintu etu pathor he sob pora bhal aru kaam laga pathor hoi jaise.

english_text: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
nagamese_text: Aru Tai nohoile dusra kun bhi poritran dibole na paribo, kelemane sorgo laga nichete kun bhi eneka nai amikhan laga paap pora mukti dibole nimite.”

english_text: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Peter aru John laga mon dangor dikhise, aru taikhan likha pora manu nohoi koi kene janise, taikhan asurit lagise, aru titia taikhan Jisu logote thakise koi kene chini bole parise.

english_text: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan dikhise bhal hoi juwa manu tai duijon logote khara hoi thakise, aru taikhan eku bhi kobo para nai.

english_text: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia apostle khan ke sabha laga bahar te pathai dise, taikhan nijor majot te kotha patise.

english_text: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
nagamese_text: Taikhan majot te eneka hudi thakise, “Amikhan etu duijon ke ki kori dile bhal hobo? Kelemane tai duijon pora asurit kaam kori diya to Jerusalem te thaka sob jani jaise, aru amikhan etu mana koribo na paribo.

english_text: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
nagamese_text: Kintu etu kotha dusra jagate bisi najabo nimite, amikhan tai duijon ke koi dibo etu naam loi kene dusra ke aru nahikabole.”

english_text: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan Peter aru John ke mati kene anise aru Jisu laga naam te nashika bole hukum dise.

english_text: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter aru John taikhan ke koise, “Isor laga kotha huna to thik ase na apnikhan laga kotha mana to thik ase, etu apnikhan bhabi sabi.

english_text: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan ki dikhise aru hunise etu nokoi kene thaki bole na paribo.”

english_text: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter aru John ke dhomki dikene jabole dise, kelemane manu khan tai duijon laga asurit kaam to dikhi kene Isor ke dhanyavad di thakise aru tai duijon ke sajai dibole eku golti taikhan dikha nai.

english_text: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
nagamese_text: Kelemane junke asurit pora changai kori dise etu manu chalis saal pora dangor thakise.

english_text: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai duijon ke chari dise, Peter aru John nijor manu khan logote jai kene maha purohit khan aru cholawta khan pora ki koise etu taikhan ke koi dise.

english_text: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan sob awaj uthaikene eke logote Isor ke prathana korise, “Probhu, apuni sorgo aru prithibi bonaise aru samundar te ki ase sob bonai diya Probhu Isor hoi.

english_text: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
nagamese_text: Apuni ekjon ase jun he Pobitro Atma pora Apuni laga noukar laga mukh pora koise, moi khan laga baba David, ‘Ki nimite Porjati manu khan khong uthise, Aru manu khan misa kotha khan kele bhabi thake?’

english_text: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
nagamese_text: ‘Prithibi laga raja khan uthi khara hoise, Aru cholawta khan eke logote joma hoise, Probhu laga bhirodh te aru Khrista laga bhirodh te.’

english_text: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,
nagamese_text: Hosa pora, Herod aru Pontius Pilate, dusra jati aru Israel laga manu khan, sob eke logote joma hoi kene Apuni laga pobitro noukar junke Apuni asirbad korise taike manu khan pora hinsa korise.

english_text: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan sob joma korise aru Apuni laga hath pora ki kori bole itcha asele etu sob poila pora hobo koi kene thakise.

english_text: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
nagamese_text: Etiya, Probhu, taikhan laga dhomki ke sabi, aru Apuni laga noukar laga mon dangor kori dibi Apuni laga kotha bhoi nakorikena kobole nimite.

english_text: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone Apuni laga hath changai kori bole nimite khuli dibi, aru Apuni laga pobitro noukar Jisu laga naam te asurit kaam kori bole nimite.”

english_text: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan prathana kori khotom hoise taikhan jun jagate thakise etu hili bole shuru hoise, aru taikhan sob Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi jaise, aru taikhan bhoi nakori kene Isor laga kotha manu khan ke koise.

english_text: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
nagamese_text: Aru jiman manu biswas te joma hoi thakise taikhan sob mon aru bhabona sob eke hoi thakise, aru kun pora bhi nijor laga dhun sompoti etu moi laga ase koi kene kowa nai kintu ekjon-ekjon logote bhag korise.

english_text: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
nagamese_text: Aru apostle khan dangor takot pora, Probhu Jisu jinda hoise koi kene gawahi di thakise, aru taikhan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakise.

english_text: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan majote kun bhi dukh nathaka hoise, kelemane kun logote kheti, ghor aru saman ase, tai etu sob bikiri kori kene etu laga daam ani di thakise.

english_text: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
nagamese_text: Aru apostle khan laga theng nichete ani kene rakhi diye, aru taikhan kunke ki dorkar ase etu saikene bhag kori diye.

english_text: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
nagamese_text: Titia Joseph, taike Barnabas koi kene apostle khan pora mate -Mon Dangor Kori Diya Putro bhi mate-, ekjon Levite, jonom pora Cyprus majuli laga manu,

english_text: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
nagamese_text: tai laga ekta kheti thakise etu bikiri kori kene poisa anise aru apostle khan laga theng te rakhidise.

english_text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
nagamese_text: Etiya ekjon manu Ananias, aru tai laga maiki Sapphira duijon mili kene chutu ekta mati bikiri korise,

english_text: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga maiki logote kotha milai kene adha poisa rakhi loise, aru adha poisa jai kene apostle khan laga theng te rakhidise.

english_text: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter koise, “Ananias, kele Saitan pora tumi laga mon to Pobitro Atma ke misa kobole bhorta kori dise aru ki bhikai se etu laga adha daam tumi kele loi rakhise?

english_text: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
nagamese_text: Jitia mati tumi logote bikiri nohoi kene thakise, titia mati to tumi laga he thakise nohoi, aru jitia bikiri hoi jaise, tumi jani kene bikiri kora nohoi? Tumi laga monte kineka etu bhabise? Tumi manu ke misa kowa nai, kintu Isor ke he misa koi ase.”

english_text: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
nagamese_text: Jitia Ananias etu kotha hunise, tai giri kene ta te mori jaise, aru jun etu kotha hunise sob bhoi lagi jaise.

english_text: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
nagamese_text: Aru taike uthaikene jawan khan ahi kene kapra pora bandhi dise, aru loijai kene, matite hali dise.

english_text: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
nagamese_text: Aru tin ghanta pichete, tai laga maiki ahise, hoilebi tai to ki hoise etu najani kene thakise.

english_text: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
nagamese_text: Titia Peter taike jawab dise, “Amike kobi, tumi etu mati iman pora bikiri korise na nohoi.” Titia tai koise “Hoi, iman pora he bikiri korise.”

english_text: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
nagamese_text: Titia Peter taike koise, “Tumi duijon mili kene Isor laga Atma ke porikha kori bole kene bhabise? Sabi, tumi laga mota ke matite hali diya manu khan dorja usorte khara kori ase, aru tumike bhi uthai loijabo.”

english_text: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
nagamese_text: Titia tai etu homoi te Peter laga theng nichete giri kene mori jaise, aru jitia jawan khan bhitor te ahise, taike mora paise, aru bahar te loijai kene tai laga mota usorte dabai dise.

english_text: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
nagamese_text: Aru jiman manu girja te thakise aru etu kotha hunise, taikhan sob bisi bhoi lagi jaise.

english_text: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
nagamese_text: Aru apostle khan laga hath pora chihna kaam manu usorte bisi kori thakise, aru biswasi khan sob eke mon hoi kene Solomon laga Veranda te joma hoise.

english_text: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan logote abiswasi khan to kaam kori bole mon dangor thaka nai; hoilebi manu khan pora taikhan ke bisi sonman di thakise.

english_text: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
nagamese_text: Probhu laga naam te mota aru mahila khan bisi joma hoise, aru biswas khan logot mili kene ekta mon pora kaam korise,

english_text: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
nagamese_text: etu karone manu khan bisna uthaikene bemar manu ke rasta te loijai kene rakhidise, jitia Peter ta te ahibo, tai laga chaya bemar manu khan uporte lagi kene changai pai jabo.

english_text: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
nagamese_text: Aru Jerusalem usorte thaka nagar khan pora manu khan bemar aru biya atma pora dukh di thaka khan loi ani joma kori dise, aru sob manu jiman ahise bhal hoi jaise.

english_text: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy
nagamese_text: Kintu maha purohit khara hoi jaise, aru jun manu tai logote thakise taikhan bhi uthijaise - Sadducee khan laga ekta dol-; aru taikhan etu saikene jolon hoise

english_text: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
nagamese_text: aru apostle khan ke dhori kene bondhi ghor te rakhidise.

english_text: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
nagamese_text: Kintu etu rati te Probhu laga sorgodoth ahi kene bondhi ghor laga dorja khuli dise, aru taikhan ke bahar ulai dise, aru koise,

english_text: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
nagamese_text: “Jabi aru khara kori kene mondoli bhitor te jiman manu ase taikhan ke jibon laga kotha koi dibi.”

english_text: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan etu hunise, taikhan phojurte mondoli bhitor te jai kene sikhaise. Kintu maha purohit aru jiman manu tai logote thakise taikhan bhi ahise, aru Israel laga bacha khan laga dangor chokra khan ke sabha te eke logote matise, aru bondhi ghor pora apostle khan ke loi anibole nimite pathaise.

english_text: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia daruga khan bondhi ghor te jaise, taikhan ke pa-a nai, titia taikhan wapas jai kene khobor dise.

english_text: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
nagamese_text: Koise, “Amikhan jai kene saise, bondhi ghor bahar te sipahi khan bhi ta te khara kori thakise, kintu jitia amikhan Khuli Kena bhitor te jaise, ta te kunke bhi panai.”

english_text: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
nagamese_text: Jitia mondoli laga cholawta aru moha purohit khan etu kotha hunise, taikhan asurit hoise, aru bhabise etu kineka hoi jaise.

english_text: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
nagamese_text: Titia kunba ahi kene taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, apnikhan kunke bondhi ghor te hali dise, taikhan to mondoli te khara kori kene manu khan ke sikhai ase.”

english_text: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
nagamese_text: Titia cholawta aru daruga khan jaise, aru taikhan ke loi anise, kintu taikhan eku kora nai, kelemane manu khan pora taikhan ke pathor maribo jodi taikhan pora apostle khan ke dukh dise koile.

english_text: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan ke anise, sabha usorte khara kori bole dise. Titia maha purohit pora taikhan ke hudise,

english_text: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Amikhan koi dise apuni khan etu naam loi kene nasikhabi, kintu, tumikhan Jerusalem to pura tumikhan laga kotha pora bhorta kori dise, aru etu manu laga khun moi khan uporte hali bole bisari ase.”

english_text: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter aru apostle khan koise, “Manu laga kotha huna pora to amikhan Isor laga kotha he poila manibo lage.

english_text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga baba khan laga Isor he Jisu ke jinda kori dise, junke apnikhan khuri te latkai kene morai dise.

english_text: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
nagamese_text: Isor he Taike Probhu aru Tran-Korta bonai kene Tai laga dyna hathte rakhi loise, aru Israel manu khan ke notun jibon dibo aru paap pora mukti pabo.

english_text: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan etu kotha laga gawahi ase, aru Isor Tai laga kotha mani thaka khan ke dibole Pobitro Atma bhi etu kotha laga sakhi ase.

english_text: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
nagamese_text: Jitia sabhakhan etu kotha hunise, taikhan bisi khong uthise, aru apostle khan ke morai dibole mon hoise.”

english_text: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
nagamese_text: Kintu sabha te ekjon Pharisee thakise, tai laga naam Gamaliel thakise, ekjon niyom jana manu, aru sob manu pora taike adar kore, tai khara kori kene apostle khan ke olop deri nimite bahar te loi jabole koise.

english_text: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ke koise, “Israel laga manu, moi ki koi ase etu bhal pora huni bhi aru tumikhan etu manu khan logote ki kori bole lage.

english_text: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
nagamese_text: Kelemane bisi sal age te, Theudas uthi kene tai kunba ekjon ase koise, aru charsoh nisena manu tai laga pichete jaise, taike morai dise, aru jun manu tai laga pichete jai thakise taikhan bhi sob alag-alag hoi jaise.

english_text: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete Galilee pora Judas koi kene ekjon uthise, tai bhi manu khan ke chela bonai loise le, kintu tai bhi harai jaise, aru jiman taike mani thakise taikhan sob alag-alag hoi jaise.

english_text: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
nagamese_text: Etiya moi apnikhan ke koi ase, eitu khan pora dur thakibi aru taikhan ke chari dibi, kelemane jodi etu dhorom aru kaam to manu pora ase koile, taikhan bhi khotom hoi jabo.

english_text: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi Isor pora ase koile, tumikhan taikhan ke kitia bhi hata bona paribo; aru tumikhan nijor Isor logote lorai kori thaka nisena hobo.”

english_text: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan apostle khan ke matise aru mari kene taikhan ke Jisu laga naam aru nolobole koise, aru jabole dise.

english_text: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sabha pora ulai jaise aru Jisu laga naam nimite, dukh paise koi kene khushi pora jaise.

english_text: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
nagamese_text: Aru etu pichete, mondoli te bhi aru ghor-ghor te jai kene Jisu Khrista laga susamachar manu khan ke prochar kori thakise.

english_text: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
nagamese_text: Aru etu dinte, jitia chela khan bisi hoi thakise, titia Yunani khan, Yehudi khan ke bhirodh kori thakise, kelemane mota morija maiki khan ke kha luwa bhag kora homoi te hisab nakore koi kene taikhan biya pai thakise.

english_text: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
nagamese_text: Titia baroh ta chela khan pora taikhan pichete aha khan ke koise, “Etu amikhan nimite thik nohoi Isor laga kotha chari kene kha luwa laga bhag kori thaki te jabo nalage.

english_text: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
nagamese_text: Etu karone bhai khan, apnikhan majote sat jon bhal manu khan ke basi lobi, Pobitro Atma aru gyaan thaka, junke amikhan etu kaam nimite basi lobo.

english_text: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan hodai prathana kori thakibo aru Isor laga kotha aru kaam te age jai thakibo.”

english_text: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga kotha sob manu khan pora bhal paise. Aru taikhan Stephen ke basi loise jun dhormik aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta thakise, aru Philip, aru Prochorus, aru Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, aru Nicolaus, Yehudi niyom mani thaka Antioch pora aha ekjon.

english_text: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ke apostle usorte anise, aru apostle khan pora hath dikene taikhan uporte prathana kori dise.

english_text: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
nagamese_text: Titia Isor laga kotha khuli prochar hoi jaise, aru biswasi khan bisi-bisi hoi thakise aru Jerusalem te purohit khan bhi bisi manu biswasi khan logot mili jaise.

english_text: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
nagamese_text: Etiya Stephen pura takot aru anugrah te bhorta hoi kene manu usorte dangor asurit kaam kori thakise.

english_text: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
nagamese_text: Kintu mondoli te Freedmen koi kene kunba uthise, aru Cyrenia aru Alexandria manu, aru Cilicia aru Asia pora kunba ahi kene Stephen logote kotha pora lagi jaise.

english_text: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan Stephen to gyaan aru Pobitro Atma pora kotha kowa dikhi kene tai uporte jiti bole para nai.

english_text: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan poisa dikene manu khan ke kobole koise, “Amikhan Stephen pora Moses aru Isor laga biya kotha koi thaka hunise.”

english_text: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan pora bura khan aru niyom likha khan laga mon ulta kori dise aru Stephen ke dhurikena taike sabha usorte tani kene loi anise.

english_text: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
nagamese_text: Taikhan misa gawahi diya manu bhi loi anise, aru koise, “Etu manu to amikhan laga pobitro jaga aru niyom laga bhirodh te biya kotha kobole narukhe.

english_text: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan tai pora etu kowa hunise, Nazareth laga Jisu pora etu jaga khotom kori dibo, aru Moses ki niyom amikhan ke dise etu sob bodli kori dibo.”

english_text: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
nagamese_text: Aru jiman manu sabha te bohi thakise sob Stephen ke he saise, aru tai laga chehera to sorgodoth laga chehera nisena dikhise.

english_text: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
nagamese_text: Titia maha purohit pora hudise, “Etu kotha khan hosa ase?

english_text: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
nagamese_text: Titia Stephen koise, “Bhai khan aru baba khan, moi laga kotha huni bhi: Isor laga mohima baba Abraham logote ahise jitia tai Mesopotamia te thakise, tai Haran te nathaka age pora;

english_text: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
nagamese_text: aru taike koise, ‘Tumi laga mati aru ghor manu khan pora ulai jabi, aru moi jun jaga tumike dikha bo ta te jabi.’

english_text: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.
nagamese_text: Titia Abraham pora Chaldea laga desh chari kene Haran te thaki jaise; aru tai laga baba mora pichete, Isor pora taike etu jagate loi anise, jun jagate tumikhan etiya thaki ase.

english_text: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai taike etu jaga diya nai, tai laga theng rakhibole bhi diya nai. Kintu Isor pora taike aru tai laga khandan ke, ekta jaga dibo koi kene kosom dise, tai laga bacha nathaka hoilebi.

english_text: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor pora taike eneka koise, tai laga khandan khan dusra desh te alag manu hoi kene thakibo, aru etu jaga laga manu khan taikhan ke nokor bonai rakhibo aru charsoh saal tak bisi dukh dibo.

english_text: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’
nagamese_text: ‘Aru,’ Isor koise, ‘jun jati taikhan ke nokor banabo, utu jati khan ke moi bisar koribo, titia taikhan ulai ahi kene moike etu jagate mohima koribo.’

english_text: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
nagamese_text: Titia Isor pora Abraham ke sunnot laga kosom dise, titia Abraham, Isaac laga baba hoise aru ath-dinte Isaac ke sunnot korise; aru Isaac pora Jacob laga baba hoise, aru Jacob pora baroh ta bacha paise aru etu khandan laga baba hoise.

english_text: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
