nagamese_text: Kintu Joseph laga bhai khan tai uporte ke suku jolise, aru taike Egypt te bikiri kori dise; kintu Isor tai logote thakise.

english_text: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
nagamese_text: Aru Isor pora tai laga dukh sob pora bachai loise. Tai laga gyaan pora Egypt raja Pharaoh laga mon jiti loise, aru raja pora taike Egypt aru tai laga ghor uporte Governor bonai dise.

english_text: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
nagamese_text: Titia Egypt aru Canaan desh te akaal ahise, aru bisi dukh paise, aru amikhan laga baba khan khabole panai.

english_text: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Jacob hunise Egypt te dhaan ase koi kene, tai amikhan laga baba khan ke ta te pathaise.

english_text: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra bar Joseph nijor bhai khan ke tai kun ase utu janibole dise, aru Pharaoh bhi Joseph laga ghor manu khan ke jani loise.

english_text: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
nagamese_text: Titia Joseph tai laga kokai khan logote manu pathai kene Jacob aru tai logote pachatar jonke loi kene Egypt te anibole pothaise.

english_text: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
nagamese_text: Titia Jacob Egypt te jaise, Jacob aru amikhan laga baba khan sob ta te morise.

english_text: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan laga mora gaw to Shechem te loijai kene kote Abraham pora Hamor bacha khan logote poisa dikene mati kini rakhise ta te kobor dise.

english_text: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
nagamese_text: Jitia Isor pora Abraham logote kosom khai kene rakha homoi ahise- etu kosom juntu Isor he Abraham logote korise- Egypt te manu bisi hoi jaise.

english_text: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.
nagamese_text: Joseph ke najana ekjon raja Egypt te ulaise.

english_text: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
nagamese_text: Tai amikhan laga manu ke thogai dise, aru jiman notun jonom huwa bacha khan ase taikhan ke ulai anibole koise ta te taikhan eitu khan ke jinda thaki bole nadibo.

english_text: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te Moses jonom hoise; tai Isor nimite bisi sundur thakise, aru taike tin mohina tak tai baba ghor te rakhise.

english_text: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia taike bahar te rakhise, Pharaoh laga swali pora taike loi kene nijor bacha nisena palise.

english_text: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
nagamese_text: Aru Moses ke Egypt laga gyaan aru niyom sob sikhai dise, aru tai kotha aru kaam te bhi bisi takot thakise.

english_text: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia tai chalis saal hoi jaise, tai nijor Israel bhai khan ke lok kori bole mon korise.

english_text: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
nagamese_text: Aru ek din, jitia Israel manu ekjon ke dukh pai thaka dikhise, Moses etu manu ke modot kori bole jaise, aru etu dikhi kene Moses pora etu Egypt manu ke morai dise.

english_text: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
nagamese_text: Tai bhabisele, tai laga bhai khan bujhi bo paribo, Isor he taikhan ke bachai dibo nimite taike pathaise, kintu taikhan etu bujhi bo para nai.

english_text: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
nagamese_text: Aru dusra dinte duijon Israel manu jhagara kori thaka homoi te tai ponchise, aru ekjon-ekjon logote shanti rakhibole koise, ‘Bhai khan, kele nijor bhai kokai majote jhagara kori ase?’

english_text: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
nagamese_text: Kintu jun tai usorte manu logot jhagara kori thakise, Moses ke pichete dhakai kene, koise, ‘Tumike kun pora amikhan uporte hukum chola bole dise?

english_text: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
nagamese_text: Juwa kali ekjon Egypt manu ke morai diya nisena, moike bhi mora bole mon ase?’

english_text: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha huni kene Moses polai jaise, aru Median laga desh te alag desh manu hoi kene thaki jaise, aru ta te tai duita chokra bacha laga baba hoi jaise.

english_text: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia chalis saal paar hoi jaise, Probhu laga sorgodoth Sinai Pahar laga jongol te jui nisena kori kene tai usorte ahise.

english_text: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,
nagamese_text: Jitia Moses jui dikhise, tai etu dikhi kene bisi asurit hoise, aru usor pora sabole jaise, titia Probhu laga awaj hunise.

english_text: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.
nagamese_text: ‘Moi tumi laga baba khan laga Isor ase, Abraham, Isaac aru Jacob laga Isor.’ Titia Moses kapi kene bhoi pora ta te phale sabole para nai.

english_text: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
nagamese_text: Titia Probhu taike koise, ‘Tumi laga theng pora juta ulai rakhi dibi, kelemane kuntu jagate tumi khara ase etu jaga Pobitro ase.

english_text: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
nagamese_text: Ami laga manu khan Egypt te dukh kori thaka Moi dikhise, aru taikhan kandi thaka awaj hunise, aru taikhan ke bacha bole nimite Moi ahise; etu karone ahibi, Moi tumike Egypt te pathabo.’

english_text: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
nagamese_text: Etu Moses, junke Israel manu khan pora grohon kora nai, tai koise, ‘Kun he tumike moi khan uporte cholawta koribo dise?’- Tai ekjon thakise junke Isor pora cholawta bonaise aru bachai dibole nimite pathaise- aru sorgodoth hath pora Moses ke jongol te dikhai dise.

english_text: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
nagamese_text: Moses pora he Egypt pora taikhan ke ulai anise, aru sob asurit kaam khan Egypt laga matite dikhai thakise aru Ghar laga Samundar te, aru jongol majot pora taikhan ke chalis saal tak cholai kene loi jaise.

english_text: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
nagamese_text: Etu Moses he ase, jun Israel khan ke koise, ‘Isor pora tumikhan nimite tumikhan laga bhai kokai khan majot pora ekjon moi nisena bhabobadi ulai dibo.’

english_text: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
nagamese_text: Etu tai ase, jongol te thaka homoi te, Sinai Pahar te sorgodoth logot kotha korise, aru kun amikhan baba laga baba khan logot asele, aru utu tai ase jun pora jinda kotha paikene amikhan ke ponchai dise.

english_text: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
nagamese_text: Etu manu laga kotha moi khan laga baba laga baba khan mani bole mon kora nai, kintu taike hatai dise, aru taikhan laga mon Egypt phale jai jaise.

english_text: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
nagamese_text: Aru Aaron koise, ‘Amikhan nimite murti khan bonai dibi jun amikhan ke loi kene age jabo. Aru etu Moses, jun he amikhan ke Egypt pora loi anise, taike ki hoise amikhan najane.’

english_text: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan ekta goru bacha bonaise, aru hath pora bona laga murti ke kiba ani kene boli dise, aru khushi manai thakise.

english_text: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor taikhan ke chari kene akas aru tara khan ke puja kori bole dise, jineka bhabobadi khan laga kitab te likha ase, ‘Tumikhan moike janwar laga boli diya nai Chalis saal jongol te thaka homoi te, tumi Israel manu khan kotha manise?

english_text: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
nagamese_text: Apuni khan Molech laga tambu ke mani loise, Aru tumikhan laga bhagwan Rephan laga tara bhi, aru murti bonai kene puja kori bole loi jaise karone: Moi tumikhan ke Babylon pora bisi dur te loi rakhidibo.’

english_text: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
nagamese_text: Ami laga baba laga baba khan logot sakhi laga tambu ase, jineka taike dikhaise jongol te, tineka bona bole koise, aru thik tineka bonai loise.

english_text: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,
nagamese_text: Etu ase tombu ghor juntu amikhan baba khan pora paikene Joshua hath pora loi yate anise, jitia taikhan desh khan ke gheri loi kene kabja kori loise, jun khan Isor he amikhan laga baba khan usor pora khedai dise, aru David raja laga homoi tak thakise,

english_text: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
nagamese_text: jun Isor itcha te paise, tai mangise Jacob laga Isor ke thaki bole ekta jagah karone.

english_text: But Solomon built him a house.
nagamese_text: Kintu Solomon he Isor karone ekta ghor bonai dise.

english_text: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
nagamese_text: Kintu, Mohan Isor to manu pora bonai diya ghor te nathake, bhabobadi pora kowa nisena,

english_text: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
nagamese_text: ‘Sorgo to Ami laga singhason, aru prithibi Ami laga theng rakha jaga. Probhu koise, tumi Moi karone ghor bonai dibo? Aru Ami laga aram kora jaga to kote hobo?

english_text: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
nagamese_text: Moi he nijor hath pora etu sob bona nai naki?’

english_text: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan phutani aru mon aru kaan te sunnot nakora khan, tumikhan Pobitro Atma laga hinsa kori thake, tumikhan baba laga baba khan kori aha nisena, tineka apuni khan bhi kore.

english_text: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
nagamese_text: Eneka kun bhabobadi ase junke tumikhan laga baba pora dukh diya nai? Taikhan pora ahibole thaka Dharmik Jon Jisu laga kotha kowa manu khan ke bhi morai dise, aru tumikhan bhi morai diya aru thogai diya khan hoi jaise,

english_text: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
nagamese_text: Tumikhan sorgodoth khan pora diya Isor laga niyom luwa khan, hoilebi tumikhan manibo para nai.”

english_text: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu kotha hunise, sabha laga manu khan monte bisi khong hoise, aru dath kamuri kene Stephen uporte khong uthise.

english_text: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
nagamese_text: Kintu tai Pobitro Atma te bhorta hoi kene, sorgote saise, aru Isor laga mohima aru Jisu to Isor laga dyna hath phale khara thaka dikhi paise.

english_text: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
nagamese_text: Stephen pora hala kori kene koise, “Sabi, sorgo khuli thaka dikhi ase, aru Manu laga Putro Isor laga dyna hath phale khara kori ase.”

english_text: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan untcha awaj pora hala korise, aru kaan bondh kori kene sob eke logot tai usorte polai ahise.

english_text: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan taike sheher bahar te loijai kene taike pathor mari dise, aru gawahi khan taikhan laga kapra loise aru jawan manu ekjon naam Saul laga bhori te rakhise.

english_text: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan jitia Stephen ke pathor mari thakise, tai Isor ke mati kene koise, “Probhu Jisu, moi laga Atma loi lobi.”

english_text: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
nagamese_text: Titia tai athukarikena jor awaj pora koise, “Probhu, taikhan ke etu paap laga bisar nokoribi.” Etu koi kene tai ghumai jaise.

english_text: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
nagamese_text: Saul bhi Stephen ke morai dibole monjur korise, aru etu dinte Jerusalem te thaka girja te bisi dukh digdar ahise; aru sob biswasi khan Judea aru Samaria te alag-alag jai jaise, khali apostle khan he thakise.

english_text: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
nagamese_text: Biswasi manu khan pora Stephen laga gaw uthai loijai kene kobor dise, aru manu khan mon dukh korise.

english_text: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
nagamese_text: Kintu Saul girja khan ke biya kori bole kosis kori thakise; aru ghor-ghor te jai kene, mota aru maiki sobke dhori kene bondhi ghor te hali dise.

english_text: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
nagamese_text: Aru jun biswasi alag phale jai jaisele taikhan ja-a jaga sob te khushi laga khobor prochar kori thakise.

english_text: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
nagamese_text: Titia Philip Samaria sheher te jai kene manu khan ke Khrista laga kotha prochar kori dise.

english_text: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
nagamese_text: Aru Philip ki kotha prochar korise, taikhan mon dikene hunise, aru tai kori diya asurit kaam khan dikhise.

english_text: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
nagamese_text: Bisi manu bhitor te dusto atma khan thakise, aru eitu khan taikhan pora ulai jaise, jor pora hala kori kene. Bisi manu jothor aru lengra khan bhi changai paise.

english_text: There was great joy in that city.
nagamese_text: Aru etu sheher manu khan bisi khushi korise.

english_text: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
nagamese_text: Kintu ta te Simon koi kene ekjon manu thakise, tai jadu montor kori kene Samaria manu khan ke asurit kori dise, aru tai nijorke ekjon dangor manu ase koi thake.

english_text: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
nagamese_text: Aru sob Samaria manu chutu pora dangor tak tai laga kotha bhal pora huni thakise aru koise, “Etu manu logote Isor laga takot ase.”

english_text: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
nagamese_text: Tai laga kotha manu khan hune, kelemane bisi homoi pora tai jadu montor kori kene manu khan ke asurit kaam dikhai thakise, etu karone taikhan tai laga kotha mani thakise.

english_text: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia taikhan Philip ke biswas korise, aru tai Isor laga rajyo kotha aru Jisu Khrista laga naam ke prochar korise, bisi mota aru maiki khan baptizma loise.

english_text: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
nagamese_text: Titia Simon nijor bhi biswas korise, aru tai baptizma loi kene Philip logote thaki jaise, aru jitia asurit kaam khan kora dikhise, tai bisi khushi paise.

english_text: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
nagamese_text: Jitia Jerusalem te thaka apostle khan Samaria pora Isor kotha loise koi kene hunise, taikhan nimite Peter aru John ke pathaise.

english_text: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
nagamese_text: Jitia Peter aru John ta te punchise, taikhan nimite prathana korise, taikhan Pobitro Atma pabo nimite.

english_text: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Pobitro Atma taikhan logote aha nai, kintu taikhan Probhu Jisu naam pora khali baptizma he loi kene thaka karone.

english_text: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter aru John taikhan uporte hath rakhi kene prathana kori dise, aru taikhan Pobitro Atma paise.

english_text: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Simon dikhise apostle khan manu laga uporte hath rakhile Pobitro Atma pai ase, tai apostle khan ke poisa dibole bisarise.

english_text: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Moike bhi etu adhikar dibi, ta te moi jun uporte hath rakhibo tai Pobitro Atma pabo.”

english_text: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter taike koise, tumi laga poisa tumi logote khotom hoi jabo, kelemane tumi Isor laga bordan poisa pora kini bole bhabi ase.

english_text: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga yate eku bhag aru hisa nai, kelemane Probhu usorte tumi laga mon thik nohoi.

english_text: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite mon ghura bhi aru biya bhabona pora ulabi, aru Probhu usorte prathana koribi, titia Tai pora tumi laga letera mon aru biya bhabona pora maph kori dibo pare.

english_text: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi dikhi ase tumi laga biya bhabona aru paap pora bandi thaka mon to.”

english_text: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
nagamese_text: Titia Simon koise, “Probhu logot moi nimite prathana kori dibi, apuni pora ki koise etu moi uporte nahibole nimite.”

english_text: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Isor kotha koi dise aru sakhi korise, Peter aru John wapas Jerusalem te jaise, aru Samaria manu laga bosti khan te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise.

english_text: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
nagamese_text: Titia Probhu laga sorgodoth Philip logote kotha korise, aru koise, “Uthibi aru dakshin laga rasta jun to Jerusalem hoi kene Gaza te jai ta te jabi.”- Etu rasta balu laga jaga pora jai.

english_text: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
nagamese_text: Titia tai uthi kene jaise. Aru ta te Ethiopia laga ekjon hijira manu thakise, tai ekjon dangor adhikar chola manu thakise, tai Candace, Ethiopia laga rani laga dhun sampoti sa-a manu asele, aru tai mohima kori bole Jerusalem te jai thakise.

english_text: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga ghora gaari te bohi kene wapas ghor te jai thakise, aru Isaiah bhabobadi laga kitab porhi thakise.

english_text: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
nagamese_text: Titia Atma pora Philip ke koise, “Jai kene ghora gari usorte bohibi.”

english_text: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
nagamese_text: Titia Philip tai usorte polaikene jaise, aru Tai Isaiah bhabobadi laga kitab porhi thaka hunise, aru koise, “Tumi ki porhi ase etu bujhi pai ase?”

english_text: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
nagamese_text: Titia tai koise, “Moi kineka janibo, jitia tak moike kunba pora nashikai?” Titia tai Philip ke ghora gari te bohi bole matise.

english_text: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
nagamese_text: Etiya jun to kitab Ethiopia manu pora porhi thakise etu eneka thakise, “Taike ekta mer bolidan dibole nisena loi jaise, Aru jineka mer bacha pora chuli kata manu usorte chup-chap pora bohe, Etu nisena, aru Tai pora Tai laga mukh khula nai.

english_text: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
nagamese_text: Tai laga bisar sorom khilai dikene Tai usor pora loi jaise. Kun Tai laga manu khan ase koi kene kobo pare? Kelemane Tai laga jibon to etu duniya pora uthai loise.”

english_text: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
nagamese_text: Titia hijira pora Philip ke hudise, “Moi apuni ke anurodh kori ase, kun bhabobadi laga kotha koi ase, tai nijor laga koi ase, na dusra manu laga kotha koi ase?”

english_text: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
nagamese_text: Titia Philip tai mukh khuli se, aru Isor kotha pora shuru kori kene, Jisu laga kotha taike prochar korise.

english_text: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
nagamese_text: Taikhan rasta te jai thaka homoi te pani thaka jagah ponchise, titia hijira pora koise, “Sabi, yate pani ase, moike baptizma lobole nimite ki pora rukhai ase?’”

english_text: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
nagamese_text: Titia tai ghora gari ke rukhibole hukum dise. Aru Philip aru hijira duijon panite namikene jaise, aru Philip pora taike baptizma dise.

english_text: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan pani pora ulai ahise, Probhu laga Atma pora Philip ke loi jaise, titia hijira taike aru dikha nai, kintu tai bisi khushi pora jai jaise.

english_text: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
nagamese_text: Kintu Philip to Azotus te ahise, aru pura jagate tai jaise, jitia tak tai Caesarea puncha nai, tai sob sheher khan te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise.

english_text: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
nagamese_text: Kintu Saul, Probhu laga chela khan ke morai dibo koi kene kotha kori thakise aru tai moha purohit logote jaise

english_text: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: aru tai moha purohit logote chithi mangise Damascus sheher laga mondoli khan nimite, jodi tai rasta te jai thaka homoi te kunba manu pai, mota aru mahila hoilebi, eitu khan ke dhori kene Jerusalem te loi jabole.

english_text: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai safar te jai thakise, Damascus te punchibole usor huwa homoi te, achanak sorgo pora ujala hoi kene ekta puhor tai uporte jolise;

english_text: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
nagamese_text: aru titia tai matite giri jaise, aru ekta awaj taike koi thaka hunise, “Saul, Saul, kele tumi Moike dukh di ase?”

english_text: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
nagamese_text: Aru titia Saul hudise, “Apuni kun ase Probhu?” Aru Probhu jowab dise, “Moi Jisu ase junke tumi dukh di ase; pathor te theng marile nijor he jokhom pabo.”

english_text: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”
nagamese_text: Titia tai asurit hoise aru bhoi pora kapi kene koise, “Probhu moi ki kori bole lage?” Titia Probhu taike koise, “Uthibi aru Damascus sheher te jabi, aru tumi ki koribo lage etu sob tumike koi dibo.”

english_text: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
nagamese_text: Jun manu Saul logote jai thakise taikhan chup hoi jaise, taikhan awaj hunise, kintu kunke bhi dikha nai.

english_text: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
nagamese_text: Titia Saul khara hoise, aru jitia tai laga suku khuli se, tai eku bhi dikhi bole napara hoise; titia taikhan tai laga hath dhori kene Damascus te loi jaise.

english_text: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
nagamese_text: Aru tai tin din suku andha hoi jaise aru eku dikhi bole para nai, aru kha luwa bhi kora nai.

english_text: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
nagamese_text: Damascus te ekjon chela Ananias koi kene thakise. Probhu pora taike darshan pora koise, “Ananais!” Titia tai koise, “Sabi, moi yate ase Probhu.”

english_text: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
nagamese_text: Titia Probhu taike koise, “Uthibi, aru Sidha kowa rasta te jabi, aru Judas laga ghor te jai kene ekjon manu Saul, Tarsus sheher pora aha, ase na nai hudibi, kelemane tai prathana kori ase.

english_text: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai darshan te ekjon manu Ananias koi kene dikhise, aru tai uporte te hath rakhi kene thaka dikhise, etu pora tai aru dikhibo paribo.”

english_text: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Kintu Ananias koise, “Probhu, moi etu manu laga kotha bisi manu pora hunise, tai Jerusalem te kiman pobitro manu ke dukh dise.

english_text: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
nagamese_text: Tai moha purohit khan pora adhikar loise aru jun manu apuni laga naam lobo taike bondhi ghor te hali dibo.”

english_text: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu taike koise, “Jabi, kelemane tai Moi laga basi luwa kaam kora manu hobo, tai he moi laga naam Porjati khan ke, raja khan ke aru Israel laga bacha khan ke koi dibo;

english_text: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
nagamese_text: kelemane Moi taike dikhai dibo, tai moi laga naam nimite ki dukh uthabo lagibo.”

english_text: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
nagamese_text: Aru Ananias etu ghor te jaise, aru tai laga hath Saul uporte rakhi kene koise, “Bhai Saul, Probhu Jisu pora tumi rasta te ahi thaka homoi te dikhai dise, Tai moike tumi usorte pathaise, tumi aru dikhibo aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hobo.”

english_text: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te Saul laga suku pora kiba chamra nisena giri jaise, aru tai dikhi bole parise, aru tai uthi kene baptizma loise;

english_text: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
nagamese_text: aru tai bhat khai kene takot paise. Aru tai chela khan logote Damascus te olop din thakise.

english_text: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
nagamese_text: Tai joldi mondoli khan te jai kene Khrista Isor laga Putro ase koi kene prochar korise.

english_text: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
nagamese_text: Aru jun manu tai laga kotha hunise sob manu asurit hoi kene koise, “Jerusalem te Khrista naam loi thaka khan ke dukh diya to etu manu nohoi? Aru yate tai yate aha to taikhan ke bandi kene moha purohit khan logot loi jabole ahise.”

english_text: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu Saul aru bisi mon dangor hoise, aru Damascus te thaka Yehudi khan nimite ekta chinta hoi jaise aru Jisu he Khrista ase koikena prochar kori thakise.

english_text: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
nagamese_text: Kintu bisi din ja pichete, Yehudi khan Saul ke morai dibole kotha milai loise.

english_text: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan laga bhabona to Saul jani loise. Taike morai dibole nimite din raat dorja usorte te rukhi thakise.

english_text: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai laga chela khan rati huwa homoi te, taike ani kene tukri pora diwar niche korise aru paar kori dise.

english_text: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Saul Jerusalem te ahise, tai chela khan logote mili bole kosis korise, kintu taikhan sob taike bhoi korise, tai bhi ekjon chela ase koi kene biswas kora nai.

english_text: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu Barnabas pora taike apostle khan logote loi jaise, aru Probhu pora kineka taike rasta te lok paise aru ki koise, aru tai Damascus te kineka mon dangor pora Jisu laga naam prochar korise, etu sob koi dise.

english_text: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
nagamese_text: Titia tai chela khan logote Jerusalem te aha juwa korise. Aru tai mon dangor pora Probhu laga naam loise.

english_text: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
nagamese_text: Tai Greece te thaka Yehudi khan logot bhi kotha korise; kintu taikhan taike morai dibole kosis korise.

english_text: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
nagamese_text: Jitia biswasi bhai khan etu janise, taike Caesarea te loijai kene Tarsus te pathai dise.

english_text: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Titia, Judea aru Galilee aru Samaria laga girja khan shanti te thakise; aru Probhu laga bhoi te thakise aru ekjon-ekjon ke Pobitro Atma pora mon dangor kori dise, aru girja laga ginti aru bhi bisi hoi jaise.

english_text: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
nagamese_text: Etiya eneka hoise, jitia Peter sob jagate safar korise, Lydda town te thaka Isor laga manu khan usorte bhi jaise.

english_text: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
nagamese_text: Ta te tai Aeneas koi kene ekjon manu ke lok paise, tai bisna te ath saal pora ghumai thakise, aru tai jothor bemar thakise.

english_text: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
nagamese_text: Peter taike koise, “Aeneas, Jisu Khrista tumike changai koridi ase, uthibi aru tumi laga bisna thik kori lobi,” aru titia tai joldi uthijaise.

english_text: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Titia Lydda aru Sharon te thaka manu khan taike dikhi kene mon ghuraise aru Probhu ke biswas korise.

english_text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
nagamese_text: Joppa te Tabitha koi kene ekjon mahila chela thakise, jun laga motlob ase “Dorcas.” Etu mahila sob bhal kaam kore aru gorib manu khan uporte bisi morom thakise.

english_text: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai bemar pora mori jaise, aru taike gaw dhulai dikene upor kamra te rakhise.

english_text: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
nagamese_text: Aru Lydda jaga to Joppa usorte thakise, aru Peter ta te ase koi kene chela khan hunise, aru taikhan pora duijon manu ke tai logote anurodh kori kene pathaise, “Amikhan logote deri nohoi kene ahibi.”

english_text: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter uthi kene taikhan logot jaise. Jitia tai ponchise, taikhan pora taike upor kamra te loi jaise aru ta te sob bidhowa khan tai usorte khara kori kene kandi thakise, aru Dorcas pora tai jinda thaka homoi te taikhan nimite kapra bonai diya khan dikhai dise.

english_text: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter taikhan sobke bahar jabo dise, aru tai athukari kene prathana korise. Titia, tai laga gaw phale saikene koise, “Tabitha, uthibi.” Tai suku khuli se, aru Peter ke dikhi kene tai bohi jaise.

english_text: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter tai laga hath dikene taike uthai dise; aru pobitro manu aru bidhowa khan ke jinda hoi juwa to dikhai dise.

english_text: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Aru Joppa te thaka sob etu kotha jani loise, aru bisi manu Probhu ke biswas korise.

english_text: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
nagamese_text: Peter bisi din Joppa te Simon koi kene ekjon manu ghor te thakise.

english_text: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
nagamese_text: Titia ekjon manu Cornelius koi kene Caesarea te thakise, aru tai Italy laga Regiment te ekjon dangor henapoti thakise.

english_text: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
nagamese_text: Tai aru tai laga ghor manu khan sob Isor ke bhoi kora khan thakise; aru tai manu khan ke poisa dikena modot kora manu asele, aru hodai Isor logote prathana kori thakise.

english_text: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
nagamese_text: Ek din tin baji nisena te, tai ekta sapha sapna dikhise, Isor laga ekjon sorgodoth tai logote ahi kene koise, “Cornelius!”

english_text: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
nagamese_text: Kintu Cornelius sorgodoth ke bhoi pora saikene hudise, “Ki ase, malik?” Titia sorgodoth pora taike koise, “Tumi laga prathana aru dukh manu ke modot kora to Isor pora dikhise.

english_text: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
nagamese_text: Etiya Joppa te kunba manu pathai kene Simon, kunke Peter bhi mate, taike anibi.

english_text: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
nagamese_text: Tai Simon koi kene ekjon chamra ula kaam kora manu laga ghor te ase, tai laga ghor samundar kinar te ase.”

english_text: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
nagamese_text: Jitia sorgodoth taike kotha koi kene jai jaise, Cornelius tai laga duijon noukar ke matise, aru bisi majote ekjon bhal sipahi jun taike sewa kore taike bhi mati anise.

english_text: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ke sob kotha koi diya pichete, Cornelius taikhan ke Joppa te pathaise.

english_text: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
nagamese_text: Etiya aru alag din ekta te, taikhan jai thaka homoi te ekta sheher te ponchise, Peter ghor uporte prathana kori bole jaise.

english_text: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
nagamese_text: Titia tai bisi bhuk lagise, aru kiba khabole itcha thakise, kintu jitia manu khan bhat bonai thakise, tai ekta darshan dikhise,

english_text: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
nagamese_text: aru tai akas pora kiba ekta saman aha dikhise, ekta dangor kapra, charta kinar pora bandhi kene prithibi nichete ahi thaka dikhise.

english_text: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te prithibi laga sob janwar charta theng thaka aru matite rengi kene choli thaka jongli janwar, aru akas laga chiriya khan sob thakise.

english_text: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
nagamese_text: Aru titia ekta awaj taike koise: “Uthibi, Peter, aru mari kene khabi.”

english_text: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter koise, “Nohobo Probhu, moi kitia bhi sapha nathaka aru letera saman khanai.”

english_text: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
nagamese_text: Kintu aru ekbar awaj ahi kene koise: “Ki Isor pora sapha kori dise, etu ke letera ase nokobi.”

english_text: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka ti bar hoise; titia saman pora bhorta thaka sorgote wapas loi jaise.

english_text: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
nagamese_text: Titia Peter etu darshan laga ki motlob ase koi kene bisi chinta bhabona korise, etu homoi te, Cornelius pora kun manu ke pathaise taikhan ahi kene dorjate khara hoi thakise, taikhan ahi kene Simon laga ghor kot te ase etu bisari kene ahise.

english_text: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ahi kene matise, aru Simon kunke Peter bhi koi, tai ta te thaki ase na nai etu hudise.

english_text: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te bhi Peter to tai ki darshan paise etu bhabona kori thakise, titia Pobitro Atma pora taike koise, “Sabi, kunba manu tumike bisari ase.

english_text: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
nagamese_text: Uthibi aru taikhan logote jabi, eku bhabona nokoribi, kelemane moi he taikhan ke pathaise.”

english_text: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
nagamese_text: Titia Peter niche kamra te namikene taikhan ke koise, “Sabi, tumikhan kunke bisari ase etu moi ase. Ki nimite tumikhan moike bisari kene ahise?”

english_text: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan koise, “Henapoti Cornelius jun dharmik manu ase, aru sob Yehudi desh manu khan pora tai laga bhal kotha he koi, pobitro sorgodoth pora etu ghor te apuni logote pathaise, apuni pora kowa kotha to huni bole nimite.”

english_text: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter taikhan ke tai logote thaki bole matise. Aru dusra dinte uthi kene taikhan logote jaise, aru Joppa pora kunba bhai khan bhi tai logote jaise.

english_text: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra dinte taikhan Caesarea te ponchise. Cornelius pora tai laga sathi aru ghor manu khan ke bhi mati kene rukhi thakise.

english_text: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
nagamese_text: Jitia Peter ghor bhitor te ahise, Cornelius ahi kene taike lok korise, aru taike aradhana kori bole Peter laga theng nichete girise.

english_text: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter taike uthaikene, koise, “Uthibi! Moi nijor bhi ekjon manu he ase.”

english_text: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Peter tai logote kotha kori thakise, tai jai kene manu bisi joma kori thaka paise.

english_text: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
nagamese_text: Titia tai taikhan ke koise, “Apnikhan bhi jani ase, Yehudi manu dusra jati khan ke lok kora aru eke logote mili kene aha juwa kora niyom nai. Kintu Isor pora moike dikhaise aru koise kunke bhi letera aru sapha nai eneka nokobi.

english_text: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi apuni khan logote eku nokoi kene ahise, jitia apuni pora moike mati bole pathaise. Etu karone moi hudise ki nimite moike lobole pathaise?”

english_text: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
nagamese_text: Titia Cornelius koise, “Char din age te etu homoi te, moi ghor te prathana kori thakise; aru sabi ekjon manu moi usorte boga kapra lagai kene khara kori thakise.

english_text: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
nagamese_text: Aru tai koise, ‘Cornelius, tumi laga prathana huni loise, aru tumi gorib manu khan ke modot kora to Isor pora Tai usorte yaad kori ase.

english_text: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
nagamese_text: Etu karone kunba ke Joppa te patha bhi, aru Simon junke Peter koi. Taike mati bhi, tai samundar kinar te chamra ula kaam kora manu Simon koi kene ekjon ghor te ase.’

english_text: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone moi apuni ke lobole kunba manu pathaise. Aru apuni aha karone bisi bhal paise, aru etu karone, amikhan aji Isor usorte sob manu joma hoi ase, aru Probhu pora apuni ke ki koise etu huni bole nimite joma hoise.”

english_text: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
nagamese_text: Titia Peter mukh khuli kene koise, “Hosa pora, Isor to kun logote bhi alag pora nasai kintu Tai sobke eke morom kore.

english_text: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
nagamese_text: Kintu, jun desh te hoilebi jun he Isor ke bhoi koribo aru Tai laga itcha pora kaam koribo tai uporte hodai Isor laga khushi thakibo.

english_text: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
nagamese_text: Etu kotha Israel laga bacha khan nimite di pathaise, shanti laga susamachar Jisu Khrista dwara, kun he sob laga Probhu ase-

english_text: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
nagamese_text: etu kotha aha to tumikhan bhi jani ase, aru sob Judea te bhorta hoijai ase, Galilee pora shuru kori kene, aru John pora baptizma kotha koi diya pichete;

english_text: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
nagamese_text: aru Nazareth Jisu laga kotha khan, kineka Pobitro Atma aru takot pora Taike Isor pora asirbad kori dise, jiman manu bhoot pora bandhi rakhise taikhan ke changai korise aru tai bhal kaam kori kene thakise, kelemane Isor tai logote asele.

english_text: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
nagamese_text: Jisu ki korise moi khan sob etu laga gawahi ase, Yehudi khan laga desh sob jagah te, aru Jerusalem te ki-ki korise amikhan utu sob laga gawahi ase. Taikhan Taike Cross te latkai kene morai dise.

english_text: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor Taike tin dinte jinda kori dise aru manu khan ke dikhai dise,

english_text: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
nagamese_text: sob manu ke nohoi, kintu Isor poila pora basi luwa khan ke- moi khan pora jun Tai logote kha luwa korise Tai mori kene jinda huwa pichete.

english_text: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai moi khan ke sob manu khan logote jai kene Tai he Isor pora basi luwa ekjon ase aru mora aru jinda sob jati uporte bisar kora ekjon ase koi kene manu khan ke jonai dibi koise.

english_text: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
nagamese_text: Jiman bhabobadi ase sob Tai laga gawahi he ase, jun manu Taike biswas kore Tai laga naam te sob manu paap pora maph pabo.”

english_text: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
nagamese_text: Jitia Peter etu kotha khan koi thakise, jun manu tai laga kotha huni thakise taikhan uporte Pobitro Atma ahi jaise.

english_text: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
nagamese_text: Aru Peter logot jiman sunnot kora biswasi khan ahise taikhan asurit hoi jaise, kelemane Pobitro Atma pora jati manu khan uporte bhi di dise.

english_text: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan pora Porjati khan alag kotha kora aru Isor ke dhanyavad di thaka hunise. Titia Peter pora etu kotha koise,

english_text: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
nagamese_text: “Kun pora taikhan ke baptizma lobole nadibo nimite pani pora dur rakhibo paribo naki, amikhan sob Pobitro Atma pa nisena?”

english_text: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
nagamese_text: Aru tai taikhan ke Jisu Khrista naam pora baptizma lobole koise, titia taike aru olop din taikhan logote thaki bole anurodh korise.

english_text: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
nagamese_text: Titia apostle khan aru Judea te thaka biswasi bhai khan hunise Porjati khan bhi Isor laga kotha ke mani loise koi kene.

english_text: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Peter Jerusalem te wapas ahise, jun khan sunnot koribo lage koi, taikhan logote kotha te laga lagi jaise;

english_text: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”
nagamese_text: taikhan koise, “Apuni khan sunnot nakora manu khan logote jai kene kha luwa korise!”

english_text: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter taikhan ke bhal pora samjai kene koise,

english_text: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
nagamese_text: Moi Joppa laga sheher te prathana kori thakise, titia moi upor pora saman nichete ahi thaka darshan te dikhise, ekta dangor kapra charta kinar pora bandi kene ahi thakise, etu moi logote ahise.

english_text: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
nagamese_text: Moi etu ke bhal pora saikene bhabona korise. Moi duniya te charta theng thaka janwar dikhise, aru jongli janwar, matite jai thaka janwar aru akas laga chiriya khan dikhise.

english_text: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
nagamese_text: Aru moike ekta awaj pora koise, “Uthibi, Peter; mari kene khabi!”

english_text: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
nagamese_text: Kintu moi koise, “Nohobo, Probhu; moi kitia bhi pobitro aru sapha nathaka saman moi laga mukh te ghusa nai.”

english_text: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra bar aru ekta awaj pora moike koise, “Ki saman Isor pora sapha ase koise, etu ke letera nokobi.”

english_text: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka tin bar hoise, titia sob saman akas te aru uthai loi jaise.

english_text: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
nagamese_text: Aru etu homoi te, moi thaka ghor te tinjon manu ahikena khara hoise; taikhan ke Caesarea pora moi logot pathaise.

english_text: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
nagamese_text: Titia Pobitro Atma pora moike taikhan logote jabole koise, kintu taikhan kun ase etu moike koi diya nai, titia choi jon bhai khan moi logote jaise, aru moi khan etu manu laga ghor te jaise.

english_text: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,
nagamese_text: Titia tai pora amikhan ke koise kineka ekjon sorgodoth pora tai laga ghor te khara kori kene taike koise, “Joppa te manu ke pathabi aru Simon ke loi anibole kobi.

english_text: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
nagamese_text: Tai tumike Isor kotha koi dibo, aru etu kotha huni kene tumi aru tumi laga ghor manu khan sob poritran pabo.”

english_text: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia moi kotha koi thakise, Pobitro Atma taikhan logote ahi jaise, jineka shuru te amikhan logote ahisele.

english_text: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
nagamese_text: Titia moike Probhu laga kotha yaad ahise, kineka tai John ke koise, “John pani pora baptizma diye; kintu tumikhan Pobitro Atma pora baptizma lobo.”

english_text: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
nagamese_text: Jodi Isor taikhan ke daan dise jineka amikhan ke bhi dise, juntu pora amikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista ke biswas kore, to moi kun ase, Isor laga kotha namanibole?”

english_text: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan etu kotha hunise, taikhan eku jowab diya nai, kintu taikhan Isor ke dhanyavad dise, aru koise, “Tinehoile Isor pora Porjati khan ke bhi notun jonom dise.”

english_text: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
nagamese_text: Stephen ke morai diya homoi te biswasi khan dukh pa-a pora alag-alag jagate jai jaise, taikhan Isor laga kotha koi kene Phoenicia, Cyprus, aru Antioch te khali Yehudi khan logote prochar kori thakise.

english_text: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan kunba manu khan Cyprus aru Cyrene laga manu thakise, aru taikhan Antioch te ahise aru Yunani manu khan logote bhi kotha korise, aru taikhan ke Probhu Jisu laga prochar korise.

english_text: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Aru Probhu laga hath taikhan uporte thakise; aru bisi manu, biswas kori kene, Probhu logot ahise.

english_text: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan laga kotha Jerusalem te thaka girja khan pora hunise, aru taikhan Barnabas ke Antioch te pathai dise.

english_text: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai ahi kene Isor laga anugraha dikhise, tai khushi paise; aru taikhan laga mon dangor kori kene arubi pura mon pora Probhu logote thaki bole koise.

english_text: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai ekjon biswas te thaka aru Pobitro Atma pora bhorta kori kene thaka ekjon bhal manu thakise, aru bisi manu Probhu ke grohon korise.

english_text: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
nagamese_text: Titia Barnabas to Saul ke bisari bole Tarsus te jaise.

english_text: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taike paise, taike Antioch te loi anise. Aru eneka hoise, pura saal taikhan eke logote thakise aru girja te manu khan ke sikhai thakise, aru titia Antioch te poila bar chela khan ke Khristan khan koi kene matise.

english_text: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
nagamese_text: Aru etu homoi te bhabobadi khan kunba Jerusalem pora Antioch te ahise.

english_text: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan majot, Agabus koi kene ekjon khara hoi kene jineka pura duniya te bisi dangor akaal ahibole ase, Atma pora taike dikhai diya nisena bhabobani koise. Etu sob Claudius laga dinte hoise.

english_text: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
nagamese_text: Titia chela khan, jun khan jabo paribo, taikhan jai kene Judea te thaka bhai khan ke modot pathai dibo nimite kotha korise.

english_text: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan eneka korise; Barnabas aru Saul laga hath pora ta te thaka bura khan ke poisa pathai dise.

english_text: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te raja Herod pora girja manu kunba khan ke dhurise aru bisi digdar dise.

english_text: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
nagamese_text: Aru tai John laga bhai James ke talwar pora morai dise.

english_text: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Yehudi cholawta khan etu karone bisi khushi pa-a janise, tai Peter ke bhi dhori bole jaise. Aru etu homoi to khomir nadhala laga roti kha laga din khan thakise.

english_text: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai Peter ke dhori loise, taike bondhi ghor te hali dise, aru charta sipahi khan ke tai uporte sabole rakhidise; tai Peter ke Nistar Purbb dinte manu khan usorte ulaikene anibole bhabi thakise.

english_text: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi te, Peter ke bondhi ghor te rakhi thakise, kintu girja manu khan mon pora tai nimite hodai Isor logot prathana kori thakise.

english_text: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
nagamese_text: Aru Peter ke Herod pora bisar nakora ek rati age te, Peter to duijon sipahi majote ghumai thakise, loha laga rusi duita pora bandi kene thakise, aru dorja usorte duijon sipahi taike rukhi thakise.

english_text: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.
nagamese_text: Titia, achanak pora Probhu laga sorgodoth tai usorte ahise, aru bondhi ghor bhitor te ujala pora bhorta hoi jaise. Tai Peter laga kona te marise, aru taike uthaikene koise, “Joldi uthibi,” aru taike bandhi kene rakha luha rusi giri jaise.

english_text: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth taike koise, “Kapra lagabi aru juta to lagai lobi.” Peter eneka korise. Sorgodoth taike koise, “Bahar laga ki kapra ase etu lagabi aru moi laga piche ahibi.”

english_text: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
nagamese_text: Titia Peter sorgodoth laga pichete jaise. Kintu tai jana nai etu sob to hosa pora sorgodoth he kori ase. Tai darshan he dikhi ase bhabise.

english_text: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan poila thaka duijon sipahi aru bahar te thaka duijon sipahi ke paar korise, taikhan loha laga ekta dorja usorte punchise juntu khuli kene taikhan sheher te jabo paribo; aru etu nijor pora khuli jaise. Titia taikhan ulaikene rasta nichete jaise, aru sorgodoth taike chari kene jai jaise.

english_text: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Peter etu sob hosa pora hoise koi kene jani loise, tai nijorke koise, “Etiya moi hosa pora jani loise Probhu moike Herod laga hath pora bachai lobole nimite Tai laga sorgodoth ke pathai dise, aru Yehudi manu khan ki bhabona kori thakise etu pora moike ulaikene anise.”

english_text: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai etu buji jaise, tai John, kunke Mark bhi mate tai laga ama Mary laga ghor te jaise, ta te bisi manu khan joma kori kene prathana kori thakise.

english_text: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Peter dorjate marikena awaj dise, ekjon chukri noukar Rhoda koi kene dorja khuli bole ahise.

english_text: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
nagamese_text: Jitia tai Peter laga awaj janise, khushi pora dorja khuli bole pahorise; aru tai, polaikene kamra te ahise; aru taikhan ke Peter dorjate khara kori kene ase koise.

english_text: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan pora koise, “Tumi pagli hoise.” Kintu tai Peter ahise koi kene jor pora koi dise. Titia taikhan koise, “Etu tai laga sorgodoth hobo.”

english_text: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
nagamese_text: Kintu Peter to dorjate mari thakise, aru jitia taikhan dorja khuli se, taikhan taike dikhi kene bisi asurit hoise.

english_text: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai taikhan ke hath pora chup thaki bole dikhai dise, aru kineka kori kene Probhu pora taike bondhi ghor pora ulai dise etu taikhan ke koise, “Jai kene etu kotha James aru bhai khan ke kobi.” Aru ta te pora tai dusra jagate jai jaise.

english_text: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia din hoise, sipahi khan Peter logote ki hoise eku bhi jana nai.

english_text: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Herod Peter ke bisari kene panai, tai sipahi khan ke hudise aru taikhan ke morai dibole hukum dise. Etu pichete tai Judea pora jai kene Caesarea te thakise.

english_text: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
nagamese_text: Aru Herod to Tyre aru Sidon laga manu khan uporte bisi khong thakise. Etu karone taikhan joma hoi kene eke logote taike lok kori bole ahise. Taikhan Blastus koi kene Raja laga kaam kora ekjon ke kotha korise aru taikhan ke modot kori bole phuslai loise. Titia taikhan shanti thaki bole nimite mangise, kelemane taikhan laga desh te kha luwa kiman jai, sob etu raja laga desh pora he jai thakise.

english_text: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
nagamese_text: Kotha kori kene rakha dinte, Herod raja laga kapra lagai kene tai nijorke taiyar korise. Tai laga singhason te bohi kene taikhan ke kotha korise.

english_text: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
nagamese_text: Kintu manu khan hala kori koise, “Etu Isor laga awaj ase, manu laga nohoi!”

english_text: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
nagamese_text: Titia etu homoi te Probhu laga sorgodoth joldi taike mari dise, kelemane tai Isor ke mohima diya nai; aru puka pora taike khai kene morai dise.

english_text: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
nagamese_text: Aru Isor laga kotha bisi-bisi hoi jaise.

english_text: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Barnabas aru Saul taikhan laga kaam pura kori loise, taikhan Jerusalem te jaise, aru John kunke Mark bhi mate taike bhi loi anise.

english_text: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
nagamese_text: Aru Antioch girja te bhabobadi khan aru hikhok khan bhi thakise. Barnabas aru Simon -junke Niger koi-, aru Cyrene laga Lucius, - Herod tetrarch pora pala bhai- aru Saul.

english_text: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan Isor ke aradhana kori kene aru upwas kori thakise, Pobitro Atma pora koise, “Tumikhan Barnabas aru Saul ke Ami nimite alag rakhi dibi, Moi taikhan nimite ki kaam ase etu kori bole karone.”

english_text: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan upwas rakhise aru duijon uporte hath dikena prathana kori dise, aru tai duijon ke pathai dise.

english_text: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
nagamese_text: Barnabas aru Saul ke Pobitro Atma pora Seleucia te pathai dise; aru taikhan naw te uthi kene Cyprus majuli te jaise.

english_text: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia duijon Salamis sheher te ponchise, taikhan Yehudi khan laga mondoli te jai kene Isor laga kotha prochar korise. Aru duijon ke modot kori bole John Mark bhi thakise.

english_text: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan Paphos sheher laga sob jagate jaise, ta te ekjon jadu kora manu ke lok paise, Yehudi laga misa bhabobadi, tai laga naam Bar Jesus thakise.

english_text: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
nagamese_text: Etu jadu kora manu to Proconsul Sergius Paulus logote thakise, tai gyaan thaka manu asele. Tai Barnabas aru Saul ke matise, kelemane tai Isor laga kotha huni bole mon thakise.

english_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
nagamese_text: Kintu Elymas “Jadu kora manu” -taike eneka naam pora he mate- taikhan ke bhirodh korise; tai proconsul ke biswas pora hatai dibole kosis korise.

english_text: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him
nagamese_text: Titia Saul, junke Paul koi kene mate, taike Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoise, aru taike bhal pora saise

english_text: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
nagamese_text: aru koise, “Tumi saitan laga bacha, tumi sob biya kaam pora bhorta hoi ase aru tumi logote sob letera bhabona he ase. Tumi dharmikta laga sob kisim kaam laga dushman ase. Tumi Probhu laga sidha rasta to tera kori bole kitia bhi norokhibo, hoi na nohoi?

english_text: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
nagamese_text: Etiya sabi, Probhu laga hath tumi uporte ase, aru tumi suku andha hoi jabo. Tumi olop din nimite suryo to nadikhibo.” Etu homoi te Elymas uporte andhera ahi jaise, aru tai manu khan ke tai laga hath dhurikena loi jabole modot mangise.

english_text: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
nagamese_text: Jitia proconsul pora ki hoise etu dikhise, tai biswas korise, kelemane tai Isor laga kotha sikhai diya to asurit lagise.

english_text: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Aru titia Paul aru tai laga sathi khan Paphos pora naw te uthi kene jaise aru Pamphylia jagate thaka Perga sheher te ahi jaise. Kintu John taikhan ke chari kene aru Jerusalem te wapas ahi jaise.

english_text: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
nagamese_text: Kintu Paul aru tai laga sathi khan Perga te jaise aru Antioch laga Pisidia jagate ponchise. Taikhan Bisram laga dinte mondoli te jai kene bohise.

english_text: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
nagamese_text: Bhabobadi aru niyom laga kotha porha pichete, mondoli laga cholawta khan pora koise, “Bhai khan, yate laga manu khan nimite kiba bhal kotha ase koile, kobi.”

english_text: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
nagamese_text: Titia Paul khara korise aru hath pora dikhai kene koise, “Israel manu aru Isor ke bhoi kori kene thaka khan, huni bhi.

english_text: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
nagamese_text: Israel manu laga Isor pora moi khan baba laga baba khan ke basi loise aru bisi kori dise jitia taikhan Egypt te thakise, aru Tai laga hath to uthaikene taikhan ke tai pora ulai loi anise.

english_text: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
nagamese_text: Aru chalis saal tak Tai jongol te taikhan logote thakise.

english_text: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Tai Cannan laga sat-ta desh ke khotom kori dise, Tai etu jaga amikhan laga manu khan ke dise.

english_text: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
nagamese_text: Etu sob charsoh pachas saal upor hoise. Etu sob huwa pichete, Isor taikhan ke bisar dise jitia tak bhabobadi Samuel aha nai.

english_text: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan raja mangise, aru Isor pora taikhan ke Kish laga chokra Saul dise, ekjon Benjamin laga jat pora, chalis saal tak raja hobole dise.

english_text: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor pora Saul ke raja laga jaga pora hatai diya pichete, taikhan nimite David ke raja bonai dise. Aru David nimite bhi Isor pora koise, ‘Moi laga mon usorte te thaka ekjon Jesse laga chokra David ke paise, tai moi laga itcha kaam sob koribo.’

english_text: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
nagamese_text: Etu manu laga khandan pora Isor Israel te bachai diya, Jisu ke pathaise, Tai Israel manu khan ke kosom diya nisena.

english_text: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
nagamese_text: Etu sob to shuru hoise jitia, Jisu naha age te, John poila Israel manu khan ke baptizma dikene mon ghura bole koise.

english_text: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
nagamese_text: Aru jitia John laga kaam khotom kori thakise, tai hudise, ‘Moike tumikhan kun ase bhabe? Moi etu nohoi. Kintu huni bhi, ekjon ahi ase, aru tai laga theng laga juta bandhi bole bhi moi layak nai.’

english_text: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
nagamese_text: Hey bhai khan, Abraham khandan laga bacha khan, apuni khan majote kun Isor ke bhoi kore, amikhan nimite he etu notun jibon laga kotha to pathai dise.

english_text: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
nagamese_text: Kunkhan Jerusalem te thaki ase, aru taikhan laga cholawta khan Taike chini bole para nai, aru bhabobadi khan kowa to pura kori dise, jun to ase, hodai Bisram dinte Taike hinsa aru bodnam kori kene puri thake.

english_text: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan Taike morai dibole eku golti napai le bhi, taikhan Pilate ke Jisu morai dibole koise.

english_text: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
nagamese_text: Jitia Tai nimite Shastro te ki likha ase etu sob pura hoise, taikhan Cross pora Taike namai ani kene kobor te rakhidise.

english_text: But God raised him from the dead,
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor Taike mora pora aru bhi jinda kori dise.

english_text: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai logote Galilee pora Jerusalem te kun manu khan ahise bisi din tak Taike dikhise. Aru etu manu khan Tai laga gawahi manu khan ke koi kene berai.

english_text: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
nagamese_text: Aru etu nimite amikhan etu kotha to koi kene prochar kore juntu Isor pora amikhan laga baba khan ke kosom disele.

english_text: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
nagamese_text: Isor he sob kotha to amikhan nimite, taikhan laga bacha khan nimite pura kori dise, Jisu ke jinda kori diya pora. Bhajan Geet te likhi kene thaka nisena: ‘Tumi Moi laga chokra ase, aji pora Moi tumi laga Baba hoise.’

english_text: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
nagamese_text: Taike mora pora jinda kori diya motlob ase Tai laga gaw to kitia bhi napuchibo, Isor to eneka koise: Moi tumike Pobitro aru hosa asirbad dibo juntu moi David ke kosom disele.’

english_text: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
nagamese_text: Etu nimite tai dusra Psalms te aru koi kene ase, ‘Apuni kitia bhi Pobitro ekjon ke puchibole nadibo.’

english_text: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
nagamese_text: Kelemane David tai laga homoi te Isor laga itcha pora Tai nijor manu ke sewa kori thakise aru mori jaise, aru tai baba khan logot moidam te dise, aru puchi jaise.

english_text: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu junke Isor jinda kori dise, Taike puchibole diya nai.

english_text: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni khan jani lobi, manu khan, bhai khan, etu manu pora he apuni khan paap to maph pabo, aru sob biya pora ajadi pabo jun to Moses laga niyom pora bhi apnikhan ke dibole para nai.

english_text: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
nagamese_text: Aru jun Taike biswas kore tai bachi jabo.

english_text: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
nagamese_text: Etu karone hoshiar thakibi bhabobadi khan pora ki koise etu apuni khan logote nohobole nimite:
