nagamese_text: Isor laga morom laga dhun juntu apuni khan uporte rakhi kene ase, aru Tai bisi dhorjo kori kene etiya tak saja nadiya karone, apnikhan eitu khan bisi chutu ase koi kene bhabi ase naki? Apuni khan najane naki, Tai laga morom to apuni khan ke mon ghurai lobole nimite ase koi kene?

english_text: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni khan bisi mon tan ase aru mon naghurai kene ase, etu nimite apuni khan nijor laga golti khan Isor laga khong laga din nimite joma kori ase. Aru utu dinte Isor laga hosa bisar sob manu khan ke dikhai dibo.

english_text: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
nagamese_text: Isor pora sob manu laga kaam hisab te taikhan ke dibo:

english_text: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
nagamese_text: Jun manu khan bhal kaam korate dhorjo kori kene mohima aru sonman aru biya kaam kora laga jibon bisara nai, taikhan ke Isor pora anonto jibon dibo.

english_text: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
nagamese_text: Kintu jun manu nijor nimite he bhabona kore aru hosa kotha namani kene adharmik phale he mani loi, taikhan karone Isor laga khong aru ghusa ahibo.

english_text: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
nagamese_text: Isor pora paap kora manu khan sob uporte dukh kosto anibo, poila Yehudi khan ke, aru etu pichete Yunani khan uporte bhi.

english_text: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun pora bhal kaam kori ase, taikhan nimite to mohima, sonman aru shanti thakibo poila Yehudi khan aru etu pichete Yehudi khan nimite bhi.

english_text: For there is no partiality with God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor to sobke eke sai.

english_text: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile niyom najani kene kiman jon paap korise taikhan eneka he harai jabo aru kiman jon niyom janikena paap korise taikhan etu niyom hisab pora bisar koribo.

english_text: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
nagamese_text: Kilekoile niyom huna pora Isor age te dharmik nohoi, kintu niyom chola pora he taikhan dharmik hobo.

english_text: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
nagamese_text: Kelemane jitia Porjati khan, kunkhan logot niyom nai, taikhan laga sobhab pora he niyom te ki koi ase etu korise koile, taikhan niyom nathakile bhi taikhan nijor he niyom ase.

english_text: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
nagamese_text: Eneka sobhab thaka pora niyom te ki hukum dise etu taikhan laga monte likhi kene ase eneka dikhai ase. Taikhan laga nijor bhabona pora bhi etu thik ase eneka sakhi di ase, aru taikhan mon pora kitia ba galti diye aru kitia ba thik ase eneka koi.

english_text: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Etu hobo utu dinte jitia Isor he manu khan laga lukai kene thaka sob bisar koribo, moi ki susamachar koi ase etu hisab pora hobo, Jisu Khrista dwara.

english_text: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni nijorke Yehudi mati ase aru niyom te asha kori ase aru Isor laga manu eneka mon dangor kori ase,

english_text: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
nagamese_text: aru Tai laga itcha jane aru ki bisi bhal ase etu ke mane kele koile apuni ke niyom pora bujhai dise;

english_text: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
nagamese_text: aru apuni hosa bhi andha khan nimite nijor bhi ekjon cholawta ase eneka jane, nohoile andhera te thaka khan nimite puhor ase eneka jane,

english_text: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
nagamese_text: murkho khan nimite hikhok ase eneka jane, bacha khan laga hikhok ase eneka koi, aru apuni logote niyom to gyaan aru hosa ase koile,

english_text: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
nagamese_text: titia apuni kun dusra ke sikhai ase, apuni nijorke bhi nasikhai naki? Apuni kun chor kora laga bhirodh te prochar kore, apuni chor kore naki?

english_text: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
nagamese_text: Apuni koi ase bebichar na koribi kintu apuni bebichar kori ase naki, apuni murti to ghin kori ase kintu mondoli pora chor kori ase naki?

english_text: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?
nagamese_text: Apuni kun pora niyom te phutani kori ase niyom to bhangai kene Isor ke sorom khilai ase naki?

english_text: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro te eneka likhi kene ase, “Apnikhan nimite Porjati majote Isor laga naam to ninda kori ase.”

english_text: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi apuni niyom thik pora manile, sunnot korate labh ase, kintu jodi apuni niyom to bhangai ase koile apuni sunnot nakora nisena he ase.

english_text: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
nagamese_text: Jodi, ekjon manu sunnot kora nai kintu niyom te thaka sob manile tai asol te sunnot nakorilebi tai sunnot kora nisena nahobo naki?

english_text: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
nagamese_text: Sunnot nakora khan kun niyom mani ase taikhan pora apuni khan kun sunnot korise aru niyom bhi paikene ase, kintu niyom bhangai ase, apuni khan ke ninda koribo naki? Etu eneka ase kelemane apuni khan logote likhi kene thaka niyom aru sunnot ase, hoilebi apuni khan niyom ke bhangai!

english_text: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
nagamese_text: Etu pora tai ekjon to Yehudi nohoi jodi khali bahar te he tai Yehudi ase; aru khali dikha bole nimite gaw mangso te sunnot kora to thik nohoi.

english_text: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
nagamese_text: Kintu asol Yehudi to kitab te likhi thaka niyom mani luwa etu ekla nohoi, kintu mon bhitor te sunnot hobo lage, Atma pora. Etu manu nimite stuti to manu pora nahibo, kintu Isor pora ahibo.

english_text: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
nagamese_text: Tinehoile Yehudi huwa labh to ki ase? Nohoile sunnot kora labh to ki ase?

english_text: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.
nagamese_text: Sob phale labh ase. Kelemane, prothom te, Yehudi khan ke Isor laga prokahit jonai dibole nimite dise.

english_text: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
nagamese_text: Nohoile kunba Yehudi khan biswas nathaka asele naki? Nohoile taikhan kunba biswas nakora karone Isor laga hosa to harai jabo naki?

english_text: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”
nagamese_text: Kitia bhi nohoi. Ulta, sob manu misa hoile bhi Isor to hosa he thakibo. Etu nimite Shastro te likha ase, “Apuni kotha kowa to hosa ase eneka janibo, Aru jitia apuni ke bisar koribo apuni bisar te jiti jabo.”

english_text: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan adharmik thaka pora Isor laga dharmikta dikhai di ase koile, titia amikhan pora ki kobo? Amikhan uporte khong utha nimite Isor he adharmik hoise naki? (Moi manu hisab te koi ase).

english_text: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?
nagamese_text: Kitia bhi nahobo! Jodi eneka hoile kineka Isor pora prithibi bisar koribo?

english_text: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi moi misa kowa karone Isor laga hosa to mohima kori kene bisi ulai ase, titia kele moike etiya tak paap-pi manu nisena bisar kori ase?

english_text: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.
nagamese_text: Aru kele eneka nakoi, jineka amikhan pora kori ase koi kene misa kotha ulai ase, aru kunba pora amikhan eneka koise koi kene sakhi kori ase, “Ahibi amikhan biya kaam koribo, aru bhal bisi ulabo nimite”? Taikhan uporte bisar kora to thik ase.

english_text: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile ki? Amikhan nijorke maph kori ase naki? Kitia bhi nohoi. Kelemane amikhan pora Yehudi aru Yunani khan, taikhan sob, paap te ase koi kene bodnam di dise.

english_text: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.
nagamese_text: Shastro te eneka likhi kene ase: “Kun bhi pobitro nohoi, ekjon bhi nai.

english_text: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
nagamese_text: Kun pora bhi nabuje. Kun pora bhi Isor ke nibisare.

english_text: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob ghurai kene jai jaise. Taikhan eke logote eku kaam nathaka hoise. Kun pora bhi bhal nakora hoi jaise- ekjon bhi nai.”

english_text: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
nagamese_text: “Taikhan laga gola to khula thaka kobor nisena ase. Taikhan laga jiba to thogabole cholai ase. Taikhan laga mukh te saph laga jeher ase.”

english_text: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
nagamese_text: “Taikhan laga mukh te biya kotha aru tita he ase.”

english_text: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.
nagamese_text: “Taikhan laga theng bhi khun gira bole ekdom joldi jai.

english_text: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
nagamese_text: Taikhan bera rasta to nosto aru dukh he ase.

english_text: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”
nagamese_text: Etu manu khan to shanti laga rasta najane.”

english_text: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
nagamese_text: “Isor ke bhoi kora taikhan laga suku age te ekdom nai.”

english_text: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.
nagamese_text: Amikhan jane niyom te ki koi ase, etu niyom te thaka manu khan nimite he koi ase. Titia sob manu laga mukh to bondh hobo aru pura prithibi to Isor age te galti hobo.

english_text: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
nagamese_text: Kelemane niyom laga kaam kora pora tai age te kun manu bhi thik nohobo. Kelemane niyom dwara he paap ki ase etu jani ase.

english_text: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya Isor laga dharmik kotha to niyom chari kene dikhai di ase. Aru etu to Bhabobadi khan aru Niom te likha khan pora sakhi dise,

english_text: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,
nagamese_text: juntu ase, Isor laga dharmikta to Jisu Khrista ke biswas kora manu sob nimite ase. Kelemane eku alag-alag kori kene nai.

english_text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
nagamese_text: Kilekoile sob manu paap korise aru Isor laga mohima napuncha hoi jaise,

english_text: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: aru Tai laga anugraha pora eku daam nadikena taikhan basi loise, juntu udhar kora Jisu Khrista te ase.

english_text: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, Isor pora Khrista ke daan dibole rasta bonaise Tai laga khun te biswas rakha dwara pora. Tai laga dharmikta dikhai dibole nimite, Khrista ke dise, kelemane Tai pora age te kora paap sob maph kori dise

english_text: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
nagamese_text: Isor laga dhorjo thaka nimite. Etu aji amikhan ke tai laga dharmikta dikhai dibole karone thakise. Titia Tai hosa ase eneka jonai dibo aru kun pora Jisu ke biswas kore taikhan ke bhi bachai lobo.

english_text: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
nagamese_text: Titia amikhan phutani kori bole ki ase? Etu hatai se. Ki laga niyom pora? Kaam kora pora naki? Nohoi, kintu biswas kora niyom pora he hoise.

english_text: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan pora jani loise niyom laga kaam kora nohoi kene biswas pora he bachaise.

english_text: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
nagamese_text: Nohoile Isor to khali Yehudi khan laga Isor ase naki? Tai he Porjati laga bhi Isor nohoi naki? Hoi, Porjati laga bhi Isor ase.

english_text: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
nagamese_text: Jodi, hosa pora, Isor to ekjon he ase, Tai pora sunnot huwa khan ke biswas pora bachabo aru sunnot nohua khan bhi biswas dwara he bachabo.

english_text: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile amikhan biswas kora karone niyom to chari dibo naki? Eneka kitia bhi nahobi! Etu laga bodli, amikhan pora niyom to dhuri rakhibo lage.

english_text: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
nagamese_text: Tinehoile Abraham, kun mangso hisab te tai amikhan laga baba ase, ki paise koi kene kobo?

english_text: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi Abraham bhi kaam kori kene dharmik hoise koile tai nijor phutani hobole kiba ase, kintu Isor usorte hoile nohoi.

english_text: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro te ki koise? “Abraham pora Isor ke biswas korise aru etu pora tai dharmik hoise.”

english_text: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
nagamese_text: Etiya kun pora kaam kori ase tai laga hajira to udhar nisena ginti nohoi kintu tai pabole thaka he ase.

english_text: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun ekjon nijor to kaam nakore, hoilebi, paap-pi manu khan ke bachai diya Isor ke biswas kore, tai laga biswas to dharmik ase koi kene ginti kori loi.

english_text: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
nagamese_text: Etu manu nimite he David pora koi ase, kaam nathakile bhi kunke Isor pora dharmik ase eneka ginti korise, tai asishit ase.

english_text: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Asis ase taikhan jun khan laga golti kaam khan maph hoise, Aru jun khan laga paapkhan dhakai dise.

english_text: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
nagamese_text: Dhonyo ase utu manu junke Probhu pora tai laga paapkhan ginti nakoribo.”

english_text: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
nagamese_text: Etu asirbad to khali sunnot huwa khan nimite ase naki, na sunnot nakora khan karone bhi ase? Kelemane amikhan koi, “Abraham laga biswas he dharmikta ase koi kene ginti hoise.”

english_text: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile etu kineka ginti hoise? Etu tai sunnot nakora age te hoise na, na sunnot huwa pichete hoise? Etu to sunnot kora pichete nohoi, kintu nakora age te hoise.

english_text: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
nagamese_text: Abraham ke sunnot laga niyom laga chihna to pai loise. Etu to dharmikta biswas laga mohor hoise juntu tai sunnot nakora age te Isor pora taike di dise. Etu nimite Abraham ekjon baba hoi jaise jun biswas kori loise, jodi taikhan sunnot nakorile bhi. Etu motlob to taikhan dharmik ase koi kene taikhan ke ginti kori lobo.

english_text: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
nagamese_text: Aru Abraham taikhan laga baba bhi ase jun khan sunnot korise, kintu khali sunnot kora niyom he mana karone nohoi, hoilebi taikhan jun amikhan laga baba Abraham pora sunnot nakora age te tai laga biswas laga kadam ke piche korise.

english_text: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Abraham aru tai laga khandan ke tai etu prithibi laga malik hobo koi kene kosom diya to khali niyom mana nimite he nohoi, kintu biswas laga dharmikta dwara ase.

english_text: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi manu khan khali niyom mani kene Isor laga kosom pai jai, tinehoile biswas laga eku motlob nathakibo. Aru Isor laga kosom Abraham ke diya to eku kaam nai.

english_text: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile niyom to khali Isor laga khong he anibo, kintu jodi niyom nathake koile, ta te niyom laga bhirodh te eku kori bole nai.

english_text: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
nagamese_text: Etu karone khali biswas pora he manu khan Isor laga kosom to pabo, eneka hoile manu khan Isor laga kosom to anugrah pora ase aru Abraham laga sob khandan khan etu kosom to pabo- khali niyom te thaka khan nimite nohoi, kintu jun khan Abraham laga biswas ke piche kore, eitu khan bhi pabo. Tai amikhan sob laga baba ase,

english_text: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
nagamese_text: jineka Shastro te likhi kene ase, “Moi tumike bisi desh laga baba bonaise.” Aru Abraham to Isor, Junke tai biswas korise, Tai logote thakise, jun mora ke jibon diye aru utu jinis khan bhi bonai jun to kitia bhi thaka nai.

english_text: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
nagamese_text: Abraham laga bacha hobo koi kene tai eku asha thaka nai, kintu Abraham Isor ke biswas kori kene asha rakhise. Aru etu nimite tai bisi desh laga baba hoise, jineka Isor pora taike koise, “Tumi laga khandan bisi hobo.”

english_text: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
nagamese_text: Abraham tai nijor laga gaw ke komjur pora mori ase koi kene bhabi thakise (kele koile tai laga umor to eksoh saal laga aas-pas te hoi jaise)- aru tai laga maiki Sarah to kitia bhi bacha nabukhibo koi kene bhabi loise, kintu Abraham to biswas te kitia bhi komjur kora nai.

english_text: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor laga kosom nimite, Abraham kitia bhi biswas te mon chutu kora nai. Ulta, tai nijorke biswas te aru bhi takot korise aru Isor ke prosansa dise.

english_text: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
nagamese_text: Abraham pora biswas kori loise Isor juntu taike kosom dise, etu tai pai jaise.

english_text: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone Abraham to Isor logote dharmikta ase koi kene ginti kori loise.

english_text: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
nagamese_text: Etiya taike grohon kori loise eneka likhi kene thaka to khali Abraham nimite nohoi.

english_text: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan nimite bhi likha ase, amikhan nimite bhi ginti hobo, kele koile amikhan bhi biswas ase utu ekjon ke jun pora Jisu Khrista ke mora pora jinda uthai dise.

english_text: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
nagamese_text: Jisu ke amikhan laga paap nimite taikhan laga hathte dise aru amikhan ke dharmik hobo nimite Taike mora pora jinda kori dise.

english_text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
nagamese_text: Etu karone biswas pora amikhan dharmik hoija karone etiya Probhu Jisu Khrista dwara Isor logote amikhan shanti te ase.

english_text: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
nagamese_text: Tai dwara biswas te amikhan anugrah pai ase kot te amikhan khara kori ase, aru Isor laga mohima laga asha te amikhan khushi kori ase.

english_text: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
nagamese_text: Aru etu uporte amikhan laga dukh kosto te bhi khushi kori ase kelemane amikhan jani ase kosto pora he dhorjo ulai.

english_text: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
nagamese_text: Kintu aru dhorjo pora adat ulai aru adat pora asha ulai,

english_text: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
nagamese_text: aru asha pora amikhan ke sorom nadibo kelemane Pobitro Atma kun amikhan ke dikene ase Tai dwara amikhan laga monte Isor laga morom bhorta hoi ase.

english_text: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kitia amikhan komjur thakise etu thik somoite paapi manu khan nimite Khrista morise.

english_text: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.
nagamese_text: Kelemane dharmik manu ekjon nimite kunba mori bole monjur nohobo. Kintu, ki jane, bhal manu ekjon karone kunba mori bole monjur hobo pare.

english_text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor he amikhan karone Tai laga morom dikhai dise, kelemane kitia amikhan paapi thakisele, titia Khrista amikhan nimite morise.

english_text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
nagamese_text: Aru etu pora bhi, etiya to, Khrista laga khun pora amikhan dharmik hoi thaka nimite, Tai laga khun pora he amikhan ke Isor laga khong pora bhi bachai lobo.

english_text: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan jitia Isor laga dushman khan thakise, titia Tai laga Putro mori bole dikena Isor pora Tai logot amikhan ke mil milap kori loise, etiya hoile, Tai logote mil milap kori luwa pichete, Tai laga jibon pora, aru bhi poritran amikhan pabo.

english_text: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
nagamese_text: Etu he nohoi, Probhu Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan Isor logot te khushi ase kelemane Tai dwara, Isor logot te amikhan etiya mil milap kori loise.

english_text: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, kineka manu ekjon pora prithibi te paap anise, aru paap pora mora anise, etu nisena mora to manu khan sob logote ahi jaise, kelemane sob pora paap korise.

english_text: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
nagamese_text: Kelemane niyom nadiya age te, paap to prithibi te thakise, kintu niyom nathaka karone paap ke ginti kora nai.

english_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, mora to Adam pora Moses tak raj korise, taikhan uporte bhi kunkhan Adam nisena kotha namana paap kora nai, aru kun he ekjon ahibole thaka laga noksa asele.

english_text: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi uphar to niyom bhirodh te ja nisena nohoi. Kilekoile, jodi, ekjon manu pora bhirodh kora nimite bisi morise koile, kiman dangor Isor laga anugrah aru ekjon manu, Jisu Khrista, laga anugrah pora uphar aha kiman bisi manu pora paise!

english_text: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.
nagamese_text: Aru etu uphar to ekjon paap kora laga anjam nimite diya nohoi. Kilekoile, ekta galti kora pora bisar ahise aru bodnam bhi anise, hoilebi uphar pora bisi galti kora pichete bhi, aru eku galti nai koi kene faisla hunai se.

english_text: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi, ekjon manu laga galti nimite sob uporte mora pora raj kore, taikhan etu pora bhi kiman dangor anugraha aru dharmikta laga inam pabo ekjon pora, kun Jisu Khrista ase.

english_text: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
nagamese_text: Etu karone kineka ekjon laga paap pora sob manu uporte sajai anise, etu nisena he ekjon dharmik kaam pora sob manu karone jibon aru dharmikta anise.

english_text: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
nagamese_text: Kelemane ekjon kotha namana pora kineka bisi manu ke paapi bonaise, etu nisena ekjon pora kotha mani luwa pora bisi manu dharmik bonai dise.

english_text: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,
nagamese_text: Kintu niyom to paap bisi ulai dibole anise. Kintu kot te paap bisi ulai ase, Isor laga kripa aru bhi bisi ulai ase.

english_text: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan huwa karone to, jineka paap pora mora khan ke raaj korise, etu nisena anugrah bhi amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista logote anonto jibon te raj koribo.

english_text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
nagamese_text: Titia amikhan pora ki kobo? Anugrah bisi ulabo nimite paap te he thakibo naki?

english_text: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
nagamese_text: Kitia bhi etu hobo nadibi. Amikhan kun paap te mori jaise, kineka aru ta te he thakibo?

english_text: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
nagamese_text: Amikhan kun Jisu Khrista logot te baptizma loise eitu khan sob Tai laga mrityu te bhi baptizma loise eneka apnikhan najane naki?

english_text: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, etiya to, mrityu te baptizma luwa dwara amikhan Tai logote mati bhitor te di dise. Aru etu pora he, jineka Baba Isor laga mohima pora Khrista mora pora jinda hoise, tineka amikhan bhi notun jibon te berabo karone.

english_text: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi Tai mora te amikhan bhi Tai logote ekta hoi kene morise koile, titia Tai jee utha te bhi Tai nisena amikhan bhi jinda hobo.

english_text: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
nagamese_text: Amikhan etu jani ase, amikhan bhitor te thaka purana manu to Tai logote Cross te morai dise, titia hoile he paap laga gaw to khotom hobo. Eneka hoile he amikhan paap laga noukar aru nahobo nimite.

english_text: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun morise tai paap pora mukti paise aru tai dharmik hoise eneka koi.

english_text: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan Khrista logot morise koile, Tai logot te amikhan bhi jinda thakibo.

english_text: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!
nagamese_text: Amikhan jani ase Khrista ke mora pora uthai dise, Tai aru bhi namoribo; mrityu to Tai uporte adhikar nathaka hoise.

english_text: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Tai kineka mrityu te morise, etu mrityu dwara etu paap ke ekbar te hodai nimite morise. Kintu ki jibon te Tai jinda ase, etu to Isor nimite he ase.

english_text: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena he, apuni bhi nijor pora paap te morise, kintu Jisu Khrista dwara Isor logote jinda ase eneka mani lobo lage.

english_text: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
nagamese_text: Etu karone paap laga itcha ki ase etu mani kene paap pora apuni mori bole laga gaw te hukum chola bo nadibi.

english_text: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga gaw te alag-alag bhag to paap logote adharmik kaam koribo nimite hathiar nisena nadibi. Kintu mora pora jinda kora manu nisena apuni nijor pora Isor logote di dibi aru apuni laga gaw bhag to Tai hathte dharmik kaam nimite hathiar ekta nisena chola bole dibi.

english_text: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
nagamese_text: Aru paap ke apuni uporte hukum chola bole nadibi. Kelemane etiya to apnikhan niyom pora nohoi, kintu anugrah pora thaki ase.

english_text: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!
nagamese_text: Tinehoile ki hobo? Amikhan niyom te nohoi kene anugrah te thaka karone aru paap to kori thakibo naki? Kitia bhi eneka hobo nadibi.

english_text: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
nagamese_text: Apuni najane naki jodi kunba manu laga agya mani kene noukar hobole apuni nijorke di dile, apuni kun laga kotha huni ase, apuni tai laga noukar nohoi? Etu hosa ase, jodi apuni paap laga noukar ase ki pora mora te loijai, nohoile kotha mani luwa laga noukar ase juntu pora dharmik hobole di ase, hoilebi apuni kun laga agya mani ase tai laga noukar ase.

english_text: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor ke dhanyavad di ase! Kelemane ekbar paap laga noukar hoi thakise, kintu apnikhan etiya to mon sob pora kotha mani loi kene ki bhal agya sikhai dise ta te thik thaki ase.

english_text: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
nagamese_text: Aru paap pora mukti pa-a nisena thik dharmikta laga noukar khan ase.

english_text: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
nagamese_text: Moi manu hisab te he kotha koi ase kelemane apuni khan bujhi bole komjur ase. Kelemane jineka apnikhan poila te niyom namana laga noukar hoi kene thakise, aru bisi biya hoijai thakise, thik etu nisena, etiya to apuni laga gaw to dharmikta laga noukar hobole dibi, etu pora gaw to pobitro hoi jabo.

english_text: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
nagamese_text: Kitia apnikhan paap laga noukar thakise titia dharmikta apuni khan logote thaka nai.

english_text: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu somoite, apnikhan pora ki phol paise eitu khan nimite etiya to apuni khan sorom kori ase? Kelemane eitu khan jinis pora to khali mrityu he ani diye.

english_text: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya to apnikhan paap pora mukti paise aru Isor laga noukar hoi jaise, etu laga phol to hoile apnikhan ke bisi pobitro bona bole laga ase aru etu pora anonto jibon pabo.

english_text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: Kelemane paap laga daam to mrityu ase, kintu Isor pora diya inam to hoile Probhu Jisu Khrista te anonto jibon ase.

english_text: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhai khan, apuni khan pora najane naki (kelemane kun niyom jani kene ase taikhan logote moi koi ase), ekjon manu jinda thaka tak niyom pora taike bandi kene thake?

english_text: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, ekjon shadi kori kene thaka maiki to tai laga mota jinda thaka tak tai laga niyom hisab te thake, kintu jodi tai laga mota mori jai, titia tai shadi kori kene thaka niyom pora ajad hoijai.

english_text: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.
nagamese_text: Thik etu nisena, jodi tai mota jinda thaki kene, dusra ekjon logot thaki jaile taike bebichari eneka kobo. Kintu jodi tai laga mota mori jai, tai niyom pora ajadi paise aru etu pichete, jodi tai dusra mota logot shadi korile bhi, tai bebichar nohoi.

english_text: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, moi laga bhai khan, apuni khan ke bhi Khrista laga gaw dwara niyom te mori jaise. Etu huwa pora, Tai kunke mora pora jinda hoise, Tai logot te amikhan ekjon-ekjon milai loi kene, amikhan Isor nimite phol dhoribo karone ase.

english_text: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kitia amikhan gaw mangso te thakise, niyom pora amikhan paap laga itcha to uthai dikene, amikhan laga gaw alag-alag bhag te kaam kori thakise aru etu pora mora laga phol dhuri thakise.

english_text: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
nagamese_text: Kintu ki pora amikhan ke dhuri kene aru bandhi kene thakise amikhan etu niyom pora etiya mukti paise. Etu nimite likhi thaka purana niyom pora nohoi, kintu Atma laga notun jibon te amikhan sewa koribo nimite.

english_text: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”
nagamese_text: Tinehoile etiya amikhan pora ki kobo? Kanun to paap ase naki? Kitia bhi nohobi. Hoilebi, jodi etu niyom pora nohoi koile, moi paap to najani bole thakise. Kelemane niyom pora “Apuni lalos nakuribo” eneka likhi nai koile, moi lalos kora ki ase najani bole ase.

english_text: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
nagamese_text: Kintu paap pora hukum kotha ki ase etu loi kene moike bisi lalos kori bole dise. Kelemane, niyom nathakile, paap nijor to mori kene he ase.

english_text: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
nagamese_text: Moi niyom nathaka age te ekbar to jinda thakise, kintu kitia hukum ahise, paap to arubi jinda hoise,

english_text: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;
nagamese_text: aru moi morise. Juntu hukum hisab te jibon anibole kotha thakisele, utu to ulta, moi nimite, mora he anise.

english_text: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.
nagamese_text: Kelemane paap pora etu hukum to loi kene moike thogaise. Aru hukum dwara moike morai dise.

english_text: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
nagamese_text: Etu karone niyom to pobitro ase, aru hukum to pobitro ase, aru dharmik aru bhal ase.

english_text: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile, ki bhal ase etu pora he moike mrityu anidise naki? Eneka hobo nadibi. Kintu etu paap pora, ki bhal ase etu loi kene moike morai dibole thakise. Titia hoile he paap to paap ase eneka janibo, aru paap to bisi biya ase eneka hukum pora dikhai dibo nimite thakise.

english_text: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan jane niyom to atmik ase, kintu moi gaw mangso laga ase. Aru moike paap laga sewkai te bikiri korise.

english_text: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.
nagamese_text: Nijor pora ki kaam kore, moi bujhi bo napare. Kelemane moi ki itcha ase, etu moi nakore. Kintu ki moi ghin kore, etu he moi kori thake.

english_text: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
nagamese_text: Jodi moi ki bhal napai etu he kori thake, titia niyom to bhal ase eneka moi nijor pora niyom kowa mani loi ase.

english_text: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
nagamese_text: Etu karone ki kori ase etu etiya moi nohoi, kintu moi logote jivit thaka paap pora he ase.

english_text: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi laga gaw mangso logot te thaka to bhal eku nai, etu moi jani ase. Kelemane ki hosa ase etu kori bole moi itcha ase kintu etu kori lobole takot he nai.

english_text: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.
nagamese_text: Kelemane bhal kaam ki moi kori bole itcha ase, etu nakore, kintu ki paap moi kori bole mon nai, etu he moi kori thake.

english_text: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.
nagamese_text: Etiya jodi moi kori bole mon nathaka kori ase koile, etu moi nohoi, kintu moi logot te jivit thaka paap pora he kori ase.

english_text: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
nagamese_text: Etu hoile, moi bujhi pai ase, moi bhal kaam to kori bole itcha ase, kintu utu paap moi logote ase.

english_text: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi laga mon bhitor te thaka manu pora Isor laga niyom te khushi pai.

english_text: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra niyom ekjon pora moi laga gaw laga alag-alag bhag te ase. Etu pora moi laga bhabona logote lorai kori ase. Moi laga gaw laga bhag te thaka paap laga niyom pora moike bandi kene rakhe.

english_text: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
nagamese_text: Moi kiman dukh manu ase! Kun pora moike etu mori bole laga gaw pora bachai dibo?

english_text: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu Jisu Khrista dwara Isor ke dhanyavad diya ase! Etu karone, etiya moi nijor mon pora Isor ke sewa kori ase. Kintu, moi laga gaw, juntu mangso te ase, etu pora he paap laga niyom cholai ase.

english_text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Etu karone etiya kun Jisu Khrista te ase taikhan karone ninda kora eku nai.

english_text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jisu Khrista dwara, Jibon diya laga Atma laga niyom pora apuni khan ke paap aru mora laga niyom pora mukti di dise.

english_text: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
nagamese_text: Kelemane komjur te ki niyom kori bole para nai, etu Isor pora korise. Tai nijor Putro ke paap nimite boli kori bole, pura paap laga gaw mangso nisena koi kene pathaise, aru etiya Tai pora paap aru gaw mangso ke ninda kori dise.

english_text: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Titia he niyom pora ki dorkar ase, etu amikhan logote pura hobo, kele koile amikhan gaw mangso hisab te naberai, kintu Atma hisab te he berai.

english_text: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun gaw mangso hisab te he thaki ase taikhan gaw mangso laga jinis te he mon rakhi ase, kintu kun Atma hisab te thaki ase taikhan laga mon bhi Atma laga jinis te he rakhi ase.

english_text: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
nagamese_text: Gaw mangso te mon rakha to mora ase, kintu Atma te mon rakha to jibon aru shanti ase.

english_text: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
nagamese_text: Kelemane gaw mangso te mon rakha to Isor logot te dushman ase, etu Isor laga niyom te nathake, kelemane etu thakibo napare.

english_text: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun gaw mangso te ase taikhan pora Isor ke khushi kori dibo napare.

english_text: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
nagamese_text: Kintu eneka hoile bhi jodi Isor laga Atma apnikhan logot thaki ase, titia apuni khan gaw mangso te nohoi, kintu Atma te ase. Kintu jodi kunba logot Khrista laga Atma nai, titia tai Khrista laga nohoi.

english_text: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi Khrista apuni logot te thake, paap nimite gaw mangso to mori thakilebi, dharmikta nimite atma to jinda thaki ase.

english_text: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
nagamese_text: Jodi Jisu ke punoruthan kori diya Atma to apnikhan logote jivit thaki ase, titia kun pora Jisu Khrista ke punoruthan kori dise, Tai pora apuni khan laga mori bole thaka gaw te bhi apnikhan logote thaka Tai laga Atma dwara jibon dibo.

english_text: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, bhai khan, gaw mangso laga itcha hisab te thaki bole amikhan etu laga dhaar luwa manu nohoi.

english_text: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi apuni gaw mangso hisab te thaki ase koile, apuni mori bole ase, kintu jodi Atma hisab te thaki ase, titia gaw mangso laga kaam sob morai di ase aru apuni jinda thakibo.

english_text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun Isor laga Atma pora cholai ase, taikhan sob Isor laga bacha khan ase.

english_text: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
nagamese_text: Kelemane apnikhan bhoi te giri jabole sewkai laga atma luwa nai; kintu apuni khan bacha laga Atma loise, kun dwara amikhan pora koi, “Abba!”

english_text: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
nagamese_text: Atma nijor pora he amikhan laga atma logot Isor laga bacha khan ase eneka sakhi di ase.

english_text: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi amikhan bacha khan ase, tinehoile amikhan bhi Isor laga uttoradhikari khan ase. Aru amikhan mili kene Khrista logote uttoradhikari khan ase, jodi amikhan Tai logote dukh pai, eneka hoile amikhan bhi Tai laga mohima te hisa hobo.

english_text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan ke dibole thaka mohima to etiya thaka kosto logote tulona kori bole eku nai.

english_text: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sob sristi to Isor laga bacha khan ke dikhibo laga ekdom rukhibo napara hoise.

english_text: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
nagamese_text: Sob sristi to misa misi thakibo diya nisena he hoise, taikhan laga khushi pora nohoi, kun he taikhan ke eneka rakhidise, ekta asha karone.

english_text: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
nagamese_text: Titia sristi laga jinis khan bhi puchija te bandi thaka pora khuli kene Isor laga bacha khan laga mohima te mukti pabo.

english_text: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
nagamese_text: Kelemane pura sristi eke logote bacha jonom dibole dukh pa-a nisena etiya tak bikhai ase.

english_text: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
nagamese_text: Aru sristi khan ekla nohoi, kintu amikhan kun Atma laga prothom phol hoi jaise- amikhan nijor bhi pali luwa khan hobole nimite bisi itcha hoi kene dukh te rukhi ase, etu amikhan laga gaw mangso pora mukti pabo nimite.

english_text: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu asha te he amikhan ke bachai loise. Etiya asha ki dikhibo pare etu to asha nohoi. Kelemane ki dikhi ase ta te kun pora asha koribo?

english_text: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan pora ki nadikhe etu karone asha korile, etu karone amikhan pora dhorjo kori kene rukhi thake.

english_text: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu nisena he, Atma pora amikhan komjur te modot kore. Kelemane ki nimite prathana koribo etu amikhan pora najane, kintu Atma nijor pora kobo napara kotha pora Isor usorte amikhan karone mangi di thake.

english_text: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun pora mon bisari ase tai pora he Atma laga mon bhi jani ase, kelemane Atma pora pobitro manu khan nimite Isor itcha thik te anurodh kori ase.

english_text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
nagamese_text: Aru kun pora Isor ke morom kore, kun Tai laga udesh kaam ekta te mati kene ase, eitu khan nimite Isor pora sob jinis to bhal ekta ulabo nimite kori diye, eneka amikhan pora jani ase.

english_text: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
nagamese_text: Kelemane age pora kun Tai jani thakise, Tai chokra nisena hobole basi loise, taikhan ke mati loise titia bhai khan sob majot te tai he prothom jonom huwa hobo.

english_text: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai pora kunkhan ke age pora basi loise, taikhan ke mati loise. Aru Tai pora kunkhan ke mati loise taikhan ke thik hobo dise. Aru kunke thik hobo dise, taikhan ke mohima bhi kori dise.

english_text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
nagamese_text: Tinehoile etu jinis sob nimite amikhan pora ki kobo? Jodi Isor amikhan phale ase koile, kun pora amikhan logot bhirodh te ase?

english_text: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
nagamese_text: Tai jun pora Tai nijor bacha ke bhi nachari kene amikhan sob karone bolidan dibole nimite pathaise, tinehoile tai laga sob jinis amikhan eku daam natirai kene nadibo?

english_text: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
nagamese_text: Jun manu pora Isor basi luwa manu khan ke ninda kori bole paribo? Isor he taikhan ke bisar koribo.

english_text: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
nagamese_text: Kun pora doshi dibo paribo? Jisu Khrista ase morija to- hoilebi etu pora bhi dangor to, mora pora jinda hoi kene- Isor laga dyna phale bohi kene, amikhan nimite prathana kori ase.

english_text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
nagamese_text: Kun he Khrista laga morom para amikhan ke alag koribo pare? Dukh khan pora naki, nahoile kosto, na bhuk, na dukh, namaribole bhoi naakal, nahoile talwar?

english_text: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
nagamese_text: Eneka likha thaka nisena, “Apuni khan nimite amikhan hodai din somoi sob te morai ase. Mer khan kati bole loija nisena he amikhan ke loijai ase.”

english_text: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu jinis sob te kun pora amikhan ke morom kore Tai dwara amikhan jiti ase.

english_text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi thik jani ase, mora hoilebi jinda hoilebi, sorgo duth hoilebi, sorkar-raj hoilebi, etiya thaka jinis khan hoilebi, ahi thaka jinis khan hoilebi, takot khan hoilebi,

english_text: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: untcha hoilebi, niche hoilebi, sristi kora sob te, eku pora bhi Jisu Khrista te Isor laga morom pora amikhan ke alag koribo na paribo.

english_text: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit
nagamese_text: Moi Khrista te hosa kotha koi ase. Moi misa nokoi; Pobitro Atma logote moi laga bhitor atma pora moike sakhi di ase,

english_text: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
nagamese_text: narukhi kene moi laga monte hodai dukh aru kosto bukhi ase.

english_text: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh
nagamese_text: Kelemane mangso phale, moi nijor laga bhai khan nimite moike shrap hoi kene, Khrista pora alag kori dile bhi etu to moi laga itcha ase.

english_text: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
nagamese_text: Taikhan Israel manu khan ase. Taikhan pali-luwa bacha ase, aru mohima, kosom pora diya niyom, aru niyom laga uphar, aru Isor ke aradhana kora, aru kosom diya vachan sob taikhan logote he ase.

english_text: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga baba laga khandan pora he Khrista ahise, mangso hisab te- Jun sob uporte Isor ase. Hodai karone Taike aradhana hobo dibi. Amen.

english_text: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor laga kosom khan to hari ja nohoi. Kelemane Israel pora aha khan sob to Israel jati pora aha nohoi.

english_text: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”
nagamese_text: Aru sob to Abraham laga asol bacha khan nohoi. Kintu “Isaac dwara tumi laga khandan laga naam hobo.”

english_text: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.
nagamese_text: Etu motlob to, gaw mangso pora aha khan Isor laga bacha nohoi. Hoilebi jun bacha Isor laga kosom pora jonom hoise taikhan he Isor laga bacha khan ase.

english_text: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane kosom te eneka koi kene ase: “Aha saal eneka somoite, moi ghurai kene ahibo, aru ekjon bacha Sarah ke dibo.”

english_text: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
nagamese_text: Khali etu he nohoi, kintu kitia amikhan laga baba Isaac dwara Rebekah bhi pet te bacha bukhi se-

english_text: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
nagamese_text: taikhan jonom nohoi kene thakise aru biya bhal eku nakora age te, etu pora he Isor pora basi luwa hisab te aru Tai laga itcha he hobo karone,

english_text: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
nagamese_text: kaam hisab te nohoi, kintu Tai kun pora mati ase - aru taike eneka koise, “Dangor pora chutu ke sewa koribo.”

english_text: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
nagamese_text: Likha thaka nisena: “Jacob ke moi morom korise, kintu Esau ke moi ghin korise.”

english_text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
nagamese_text: Tinehoile amikhan pora ki kobo? Isor logote adharmik ase naki? Kitia bhi eneka nohoi.

english_text: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Tai pora Moses ke koise, “Moi daya kora khan uporte daya koribo aru morom kora khan ke morom koribo.”

english_text: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, manu khan laga itcha pora nohoi, aru kosis kora pora nohoi, kintu Isor kun logote daya ase Tai laga itcha pora he ase.

english_text: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro pora Pharoah ke koise, “Etu nimite he moi tumike uthai dise, titia tumikhan uporte moi laga hokti dikhai dibo, aru eneka moi laga naam prithibi sob jagate janai dibo.”

english_text: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, kun logote Isor pora daya kori bole itcha ase, taike daya kore, kintu jun uporte Tai mon tan kori dibole itcha kore, taikhan ke mon tan kori bole diye.

english_text: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
nagamese_text: Titia apnikhan pora moike hudibo, “Kile etiya bhi Tai golti pai ase? Kun pora Tai laga itcha ke rukhabo parise?”

english_text: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
nagamese_text: Kintu, O manu, Isor pora itcha kora kaam te alag jowab dibole manu tumi kun ase? Ki saman hath pora bonaise etu saman pora bona manu ke, “Apuni kele moike eneka bonaise eneka kobo pare naki?”

english_text: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
nagamese_text: Kumar ekjon pora ki kolsi bona bole itcha ase, etu bonabo nimite mati uporte tai adhikar nohoi? Aru eke mati pora kolsi ekta sonman nimite aru dusra ekta mamuli te chola bo nimite bona bole tai adhikar ase nohoi?

english_text: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
nagamese_text: Kintu, jodi Isor he Tai laga khong dikha bole aru Tai laga hokti jonai dibole nimite itcha thakise, etu pora he Tai kolsi kunkhan nosto kori bole bonaise, eitu khan ke dhorjo korise koile?

english_text: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—
nagamese_text: Jodi Tai pora etu kora Tai laga dhun laga mohima, kolsi khan uporte daya dikha bole korise koile, kun to Tai age pora mohima nimite bonai kene rakhidise?

english_text: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
nagamese_text: Aru jodi Tai pora etu korise, amikhan nimite jun khan ke Tai mati loise, khali Yehudi khan majot nohoi kintu Porjati khan majot pora bhi?

english_text: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
nagamese_text: Hosea kitab te Tai pora koi ase: “Kun Moi laga jati thaka nai, Moi taikhan ke Moi laga manu khan eneka matibo, Aru kun age te morom napai kene thakise, taike morom kora khan eneka matibo.

english_text: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
nagamese_text: Aru etu jagate taikhan ke eneka bhi kobo, ‘Tumikhan moi laga manu nohoi,’ Ta te taikhan ke, “Jinda Isor laga bacha khan eneka matibo.’”

english_text: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
nagamese_text: Aru Israel nimite Isaiah jor pora awaj chilai kene koi ase, “Israel bacha khan samundar laga balu nisena bisi thakile bhi, Khali basi kene thaka olop jon khan ke he bachabo,

english_text: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Probhu pora prithibi uporte Tai laga kotha deri nohoi kene joldi kaam kori lobo.”

english_text: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
nagamese_text: Aru Isaiah pora koi thaka nisena, “Jodi sorgo Probhu pora amikhan nimite khandan rakhi diya nai koile, Amikhan bhi Sodom aru Gomorrah nisena he hobo asele.”

english_text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
nagamese_text: Tinehoile, etiya amikhan pora ki kobo? Dharmikta jun to biswas pora pai, etu Porjati khan, kun pora dharmikta hobole bisara nai, taikhan pora he paise naki?

english_text: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
nagamese_text: Kintu Israel, kun he niyom pora dharmikta hobole bisarise, taikhan etu ke niyom dwara pa-a nai naki?

english_text: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
nagamese_text: Kile huwa nai? Kelemane taikhan pora etu biswas pora bisara nai, kintu kaam kora pora he pabo eneka bhabise. Taikhan theng lagija pathor te lagi jaise,

english_text: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
nagamese_text: eneka likha thaka nisena, “Sabi, Moi Zion te thogar kha pathor ekta rakhidi ase; aru kun pora Taike biswas kore, Tai kitia bhi sorom nahobo.”

english_text: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi laga monte itcha aru taikhan nimite Isor usorte prathana kora to taikhan poritran pabo nimite ase.

english_text: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
nagamese_text: Isor nimite taikhan mon juli thaka to moi bhi sakhi di ase kintu thik buddhi pora kora nai.

english_text: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, taikhan Isor laga dharmikta najane, aru taikhan nijor laga dharmikta bona bole kosis korise. Taikhan to Isor laga dharmikta te nijor jibon diya nai.

english_text: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun he biswas kore taikhan laga dharmikta nimite Khrista he niyom ke pura korise.

english_text: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Moses pora likhise dharmikta to niyom pora he ahe: “Kun manu niyom kowa khan kori ase, tai etu pora jinda thakibo.”

english_text: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);
nagamese_text: Kintu biswas pora aha laga dharmikta pora etu koi ase, “Tumi laga monte eneka nakobi, ‘Kun sorgote uthijabo?’ (Etu ase, Khrista ke nami anibo karone);

english_text: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”
nagamese_text: aru nohoile eneka nokobi, ‘Kun norokte nami bo?’” (Etu ase, Khrista mora pora jinda uthaikene anibole).

english_text: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:
nagamese_text: Kintu etu pora ki koi ase? “Kotha to apuni usorte he ase.” Etu biswas laga kotha ase, jun to amikhan prochar kori ase.”

english_text: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, jodi apuni laga mukh pora Jisu ke Probhu eneka shikar korile, aru apuni laga monte Isor pora Tai mora pora jinda uthai dise eneka biswas korile, titia hoile apuni poritran pabo.

english_text: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
nagamese_text: Kelemane monte biswas kora pora ekjon dharmik hoijai, aru mukh pora shikar korile poritran pai loi.

english_text: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro te eneka likha ase, “Kun pora taike biswas kore, taikhan kunke bhi sorom nadibo.”

english_text: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Yehudi aru Yunani majote eku alag nai. Kelemane Probhu to sob laga Probhu ase, aru kun pora Taike mate, taikhan sobke Tai laga dhun di ase.

english_text: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun pora Probhu laga naam mati ase taikhan sob poritran pabo.

english_text: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan pora biswas nakora ekjon laga naam kineka matibo? Aru kitia bhi nahuna ekjon ke taikhan kineka biswas koribo? Aru kunba pora prochar nakorile taikhan kineka hunibo?

english_text: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan ke napathaile, taikhan kineka prochar koribo? - Likha thaka nisena, “Bhal khobor prochar kora khan laga theng kiman bhi sundur ase!”

english_text: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan sob pora susamachar laga kotha mana nai. Kelemane Isaiah koi ase, “Probhu, amikhan prochar kora huni kene kun biswas korise?”

english_text: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
nagamese_text: Etu karone huna pora he biswas ahe, aru Khrista laga kotha prochar kora pora hunibo pai.

english_text: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
nagamese_text: Kintu moi hudi ase, “Taikhan pora huna nai naki?” Hoi, hosa taikhan pora hunise. “Prithibi sob jagate taikhan laga awaj jai jaise, Aru taikhan laga kotha pora duniya laga sob kona tak punchise.”

english_text: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”
nagamese_text: Kintu moi hudi ase, “Israel pora buja nai naki?” Moses pora prothom te koise, “Moi juntu desh bhi nohoi, eitu khan dwara tumikhan ke suku jola bole dibo. Nabuja laga desh pora tumikhan ke khong uthibole dibo.”

english_text: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”
nagamese_text: Titia Isaiah mon dangor hoi kene eneka koise, “Kun pora bisara nai taikhan pora Moike pai loise. Kun pora huda nai taikhan logote Moi nijor dikhai dise.”

english_text: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Israel laga eneka koi ase, “Pura dinte Ami kotha namana aru jhagara kora manu khan uporte hath uthaikene thakise.”

english_text: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
nagamese_text: Moi koi ase titia, Isor pora Tai nijor manu khan ke ninda korise naki? Kitia bhi nohoi. Kelemane moi nijor bhi Israel manu ekjon, Abraham laga khandan aru Benjamin laga jati laga ekjon ase.

english_text: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
nagamese_text: Isor pora Tai nijor manu kunkhan ke Tai age pora janikena thakise taikhan ke ninda kora nai. Apnikhan pora Shastro te Elijah pora Isor ke Israel bhirodh te ki anurodh korise etu jana nai naki?

english_text: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
nagamese_text: “Probhu, taikhan pora apuni laga bhabobadi khan ke morai dise, taikhan apuni laga girja laga saman rakha khan bhangai dise. Moi ekla he bachi jaise, aru etiya taikhan moike morai dibole bisari ase.”

english_text: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor taike ki jowab dise? “Ami nijor nimite sath hajar manu rakhi kene ase jun khan jhukikena Baal ke puja kora nai.”

english_text: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
nagamese_text: Etiya bhi eneka he ase, etiya laga somoite bhi bisi komti manu ke he basi se Isor laga kripa pora.

english_text: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi jodi etu anugraha pora hoi, tinehoile etu to tai laga kaam pora nohoi. Nohoile kripa to kripa nohoi jabo.

english_text: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile ki ase? Israel laga manu khan ki bisarise, etu panai, hoile bhi Isor pora basi luwa manu khan etu paise, aru dusra manu khan to mon tan hoi jaise.

english_text: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
nagamese_text: Pobitro kitab te likha nisena: “Isor pora taikhan ke murkho dimag laga atma dise, suku dise nadikhibo nimite aru kandise nahunibo nimite, aji laga din tak.”

english_text: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
nagamese_text: Aru David koise, “Taikhan laga mez ke jhali aru phang hoi jabo dibi, Aru taikhan phasibo aru saja pabo.

english_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga suku ke andhar hoi jabo dibi, titia taikhan eku sabo na paribo, Aru hodai taikhan laga komor niche kori kene thaki jabo.”

english_text: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
nagamese_text: Etu karone moi hudi ase, “Taikhan giri jabole theng te thogar lagise naki?” Kitia bhi eneka nohoi. Kintu taikhan paapi howa karone poritran to Porjati khan logote ahi ase, titia Israel khan suku jolibo.

english_text: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
nagamese_text: Etiya taikhan paapi huwa to prithibi laga dhun nimite ase, aru jodi taikhan pora harai diya to Porjati khan laga dhun ase, titia taikhan pura hobole din ahile, kiman bisi dhuni hobo?

english_text: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
nagamese_text: Etiya Porjati khan, moi apuni khan ke koi ase, jitia tak moi Porjati nimite apostle kaam kori bole dise, eneka moi laga kaam te phutani kori ase.

english_text: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
nagamese_text: Titia ji hoile bhi moi nijor gaw mangso laga Yehudi khan ke suku julibole dibo. Titia taikhan majot te kunba to bachai lobo pare.

english_text: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi taikhan ke chari diya motlob prithibi logot mil-milap hoile, titia taikhan pora grohon kora to mora pora jibon pa nohoi?

english_text: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi prothom phol to pobitro ase, tinehoile etu nimite diya maida bhi pobitro ase. Aru jodi ghas laga shikor to pobitro ase koile, daal sob to pobitro ase.

english_text: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi kunba daal ke bhangai diye, aru jodi apuni, kun jongol laga oliv ghas ase, kolom kori kene dusra majot te bandhi dise, aru taikhan logote oliv ghas laga shikor logote eke hoise,

english_text: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
nagamese_text: tinehoile dusra daal usorte phutani na koribi. Kintu jodi apuni phutani kore koile etu yaad koribi, shikor ke modot diya to apuni nohoi, kintu shikor pora he apuni ke modot di ase.

english_text: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
nagamese_text: Titia apuni kobo, “Daal kunba bhangi ja to moike kolom kori lobole nimite he thakise.”

english_text: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
nagamese_text: Etu thik ase. Taikhan laga abiswas pora taikhan bhangi jaise, kintu biswas pora apnikhan mojbut te khara koridi ase. Etu karone nijorke dangor nabhabi bhi, kintu bhoi koribi.

english_text: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi Isor pora asol ghas laga daal ke nabachaile, apuni ke bhi nabachabo.

english_text: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Isor pora morom laga kaam kora to jani lobi: bisi dangor dukh Yehudi khan uporte girise, kintu Isor laga daya apuni khan nimite hoise, jodi apuni khan Tai laga daya hisab te thakile. Nohoile apuni khan ke kati phelai dibo.

english_text: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan hoilebi, jodi taikhan laga biswas te nathakile bhi, taikhan ke kolom kori lobo. Kelemane taikhan ke aru bhi kolom kori lobole Isor logot takot ase.

english_text: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
nagamese_text: Kelemane jodi apnikhan, ene jongol laga oliv ghas pora kati loise, aru niyom nohoi kene pali thaka oliv ghas te kolom kori loise koile, titia etu Yehudi khan, jun khan he asol daal ase, taikhan ke anikena tai laga ghas te kolom nakoribo naki?

english_text: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
nagamese_text: Kelemane bhai khan, ki lukaikene ase, etu apuni khan najanikena thakibo dibo mon nai, kele koile apnikhan nijor bhabona te nijor to gyaani nisena nabhabibo le. Etu lukai kene thaka to Porjati khan kiman basi kene ase, taikhan purah nohua tak, olop somoi nimite Israel manu mon tan hoi jabole dise.

english_text: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
nagamese_text: Likha thaka nisena, Israel manu khan sob eneka bachai lobo: “Zion pora Udhar-Korta ahibo. Tai he Jacob pora Isor najana khan logote paapkhan hatai dibo,

english_text: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan laga paap moi kitia hatai dibo, taikhan logot te kosom etu hobo.”

english_text: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
nagamese_text: Susamachar hisab te hoile, apnikhan nimite he taikhan to apnikhan laga dushman ase. Kintu basi luwa hisab te hoile, taikhan laga baba khan nimite taikhan uporte morom dise.

english_text: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor pora diya uphar aru Tai pora mata to kitia bhi bodla-bodli koribo napare.

english_text: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
nagamese_text: Kineka apnikhan ekbar Isor kotha namana khan thakise, kintu etiya to Yehudi khan pora Isor kotha namana pora apuni Porjati khan daya paise,

english_text: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
nagamese_text: aru etu nisena, Yehudi khan bhi kotha namana hoi kene ase. Aru apnikhan logote ki daya dise taikhan bhi etiya daya pabo nimite ase.

english_text: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor pora manu sobke kotha namana te rakhidise, titia Tai laga daya to sob manu pora pabo.

english_text: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
