nagamese_text: Oh, Isor laga buddhi, aru gyaan kiman bhi dhun aru bisi ase! Tai pora manu khan bisar kora aru Tai laga bera rasta kun pora bujhi bo!

english_text: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
nagamese_text: “Kelemane Probhu laga monte ki ase etu kun he janibo, nohoile taike buddhi dibole kun ase?

english_text: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
nagamese_text: Nohoile kun pora poila Isor ke kiba dise, Junke Isor pora wapas tirabole lagibo?”

english_text: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sob bostu Tai pora ahise, Tai dwara hoise aru Tai karone he ase. Tai laga mohima hodai hobi. Amen.

english_text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, bhai khan, Isor laga daya dwara, nijor gaw to jinda thaka bolidan nisena dibole apnikhan ke anurodh kori ase, juntu pobitro hoi kene Isor pora bhal lagibo. Etu to apuni atma te aradhana kori ase.

english_text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
nagamese_text: Etu prithibi laga itcha te monjur na koribi, kintu poribortan pora mon notun bonai lobi. Eneka hoile, apuni nijor pora Isor laga itcha to ki ase, ki bhal ase, aru ki thik ase etu jani lobo.

english_text: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
nagamese_text: Moi koi ase, kelemane moike anugraha dise, etu pora sob logote koi ase, apnikhan majot te kun manu pora bhi nijor ki ase etu pora dangor bhabona na koribi, kintu nomro hoi kene nijorke Isor pora kiman biswas dise, etu hisab te bhabona kori thakibi.

english_text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
nagamese_text: Kelemane kineka ekta gaw te alag-alag bisi bhag ase, aru bhag sob pora eke kaam nakore,

english_text: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
nagamese_text: etu nisena amikhan bisi hoilebi, Khrista te ekta gaw ase, aru sob manu ekjon-ekjon laga bhag ase.

english_text: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan ke anugraha diya hisab te alag-alag bordan diya nisena, amikhan pora etu chola bo lage. Jodi ekjon ke bhabobani laga bordan dise, tai laga biswas hisab te chola bole dibi.

english_text: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;
nagamese_text: Jodi sewa kora ase, titia sewa kora kaam te chola bhi, kunke sikhai diya laga bordan dise tai etu kaam te chola bhi.

english_text: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba laga bordan to manu khan laga mon uthai diya laga ase, tenehoile taikhan laga mon uthai di thakibi. Jodi kunba laga bordan to di thaka laga ase, taike di thakibo dibi. Jodi kunba laga bordan to cholawta laga ase, taike hoshiar pora koribo dibi. Jodi kunba laga bordan to daya dikhai diya laga ase, taike khushi pora koribo dibi.

english_text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
nagamese_text: Morom to misa hobo nadibi. Ki biya ase etu ke ghin koribi; ki bhal ase etu ke dhuri lobi.

english_text: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
nagamese_text: Ekjon pora ekjon ke bhai khan ke morom kora nisena kori bhi. Ekjon pora ekjon ke bisi sonman koribi.

english_text: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
nagamese_text: Mon itcha laga kaam te alsi na koribi, atma te mojbut thakibi, aru Probhu ke sewa koribi.

english_text: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
nagamese_text: Asha te anond koribi, dukh te dhorjo koribi, aru prathana te hodai thakibi.

english_text: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
nagamese_text: Pobitro manu khan karone dhun joma kori dibi aru modot kori bole bisaribi.

english_text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
nagamese_text: Kun pora dukh kosto di ase taikhan nimite asirbad dibi; kun pora shrap di ase, taikhan ke asirbad dibi.

english_text: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
nagamese_text: Kun manu khushi hoi kene ase, taikhan logote khushi koribi, kanda khan logote kandibi.

english_text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
nagamese_text: Ekjon pora ekjon logote mil milap kori thakibi. Phutani na koribi, kintu nomro khan logote mili thakibi. Kitia bhi bisi jana nisena phutani na koribi.

english_text: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
nagamese_text: Kunke bhi biya bodli biya nadibi, kintu sob manu age te ki sonman ase etu he kori bole bhabona koribi.

english_text: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
nagamese_text: Jodi parile apuni laga takot hisab te sob logote shanti te thakibi.

english_text: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
nagamese_text: Moi bisi morom kora bhai khan, kunke bhi biya bodli biya naghurabi, kintu Isor laga khong nimite chari dibi. Kelemane eneka likha ase “‘Bodli ghurai diya moi laga ase; moi ghurai dibo,’ eneka Probhu he koi ase.”

english_text: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
nagamese_text: “Jodi apuni laga dushman bhuk lagi ase, khabole dibi. Jodi tai pyaas lagi ase, taike pani khabole dibi. Kelemane eneka kora pora apuni tai laga matha te jui julai diya nisena ase.”

english_text: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
nagamese_text: Biya pora jiti bole nadibi, kintu bhal pora he biya ke jiti lobi.

english_text: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
nagamese_text: Sob manu khan sorkar laga adhikari khan ke sonman kori bhi, kelemane Isor pora nadile, adhikari khan kun bhi nathakibo. Taikhan sobke Isor pora he sthapon kora ase.

english_text: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
nagamese_text: Etu karone kun pora adhikari manu khan laga kotha naloi; aru kotha namani kene bhirodh kore, taikhan nijor uporte bisar saja anibo.

english_text: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
nagamese_text: Kelemane bhal kora khan nimite adhikar manu khan bhoi nakore, kintu biya manu khan nimite bhoi ase. Apuni adhikar manu khan ke bhoi nakori kene thakibo mon ase? Ki bhal ase etu he koribi, aru tai pora apuni to bhal ase eneka kobo.

english_text: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apnike bhal koribo nimite Tai Isor laga noukar ase. Kintu jodi apuni biya korile, bhoi koribi, kelemane Tai hathte talwar to ene dhura nohoi. Kelemane kun pora galti kore taikhan uporte Isor laga khong anibole Tai to Isor laga noukar ase.

english_text: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
nagamese_text: Etu karone kotha mani bhi, khali Isor laga khong pora bachibo nimite nohoi, kintu nijor laga bhabona sapha hobo nimite.

english_text: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena bhabona sapha hobo nimite he apnikhan pora masul bhi di ase. Kelemane adhikar manu khan to eitu khan kori bole Isor laga nokorkhan ase.

english_text: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
nagamese_text: Kunke dibo lage taikhan sobke dibi. Kunkhan ke masul dibo lage, di dibi, kunkhan ke daam dibo lage di dibi; bhoi koribi kunke bhoi koribo lage, aru kunke sonman dibole lage, taikhan ke sonman dibi.

english_text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
nagamese_text: Kunke bhi eku baki narakhibi, kintu ekjon pora ekjon ke morom he kori thakibi. Kelemane kun pora dusra ke morom kore tai to niyom pora ki koi ase etu tai pora purah kori loise.

english_text: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
nagamese_text: Hukum te kowa nisena, “Bebichar na koribi, manu ke namorabi, chor na koribi, dusra manu laga bostu lalos na koribi,” aru dusra baki kotha kiman ase eitu khan sob yate he lagi kene ase: “Apuni laga ghor usorte thaka khan ke nijor nisena morom koribi.”

english_text: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
nagamese_text: Morom to usorte thaka khan ke biya nakore, etu karone, morom pora niyom ke purah kori bole dise.

english_text: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
nagamese_text: Etu koribi, kelemane amikhan ghumai thaka pora uthibole somoi hoise eneka amikhan jani ase. Kelemane amikhan biswas kora din pora etiya to poritran amikhan laga usorte ahi kene ase.

english_text: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
nagamese_text: Rati to bisi lamba jai jaise, din to usorte ahi kene ase. Etu karone andhera laga kaam sob chari kene puhor laga hathiar pindhi lobo.

english_text: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
nagamese_text: Dinte bera nisena amikhan thik berabo, modhu kha aru nisa huwa nohoi, bebichar nohoi, mangso laga itcha nohoi, jhagara aru suku jola nohoi.

english_text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu Jisu Khrista ke pindhi lobi, aru gaw mangso itcha koribo nimite eku jaga nadibi.

english_text: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun biswas te komjur ase, tai logote eku bisar kotha nadiyi kene, taike grohon koribi.

english_text: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
nagamese_text: Biswas thaka ekjon to sob khabo pare, kintu komjur thaka ekjon to khali pata-sata he khai.

english_text: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
nagamese_text: Etu karone kun pora sob khai, tai pora ekjon kun eku nakhai taike ninda koribo nadibi; aru jun manu nakhai tai bhi kha ekjon ke bisar na koribi. Kelemane Isor pora taike grohon kori loise.

english_text: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
nagamese_text: Apuni kun ase dusra laga nokor ke bisar kori bole to? Tai nijor laga malik age te he tai khara korithake, nohoile giri thake. Kintu taike uthai dibo kelemane, Probhu pora taike khara kori dibole pare.

english_text: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
nagamese_text: Ekjon pora din ekta to dusra din pora bhal eneka bhabona kore, kintu kunba pora sob din to eke eneka bhabona kore. Sob manu pora nijor monte he thik biswas koribo lage.

english_text: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
nagamese_text: Kun pora din alag ulaikene mani ase, tai Probhu laga naam te mani loi ase; aru jun manu khai ase, Isor ke dhanyavad diya nisena, Probhu laga naam te khai ase. Jun manu nakhai, Isor ke dhanyavad diya nisena Probhu laga naam te nakhabi.

english_text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan kun bhi nijor nimite jinda nathake, nohoile nijor karone namore.

english_text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan jinda thakile, Probhu nimite ase, aru jodi morile bhi, Probhu nimite he mori ase. Etu nimite, jodi amikhan jinda thakilebi morile bhi Probhu nimite he ase.

english_text: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite he Khrista mori jaise aru jinda hoise, titia he Tai jinda thaka khan aru mori kene thaka khan sob laga Probhu hobo.

english_text: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni kele bhai khan uporte bisar kori ase? Aru apuni kele bhai khan ke ninda kori ase? Kelemane amikhan sob Isor pora bisar korate khara koribo.

english_text: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
nagamese_text: Kelemane eneka likha ase, Probhu he koise, “Moi jinda thaka tak,” sob Moi age te athukaribo, Aru sob manu nijor jiba pora Isor ke shikar koribo.”

english_text: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
nagamese_text: Etu karone amikhan sob nijor laga kaam Isor logot te janai dibo.

english_text: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
nagamese_text: Etu karone etiya pora amikhan ekjon he ekjon laga bisar nakoribo, kintu tai laga bhai laga theng nalagibo nimite, nohoile bhal laga rasta bondh nakoribo nimite monte rakhibo.

english_text: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
nagamese_text: Moi jani ase aru Probhu Jisu naam te thik jani loise, sapha nohua jinis eku bhi nai, kintu kun pora nohoi eneka bhabona kore tai nimite sapha nohoi.

english_text: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni ki khai ase, etu pora bhai laga mon jokhom kori dile, apuni morom te nathake. Apuni ki khai ase etu pora Khrista kun karone morise Taike nosto na koribi.

english_text: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
nagamese_text: Etu karone ki bhal ase eneka apuni pora mani loi ase, etu biya nisena kobole nadibi.

english_text: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga rajyo to kha luwa nimite nohoi, kintu Pobitro Atma te dharmikta, aru shanti aru khushi nimite ase.

english_text: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
nagamese_text: Kun pora Khrista ke eneka pora sewa kore Isor ke bhi aru manu ke bhi khushi kore.

english_text: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, ki shanti ase aru ki pora mili kene ekjon-ekjon ke banabo pare etu bisaribi.

english_text: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
nagamese_text: Kha luwa nimite Isor laga kaam nosto na koribi. Sob jinis to hosa bhi sapha ase, kintu ekjon laga kha luwa pora jodi kunba theng lagi bole dise koile, titia etu to galti ase.

english_text: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
nagamese_text: Jodi mangso aru angur ros kha nimite bhai ekjon ke theng lagikena, aru tai paap kori jai nohoile komjur hoijai, tinehoile eitu khan nakhaile he bhal hobo.

english_text: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga ki biswas ase, apuni majote he rakhibi. Kun he nijor pora mani luwa sob te nijorke galti nabhabi, etu manu asishit ase.

english_text: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
nagamese_text: Kintu kunba pora jodi duita mon kori biya bhabona pora khai koile, etu nijorke ninda kori ase, kelemane etu to biswas pora nohoi. Aru ki biswas te nohoi, etu sob to paap ase.

english_text: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan jun takot te ase, khali amikhan nijorke khushi kori bole nohoi, kintu komjur pora giri thaka khan ke uthabole amikhan laga kaam ase.

english_text: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
nagamese_text: Amikhan sob pora nijor ghor usor khan nimite bhal kori kene taike uthai dibole aru khushi kori dibo lage.

english_text: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista bhi nijorke khushi kora nai, kintu likha thaka nisena, “Apuni khan ke bodnam diya laga bodnam moi uporte girise.”

english_text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
nagamese_text: Kelemane age dinte ki likhise, etu sob aji amikhan ke jonai dibo nimite ase, titia Shastro laga kotha pora mon dangor hobo aru dhorjo kori kene asha thakibo.

english_text: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Etiya dhorjo aru mon dangor kori bole diya Isor pora, Jisu Khrista logote kineka apuni khan mili loise, etu nisena he apuni khan sob majot te mili kene shanti te thaki bole dibi.

english_text: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Titia ekta awaj te apnikhan eke logote amikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Baba aru Isor ke mohima dibo.

english_text: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
nagamese_text: Etu karone Isor laga mohima nimite Khrista pora apnike kineka swekar korise, etu nisena ekjon pora ekjon ke swekar koribi.

english_text: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi apnikhan ke koi ase, Isor he hosa ase eneka jonai dibole sunnot kora khan nimite Khrista nijor he noukar hoi jaise, eneka hoile, khandan baba khan logote ki kosom di thakise etu kori dibo.

english_text: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
nagamese_text: Aru Porjati khan pora bhi Isor laga anugrah nimite mohima dibo. Likha te thaka nisena, “Etu karone Porjati khan majote moi Apuni laga naam laga ke stuti koribo, Aru Apuni laga naam te gana gabo.”

english_text: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
nagamese_text: Aru bhi eneka koi ase, “Probhu laga naam untcha koribi, tumi Porjati khan; sob manu Taike stuti koribi.”

english_text: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
nagamese_text: Aru bhi, “Probhu ke stuti koribi, tumi Porjati khan; Aru manu khan sob pora Tai laga naam uthaidibi.”

english_text: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
nagamese_text: Aru, Isaiah koi ase, “Jesse laga khandan pora ekjon ahibo, Porjati khan majote bhi chola bole taike uthai dibo; tai logote Porjati khan asha thakibo.”

english_text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Biswas kora nimite apnikhan laga monte shanti aru khushi pora bhorta kori dibo, titia Pobitro Atma laga sakti dwara apnikhan asha te mojbut hobo.

english_text: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi nijor bhi apnikhan, ami laga bhai khan nimite khushi ase, kelemane bhal niyom pora bhorta hoi kene aru gyaan-buddhi thik pora apnikhan ekjon he ekjon ke sikhai dibo pare.

english_text: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan pora yaad koribo nimite Isor pora moike diya anugrah te himot kori kene apuni khan ke moi likhi ase.

english_text: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Isor laga susamachar laga noukar hobole, ekjon purohit nisena, Porjati khan majot te Jisu Khrista ke jonai diya kaam kori bole Isor pora moike etu uphar dise. Titia Porjati khan pora daan diya to Isor usorte Pobitro Atma dwara sapha kori diya hoise.

english_text: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
nagamese_text: Etu karone Jisu Khrista dwara moi Isor laga kaam juntu korise etu te phutani kori bole dorkar ase.

english_text: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Porjati khan pora Isor ke bhoi kori kene kotha mani lobole Khrista pora moi dwara kori dise, etu laga bahar te moi dusra kotha eku nakobo. Etu jinis khan to kotha aru kaam khan pora hoi thake,

english_text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
nagamese_text: aru chihna aru Pobitro Atma dwara asurit laga kaam pora. Etu karone, Jerusalem pora shuru hoi kene Illyricum jaga sob phale moi Khrista laga susamachar loijabo nimite hoise.

english_text: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
nagamese_text: Aru etu nisena Khrista laga naam nahuna sob te susamachar prochar kora to moi laga kaam eneka bhabona kori kene kaam korise, nohoile to dusra pora kori thaka bhetimul te moi kaam kora he hobo.

english_text: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
nagamese_text: Kintu eneka likha nisena: “Tai laga kitia bhi nahuna khan pora Taike dikhibo, aru kunkhan pora Tai laga eku huna nai, taikhan pora bujhi bo.”

english_text: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite he bisi bar moi apnikhan usorte ahibole thaka pora rukhi thakise.

english_text: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya, moi nimite etu jaga khan te thaki bole jaga nai, aru moi ahibole itcha kori kene bisi saal hoi ase.

english_text: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
nagamese_text: Moi Spain te ja somoite apnikhan ke lok kori bole asha ase, aru olop din eke logote thaka pichete moi yaatra ja somoite apnikhan pora modot dibo.

english_text: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya to moi Jerusalem te biswasi khan nimite modot loi kene jai ase.

english_text: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jerusalem te thaka biswasi khan majot te dukhiya khan nimite modot pathai dibole, Macedonia aru Achaia te thaka khan pora bisi khushi pora itcha thakise.

english_text: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
nagamese_text: Taikhan etu kori bole bisi khushi pai thakise, kelemane etu taikhan ekta baki thakisele. Jodi Porjati khan pora taikhan laga atmik asirbad bhag korise koile, titia prithibi laga jinis, dhun sompoti aru taka-poisa asirbad khan loi kene taikhan ke sewa koribo lage.

english_text: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
nagamese_text: Etu karone ki joma kori kene taikhan ke dibole anise, moi kitia etu kaam khotom hobo, moi apnikhan ke lok kori kene Spain te jabo.

english_text: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
nagamese_text: Moi jani ase, kitia moi apnikhan logote ahibo, titia Khrista laga asirbad sob loi kene ahibo.

english_text: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu Khrista aru Tai laga morom, Tai laga Atma dwara apuni, bhai khan, mili kene moi nimite Isor usorte prathana kori bole moi apnikhan ke anurodh kori ase.

english_text: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
nagamese_text: Moi nimite prathana koribi Judea te thaka abiswasi khan hath pora moike bachai lobo nimite aru Jerusalem te thaka pobitro manu khan pora moi laga kaam to swekar koribo nimite.

english_text: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
nagamese_text: Titia Isor laga itcha te moi khushi pora apnikhan usorte ahibo aru apuni khan majot te khushi pabo.

english_text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Isor laga shanti apnikhan logote thakibi. Amen.

english_text: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
nagamese_text: Cenchrea girja te thaka amikhan laga bhoini Phoebe nimite moi sakhi di ase,

english_text: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
nagamese_text: apnikhan pora Probhu naam te taike pobitro manu nisena swekar koribi, aru apnikhan pora tai ki modot lage, sob te modot dibi. Kelemane tai to bisi manu ke modot korise, aru moi nijor karone bhi tai bisi modot thakise.

english_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista te moi logot eke kaam kora Priscilla aru Aquila tai duijon ke salam jonabi,

english_text: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
nagamese_text: kun pora moi laga jibon nimite nijor laga jibon khatra te rakhidise. Taikhan ke khali moi pora he nohoikena Porjati laga girja sob pora dhanyavad di ase.

english_text: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ghor te girja ghor ke salam jonabi. Moi laga morom thaka Epaenetus, kun Asia te Khrista laga prothom phol ase, taike bhi salam jona bhi.

english_text: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
nagamese_text: Mary ke bhi salam jonabi, kun he apnikhan nimite bisi kaam korise.

english_text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
nagamese_text: Andronicus aru Junias ke bhi salam jona bhi, kun moi nisena Yehudi aru moi logo bandhi ghor te thakise. Apostle khan pora bhi taikhan ke jani ase, aru moi laga age taikhan Khrista te thakise.

english_text: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Probhu naam te moi laga morom thaka Ampliatus ke bhi salam jona bhi.

english_text: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
nagamese_text: Eke logote Khrista te kaam kora Urbanus, aru moi laga morom thaka Stachys ke bhi salam jona bhi.

english_text: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
nagamese_text: Khrista ke loi kene thaka, Apelles ke bhi salam jonabi, aru Aristobulus laga ghor te thaka sobke bhi salam jonabi.

english_text: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Eke Yehudi manu thaka Herodion ke bhi salam jona bhi. Probhu logot thaka Narcissus laga ghor manu khan sobke bhi salam jonabi.

english_text: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Probhu naam te kaam kora Tryphaena aru Tryphosa ke salam janai dibi. Morom thaka Persis ke salam jonai dibi, kun pora Probhu laga kaam bisi korise.

english_text: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
nagamese_text: Probhu naam te basi luwa Rufus aru tai ama, kun he moi laga ama bhi thakise, taikhan ke salam jonabi.

english_text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
nagamese_text: Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermes, aru bhai khan kun taikhan logot ase sobke salam jana bhi.

english_text: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
nagamese_text: Philologus, Julia, Nereus aru tai laga bhoini, aru Olympas, aru biswasi manu khan sob kun taikhan logote ase, sobke salam jonai dibi.

english_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
nagamese_text: Ekjon pora ekjon ke pobitro laga chuma dibi. Khrista laga sob girja khan pora apnikhan ke salam janai ase.

english_text: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
nagamese_text: Etiya bhai khan, ami laga kotha bhal pora huni bhi, jun khan apuni khan majote dushmani nohoile bhi rasta bondh kori diye, aru apuni khan ke sikhai diya kotha khan laga bhirodh te kori diye. Eneka manu khan pora ghurai lobi.

english_text: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
nagamese_text: Kelemane eneka manu pora amikhan Probhu Khrista ke sewa nakore, kintu nijor pet nimite he sewa kore, aru taikhan laga mitha aru sundur kotha pora najana manu khan ke thogai ase.

english_text: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apnikhan pora Isor kotha mani luwa to sob manu pora jani ase. Etu karone moi apnikhan nimite khushi kori ase, kintu apnikhan bhal kaam nimite buddhi thaki bole moi itcha ase, aru biya kaam phale eku najana manu hobi.

english_text: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
nagamese_text: Shanti laga Isor pora deri nohoi kene apnikhan laga theng nichete Saitan ke pisi dibo. Amikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah apnikhan logot thakibi.

english_text: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
nagamese_text: Moi logot eke kaam kora bhai Timothy pora salam jonai ase, aru moi nisena Yehudi manu Lucius, Jason aru Sosipater pora bhi salam jonai ase.

english_text: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Moi Tertius, kun pora etu chithi likhi ase, Probhu naam te moi bhi salam jonai ase.

english_text: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
nagamese_text: Gaius, kun logot moi thakise aru girja manu khan sob pora apnikhan ke salam jonai ase. Sheher laga bhorali Erastus aru amikhan bhai Quartus pora bhi salam jonai ase.

english_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga asis apnikhan sob logote thaki bole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,
nagamese_text: Aru etiya Taike, kun pora he apnikhan biswas te mojbut hoi kene khara kori dibo pare, Jisu Khrista laga susamachar moi prochar kora, Kun to bisi yug nimite lukai thakise, kintu etiya etu hosa kotha to janai dise,

english_text: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;
nagamese_text: Etiya etu hosa kotha to khuli dise aru bhabobadi khan pora likha dwara, anonto Isor laga hukum pora jati sobke jonai dise, titia he sob manu biswas kori kene kotha mani lobo.

english_text: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.
nagamese_text: Etiya buddhiman Isor ke, Jisu Khrista dwara hodai nimite mohima hobi. Amen.

english_text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
nagamese_text: Paul, Khrista Jisu pora Tai laga apostle hobole nimite junke Isor laga itcha pora he basi loise, aru amikhan laga bhai Sosthenes, duijon pora,

english_text: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
nagamese_text: Corinth sheher te thaka Isor laga girja te, jun khan ke Khrista Jisu logot pobitro kori loise, jun khan ke pobitro hobo nimite matise, aru sob jagate thaka jun Khrista Jisu amikhan sob laga Probhu laga naam ke biswas kori loise.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Baba Isor, aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam pora anugrah aru shanti apnikhan uporte thakibo dibi.

english_text: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Moi hodai apnikhan nimite ami laga Isor ke dhanyavad diye, kelemane Isor laga anugrah to apnikhan uporte Jisu Khrista dwara dise.

english_text: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
nagamese_text: Kilekoile sob te apnikhan ke Khrista pora dhuni bonai dise, sob kotha aru sob gyaan te,

english_text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
nagamese_text: jineka amikhan pora apnikhan majote Khrista laga gawahi koi disele, etu to hosa hoise koi kene amikhan jani loise.

english_text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, apuni khan ke atmik bordan sob dikena ase, etu nimite amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista ke dikhai nadiya din tak apnikhan rukhibole pare.

english_text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Tai pora apnikhan ke ses din tak takot kori dibo, eneka hoile amikhan laga Probhu Jisu wapas aha dinte apnikhan eku bhi bodnam hoi kene nathakibo.

english_text: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
nagamese_text: Isor to hosa ase, jun pora apnikhan ke Tai laga Putro, Jisu Khrista amikhan laga Probhu laga sangoti te joma kori bole matise.

english_text: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
nagamese_text: Etiya, moi apnikhan ke utsah kori ase, bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam te, apnikhan sob mon milai lobi, aru ta te apnikhan majote bhag nahobi, kintu apnikhan eke logote bhabona hobi aru ekta kaam te mili kene thakibi.

english_text: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bhai khan, Chloe laga kunba manu khan amike koise, apnikhan majote bhag hoi kene ase.

english_text: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
nagamese_text: Etiya moi laga motlob etu ase, apnikhan sob ekjon-ekjon he eneka koi ase, “Moi to Paul logot ase,” nohoile bhi “Moi Apollos logot ase,” nohoile bhi, “Moi Cephas logot ase,” nohoile bhi “Moi Khrista logot ase.”

english_text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
nagamese_text: Khrista to alag-alag bhag hoise naki? Apnikhan nimite Paul to Cross te morise naki? Nahoile bhi apnikhan Paul laga naam pora baptizma loise?

english_text: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
nagamese_text: Moi Isor ke dhanyavad di ase kelemane moi apnikhan kunke bhi baptizma diya nai, khali Crispus aru Gaius ke nohoile,

english_text: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
nagamese_text: titia kun bhi apnike moi laga naam pora baptizma dise nakobo.

english_text: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
nagamese_text: Moi bhi Stephanas laga ghor manu khan ke baptizma dise. Kintu etu pora dusra kunba khan ke moi pora baptizma diya to moi yaad nai.

english_text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Khrista to amike baptizma kori bole patha nohoi, kintu Tai laga susamachar prochar kori bole- moike Tai laga kotha to chalak kotha pora kobole patha nohoi, eneka hoile Khrista laga Cross te hokti thaka to sob kaam nathaka hoi jabo.

english_text: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile harai ja manu khan nimite Cross laga kotha to eku bhi motlob nai, kintu amikhan junke bachai loise, etu to Isor laga hokti ase.

english_text: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Shastro te eneka likha ase, “Moi pora gyaani manu khan laga gyaan khotom kori dibo, Aru Moi pora buddhi manu khan ke bujhibo napara kori dibo.”

english_text: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
nagamese_text: Kote ase gyaani manu? Kot te ase pura-likha manu? Kot te ase etu prithibi laga kotha bisi kora manu khan? Isor pora etu prithibi laga gyaan sob murkho te ulta kori dise nohoi?

english_text: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor laga buddhi te etu prithibi laga buddhi pora Isor ke jana nai, kintu jun manu khan Isor laga murkho kotha prochar kora ke biswas kore, Tai eitu khan ke bacha bole itcha thakise.

english_text: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Yehudi khan khali Tai laga asurit kaam khan he bisare aru Yunani khan Tai laga buddhi he bisare.

english_text: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan Khrista ke Cross te morai diya he prochar kore, etu kotha khan Yehudi khan nimite digdari dise aru Yunani khan nimite murkho kotha ase.

english_text: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
nagamese_text: Kintu jun khan ke mati loise, Yehudi aru Yunani khan nimite bhi, Khrista to Isor laga hokti aru buddhiman ase.

english_text: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor laga murkho kotha khan to manu khan pora bhi buddhi ase, aru Isor laga komjur to manu khan pora bhi takot ase.

english_text: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
nagamese_text: Bhai khan Isor pora mati luwa to bhabi sabi, kele koile bisi manu khan apnikhan majote mangso hisab te buddhi thaka nai, apnikhan bisi bhak to hokti thaka nai, aru apnikhan bisi bhak to jonom pora untcha khandan pora aha nai.

english_text: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor pora prithibi laga gyaani khan ke sorom khila bole ki murkho ase eitu khan ke basi loise, eneka hoile gyaani khan ke sorom dibole nimite, aru Isor pora prithibi te komjur thaka jinis khan ke basi loise, eneka pora takot thaka khan ke sorom dibole.

english_text: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
nagamese_text: Isor pora juntu sobse niche ase aru kunke etu prithibi pora ghin kore, taikhan ke basi loise, aru kaam nathaka khan ke Isor pora basi loise, etu prithibi te thaka khan ke khotom kori dibo nimite,

english_text: that no flesh should boast before God.
nagamese_text: eneka hoile kun manu bhi Isor usorte phutani nakoribo.

english_text: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai nimite, apnikhan Jisu Khrista logote ase, Junke amikhan nimite Isor laga buddhiman bonai dise, ekjon dharmikta aru sapha bhi kori dise aru paap pora bachai loise.

english_text: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Shastro te eneka likhi kene ase, “Jun manu phutani kori ase, taike Probhu laga naam te he phutani koribo dibi.”

english_text: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
nagamese_text: Jitia moi apnikhan logote ahise, bhai khan, moi bisi kotha kobole jana nohoile bhi buddhi kotha khan pora Isor laga lukaikene thaka kotha prochar kori kene aha nohoi.

english_text: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile moi nijor itcha pora apnikhan laga ki hoile bhi janibole mon thaka nai khali Jisu Khrista aru Taike Cross te morai diya laga he nohoile.

english_text: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan logote komjur, aru kapi kene bhoi te thakise.

english_text: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
nagamese_text: Moi laga kotha khan aru prochar khan buddhi laga kotha pora nohoi, kintu Isor laga Atma aru hokti pora kori kene dikhai dise,

english_text: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
nagamese_text: eneka hoile apnikhan laga biswas to mangso laga buddhi te nathakibo, kintu Isor laga hokti te thakibo.

english_text: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan buddhi kotha kowa khan to buja manu khan majote kore, kintu etu jamana laga gyaan nohoi, nohoile bhi etu jamana laga cholawta, jun khan etu prithibi chari kene jai ase taikhan laga kotha nohoi.

english_text: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, amikhan Isor laga buddhiman to bujhi bole napara kotha nisena lukai kene koi, juntu Isor Tai laga kaam nimite amikhan laga prithibi nabona age pora basi kene taiyar kori loise.

english_text: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
nagamese_text: Etu jamana laga cholawta khan kun bhi itu gyaan bujhi bole para nai, kele koile jodi taikhan etu bujhi loi, tinehoile taikhan asis laga Probhu ke Cross te mari dibole thaka nai.

english_text: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Shastro te eneka likhi kene ase, “Ki suku pora dikha nai, Aru kan pora huni panai, Aru manu khan laga monte jinda huwa nai, Eitu khan sob Isor pora utu khan nimite taiyar kori kene ase jun Taike morom kore.”

english_text: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor pora eitu khan sob Tai laga Atma pora he dikhai dise. Kilekoile Atma to sob bisari loi, Isor laga ekdom bhitor kotha khan bhi.

english_text: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
nagamese_text: Kile mane kun pora ekta manu laga bhabona janibole pare, tai laga bhitor te atma thaka ke chari kene? Thik etu nisena, kun manu bhi Isor laga bhabona janibo napare khali Tai laga bhitor te thaka Atma pora he jane.

english_text: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan etu prithibi laga atma ke luwa nai, hoile bhi Isor laga Atma jun Tai amikhan ke dise, titia juntu jinis Isor pora amikhan ke eku daam noloikene dise eitu khan ke jani lobo.

english_text: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan manu laga gyaan pora kotha khan nakoi, Atma pora sikhai diya kotha khan he koi, juntu kotha khan Atma pora amikhan ke koi, etu kotha khan atma te thaka manu khan ke bujhai diye.

english_text: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
nagamese_text: Kintu ekjon prithibi manu to Isor laga Atma laga kaam khan lobole na paribo, kele koile eitu khan tai nimite murkho kotha ase, taikhan eitu khan nabuje kelemane taikhan ke bujhai dibole atma to nai.

english_text: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun manu Atma te ase taikhan eitu khan sob bujhi bo pare, hoile bhi jun atma te nai, kintu tai nijorke dusra kun bhi bujhi bole napare.

english_text: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
nagamese_text: “Kilekoile kun pora Probhu laga bhabona jane? Kun pora Taike bujhai dibole pare? Kintu amikhan logote Khrista laga bhabona ase.

english_text: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi apnikhan ke atma te thaka manu khan nisena kotha kobole na paribo, kintu mangso te thaka manu nisena kobole lagibo, kele koile apnikhan Khrista te etiya bhi ekta chutu bacha nisena ase.

english_text: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan ke dudh he khilai ase, aru tan bhat khila nohoi, kele koile apnikhan chabai kene bhat khabole para nai. Hoi, etiya tak bhi apnikhan etu khabole na paribo.

english_text: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan etiya bhi mangso te ase. Apnikhan ekjon-ekjon ke suku juli thake, aru apnikhan khali kotha pora jhagara kori thake. Eneka hoile apnikhan mangso te he ase nohoi, aru dusra manu nisena berai nohoi?

english_text: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
nagamese_text: Kunba pora koi, “Moi Paul logote ase,” aru dusra pora koi, “Moi Apollos logote ase,” titia hoile apnikhan mangso itcha te ase nohoi?

english_text: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
nagamese_text: Apollos to kun ase? Aru Paul to kun ase? Ami duijon dwara apnikhan biswas te ahise, kintu amikhan to Isor laga noukar khan he ase, aru ami duijon to Isor pora diya kaam he kori ase.

english_text: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
nagamese_text: Moi bijon hali se, aru Apollos pora pani hali se, kintu Isor pora he etu ghas ke dangor hobole dise.

english_text: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile, jun bijon hali se aru jun pani hali se etu to dorkar nai, kintu Isor jun pora etu ghas ke dangor hobole dise Tai he dorkar ase.

english_text: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
nagamese_text: Etiya, jun bijon hali se aru jun pani hali se etu duijon laga kaam to eke ase, aru duijon bhi taikhan laga kaam hisab te inam pabo.

english_text: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan Isor laga kaam kora manu ase. Apnikhan to Tai laga kheti kora manu ase, aru Tai laga ghor ase.

english_text: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
nagamese_text: Isor laga anugrah hisab te juntu Tai pora amike ekta pucca ghor bona mistiri hobole dise, moi pora ekta bhal ghor bona bole bhetimul dise aru dusra khan to etu uporte he ghor bonai uthaise. Kintu taikhan ke hoshiar pora ghor to uthabole dibi.

english_text: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile juntu bhetimul bonai kene rakhi loise, etu uporte aru notun ekta bhetimul bona bole na paribo, etu to Jisu Khrista ase.

english_text: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
nagamese_text: Etiya, jodi kunba manu etu ghor laga asol pathor uporte suna, chandi, daam pathor, khuri, nohoile bhi kher laga ghor khan bonai koile,

english_text: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
nagamese_text: sob kisim kaam khan to dikhibo paribo, kele koile etu din laga ujala te sob dikhe, kelemane etu to jui pora he dikhai dibo. Jui nijor pora he eitu khan ke julai kene bhal-biya kaam khan sob janai dibo.

english_text: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
nagamese_text: Jun manu laga kaam to jui pora jula nai, tai laga kaam nimite inam pabo;

english_text: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
nagamese_text: kintu jun manu laga kaam to jui pora julai diye, tai laga kaam khan sob nuksan hobo, hoile bhi tai to bachi jabo, jineka ekjon manu jui jula pora polaikene bachi jai.

english_text: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan najane naki apnikhan to Isor laga ghor ase aru apnikhan bhitor te Tai laga Atma thake?

english_text: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
nagamese_text: Jun manu Isor laga ghor ke biya kori diye, Isor pora etu manu ke khotom kori dibo. Kilekoile Isor laga ghor to pobitro ase, juntu apuni he ase.

english_text: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
nagamese_text: Kun bhi nije ke nijor pora nathoka bhi. Jun etu jamana te apuni khan majote nijorke buddhi thaka manu bhabe, taike “murkho” hobole dibi titia tai buddhi thaka manu hoi jabo.

english_text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu prithibi laga buddhiman to Isor nimite murkho ase. Kile mane te Shastro te likhi kene ase, “Tai pora buddhiman khan ke taikhan laga nijor chal te phasai diye,”

english_text: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
nagamese_text: Arubi eneka likhi kene ase, “Probhu to buddhiman manu khan laga bhabona khan jane, aru eitu khan sob eku labh nathaka he ase.”

english_text: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, etu prithibi te kunke bhi manu khan karone phutani kori bole nadibo. Kilekoile eitu khan sob apnikhan laga he ase,

english_text: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
nagamese_text: Paul hoile bhi, Apollos hoile bhi, Cephas hoile bhi, nohoile etu prithibi, aru jibon hoile bhi, nohoile mora, nohoile etu somoite thaka, nohoile ahibole thaka somoi. Eitu khan sob apnikhan laga he ase,

english_text: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
nagamese_text: aru apnikhan to Khrista laga ase, aru Khrista to Isor laga ase.

english_text: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
nagamese_text: Manu khan pora apnikhan ke Khrista ke sewa kora manu bhabibo lage, aru manu khan ke Isor laga lukai kene thaka kotha khan bujhai dibole jimedari dikene thaka manu nisena hobo lage.

english_text: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
nagamese_text: Etiya, eneka kaam kora manu khan pora ki itcha ase koile, taikhan ke ekta biswas te thik thaka pabo lage.

english_text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan pora, nohoile etu prithibi laga faisla pora moike bisar kora to moi nimite bisi mamuli kotha ase. Kilekoile moi nijorke nijor pora bhi bisar nakore.

english_text: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
nagamese_text: Kile mane ami nijor jani ase ami laga eku golti nai, kintu ami etu jana karone ami nimite kafi nohoi. Hoile bhi Probhu he ekjon ase Jun he amike bisar koribo.

english_text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
nagamese_text: Etu karone Probhu laga chuni luwa somoi naha age te bisar na koribi. Tai pora he andhar laga kaam khan aru mon laga bhabona duita ke bhi ujala te sob dikhai dibo. Etu pichete Isor laga stuti kori bole ekjon-ekjon uporte ahibo.

english_text: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bhai khan, etu kaam khan moi aru Apollos pora apnikhan nimite he kori kene ahise, eneka hoile amikhan pora he apnikhan sikhi jabo: “Ji likha ase, khali etu te he thakibi,” Titia hoile he ekjon pora ekjon ke dangor-chutu ase koi kene nasabo.

english_text: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan ke kun pora dangor bonai? Apnikhan logote ki ase juntu apnikhan ke diya nohoi? Tinehoile apnikhan ke sob diya ase koile, kele apnikhan to nijor pora paise koi kene phutani kore?

english_text: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
nagamese_text: Etiya pora he apnikhan sob ase koi kene khushi ase! Etiya pora he apnikhan nijorke dhuni ase bhabi ase! Apnikhan amikhan ke chari kene nijor he raj koribo bhabi ase, aru ami laga itcha to apuni hosa pora bhi raj korile bhal, eneka hoile he amikhan bhi apuni logote raj koribo.

english_text: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
nagamese_text: Kile mane moi hisab te Isor pora apostle khan ke sob pora pichete rakhise, jineka mora laga sajai diya nisena. Kilekoile amikhan to etu prithibi pora sabole jinis ekta nisena hoi jaise- sorgodoth aru manu khan duijon ke bhi.

english_text: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Khrista karone murkho ase, kintu apnikhan to Khrista te gyaani ase. Amikhan to komjur ase, kintu apnikhan takot ase. Apnikhan to sonman pai, kintu amikhan to sonman napai.

english_text: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
nagamese_text: Etiya laga somoi tak bhi amikhan sob pyaas aru bhuk lagi ase, aru amikhan ekdom biya kapra lagaikena ase, aru amikhan ke biya pora marise, aru amikhan laga thaki bole ghor bhi nai.

english_text: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
nagamese_text: Amikhan bisi dukh pora kaam kore, amikhan nijor laga hath pora kore. Jitia manu khan pora amikhan ke hinsa kore, amikhan taikhan ke asis kore. Jitia amikhan uporte Isor kaam nimite dukh digdar pai, amikhan eitu khan dhorjo kori loi.

english_text: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
nagamese_text: Jitia manu pora amikhan laga biya kotha koi, taikhan ke bhal kotha pora jawab diye. Kintu manu pora amikhan ke etiya tak bhi etu prithibi laga letera jhabara nisena bhabi ase.

english_text: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
nagamese_text: Moi etu apnikhan ke sorom khila bole nimite likha nohoi, kintu apnikhan ke moi morom kori thaka bacha khan nisena sikhai ase.

english_text: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi apnikhan logote Khrista te dos hajar sai diya sipahi thakilebi, apnikhan logote bisi baba khan nathakibo. Kilekoile moi apnikhan laga baba hoise juntu Khrista Jisu laga susamachar pora he hoise.

english_text: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
nagamese_text: Etu karone moi apnikhan ke moi nisena koribi koi kene mangi ase.

english_text: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu nimite, moi Timothy ke apnikhan logot pathaise, jun Probhu te, moi laga morom thaka aru biswas te thik thaka bacha ase. Tai apnikhan ke ami ki Khrista Jisu laga ki niyom cholai ase, aru girja khan te ami ki hikai thake eitu khan sob hikai dibo.

english_text: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
nagamese_text: Etiya, apnikhan bhitor te kunba to bisi phutani hoi ase, moi kitia bhi apnikhan logote nahibo nisena.

english_text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi apnikhan logote joldi ahibo, jodi etu Probhu laga itcha hoile. Etu pichete moi utu phutani manu khan ke ahikena sabo, taikhan logot khali kotha pora phutani ase na dusra hokti bhi ase.

english_text: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor laga rajyo to khali kotha pora nohoi kintu hokti pora ase.

english_text: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan ki lage? Moi apnikhan ke luha laga lathi loi kene na morom aru norom atma loi kene ahibo?

english_text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
nagamese_text: Ami huni bole pai ase ta te kunba khan ase jun khan bebichar laga kaam apnikhan majote kori ase, aru eneka biya kaam khan juntu Porjati khan majote kitia bhi huna nai- jineka ekjon manu tai laga baba laga maiki ke loi kene ase.

english_text: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka hoi kene bhi apnikhan iman phutani ase! Asol to apnikhan mon dukh hobole lage, eneka hoile jun manu eneka kaam kori ase taikhan ke apnikhan logot pora ulai dibi.

english_text: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
nagamese_text: Ami apnikhan majote gaw pora alag thakile bhi, ami laga atma to apnikhan logote ase. Moi poila pora utu manu laga kaam khan nimite bisar kori dise, ami nijor ta te thaka nisena.

english_text: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Jitia apnikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam pora joma hoise, aru ami atma pora apnikhan logote ase, amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga hokti pora,

english_text: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
nagamese_text: etu manu ke Saitan laga hathte tai laga gaw ke khotom kori dibo nimite dibi, eneka hoile Probhu laga dinte tai laga atma to bachai lobo.

english_text: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan phutani dikhai thaka to bhal nohoi. Apnikhan najane naki, ekta chutu khomir to pura atta ke phulai diye?

english_text: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
nagamese_text: Purana khomir ke ulai dibi eneka hoile apnikhan ekta notun roti bona bole laga atta hoi jabo. Kilekoile Khrista, amikhan laga Nistar laga mer bacha to bolidan hoi jaise.

english_text: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ahibi amikhan khushi laga din ke manabo, purana khomir logote nohoi, nohoile bhi biya adat aru biya kaam laga khomir pora nohoi, kintu hosa aru ekta naphula laga roti nisena sapha hoi kene.

english_text: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
nagamese_text: Ami poila laga chithi te bhi likhise, bebichar kora manu khan logote namilibi.

english_text: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
nagamese_text: Ami laga chithi te, etu prithibi laga bebichar kaam kora khan, nohoile lalchi thaka, nohoile thogai diya manu, nohoile murti puja kora khan logote namili kene thakibi kowa nohoi, eneka hoile apnikhan etu prithibi pora bahar te jabole lagibo.

english_text: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya ami apnikhan ke likha to utu manu khan logote namilibi jun tai nijorke ekjon bhai nisena koi kintu jun bebichar ase, nohoile lalchi ase, nohoile murti puja kora, nohoile kotha pora biya gali kora, nohoile nisa pani kore, nohoile manu ke thogai diye. Eneka manu logote kha luwa bhi na koribi.

english_text: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
nagamese_text: Ki kori bole ami abiswasi khan ke bisar koribo? Bhitor te thaka khan ke bisar koribo lage nohoi?

english_text: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor to abiswasi khan ke bisar kore. “Etu biya manu ke apnikhan laga majot pora ulai dibi.”

english_text: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
nagamese_text: Jitia apnikhan majote kotha namile, titia adharmik ukil khan logote faisla kori bole jabo pare, kintu Isor laga manu khan logot jabo napare?

english_text: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi apnikhan najane naki pobitro manu khan he etu prithibi ke bisar koribo koi kene? Aru jodi etu prithibi ke apnikhan pora bisar koribo ase koile, apnikhan pora etu chutu kotha khan ke bisar koribo napare naki?

english_text: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan najane naki amikhan pora he sorgodoth khan ke bisar kori bole ase koi kene? Tinehoile etu jibon laga kotha to ki dorkar ase?

english_text: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
nagamese_text: Tinehoile, apnikhan majote namila kotha thakile, kele apnikhan dusra manu khan ke bisar kori bole diye jun khan girja te naam nai?

english_text: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan sorom khila bole koi ase. Apnikhan majote kunbi gyaani manu nai naki, jun pora bhai khan majote jhagara faisla kori dibo paribo?

english_text: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
nagamese_text: Kintu ekjon biswasi pora tai laga bhai ke faisla ghor te loijai, aru ekjon abiswasi ke bisar kori bole diye!

english_text: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
nagamese_text: Etu karone, apnikhan to shuru pora pura hari jaise, kele koile apnikhan nijor uporte bisar kori ase. Manu khan pora apnikhan logot biya kaam korate dhorjo kora he bhal nohoi? Nohoile bhi etu pora to manu khan pora apnikhan ke thogai diya he bhal nohoi?

english_text: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan nijor golti aru thoga baji kore, aru etu bhi nijor bhai khan ke!

english_text: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi apnikhan najane naki dharmik nathaka manu khan to Isor laga rajyote jabole na paribo koi kene? Apnikhan dhoka nakhabi; letera kaam khan, nohoile bhi murti puja, nohoile bhi bebichari, nohoile bhi nijor gaw ke bikiri kora khan, nohoile mota-mota aru maiki-maiki biya kaam kora khan,

english_text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
nagamese_text: nohoile chor, lalchi, nisa pani kha khan, bodnam kora khan, manu ke thogai diya kaam khan, eneka kaam kora khan kunbi Isor laga rajyo sabole na paribo.

english_text: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan poila te eneka thakisele. Kintu apnikhan ke dhulai kene sapha kori dise, apnikhan ke pobitro kori dise, apnikhan ke Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam aru Isor laga Atma pora sapha kori dise.

english_text: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
nagamese_text: “Ami nimite sob to niyom te ase,” kintu sob to labh thaka nohoi. “Ami nimite sob to niyom te ase,” kintu eku pora bhi ami uporte malik hobole nadibo.

english_text: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
nagamese_text: “Kha luwa khan to pet nimite ase, aru pet to kha luwa nimite ase,” kintu Isor pora duita bhi khotom kori dibo. Gaw to mangso itcha kaam nimite nohoi, kintu Probhu laga ase, aru Probhu to gaw laga ase.

english_text: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
nagamese_text: Etiya Isor to hosa pora bhi Probhu ke uthai dise, aru amikhan ke bhi Tai laga hokti pora uthai dibo.

english_text: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
nagamese_text: Apnikhan najane naki apnikhan laga gaw to Khrista laga bhag ase koi kene? Tinehoile moi Khrista laga bhag ke ulai dibo aru paap kaam laga bhag bonai dibo? Eneka to kitia bhi nahobi!

english_text: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi apnikhan najane naki jitia ekjon bebichar mahila logote biya kaam kore tai duijon ekta sharir hoijai koi kene? Kilekoile Isor kotha te eneka likhi kene ase, “Duijon to ekta sharir hoi jabo.”

english_text: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun Probhu logote mili kene ase tai to Tai logote ekta atma hoijai.

english_text: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
nagamese_text: Bebichari kaam khan pora dur polai jabi! Sob paap juntu ekjon manu pora kore etu to gaw bahar te kora ase, kintu bebichari kora paap kaam to nijor gaw ke paap kori diye.

english_text: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
nagamese_text: Nohoile bhi apnikhan najane naki apnikhan laga gaw to Pobitro Atma laga girja ase, jun apuni bhitor te ase, aru Jun Isor pora apnikhan ke dise? Apnikhan to nijor laga nohoi,

english_text: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
nagamese_text: kele koile Isor pora daam dikene apnikhan ke kini loise. Etu karone Isor ke apnikhan laga gaw dwara mohima dibi.

english_text: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
nagamese_text: Etiya juntu jinis khan nimite apnikhan amike likhise: “Ekjon mota manu pora ekjon mahila ke gaw-mangso te namilile he bhal ase.”

english_text: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
nagamese_text: Eneka hoile bhi, bebichari nakoribole nimite, sob mota laga nijor maiki thaki bole dibi, aru sob maiki laga nijor mota thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
nagamese_text: Mota pora maiki ki bhal lage etu koribi: aru maiki bhi mota logote eneka koribi.

english_text: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
nagamese_text: Maiki to tai laga nijor gaw uporte adhikar nai, hoile bhi mota laga adhikar ase: aru eneka nisena mota bhi tai laga nijor gaw uporte adhikar nai, hoile bhi maiki laga adhikar ase.

english_text: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
nagamese_text: Ekjon-ekjon ke mana na koribi, ekta homoi nimite hoile monjur hoi kene thakibi, titia apnikhan nijor nimite prathana te mon dibole paribo; aru etu piche eke logote ahibi, titia Saitan pora apnikhan ke porikha nakoribo, apnikhan nijor pora nijorke rukhabole napara nimite.

english_text: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi ami etu niyom diya nisena he koi ase, hukum nisena nohoi.

english_text: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami bhabi ase sob manu khan ami nisena hobo. Hoile bhi sob manu logote thik pora Isor laga inam ase, ekjon eneka nisena, aru dusra utu nisena.

english_text: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami shadi nakora aru bidhowa mahila khan ke koi ase, taikhan ami nisena thakile, etu he taikhan nimite bhal ase.

english_text: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi taikhan naparile, taikhan ke shadi kori bole dibi: kele koile itcha te thaka pora to shadi korile bhal ase.

english_text: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
nagamese_text: Aru shadi kora khan ke ami koi ase, etiya bhi ami nohoi, hoilebi Probhu koi ase, ekjon maiki tai laga mota ke chari kene jabole nalage

english_text: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
nagamese_text: (kintu aru tai chari kene jaise koile, taike shadi nakori kene thaki bole dibi, nahoile tai laga mota logote wapas mili bole dibi), aru mota bhi tai laga maiki ke chari bole nadibi.

english_text: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi dusra khan sobke- Moi pora koi ase, Probhu pora nohoi- kunba bhai laga maiki ase jun biswasi nohoi, aru tai duijon thaki bole mon ase koile, tai to maiki ke chari bole nalage.

english_text: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
nagamese_text: Aru ekjon maiki jun laga mota biswasi nohoi, aru tai duijon thaki bole mon ase koile, tai to mota ke chari bole nalage.

english_text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile utu abiswasi mota to biswasi maiki pora pobitro hoijai, aru abiswas maiki bhi sapha kori loise. Eneka nohoile apnikhan laga bacha khan niyom pora moila hobo asele; hoile bhi etiya taikhan pobitro hoise.

english_text: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
nagamese_text: Kintu, jodi abiswas jon pora chari diye koile, taike jabo dibi. Ekjon bhai nahoile ekjon bhoini ke eku bandi kene rakha nohoi: hoile bhi Isor he amikhan ke shanti nimite matise.

english_text: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile oh maiki, apuni jani ase apuni pora apuni laga mota ke bacha bole paribona nai? Nahoile apuni kineka pora jani ase, oh manu, apuni pora apnilaga maiki ke bacha bole paribona nai?

english_text: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Isor jineka dise sob manu ke, Probhu jineka pora sobke matise, eneka he taike bera bole dibi. Aru eneka pora ami sob girja khan te pobitro kotha koi thake.

english_text: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
nagamese_text: Kunba manu ke sunnot kora pichete he matise? Taike sunnot nakoribole nadibi. Kunba ke sunnot nohoikena matise? Taike sunnot hobole nadibi.

english_text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
nagamese_text: Sunnot kora to eku nohoi, aru sunnot nakora bhi eku nohoi, hoile bhi ki dorkar ase koile Isor laga hukum khan mani kene thaka.

english_text: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
nagamese_text: Jun manu ke jineka matise taike eneka he thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
nagamese_text: Apuni ekjon noukar thaka homoi te matise? Etu hisab na koribi: hoile bhi apuni ajad hobole parise koile, etu kori lobi.

english_text: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile tai junke Probhu bhitor te matise, ekta noukar hoilebi, Probhu laga ajad manu ase. Eneka pora tai bhi jun ajad thaka ke matise, tai bhi Khrista laga noukar ase.

english_text: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan ke Isor pora ekta daam tirai kene kinise; apnikhan manu khan laga noukar nahobi.

english_text: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, sob manu ke, jineka taike matise, Isor logote eneka he thakibi.

english_text: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
nagamese_text: Etiya kumari mahila khan laga kotha nimite Probhu pora ami logote eku bhi hukum diya nai. Eneka hoilebi ami laga bhabona di ase, ekjon hoi kene jun biswasi huwa nimite Probhu pora daya paise.

english_text: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
