nagamese_text: Taikhan moi laga aru apuni laga atma ke khushi kori dise. Etu karone, apnikhan eneka manu ke janikena thakibi.

english_text: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
nagamese_text: Asia jaga laga girja khan apnikhan ke salam janai di ase. Aquila aru Priscilla pora Probhu laga naam pora salam janai di ase, taikhan laga ghor te thaka girja logot te.

english_text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
nagamese_text: Sob bhai khan apuni ke salam di ase. Ekjon-ekjon ke pobitro laga chuma dibi.

english_text: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
nagamese_text: Ami laga nijor hath pora salam diya laga likhi ase- Paul.

english_text: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
nagamese_text: Kun pora Probhu ke morom nakore, tai uporte shrap thaki bole dibi. Amikhan laga Probhu. Ahibi!

english_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu laga anugrah apuni khan logote thakibi.

english_text: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
nagamese_text: Moi laga morom aru Probhu Jisu laga morom apuni khan logote thaki bole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
nagamese_text: Paul, jun Isor laga itcha pora Khrista Jisu laga apostle ase, aru amikhan laga bhai Timothy, Corinth sheher te thaka Isor laga girja ke, aru Achaia jagate thaka sob pobitro jonke.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Anugrah aru shanti Isor amikhan laga Baba aru Probhu Jisu Khrista pora aha apnikhan logote thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
nagamese_text: Asis hobi Isor aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Baba, jun daya laga Baba ase aru mon aram diya laga Baba ase,

english_text: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
nagamese_text: Kun pora amikhan laga sob dukh te anondo kori diye, titia amikhan pora bhi dusra khan ke anondo dibole paribo, etu eke anondo Isor pora amikhan ke bhi anondo dise.

english_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile kineka Khrista laga dukh te amikhan bhi bhag hoi ase, thik etu nisena, Khrista te amikhan bhi bisi anondo pai ase.

english_text: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan digdar pai ase, etu apnikhan laga anondo aru poritran nimite ase, jodi amikhan anondo pai ase, etu to apnikhan ke anondo dibo nimite ase, aru etu pora apnikhan bhi nomro kori kene amikhan laga dukh te bhag hobo.

english_text: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan laga asha apnikhan nimite thaka to mojbut ase, amikhan laga dukh te apnikhan bhi bhag ase koi kene jani ase, etu nisena anondo te bhi bhag ase.

english_text: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bhai khan, amikhan uporte Asia jagate ki digdar hoise, etu apnikhan najani kene thakibo dibo mon nai. Ta te amikhan dukh pa to amikhan laga takot bahar thakise aru etu nimite amikhan jinda thaki bole bhi asha nathaka hoi jaisele.

english_text: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
nagamese_text: Hosa pora bhi, amikhan morai dibole hukum thakisele, eneka hoile he amikhan nijor uporte nohoi kene, Isor kun pora mora ke jinda kori diye, Tai uporte biswas thakibo nimite.

english_text: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
nagamese_text: Isor he amikhan ke mori bole thaka pora bachai dise, aru Tai amikhan ke aru bhi bachai lobo. Tai uporte amikhan laga asha to rakhidise titia Tai amikhan ke bachai thakibo,

english_text: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
nagamese_text: apnikhan bhi eke logote mili kene amikhan nimite prathana koribi, titia amikhan uporte bisi manu pora modot kora nimite apnikhan ke bisi manu khan dhanyavad dibo.

english_text: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu nimite amikhan mon dangor kore: aru amikhan laga thik bhabona pora etu gawahi di ase, amikhan ji kaam etu prithibi te korise, etu pobitro aru hosa mon pora korise, aru mangso laga buddhi pora nohoi, kintu Isor laga kripa pora, aru asol to apuni khan logot te he kaam to bisi korise.

english_text: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan dusra eku bhi likha nai, khali juntu apnikhan puribole aru bujhi bole pare. Kintu etiya ami asha ase apuni khan pura bujhi jabo,

english_text: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
nagamese_text: jineka apuni khan age pora amikhan laga bisi kotha bujhi kene ase, titia apnikhan bhi Probhu Jisu wapas aha laga dinte amikhan nimite mon dangor dikha bo, aru amikhan bhi apuni khan nimite dikha bo.

english_text: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
nagamese_text: Aru mon dangor pora, moi age te apnikhan logote ahibole bhabona korise, titia apnikhan aru dusra bar asirbad pabo,

english_text: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
nagamese_text: aru Macedonia jagate jai thaka homoi te apnikhan ke paar kori kene jabo, aru Macedonia pora wapas aha homoi te bhi, aru ami Judea jagate jabole nimite apnikhan pora amike modot koribo.

english_text: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jitia ami eneka pora bhabona kori thakise, moi etu ke asani pora luwa nai, na loise? Na ami ki bhabona korise etu to mangso laga itcha pora he hoise, juntu nimite apnikhan eke somoite “Hoi, hoi” aru “Nohoi, nohoi” eneka koi ase?

english_text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor to hosa ase, etu nimite amikhan laga kotha apnikhan ke khali “Hoi” aru “Nohoi” eneka hobo napare.

english_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor laga Putro, Jisu Khrista, junke ami aru Silvanus aru Timothy pora apnikhan majote prochar kori dise- Tai to “Hoi” aru “Nohoi” thaka nai, kintu khali “Hoi” he thakise.

english_text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Tai bhitor te, Isor laga sob vachan khan “Hoi” ase. Etu nisena Tai dwara amikhan pora “Amen” koi ase, Tai laga mohima nimite.

english_text: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
nagamese_text: Etiya Isor he ekjon ase jun pora ami aru apnikhan ke Khrista te takot bonai dise, aru Tai laga kaam nimite amikhan ke basi loise,

english_text: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
nagamese_text: Tai pora amikhan ke Tai nimite mohor lagai dise, aru Atma laga kosom amikhan laga monte dise.

english_text: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
nagamese_text: Moi hosa pora koi ase, Isor ke ami laga gawah hobo nimite mati ase, moi apnikhan ke saja nadibo karone Corinth te aha nai.

english_text: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
nagamese_text: Amikhan eneka kora to apuni khan laga biswas ke amikhan laga nichete rakhi kene chola bo nimite nohoi, kintu, amikhan sob apnikhan logote mili kene kaam kora manu khan ase aru apnikhan laga khushi nimite ase, kele koile apnikhan laga biswas to bisi mojbut hoi kene ase.

english_text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
nagamese_text: Moi laga mon nijor pora etu bhabi loise, moi apnikhan logote mon dukh hoi kene aru nahibo.

english_text: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi moi apnikhan ke mon dukh kori diye, tinehoile kun pora amike mon khushi kori dibo, ami pora mon biya kori diya khan pora nohoile?

english_text: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
nagamese_text: Aru moi etu eke kotha khan likhi ase, eneka hoile jitia moi ahibo, moi jun khan uporte moi laga mon khushi thakibo lage, taikhan pora moi laga mon dukh nakoribo karone, aru moi apnikhan sobke pura mon pora biswas ase ami laga khushi to apnikhan sob laga khushi hobo koi kene.

english_text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile moi laga mon bisi bikhai kene aru dukh hoi kene likhi ase, suku pani giri kene, kintu apnikhan ke mon dukh kori dibo nimite nohoi, hoilebi ami laga morom apnikhan nimite bisi thaka to janai dibo nimite ase.

english_text: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba pora mon dukh kori bole dise, tai moi ekla ke mon dukh kori diya nohoi, hoile bhi, olop kori kene- moi laga kotha kara nalagaibo nimite- apnikhan sob laga mon dukh koridi ase.

english_text: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
nagamese_text: Eneka ekjon manu nimite etu sajai he thik ase, manu bisi pora taike golti diya to he kafi ase,

english_text: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
nagamese_text: etu hoile ulta apnikhan taike maph kori dibole lage, aru tai laga mon dangor kori dibole lage. Tinehoile, eneka ekjon ke bisi mon dukh pora khai dibo.

english_text: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
nagamese_text: Eneka nimite, ami apnikhan ke utsah kori ase, apnikhan laga morom tai phale thik pora rakhibi.

english_text: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etiya bhi ami apuni khan ke likhi ase, tinehoile ami apuni khan ke porikha kori bole paribo, apuni khan sob phale kotha mani kene ase na nai.

english_text: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
nagamese_text: Junke apnikhan jineka pora hoile bhi maph kori dise, ami bhi maph koridi ase- kele koile ami kunba ke maph korise -junke ami maph koridi ase-, ami apnikhan nimite Khrista bhitor te thaka manu hoi kene maph koridi ase,

english_text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
nagamese_text: eneka nohoile Saitan amikhan pora labh uthabo. Kilekoile amikhan tai laga chalak khan najani kene thaka nohoi.

english_text: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
nagamese_text: Jitia ami Khrista laga susamachar laga kotha jonai dibole nimite Troas te ahisele, ami usorte Probhu laga ekta dorja khuli sele.

english_text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
nagamese_text: Ami laga atma bhitor te aram thaka nai, kele koile ami laga bhai Titus ke ami bisarikena paa nai. Etu pora, ami taikhan ke chari kene Macedonia te jai jaise.

english_text: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
nagamese_text: Etiya Isor ke dhanyavad ase, jun amikhan ke hodai Khrista dwara jiti bole di thake, aru amikhan dwara pora tel laga mitha sugandh laga gyaan sob jagate dikhai thake.

english_text: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan Isor usorte Khrista laga mitha sugandh thaka ase, taikhan nimite jun khan ke bachai loi ase, aru taikhan jun khan harai ase-

english_text: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
nagamese_text: Jun khan harai ase taikhan nimite amikhan mora laga gundh ase, aru jun khan ke bachi loi ase taikhan nimite jibon laga sugandh ase. Aru kun eitu khan pabole thik ase?

english_text: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan bisi jon nisena nohoi, jun khan Isor laga kotha ke bisi halka pora cholai ase, hoile bhi amikhan to hosa pora Isor usorte amikhan Khrista bhitor te thaki kene koi ase.

english_text: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
nagamese_text: Amikhan aru bhi nijorke untcha kori bole shuru hoi ase? Amikhan to bhal naam laga chithi apnikhan pora nohoile bhi amikhan nimite lagi ase naki, dusra manu khan dorkar kora nisena?

english_text: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
nagamese_text: Apnikhan he amikhan laga mon bhitor te likhi kene thaka chithi ase, sob manu khan pora jani ase aru puri ase,

english_text: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
nagamese_text: apnikhan Khrista laga chithi ase koi kene dikhai dise, junke amikhan pora sai dise, kolom pora likhi kene nohoi, kintu jinda Isor laga Atma pora, pathor laga tukrate nohoi, hoile bhi mon laga tukrate.

english_text: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
nagamese_text: Aru Khrista dwara amikhan Isor phale eneka biswas ase.

english_text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
nagamese_text: Amikhan sob parikena sob to amikhan pora he kori ase eneka kobole nohoi. Hoile bhi Isor he amikhan ke paribole di ase,

english_text: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
nagamese_text: Jun pora amikhan ke notun vachan nimite yogya hobole dise; likha kotha pora nohoi, hoilebi Atma pora hoise. Kilekoile likhi kene thaka kotha to mori bole diye, hoilebi Pobitro Atma pora he jibon diye.

english_text: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
nagamese_text: Hoilebi juntu porisorja pora mrityu anise- juntu pathor khan te khundi kene likhise- iman mohima te ahise, juntu nimite Israel laga bacha khan Moses laga mukh phine sabole para nai, kele koile tai mukh laga mohima to komti hoi asele,

english_text: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
nagamese_text: tinehoile, kineka Pobitro Atma laga kaam khan etu pora bhi bisi mohima thaka nahobo?

english_text: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi bodnam kori diya laga kaam khan te mohima thakise koile, dhormikta laga kaam khan to mohima pora bhorta hobo!

english_text: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile juntu mohima ase koi thakise, etiya utu hisab te mohima nai, kele koile etiya laga mohima to he bisi dangor ase.

english_text: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile juntu khotom hoijai ase utu laga mohima pora ahise koile, juntu thaki ase etu to aru bhi kiman bisi dangor mohima pora ahibo!

english_text: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
nagamese_text: Tinehoile jitia dikhi ase amikhan laga eneka asha ase, amikhan mon dangor huwa kotha koi thake,

english_text: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
nagamese_text: Aru Moses nisena nohoi, jun tai laga mukh uporte ekta kapra rakhise, eneka pora Isor laga bacha khan utu laga piche phine saikene nathakibo juntu khotom hoijai ase.

english_text: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi Israel manu khan to taikhan laga bhabona ke bon kori kene rakhise. Kilekoile aji tak bhi purana niyom khan pura homoi te utu kapra ke nahataikena rakhi ase. Utu kapra ke uthai diya nai, kele koile Khrista dwara he etu khotom hoijai ase.

english_text: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi aji tak bhi, jitia Moses ke porhe, utu kapra taikhan laga mon uporte ase.

english_text: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
nagamese_text: Eneka hoile bhi jitia ekjon Probhu phale ahibo, utu kapra ke hatai diye.

english_text: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
nagamese_text: Etiya Probhu Atma ase: aru jun jagate Probhu laga Atma ase, ta te ajadi ase.

english_text: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi amikhan sob, mukh te eku bhi nalagaikena sisate sa-a nisena Probhu laga mohima sai ase, aru nijor bhi eneka pora mohima paikena bodli hoi ase, jineka Probhu laga Atma pora hoi ase.

english_text: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, etu porisorja kaam kori thaka to, jineka amikhan Isor laga daya paise, amikhan mon chutu nohoi.

english_text: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi lukai kene thaka misa khan chari dise, chalak kori kene na berabo, Isor laga kotha thoga baji nimite nacholabo; hoilebi hosa ke dikhai kene Isor usorte sob manu laga mon laga bhabona te nijorke thik korise.

english_text: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
nagamese_text: Hoilebi jodi amikhan prochar kora susamachar to dhaki kene ase, etu taikhan nimite ase jun khan harai kene ase,

english_text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
nagamese_text: jun khan bhitor te etu yug laga isor pora abiswasi khan laga dimag ke bondh kori dise, eneka pora Khrista laga mohima laga susamachar, jun Isor nisena ase, taikhan uporte pohor nathake.

english_text: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan nije ke prochar kora nohoi, kintu Probhu Jisu Khrista ke; aru amikhan nijor apnikhan laga noukar ase, Jisu nimite.

english_text: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor he ase, jun koise, “Andhar pora puhor to ujala ulai ahibo,” jun amikhan laga mon bhitor te ujala korise, Isor laga mohima laga gyaan laga puhor Jisu Khrista laga chehera pora dikha bole nimite.

english_text: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi amikhan logote etu khajana to mati kolsi khan bhitor te ase, tinehoile etu iman dangor takot to Isor laga he hobo, aru amikhan laga nohoi.

english_text: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
nagamese_text: Amikhan sob phale digdar ase, eneka hoile bhi mon dukh nai; amikhan ulta-pulta hoi kene ase, hoile bhi bhabona harai kene thaka nohoi.

english_text: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
nagamese_text: Biswas nimite dukh kosto paise, kintu amikhan ke chari diya nohoi. Amikhan ke mari kene girai dise, hoile bhi khotom kori diya nohoi.

english_text: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
nagamese_text: Hodai Probhu Jisu laga mora gaw ke bukhi kene thaki ase, titia Jisu laga jibon bhi amikhan laga gaw te dikhi bole pabo.

english_text: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan jun khan jinda ase Jisu nimite hodai mori bole nisena hoijai, titia amikhan laga mori bole thaka gaw te Jisu laga jibon bhi dikhi bole pabo.

english_text: So then death works in us, but life in you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite mrityu to amikhan bhitor te kaam kori ase, hoilebi jibon to apnikhan bhitor te ase.

english_text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
nagamese_text: Amikhan logote eke biswas laga atma ase, likhi kene thaka nisena, “Ami biswas korise; aru etu nimite ami kotha koise. Amikhan bhi biswas korise aru etu nimite amikhan bhi koise,

english_text: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.
nagamese_text: amikhan jani ase tai jun Probhu Jisu ke uthaise, amikhan ke bhi Jisu logote uthabo, aru amikhanke aru apnikhan ke eke logote Tai usorte loijabo.

english_text: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile eitu khan sob apnikhan nimite ase, tinehoile kiman dangor anugraha sob phale jai ase, tineka he Isor laga mohima nimite dhanyavad bisi diya he hobo.

english_text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan alsi hoi najai. Amikhan laga gaw mangso to bura hoijai ase, hoilebi, amikhan laga bhitor laga atma to din-dinte notun koridi ase.

english_text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan laga olop dukh khan, juntu olop homoi nimite he ase, amikhan nimite bisi bhal aru kitia bhi khotom nahobole bisi dangor nimite kaam kori ase.

english_text: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
nagamese_text: Amikhan utu jinis khan ke sa-a nohoi juntu dikhi ase, hoilebi utu jinis khan ke sai ase juntu dikhi bole napare. Kilekoile ki dikhi ase, etu olop homoi nimite he ase; hoile ki suku pora nadikhe, etu he anonto ase.

english_text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan jani ase jodi amikhan prithibi te thaka tombu laga ghor to bhangi jaise koile bhi, amikhan logote Isor laga ghor ase, juntu hath pora bona nohoi, hoilebi sorgo khan te thaka anonto ghor ase.

english_text: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu tombu laga ghor te amikhan dukh pora hala kori ase, aru amikhan ke sorgo laga kapra lagai dibole itcha ase,

english_text: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
nagamese_text: Eneka pora amikhan ke kapra lagai dise koile amikhan ke kapra nalagai kene napabo.

english_text: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan jun khan etu tombu laga ghor te ase dukh paikena hala kori ase, bisi bhari ujon bukhi kene, kelemane amikhan kapra nalagaikena thaka hobo mon nai, kintu kapra lagai kene thakibo mon ase, titia mori bole thaka gaw ke jibon pora khai dibo.

english_text: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Etiya tai jun amikhanke eneka kori bole dise etu Isor ase, jun amikhan ke Atma bisari bole nimite ekta bhabona bhi dise.

english_text: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan hodai mon-dangor kori kene ase, etu janikena, jiman tak amikhan etu ghor te thaki kene gaw bhitor te ase, amikhan utu Probhu logote nai-

english_text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan biswas pora berai ase, dikhi kene nohoi-

english_text: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
nagamese_text: Amikhan mon dangor ase, aru bhabi ase etu gaw te nathaki jabo, aru Probhu logote he thakibo.

english_text: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan kaam kori ase, titia, thakile bhi nohoile nathakile bhi, amikhan ke Tai khushi pabo.

english_text: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan sob Khrista bisar kora laga singhason age te khara hobole lagibo, tinehoile sob manu pabo juntu tai nijor gaw te korise, jineka tai korise, bhal hoilebi biya hoilebi.

english_text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Probhu laga bhoi janikena, amikhan pora manu khan ke kotha mani bole koi ase. Kintu amikhanke Isor pora dikhai dise, aru ami etu bhi asha kori ase apuni khan laga mon laga bhabona te amikhan ke bujhi di ase.

english_text: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan usorte aru bhi bhal hobole nimite eneka kora nohoi, hoile bhi apuni khan pora amikhan nimite phutani kori bole ekta homoi di ase, titia apnikhan taikhan ke jowab dibole paribo jun khan khali bahar te he sai, aru mon-bhitor nohoi.

english_text: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan pagala hoile, etu Isor logote ase: nohoile amikhan dimag thaka hoile, etu to apnikhan nimite ase.

english_text: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Khrista laga morom pora amikhanke eneka kori bole joborjosti kori ase, kele koile amikhan eneka jani loise: ekjon manu pora sob nimite morise; etu karone sob manu morise.

english_text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
nagamese_text: Aru kele koile Tai sob nimite morise, titia kunkhan jinda ase etiya pora nijor nimite jinda nathakibo, hoilebi Jun taikhan nimite morise, aru bhi uthise Tai nimite he jinda thakibo.

english_text: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, etiya pora amikhan mangso hisab te manu ke nasabo. Hoi, amikhan Khrista ke mangso hisab te janise, hoilebi etiya to amikhan Taike eneka pora nasai.

english_text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, kunba manu Khrista bhitor te ase koile, tai ekjon notun bonai luwa jon hoise. Purana khan paar hoise. Sabi, etiya sob to notun hoise.

english_text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;
nagamese_text: Aru etu sob Isor laga ase, jun nije ke Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan logote milai loise, aru amikhan ke mil-milap kori dibole laga kaam dise.

english_text: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
nagamese_text: Etu bujhai diya kotha to eneka ase, Khrista dwara Isor pora prithibi ke nijor logote milai loise, aru eku golti khan taikhan usorte rakha nai; aru amikhanke etu prithibi te mil-milap kori bole laga kaam to dise.

english_text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
nagamese_text: Etiya tinehoile amikhan Khrista laga janai diya manu khan ase, jineka Isor amikhan ke cholai kene apuni khan ke morom pora koi ase. Amikhan Khrista laga naam te apuni khan logote prathana kori ase, apuni khan “Isor logote milai lobi!

english_text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
nagamese_text: Jun paap jana nai, Taike amikhan nimite paapi bonaise, titia amikhan Tai dwara Isor usorte dharmikta thaka hobole paribole nimite.

english_text: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan tai logote mili kene kaam kora khan pora apuni khan ke bhi utsah kori ase Isor laga anugraha ke misa-misi nalobi.

english_text: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Tai koise, “Ami apnikhan ke ekta homoi te huni loise, Aru poritran laga dinte ami apuni khan ke modot korise.” Sabi, etiya bhal homoi ase. Sabi, etiya poritran laga din ase.

english_text: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
nagamese_text: Amikhan kunke bhi girai dibole kaam kora nai, amikhan sewa kora bodnam nahobo nimite.

english_text: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, sob te amikhan nije ke Isor laga kaam kora manu khan ase koi kene dikhai thakibo; nijorke rukhabole parikena, dukh te, dorkar te, digdar te,

english_text: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
nagamese_text: mari kha-a te, bondhi ghor te, gondugol te, tan kaam te, ghuma bole napara rati khan te, bhuka thaka homoi te;

english_text: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
nagamese_text: sapha pora, gyaan pora, nijorke rukhabole para, Pobitro Atma pora, hosa laga morom pora,

english_text: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
nagamese_text: Hosa laga kotha pora, Isor laga takot pora; dyna hathte aru baya hathte dhormikta laga hathiar khan pora,

english_text: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
nagamese_text: Sonman aru sorom pora, bhal khobor aru biya khobor pora: thoga-baji nisena, aru hoilebi hosa te;

english_text: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
nagamese_text: Najana nisena, hoile bhi bhal pora jani thaka; mori juwa nisena, hoilebi sabi, jinda ase; mar kha-a nisena, kintu morai diya nai;

english_text: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
nagamese_text: Mon dukh kora nisena, kintu hodai khushi pora thaka; dukhia nisena, kintu bisi khan ke dhuni bonaise; eku bhi nathaka nisena, kintu sob paikene ase.

english_text: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
nagamese_text: Oh Corinth laga manu khan, apnikhan usorte amikhan laga mukh khuli kene ase, amikhan laga mon bhi dangor khuli kene ase.

english_text: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
nagamese_text: Amikhan pora apnikhan ke dhuri bandhikena rakha nohoi, kintu apnikhan nijor laga morom bhabona pora he apnikhan bandhi kene ase.

english_text: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
nagamese_text: Etiya etu laga ekta bhal bodli kori bole nimite to- ami bacha khan ke kowa nisena- apnikhan bhi mon dangor khuli bhi.

english_text: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
nagamese_text: Apuni khan biswas nakora khan logote eke hoi kene namilibi. Kilekoile dhormikta te thaka khan aru niyom nathaka khan logot ki mili bole ase? Aru puhor to andhar logot ki mili bole paribo?

english_text: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
nagamese_text: Aru Khrista to Belial logote ki kotha milai kene rakhibo? Nohoile biswas kora jon pora abiswasi logote ki bhag ase?

english_text: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
nagamese_text: Aru Isor laga mondoli to murti khan logote ki kotha milai kene rakhise? Kilekoile amikhan jinda Isor laga mondoli ase jineka Isor pora koi dise; “Ami taikhan bhitor te thakibo, aru taikhan bhitor te berabo; Aru ami taikhan laga Isor hobo, Aru taikhan ami laga manu khan hobo.”

english_text: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, “Taikhan majot pora ulaikena Ahibi, Aru apnikhan alag hobi,” Probhu koi ase, “Aru niyom pora moila thaka saman na chubi,” “Aru ami apnikhan ke mani lobo.”

english_text: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
nagamese_text: “Aru apnikhan laga Baba hobo, Aru apnikhan ami laga chokra khan aru chukri khan hobo,” Sob pora Mohan Probhu pora koi ase.

english_text: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
nagamese_text: Moi bisi morom kora khan, etu kosom khan thaka nimite, amikhan laga mangso aru atma laga letera khan pora nije ke sapha kori lobo, aru Isor laga bhoi te thik pora pobitrota kori lobo.

english_text: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
nagamese_text: Amikhan nimite jaga bonabi! Kilekoile amikhan kun manu ke bhi galti kora nai, amikhan kun manu ke bhi misa-misi kora nai, amikhan kun manu ke bhi thoga baji kora nai.

english_text: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
nagamese_text: Ami apuni khan ke golti janabole nimite etu kowa nohoi; kele koile ami poila pora koise, amikhan laga mon bhitor te apnikhan ase, aru eke logote he moribo aru jinda thakibo.

english_text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
nagamese_text: Ami bhoi nakorikena apnikhan logote kotha koi ase, ami apnikhan laga naam untcha kori bole bisi ase: ami mon aram hoi kene ase, amikhan laga sob dukh aru digdar te ami bisi khushi paikena ase.

english_text: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, jitia amikhan Macedonia jagate ahise, amikhan bisi dukh te thakise. Aru sob phale digdar paise- bahar te lorai khan asele, aru bhitor te bhoi.

english_text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
nagamese_text: Eneka hoile bhi Isor, jun mon chutu hoi kene thaka khan ke aram diye, Titus aha pora amikhan ke anondo dangor kori dise,

english_text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
nagamese_text: Aru khali tai aha nimite he nohoi, kintu apnikhan pora taike mon dangor kori diya te amikhan bhi anondo hoise, aru moike lok kori bole itcha pora mon bhorta thaka, kandikena mon ghurai aha, moi logote milikena modot kori bole itcha thaka, eitu khan sob khobor huni kene moi arubi bisi khushi paise.

english_text: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile moi laga ekta chithi pora apnikhan ke mon dukh kori bole dise, hoile bhi ami golti bhabona nai, -olop homoi nimite golti lagise, jitia moi dikhise apnikhan etu chithi nimite mon dukh hoise, khali ek ghanta nimite hoile bhi.-

english_text: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
nagamese_text: Etiya ami khushi ase, apnikhan mon dukh huwa nimite nohoi, hoilebi apnikhan mon dukh lagi kene paap pora mon ghura nimite. Kilekoile apuni khan ke bhal nimite mon dukh lagi bole dise, apnikhan mon ghura bole tak mon dukh hoise. Kilekoile, Isor laga itcha te apnikhan mon dukh hoise, aru etu nimite apnikhan to amikhan karone eku te nuksan nohobole nimite.

english_text: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor pora lagi thaka mon dukh to paap pora mon ghura bole diye juntu pora mon chinta nathaki kene poritran pai. Hoilebi etu prithibi laga mon dukh to mora he ane.

english_text: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile sabi, juntu bhal nimite apuni khan ke Isor pora mon dukh kori bole dise, etu pora apnikhan bhitor te kiman kaam korise. Kiman mon bhorta huwa, kiman nijor nimite safai koribo dise, kiman khong, kiman bhoi, kiman mon pora lagi thaka bhabona, kiman biya laga bodla lobole mon laga bhabona! Eitu khan sob bhitor te apnikhan eku golti nathaka nijor pora dikhai dise.

english_text: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, ami apuni khan ke poila likha bhi, ami tai nimite likha nohoi jun golti korise, tai nimite bhi likha nohoi jun galti nimite dukh paise, hoilebi Isor age te apuni khan laga mon kiman bhorta ase etu apnikhan ke buja bole nimite hoise.

english_text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apnikhan laga mon aram te amikhan bhi aram paise. Amikhan aru bhi bisi mon aram pa-a to, Titus laga khushi nimite, kele koile apnikhan sob pora tai laga atma ke aru bhi notun takot kori dise.

english_text: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan nimite ami tai usorte kiba phutani korile bhi, ami sorom laga nai; hoilebi jineka amikhan apuni khan ke sob hosa khan koi dise, eneka amikhan laga phutani bhi, juntu ami Titus usorte korisile, etu hosa paise.

english_text: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga bhitor te apnikhan nimite aru bhi morom bisi hoise, apnikhan sob pora kotha mana nimite tai apuni khan ke bhabona kori thake, jineka bhoi aru kapi kene apnikhan taike mani loise.

english_text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami khushi ase kele koile sob te ami apnikhan uporte mon dangor kori bole pare.

english_text: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
nagamese_text: Etu uporte, bhai khan, amikhan laga itcha ase apnikhan janibo Isor laga morom laga asis juntu Macedonia laga girja khan uporte dise,

english_text: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
nagamese_text: Kineka digdar laga porikha te taikhan bisi khushi pora thakise aru taikhan bisi dukhiya hoile bhi khuli kene di thakise.

english_text: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taikhan jiman parise eneka dise, ami nije jani ase, hoi, aru taikhan logot thaka pora bhi nijor khushi pora dise,

english_text: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
nagamese_text: Amikhan logote bisi morom-mangi kene prathana korise amikhan pobitro manu khan logote milikena kaam kora laga asis taikhan ke bhi punchibo nimite.

english_text: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan bhabona kora nisena nohoi, hoilebi poila taikhan nijorke Probhu logote dise, aru Isor laga monjur pora amikhanke bhi dise.

english_text: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
nagamese_text: Iman tak amikhan Titus nimite bhabona korise, jineka tai anugraha laga kaam shuru korise, eneka pora tai apnikhan bhitor te etu kaam pura kori bole.

english_text: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, jineka apuni khan sob jinis te bisi hoi kene ase, biswas te, kotha te, aru dimag te, aru hoshiar koi kene kaam khan mon diya te, aru amikhan nimite apnikhan laga morom te, sabi kineka pora apnikhan anugraha laga asis te bhi bisi hobole paribo.

english_text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
nagamese_text: Ami hukum kotha koi diya nohoi, hoilebi dusra khan laga mon khula saikene, apnikhan laga sapha thaka morom ke porikha koribo nimite.

english_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan pora amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha jani ase, jineka, Tai dhuni hoile bhi, apnikhan nimite tai dukhiya hoise, etu pora apnikhan dhuni hobole paribo nimite.

english_text: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
nagamese_text: Aru yate ami nije pora bujhai di ase: kele koile etu apnikhan nimite thik ase, kele koile apnikhan bisi itcha thakikena etu kaam to ek saal age te shuru korise.

english_text: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jineka kaam shuru kori bole itcha thakisele, eneka he apuni khan logot te ki ase, etu loi kene kaam to pura koribi.

english_text: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jodi ekjon tai laga ki ase etu pora inam dibole itcha thakile, etu he bhal ase, eku nathaka pora diya nohoikena.

english_text: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
nagamese_text: Ami laga motlob to apnikhan dukh paikena dusra khan hobi kuwa nohoi, kintu sob eke hobole nimite koi ase.

english_text: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etiya apnikhan logot bisi thaka pora taikhan ke dile, taikhan laga bisi pora apnikhan ke bhi dibole: titia ta te sob eke nisena hobo,

english_text: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
nagamese_text: Shastro te eneka likhi kene thaka nisena: “Tai jun bisi joma korise tai logote bisi thaka nai, Aru tai jun komti joma korise tai laga komti huwa nai.”

english_text: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi Isor ke dhanyavad di ase, jun Titus laga mon bhitor te apnikhan nimite bhabona kori bole dise.

english_text: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile hosa pora tai amikhan laga kotha mani loise, hoile bhi bisi mon thaka nimite, tai laga nijor khushi pora apnikhan usorte jaise.

english_text: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
nagamese_text: Aru tai logote amikhan utu bhai ke pathaise, jun laga bhal naam sob girja khan te susamachar nimite ase;

english_text: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
nagamese_text: Aru khali etu he nohoi, hoilebi taike amikhan logote bera bole girja pora basi loise, Probhu laga mohima karone aru amikhan laga itcha janai dibole aru ki anugraha kaam amikhan kori ase, etu kori bole dise.

english_text: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
nagamese_text: Amikhan hoshiar kora to, ki modot kaam amikhan pora korise, ta te kun pora bhi apatti nakoribole korise.

english_text: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan to Probhu age te he nohoikena manu khan sob age te bhi ki thik kaam ase, etu he korise.

english_text: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan laga bhai ke taikhan logot pathai ase, junke amikhan bisi bar porikha korise aru tai bisi kaam koribo mon thaka dikhise. Aru, etiya bhi tai apnikhan uporte biswas dangor thaka pora apnikhan logot kaam kori bole bisi itcha ase.

english_text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
nagamese_text: Aru Titus to apnikhan nimite, amike modot kora aru ami laga sathi ase. Aru amikhan laga bhai khan to girja khan pora pathai diya manu khan ase, Khrista laga mohima nimite.

english_text: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, apnikhan pora girja khan ke apnikhan laga morom dikhai dibi, aru apnikhan laga naam te amikhan laga dangor kotha khan koi dibi.

english_text: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
nagamese_text: Aru pobitro manu khan pora ki porisorja koribo lage etu hoile apuni khan ke ami likhi bole eku dorkar nai.

english_text: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami apnikhan laga bhabona jani ase, juntu ami Macedonia te thaka khan ke mon dangor pora koi dise, ki Achaia to ek saal age pora taiyar ase, aru apnikhan laga itcha jui nisena joli thaka pora taikhan laga mon dangor kori dise.

english_text: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
nagamese_text: Kintu ami utu bhai khan ke pathaise, apnikhan nimite amikhan ki dangor kotha khan koise etu misa-misi nohobo nimite; etu karone ami koi diya nisena, apnikhan taiyar thakibi.

english_text: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
nagamese_text: Nohoile, jodi Macedonia manu kunba moi logote ahikena apnikhan taiyar nohoikena thaka dikhile, amikhan bisi sorom hobo- apnikhan nimite mon dangor pora koi diya to.

english_text: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi etu dorkar ase bhabise ki bhai khan ke apuni khan logot pathaikena ki uphar apuni khan pora dibole kosom korise, etu ke taiyar rakhibole nimite. Eneka pora, etu uphar to asis nisena taiyar hobo, mon khushi pora diya, joborjosti pora nohoi.

english_text: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi etu ami koi ase, Tai jun olop bijon phelabo olop he katibo, aru tai jun bisi bijon phelabo bisi katibo.

english_text: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
nagamese_text: Jiman dibole ekjon pora mon bhitor te bhabi ase, eneka taike dibole dibi; biya paikena nohoi, nohoile dorkar nimite bhi nohoi, kele koile Isor khushi pora diya ke morom kore.

english_text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
nagamese_text: Aru Isor pora apnikhan ke anugraha bisi dibole pare, tinehoile sob jinis khan te hodai bisi hoi kene, bisi pora bhal kaam kori bole paribo.

english_text: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
nagamese_text: Shastro te likhi kene thaka nisena: “Tai sob uphale-ephale kori dise; Tai dukhiya khan ke dise Tai laga dharmikta te thaka khan hodai nimite thakibo.”

english_text: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
nagamese_text: Etiya jun pora bijon phela manu ke bijon di ase aru roti khabole di ase, tai pora he phelai diya bijon bisi hobole di ase, aru apnikhan laga dharmikta laga phol khan aru bisi hobole di ase;

english_text: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
nagamese_text: aru khushi pora diyi thaka te apnikhan ke arubi bisi hoi thaki kene, amikhan pora Isor ke dhanyavad dibo.

english_text: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
nagamese_text: Etu porisorja ke thik pora kori bole nimite pobitro manu khan ki lage etu he amikhan pora di thaki bole nohoi, hoilebi Isor ke bisi dhanyavad di thakibo lage.

english_text: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
nagamese_text: Aru jitia taikhan etu porisorja huwa dikhibo, titia taikhan Isor laga naam untcha koribo, apnikhan Khrista laga susamachar prochar kora nimite, aru apnikhan mon khuli kene taikhan aru sob manu ke diya nimite.

english_text: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan laga prathana apnikhan nimite thakibo, kele koile Isor laga dangor anugraha apnikhan logote bisi thaka nimite.

english_text: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
nagamese_text: Isor ke dhanyavad ase Tai laga kobole bhi napara daan nimite.

english_text: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
nagamese_text: Etiya ami Paul nije Khrista laga niche aru norom hoi kene apnikhan ke anurodh kori ase - jun apnikhan laga majote thakile dorpok hoi kene thake, hoile bhi usorte nathakile ami bhoi nakori jai!

english_text: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi ami apnikhan pora morom mangi ase, ami jitia usorte ahibo moi laga mon dangor kori kene bhoi nalagikena nathakilebi hobo, eneka hoile bhi ami bhabi ase kunba usorte ami biya paikena bhoi nakoribo, jun khan amikhanke bhabi ase jineka amikhan mangso hisab te berai thake.

english_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan mangso bhitor te thaki kene beraile bhi, amikhan mangso hisab te lorai nakore.

english_text: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan laga lorai laga hathiar khan gaw mangso nimite nohoi, hoilebi Isor laga takot pora takot dhuri kene thaka khan ke tanikena niche girai dibole laga ase.

english_text: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
nagamese_text: Misa-misi bhabona khan ke niche kori diye, aru sob dangor saman khan ke juntu nije ke uporte uthai thake Isor laga gyaan bhirodh te aru amikhan pora sob bhabona ke bandi kene Khrista laga kotha mani bole nimite kori diye.

english_text: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan taiyari kori kene ase, kotha namana khan ke bodla lobole, jitia apnikhan Khrista laga kotha mana to pura hoi jabo.

english_text: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan samankhan laga bahar phine sai ase? Jodi kunba manu biswas kori ase tai Khrista laga ase koile, taike nije etu aru bhi bhabibole dibi, kele koile, jineka tai Khrista laga ase, eneka amikhan bhi Khrista laga ase.

english_text: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami adhikar thaka laga phutani korile bhi etu amikhan laga kaam nimite ase, juntu Malik he amikhan ke dise hika bole nimite, aru biya kori bole nimite nohoi, ami sorom kori bole nalage,

english_text: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
nagamese_text: Ta te ami eneka dikhibole nalage jineka ami apuni khan ke chithi khan pora bhoi dikha bole kosis kori ase.

english_text: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, apuni kunba khan koi, “Tai laga chithi khan bhari thake aru joborjosti kore, kintu tai gaw pora to komjur ase, aru tai laga kotha eku daam nai.”

english_text: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
nagamese_text: Utuke eneka bhabibole dibi, jineka amikhan nijor gaw pora nathakile bhi chithi laga kotha te ase, eneka he amikhan kaam te bhi ase.

english_text: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan nijorke utu kunba logote mila bole bhoi lage jun khan nijor laga kaam ke bhal koi thake. Taikhan kunkhan nijor majote kaam khan ujon kore, aru majote nijorke tulona kori thake, taikhan to dimag nai.

english_text: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi amikhan, utu jinis khan nimite phutani nakoribo juntu amikhan nimite bisi hoijai, hoilebi Isor pora kiman tak kori bole dise etu hisab te he koribo, juntu apuni khan usorte bhi ponchise.

english_text: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan ke dikena thaka kaam ke paar kori kene janai kitia amikhan apnikhan logote ahise, amikhan naha nohoi, kele koile Khrista laga susamachar nimite apnikhan usor tak ahise.

english_text: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
nagamese_text: Amikhan ke diya kaam paar kori kene dusra laga kaam te phutani kora nohoi, kintu, amikhan laga asha thaka to, jineka apuni khan laga biswas to dangor hoi thakibo, amikhan laga kaam apnikhan majote dangor hoi thakibo,

english_text: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
nagamese_text: apuni khan ke paar hoi kene napuncha jaga khan te susamachar laga kotha khan janai dibo nimite - aru dusra manu khan kaam kori kene rakha jaga khan te nijor hathte loi kene phutani nakoribo.

english_text: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
nagamese_text: “Hoilebi tai jun naam untcha kori ase, taike Probhu bhitor te naam untcha kori bole dibi.”

english_text: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taike namanibo, jun nijor pora he nijor laga kaam bhal ase koi, hoilebi tai he hobo jun laga kaam Probhu pora bhal ase kobo.

english_text: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
nagamese_text: Murkho nisena hoilebi, Isor nimite amike olop dhorjo koribi, hoi apnikhan moike dhorjo kori ase!

english_text: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami apnikhan uporte bhal nimite suku-juli ase: ami apnikhan ke ekjon mota logote milai dise, titia ami apuni khan ke ekjon pora sapha kumari maiki nisena Khrista usorte dibole paribo nimite.

english_text: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu ami bhoi lage, jineka utu saph tai laga chalak kotha pora Eve ke thogaise, eneka pora he apnikhan laga Khrista te thaka sapha bhabona khan misa-misi hoi jabo.

english_text: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile tai jun ahikena dusra Jisu laga prochar kore, juntu laga prochar amikhan kora nai, nohoile apnikhan dusra ekta atma paise, juntu apnikhan poila pa-a nai, nohoile dusra susamachar, juntu apnikhan poila mana nai, hobole pare apnikhan bhal para taike mani lobo!

english_text: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami bhabona kori ase ami bhi “mohan apostle khan” pora chutu nohoi.

english_text: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
nagamese_text: Kintu ami kotha kobo najanile bhi, gyaan te moi eneka nohoi. Hoilebi apnikhan majote sob te sapha pora dikhai dibole parise.

english_text: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
nagamese_text: Na apnikhan laga naam untcha hobo nimite nije ke nomro kora to ami golti korise, kele koile moi Isor laga susamachar kotha eku daam noloikena janai dise?

english_text: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
nagamese_text: Moi dusra girja khan pora hajira loi kene dakaiti korise, apnikhan laga kaam te modot kori bole.

english_text: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia ami apnikhan logote asele, aru dorkar thakile bhi ami kun pora bhi eku luwa nai. Kilekoile ami ki dorkar thakise, eitu khan sob Macedonia jaga pora aha biswasi bhai khan pora di dise. Sob te ami apnikhan usorte digdar hobole diya nai, aru ami etu he kori thakibo.

english_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
nagamese_text: Jineka Khrista laga hosa ami bhitor te ase, eneka he Achaia jaga phale tak te kun manu bhi ami phutani kori bole pora rukhabo na paribo.

english_text: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
nagamese_text: Ki nimite? Kilekoile ami apuni khan ke morom nakore? Isor jani ase moi apnikhan ke kiman morom kore!

english_text: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi ami kori thaka to kori thakibo, titia kun pora nijorke taikhan bhi apostle ase eneka dikha bole kore aru amikhan logote borabar nisena kore, aru naam untcha kori bole kosis kore, taikhan logot pora moi etu hatai dibo.

english_text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile eneka khan misa-misi bhabobadi khan ase, thoga-baji laga kaam kora khan ase, nije ke Khrista laga apostle khan bona ase.

english_text: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
nagamese_text: Aru etu asurit nohoi; kele koile Saitan bhi tai nije ke ujala laga duth nisena bonaise.

english_text: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite etu asurit nohoi jodi tai laga noukar khan nije ke dharmikta te thaka noukar khan nisena bonaile, jun khan bhi taikhan laga kaam hisab te khotom hobo.

english_text: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
nagamese_text: Ami arubi koi ase: Kun manu bhi amike ekta murkho nabhabi bhi. Kintu eneka bhabile, ekta murkho nisena he amike mani lobi, tinehoile nijor nimite ami olop phutani kori bole paribo.

english_text: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
nagamese_text: Ami ki koi ase, etu ami Probhu laga niyom te kowa nohoi, hoilebi ekjon murkho nisena, etu phutani laga bhabona te koi ase.

english_text: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
nagamese_text: Bisi manu khan mangso te phutani kore, ami bhi mangso te phutani pora naam untcha koribo.

english_text: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan, gyaani huwa nimite, murkho khan ke khushi pora dhorjo kori loi.

english_text: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
nagamese_text: Aru manu pora apuni khan ke noukar bona, apuni khan ke khai diya, apuni khan pora loi diya, manu pora nijor naam untcha kora, apnikhan laga mukh te thapor mara, apnikhan to etu sob te dhorjo koriloi.

english_text: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
nagamese_text: Moi nijor sorom hoi kene koi ase, amikhan bhi eitu khan nimite bisi komjur hoise! Eneka hoilebi kunba naam untcha kori bole ase koile - ami murkho nisena koi ase- ami bhi naam untcha kori bole bhoi nai.

english_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Ibrani jati khan ase? Ami bhi ase. Taikhan Israel jati ase? Ami bhi ase. Taikhan Abraham laga bijon ase? Ami bhi ase.

english_text: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Khrista laga noukar khan ase? -Ami murkho nisena koi ase- ami taikhan pora bhi bisi ase: kaam khan ke bisi, bondhi ghor te bisi, mari kha-a te bisi, mora laga khatra te bisi.

english_text: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
nagamese_text: Pans bar ami “chalis bet laga mar khaise, ekta chari kene.”

english_text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
nagamese_text: Tin bar amike lathi marise, ekbar pathor marise, tin bar ami pani jahaaj bhangai kene dukh paise, ek rati aru ek din ami pani bhitor te thakise.

english_text: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;
nagamese_text: Bisi bar berai thakise, panikhan laga khatra pora bhoi, chor khan pora bhoi, ami laga nijor manu khan pora bhoi, paapi khan pora bhoi, sheher bhitor te bhoi, jongol te bhoi, samundar bhitor te bhoi, misa-misi bhai khan laga majote bhoi.

english_text: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
nagamese_text: Moi bisi dukh paikena raat bhar na ghumai kene, bhuk aru pyaas lagi kene, bisi bar upwas kori kene, thanda lagi kene aru lengta hoi kene bisi tan kaam khan kori ahise.

english_text: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan logote, hodai din moi uporte sob girja khan laga chinta ahi thake.

english_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
nagamese_text: Kun komjur ase, aru ami komjur nohoi? Kun biswas pora giri jaise, aru ami juli thaka nohoi?

english_text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
nagamese_text: Ami naam utcha lagi ase koile, ami utu jinis khan nimite naam untcha koribo juntu ami laga komjur khan ase.

english_text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Malik Jisu Khrista laga Isor aru Baba, jun hodai-hodai nimite asis paikene ase, jani ase ami misa kowa nohoi.

english_text: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
nagamese_text: Damascus te, raja Aretas laga niche thaka Governor to Damascus sheher te sipahi khan logote amike dhori bole nimite bisi bhabona kori kene rukhi thakise.

english_text: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
nagamese_text: Aru amike ekta tukri bhitor te rakhi kene pathor laga dewar laga ekta khirki pora amike niche kori dise, aru tai laga hath pora ami polaise.

english_text: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
nagamese_text: Naam utcha kori thaka ami nimite dorkar ase, kintu etu eku labh nai. Kintu ami Probhu laga darshan khan aru prokahit kora khan kobo.

english_text: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
nagamese_text: Choudah saal pora bisi, ami Khrista te thaka ekjon manu ke jani ase,- sharir te na sharir bahar, etu ami kobole napare; Isor jani ase- eneka ekjon tisra sorgote thakise.

english_text: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
nagamese_text: Ami eneka ekjon manu jani ase- sharir te na sharir bahar te ase, ami kobole napare, Isor jani ase-

english_text: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
nagamese_text: Taike kineka Paradise te loi jaise, aru bujhi bole napara kotha khan hunise, juntu manu kobole bhi mana ase.

english_text: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
nagamese_text: Eneka ekjon nimite ami naam untcha koribo. Hoilebi nijor laga naam untcha ami nakoribo, hoilebi ami laga biya khan nohoile.

english_text: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami naam untcha kori bole mon hoilebi, ami murkho hobole nohoi, kele koile ami hosa kotha he kobo. Kintu moi etu pora nijorke rukhai thake, nohoile kunba manu ami kineka dikhi ase, nohoile amike kineka huni ase etu pora uporte bhabibo nadibole nimite.

english_text: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
nagamese_text: Aru utu bisi dangor kotha khan prokahit kora khan karone nijor laga bisi naam untcha nakoribo nimite, ami laga mangso bhitor te amike ekta kata dikene ase- Saitan laga khobor janai diya jon- amike mari thaki bole etu pora ami bisi phutani nohobo nimite.

english_text: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami pora Probhu ke tin bar anurodh korise moi pora etu hatai dibi koi kene.

english_text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai amike koise, “Ami laga anugraha he tumi nimite kafi ase: kele koile ki komjur ase etu to Ami laga hokti pora he thik kori diye.” Etu nimite bisi khushi pora ami laga komjur khan nimite naam untcha koribo, tinehoile Khrista laga hokti ami uporte thakibo.

english_text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite kitia ami komjur hoijai, gali khai, digdar hoi, dukh kosto din lok pai, aru bisi mon dukh huwa homoi ahe, titia moi Khrista nimite khushi hobo: kele koile jitia ami komjur ase, titia ami logote takot ase.

english_text: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
nagamese_text: Moi ekjon murkho hoise; apnikhan amike eneka kori bole dise: kele koile apnikhan pora moi bhal ase kobo lagisele. Kilekoile eku nohoile bhi ami “sob pora bhal apostle khan” laga pichete thaka nohoi.

english_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
nagamese_text: Hosa pora, sob te dhorjo kori kene, ekjon apostle laga chihna khan dikha bole nimite apnikhan majote kaam korise, asurit aru dangor kaam khan.

english_text: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, eneka hoise naki ami pora dusra girja khan ke chari kene apnikhan ke he biya pora cholai se, ami nijor apnikhan nimite ekta boja nisena nabona to chari kene? Etu galti nimite amike maph koribi.

english_text: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
nagamese_text: Sabi! Ami apnikhan logote tin bar ahibole taiyar ase; aru ami apnikhan ke digdar nadibo. Kilekoile ami apnikhan laga ki ase etu nalage, khali apnikhan ke he lage. Kilekoile bacha khan pora ama-baba khan nimite joma kori bole nalage, hoilebi ama-baba khan pora bacha khan karone joma kore.

english_text: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
nagamese_text: Aru ami bisi khushi pora kharcha koribo aru apnikhan laga atma khan nimite ami kharcha koribo. Jodi ami apnikhan ke bisi morom kore koile, apnikhan etu pora komti amike morom koribo?

english_text: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi eneka hobole dile bhi, ami apnikhan ke digdar diya nai, kintu chalak thaka manu huwa pora, ami apnikhan ke galti adat te dhorise.

english_text: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan ke kunba pathai kene ami labh uthaise, eneka moi korise?

english_text: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
nagamese_text: Ami Titus ke apnikhan logote jabole uksai se, aru tai logote ami ekjon bhai ke pathaise. Titus to apnikhan pora eku labh utha nai, na tai eneka korise? Amikhan ekta atma te berai thaka nohoi? Amikhan ekta rasta te he berai thake nohoi?

english_text: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
nagamese_text: Aru eneka bhabi ase naki apnikhan usorte amikhan nijorke safai di ase? Amikhan Khrista te thaki kene Isor naam te koi ase: amikhan etu sob kori thaka to, bisi morom thaka, apuni khan ke mojbut kori bole nimite ase.

english_text: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ami bhoi lage, hobole pare, jitia ami ahibo, apuni khan ke eneka napabo jineka ami bhabi ase, aru amike apnikhan pora jineka bhabona kora nai eneka pabo pare, hobole pare ta te jhagara khan, suku-jula, khong kora, mara-mari, chukuli, bodnam kora, phutani kora, gondugol khan hobo bhi pare.

english_text: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
nagamese_text: Aru hobole pare, jitia ami aru bhi ahibo, ami laga Isor amike apnikhan laga majote norom kori dibo, aru ami bisi nimite bisi mon-dukh koribo jun khan paap korise, aru bebichari kori ahise kintu mon to ghura aha nai, taikhan nimite moi mon dukh pora kandibo.

english_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
nagamese_text: Etiya ami apnikhan logote ahile etu tin bar hobo. “Sob kotha te, duijon nohoile tinjon pora sakhi korile he khara koribi.”

english_text: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
nagamese_text: Ami dusra bar aha homoi te hoshiar kotha koi dise, etiya ami apnikhan majote nai; hoile bhi kunkhan poila te paap kori thakise, aru dusra sob jon, jodi moi aru bhi taikhan logote ahile, ami kunke bhi nacharibo,

english_text: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan to Khrista ami dwara kotha koi ase na nai etu janibole bisari ase. Tai apnikhan phale komjur nohoi, hoilebi apnikhan majot te takot ase.

english_text: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Taike komjur hoi kene Cross te morai dise, hoilebi Tai Isor laga takot pora jinda ase. Kilekoile amikhan bhi Tai bhitor te komjur ase, hoilebi amikhan tai logote Isor laga takot pora apnikhan phale jinda thakibo.

english_text: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan biswas bhitor te ase na nai, nijorke porikha koribi. Apnikhan nije ke nije pora porikha koribi. Na apnikhan bhitor te Jisu Khrista ase koi kene najane- apnikhan nijor pora porikha te gira nai koile?

english_text: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi porikha kora homoi te, moi khan gira nai koi kene apnikhan janibole moi laga asha ase.
