english_text: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
nagamese_text: Etiya ami Isor logot prathana kori ase apnikhan pora eku bhi biya nakoribole, amikhan porikha te jitise eneka dikha bole karone nohoi, hoilebi apnikhan juntu hosa ase etu he kori bole lage, amikhan porikha te gira nisena hoilebi.

english_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan hosa ke biya paikena eku bhi kori bole napare, hoilebi hosa nimite he kore.

english_text: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan khushi kore, jitia amikhan komjur ase, apnikhan logote takot ase. Aru amikhan etu bhi prathana kori ase: apnikhan ekdom thik hobo karone.

english_text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami nathakikena eitu khan likhi ase, hobole pare ami thakile ami laga adhikar kara pora nacholabo pare- utu adhikar pora juntu amike Malik dise, bona bole nimite, aru bhanga bole nimite nohoi.

english_text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
nagamese_text: Hekh te, bhai khan, khushi kori thakibi! Nijorke thik koribi, mon dangor thakibi, ekta bhabona kori kene thakibi, shanti pora thakibi; aru morom laga aru shanti laga Isor apnikhan logote thakibo.

english_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
nagamese_text: Pobitro chuma pora ek-dusra ke salaam dibi.

english_text: All the saints greet you.
nagamese_text: Sant-khan sob apunikhan ke salaam dise.

english_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha, aru Isor laga morom, aru Pobitro Atma laga sangoti apnikhan sob logote thaki bole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
nagamese_text: Paul, ekjon apostle- manu pora nohoi aru manu laga itcha pora nohoi, kintu Jisu Khrista aru Baba Isor pora, kun he Taike mora pora jinda kori dise-

english_text: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
nagamese_text: aru moi logote thaka sob bhai khan, Galatia jaga laga girja khan ke:

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Baba laga anugrah aru Jisu Khrista laga morom apuni khan logote hodai thaki bole di bhi.

english_text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
nagamese_text: Moi khan ke etu yug laga paap pora bacha bole nimite, Khrista kun Tai nijor laga jibon di dise, moi khan laga Baba laga itcha nimite,

english_text: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: sob mohima Isor laga he hobole dibi hodai aru hodai nimite. Amen.

english_text: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
nagamese_text: Moi asurit hoi jaise apuni khan iman joldi dusra manu khan alag susamachar prochar kora laga kotha phale jai ase aru Khrista laga anugrah juntu te apuni khan ke matise etu pora dur hoi ase,

english_text: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
nagamese_text: aru bhi dusra susamachar prochar kora laga kotha ase kowa nohoi, kintu kunba manu digdar kori bole mon thaka bhi ase aru Khrista laga susamachar kotha ke ulta kori diya manu khan bhi ase.

english_text: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi kunba sorgodoth aru moi khan hoile bhi kunba apuni khan ke susamachar chari kene dusra susamachar kotha pora prochar kore, taike shrap hobo dibi.

english_text: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
nagamese_text: Moi khan poila te kowa nisena, aru bhi ekbar moi koi ase, “Jodi kunba apuni ke Isor laga susamachar kotha chari kene dusra phale pora prochar kore, taike shrap kori dibi.”

english_text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
nagamese_text: Moi etiya manu laga itcha kori bole bisari ase na Isor laga itcha kori bole bisari ase? Moi manu ke khushi kori bole bisari ase naki? Jodi moi etiya bhi manu ke khushi kori bole bisari ase koile, moi Khrista laga ekta noukar nohoi.

english_text: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
nagamese_text: Bhai kokai khan, moi apuni khan ke janibole dibo mon ase, moi ki prochar kori ase etu manu pora kotha kowa laga nohoi.

english_text: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi etu kun manu pora bhi pa nohoi, aru kun bhi moike sikha nai. Kintu, Jisu Khrista pora he moike sob dikhai dise.

english_text: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan moi poila Yehudi niyom te thaka homoi te kineka thakise etu jane, moi kineka kori kene Isor laga girja khan ke kobole napara laga dukh di thakise aru pura khotom kori dibole nimite bisarise.

english_text: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
nagamese_text: Moi Yehudi niyom te bisi bhal thakise aru moi pora dangor umor thaka manu khan pora bhi moi laga dimag he age thakise, moi nijor manu khan majot pora. Moi laga baba khan laga niyom khan bhal kori kene rakhibole nimite moi hodai taiyar thakise.

english_text: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Isor, kun moike ama laga pet te thaka homoi pora alag kori dise, aru kun moike Tai laga anugrah te matise, Tai khushi paise

english_text: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
nagamese_text: moi dwara Tai laga Putro dikhai dibole nimite, etu pora moi Tai laga kotha Porjati manu khan ke kobole nimite, moi khun aru gaw mangso te thaka khan logote etu huda hudi kora nai.

english_text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
nagamese_text: Moi Jerusalem te kun moi laga age te apostle hoi kene thakise taikhan nimite janai. Kintu, moi Arabia desh te jaise aru Damascus sheher te wapas ahi jaise.

english_text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
nagamese_text: Titia moi tin saal pichete Jerusalem te jaise aru ta te Cephas ke lok paise aru moi tai logote pondro din tak thakise.

english_text: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi Probhu laga bhai James ke chari kene, aru dusra apostle kunke bhi dikha nai.

english_text: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi apuni khan ke etu chithi te ki likhise, moi Isor laga naam pora koi ase, moi apuni khan ke misa kotha kowa nai.

english_text: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
nagamese_text: Titia moi Syria aru Cilicia laga jaga khan te jaise.

english_text: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
nagamese_text: Judea jaga laga girja khan kun Khrista logote ase taikhan ke moi bhal pora najane.

english_text: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan eneka koi thaka to he hunise, “Etu manu kun poila te moi khan ke dukh dise aru sob to khotom kori bole bisarise tai etiya to biswas laga kotha moi khan ke prochar kori ase.”

english_text: So they glorified God in me.
nagamese_text: Etu pora taikhan moi logot pora Isor ke stuti dise.

english_text: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
nagamese_text: Titia moi choudah saal pichete Barnabas ke loi kene Jerusalem te wapas jaise, aru Titus ke bhi moi logote loi jaise.

english_text: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
nagamese_text: Moi bhi jaise kelemane ekta prokahit thaka nimite, aru Porjati manu khan logote susamachar prochar kori bole nimite koise. Moi ta te kunba khan logote alag kori kene kotha korise, moi polai thaka to ene pora polai thaka nahobole nimite nijorke bhal kori kene sai thakise.

english_text: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
nagamese_text: Aru Titus, ekjon Yunani kun moi logote thakise, taike bhi sunnot kori bole joborjosti korise.

english_text: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
nagamese_text: Kintu etu sob to misa kowa bhai khan kun lukai kene ahise taikhan nimite eneka hoise. Taikhan lukai kene ahise aru amikhan Jisu Khrista logote bhal kori thaka pora hatai kene amikhan ke taikhan laga nokor bona bole nimite korise,

english_text: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
nagamese_text: kintu amikhan olop homoi nimite thaki bole karone etu kaam kora nai, kintu susamachar laga hosa kotha to apuni khan logote hodai thaki bole nimite korise.

english_text: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu cholauta ase koi kene dikhai (taikhan kineka thakile bhi moi nimite eku motlob nai, Isor manu laga bahar nasai) - kun manu bhal nisena dikhe taikhan moi nimite eku nai.

english_text: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
nagamese_text: Aru ulta he hoise, sunnot nakorikena thaka khan moi logote kaam kori bole nimite basi loise koi kene taikhan dikhise, jineka Peter ke sunnot huwa manu khan ke prochar kori bole nimite basi loise.

english_text: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor, kun Peter ke sunnot huwa majote kaam kori bole nimite basi loise, Porjati manu majote kaam kori bole nimite moike bhi basi loise.

english_text: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
nagamese_text: Jitia James, Cephas aru John, kunke ekta mojbut khamba nisena manise, moike anugrah diya to bujise, taikhan moi aru Barnabas ke taikhan laga dyna hath khuli kene sob dise. Amikhan Porjati khan logote jabole paribo nimite taikhan eneka korise, aru taikhan bhi kun sunnot hoise taikhan logote jabole paribo nimite eneka korise.

english_text: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
nagamese_text: Taikhan khali gorib khan ke modot kori bole nimite anurodh korise, aru moi bhi etu he kori bole nimite bisi mon thakise.

english_text: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Cephas Antioch sheher te ahise, moi taike sidha mana kori dise kelemane tai golti kaam korise koi kene sob jani thakise.

english_text: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
nagamese_text: Kintu, James logote kunba manu khan naha age te, Cephas to Porjati khan logote bohi kene khai thakise. Kintu jitia etu manu khan ahise, tai nijorke Porjati khan pora alag hoi jaise. Kunkhan pora sunnot kori dibi koi kene mangi thakise, taikhan ke bhoi lagise.

english_text: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
nagamese_text: Dusra Yehudi manu khan bhi tai logote misa pora thaki ase, etu nimite Barnabas bhi taikhan laga misa kaam te ulta phale jai jaise.

english_text: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia moi taikhan susamachar laga hosa kotha namani kene thaka dikhise, moi Cephas ke taikhan sob laga majote koise, “Apuni jodi Yehudi ase hoile bhi apuni Porjati manu nisena thaki ase, aru Yehudi manu nisena thaka nai, titia hoile apuni Porjati khan ke apuni nisena thaki bole kineka kobole paribo?”

english_text: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
nagamese_text: Amikhan jonom pora Yehudi ase aru amikhan paapi Porjati khan nohoi;

english_text: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
nagamese_text: amikhan jane kun manu bhi niyom laga kaam kori kene nijorke bhal kori bole napare kintu khali Jisu Khrista logote biswas thakile he pare. Niom mani kene nohoi kintu Jisu Khrista logote biswas kori kene amikhan bhal hobole paribo. Kelemane niyom laga kaam pora amikhan laga gaw to bhal kori bole napare.

english_text: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi, amikhan Khrista usorte thik kori bole bisarile, amikhan nijor bhi, nijorke paapi manu ase koi kene he pabo, titia hoile Khrista he paap kori bole diye naki? Kitia bhi nohoi!

english_text: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
nagamese_text: Jodi moi juntu niyom poila bhangai dise etu bona bole bisarile, moi nijorke ekta niyom bhangai diya manu ase kobo.

english_text: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.
nagamese_text: Moi niyom te thaka nimite niyom pora he morise, etu pora moi Isor nimite jinda thaki bole paribo. Moi bhi Khrista logote Cross te morise.

english_text: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi nijor pora jinda thaka nai, kintu Khrista moi logote jinda ase. Kintu moi biswas pora gaw te jinda thaki ase - Isor laga Putro logote biswas pora, Tai moike morom kora nimite nijorke bolidan kori dise.

english_text: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
nagamese_text: Moi Isor laga anugrah ke alag kori kene rakhi nadiye; jodi dharmik to niyom pora he pabole parile, titia hoile Khrista amikhan nimite mora to eku kaam nai!

english_text: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
nagamese_text: O Galatia laga murkho manu khan! Kun pora apuni khan uporte jadu kori dise? Apuni khan laga suku usorte he Jisu Khrista ke Cross te mari kene dikhai dise.

english_text: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
nagamese_text: Moi etu kotha apuni khan pora janibole mon ase: Apuni khan Atma laga asirbad niyom pora paise na biswas pora huni kene paise?

english_text: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan iman murkho ase? Isor laga Atma pora shuru korise, aru etiya apuni gaw mangso pora khotom kori bole ase?

english_text: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
nagamese_text: Apuni khan motlob nathaka laga kaam nimite dukh paise - jodi etu eku kaam nimite thaka nai koile?

english_text: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Tai kun apuni khan ke Atma dise aru asurit kaam kori kene dikhai dise Tai niyom pora kore na susamachar huni kene biswas pora kore?

english_text: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
nagamese_text: Abraham pora Isor ke biswas kora nisena “Isor he tai ekjon dharmik manu ase koise,”

english_text: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
nagamese_text: etu nisena, bujhi lobi, kun manu biswas te ase, taikhan Abraham laga khandan pora ase.

english_text: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Shastro pora koi dise, Isor age pora jani thakise Tai Porjati khan ke biswas hisab te bisar koribo, Abraham ke age pora etu Isor laga kotha to prochar kori dise, aru koise, “Tumi pora he sob desh khan asishit hobo.”

english_text: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
nagamese_text: Titia hoile, kun manu logote biswas ase tai bhi Abraham logote asishit ase, biswas te thaka manu ekjon.

english_text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, kun manu niyom laga kaam te he bharosa kori kene thake taikhan paap te giri ase; aru etu karone eneka likhi kene ase, “Kun manu etu niyom laga kitab te likhi kene thaka khan namani kene thake, taikhan paap te giri kene ase, aru kun etu nakore taikhan bhi paap te ase.”

english_text: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
nagamese_text: Etiya kun manu bhi Isor usorte niyom laga niyom hisab te thik ase nokobo, kelemane “dharmik manu biswas pora he jinda thakibo.”

english_text: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
nagamese_text: Kintu niyom to biswas laga nohoi, hoile bhi, “Kun manu niyom laga kaam kore tai etu hisab te he thaki bole lage.”

english_text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
nagamese_text: Khrista Tai nijor amikhan karone shrapit hoise aru amikhan laga shrap pora udhar kori dise- Isor kotha te likhi kene thaka nisena, “Jiman manu ghas uporte jhundai tai shrapit manu ase”-

english_text: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
nagamese_text: etu pora Abraham laga asirbad Porjati khan logote Jisu Khrista dwara ahibo, aru biswas pora amikhan Atma laga kosom pabo.

english_text: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, manu laga hisab te he moi kotha koribo. Manu pora bonai diya kagos te, nijor khushi pora eku bodli aru hatai dibole na paribo, jodi etu niyom laga niyom te bonai loise koile.

english_text: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
nagamese_text: Etiya etu kosom Abraham aru tai laga manu khan logote koi dise. Ta te eneka kowa nai, “khandan khan ke,” bisi manu ke kowa nisena, kintu khali ekjon ke he koise, “aru tumi laga khandan manu ke,” kun Khrista ase.

english_text: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
nagamese_text: Etiya moi kobole thaka to hoile: etu niyom, kun to 430 saal pichete ahise, Isor pora age dinte kun to kosom dise aru ki kaam nimite dise etu hatai nadiye.

english_text: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
nagamese_text: Jodi niyom pora he amikhan Isor logote thaki bole pare koile, titia hoile etu kosom diya pora aha nohoi jabo. Kintu Isor he Abraham ke kosom dwara dise.

english_text: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
nagamese_text: Titia, hoile, niyom ki nimite dise? Etu dise kelemane paap bisi hoija pora, jitia tak Abraham laga pidhi pora kosom diya laga ekjon nahe, titia tak choli bo karone disele. Etu niyom sorgodoth khan dwara ekjon pora joborjosti hali dise.

english_text: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
nagamese_text: Etiya manu laga majote kotha milai diya manu ekjon pora bhi bisi thake, kintu Isor to ekta he ase.

english_text: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
nagamese_text: Eneka hoile, niyom to Isor laga kosom pora bhi dangor ase naki? Eneka nohoi! Kelemane jodi niyom pora he jibon pabole parise koile, titia hoile dharmikta bhi niyom pora he ahibole thakise.

english_text: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
nagamese_text: Kintu Shastro pora sobke paap logote bondh kori dise. Isor pora eneka korise kelemane kun manu biswas kore taikhan ke kosom diya nisena Jisu Khrista pora bachai dibo.

english_text: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
nagamese_text: Etiya biswas naha age te, amikhan ke niyom pora dhori kene rakhi thakise, jitia tak biswas to dikhai diya nai.

english_text: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
nagamese_text: Kanun pora he amikhan ke sai thakise jitia tak Jisu Khrista amikhan logote aha nai, biswas pora he amikhan ke bisar koribo nimite.

english_text: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya biswas to ahi jaise, amikhan etiya to dusra manu laga nichete nai.

english_text: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kelemane biswas pora Jisu Khrista te apnikhan sob Isor laga bacha khan ase.

english_text: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
nagamese_text: Kiman manu Khrista logote baptizma loise taikhan sob nijorke Khrista laga kapra pindhai loise.

english_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Ta te aru Yehudi aru Yunani nai, ta te aru sewa kora aru ajad thaka nai, ta te mota aru mahila nai, apuni khan sob Jisu Khrista logote ekta ase.

english_text: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni Khrista laga ase, titia hoile apuni Abraham laga pidhi ase, aru kosom dikene thaka laga waris khan ase.

english_text: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
nagamese_text: Kintu moi koi ase, uttoradhikari to, jitia tak tai chutu bacha ase, tai nijor laga mati bari bisi thakile bhi, tai manu laga sewa kora manu nisena he ase.

english_text: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
nagamese_text: Kintu bacha khan ke manu khan pora sai dibo jitia tak Tai laga Baba pora thik homoi to nadiye.

english_text: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jitia amikhan bacha thakise, amikhan prithibi laga niyom hisab te chuli kene sewa kori thakise.

english_text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia thik homoi hoise, Isor he Tai laga Putro ke pathaise, ekjon mahila pora jonom korise, niyom te jonom korise.

english_text: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
nagamese_text: Kunkhan niyom nichete dabi kene ase taikhan ke udhar kori bole nimite Tai eneka korise, etu pora amikhan bhi Tai laga bacha khan hoi jabole nimite.

english_text: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan bacha khan ase, Isor he Tai laga Putro laga Atma moi khan laga monte pathai dise, kunke, “Sorgote thaka Baba,” koi kene mate.

english_text: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apuni khan aru sewa kora manu nohoi, kintu ekjon chokra ase, aru jodi ekjon chokra ase koile, titia to apuni bhi Isor dwara Tai laga ekjon uttoradhikari hoise.

english_text: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
nagamese_text: Kintu, poila somoite to, tumikhan Isor ke najani kene thakise, aru tumikhan ke sewa koribo dise jun khan, niyom pora Isor khan nohoi.

english_text: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya apuni khan Isor ke jani loise, aru Isor pora bhi apuni khan ke jani loise, titia hoile kele apuni khan komjur aru biya rasta phale jai ase? Apuni khan aru bhi taikhan laga nichete sewa kori bole mon ase?

english_text: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan notun din, notun chand, notun saal aru mohina khan mani thake!

english_text: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
nagamese_text: Ki kaam apuni khan nimite moi kori dise etu eku labh nathaka hoi jabole bhoi lagi ase.

english_text: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi apuni khan ke anurodh kori ase, moi nisena hoi jabi, kelemane moi apuni khan nisena hoi jaise. Apuni khan moike eku biya kaam kori diya nai.

english_text: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni khan jane moi gaw pora bemar thaka nimite etu bhal kotha khan apuni khan ke poila pora prochar kori dise.

english_text: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Moi laga gaw saikene apuni khan dukh pai ase, hoile bhi apuni khan moike chara nai. Aru apuni khan moike Isor laga sorgodoth thaka nisena bhal kori kene moike saise, Jisu Khrista to moi he thaka nisena.

english_text: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
nagamese_text: Titia, hoile, apuni laga asirbad to etiya kote ase? Moi apuni khan ke etu gawahi di ase, jodi parise koile, apuni khan nijor pora nijor laga suku ulaikene moike di dibole thakise.

english_text: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, moi apuni khan ke hosa kotha to koi diya nimite apuni laga dushman hoi jaise?

english_text: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan apuni ke jiti lobole nimite joli ase, kintu bhal nimite nohoi. Taikhan apuni ke chup kori dibole mon ase, etu pora apuni taikhan uporte he mon thakibo nimite.

english_text: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
nagamese_text: Kintu hodai bhal kaam kori bole nimite mon jola to bhal ase, aru khali moi apuni khan logote thaka homoi te nohoi.

english_text: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
nagamese_text: Moi laga chutu bacha khan, jitia tak Jisu Khrista apuni khan bhitor te jonom noloi titia tak moi ekjon mahila pora bacha jonom dibole dukh pa nisena pai thakibo.

english_text: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi itcha kore apuni khan logote thaki kene moi kotha kora laga adat to bodli kori bole nimite, kelemane moi apuni khan nimite bisi chinta ase.

english_text: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
nagamese_text: Moike kobi, apuni khan kun niyom laga nichete thaki bole mon ase, apuni khan niyom to mani kene nathake naki?

english_text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
nagamese_text: Isor kotha te likha ase, Abraham laga duijon bacha thakise, ekjon to sewa kora maiki laga bacha aru ekjon to ajad thaka maiki laga bacha.

english_text: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
nagamese_text: Kintu ekjon sewa kora maiki gaw pora jonom loise, aru ekjon to kosom diya nisena ajad thaka maiki pora jonom loise.

english_text: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob to ekta dristanto nisena koi dibole nimite, kelemane etu maiki khan duita kosom loi kene ase. Ekjon to hoile Sinai pahar pora ase aru tai nokor kora bacha khan ke jonom dise. Tai Hagar ase.

english_text: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
nagamese_text: Etiya Hagar to Sinai Pahar nisena ase, juntu Arabia te ase; aru tai etiya laga Jerusalem nisena bhi ase, kelemane tai laga bacha khan ke loi kene sewa kori kene thaki ase.

english_text: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jerusalem kun to uporte ase, etu to ajad ase, aru tai moi khan laga ama ase.

english_text: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor kotha te eneka likha ase, “Khushi koribi maiki, kun bacha jonom kori bole napare; Hala kori kene khushi pora kandibi, apuni khan kun bacha jonom kora laga dukh panai; Kelemane ekta chari diye maiki laga bacha khan he bisi ase Jun maiki khan laga mota taikhan logote ase.”

english_text: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni, bhai khan, Isaac nisena, kosom diya laga bacha khan ase.

english_text: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
nagamese_text: Kintu ekta homoi te kun gaw mangso pora jonom loise Isor Atma pora jonom luwa ekjon ke dukh dise. Etiya bhi eneka ase.

english_text: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor kotha pora ki koi ase? “Sewa kora laga maiki aru tai laga chokra ke pathai dibi. Kelemane sewa kora maiki laga chokra aru ajad thaka maiki laga chokra eke logote thaki bole na paribo.”

english_text: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan, moi khan sewa kora maiki laga bacha khan nohoi, kintu ajad thaka maiki laga bacha khan ase.

english_text: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista pora moi khan ke ajad kori dise. Thik pora khara hoi jabi, etu nimite, aru paap laga kaam ke aru bhi sewa nokoribi.

english_text: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
nagamese_text: Sabi, moi, Paul, apuni khan ke koi ase, jodi apuni khan bhi sunnot korise koile, etu kora nimite apuni khan Khrista ke luwa to eku labh nai.

english_text: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi sob manu khan ke etu gawahi di ase kun manu nijorke sunnot kori loise, tai to pura niyom mani kene thakibo lage.

english_text: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan Khrista usor pora kati dise, apuni khan ke niyom laga niyom pora he bisar koribo; apuni khan Tai laga anugrah pora giri jaise.

english_text: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga Atma pora, aru biswas pora, amikhan dharmikta nimite asha kori kene rukhi ase.

english_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Jisu Khrista nimite sunnot kora aru nakora laga eku motlob nai, kintu morom dwara he biswas to kaam kore.

english_text: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
nagamese_text: Apuni bhal pora polai thakisele. Kun pora apuni ke hosa kotha mani kene thaki bole nimite rukhai rakhise?

english_text: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
nagamese_text: Isor, jun pora apuni ke matise Tai eneka kaam nakore!

english_text: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
nagamese_text: Ekta chutu khomir pora pura roti to dangor phuli bole diye.

english_text: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan uporte Probhu laga naam te pura biswas ase apuni khan dusra phale nasabo. Kintu, kun manu apuni ke digdar kori ase tai sajai pabo, tai kun hoile bhi.

english_text: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
nagamese_text: Kintu bhai khan, jodi moi etiya bhi apuni khan sunnot kori bole laga kotha koi ase, titia hoile moi kele dukh kosto pai ase? Eneka ase koile Cross usorte ahibole laga rasta bondh kori kene thaka to hatai dise.

english_text: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
nagamese_text: Kun manu apuni khan ke digdar kori ase, moi itcha kori ase taikhan nijorke sunnot koribo nimite!

english_text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan ke ajad thaki bole nimite mati loise, bhai khan. Kintu apuni khan ke ki nimite matise etu biya aru paap laga kaam pora nacholabi, hoilebi, morom dwara ekjon-ekjon ke sewa kori bhi.

english_text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane pura niyom to ekta hukum pora he pura kori kene ase, etu hoile, “Apuni nijorke morom kora nisena apuni laga ghor usor manu ke bhi morom koribi.”

english_text: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni khan ekjon-ekjon logote biya kori bole bisare, titia hoile sai lobi apuni khan ekjon-ekjon ke khotom kori nadibo nimite.

english_text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi koi ase, Pobitro Atma pora berabi titia apuni paap laga kaam aru itcha khan nabukhibo.

english_text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
nagamese_text: Kelemane beya kaam laga itcha khan Pobitro Atma logote namile, aru Pobitro Atma laga kaam khan paap laga kaam ke bhirodh kore. Kelemane etu duita ekjon-ekjon logote namile, etu pora apuni ki kori bole mon jai etu kori bole napare.

english_text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni ke Pobitro Atma pora cholai kene loijai, titia apuni niyom laga nichete nai.

english_text: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
nagamese_text: Etiya paap laga kaam eneka khan ase: bebichari, sapha nathaka kaam,

english_text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
nagamese_text: murti puja kora, jadu tona kora, hinsa kora, suku jola, khong uthi thaka, manu pora bhi bisi bhal kori bole mon juwa, aru, bhag kori diya,

english_text: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
nagamese_text: nisa hoi thaka, nisa te khushi kora, eneka khan ase. Apuni khan ke etu kaam pora hoshiar kori ase, moi poila bhi koi dise, kun manu etu kaam khan kori thake taikhan Isor laga rajyote jabole na paribo.

english_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
nagamese_text: Kintu Pobitro Atma laga phol ase morom, khushi, shanti, dhorjo, bhal niyom, aru biswas,

english_text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
nagamese_text: nomro, aru nijorke biya kaam pora rukhai kene rakha; eitu khan nimite eku niyom nai.

english_text: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
nagamese_text: Kintu, kun manu Jisu Khrista laga ase taikhan laga sob paap laga itcha khan Cross te morai dise.

english_text: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan Atma te thake, titia hoile amikhan bhi Atma te bera bole lage.

english_text: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
nagamese_text: Amikhan nijor uporte phutani nokorile, dusra ke biya nokobo, aru ekjon-ekjon logote suku nojolibo.

english_text: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, jodi kunba ke biya kaam kori kene dhure, apuni khan kun Atma te ase taikhan ke nomro laga atma pora uthai lobi. Nijor nimite chinta thakibi, apuni khan bhi porikha nohobole nimite.

english_text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
nagamese_text: Ek dusra laga boja to uthai lobi, aru Khrista laga niyom ki ase eitu khan pura koribi.

english_text: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu tai bhal nohoile bhi nijorke bhal bhabe, tai nijor taike thogai di ase.

english_text: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
nagamese_text: Sob manu nijor laga kaam to bhal pora sai lobi, etu pora tai nijorke saikene phutani kori bole paribo kintu dusra ke saikene nohoi.

english_text: For each man will bear his own burden.
nagamese_text: Kelemane nijor he nijor laga boja bukhi bole ase.

english_text: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Isor laga kotha sikhai, tai sikhai diya manu logote mili kene sob bhal kaam khan kori bole lage.

english_text: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
nagamese_text: Nijorke nothogabi. Isor ke sorom khila bole napare, ekjon manu pora ki kaam kore, tai etu hisab te he pabo.

english_text: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kun manu tai nijor laga paap laga bijon dhale, etu paap pora he tai khotom hoi jabo. Kintu kun manu Atma laga bijon dhale, etu Atma pora he tai anonto jibon pabo.

english_text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan bhal kaam kori bole nimite alchi nokorile, kelemane thik homoi te amikhan kheti katibo, jodi amikhan alchi nakore.

english_text: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, amikhan kori bole para homoi te, sob manu nimite bhal kaam koribo, arubi bisi koribo taikhan nimite jun khan biswasi hoise.

english_text: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
nagamese_text: Sabi moi nijor laga hath pora apnikhan ke iman dangor chithi likhi dise.

english_text: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
nagamese_text: Kun manu gaw mangso pora bhal dikha bole mon ase taikhan apuni khan ke sunnot kori dibole mon ase. Taikhan Jisu Khrista laga Cross nimite dukh napabole eneka kori ase.

english_text: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
nagamese_text: Kun manu sunnot kori loise taikhan nijor bhi niyom mani kene nathake, kintu taikhan apuni ke sunnot kori dibole mon ase kelemane taikhan apuni laga gaw loi kene phutani kori bole nimite.

english_text: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
nagamese_text: Moi khali Jisu Khrista laga Cross te he phutani koribo, etu pora pura prithibi moi logote Cross te mari dise, aru moi etu prithibi logote.

english_text: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sunnot kori luwa aru nakora to eku ginti nakore, kintu ki ginti kore koile ekta notun bonai diya manu.

english_text: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
nagamese_text: Kun manu bhal pora thaki ase, shanti aru daya apuni khan logote thaki bole dibi, Israel laga Isor logote bhi thaki bole dibi.

english_text: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
nagamese_text: Etiya pora moike kun bhi digdar nokoribi, kelemane moi Jisu laga dagi moi laga gaw te loi kene ase.

english_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah apuni khan laga Atma logote thaki bole dibi, bhai khan. Amen.

english_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
nagamese_text: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon apostle pora Ephesus sheher te thaka pobitro khan aru Khrista Jisu logote biswasi thaka khan ke likhi ase.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Baba aru, Jisu Khrista laga anugrah aru shanti apuni logote thakibo dibi.

english_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista laga Isor aru Baba ke proshansa thakibo dibi, jun pora amikhan ke atma laga sob asirbad dise, Khrista dwara,

english_text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
nagamese_text: jineka Isor amikhan ke prithibi bona age te bisari loise, tai usorte pobitro aru galti nohoikena thakibo nimite.

english_text: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
nagamese_text: Tai laga itcha te Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan ke Tai nijor laga pali luwa bacha khan hobole basi loise,

english_text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.
nagamese_text: Tai laga anugrah laga mohima juntu Tai amikhan ke ene pora dise Tai laga Sobse Morom Thaka Ekjon dwara,

english_text: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
nagamese_text: Tai laga khun pora he amikhan udhar kori loise, aru Tai laga dangor anugrah te amikhan laga paap sob maph paise,

english_text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
nagamese_text: sob gyaan aru buddhi pora amikhan ke bhorta kori dise.

english_text: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
nagamese_text: Khrista dwara sorgote aru prithibi te thaka sob manu ke Isor laga asurit kotha koidibole Isor laga itcha korise,

english_text: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
nagamese_text: Isor laga itcha to kineka thik homoi te pura hobo etu he tai laga bhabona ase, aru sorgo aru prithibi te ki jinis khan ase, sob eke logote mili kene Khrista laga age te anibo,

english_text: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,
nagamese_text: Khrista te he amikhan ke Isor laga manu hobole basi loise. Amikhan ke age pora jaga bonai kene rakhise juntu hisab te tai laga itcha pora amikhan ke Isor laga maksad karone basi loise,

english_text: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.
nagamese_text: etu nimite he amikhan, jun Khrista uporte poila pora asha rakhise, tai laga mohima hobo nimite aradhana koribo.

english_text: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
nagamese_text: Apuni khan bhi Khrista ke biswas korise, aru jitia apnikhan laga poritran laga susamachar hunise, aru biswas korise, titia apuni ke Pobitro Atma laga kosom pora mohor lagai dise,

english_text: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
nagamese_text: aru amikhan nimite pabole thaka to Pobitro Atma pora ji hoilebi rakhi diye, jitia tak amikhan etu pura pai naloi, Tai mohima karone.

english_text: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, jitia apuni laga biswas Jisu Khrista te thaka aru apnikhan sob pobitro manu ke morom kora moi hunise,

english_text: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
nagamese_text: Moi apnikhan nimite dhanyavad dibole rukhanai, moi laga prathana te hodai yaad kori thake,

english_text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
nagamese_text: ami laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Isor, mohima laga Baba, apnikhan ke Tai laga buddhi laga atma aru Tai laga gyaan apnikhan ke jonai dibo nimite,

english_text: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
nagamese_text: aru apnikhan laga mon laga suku khuli kene ujala hobo nimite titia apuni janibo paribo kele tai apnikhan ke Tai laga asha te matise aru pobitro khan nimite tai kineka dhun aru mohima rakhi dikene ase etu janibo,

english_text: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
nagamese_text: aru tulona kori bole napara Tai laga mohan hokti juntu biswas kora khan logot ase, juntu hisab te tai kaam kore,

english_text: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
nagamese_text: juntu hokti Khrista bhitor te kaam korise, aru Jisu ke mora pora uthai dise aru sorgote Tai laga dyna hathte rakhise,

english_text: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
nagamese_text: sob niyom, adhikar aru takot pora ki kotha koise khali etiya he nohoi, kintu ahibole yug nimite bhi.

english_text: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
nagamese_text: Isor sob jinis to tai laga theng nichete rakhise aru sob hokti to taike dise aru sob girja uporte cholawta hobole dise,

english_text: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
nagamese_text: girja to Khrista laga gaw ase aru tai pora he bhorta kore, Tai sob saman ke pura kore aru thik kore.

english_text: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
nagamese_text: Aru apnikhan poila to kotha namana aru paap te morikene asele,

english_text: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
nagamese_text: utu somoite apuni khan etu prithibi laga niyom hisab te berai thakise, aru apnikhan hawa atma laga takot te berai thakise, juntu atma etiya kotha namane laga manu khan logote kaam kori ase.

english_text: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
nagamese_text: Amikhan bhi taikhan nisena he thakise, biya laga bhabona aru gaw mangso ke khushi koribo dise. Etu nimite, dusra khan nisena he, amikhan to Isor laga khong te julibole thaka bacha khan ase.

english_text: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor to daya te bisi dhuni ase, aru tai laga dangor morom pora amikhan ke bisi morom korise.

english_text: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
nagamese_text: Jitia amikhan tai laga kotha namana nimite mori thakise, Tai amikhan ke Khrista logote jinda kori dise- anugrah pora poritran anidise-

english_text: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: aru Tai logote amikhan bhi jinda uthai dise aru sorgo jaga sob te Jisu Khrista logot bohi bole dise,

english_text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
nagamese_text: etu nimite ahibole yug te etu jhuki bole napara dangor anugrah ki Tai daya kori kene Jisu Khrista te amikhan ke dikhai dise, etu sobke janai dibo karone ase.

english_text: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
nagamese_text: Kile mane biswas dwara Isor laga anugrah pora apnikhan poritran paise, aru etu to apuni pora aha nohoi, kintu Isor laga bordan ase,

english_text: not of works, that no one would boast.
nagamese_text: nijor laga kaam khan pora nohoi, kelemane kun bhi phutani nahobo nimite.

english_text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan tai laga hath pora bona sristikhan ase, aru Khrista Jisu logote bhal kaam kori bole amikhan ke etu jibon dise.

english_text: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
nagamese_text: Etu karone monte rakhibi, ekta somoite apnikhan gaw mangso te Porjati thakise, aru apnikhan “sunnot kora khan” pora “sunnot nakora khan” eneka mati thakise - juntu kaam to manu laga hath pora kora kaam ase.

english_text: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile etu somoite apuni khan Khrista pora alag thakise, aru Israel samaj te luwa nai, aru kotha milai luwa laga kosom para apuni khan najana manu khan ase, aru eku asha aru Isor nathaka duniya thakise.

english_text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya Khrista Jisu te, apuni khan jun poila te tai pora bisi dur thakisele, Khrista laga khun pora usorte ani loise.

english_text: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
nagamese_text: Kile mane Khrista nijor he amikhan laga shanti ase. Tai laga gaw pora duita thaka to ekta kori dise aru juntu diwar pora amikhan ke alag korise etu ke tai bhangai kene khotom kori dise.

english_text: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
nagamese_text: Tai laga kotha aru Yehudi niyom pora etu sob niyom khan khotom kori dise. Tai laga itcha to duita jat thaka to ekta hoi kene tai logote thaki bole, aru eneka pora he shanti banabo,

english_text: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
nagamese_text: aru etu nimite Khrista laga Cross pora he taikhan majote dushmani thaka to khotom koribo paribo, aru Isor logot milai loi kene ki dushmani thakise etu khotom kori bole nimite.

english_text: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
nagamese_text: Aru Khrista ahi kene jun dur te ase, aru jun usorte ase, duita jat ke shanti laga susamachar janai dise,

english_text: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
nagamese_text: kelemane Tai pora he amikhan duijon ke ekjon Atma bonai kene Baba Isor ke milai dise.

english_text: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
nagamese_text: Etu karone apuni khan etiya dusra desh aru nachina manu nohua hoise. Hoile bhi, etiya apnikhan to pobitro manu khan logote Isor laga ghor te thaki thaka manu hoi jaise.

english_text: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
nagamese_text: Apuni khan ke apostle aru bhabobadi khan laga mojbut kotha uporte bonaise, aru Jisu Khrista tai nijorke ekta bisi dorkar pathor dise.

english_text: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;
nagamese_text: Jun he dangor ghor ke eke logote mojbut pora dhuri rakhise, aru Probhu te ekta pobitro mondoli hoi kene uthi thakibi,

english_text: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
nagamese_text: aru Khrista te apnikhan ke milai kene bonai dise, juntu te Isor laga Atma thaki jabo.

english_text: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi, Paul, apuni Porjati khan nimite, Khrista Jisu laga bondhi ase.

english_text: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
nagamese_text: Jodi apuni Isor laga kripa kotha hunise juntu Isor pora moike dise apnikhan nimite,

english_text: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
nagamese_text: juntu moike prokahit kori dise, utu lukai kene rakha kotha juntu moi age te olop likhi loise.

english_text: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
nagamese_text: Jitia apuni etu kotha porhibo, apuni Khrista laga asurit aru bhitor kotha to bujhi bole paribo,

english_text: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
nagamese_text: poila te etu kotha to dusra jamana khan ke janai diya nai, hoile bhi ekta sob kotha he Atma pora tai laga pobitro apostle aru bhabobadi khan pora janai dise--

english_text: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
nagamese_text: aru Porjati khan bhi Jisu Khrista laga waris ase aru Tai laga gaw laga bhag ase aru susamachar laga kosom dwara taikhan bhi Isor diya kosom te bhag loise,

english_text: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
nagamese_text: etu nimite he moi Tai laga sewa korise, Isor laga anugrah pora kaam kori thaka aru asirbad morom moike dise.

english_text: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
nagamese_text: Moi pobitro manu bhitor te sobse chutu ase, Khrista laga bisarikena khotom kori bole napara dhun kotha Porjati khan ke prochar koribo nimite etu anugrah moike dise,

english_text: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: aru sobke juntu tai laga asol maksad to ki ase etu dikhai dibo, ekta hosa kotha juntu Isor pora sob jinis bona homoi te lukai kene rakhidise-

english_text: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
nagamese_text: etu hoile girja dwara he sob cholawta aru adhikari khan, jun sorgo jagate ase, taikhan Isor laga bisi kisim gyaan thaka to janibole pabo,

english_text: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: kitia bhi khotom nohobole bhabona juntu Isor pora amikhan laga Probhu Khrista Jisu logote korise,

english_text: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
nagamese_text: amikhan Khrista logote biswas pora mon dangor kori kene tai usorte jabo.

english_text: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi anurodh kori ase apuni khan ke, mon chutu na koribi kelemane moi dukh pa to apnikhan laga labh hobole nimite ase.

english_text: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi Baba Isor usorte athukari kene ase,

english_text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
nagamese_text: jun pora sob dol laga ghor manu khan ke sorgo aru prithibi te naam dise,

english_text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
nagamese_text: titia Isor laga dhun aru morom laga asis pora apuni ke dibo aru apuni laga bhitor te thaka manu ke Atma pora takot koribo,

english_text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
nagamese_text: etu hoile Khrista apuni laga mon bhitor te biswas dwara thakibo paribo, aru morom te thaki bole paribo,

english_text: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
nagamese_text: titia apuni sob pobitro manu khan logote milikena bujhi bole paribo, kiman lamba aru kiman bhitor, aru kiman untcha ase,

english_text: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
nagamese_text: aru Khrista laga morom bujhi bo paribo, etu morom to gyaan pora bhi bisi dangor ase, etu sob to Isor laga bhal kaam pora amikhan uporte bhorta hoi jabo.

english_text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
nagamese_text: Isor usorte amikhan ki mangile bhi aru bhabona korile bhi sob to kori diye, aru juntu takot amikhan ke chulai ase etu laga itcha te he sob to pura hoi jabo,

english_text: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Isor ke mohima hobi girja te aru Khrista Jisu dwara ahibole yug sob te, etiya pora hodai nimite. Amen.

english_text: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami Isor laga bondhi ghor te thaka manu, apnikhan ke utsah kori ase juntu kaam kori bole apnikhan ke matise utu thik pora kori kene berabi,

english_text: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
nagamese_text: nomro aru norom hoi kene, dhorjo kori kene, ekjon-ekjon ke morom te thakibi,

english_text: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
nagamese_text: shanti pora Atma bhitor te ekta hoi kene thaki bole kosis koribi.

english_text: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
nagamese_text: Ekjon he gaw ase, aru ekjon Pobitro Atma ase, jineka apnikhan ke ekta bhabona kori kene mati sele,

english_text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
nagamese_text: ekjon Isor, ekta biswas, ekta baptizma,

english_text: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
nagamese_text: Ekjon Isor aru sob laga Baba, jun sob laga uporte ase, aru sob pora ase, aru sob bhitor te ase.

english_text: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan sobke anugrah dikene ase Khrista laga inam laga ujon hisab te.

english_text: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite tai koise: “Jitia tai uporte uthise, Tai dhuri kene thaka khan ke dhuri kene loi jaise, Aru manu khan ke inam khan dise.”

english_text: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
nagamese_text: To etu laga motlob to ki ase “Khrista uthise,” hoilebi tai prithibi laga sob pora niche bhag te bhi jaise?

english_text: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
nagamese_text: Tai jun nichete jaise utu tai he ase jun sob sorgo khan pora bisi uporte bhi uthise, titia Tai sob jinis khan ke bhorta kori bole paribo.

english_text: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
nagamese_text: Aru Khrista pora kunba ke apostle, kunba ke bhabobadi, kunba ke procharok, aru kunba ke palok aru hikhok kori bole dise,

english_text: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
nagamese_text: pobitro manu khan ke thik kori bole nimite, mantri khan laga kaam khan aru Khrista laga gaw ke hikai dibole nimite,

english_text: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
nagamese_text: Isor laga chokra laga gyaan te ekta biswas te napuncha tak, ekta pura aru thik manu hobo nimite, pura Khrista nisena,

english_text: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
nagamese_text: titia amikhan aru bacha nisena nahobo, age piche nahilibo, niyom laga sob hawa te loi najabo, manu khan laga thoga baji te, aru chalak kaam khan te nagiribo.

english_text: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
nagamese_text: Kintu morom pora hosa kotha kobo, aru sob jinis te uthibo, Tai logote jun matha ase, Khrista nijor,

english_text: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
nagamese_text: Jun pora pura gaw thik pora mili kene ekta hoijai, aru bhag sob pora nijor kaam kori kene ekta bhag logote ekta bhag mili jai, etu pora gaw ke hikai, nijor pora morom te bonai uthibole.

english_text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ami koi ase, aru Probhu naam te utsah di ase, etiya pora apnikhan Porjati khan misa-misi bhabona te thakikena bera nisena na koribi.

english_text: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
nagamese_text: Bujhi bole para takot to andhar te rakhi kene ase, aru Isor laga jibon pora alag hoi kene ase, kele koile taikhan monte buddhi nai aru Isor ke taikhan laga mon tan hoi kene thaka nimite.

english_text: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
nagamese_text: Jun khan nijor bhabona ke morai dise, aru nijorke bebichari kaam nimite cholai se, aru gaw mangso kaam te berai thakise.

english_text: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi apnikhan eneka pora Khrista laga kotha hika nai,

english_text: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
nagamese_text: eneka hoile apnikhan utu hobi juntu apnikhan tai laga hunise, aru Jisu pora jineka hikai se, juntu hosa to Jisu bhitor te ase.

english_text: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
nagamese_text: Titia apnikhan utu purana manu laga poila kotha khan phelai dibi, juntu misa-misi ase thoga baji laga lalchi khan ase,

english_text: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
nagamese_text: Aru apnikhan laga bhabona laga atma te notun hobi,

english_text: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te apuni khan utu notun manu hobi jun Isor laga protima ase- dharmikta aru pobitrota te.

english_text: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite misa phelai dibi, sob manu dusra manu logote hosa kotha kobi kele koile amikhan ekjon-dusra-jon laga bhag ase.

english_text: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
nagamese_text: Apnikhan khong hobi, aru paap na koribi: apnikhan laga khong uporte din khotom hobole nadibi.

english_text: and don’t give place to the devil.
nagamese_text: Bhoot khan ke bhal homoi to nadibi.

english_text: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
nagamese_text: Taikhan jun khan chor kore, taikhan chor nakori jabi. Ulta, tai kaam kori bole lage, tai laga hath khan pora utu kaam khan kori bole dibi juntu bhal ase hoile bhi, titia tai dusra ke dibole paribo junke dorkar ase.

english_text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan laga mukh pora misa-misi kotha khan ulabole nadibi, hoile bhi juntu kotha dusra ke uthai dibole nimite bhal ase, eneka pora huni thaka khan anugrah pabo.

english_text: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
nagamese_text: Aru Isor laga Pobitro Atma ke mon dukh kori bole nadibi, juntu pora apuni khan ke paap pora bachai diya laga dinte daag dise.

english_text: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
nagamese_text: Sob tita khan, biya pa-a, khong, hala, aru gali diya khan apnikhan pora hatai dibi, sob biya laga bhabona khan.

english_text: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
nagamese_text: Aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribi, norom mon rakhibi, maph koribi, jineka Isor pora Khrista dwara apnikhan ke maph korise.

english_text: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Isor pora morom kora bacha khan nisena, apnikhan bhi Isor laga niyom khan koribo lage,

english_text: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
nagamese_text: aru morom te bera bhi, jineka Khrista amikhan ke morom korise aru amikhan nimite tai laga jibon Isor ke ekta mitha sugandh thaka nisena bolidan dise.

english_text: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
nagamese_text: Kintu bebichari aru letera kaam khan aru lalchi huwa, etu kaam khan pora apnikhan uporte bodnam hobo nadibi kele koile apnikhan pobitro manu ase,

english_text: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
nagamese_text: aru letera aru murkho kotha khan nohoile bhi biya kotha pora dhamali kora thik nai kintu dhanyavad diya laga kotha he kobi.

english_text: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
nagamese_text: Etu bhal pora jani bhi, bebichari, nohoile letera, nohoile lalchi, aru murti puja kora- eitu khan sob Khrista aru Isor laga rajyote jaga napabo.

english_text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
nagamese_text: Kun manu pora bhi apnike eku motlob nathaka kotha pora thogabo nadibi, kele koile etu kotha namana bacha khan uporte Isor laga khong to ahibo.

english_text: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, eneka manu khan logote namili bhi,

english_text: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
nagamese_text: kele koile poila apnikhan andhera te thakise, kintu etiya apnikhan Probhu logote ujala te ase. Ujala laga bacha nisena berabi

english_text: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
nagamese_text: -kele koile puhor laga phol to sob bhal niyom, dharmikta aru hosa khan ase-,

english_text: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Hoshiar pora Probhu laga itcha janikena thakibi.

english_text: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
nagamese_text: Andhera te phol nadhura kaam kora manu khan logot namilibi, hoile bhi taikhan ke ujala te anibi.

english_text: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taikhan lukai kene kora kaam khan kobole bhi sorom ase.

english_text: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
nagamese_text: Kintu pohor te sob jinis khan dikhi jai, kelemane ki dikhi bole pare, etu sob pohor ase.

english_text: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Isor kotha te eneka likha ase, “Uthi bhi, jun ghumai ase, Aru mora pora uthi jabi, Aru Khrista laga pohor apuni uporte ahibo.”

english_text: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
nagamese_text: Hoshiar pora sai thakibi, apuni kineka berai- murkho manu nisena nohoi kintu gyaani nisena,

english_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
nagamese_text: homoi to para tak chola bhi kele koile din khan biya ase.

english_text: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, murkho nahobi, kintu Probhu laga ki itcha ase etu bujhi bole koribi.

english_text: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
nagamese_text: Modhu pora nisa nohobi, kelemane etu pora apuni laga jibon sob khotom kori dibo. Kintu, Pobitro Atma pora bhorta hoi kene thakibi,

english_text: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
nagamese_text: ekjon-ekjon logote bhajan aru gana khan, aru pobitro gana khan, Probhu ke apuni laga mon bhitor pora gana kora khan aru sundur pora bajana koribi,

english_text: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
nagamese_text: Sob homoi te Baba Isor aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam te dhanyavad dibi,

english_text: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
nagamese_text: Pura mon pora Khrista karone nijorke ekjon-ekjon logot mili kene thakibi.

english_text: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Isor ke diya nisena, maiki khan nijor mota ke pura mon pora sabi.

english_text: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ekjon mota to maiki laga matha ase jineka Khrista ekta girja laga matha ase- tai nije he ekjon gaw laga tran-korta ase.

english_text: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jineka girja to Khrista nichete ase, etu nisena maiki khan sob tai laga mota nimite ase.

english_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
nagamese_text: Mota khan, apnikhan laga maiki khan ke morom koribi jineka Khrista tai laga girja ke korise aru etu nimite tai nije ke di dise,

english_text: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
nagamese_text: Titia tai pora eitu khan ke pobitro kori dibo, taike Isor kotha loi kene pani pora dhulai sapha kori dibo,

english_text: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
nagamese_text: titia Khrista nijor nimite ekta sonman laga girja ase koi kene dibo, eku bhi dagi nathaki kene nohoile bhi tera, nohoile bhi dusra eku bhi biya nathaka, kintu titia tai pobitro aru eku bhi galti nathaka hobo.

english_text: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena mota khan bhi nijor maiki ke nijor gaw nisena morom koribo lage. Jun mota nijor maiki ke morom kore tai nijorke morom kora nisena ase.

english_text: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile kunbi nijor gaw ke biya nalage, kintu tai bhal pora khilai aru sapha rakhe, jineka Khrista tai laga girja ke morom kore.

english_text: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan tai laga gaw laga bhag khan ase.

english_text: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
nagamese_text: “Etu karone ekjon mota tai nijor baba aru ama ke chari kene nijor maiki logote ekta gaw hoi kene thake.”

english_text: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
nagamese_text: Etu ekta bisi dangor bujhi bo napara kotha ase, kintu ami Khrista aru girja laga kotha koi ase.

english_text: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
nagamese_text: Kineka hoile bhi, apuni khan sobke koi ase, nijorke morom kora nisena nijor maiki ke morom koribi, aru maiki khan nijor mota ke sonman dibo lage.

english_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
nagamese_text: Bacha khan, Probhu dwara ama baba laga kotha mani bhi, kele koile etu he thik ase.

english_text: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
nagamese_text: “Tumi laga baba aru ama ke sonman koribi” -juntu poila hukum ase kosom thaki kene-,

english_text: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
nagamese_text: “Titia tumi nimite bhal hobo, aru tumi prithibi te lamba jibon thaki bole paribo.”

english_text: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
nagamese_text: Baba khan, apnikhan laga bacha khan ke khong hobole nadibi. Hoile bhi, taikhan ke Isor laga niyom te aru hisab te dangor koribi.

english_text: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
nagamese_text: Sewak khan, tumikhan laga mon sapha pora, malik logote kotha mani kene, bhoi pora aru kapi kene thaki bhi, jineka Khrista usorte thake,

english_text: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
nagamese_text: khali suku usorte nohoi, jineka manu khan ke khushi kori bole nimite kore, hoile bhi Khrista laga noukar khan nisena, atma pora Isor laga monjur koribi,

english_text: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
nagamese_text: bhal niyom pora sewa koribi Isor laga naam pora, manu laga naam pora nohoikena,

english_text: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
nagamese_text: jani bhi jun manu bhal kaam koribo, etu manu Isor pora pabo, tai nokor hoile bhi nahoile ajad thaka hoile bhi.

english_text: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
nagamese_text: Malik khan, taikhan nimite bhi eneka he kori bhi. Gali kene bhoi nakhila bhi. Apnikhan jani ase, apnikhan aru taikhan laga Malik sorgote ase, aru Tai logot te eku bhagsak nai.

english_text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
nagamese_text: Hekh te, Probhu logote thakibi aru tai laga takot te sakti pabi.

english_text: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
nagamese_text: Isor laga sob hathiar khan lagai lobi, titia apnikhan bhoot laga chalak khan bhirodh te khara kori bole paribo.
