english_text: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan gaw mangso aru khun logote lorai kora nohoi, hoile bhi biya niyom khan logote, biya takot khan logote, etu duniya laga andhar-laga-rajakhan laga biya khan logote, utcha jaga khan te thaka biya atma khan logote lorai kori ase.

english_text: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apuni khan Isor laga hathiar khan loi lobi, titia apuni khan biya dinte khara hobole paribo, aru sob kori kene, khara hobo.

english_text: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
nagamese_text: Khara hobi, apuni laga komor te hosa bandi lobi, aru chati te dharmikta bandi lobi,

english_text: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
nagamese_text: aru apuni laga theng khan te susamachar laga shanti nimite juta lagai kene taiyar koribi.

english_text: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
nagamese_text: Sob somoite, biswas laga dhal lobi, etu hoile biya jon pora jui laga tir mari thaka to khotom kori bole paribo.

english_text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
nagamese_text: Aru poritran laga loha-laga-topi pindhi lobi, aru Atma laga dao, juntu Isor laga kotha ase.

english_text: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
nagamese_text: Sob somoite Pobitro Atma pora prathana kori bhi, ki lagi ase etu sob mangi kene prathana koribi. Etu sob koribo nimite, hodai taiyar aru hoshiar thakibi aru pobitro manu khan nimite hodai prathana koribi,

english_text: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
nagamese_text: Aru ami nimite to, kotha kobole nimite sandesh dibi, tine hole ami bhoi nakori kene mukh khuli bo, susamachar laga lukai kene rakha janai dibole nimite.

english_text: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
nagamese_text: -Juntu nimite moi noukar hoi kene ekjon janai diya manu ase-, titia moi bhoi nakori kene kobo, jineka moi kobo lage.

english_text: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
nagamese_text: Aru ami ki kori ase, kineka kori ase apuni khan bhi janibo, Tychicus, Probhu te thaka ekjon morom aru biswas thaka bhai pora apnikhan ke koi dibo,

english_text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
nagamese_text: Junke moi apnikhan usorte thik etu nimite he pathai ase, titia amikhan laga kaam khan janibole paribo, aru apnikhan laga mon dangor hobo.

english_text: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Sob bhai khan logote shanti aru morom thakibi, biswas pora Baba Isor aru Jisu khrista te.

english_text: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
nagamese_text: Aru kunkhan Probhu Jisu Khrista ke kitia bhi biya nohobole laga morom kore taikhan logote Isor laga anugraha hobo dibi.

english_text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
nagamese_text: Paul aru Timothy, Jisu Khrista laga noukar khan, kun Khrista nimite alag kori kene Philippi sheher te thaki ase, aru taikhan logote thaka cholawta aru porisharok khan.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha aru Baba Isor laga shanti apuni khan logote thakibo dibi.

english_text: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke yaad kori kene Isor ke ami laga dhanyavad diye,

english_text: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
nagamese_text: hodai, moi apuni khan nimite prathana kori thake, aru bisi khushi pora prathana kore.

english_text: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
nagamese_text: Kelemane apnikhan Isor laga kotha nimite moi logote shuru pora aji tak ase.

english_text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, moi sob kaam te mon dangor hoi kene ase, Tai kun apuni khan logote bhal kaam korise Jisu Khrista wapas naha tak etu sob kaam pura koribo.

english_text: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
nagamese_text: Moi eneka bhabona kora to bhal ase kelemane ami laga monte apuni khan ase. Apuni khan moi logote Isor laga susamachar prochar kora kaam te hodai thakise aru Tai nimite dukh paikene koidi ekta thaka homoi te, moike nachari kene hodai prathana pora modot kori thakise.

english_text: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor ami laga sakhi ase, Jisu Khrista pora morom kora nisena moi apuni khan ke hodai yaad kori thake.

english_text: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
nagamese_text: Etu he ami laga prathana ase: apuni khan laga morom bisi hoi kene Isor laga gyaan aru sob bujhi bole thaka to bujhi paribole nimite.

english_text: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
nagamese_text: Etu pora ki bhal ase, etu apnikhan bujibo, aru Khrista wapas naha tak, apuni khan hosa thakibo aru mon dikene pobitro thakibo,

english_text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
nagamese_text: aru Jisu Khrista pora aha laga dharmikta laga phol pora bhorta hoi jabo aru Isor laga mohima aru aradhana hodai kori thakibo.

english_text: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke etu janai dibole mon ase, bhai khan, moi logote ki hoise etu sob susamachar ke age loi jabole nimite hoise.

english_text: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
nagamese_text: Aru etu nisena, Khrista nimite moike luha pora bandi kene rakha homoi te sipahi aru sob manu khan ujala aha to dikhise.

english_text: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
nagamese_text: Biswasi bhai khan moike luha pora bandhi kene rakha to dikhi kene Probhu uporte bharosa korise aru taikhan dusra manu khan ke bhoi nakori kene Isor laga kotha kobole nimite mon dangor hoise.

english_text: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
nagamese_text: Kunba to suku jola pora Khrista laga prochar kori ase, aru kunba khan bhal mon loi kene Khrista laga kaam kori kene jai ase.

english_text: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
nagamese_text: Kunba manu khan morom pora etu kaam korise, kelemane taikhan jane Isor laga kotha nimite moike yate khara kori rakha ase.

english_text: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
nagamese_text: Kintu kunba manu khan nijor laga labh nimite Khrista laga kaam kori ase, mon dikena nohoi. Taikhan bhabe moi yate koidi thaka homoi te moike dukh dibo paribo.

english_text: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
nagamese_text: Titia hoile ki? Kotha to etu he ase, ki rasta pora hoile bhi Khrista ke prochar kori diya te he moi khushi kori ase. Hoi, moi khushi koribo,

english_text: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: kelemane moi jani ase apuni khan laga prathana aru Jisu Khrista laga Atma laga modot pora moi bachi jabo.

english_text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
nagamese_text: Moi laga monte itcha thaka aru asha kora to moi kitia bhi sorom nakhabo, aru moi mon dangor kori kene thaki ase, etiya bhi aru hodai, Khrista ke moi laga gaw pora hodai untcha te uthai thakibo, jinda thakile bhi aru mori jaile bhi.

english_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi jinda thakile Khrista nimite aru mori jaile etu moi laga labh ase.

english_text: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi moi gaw mangso te jinda thake, titia hoile etu moi nimite bhal phol ulabo nimite moi kaam kori bole laga ase. Kintu moi ki to basi lobo? Moi najane.

english_text: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi etu duita majote phasi kene ase. Moi laga itcha etu gaw chari kene Khrista logote thaki bole mon ase, etu he sob pora bhal ase,

english_text: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
nagamese_text: kintu gaw mangso te thaki bole dorkar thaka to apnikhan nimite he ase.

english_text: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
nagamese_text: Aru eitu khan sob bhabona kora pichete, moi jane apuni khan logote thaki kene Isor laga kaam kori kene jabo, khushi pora apuni khan laga biswas dangor hobole nimite,

english_text: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
nagamese_text: etu pora apuni khan moike saikene Jisu Khrista uporte biswas kori kene Tai laga naam te phutani kori bole paribo jitia moi apuni khan ke lok kori bole aru ahibo.

english_text: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga jibon laga niyom khan to Khrista laga susamachar logot milaikena thakibi, titia moi apuni khan logote thakile bhi nathakile bhi, moi apuni khan to biswas te bhal pora khara kori ase, aru ekjon-ekjon logote mili kene susamachar laga biswas nimite kaam kori ase koi kene moi hunibo nimite.

english_text: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
nagamese_text: Aru apnikhan laga dushman khan ke kitia bhi bhoi nokoribi. Taikhan eneka kora to taikhan khotom hoi jabole laga chihna ase, kintu apuni khan nimite te etu to poritran pabole laga ase, juntu Isor pora diye.

english_text: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu apuni ke eku daam noloikene Jisu Khrista nimite dise, khali Taike biswas kori bole nimite nohoi, kintu Tai nimite dukh kosto kori bole,

english_text: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
nagamese_text: apuni khan dikhise moi ki logote lorai kori ase, aru etiya apuni khan moi pora eitu khan sob huni ase.

english_text: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, jodi Khrista laga naam pora mon dangor kori diya kotha thakile, jodi morom pora mon aram kori diya kotha thakile, jodi Pobitro Atma laga sangoti thakile, jodi nomro daya aru morom thakile,

english_text: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
nagamese_text: tinehoile ami laga khushi aru bhi bisi bhorta kori dibi, eke morom thaki kene, atma te mili kene, aru ekta bhabona hobi.

english_text: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
nagamese_text: Nijor nimite te bhabona kori kene kaam nokoribi. Kintu chutu hoi kene dusra khan ke nijor pora bhi bisi bhal bhabibi.

english_text: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
nagamese_text: Nijor pora ki bhal pai etu nokoribi, kintu dusra pora ki bhal pai ase, etu bhi sabi.

english_text: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista kineka thakise etu nijor pora bhabona kori kene sabi,

english_text: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
nagamese_text: Kun, Tai Isor laga roop loi kene thakise, Kintu Tai Isor logote nijorke eke nisena bhabona kora nai Juntu ke Tai dhuri kene rakhibo.

english_text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, Tai nijorke eku nathaka korise Aru ekjon noukar nisena thakise, Aru ekjon manu nisena jonom loise, Aru Taike manu nisena he paise,

english_text: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
nagamese_text: Tai mori bole ja homoi tak kotha mani kene thakise, Cross te mora homoi tak!

english_text: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Isor bhi Taike utcha te uthai dise Aru Tai laga naam sob naam pora utcha te rakhidise.

english_text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
nagamese_text: Isor eneka kori dise kelemane Jisu Khrista laga naam te sob manu athukaribo, Kunkhan sorgote aru prithibi aru mati nichete ase taikhan sob athukaribo,

english_text: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
nagamese_text: Aru kiman manu ase taikhan sob Jisu Khrista he Probhu ase koi kene shikar koribo, Aru Baba Isor laga mohima koribo.

english_text: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, moi morom kora bhai khan, apuni khan hodai kotha mani thaka nisena, khali moi thaka homoi te he nohoi, hoile bhi moi nathaka homoi te bhi, Isor ke bhoi kori kene nijor laga jibon nimite kaam koribi.

english_text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor apuni khan logote bhal kaam kori bole nimite Tai laga itcha ase.

english_text: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
nagamese_text: Apuni ki kaam kori ase etu jhagara aru sikayat nakori kene koribi,

english_text: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
nagamese_text: etu pora apuni eku bodnam napaikena sapha thakibo, eku daag nathaka Isor laga bhal bacha khan hoi kene thakibo, aru prithibi laga biya aru paapi jamana majot te apnikhan ekta puhor hoi kene thakibo.

english_text: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
nagamese_text: Jibon laga kotha dhori kene thakibi jitia tak Khrista wapas nahe, etu pora moi ki kaam kori kene polaise etu te moi phutani kori bole paribo aru dukh pa-a eku labh huwa nai eneka nokobo.

english_text: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi apuni khan laga biswas nimite moike bolidan nisena hali dile bhi, moi apuni khan logote khushi koribo.

english_text: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena apuni khan bhi moi logote khushi aru anondo koribi.

english_text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi Probhu Jisu Khrista uporte biswas ase apuni khan logote Timothy ke joldi pathai dibole nimite, etu pora apuni khan ki kaam kori ase etu jani kene mon dangor kori bole paribo.

english_text: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai nisena moi logote aru dusra kun bhi nai, apuni khan nimite tai hosa pora chinta kori thake.

english_text: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan sob nijor nimite he chinta kori thake, Jisu Khrista laga kaam nimite eku chinta nai.

english_text: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai kineka ase apuni khan jane, aru ekjon chokra tai laga baba nimite ki ase, etu nisena, tai moi logote Isor laga susamachar nimite sewa kori thaka jon ase.

english_text: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi ki koribo etu saikene para tak joldi taike apuni khan logote pathai dibo.

english_text: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi Probhu uporte pura biswas ase moi nijor bhi apuni khan ke joldi sabole ahibo.

english_text: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
nagamese_text: Kintu moi bhabe Epaphroditus ke apuni khan logote joldi pathai dibole nimite dorkar ase. Tai moi laga bhai ase aru eke logote kaam kora sipahi ase, aru apuni khan nimite Isor laga khobor bukha manu ase, kun pora moi laga kaam te modot kore.

english_text: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
nagamese_text: Tai apuni khan logote thaki bole mon juwa to dikhise aru tai bemar ase koi kene apuni khan hunise koi kene tai bisi mon dukh hoise.

english_text: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, tai bemar howa to olop pora mora nai. Kintu Isor he tai uporte daya korise, aru khali taike he nohoi, kintu moi uporte bhi, etu pora moi dukh uporte dukh hoi nathakibole nimite.

english_text: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi taike joldi apuni khan logote pathai dibo, apuni khan taike dikhi kene bisi khushi hobo, aru etu pora moi laga dukh komti hoi jabo.

english_text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite taike grohon koribi aru tai nisena manu ke sonman dibi.

english_text: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista laga kaam nimite tai mori bole thaka pora jinda hoi kene ase. Tai pora moike sewa kori bole nimite tai laga jibon dise aru apuni khan moi nimite ki kori bole para nai, etu sob tai pora he moi nimite korise.

english_text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
nagamese_text: Ami laga bhai khan, Probhu logote khushi koribi. Etu kotha ami apuni khan logote hodai likhi thaka to ami nimite eku dukh nai, aru etu pora apuni khan ke bachai kene rakhe.

english_text: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
nagamese_text: Kutta berai thaka khan ke hoshiar pora sabi, biya kaam kora manu khan pora hoshiar koribi, kun manu gaw mangso kati bole bisare, eitu khan pora hoshiar thakibi.

english_text: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan sunnot kori diya manu ase- aru amikhan Isor laga Atma pora mohima kore, aru Jisu Khrista laga naam te phutani kore, aru gaw mangso laga eku itcha nakore.

english_text: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, moi nijor bhi kitia ba gaw mangso ke biswas kori kene thakibo pare. Jodi kunba manu tai nijor laga gaw te biswas kore, titia hoile moi nimite to apuni khan pora bhi bisi hobo.

english_text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
nagamese_text: Moike ath dinte sunnot kori dise, Israel laga manu, Benjamin laga jat pora, sob Ibrani manu khan laga ekjon Ibrani; aru niyom hisab te, ekjon Pharisee manu ase.

english_text: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
nagamese_text: Moi laga itcha nimite, moi girja khan ke dukh di thakise, aru niyom laga dharmikta te, moi eku biya nathaka manu thakise.

english_text: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi nimite ki labh thakise, etiya Jisu Khrista usorte eitu khan sob to nuksan he ase.

english_text: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
nagamese_text: Kintu hosa te, etiya, moi laga Probhu Jisu Khrista ke janibo para laga gyaan usorte eitu khan sob moi nimite nuksan he ase. Tai nimite moi sob jinis khan chari dise- aru eitu khan sob eku kaam nathaka ase- etu pora moi Khrista ke janibole nimite,

english_text: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,
nagamese_text: Aru Tai logote thaki bole nimite, nijor laga niyom pora dharmik thaki bole nohoi, kintu Jisu Khrista logote biswas pora thaki bole nimite- Isor pora diya biswas laga dharmik jibon te thaki bole nimite.

english_text: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
nagamese_text: Etiya, moi Tai punoruthan huwa laga takot janibole mon ase, aru Tai laga dukh kosto te bhag lobo aru mora te Tai nisena hobo,

english_text: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
nagamese_text: titia moi bhi mora pora jinda hoi jabo, etu he moi laga asha ase.

english_text: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Moi eitu khan sob pai loise aru moi sob thik hoise eneka nohoi, kintu ki nimite Jisu Khrista pora moike dhori kene rakhise, etu pabole moi bhi kosis kori ase.

english_text: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi etiya bhi etu paise koi kene bhabona kora nai. Kintu ekta kaam moi kore: pichete ki ase etu pahori kene age te ki ase etu nimite he bhabona kore,

english_text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista nimite Isor pora mati luwa nisena moi inam pabole nimite kosis kori ase.

english_text: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi khan bujhi bole para manu nisena eitu khan bhabi kene thakibo; jodi apuni khan alag bhabi thake, Isor pora apuni khan ke etu bhi dikhai dibo.

english_text: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, amikhan kun jagate punchi kene thakile bhi, amikhan logote ki ase etu dhori kene thakibo.

english_text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, moi kineka ase etu saikene apnikhan bhi eneka koribi. Amikhan ke saikene kaam kori thaka khan, kun apnikhan majote te thake, taikhan kineka ase, etu bhal pora sai bhi.

english_text: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
nagamese_text: Bisi manu berai ase- kun nimite moi apuni khan ke hodai koi thake, etiya bhi moi apuni khan ke kandi kene koi ase- taikhan Khrista laga Cross laga dushman ase.

english_text: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
nagamese_text: Taikhan biya pora khotom hoi jabo, kelemane taikhan laga pet he taikhan laga Isor ase, aru taikhan phutani kori thaka to sorom khai jabo. Taikhan prithibi laga kotha khan nimite bhabona kori thake.

english_text: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan laga desh to sorgote ase, aru etu jaga pora amikhan laga Tran-Korta, Probhu Jisu Khrista ke rukhi thake.

english_text: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
nagamese_text: Tai amikhan laga purana gaw ke Tai laga pobitro gaw nisena bonai dibo, Tai laga mohan takot pora aru sob jinis ke Tai logote aru Tai nijor nichete rakhibo.

english_text: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, ami laga bhai khan, moi apnikhan ke morom kore aru bhabi thake, apnikhan moi laga khushi aru moi laga mukut khan ase, apnikhan etu nisena Probhu logote biswas te bhal pora khara hoi kene thaki bhi, morom laga sathi khan.

english_text: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Moi Euodia khan ke anurodh kori ase, aru moi Syntyche ke bhi anurodh kori ase, Probhu logote ekta bhabona hoi kene thakibi.

english_text: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
nagamese_text: Hoi, moi apuni khan ke hudise, moi laga hosa sathi khan, etu mahila khan ke modot kori bole nimite kunkhan dukh kori kene moi logote Isor laga kotha prochar korise, moi logote kaam kora manu Clement aru dusra khan, kunkhan laga naam to Jibon laga Kitab te likhi kene ase.

english_text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
nagamese_text: Probhu logote hodai khushi koribi. Aru bhi moi kobo, hodai khushi koribi.

english_text: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
nagamese_text: Apuni nomro hoi kene thaka to manu khan ke janibole dibi. Probhu wapas ahibole nimite usor hoise.

english_text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
nagamese_text: Kiba ekta kori bole nimite bisi mon digdar nokoribi. Kintu, sob kaam te prathana aru dhanyavad dikene anurodh koribi, apuni ki bhabi ase etu Isor ke janibole dibi,

english_text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: aru Isor laga shanti, kun to sob bujhi bole nimite diye, Jisu Khrista uporte biswas kori bole nimite apuni khan laga mon aru bhabona bhal kori kene sai dibo.

english_text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bhai khan, ki kotha khan hosa ase, aru kuntu pora sonman diye, aru ki thik aru sapha ase, aru ki kotha khan bhal pora kobole pare, jodi ta te kiba bhal ase koile, aru jodi manu ke uthai diya laga kotha ase koile, etu kotha khan sob bhabona koribi.

english_text: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan ki kotha khan sikhise aru paise aru hunise aru moi logote dikhise, eitu khan koribi, aru Isor laga shanti apuni khan logote thakibo.

english_text: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi Probhu logote bisi khushi kori ase kelemane apuni khan moi nimite bisi bhabona kori kene thaki ase. Apuni khan poila pora bhi moi nimite bisi bhabona kori thake, hoile bhi apuni khan modot kori bole nimite bhal homoi to aha nai.

english_text: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
nagamese_text: Moi kiba dorkar ase koi kene etu kotha khan kora nai. Kelemane, ki-ki hoilebi, kineka thaki bole lage, etu ami bhal pora jani ase.

english_text: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
nagamese_text: Moi gorib huwa to kineka ase etu jane, aru bisi thaka to ki ase, etu bhi moi jane. Moi sob rasta pora kineka thaki bole lage aru nijorke kineka bhuk pora bachai kene rakhibole lage, etu sob jani loise, aru bisi thaka te bhi aru eku nathaka te bhi, mon khushi hobole sikhi loise.

english_text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
nagamese_text: Moi sob kaam Tai laga naam pora kori bole pare kelemane Tai moike takot diye.

english_text: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
nagamese_text: Kintu, apuni khan moi dukh pai thaka homoi te bhal pora sai dise.

english_text: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
nagamese_text: Aru, apuni Philippi manu khan, Isor laga kotha shuru pora jani ase, jitia moi Macedonia te jaise, kun girja pora bhi moike dikene modot kora nai, khali apuni khan pora he korise.

english_text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
nagamese_text: Jitia moi Thessalonica sheher te thakise, moi nimite apuni khan pora ekbar pora bhi bisi modot pathai dise.

english_text: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
nagamese_text: Moi manu khan pora kiba pabole nimite nibisare. Kintu, moi apuni khan bhal hoi kene thaka to he bisare.

english_text: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi pura pai loise, aru bisi paise. Moike Epaphroditus pora ki pathai dise etu sob bhal kori kene paise. Etu to ekta mitha sugandh thaka pora mitha gundai thaka nisena, Isor pora khushi pa-a laga bolidan ase.

english_text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi laga Isor pora Khrista Jisu naam te Tai laga dhun hisab te sob laga dorkar pura kori dibo.

english_text: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan laga Baba Isor ke hodai nimite mohima dibi. Amen.

english_text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista te thaka sob pobitro manu khan ke salam dibi. Moi logote thaka bhai khan pora bhi apuni khan ke salam di ase.

english_text: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
nagamese_text: Yate laga sob pobitro manu khan pora apuni khan ke salam di ase, aru Caesar laga ghor manu khan ke bhi salam di ase.

english_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga atma logote Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah thaki bole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
nagamese_text: Paul, Isor laga itcha dwara Khrista Jisu laga ekjon apostle, aru Timothy amikhan laga bhai,

english_text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: pora Colossae nogor te thaka biswasi khan aru Khrista te biswasi bhai khan logot likhi ase. Apuni khan logote anugrah aru Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga shanti thaki bole dibo.

english_text: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
nagamese_text: Amikhan Isor ke dhanyavad di ase, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga Baba Isor, aru amikhan hodai apuni khan nimite prathana kori ase.

english_text: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
nagamese_text: Apuni khan Jisu Khrista te biswas kora amikhan huni loise aru Tai nimite alag rakhikena thaka manu khan nimite apuni khan laga morom thaka sob jani loise.

english_text: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
nagamese_text: Apuni logote etu morom ase kelemane sorgote apuni nimite asha rakhi kene ase,

english_text: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
nagamese_text: kun to apuni khan logote ahise. Etu susamachar pora bisi phul ulaikene prithibi te aru bhi dangor hoi thaka nisena, apuni khan majote bhi etu kotha kaam kori ase, juntu din pora apuni khan hunise aru Isor laga anugrah laga kotha hosa te sikhise.

english_text: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
nagamese_text: Etu susamachar kotha apuni khan Epaphras pora sikhi bole parise, morom laga noukar, amikhan laga bodli te Khrista laga biswasi noukar.

english_text: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Epaphras pora apuni khan Atma te morom thaka to amikhan ke janibole dise.

english_text: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
nagamese_text: Etu morom thaka nimite, jitia pora etu hunise amikhan apuni khan nimite prathana kori bole rukhanai. Apuni khan ke Tai laga gyaan pora atma laga kotha khan bujhi bole paribole nimite mangi thakise.

english_text: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
nagamese_text: Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan Probhu ke khushi kori kene bhal rasta te berai kene jabo aru sob kaam mon dikene kori thakibo. Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan sob phol ulabo aru Isor laga gyaan te aru bhi bisi dangor hoi thakibo.

english_text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
nagamese_text: Amikhan prathana kore apuni khan sob kaam khan kori bole nimite takot pabo Tai laga mohima aru takot pora aru sob kaam te nomro aru khushi pora cholai kene loijabo.

english_text: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
nagamese_text: Amikhan prathana kori ase apuni khan Baba Isor ke dhanyavad dibo, kun pora apnikhan ke puhor laga pobitro manu hoi kene Tai laga rajyote thaki bole nimite jaga dise.

english_text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
nagamese_text: Isor he amikhan ke andhera laga rajyo pora bachai loise Tai sob pora morom kora chokra laga rajyote ani loise,

english_text: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
nagamese_text: aru Tai pora he udhar pai, aru sob paap pora maph kori diye.

english_text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
nagamese_text: Khrista to nadikha Isor laga protima ase, shristi majote prothom jonom luwa to ase.

english_text: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
nagamese_text: Tai pora he sob jinis khan ke bonaise, sorgote aru prithibi te thaka, dikha aru nadikha jinis khan. Singhason aru rajyo cholawta aru sorkar khan aru adhikari khan, sob to Tai pora he bonaise aru Tai nimite he bonaise.

english_text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
nagamese_text: Tai nijor sob jinis age te ase, aru Tai logote he sob jinis eke logote dhori kene ase.

english_text: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
nagamese_text: Khrista he gaw te matha ase, girja laga matha ase. Tai he shuru ase aru mora pora prothom jonom huwa ase, etu nimite Tai he sob jinis te age jagate ase.

english_text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Tai logote Isor laga itcha bhorta thaka to Isor khushi paise,

english_text: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
nagamese_text: aru Putro te Tai nijor logote sob jinis ke milai loise. Tai Cross te bahai diya khun pora Isor shanti bonai dise. Tai dwara, Isor pora sob milai dise, etu prithibi aru sorgote thaka sob jinis ke.

english_text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
nagamese_text: Ekta homoi te, apuni bhi Isor usorte alag manu thakise aru bhabona aru biya kaam pora Tai laga dushman thakise.

english_text: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya Tai nijor gaw te mora nimite apuni logote milai loise. Tai apnikhan ke Isor usorte pobitro aru sapha pora dibole nimite korise,

english_text: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
nagamese_text: etu karone apuni biswas te thik choli kene, ki susamachar laga asha apnikhan pora hunise ta te nahili kene thik pora khara koribi. Etu susamachar ke sorgo nichete thaka sob manu logot prochar kori ase. Etu susamachar nimite moi, Paul, ekjon noukar hoi jaise.

english_text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
nagamese_text: Etiya moi apuni khan karone dukh kori thaka nimite khushi pai ase, aru moi laga gaw mangso te ki komti ase aru Khrista pora dukh pa nisena etu Tai laga gaw nimite kori ase, kun to girja ase.

english_text: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
nagamese_text: Moi etu girja laga ekjon noukar ase, Isor pora moike etu jimedari apuni khan uporte diya nisena, Isor laga kotha to pura kori bole nimite.

english_text: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
nagamese_text: Etu asurit kotha khan poila homoi pora manu khan nimite lukai kene rakhise. Kintu etiya kun Taike biswas kore taikhan ke dikhai dise.

english_text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
nagamese_text: Isor pora Tai laga sob mohima laga dhun juntu laga hosa lukai kene thakise, etiya to etu Porjati manu khan ke jonai dibole mon ase. Etu ase Khrista, jun apuni khan logote ase, mohima laga asha.

english_text: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
nagamese_text: Etu Tai ase kun nimite amikhan prochar kori ase. Amikhan sob manu ke koi ase, aru amikhan sob manu ke gyaan pora sikhai di ase, etu pora sob manu khan ke Khrista laga usorte pura kori kene loi anibole paribo.

english_text: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi kaam kori ase aru Tai laga takot loi kene thaki ase juntu takot moi logote kaam kori ase.

english_text: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
nagamese_text: Moi kiman dukh korise apuni khan nimite etu janibole dibo karone mon ase, aru Laodicea sheher te thaka khan, aru kun manu etiya tak moi laga chehera dikha nai.

english_text: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan laga mon dangor kori dibole nimite kaam kore aru morom pora eke logote ani kene sob gyaan laga dhun pora bhorta kori dibole nimite, Isor laga hosa kotha lukai kene rakhi thaka khan bujhi bole nimite, juntu Khrista ase.

english_text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
nagamese_text: Khrista logote he sob gyaan aru buddhi laga dhun khan lukai kene ase.

english_text: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke etu koidi ase kun pora bhi phusla kotha kori kene apuni khan ke thogai nadibo nimite.

english_text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan logote gaw pora nathakile bhi, moi apuni khan logote atma te ase. Moi apuni khan laga takot aru Khrista uporte biswas aru bhal kaam khan kori thaka saikene khushi kori ase.

english_text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, apuni Probhu Jisu Khrista ke luwa nisena, Tai logote bera bhi.

english_text: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
nagamese_text: Gash laga shikor thaka nisena nijorke Tai logote bonai lobi, aru apuni ke sikhai diya nisena hodai biswas te thakibi, aru dhanyavad di thakibi.

english_text: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
nagamese_text: Sabi kun manu pora bhi apuni ke misa laga kotha khan koi kene dhori rakhibole nadibi, manu khan laga niyom hisab te, aru etu prithibi laga saman khan te khushi paikene, aru Khrista ke khushi nakori kene prithibi laga itcha te najabi.

english_text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista pora he Isor laga ki itcha ase eitu khan pura manu khan logote thaki bole diye.

english_text: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan Tai logote bhorta hoi jaise, kun etu sob takot aru adhikar laga matha ase.

english_text: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
nagamese_text: Tai pora apuni ke bhi sunnot kori dise aru gaw mangso laga sunnot nohoi kintu Jisu Khrista laga khun pora sunnot kori dise.

english_text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
nagamese_text: Tai logote baptizma pora apuni ke kobor te dise, biswas aru Isor laga takot pora Tai apuni ke jinda kori dise, kun he Taike mora pora jinda kori dise.

english_text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
nagamese_text: Jitia apuni khan paap aru gaw mangso laga sunnot pora mori kene thakise, Tai logote apuni khan ke jinda kori dise aru amikhan laga kiman paap thakise, etu sob maph kori dise.

english_text: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga uporte baki lagai kene thaka khan sob Isor pora tirai dise, kun to amikhan uporte hali disele. Taike Cross te gojal mara pora etu baki hatai dise.

english_text: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
nagamese_text: Khrista pora taikhan laga takot aru adhikar khan ke komjur koridi kene manu khan laga usorte dikhai dise, Cross uporte mori kene taikhan uporte jiti loise.

english_text: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, apuni kha luwa kora to bisar kori bole nadibi, aru notun chand ula homoi te kha luwa kora khan manu ke bisar kori bole nadibi, aru Bisram din bhi bisar kori bole nadibi.

english_text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob to ahibole thaka laga chaya nisina he ase, kintu asol laga kotha to Khrista he ase.

english_text: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
nagamese_text: Kun manu dhorjo lobole mon ase aru sorgodoth khan ke aradhana kore, taikhan pora thogai kene tumikhan laga uphar harabo nadibi. Etu nisena manu to tai ki dikhise etu pora nijor mangso bhabona te bisi phutani hoijai.

english_text: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
nagamese_text: Tai matha to dhori kene nathake. Etu matha pora he pura gaw laga kaam khan eke logote dhori kene rakhe; etu Isor pora diya pora he dangor hoi.

english_text: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
nagamese_text: Jodi apuni Khrista logote etu prithibi laga sob jinis khan chari dise, titia hoile aru bhi etu prithibi laga itcha te thaka nisena kele thaki ase:

english_text: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
nagamese_text: Apuni nadhuri bhi, aru khai nasabi, aru na chubi!”

english_text: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob to harai jai ase, manu khan pora kowa aru sikhai diya nisena.

english_text: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan niyom to nijor laga gyaan pora bonai diya dhorom aru misa pora nomro dikhai diya he ase. Kintu taikhan laga gaw mangso laga kaam khan to eku daam nai.

english_text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
nagamese_text: Jodi Isor pora apuni ke Khrista logote uthai dise, titia hoile apuni to upor laga jinis ke he bisaribi, kun jagate Khrista to Isor laga dyna hathte bohi ase.

english_text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
nagamese_text: Prithibi laga jinis khan nohoi, kintu uporte thaka jinis khan ke bhabona koribi.

english_text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni mori jaise, aru apuni laga jibon to Isor te Khrista dwara lukai kene ase.

english_text: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
nagamese_text: Jitia Khrista wapas ahibo, jun apuni laga jibon ase, titia apuni bhi Tai laga mohima te ahibo.

english_text: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite prithibi te thaka kaam khan sob morai dibi- bebichari, sapha nathaka, gaw mangso itcha, biya laga itcha, aru lalchi kora, kuntu to murti puja kora nisina he ase.

english_text: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
nagamese_text: Etu kaam khan nimite Isor laga khong to ahi ase.

english_text: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
nagamese_text: Ekta homoi te apuni khan etu kaam khan kori kene jinda thakise.

english_text: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya apuni khan sob purana kaam khan chari dibole lage- gusa, khong, biya bhabona, sorom khilai diya, aru apuni laga mukh pora biya kotha ula khan.

english_text: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
nagamese_text: Ekjon-ekjon logote misa kotha nokoribi, kelemane apuni khan logote purana manu aru purana kaam kori thaka khan sob ulaikene phelai dise,

english_text: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
nagamese_text: aru kun pora apuni khan ke notun manu bonai dise Tai laga gyaan pora notun hoi jaise.

english_text: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
nagamese_text: Yate kun bhi Yunani aru Yehudi nai, sunnot kora aru sunnot nakora nai, dusra jat aru desh laga manu nai, ta te Scythia laga manu nai, noukar aru ajad thaka manu nai, kintu Khrista he sob ase, aru sob te Tai he ase.

english_text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Isor pora basi luwa manu nisena, pobitro aru morom thaka khan, apnikhan daya, morom, nomro aru norom aru dhorjo eitu khan pindhi lobi.

english_text: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
nagamese_text: Ekjon-ekjon logote nomro aru morom kori kene thakibi. Jodi kunba manu dusra laga bhirodh kore, Probhu pora apuni ke maph kori diya nisena, taikhan ke bhi maph kori dibi.

english_text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
nagamese_text: Etu sob kotha khan pora bhi, morom thakibi, etu pora he sob to bhal bonai dibo.

english_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
nagamese_text: Khrista laga shanti apuni khan laga monte raj kori bole dibi. Etu shanti nimite apuni khan ke ekta gaw hoi kene matise. Aru dhanyavad dibole janibi.

english_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
nagamese_text: Khrista laga kotha apuni khan logote bhorta hoi kene rakhi bhi. Atma laga gana kori kene ekjon-ekjon ke gyaan pora sikhai dibi. Apuni laga monte Isor ke dhanyavad dikene gana kori thakibi.

english_text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan ki kore, kotha aru kaam pora, Probhu Jisu laga naam te he koribi. Tai nimite Baba Isor ke dhanyavad dibi.

english_text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Maiki khan, nijor mota logote bhal pora thakibi, etu he Probhu usorte thik ase.

english_text: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
nagamese_text: Mota khan, nijor laga maiki ke morom koribi, aru taikhan logote mon tita kori kene nathakibi.

english_text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
nagamese_text: Bacha khan, sob kotha te ama baba khan laga kotha mani kene thakibi, kelemane Probhu etu he khushi pai.

english_text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
nagamese_text: Baba khan, apuni laga bacha khan ke biya kotha na koribi, etu pora taikhan laga mon dukh kori bole nadibi.

english_text: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
nagamese_text: Sewak kora khan, gaw pora ki pare etu loi kene apuni malik laga kotha mani kene thakibi, manu ki suku pora dikhi kene khushi pai etu pora nohoi, kintu bhal mon loi kene. Probhu ke bhoi koribi.

english_text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
nagamese_text: Apuni ki kori ase, atma pora kaam koribi aru Probhu nimite koribi, manu khan nimite kora nisena na koribi.

english_text: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
nagamese_text: Apuni jane Probhu pora apuni waris hobole laga inam pabo. Etu Probhu Khrista ase kunke apuni khan sewa kori ase.

english_text: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
nagamese_text: Kun manu biya kaam khan kore tai biya kaam kora laga hisab te he sajai pabo, aru taike eku alag morom napabo.

english_text: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
nagamese_text: Malik khan, ki bhal aru hosa ase etu he noukar khan ke dibi. Apuni bhi jane sorgote ekjon malik ase.

english_text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
nagamese_text: Prathana te mon dikena kori thakibi. Dhanyavad dikene hoshiar thakibi.

english_text: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
nagamese_text: Mili kene amikhan nimite bhi prathana koribi, Tai laga kotha kobole nimite Isor pora dorja khuli dibole, Khrista laga hosa kotha khan kobole nimite. Etu nimite, moike bhi bandi kene ase.

english_text: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
nagamese_text: Prathana koribi moi apuni khan ke sapha pora koi dibole nimite, moi kobole thaka kotha khan.

english_text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
nagamese_text: Bahar te thaka manu khan logote gyaan pora berabi, aru homoi to usor ase etu janibi.

english_text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan hodai morom pora he kotha koribi. Nimok hali kene mitha kori diya nisena hobole dibi, etu pora apuni khan manu logote ki kobole lage etu janibo.

english_text: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Moi sob kotha khan bhabi thaka to, Tychicus pora apuni khan ke jonai dibo. Tai ekjon morom laga bhai ase, aru ekta biswasi noukar, aru Probhu nimite kaam kora manu ase.

english_text: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan ke etu karone he pathaise, amikhan ki kori ase eitu khan janibole nimite, aru tai apuni khan laga mon to dangor kori dibole nimite.

english_text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
nagamese_text: Moi taikhan ke Onesimus logote pathaise, ekta biswasi aru morom laga bhai, tai bhi apuni khan nisena he ase. Taikhan yate ki hoise etu sob apuni khan ke koi dibo.

english_text: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
nagamese_text: Aristarchus, moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka ekjon sathi, apuni khan ke salam di ase, aru Mark bhi apuni khan ke salam di ase, Barnabas laga bhai (kun nimite apuni adesh paisele; jodi tai apuni khan logote ahe, taike bhal kori kene sabi),

english_text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
nagamese_text: aru Jisu kunke Justus bhi mate. Taikhan to sunnot kori luwa biswasi jon khan ase aru ami logote Isor laga rajyo nimite kaam kori ase, aru taikhan pora moi laga mon ke aram di thake.

english_text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
nagamese_text: Epaphras apuni khan ke salam di ase. Tai bhi apuni khan nisena ekjon Jisu Khrista laga noukar ase. Apuni khan Isor laga itcha te bhal pora khara thaki bole nimite tai prathana koridi thake.

english_text: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi tai laga gawahi di ase, tai apuni khan nimite mon dikene kaam kori ase, aru Laodicea aru Hierapolis sheher khan te thaka karone bhi.

english_text: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
nagamese_text: Luke, kun bemar bhal kora manu ase aru Demas, tai duijon pora apuni khan ke salam di ase.

english_text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
nagamese_text: Laodicea te bhai khan ke salam dibi, aru Nympha ke, aru tai laga ghor te thaka girja ke.

english_text: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
nagamese_text: Jitia etu chithi apuni khan majot porhe, Laodicea laga girja te bhi porhi kene hunai dibi, aru apuni khan bhi Laodicea pora patha chithi saikene porhibi.

english_text: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
nagamese_text: Archippus ke kobi, “Probhu pora pa-a laga porisorja sai lobi, etu apuni pura kori bole lage.”

english_text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
nagamese_text: Etu salam moi nijor laga hath pora likhise- Paul. Moike luha pora bandhi kene thaka to yaad kori bhi. Isor laga anugraha apuni khan logote thaki bole dibo.

english_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Moi Paul, aru moi logote Silvanus aru Timothy pora Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista te thaka Thessalonica laga girja ke likhi ase. Anugrah aru shanti apnikhan uporte hobi.

english_text: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
nagamese_text: Amikhan hodai apnikhan nimite Isor ke dhanyavad di thake, aru apnikhan nimite prathana te yaad kori thake.

english_text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
nagamese_text: Amikhan pora apuni khan laga biswas laga kaam, morom laga kaam, aru Probhu Jisu Khrista ke mon dikene asha kora, juntu amikhan Isor laga age te ase, etu sob prathana te yaad kori thake.

english_text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
nagamese_text: Isor pora morom kora bhai khan, amikhan jane Tai he apnikhan ke basi loise,

english_text: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
nagamese_text: kelemane Isor laga kotha apuni khan logote khali kotha pora aha nai, kintu hokti pora Pobitro Atma te amikhan pora anise, aru hosa pora janai dise. Etu nisena, amikhan kineka apuni khan majote thakise etu apnikhan bhi jani ase.

english_text: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
nagamese_text: Apnikhan pora amikhan laga aru Isor laga niyom cholai ase aru jiman dukh paile bhi apnikhan Pobitro Atma laga kotha ke ekdom khushi pora loise.

english_text: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
nagamese_text: Eneka huwa nimite apnikhan to Macedonia aru Achaia jaga manu khan nimite ekta namuna nisena dikhai dise.

english_text: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan nimite he Isor laga kotha to bahar te hunai dise aru khali Macedonia aru Achaia te nohoi, hoile bhi apnikhan laga biswas Isor uporte thaka to sob jagate punchi jaise. Etu karone amikhan etu nimite amikhan eku nokoile bhi hobo.

english_text: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taikhan nijor pora amikhan ke janai dise, amikhan kineka apuni khan logote ahibo parise, aru kineka apnikhan murti puja pora ghuri kene jinda aru hosa Isor ke biswas korise,

english_text: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
nagamese_text: aru koise apnikhan to Isor laga Putro ke sorgo pora wapas ahibole rukhi ase, junke Tai mora pora uthai dise- Jisu, jun he amikhan uporte ahibo thaka khong pora bachai dise.

english_text: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, kele koile apnikhan nijor jani ase amikhan pora apnikhan logote aha to ene misa-misi pora nohoi.

english_text: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, apnikhan nije jana nisena, amikhan poila bhi dukh paise aru Philippi sheher te sorom khaise. Amikhan Isor logote mon dangor kori kene bisi dukh pora Isor laga kotha prochar korise.

english_text: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan pora utsah diya khan galti pora nohoi, letera thaka pora nohoi, nohoile thogabole nimite bhi nohoi.

english_text: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi jineka Isor pora amikhan ke Tai laga susamachar dise, etu nimite manu ke khushi kori bole karone amikhan kotha kuwa nohoi, kintu Isor kun pora manu laga mon sai Taike khushi kori bole koi ase.

english_text: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apuni khan jane amikhan to phusla bole, nohoile misa kotha pora kiba lobole aha nohoi - Isor he amikhan laga sakhi ase.

english_text: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
nagamese_text: Amikhan manu pora proshansa bisara nohoi, apuni khan pora aru dusra khan pora bhi.

english_text: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Khrista laga chela ase koi kene apnikhan uporte bhari boja nisena ahibo paribo thakise. Kintu, apnikhan majote, amikhan he bacha nisena hoi jaise aru ama pora jineka bacha khan ke morom kore,

english_text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
nagamese_text: etu nisena apnikhan ke bisi morom korise. Khali Isor laga kotha he nohoi hoilebi nijor jibon bhi dibole taiyar ase. Kelemane apuni khan karone bisi morom hoi jaise.

english_text: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bhai khan, amikhan dukh pora kaam kora to apnikhan jani ase. Amikhan Isor laga kotha apnikhan ke kowa somoite, apnikhan ke dukh kosto nadibo nimite amikhan din raat kaam korise.

english_text: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan aru Isor bhi sakhi ase, amikhan laga niyom to biswasi khan age te kiman pobitro aru dharmik thakise.

english_text: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
nagamese_text: Etu nisena amikhan kineka apnikhan logote thakise etu apnikhan jani ase, jineka ekjon baba tai laga nijor bacha logote thake,

english_text: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
nagamese_text: etu nisena apuni khan ke mon uthai dise, mon dangor kori dise aru, kineka korile Isor ke khushi koribo eitu khan hodai sikhai thakise, jun pora apnikhan ke tai laga rajyo aru mohima te matise.

english_text: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan bhi Isor ke hodai dhanyavad diye, jitia apnikhan Isor luwa somoite juntu amikhan hunise, apuni khan etu ke manu laga kotha ase bhaba nai, kintu jineka Isor laga kotha hosa ase, jun biswas kore eitu khan logote kaam kori bole hoise.

english_text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
nagamese_text: Kelemane, apuni, bhai khan, Judea te Isor laga girja laga chela hoi jaise juntu Khrista Jisu te ase. Aru kineka taikhan ke dukh kosto dise, apuni khan bhi nijor manu khan pora dukh kosto dise, jineka taikhan ke Yehudi jati khan pora dise,

english_text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
nagamese_text: jun khan pora Probhu Jisu aru tai laga bhabobadi khan ke morai dise, aru amikhan ke bhi khedai dise. Utu Yehudi khan pora Isor ke khushi kori bole napare. Ulta, taikhan manu khan logote dushman hoi jaise.

english_text: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
nagamese_text: Amikhan ke Porjati khan logote jai kene bachai diya laga kotha rukhai thake, eitu khan nijor laga paap ke aru bhi bisi kori diye. Kintu hekh dinte Isor laga khong taikhan uporte ahibo.

english_text: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
nagamese_text: Kintu bhai khan, olop din karone amikhan ke apnikhan pora alag kori dise, kintu gaw pora hoise, mon pora nohoi. Amikhan apnikhan ke bisi sabole mon ase.

english_text: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan apnikhan ke lok kori bole bisi itcha thakise, moi nije Paul, bhi ek duibar nisena- kintu Saitan pora amikhan ke rukhai dise.

english_text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Probhu Jisu wapas aha somoite, amikhan laga asha aru itcha, nohoile khushi laga mukut kun ase? Etu apnikhan nohoi naki?

english_text: For you are our glory and our joy.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan he amikhan laga shaan aru khushi ase.

english_text: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
nagamese_text: Jitia amikhan laga takot pora napara hoi jaise, amikhan bhabise Athens sheher te thakile he bhal hobo,

english_text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
nagamese_text: aru Timothy ke pathaise jun amikhan laga bhai aru Khrista laga susamachar karone Isor laga noukar ase, apnikhan laga biswas takot aru aram kori dibole nimite,

english_text: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
nagamese_text: titia jun manu bhi etu dukh kosto nimite nahilibo. Kilekoile apnikhan nijor jani ase etu karone amikhan ke basi loise.

english_text: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jitia amikhan apnikhan logote thakise, titia apnikhan ke poila pora dukh pabo koi kene janai dise aru etu hosa hoise, aru apnikhan jani ase.

english_text: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jitia ami nijor pora janibole para nai, apnikhan laga biswas janibole nimite ami Timothy ke pathaise. Kelemane Saitan pora apnikhan ke porikha korise, aru amikhan dukh kori kene kaam kora to harai dibole bhoi ase.

english_text: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya apnikhan logot pora Timothy amikhan logote ahise aru apnikhan laga biswas aru morom laga bhal khobor anise. Tai koise apuni khan amikhan nimite hodai bhal bhabona kori thake, aru jineka apnikhan ke lok kori bole mon ase, eneka he apnikhan bhi amikhan ke lok kori bole mon hoi.

english_text: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, ami laga bhai khan, mon dukh hoile bhi apnikhan laga biswas nimite amikhan laga mon aram hoise.

english_text: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan Isor logote thik thakile amikhan jinda ase.

english_text: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,
nagamese_text: Isor age te apnikhan nimite amikhan laga khushi thaka to ki pora Isor ke dhanyavad dibo?

english_text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
nagamese_text: Din raat amikhan bisi jor pora prathana kori thake, apuni khan laga chehera sabo paribo nimite, aru ki pora apnikhan laga biswas te puncha nai etu ke modot koribo paribo nimite.

english_text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan laga Baba Isor Nijor, aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu pora amikhan laga rasta apnikhan ke dikhai kene wapas ahibole dibi.

english_text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
nagamese_text: Aru bhi Probhu he apnikhan ke uthai di thakibi aru ekjon-ekjon ke aru sob manu logote morom te thakibo dibi, jineka amikhan bhi apnikhan ke kore.

english_text: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Probhu Jisu tai laga manu khan logote wapas ahibo, titia Baba Isor usorte apnikhan laga mon ke takot dibo aru eku dagi nathaka aru pobitrota te thakibo nimite. Amen!

english_text: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
nagamese_text: Tinehoile, bhai khan, Probhu Jisu laga naam te apuni khan ke utsah koridi ase. Isor ke khushi kori kene thakibo nimite amikhan pora ki sikhise, etu he bisi kori jai thakibi.

english_text: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apuni khan jani ase amikhan pora niyom diya to Probhu Jisu naam te dise.

english_text: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
nagamese_text: Aru apnikhan sapha thakibo lage, etu he Isor laga itcha ase, bebichari pora dur te thaki bole nimite,

english_text: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
nagamese_text: apnikhan nijor laga sonman aru pobitrota dhori kene rakhibi,

english_text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
nagamese_text: aru Isor najana Porjati khan nisena mangso itcha te nathakibi.

english_text: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha te kun manu bhi nijor bhai ke biya aru galti pora bodnam koribo nadibi. Kilekoile amikhan laga Isor to bodla luwa Isor ase, sob kotha to apuni khan ke poila pora jonai dise.

english_text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor to amikhan ke sapha nohoi kene thaki bole mata nohoi, kintu pobitro thaki bole nimite matise.

english_text: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, tai kun etu kotha namane, tai manu ke nohoi, kintu Isor jun he Tai laga Pobitro Atma tumike dise, Taike mana kori ase,.

english_text: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
nagamese_text: Kintu bhai-kokai khan majot morom kora laga kotha to, apnikhan ke kunba pora likhi dibole eku kaam nai, kelemane ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole Isor he apnikhan ke sikhai dise.

english_text: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;
nagamese_text: Macedonia te jiman bhai khan ase sob nimite apnikhan etu kori ase. Kintu aru bisi morom kori bole nimite, apuni, bhai-kokai khan ke aru mon dangor koridi ase.

english_text: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
nagamese_text: Apuni khan shanti aru bhal pora thaki bole nimite mon dangor koridi ase, aru nijor laga ki kaam ase eitu khan sob bhal pora cholai loijabi aru nijor pora ki kaam pare etu he kori thakibi, apuni khan ke sikhai diya nisena,

english_text: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
nagamese_text: etu hoile apnikhan abiswasi manu usorte bhal pora berabo, eneka thakile eku komti nathakibo.

english_text: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
nagamese_text: Kintu bhai khan, apnikhan bhi ghumai thaka khan laga kotha janibo lage, kele koile etu pora apnikhan mon nabikhabo nimite, jineka asha nathaka manu khan kore.

english_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
nagamese_text: Amikhan jani ase Jisu mori kene aru jinda hoise, etu nimite jun biswas kori kene mori jaise, taikhan ke Isor he Jisu logote wapas loi anibo.

english_text: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
nagamese_text: Etiya apnikhan ke hikai di thaka sob Isor laga kotha ase, amikhan kun jinda ase, Isor wapas aha dinte amikhan kun jinda thakibo, jun manu khan morise, taikhan age te amikhan najabo.

english_text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,
nagamese_text: Aru Isor nijor sorgo pora nami ahibo. Tai bisi jor pora hala kori kene ahibo, prodhan sorgodoth laga awaj pora, aru Isor laga bhigul loi kene ahibo, aru jun khan Khrista ke biswas kori kene morise, taikhan poila jinda hobo.

english_text: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete amikhan kunkhan namori kene ase, amikhan sob badal te taikhan logote mili kene Probhu ke lok kori bole uthai loijabo. Etu nisena he, amikhan hodai nimite Probhu logote thaki jabo.

english_text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, ekjon-ekjon ke etu kotha pora mon aram koridi thakibi.

english_text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bhai khan, utu din aru somoi laga kotha apnikhan janibole dorkar nai.

english_text: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
nagamese_text: Aru apnikhan nijor bhal pora jani ase Probhu wapas aha laga din to najana homoi te chor manu rati te aha nisena hobo.

english_text: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.
nagamese_text: Jitia taikhan koi, “Shanti aru surakhsa,” titia achanak pora taikhan uporte dukh aru nosto ahibo. Aru ekjon maiki bacha pabole dukh pa nisena hobo. Aru kun bhi polabo na paribo.

english_text: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
nagamese_text: Kintu bhai, apnikhan andhar te thaka nohoi, aru Tai aha laga din to apuni khan ke chor ahikena asurit kori diya nisena nohobo.

english_text: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apuni khan sob ujala aru din laga bacha khan ase. Amikhan rati aru andhar te thaka bacha khan nohoi.

english_text: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, amikhan dusra khan nisena ghumai nathakibo. Ulta, nisa nakori kene amikhan sai-rukhi thakibo.
