english_text: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, kun ghumai, taikhan rati te he ghumai, aru jun nisa hoi, taikhan bhi rati te nisa hoi.

english_text: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan din laga manu ase, amikhan nisa nohoi kene biswas aru morom to chati laga loha nisena lagabo lage, aru poritran laga asha to loha tupi nisena lagabo lage.

english_text: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile, Isor to Tai laga khong karone amikhan ke basi luwa nohoi, kintu amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista dwara poritran pabo nimite rakhise.

english_text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
nagamese_text: Khrista amikhan sob nimite morise, titia amikhan uthi kene thakilebi nohoile ghumai kene thakilebi, amikhan tai logote mili kene thakibo lage.

english_text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ekjon-ekjon laga mon aram aru uthai di thakibi, jineka apnikhan kori thakise eneka he kori thakibi.

english_text: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan ke hudi ase, bhai khan, jun khan pora apnikhan majot thaki kene Probhu laga kaam kori ase, aru apuni khan ke bujhai thake, taikhan ke bhal pora sabi.

english_text: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga kaam karone taikhan ke bisi sonman dibi koi kene amikhan mangi ase. Apnikhan mili kene thakibi.

english_text: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan laga mon uthai dikene koi ase, bhai khan: kotha-namana khan ke hoshiar kori dibi, mon biya hoi kene thaka khan ke mon dangor kori dibi, komjur khan ke modot koribi aru sob logote dhorjo thakibi.

english_text: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
nagamese_text: Sabi, ta te kunbi kunba manu ke biya kaam nimite biya wapas dibole nadibi, kintu hodai, juntu bhal ase etu he koribi, nijor nimite bhi aru sob nimite bhi.

english_text: Always rejoice.
nagamese_text: Hodai khushi thakibi.

english_text: Pray without ceasing.
nagamese_text: Prathana to narukhi kene kori thakibi.

english_text: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
nagamese_text: Sob te Isor ke hodai dhanyavad dibi. Kilekoile apnikhan nimite Khrista Jisu bhitor te etu Isor laga itcha ase.

english_text: Don’t quench the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Pobitro Atma ke bondh na koribi.

english_text: Don’t despise prophecies.
nagamese_text: Bhabobani khan ninda na koribi.

english_text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
nagamese_text: Sob saman ke bhal pora bujhi bhi. Ki bhal ase etu dhuri kene thakibi.

english_text: Abstain from every form of evil.
nagamese_text: Sob biya kaam pora dur te thakibi.

english_text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Shanti laga Isor tai nijor pora apnikhan ke pura pobitro koribo dibi. Probhu Jisu Khrista wapas naha tak apnikhan laga atma, jibon aru pura gaw galti nathaki kene rukhibo dibi.

english_text: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
nagamese_text: Hosa te thaka Isor ase jun apuni ke matise, aru Tai pora he etu bhi kori dibo.

english_text: Brothers, pray for us.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, amikhan karone bhi prathana kori dibi.

english_text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
nagamese_text: Sob bhai khan ke ekta pobitro chuma pora salam koribi.

english_text: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke Probhu laga naam te koi ase etu chithi sob biswasi bhai kokai khan ke porhayi dibi.

english_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah apnikhan logote thakibo dibi.

english_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
nagamese_text: Paul, aru Silvanus aru Timothy, Thessalonica sheher laga girja ke likhi ase, juntu Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista te ase.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan logote amikhan laga Baba Isor laga anugrah aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga shanti thakibi.

english_text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
nagamese_text: Amikhan hodai apnikhan nimite Isor ke dhanyavad dibo lage, bhai khan. Etu thik ase, kele koile apnikhan laga biswas bisi dangor hoi kene jai ase, aru apnikhan sob ekjon-ekjon nimite morom thaka to bisi hoi ase.

english_text: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan nijor pura mon khushi kori kene apnikhan laga kotha Isor laga girja ke koidi ase. Apnikhan ke dukh kosto diya homoi te apnikhan kineka dhorjo korise aru biswas te thakibo parise etu laga kotha khan koidi ase. Apuni khan dukh kosto te dhorjo kora to amikhan koi thake.

english_text: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.
nagamese_text: Etu Isor laga dharmikta pora kora bisar laga sakhi ase, kele koile etu nimite he apuni to Isor laga rajyo karone yogya ase, jun nimite apuni khan bhi dukh kosto pai ase.

english_text: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
nagamese_text: Kelemane, kun pora apnikhan ke dukh kosto diye, taikhan ke Isor pora he dukh kosto dibo, eneka kora to Isor nimite dharmikta dikha ase,

english_text: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,
nagamese_text: aru jun khan amikhan logote dukh te ase, sob nimite aram pabo. Etu hobo jitia Probhu Jisu Tai laga mohan sorgodoth khan logote akas te ulaikena ahibo.

english_text: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
nagamese_text: Juli thaka jui pora Tai jun khan Isor ke najane aru Probhu Jisu laga susamachar ke mana nai taikhan uporte saja dibo.

english_text: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
nagamese_text: Taikhan anonto homoi laga nosto te sajah pabo aru Isor aru Tai laga mohima thaka takot pora dur hoi jabo.

english_text: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
nagamese_text: Tai eitu khan koribo jitia Tai laga pobitro khan logot stuti pabole wapas ahibo, aru Taike biswas kora khan Taike saikene asurit hobo. Kilekoile amikhan laga etu gawahi kora kotha ke apnikhan biswas korise.

english_text: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan hodai apnikhan karone prathana kori thake, amikhan laga Isor pora apnikhan ke mata to yogya hoi thaki bole. Amikhan etu he prathana kori ase Tai pora apnikhan laga bhal kaam laga itcha thaka sob pura kori dibo karone aru biswas laga kaam khan pura hokti pora hobole karone.

english_text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu laga mohima apnikhan laga jibon te dikhibo nimite prathana kore, aru Tai pora apnikhan ke stuti kori dibo, etu sob hobo amikhan Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah nimite.

english_text: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you
nagamese_text: Etiya bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista wapas aha aru amikhan Taike lok kori bole joma kora laga kotha pora,

english_text: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
nagamese_text: apnikhan Probhu laga din asol pora ahi jaise bhabikena apnikhan mon ulta pulta nabhabi bhi, aru mon dukh nohoile manu laga kotha pora nohoile atma laga kotha nohoile amikhan laga chithi nimite apnikhan laga mon dukh na koribi.

english_text: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.
nagamese_text: Kun manu pora bhi apnikhan ke thogabole nadibi. Kilekoile etu laga din nahibo, jitia tak niyom bhanga ekjon, kun nosto laga chokra ase, kun he Isor laga kotha ke ninda kore, tai ahi najai.

english_text: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.
nagamese_text: Etu tai he ase jun nijorke uthai diye aru Isor laga naam aru Isor ke aradhana kori bole thaka ki ase sobke bhirodh kore. Etu pora, tai Isor laga mondoli te jai kene ta te bohi jai aru nijorke Isor koi kene dikhai.

english_text: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan monte nai naki, jitia ami apuni khan logote thakise, etu homoi te etu kotha khan koi dise nohoi?

english_text: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.
nagamese_text: Taike ki pora rukhai ase apnikhan jani loise, aru taike thik homoi te he dikhai dibo.

english_text: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile bujhi bo napara laga niyom nathaka age pora kaam shuru hoise, khali ta te ekjon ase jun he taike etiya rukhai kene ase jitia tak taike rasta pora ulai nadiye.

english_text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;
nagamese_text: Titia niyom nathaka ekjon ke janai dibo, junke Probhu Jisu pora Tai laga saas pora morai dibo. Aru Probhu wapas ahibole laga din prokahit janai diya pora taike khotom kori dibo.

english_text: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
nagamese_text: Etu niyom nathaka ekjon aha to Saitan laga biya kaam pora he ase, aru tai pora kisim-kisim sakti pora chihna khan dikha bo, aru asurit kaam misa pora dikhai dibo,

english_text: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
nagamese_text: adharmikta laga misa pora he eitu khan sob koribo. Etu manu khan sob mori jai ase kele koile taikhan nijorke bachai lobo paribole thaka hosa laga morom to taikhan luwa nai.

english_text: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,
nagamese_text: Etu karone Isor pora taikhan ke galti thaka laga kaam pathai dise, titia taikhan etu misa ke biswas koribo.

english_text: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
nagamese_text: Etu pora he taikhan sob uporte bisar anibo, jun khan hosa ke biswas kora nai, aru, ulta, adharmik kaam khan te khushi pai thakise.

english_text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
nagamese_text: Isor pora morom kora bhai khan, apnikhan nimite Isor ke hodai amikhan dhanyavad di thakibo lage. Kilekoile apuni khan ke Pobitro Atma pora sapha kori luwa aru hosa ke biswas kori luwa karone Isor apuni khan ke poritran dibole basi loise.

english_text: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Isor pora amikhan koi diya susamachar pora apuni khan ke mati loise, apuni khan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga mohima pabo nimite.

english_text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan bhal pora khara thakibi, prochar kora aru amikhan laga chithi pora ki to sikhai dise, eitu khan bhal pora dhori kene thakibi.

english_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista nijor, aru Isor amikhan laga Baba jun amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai laga anugrah dwara amikhanke hodai thaka mon aram aru bhal asha dise,

english_text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
nagamese_text: etu pora apnikhan ke bhal kotha aru bhal kaam kori bole uthai thakibo dibi.

english_text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,
nagamese_text: Aru bhai khan, amikhan nimite prathana koribi, titia Probhu laga kotha to sob jagate joldi punchibo aru Tai laga naam untcha hobo, jineka apnikhan logote hodai hoi ase.

english_text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.
nagamese_text: Biya aru paapi khan logot pora amikhan ke bachai loi lobole prathana kori dibi, kele koile biswas to sob logote nai.

english_text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu to hosa ase, Tai he apuni ke arubi khara kori dibo aru biya jon pora bachai lobo.

english_text: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan Probhu dwara apnikhan uporte pura biswas ase, apnikhan juntu kaam kori ase etu hodai kori thakibo.

english_text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
nagamese_text: Aru Probhu he apuni laga mon to Isor laga morom aru Khrista laga dhorjo te apuni laga ke mon rakhi thakibo.

english_text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.
nagamese_text: Etiya bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam te apnikhan ke hukum di ase, alsi thaka aru amikhan sikhai diya namani kene thaka khan pora dur thakibi.

english_text: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan jani ase apnikhan bhi amikhan nisena koribo, kele koile jetia apnikhan majote amikhan thakise, etu homoi te amikhan alsi kora nai.

english_text: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.
nagamese_text: Amikhan kun laga bhi poisa nadikena bhat khai diya nai. Hoilebi amikhan din rath dukh paikene kaam korise, kele koile apnikhan uporte khang dibole itcha thaka nai.

english_text: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
nagamese_text: Amikhan logote adhikar nathaka karone nohoi, hoilebi nije he kaam kori kene apuni khan ke buja bole korise, eneka hoile apuni khan bhi amikhan nisena koribo.

english_text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan logote thaka somoite amikhan etu koise, “Kaam nakora manu khabo nalage.”

english_text: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan huni ase ta te kunba apnikhan majote eku bhi kaam nakori kene, misa-misi kotha koi kene berai thake.

english_text: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
nagamese_text: Etu manu khan ke Probhu Jisu Khrista laga naam pora amikhan utsah kori ase, nijor kaam kori kene khabi.

english_text: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, bhai khan, ki bhal kaam ase etu kori bole alsi nohobi.

english_text: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi kunba manu chithi te koi diya kotha khan namanile, taike bhal pora sai thakibi aru tai logote namilibi, titia tai sorom lagibo.

english_text: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
nagamese_text: Kintu taike dushman nisena nabhabi bhi, hoilebi ekjon bhai nisena samjhai dibi.

english_text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
nagamese_text: Etiya, shanti laga Probhu Tai nije apuni khan ke shanti dibi sob homoi te. Probhu apnikhan sob logote thakibi.

english_text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.
nagamese_text: Etu ami laga salam ase, moi Paul, moi nije hath pora likhi ase, juntu sob chithi te moi laga dagi dise. Eneka he moi likhe.

english_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah sob logote hodai thakibo dibi.

english_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,
nagamese_text: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon apostle, Isor amikhan laga Tran-Korta laga hukum dwara Jisu Khrista, jun amikhan laga asha ase,

english_text: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: Timothy ke likhi ase, biswas te ami laga hosa chokra; anugraha, daya, aru shanti Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista amikhan laga Probhu naam pora.

english_text: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
nagamese_text: Moi Macedonia te jabole homoi te apnike ki kori bole koise, etiya bhi moi etu he koi ase, Ephesus te he thaki bhi aru kunba khan ke dusra shastro nashikabo nimite hukum dibi.

english_text: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan dusra jati laga dristanto khan aru dangor khandan laga kotha khan te mon nadibi kobi, juntu kotha khan pora jhagara he ulai, aru Isor laga kaam juntu biswas pora he hoi, etu komjur hoijai.

english_text: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,
nagamese_text: Etiya hukum laga asol maksad to sapha mon laga morom, bhal bhabona, aru mojbut biswas khan ase.

english_text: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
nagamese_text: Kunba khan etu rasta chari kene misa-misi kotha phale ghuri jaise.

english_text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.
nagamese_text: Taikhan niyom laga hikhok khan hobole mon ase, kintu taikhan ki koi ase aru ki bujhi kene mon dangor pora etu paribo bhabi ase, taikhan eitu khan ekta bhi najane.

english_text: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,
nagamese_text: Hoilebi jun niyom hisab te niyom cholai, etu niyom to bhal ase koi kene jane.

english_text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
nagamese_text: Amikhan etu jani ase, niyom to dharmik manu nimite bonai diya nohoi, kintu, dhorom namana aru kotha namana khan nimite bonai, Isor ke najana paapi manu khan, dhorom ke bodnam aru moila kora khan, baba-ama khan ke morai diya aru manu khan ke morai diya khan nimite,

english_text: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
nagamese_text: bebichari kora manu khan, mota-maiki biya kaam kora manu khan, manu ke nokor nisena bikiri kora khan, misa kowa khan, misa-misi kosom kora manu khan, aru utu sob juntu to biswasi manu khan ke hikai dibole nimite koi diya laga anurodh te ase.

english_text: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
nagamese_text: Etu sob kaam to asishit thaka Isor pora moike diya mohima laga susamachar ase.

english_text: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,
nagamese_text: Moi Jisu Khrista, amikhan laga Probhu ke dhanyavad di ase, jun pora amike hokti dise, Tai moike biswas korise aru Tai laga kaam karone moike mati loise.

english_text: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
nagamese_text: Age te, moi Probhu ke ninda kora manu thakise, aru buswasi khan ke bisi dukh digdar dise aru mara-mari kori thaka manu thakise, kintu ami daya paise, kele koile moi etu sob to biswas nathaka pora najani kene korise.

english_text: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan laga Probhu laga anugraha moi logote bhorta dise, aru Khrista Jisu te biswas aru morom dise.

english_text: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
nagamese_text: Etu to hosa aru manibo laga kotha ase, Jisu Khrista paapi khan ke bacha bole ahise aru paapi khan majot te moi sob pora maha paapi ase.

english_text: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu karone moi Isor laga daya paise, aru etu ekta kaam nimite ase, paapi manu kiman jon anonto jibon nimite biswas kori kene ahibole ase, taikhan uporte Jisu Khrista laga dhorjo thik dikhai dibo nimite ase.

english_text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Etiya yug upor yug laga raja, anonto thaka, suku pora dikhibo napara, ekjon he thaka Isor, ke sonman aru mohima hodai aru hodai nimite hobi. Amen.

english_text: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,
nagamese_text: Apnike hukum di ase, Timothy, moi laga bacha, utu bhabobani khan hisab te juntu apuni nimite dise, titia apuni eitu khan pora ekta biswas laga lorai kori bole paribo.

english_text: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,
nagamese_text: Khrista ke biswas ke dhori kene aru ekta bhal bhabona thakibi, juntu kunba manu khan chari dise aru panite taikhan laga biswas to jahaaj dubi ja nisena dubai dise.

english_text: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan to Hymenaeus aru Alexander ase, jun khan ke moi Saitan laga hathte di dise titia taikhan hikibo Isor naam ke ninda nakoribole.

english_text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, sob pora shuru te, ami tumikhan ke binti kori ase sob manu khan nimite amikhan Isor logote prathana koribi,

english_text: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
nagamese_text: raja khan aru adhikari khan nimite, titia amikhan ekta shanti aru bhal aru pobitro jibon chola bole paribo.

english_text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Tran-Korta nimite prathana kora to bhal aru khushi kotha ase.

english_text: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
nagamese_text: Isor he sob manu khan ke bacha bole, aru hosa gyaan dibole itcha kore.

english_text: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ta te ekjon Isor ase, aru Isor aru manu majote kotha milai diya ekjon ase, Jisu Khrista.

english_text: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
nagamese_text: Tai sob udhar koribo nimite thik somoite nijor jibon di dise, ekta sakhi hobo nimite.

english_text: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite he, moi nijorke Isor aru manu khan majote ekjon hikai diya aru ekjon apostle hobole basi loise. Moi Khrista te hosa koi ase- misa kowa nohoi. Porjati khan nimite biswas aru hosa hikai dibole moi ekjon hikhok ase.

english_text: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, moi itcha ase aradhana kora sob jagate, manu khan pobitro hath uthaikene prathana kori bole, ghusa aru jhagara nakorikena.

english_text: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
nagamese_text: Thik etu nisena, ami itcha kori ase kineka kapra lagai le sonman pai, eitu khan lagabi aru nijorke rukhai kene bhal pora thakibi. Chuli khan te kiba-kiba nabonabi, nohoile suna, moti, aru daam kapra khan nalagabi,

english_text: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
nagamese_text: kintu Isor jana mahila nimite ki bhal kaam ase eitu khan he kori kene dikhabi.

english_text: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
nagamese_text: Ekjon mahila to shanti, nomro aru, mon dikene sikhibo lage.

english_text: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
nagamese_text: Mahila khan pora mota khan uporte Sikhsa dibole aru adhikar cholabole karone ami anumati nadibo, kintu taikhan aradhana to chup-chap koribo lage.

english_text: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
nagamese_text: Kile mane poila Adam ke bonaise, etu pichete Eve ke bonaise.

english_text: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
nagamese_text: Aru Adam pora paap kora nai, kintu Eve he Saitan pora poila thogai khaise aru tai he poila paap korise.

english_text: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
nagamese_text: Kintu, taikhan bacha jonom diya te bachibo, jodi taikhan biswas, morom, aru bhabona to pobitro kori kene sob mani thakile.

english_text: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha to hosa ase: kunba cholawta hobole mon thakile, tai ekjon bhal kaam kori bole mon kori ase.

english_text: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
nagamese_text: Etu karone, ekjon cholawta to galti nathaka hobo lage, tai ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, hisab te thaka manu, dimag thaka, bhal adat, aru ghor te aha manu khan logote bhal thaki bole, sikhai dibole para manu,

english_text: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
nagamese_text: kintu modhu kha adat thaka aru jhagara kora manu nohobo lage, kintu tai to nomro, shanti thaka, aru poisa morom kora manu nohobo lage.

english_text: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
nagamese_text: Tai nijor ghor ke bhal pora chola bo janibo lage, tai laga bacha khan pora tai laga kotha manibo lage, aru taike sonman kora manu hobo lage.

english_text: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ekjon manu tai laga nijor ghor manu khan ke thik pora chola bo najanile, kineka tai Isor laga girja ke sabo paribo?

english_text: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
nagamese_text: Tai ekjon notun biswasi nohobo lage, etu pora tai phutani pora bhorta nohobo aru tai bhoot laga rasta te nagiribo.

english_text: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
nagamese_text: Tai bhal naam thaka aru bahar te bhi ekjon bhal naam thaka hobo lage, etu hoile tai sorom nohobo aru bhoot laga jal te nagiribo.

english_text: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
nagamese_text: Thik eneka, porisharok khan bhi, sonman thaka hobo lage, aru duita kotha kora, modhu kha manu, aru lalchi kora manu nahobo lage,

english_text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
nagamese_text: hoilebi, taikhan to mon sapha pora hosa laga biswasi hobo lage.

english_text: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ke bhal pora sabi, aru taikhan thik ase koile taikhan ke etu kaam koribo dibi.

english_text: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena mahila khan bhi sonman thaka hobo lage, chukuli nakoribo lage, hisab-te thaka, aru sob te thik mon dibo para hobo lage.

english_text: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
nagamese_text: Girja laga porisharok khan ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, bacha khan ke aru ghor manu khan sobke bhal pora cholabole janibo lage.

english_text: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jun kaam thik pora korise, tai nijor nimite ekjon bhal sonman thaka naam hobo aru biswas te bisi mon dangor hobo juntu Jisu Khrista te ase.

english_text: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
nagamese_text: Ami etu sob apuni khan ke likhi ase, aru apnikhan logote joldi ahibole bhabi ase,

english_text: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
nagamese_text: hoilebi ami ahibole deri hoise koile, etu likha khan pora apuni janibo Isor laga ghor te thaka manu khan kineka niyom manibo lage, juntu jinda Isor laga girja ase, juntu hosa laga khamba ase aru etu ke khara kori bole dhuri thake.

english_text: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
nagamese_text: Eku ulta bhabona nathaki kene, Isor laga hosa to dangor pora dikhaise: “Khrista ke mangso te dikhai dise, Atma pora bujhai dise, Sorgodoth khan pora dikhise, Desh majote sobke janai dise, Prithibi te biswas korise, Aru Taike sorgote loi jaise.”

english_text: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
nagamese_text: Etiya Pobitro Atma pora sapha pora koidi ase, olop homoi pichete manu khan biswas chari bo, aru misa atma khan laga kotha te mon di jabo, aru bhoot khan pora sikhai diya kotha khan hunibo,

english_text: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
nagamese_text: aru misa hikhok khan ke biswas koribo, taikhan laga nijor bhabona ke jui pora sukha nisena sukhai dibo.

english_text: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
nagamese_text: Taikhan pora shadi kora to paap ase kobo aru kha luwa juntu Isor pora dise, juntu biswasi aru hosa buja khan pora khai kene dhanyavad dibole ase, eitu khan nakhai jabi kobo.

english_text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile ki saman Isor pora banai se etu sob bhal ase, aru juntu amikhan pora Isor ke dhanyavad dikene khabo, eitu khan ekta bhi phelabo nalage,

english_text: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
nagamese_text: kele koile etu kha bostu to Isor laga kotha aru prathana pora sapha kori dise.

english_text: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
nagamese_text: Etu janoni kotha sob to bhai khan ke janibo dise koile tumi Jisu Khrista laga ekjon bhal kaam kora noukar hobo, tumi etu biswas laga kotha pora taikhan ke pali bo, juntu tumi nijor bhi mani kene ahise.

english_text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
nagamese_text: Kintu duniya laga dristanto khan juntu buri ama khan bhal pai, eitu khan pora dur thakibi. Kintu, nije ke Isor laga jibon te taiyar koribi.

english_text: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile nijor gaw ke mon dile olop he labh hoi, kintu Isor laga jibon ke mon dile sob phale labh hoi, kelemane etu pora he etiya thaka jibon aru ahibole thaka jibon te asha thakibo.

english_text: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha to hosa ase aru biswas koribo lage aru mani bole nimite yogya ase.

english_text: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, amikhan dukh paikena bisi kaam kori thake, kele koile amikhan jinda thaka Isor uporte asha ase, jun he sob manu laga Tran-Korta ase, biswasi khan nimite aru bhi bisi ase.

english_text: Command and teach these things.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan hukum kori dibi aru sikhai dibi.

english_text: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga jawani ke kun pora bhi ninda koribo nadibi, hoilebi taikhan jun biswas kore, taikhan ke tumi laga kotha, kaam, morom, biswas, aru eku dagi nathaka jibon pora ekta bhal namuna dikhai dibi.

english_text: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
nagamese_text: Jitia tak ami ta te nahe, mon dikene Shastro porhi thakibi, manu khan laga mon dangor kori dibi aru taikhan ke hikai dibi.

english_text: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
nagamese_text: Kitia bhi tumi bhitor te thaka Atma laga bordan, juntu bura manu khan pora tumi uporte hath dikene bhabobani pora tumi etu paise, etu ke nacharibi.

english_text: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan porhi thakibi; eitu khan te bhorta thakibi, titia tumi laga bhal kaam laga labh sob manu dikhibo pabo.

english_text: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
nagamese_text: Nije ke hoshiar thakibi, aru tumi ki hikai di ase etu te bhi hoshiar thakibi. Eitu khan sob kori thakibi, kele koile eneka korise koile, tumi nijor bhi aru tumi sikhai diya manu khan sob bachibo.

english_text: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;
nagamese_text: Bisi umor thaka bura manu ke gali nadibi, hoilebi nijor baba nisena kotha koribi; jawan manu khan ke bhai khan nisena,

english_text: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
nagamese_text: bisi umor mahila khan ke nijor ama nisena, aru jawan mahila khan ke nijor bhoini nisena, sapha pora bhabi bhi.

english_text: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
nagamese_text: Bidhowa khan ke sonman koribi.

english_text: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
nagamese_text: Kintu kunba bidhowa laga bacha nohoile nata-nati ase koile, taikhan ke poila nijor ghor te bhal niyom dikha bole karone sikhibo dibi, aru taikhan pora baba-ama ke wapas sabo, kele koile etu he Isor ke khushi kore.

english_text: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai he asol bidhowa ase junke chari dise aru tai ekla hoise, aru tai laga pura asha to Isor logote rakhi kene ase, aru din-raat tai binti kore, aru hodai prathana kori thake.

english_text: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
nagamese_text: Kintu, ekjon bidhowa kun mangso itcha te thaki ase, tai to jinda thakile bhi mora nisena ase.

english_text: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha khan bhi taikhan ke koi dibi, titia taikhan laga galti nathakibo.

english_text: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
nagamese_text: Kintu jun manu tai laga asol ghor manu khan ke nasai aru nijor ghor khandan khan nimite, aru khas pora, nijor ghor manu khan nimite eku nadiye, tai to tai laga biswas haraise, aru tai to dhorom namana pora bhi biya ase.

english_text: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
nagamese_text: Jun bidhowa sat saal pora bisi ase, aru khali ekjon mota laga maiki he thakise,

english_text: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
nagamese_text: tai laga bhal kaam laga naam nimite jani thaka ekjon ase; jodi tai bacha khan ke bhal pora palikena sa jon ase, nachina manu khan ke bhal pora saise, tai pobitro manu khan laga theng dhulaise, tai dukh pa khan ke aram dise, aru tai sob bhal kaam khan korise, eneka hoile tai laga naam likhibi.

english_text: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
nagamese_text: Kintu jawan bidhowa khan laga naam nalikhibi, kele koile jitia nijor laga itcha kori bole mon thake, taikhan arubi shadi kori bole mon kore,

english_text: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
nagamese_text: eneka hoi kene taikhan Khrista te thaka biswas chari kene galti te thaki jai.

english_text: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
nagamese_text: Aru, taikhan ekta ghor pora ekta ghor te jai kene alsi hobole sikhi jai. Aru alsi kora ekla nohoi, hoile bhi misa-misi kotha kora aru bisi kaam kora nisena dikhai, nakobole laga kotha khan koi thake.

english_text: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite bidhowa khan ke shadi kori lobi koi ase, bacha khan pai lobi, taikhan laga ghor manu ke sabi, aru dushman khan ke amikhan laga biya kobole somoi nadibi.

english_text: For already some have turned away after Satan.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile kunba bidhowa khan poila pora Saitan phale girise.

english_text: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
nagamese_text: Kunba bidhowa ase koile, biswasi mahila khan pora taike modot koribi. Etu kaam to girja uporte nadibi, eneka hoile biswasi mahila khan pora bidhowa khan ke sai lobo.

english_text: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
nagamese_text: Cholawta kori thaka khan ke bisi sonman koribi, jun khan Isor kotha te ase aru sikhai thake.

english_text: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Shastro te koi ase, “Apuni khan goru laga mukh bondh na koribi jitia tai dhaan uporte morona marikena berai” aru “Kaam kora khan dukh laga inam pabo lage.”

english_text: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
nagamese_text: Duijon nohoile tinjon gawahi nathakile dangor manu khan uporte biya kaam laga galti nadibi.

english_text: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
nagamese_text: Jun manu paap kori ase, taike sob manu laga usorte galti hunai dibi titia dusra khan bhi bhoi lagibo.

english_text: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
nagamese_text: Ami hukum di ase Isor aru Khrista Jisu basi luwa sorgodoth age te, tumike juntu kotha koi dise tumi sob logote eke pora mani bhi aru mukh-saikene eku kaam na koribi.

english_text: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
nagamese_text: Kunke bhi prathana te joldi hath narakhibi. Taikhan laga paap logote eke bhag nalobi. Nijorke sapha rakhibi.

english_text: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
nagamese_text: Khali pani ekla khai nathaki bhi, hoile bhi angur-ros bhi olop khabi tumi laga pet kitia ba bemar hoi thaka karone.

english_text: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
nagamese_text: Kunba laga paap to khula khuli dikhi jai, bisar din naha age te. Kintu kunba laga paap to pichete ulai jai.

english_text: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena bhal kaam to khula pora dikhi jai, jun manu biya kaam kori ase, etu lukabo na paribo.

english_text: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
nagamese_text: Kiman manu sewa laga bhar loi kene nokor ase nijor malik ke sob sonman dibi, tinehoile kun bhi Isor laga naam aru ki hikai se eitu khan bodnam nohobo.

english_text: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
nagamese_text: Kintu nokorkhan biswasi malik logote thaka karone biya napabo lage, kele koile taikhan bhi bhai kokai ase. Kintu taikhan ke aru bhi bhal pora sewa koribo lage, kele koile jun malik ke sewa kore etu malik bhi biswasi aru Isor laga morom te ase. Etu kotha khan shikabi aru janai dibi.

english_text: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu ulta kotha hikai ase, aru amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista laga kotha hikai diya nisena eke nohoi,

english_text: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
nagamese_text: tinehoile tai to phutani aru eku bhi nabuja ase, kintu tai misa-misi kotha loi kene jhagara kori bole bisi mon ase. Eitu khan pora suku jula, jhagara, hinsa kora, biya bhabona khan ulai,

english_text: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
nagamese_text: aru biya bhabona hoi kene taikhan majote hodai jhagara thake. Taikhan logote hosa nai, aru Isor laga sewa kora pora dhun hobole bisare.

english_text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor logote khushi hoi kene thakile etu he labh ase.

english_text: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan eku bhi ana nai, aru etu prithibi pora eku loijabo na paribo.

english_text: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
nagamese_text: Kintu kha luwa, aru kapra thakile, etu pora amikhan khushi thakibo.

english_text: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
nagamese_text: Etiya jun manu dhuni hobole mon jai taikhan porikha te giri jai aru phang te phasi jai, aru sob murkho jokhom laga lalchi pora dhuri loi, juntu pora manu khan ke biya aru khotom kori diye.

english_text: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile poisa laga morom to sob biya laga bijon ase, etu nimite kunba manu khan etu te bisi itcha hoi kene biswas pora dur hoijai aru bisi dukh nijorke jokhom korise.

english_text: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi, Isor laga manu, eitu khan pora dur thakibi. Etu pora to, dharmikta, Isor jana, biswas, morom, rukhibole para, aru norom thaka eitu khan he bisari bhi.

english_text: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
nagamese_text: Biswas laga bhal lorai ke loribi. Tumike anonto jibon nimite Isor pora matise, etu ke dhori kene thakibi, juntu nimite bisi gawahi khan laga age te tumi bhal shikar korise.

english_text: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
nagamese_text: Moi tumike, Isor laga naam pora koi ase, jun sobke jibon diye, aru Khrista Jisu laga naam pora, jun Pontius Pilate age te bhal pora shikar dise:

english_text: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: etu hukum khan eku dagi aru bodnam nohoikena mani bhi jitia tak amikhan laga Probhu Jisu Khrista wapas nahe.

english_text: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
nagamese_text: Isor he Khrista ke thik homoi te dikhai dibo- Tai asishit thaka Isor ase, Sason-Korta aru Raja laga Raja, aru Probhu khan uporte Probhu ase.

english_text: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
nagamese_text: Tai kitia bhi namoribo, aru Tai usorte jabo napara puhor laga ujala te thake. Kun manu bhi Taike dikha nai aru kun bhi Taike sabo na paribo. Tai logote sonman aru anonto hokti thakibi. Amen.

english_text: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;
nagamese_text: Etu yug laga dhuni khan ke phutani nakoribole koi dibi aru eku thikana nathaka laga dhun te asha narakhibi kobi. Kintu taikhan ke Isor jun pora amikhan ki lage etu sob diye, etu Isor logot asha rakhibole kobi.

english_text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
nagamese_text: Bhal kori bole nimite hukum dibi, bhal kaam kori kene dhuni hobole, mon khuli kene dibole aru sob logot te eke bhag kori bole nimite kobi,

english_text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
nagamese_text: tinehoile he ahibole din nimite bhal bhetimul karone sompoti joma kori ase, aru asol jibon he ase, etu taikhan pabo.

english_text: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
nagamese_text: Timothy, tumike ki jimedari dise, etu bhal pora bachai kene rakhibi, dusra dhorom pora dur thakibi, misa-misi kotha khan napatibi, aru misa laga gyaan khan pora dur thakibi.

english_text: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
nagamese_text: Kunba biswasi khan nijor bisi jane koi, etu nimite taikhan laga biswas to nai. Isor laga anugrah tumi uporte thakibi.

english_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
nagamese_text: Paul, Isor laga itcha pora Jisu Khrista laga ekjon apostle, jibon laga kosom juntu Jisu Khrista te ase,

english_text: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
nagamese_text: moi laga morom bacha, Timothy ke likhi ase: Baba Isor aru Khrista Jisu amikhan Probhu laga kripa, daya, aru shanti thakibi.

english_text: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
nagamese_text: Ami Isor ke bisi dhanyavad di ase, junke moi laga baba khan laga din pora moi sewa kori ahise, sapha bhabona loi kene, jun nimite ami kaam kori ase, ami narukhi kene din raat apuni ke ami laga prathana pora monte rakhe.

english_text: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
nagamese_text: Ami tumi laga suku pani ke yaad kori thake, ami tumike bisi sabole mon hoi ase, titia ami laga khushi pora bhorta hobo.

english_text: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga asol biswas moi yaad kori dise, juntu poila tumi laga ama Eunice aru nani Lois logot bhi thakise, aru ami pura biswas ase tumi logot bhi ase.

english_text: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha nimite, ami tumike yaad kori bole di ase, moi laga hath tumi uporte rakhikena Isor ke mangi diya bordan, juntu tumi bhitor te ase, etu ke notun kori kene chola bhi.

english_text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile Isor amikhan ke bhoi laga atma diya nai, hoile bhi hokti aru morom aru bhal niyom laga atma dise.

english_text: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite tumi Isor laga gawahi kori bole sorom na koribi, nohoile bhi moi nimite, jun Isor laga noukar ase. Ulta, Isor laga hokti hisab te amikhan eke logote susamachar karone Khrista nimite dukh koribo.

english_text: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
nagamese_text: Isor he amikhan ke bachai dise aru pobitro hobo nimite matise, amikhan laga kaam hisab te nohoi, hoile bhi Tai laga Nijor itcha aru anugraha hisab te, juntu, somoi shuru nohua age te, Khrista Jisu te Tai amikhan ke dise,

english_text: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
nagamese_text: juntu etiya amikhan laga Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista ulai aha te prokahit kori dise. Tai hosa pora bhi mrityu ke khotom kori dise, aru jibon aru anonto jibon ke Tai laga susamachar pora ujala te anidise.

english_text: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
nagamese_text: Juntu nimite amike procharok, apostle, aru hikhok hobole Isor pora basi loise.

english_text: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan nimite ami bhi bisi dukh kore. Hoilebi ami sorom nakore, kele koile ami Taike jani ase junke ami biswas kore, aru ami biswas ase hekh din tak Tai juntu jimedari amike dise etu rakhibo.

english_text: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Ami juntu hosa kotha tumike hunai dise, bhal pora mani kene thakibi aru Jisu Khrista ke biswas koribi aru Tai laga morom te thakibi.

english_text: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
nagamese_text: Utu bhal kaam juntu tumi uporte jimedari dise, amikhan bhitor te thaka Pobitro Atma pora etu ke hoshiar pora bachai kene rukhibi.

english_text: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
nagamese_text: Etu tumi jani ase, ta te sob manu jun khan Asia desh te ase taikhan sob amike chari dise, taikhan majote Phygelus aru Hermogenes bhi ase.

english_text: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
nagamese_text: Probhu he Onesiphorus laga ghor uporte daya thaki bole dibi, kele koile tai amike mon khushi koridi thake aru ami koidi ghor te ase koi kene tai sorom nalage.

english_text: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, jitia tai Rome sheher te ahise, tai amike lok nakora tak amike bisari thakise.

english_text: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
nagamese_text: Probhu laga dinte Probhu he taike daya pabole rasta dikhai dibi. Tumi bhal pora jani ase tai Ephesus sheher te ami nimite kiman bhal pora modot korise.

english_text: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, moi laga bacha, Jisu Khrista pora aha anugraha te takot pora khara thakibi.

english_text: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
nagamese_text: Moi bisi manu ke koi diya kotha khan juntu tumi huni loise, etu kotha khan loi kene dharmik aru dusra ke sikhabo para manu khan ke jimedari di dibi.

english_text: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Dukh digdar paile bhi, amikhan logote Khrista Jisu laga ekjon bhal sipahi hoi kene thakibi.

english_text: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
nagamese_text: Sipahi te thaka khan kitia bhi taikhan laga pura dhyan to etu jibon laga kaam te nadiye, kintu taike kun jimedari dise, taike khushi kori bole kosis kore.

english_text: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
nagamese_text: Aru, ekjon pola manu jun polai, tai thik niyom te nakhilile tai inam napai.

english_text: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
nagamese_text: Ekjon kheti-kora manu, jun bisi dukh kori kene bijon lagase, tai he sobse poila kheti kata laga dhaan to pabo lage.

english_text: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
nagamese_text: Moi ki kotha koi ase etu ke bhabibi, kele koile Probhu pora sob te bujhi bole gyaan dibo.

english_text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista ke yaad koribi, jun mora pora jee uthise, jun David laga bijon pora ahise, ami prochar kori thaka susamachar hisab-te

english_text: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
nagamese_text: juntu nimite ami iman dukh te ase, ekjon biya kaam kora manu nisena moike bandi kene ase. Hoilebi Isor laga kotha ke kitia bhi bondh kori kene rakhibole na paribo.

english_text: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Isor laga basi luwa manu khan nimite moi dhorjo kori kene thake, titia taikhan bhi poritran juntu Jisu Khrista te ase, aru anonto mohima thaka to pabo.

english_text: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha khan hosa ase: “Kitia amikhan Khrista logote morise, amikhan bhi tai logote jinda thakibo.

english_text: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
nagamese_text: Kitia amikhan dhorjo thakibo, amikhan bhi Tai logote raj koribo. Jodi amikhan Taike chari dise koile, Tai bhi amikhan ke chari dibo.

english_text: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan hosa pora nathakile bhi, Khrista to pura mon dikene amikhan logote thake, Kilekoile Tai nijorke misa bona bole napare.”

english_text: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
nagamese_text: Hodai etu kotha khan taikhan ke yaad koridi thakibi, aru Isor kotha loi kene jhagara kori bole nadibi, etu pora eku bhal nahe, ulta etu huni kene manu biya hoi jabo.

english_text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
nagamese_text: Isor pora tumike bhal ase kobo nimite, aru kaam kori bole sorom nathaka ekjon hobole para tak kosis koribi, aru hosa kotha loi kene hikai dibi.

english_text: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi jun khan Isor laga kotha nohoi kene misa-misi kotha kore eitu khan pora dur thakibi, kele koile taikhan pora aru bhi biya rasta te loijabo.

english_text: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga kotha to ekta ghao nisena sob jagate ulai jai, eitu khan majote Hymenaeus aru Philetus bhi ase,

english_text: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
nagamese_text: jun khan hosa kotha pora polai jaise. Taikhan pora punoruthan din to poila pora jai jaise, aru eneka koi kene dusra laga biswas ke khotom koridi ase.

english_text: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
nagamese_text: Hoilebi, Isor laga bhetimul to mojbut pora khara thake, aru eneka likhi kene ase: “Probhu jane jun khan Tai laga ase” aru “Jun manu Probhu laga naam te biswas kore, taikhan adharmikta thaka kaam nakoribo lage.”

english_text: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.
nagamese_text: Ekta dangor ghor te, suna aru chandi pora bana samankhan ase, hoile bhi khuri aru mati pora bona saman khan bhi ase, aru kunba saman to dangor kaam nimite cholai aru kunba saman to hodai cholai.

english_text: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jun manu nijorke biya khan pora sapha kori loise, taike bhal kaam nimite rakhibo, etu pichete tai to pobitro hobo aru tai laga malik pora taike chola bo. Aru tai to sob bhal kaam nimite taiyar thakibo.

english_text: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jawan howa laga mangso itcha thaka pora dur polabi aru dharmikta, biswas, morom aru shanti bisari bhi aru jun pora Probhu ke sapha mon pora mate, eneka thakibi.

english_text: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi murkho aru misa-misi kotha khan pora dur thakibi, tumi jani ase etu kotha khan pora jhagara ulai.

english_text: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi ekjon Isor laga noukar to jhagara nakoribo lage, kintu sob age te nomro thakibi, aru bhal sikhai dibi, aru dhorjo koribi,

english_text: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
nagamese_text: jun tumi laga kotha noloi, taike nomro pora buja bhi, hobo pare Isor taikhan laga mon chui kene hosa laga gyaan te mon ghurai dibo pare,

english_text: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.
nagamese_text: aru bhoot laga jaal pora polabole taikhan laga dimag khuli dibo pare, juntu jagate tai laga khushi nimite taikhan ke dhuri rakhi ase.

english_text: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi etu janikena thakibi, hekh din punchile, bisi dukh somoi ahibole ase.

english_text: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile manu khan nijorke morom koribo, poisa laga lalchi koribo, nijorke dangor bhabibo, phutani koribo, dhorom laga biya kotha kobo, baba-ama laga kotha namanibo, bhal kaam kori dile bhi dhanyavad dibo najanibo, sapha nathakibo,

english_text: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
nagamese_text: manu ke morom nalagibo, manu ke maph nadibo, misa kobo, nijorke biya kori bole rukhabo na paribo, bhal ke sabo na paribo,

english_text: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
nagamese_text: manu ke thogai dibo, nabhabi kene kaam koribo, dangor bhabona koribo, Isor pora bhi prithibi ke he bisi morom koribo.

english_text: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Isor ke jana nisena dikha bo, hoile bhi Tai laga hokti to nolobo. Eneka manu khan pora dur thakibi.

english_text: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
nagamese_text: Kilekoile eitu khan majote kunba khan manu laga ghor te ghusi kene murkho mahila khan, jun khan paap pora bhorta hoi kene thake, taikhan ke thogai kene mangso laga itcha te giribole diye.

english_text: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
nagamese_text: Etu mahila khan hodai sikhi thake, hoile bhi taikhan kitia bhi hosa kotha to bujhi bo napare.

english_text: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
nagamese_text: Jineka Jannes aru Jambres pora Moses laga kotha mana nai, etu manu khan bhi hosa kotha ke mana korise, paap pora taikhan laga dimag bandi kene ase, aru taikhan laga biswas ekdom komjur ase.

english_text: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
nagamese_text: Kintu taikhan bisi dur te najabo, taikhan laga murkho to sob manu jani jabo, jineka utu duijon logote hoisele.

english_text: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi moi hikai diya kotha manise, niyom, maksad, biswas, morom, dhorjo,

english_text: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
nagamese_text: kiman kisim laga dukh digdar paise aru moi logot ki hoise aru kineka Antioch, Iconium, aru Lystra sheher khan te moi dukh paise; eitu khan sob pora dukh digdar khan bardas koribo parise. Kilekoile etu sob pora Probhu he moike bachai loise.

english_text: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile jun manu Khrista Jisu logote dharmik hoi kene thakibo mon ase, taikhan to dukh digdar pabo.

english_text: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
nagamese_text: Kintu biya aru thogai diya manu khan nijor bhi thogai pabo aru biya pora aru bhi biya hoi jabo.

english_text: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
nagamese_text: Kintu, jun logot pora tumi sikhise, aru biswas kori loise, eitu khan ke mani kene thakibi.

english_text: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Aru kineka bacha homoi pora Shastro te likha jani thakise, etu pora Jisu Khrista te biswas kora pora poritran pai eneka janibole gyaan paise, etu yaad koribi.

english_text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
nagamese_text: Pobitro kitab laga sob kotha to Isor laga gyaan pora hoise aru etu laga labh to sikhai dibo nimite, gali kori hikai dibo nimite, sidha kori dibo nimite, aru dharmikta te thakibo nimite hikai dibole karone ase,

english_text: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
nagamese_text: titia Isor laga manu to sob bhal kaam koribo nimite gyaan aru taiyar thakibo.

english_text: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
nagamese_text: Moi tumike etu hukum di ase, Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga naam te, kun morija-a aru jinda thaka manu khan sobke bisar koribo, aru Tai nijor aru Tai laga rajyo dikhai dibole ahibo:

english_text: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
nagamese_text: Susamachar kotha prochar koribi; hodai taiyar thakibi; dhorjo kori kene manu khan ke bujhai di thakibi, gali dibi aru mon dangor koridi kene sob sikhai thakibi.

english_text: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
nagamese_text: Kelemane hosa kotha sikhai diya huni bole mon nathaka homoi ahi ase. Kintu nijor laga mangso itcha phale jabo aru taikhan pora huni bole mon kora kotha he bisaribo,

english_text: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
nagamese_text: aru hosa kotha pora dur hoi jabo, aru taikhan dristanto khan phale mon ghuri jabo.

english_text: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi to sob homoi te nijorke dhorjo kori thakibi. Dukh kosto uthabi; procharok laga kaam koribi; tumike diya kaam pura koribi.

english_text: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, moi to hoile bolidan diya nisena nijor jibon chari dibole homoi punchi kene ase.

english_text: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
nagamese_text: Moi para tak bhal lorai te bhal pora lorai korise; moi polai thaka khotom kori loise; moi biswas rakhise.

english_text: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
nagamese_text: Etiya pora moi karone dharmikta laga mukut rakhi dikene ase, juntu Probhu, kun dharmik bisar-korta ase, Tai pora moike utu dinte dibo, aru khali moike he nohoi, kintu sob jonke kunkhan Tai wapas aha din ke bisi asha pora rukhi ase.

english_text: Be diligent to come to me soon,
nagamese_text: Moi logote joldi ahibole tumi para tak moi logote ahibole kosis koribi,

english_text: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
nagamese_text: kelemane Demas to amike charise, etu yug ke morom hoija karone aru tai Thessalonica sheher te jai jaise, Crescens bhi Galatia te, aru Titus bhi Dalmatia te.

english_text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
nagamese_text: Khali Luke ekla moi logote ase. Tumi logote Mark ke bhi loi kene anibi, kelemane tai porisorja laga kaam te moi nimite bisi bhal ase.

english_text: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tychicus ke moi Ephesus sheher te pathaise.

english_text: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
nagamese_text: Tumi aha homoi te Troas te thaka Carpus logote moi pora chari diya kapra khan, kitab khan aru etu sob pora uporte kitab likha chamra khan ani dibi.

english_text: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
nagamese_text: Alexander, jun luha bostu bona manu ase, tai pora amike bisi biya kaam korise. Tai laga kaam hisab te Probhu pora ghurai dibo.

english_text: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
nagamese_text: Tumi bhi tai logot pora nijorke hoshiar kori lobi, kele koile tai amikhan laga kotha ke bisi apatti korise.

english_text: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
nagamese_text: Moi nijor laga prothom sakhi diya te, kun bhi moi logote khara kora nai, sob moike chari dise. Isor pora morom kori kene taikhan uporte etu ghurai nadibi.

english_text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu moi logote te thakikena moike takot dise, etu nimite moi Porjati majot te susamachar hunai dise. Etu nimite moike bagh laga mukh pora bachai loise.

english_text: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Probhu pora biya kaam sob pora moike udhar koribo aru moike bachai loi kene Tai laga sorgo rajyote loijabo. Taike he hodai-hodai nimite mohima thakibi. Amen.

english_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
nagamese_text: Priscilla aru Aquila, aru Onesiphorus laga ghor-manu khan sobke salam janai dibi.

english_text: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
nagamese_text: Erastus to Corinth sheher te thaki jaise, kintu Trophimus ke ami Miletus sheher te chari dise kele koile tai bemar thakise.

english_text: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
nagamese_text: Thanda din naha age te tumi yate ahibole kosis koribi. Eubulus pora tumike, aru Pudens, aru Linus, Claudia, aru sob bhai khan ke salam di ase.

english_text: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
nagamese_text: Probhu tumi laga atma logote thakibi. Isor laga anugrah sob logote thakibi.

english_text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
nagamese_text: Paul, Isor laga ekjon noukar, Jisu Khrista laga apostle, aru Isor pora basi luwa khan laga biswas nimite aru hosa gyaan thaka juntu ki bhal ase etu logote ekta ase,

english_text: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
nagamese_text: anonto jibon te asha rakhi thaka, juntu Isor, kun kitia bhi misa nokoi, yug shuru nakora age pora kosom rakhidise.

english_text: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
nagamese_text: Aru thik homoi te, Tai laga kotha prokahit kori dise, amikhan laga Tran-Korta Isor laga hukum pora moike kori bole hukum dise.

english_text: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
nagamese_text: Titus ke, amikhan laga biswas te thaka ekjon asol chokra; amikhan laga Baba Isor, Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista te anugrah aru shanti hoi thakibi.

english_text: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
nagamese_text: Moi etu karone tumike Crete majuli te chari jaise, ki kaam thik nohoi kene thakise eitu khan thik kori bole, aru moi tumike kowa nisena, sheher te girja laga rokhiya kori bole bura khan ke basi lobi.

english_text: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
nagamese_text: Aru bura khan to golti nathaka hobo lage, aru ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, aru tai laga bacha khan bhi adat biya aru kotha namana eneka nohobo lage.

english_text: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
nagamese_text: Kelemane ekjon girja laga cholawta to Isor laga ghor sa karone eku napuncha nathakibo lage. Aru tai ekjon nijor khushi te jai thaka, aru joldi khong kora, aru misa kotha, aru jhagara kora, aru lalchi nohobo lage.

english_text: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
nagamese_text: Kintu tai alohi manu ke tai laga ghor te rakhibo para hobo lage, dhorjo kora, sidha mon thaka, pobitro thaka, nijorke rukhabole para hobo lage.

english_text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
nagamese_text: Tai hosa biswas kotha ke thik dhori thaka, aru manu ke Isor laga kotha to bhal pora bujhai dibo para, kotha namana khan ke thik rasta dikha bo para hobo lage.

english_text: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
nagamese_text: Kelemane, bisi Yehudi biswasi manu khan ase, kunkhan kotha bhi namane, aru sunnot laga kotha te eku motlob nathaka kotha koi aru dusra ke thogai thake.

english_text: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan ke rukhai dibole dorkar ase. Taikhan sorom kamai lobo nimite ghor-ghor ke sikhai thake.

english_text: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan majot te ekjon bhabobadi asele kun pora koi rakhise, “Creta laga manu to sob misa koi thake, aru dusto janwar aru alsi kha-kuwa khan ase.”

english_text: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
nagamese_text: Etu gawahi hosa ase, karone taikhan ke kara pora koi thakibi, taikhan biswas te thik thaki bole nimite,

english_text: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
nagamese_text: aru taikhan ke Yehudi laga kotha khisa khan aru hosa ke namani kene ghuri juwa khan laga piche jabo nadibi.

english_text: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
nagamese_text: Mon sapha thaka khan nimite hoile sob bostu to sapha ase, kintu sapha nathaka aru biswas nakora khan nimite hoile eku bhi sapha nai, kintu taikhan laga dimag aru bhabona te bhi sob letera ase.

english_text: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Isor ke jane koi, kintu kaam te hoile taike namane. Taikhan ke to ghin kori bole lage aru taikhan kotha namana khan ase aru eku bhal kaam kori bole thik nohoi.

english_text: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
nagamese_text: Kintu tumi to hoile, ki kotha koi, etu hosa hisab te sikhai di thakibi.

english_text: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
nagamese_text: Bura manu khan ke gusa nauthi bole, bhal bhabona kori bole, nijorke nomro kori bole, biswas te thaki bole, morom kori bole, aru dhorjo pora thaki bole sikhai dibi.

english_text: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
nagamese_text: Etu nisena dangor umor thaka mahila khan ke bhi pobitro jibon laga bhal niyom thakibo nimite sikhabi, misa kotha kowa aru draikha ros piya nohobo lage, etu bodli, ki bhal ase etu dusra khan ke hikai thaki bole sikhai dibi.

english_text: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
nagamese_text: Etu nisena jawan mahila khan ke tai laga mota aru bacha ke kineka morom koribo lage, etu sikhai dibi,

english_text: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
nagamese_text: bhal bhabona thaka, sapha mon thaka, nijor mota laga kotha mani thaka, sapha hoi nijor ghor kaam te bhal thaka mahila khan hobole sikhai dibi, tinehoile Isor laga pobitro kotha ke hinsa nohobo.

english_text: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
nagamese_text: Aru etu nisena jawan manu ke bhal kaam kori bole samjai dibi.

english_text: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
nagamese_text: Tumi laga sob kaam te bhal namuna he dikhai dibi. Aru tumi ki sikhai ase etu hosa aru sapha pora kowa kotha hobo lage,

english_text: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
nagamese_text: juntu hosa kotha ase aru junke eku golti dibo na paribo, eneka hoile kun tumike digdar diye, taikhan sorom hobo, ki karone taikhan pora amikhan laga eku bhi biya kobo na paribo.

english_text: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
