nagamese_text: Sewak khan ke sob kaam te malik laga kotha mani thaki bole sikhai dibi, khushi pora aru eku jhagara nakori kene,

english_text: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
nagamese_text: nijor malik laga eku chor nakori kene aru sob bhal kaam to biswas pora dikhai dibole nimite sikhai dibi, eneka korile bhal naam to amikhan laga Tran-korta Isor pora sikhai diya kotha ke pabo.

english_text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor pora aha anugrah to sob manu laga poritran nimite ase.

english_text: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
nagamese_text: Etu amikhan ke sikhai ase, etu pora he, ki biya ase aru duniya laga itcha hisab te ase etu ke amikhan nabhabibo, aru nijorke rukhabole paribo, dharmik thakibo paribo, eneka hoile etu yug te Isor ke jana jibon thaki bole paribo,

english_text: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: kele koile amikhan etu asis laga din nimite rukhi ase jitia sob pora dangor Isor aru Tran-korta Jisu Khrista arubi wapas ahibo.

english_text: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
nagamese_text: Jisu he amikhan ke niyom namana paap pora udhar koribo nimite nijor jibon daan dise, aru Tai nijor nimite pobitro kori kene ekta jati bonai loise, kunkhan bhal kaam kori bole khushi kore.

english_text: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
nagamese_text: Girja te etu kotha khan sikai dibi, aru manu sobke eitu khan kori bole mon dangor kori dibi, aru adhikar thaka hisab te golti kora khan ke sidha kori bhi. Kun pora bhi apuni ke hisab nathaka hobo nadibi.

english_text: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
nagamese_text: Girja te aha khan ke janai dibi cholawta aru dangor khan laga niche thaki bole, taikhan laga kotha mani bole, aru hodai bhal kaam nimite taiyar thaki bole,

english_text: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
nagamese_text: kunke bhi bodnam nakoribole aru jhagara nakoribole, kintu sob logote nomro aru bhal niyom pora thaki bole.

english_text: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan bhi ekta somoite eku bhabona nathaka aru kotha namana thakise. Amikhan mangso laga itcha pora dhori kene harai ja khan thakise. Amikhan paap kori thakise aru dusra ke suku joli thakise. Amikhan bisi ghin thakise aru ekjon- ekjon ke bhi ghin kori thakisele.

english_text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi jitia Udhar-korta Isor laga morom manu uporte dikhai dise,

english_text: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
nagamese_text: juntu amikhan laga kaam aru dharmikta pora nohoi, kintu Tai laga anugrah pora poritran anidise, aru Pobitro Atma dwara notun jonom aru notun jibon dise,

english_text: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
nagamese_text: amikhan laga Udhar-korta Jisu Khrista karone Pobitro Atma amikhan ke bhorta haali dise,

english_text: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
nagamese_text: etu nimite Tai laga anugrah karone amikhan ke dhormik bonai kene anonto jibon laga asha te Tai laga uttoradhikari bonai dibo karone.

english_text: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
nagamese_text: Etu kotha to biswas koribo laga ase. Aru tumikhan ke etu kotha taikhan ke jor pora koi dibole mon ase, etu pora kunkhan Isor ke biswas korise, taikhan bhal kaam te mon dikene kori thakibo nimite. Etu kotha to bhal aru sob karone labh ase.

english_text: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
nagamese_text: Kintu misa-misi kotha koi thaka, aru khandan khan khisa, aru jhagara kora, aru niyom laga kotha nimite jhagara kora sob to chari di bhi kele koile eitu khan eku labh nai.

english_text: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
nagamese_text: Kunba kotha namana manu ke ekbar-duibar samjai dibi, judi tai arubi kotha namanile taike alag kori dibi,

english_text: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
nagamese_text: etu jani kene kun manu bhal rasta chari kene aru paap kori thake, tai nijorke bodnam kori ase.

english_text: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
nagamese_text: Moi kitia Artemas nohoile Tychicus ke tumi logot pathabo, joldi Nicopolis sheher te ahibi, kelemane moi ta te thanda dinte thaki bole bhabona kori loise.

english_text: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
nagamese_text: Para tak Zenas ukil aru Apollos ke pathai dibi, taikhan eku bhi komti nohobo nimite.

english_text: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
nagamese_text: Aru biswasi khan bhi bhal kaam kori bole hiki bo lage, aru bisi ki dorkar ase, etu te modot dibo paribo nimite, aru eneka hoile eku kaam nathaka nohobo.

english_text: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Ami logote thaka sob pora tumike salam janai ase. Salam di ase jun manu khan biswas te amikhan ke morom kori ase. Apuni khan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakibo dibi.

english_text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
nagamese_text: Paul, Jisu Khrista laga koidi, aru moi logote bhai Timothy, duijon pora Philemon ke, jun amikhan laga morom sathi aru susamachar laga prochar korate eke logote kaam kora jon ase,

english_text: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
nagamese_text: aru biswas te amikhan laga bhoini Apphia ke, aru Archippus amikhan laga sipahi ke, aru tumi laga ghor te joma kora girja ke.

english_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha aru shanti tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi.

english_text: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
nagamese_text: Moi hodai Isor ke dhanyavad di thake. Moi laga prathana te tumikhan ke yaad kori thake.

english_text: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista logote morom aru biswas thaka aru ekjon-ekjon logote thaka to moi hunise.

english_text: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
nagamese_text: Moi prathana kori ase tumikhan biswas pora lok kori thaka to amikhan majote Khrista dwara ki bhal ase, etu sob aru bhi bhal pora janibo paribo.

english_text: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan laga morom thaka nimite moi bisi khushi aru aram paise, kelemane, tumi, moi laga bhai, pora pobitro khan laga mon pora taja kori dise.

english_text: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, moi Khrista laga naam pora mon dangor hoi kene tumikhan ke ki kori bole lage etu hukum dibole pare,

english_text: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: kintu morom thaka nimite, moi tumikhan ke anurodh kori ase- Moi, Paul, ekjon bura manu aru etiya Jisu Khrista nimite ekjon koidi.

english_text: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
nagamese_text: Moi laga bacha Onesimus ke bhabona kori kene hudi ase, moi loha laga rusi pora bandhi kene thaka homoi te tai laga baba hoi jaise.

english_text: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
nagamese_text: Tai ekta homoi te tumikhan nimite eku kaam laga thaka nai, kintu etiya tai tumi aru moi nimite bisi kaam laga ase.

english_text: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
nagamese_text: Moi taike tumikhan logote pathai di ase, tai moi laga bisi morom kora ekjon ase.

english_text: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
nagamese_text: Moi itcha thakise, jitia tak moi susamachar prochar kora nimite loha pora bandhi kene ase, titia tak taike moi logote rakhi kene tumikhan laga naam te moike sewa kori bole nimite.

english_text: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi tumikhan ke nahudi kene eku kaam kori bole mon nai. Moi tumikhan pora bhal kaam kori thaka to hoile ene pora koribo dibole mon nai, kintu ki bhal kaam kori ase etu bhal itcha pora hobole lage.

english_text: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
nagamese_text: Etu karone tai tumikhan pora olop din nimite alag hoi jaisele, aru etu pora hodai nimite taike tumi wapas pai jobole nimite.

english_text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Tai aru manu laga sewa nokorile, kintu tai ekjon sewa kora manu pora bhi bhal hoi kene morom thaka bhai hobo. Moi taike bisi morom kore, aru tumike bhi bisi morom kore, mangso pora bhi aru Probhu Jisu laga naam pora bhi.

english_text: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
nagamese_text: Jodi moi bhi tumikhan laga sathi ase koile, moike jineka tumikhan pora loise etu nisena, taike bhi loi lobi.

english_text: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi tai tumikhan logote kiba biya korise aru dibole baki ase koile, etu moi uporte hali dibi.

english_text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
nagamese_text: Moi, Paul, moi laga nijor hath pora etu likhi ase. Moi nijor sob to wapas kori dibo- aru tumikhan nijorke moi logote dibole baki ase!

english_text: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
nagamese_text: Hoi, bhai, Probhu laga naam pora moi nimite ekta kaam kori dibi; Khrista nimite moi laga mon to taja kori dibi.

english_text: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
nagamese_text: Tumi pora kotha mani kene thaka to moi bharosa ase. Aru moi kowa kotha pora bhi tumi bisi koribo koi kene moi tumike etu chithi likhi ase.

english_text: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
nagamese_text: Aru etu logote, etiya moi nimite ekta kamra taiyar kori kene rakhibi, moi asha ase tumi laga prathana pora moi joldi tumi logote wapas ahibo paribo.

english_text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
nagamese_text: Epaphras, Jisu Khrista laga kaam nimite moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka sathi, tai bhi tumike salam jonai ase.

english_text: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
nagamese_text: Mark, Aristarach, Demas, aru Luke, moi logot kaam kori thaka khan sob pora bhi salam jonai ase.

english_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista laga anugrah tumikhan sob logot hodai thaki bole dibi. Amen.

english_text: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
nagamese_text: Purana dinte amikhan baba laga baba khan logote Isor pora alag-alag bhabobadi khan dwara bisi bar kisim kotha koise.

english_text: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu hekh din khan te, Isor he Tai laga ekjon Putro dwara amikhan logote kotha korise, junke Tai sob laga waris hobole nimite basi loise. Tai pora he pura shristi bonai dise.

english_text: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
nagamese_text: Jisu he ujala pora bhorta thaka Isor laga mohima dikhai diya jon ase. Tai laga kotha laga hokti pora sob to dhori kene ase. Jitia Tai paapkhan sapha kori dise, Tai jai kene Mohan Isor laga dyna hathte bohise.

english_text: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
nagamese_text: Sorgodoth khan pora bhi Tai he sobse untcha hoise kelemane Taike diya uttoradhikari laga naam bhi sorgodoth khan pora bhi bisi mohan ase.

english_text: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
nagamese_text: Kun to sorgodoth ke Isor pora eneka koise, “Tumi Moi laga chokra ase, Aji Moi tumi laga baba hoi jaise”? Aru bhi, “Moi taikhan laga baba hobo, Aru taikhan Moi laga ekjon chokra hobo”?

english_text: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu aru jitia Isor poila jonom kora bacha ke duniya te ane, Tai koi, “Sob Isor laga duth khan Taike mohima koribi.”

english_text: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth khan ke Tai pora koi, “Tai he ekjon ase kun he sorgodoth khan ke atma bonai, Aru Tai laga noukar khan ke juli thaka jui bonai.”

english_text: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai laga Putro ke Isor koi, “Tumi laga singhason, Isor, hodai aru hodai nimite ase. Tumi laga rajyo to dharmik ase aru tumi thik niyom pora he manu khan ke bisar kore.

english_text: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
nagamese_text: Tumi bhal kaam he khushi pai aru niyom laga niyom nathaka ke ghin kore. Etu nimite Isor, Tumi laga Isor, pora he apuni ke khushi laga tel hali kene basi loise. Aru etu to tumi logote thaka sathi khan pora bhi bisi dangor laga khushi ase.”

english_text: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
nagamese_text: “Shuru te, Probhu, tumi prithibi bonaise. Aru sorgo to Tumi laga hath pora bona kaam ase.

english_text: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
nagamese_text: Taikhan harai jabo, kintu Tumi hodai thakibo. Taikhan sob purana hoija kapra nisena he hoi jabo.

english_text: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
nagamese_text: Lamba kapra ke lipai kene rakha nisena Tumi taikhan ke lipai kene rakhidibo, Aru kapra bodli kora nisena, Tumi taikhan ke bodli kori dibo. Kintu Tumi eke ase, Aru Tumi laga din aru saal kitia bhi khotom nohobo.”

english_text: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
nagamese_text: Kintu, kun homoi te Isor Tai laga duth khan ke eneka koisele, “Moi laga dyna hathte bohibi Jitia tak moi tumi laga dushman khan ke tumi laga theng nichete narakhe”?

english_text: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
nagamese_text: Sewa kori thaka kiman sorgodoth khan ase taikhan atma nohoi naki, jun khan ke poritran pabole thaka manu khan ke sai dibole nimite pathai dise nohoi?

english_text: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
nagamese_text: Etu karone amikhan pora ki huni loise, ta te bisi mon dibo lage, amikhan itu kotha khan pora hati najabo nimite.

english_text: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
nagamese_text: Jodi etu kotha khan kun to sorgodoth pora koise aru etu kotha khan sob thik ase koi kene janise, aru kun manu biya rasta te jai aru kotha namane taikhan sajai pabo koi kene janise,

english_text: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
nagamese_text: titia hoile iman dangor poritran laga kotha jodi amikhan ninda korile, amikhan kineka polabo paribo? Etu jibon laga kotha to age te Probhu pora amikhan ke janai dise aru kun manu hunise etu thik ase koi kene moi khan ke janibole dise.

english_text: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
nagamese_text: Isor bhi etu kotha khan laga sob gawahi dise, alag-alag chihna khan pora, asurit kaam pora, aru Tai laga itcha hisab te sobke Pobitro Atma laga alag-alag bordan dise.

english_text: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
nagamese_text: Prithibi te ki hobole ase, juntu kotha amikhan etiya koi ase, etu Isor pora sorgodoth khan ke diya nai.

english_text: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
nagamese_text: Kintu, Isor laga kotha te kunba pora gawahi dise aru koise, “Manu ki ase, ki tai nimite Apuni iman bhabona kori ase? Nohoile manu laga chokra, jun nimite Apuni iman chinta kori ase?

english_text: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
nagamese_text: Apuni manu ke sorgodoth pora olop he niche kori dise; Apuni taike mohima aru sonman laga mukut lagai dise.

english_text: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
nagamese_text: Apuni Tai laga theng nichete sob saman khan rakhidise.” Aru sob Tai laga nichete thaki jaise, Isor pora Tai laga nichete rakhi nadiya eku nai. Kintu amikhan etiya bhi sob jinis Tai laga nichete nahi kene thaka dikhi ase.

english_text: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan Jisu ke dikhise, kunke sorgodoth laga nichete olop din nimite rakhise, aru Tai dukh aru kosto kori kene mora nimite mohima aru sonman laga mukut lagai dise, eneka kora pora Isor laga anugraha dwara Tai sob nimite moribo.

english_text: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, kun karone aru kun sob jinis ulabole dise, sob nimite dukh kosto pora mori bole aru poritran laga cholawta, Jisu ke mohima te anibole, Tai he yogya asele.

english_text: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun pora sapha kori diye aru kun sapha hoijai taikhan sob to eke jaga pora ahise. Etu nimite, Tai pora taikhan ke bhai khan eneka mati bole sorom nohoi.

english_text: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
nagamese_text: Tai koi, “Moi tumikhan laga naam bhai khan majote koi dibo, Moi manu majot pora tumikhan nimite gana koribo.”

english_text: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
nagamese_text: Aru bhi, “Moi taike biswas koribo.” Aru bhi, “Sabi, Moi yate ase aru Moi aru Moi laga bacha khan bhi yate ase kun Isor pora Moike dise.”

english_text: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
nagamese_text: Aru kineka bacha khan gaw aru khun te eke bhag ase, etu nisena Tai bhi bhag loise, aru Tai nijor morija pora he, bhoot, kun logote mrityu laga takot ase, taike khotom koribo parise.

english_text: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
nagamese_text: Etu pora he, jun khan mrityu ke bhoi kora jibon pora bandhi kene thakise, taikhan ke ajad kori dibole korise.

english_text: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
nagamese_text: Tai sorgote thaka duth khan nimite chinta kora nohoi; kintu, Abraham laga bacha khan nimite chinta thakise.

english_text: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
nagamese_text: Etu karone sob kaam te Tai laga bhai khan nisena hobole nimite dorkar thakise, aru etu pora Tai ekjon dayalu aru biswasi moha purohit hobo aru Isor laga ki kaam ase etu sob pura koribo, aru manu laga sob paap to sapha kori dibo.

english_text: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
nagamese_text: Aru kelemane Tai nijor bhi porikha kori kene dukh paise, Tai kun manu porikha te ase taike modot kori bole paribo.

english_text: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, pobitro bhai khan, apuni khan sorgo rajyo nimite matise. Jisu ke bhabibi, jun ase amikhan pora shikar kora laga apostle aru moha purohit.

english_text: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
nagamese_text: Jineka Moses pora Isor laga ghor te hodai biswasi hoi kene thakise, tineka Tai bhi, kun pora etu kaam kori bole nimite Taike basi loise, Tai uporte biswas koribo para ekjon thakise.

english_text: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
nagamese_text: Jineka ekta ghor pora bhi ghor bona manu ke bisi sonman aru mohima hoi, eneka pora Tai he Moses pora bhi dangor sonman aru mohima ase.

english_text: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane ghor to kunba pora bonai, kintu Isor pora he sob bonaise.

english_text: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
nagamese_text: Moses bhi Isor laga pura ghor te biswasi ekjon noukar thakise, etu kotha laga gawahi khan hobo nimite jun aha dinte hobole ase.

english_text: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
nagamese_text: Kintu Khrista to Isor pora biswas thaka Putro ase kun Isor laga pura ghor sai ase. Amikhan bhi Tai laga ghor hobo jodi amikhan ke ki asha te matise etu te phutani kori kene mon dangor pora dhuri thakise koile.

english_text: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Pobitro Atma pora bhi eneka koise: “Aji, jodi apuni Tai laga awaj hune

english_text: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
nagamese_text: Mon tan nokoribi, Aru biya kaam nokoribi, Jongol te thaka homoi te porikha kori kene sa nisena.

english_text: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
nagamese_text: Tumi baba khan laga baba khan pora Moike porikha kori kene kotha mana nai, Taikhan Moi chalis saal tak ki kaam korise etu sob dikhise.

english_text: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Moi manu khan uporte khushi thaka nai. Moi koise, ‘Taikhan hodai mon pora biya kaam kori kene jai, Aru taikhan Moi pora bhal rasta dikhai diya to najane.’

english_text: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
nagamese_text: Moi laga ghusa pora kosom kha nisena he ase: ‘Moi thaka aru aram kora jagate taikhan kitia bhi jabo na paribo.’”

english_text: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
nagamese_text: Hoshiar hoi jabi, bhai khan, apuni khan laga monte biswas nakora laga biya bhabona nahibo nimite, kelemane etu pora apuni khan ke jivit Isor pora dur loijai.

english_text: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
nagamese_text: Kintu, hodai ekjon-ekjon laga mon dangor kori dibi, jiman din ke “aji” matibo, titia apuni khan majot kun laga bhi mon to paap laga biya kaam pora tan nohobo.

english_text: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan Khrista laga kaam te sathi hoi jaise jodi amikhan shuru pora ses tak Tai pora biswas koribo para manu thakise koile.

english_text: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
nagamese_text: Eitu khan nimite Isor kotha te koi dise, “Aji, jodi apuni Tai laga awaj hune, Apuni laga mon tan nokoribi, Aru biya rasta te najabi.”

english_text: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun Yehudi khan huni kene bhi kotha mana nai? Taikhan sob Moses logot pora Egypt chari kene ulabole parise na hoi?

english_text: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
nagamese_text: Aru kun logote Tai chalis saal tak khong uthi kene thakise? Paap kora manu khan logote nohoi naki, kun laga mora gaw to jongol te giri kene thakise?

english_text: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
nagamese_text: Aru kun logote Tai kosom khai sele taikhan Tai laga aram kora jagate ghusi bole na paribo koi kene, kun manu kotha namani kene ase taikhan ke nohoile aru etu kotha kunke koisele?

english_text: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
nagamese_text: Amikhan dikhise biswas nathaka nimite taikhan ta te ghusi bole para nai.

english_text: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Isor laga aram jagate ghusi bo paribo laga kosom amikhan logote ase, hoilebi jodi kunba manu ta te punchibole para nai eneka nohobo nimite amikhan bhoi pora rukhi thakibo.

english_text: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan ke koi diya nisena amikhan ke bhi bhal khobor to koi dise. Kintu ki kotha koi dise etu pora taikhan nimite eku labh huwa nai, kelemane kun manu biswas pora hunise taikhan logote mon mili kene thaka nai.

english_text: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan biswas kora pora aram jagate ghusi bole parise, Tai pora kowa nisena, “Moi laga ghusa te kosom kha nisena, Taikhan Moi laga aram jagate kitia bhi ghusi bole na paribo.” Aru jodi bhi, shristi shuru kora homoi pora Tai laga kaam sob pura kori kene rakhise.

english_text: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor kotha te sath din laga kotha eneka koise: “Aru Isor bhi sob kaam kori kene sath dinte aram korise.”

english_text: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
nagamese_text: Aru bhi eneka likha ase, “Taikhan Moi laga aram kora jagate ghusi bole na paribo.”

english_text: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, ta te ghusi bole para kunba aru bhi ase, aru kunba manu susamachar hunise hoile bhi taikhan kotha namana nimite ta te ghusi bole para nai.

english_text: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
nagamese_text: Isor pora ek din ke “Aji” matidise. Bisi din pichete, Tai David logote kotha korise, age te kowa nisena, “Aji jodi tumi Tai laga awaj hunile, Apuni laga mon tan nokoribi.”

english_text: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi Joshua pora taikhan ke aram dise koile, etu pichete Isor pora aru bhi alag din laga kotha nokobole thakise.

english_text: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Isor laga manu nimite Bisram din rakhi ase.

english_text: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun Tai laga aram jagate ghusi bole parise, tai nijorke sob kaam pora aram pai loise, jineka Isor Tai laga kaam pora aram loi sele.

english_text: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, kun bhi eneka kotha namani kene girija nisena nohobo nimite amikhan bhi aram jagate ghusi bole nimite taiyar koribo.

english_text: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga kotha to jinda aru dui phale dhar thaka talwar nisena kaam kore. Etu he atma aru jibon majot te ghusi kene, jurai aru hardi khan ke bhag koribo pare, aru manu laga monte ki bhabona ase etu sob bhi janibole pare.

english_text: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
nagamese_text: Aru shristi te ki bonai kene thaka eku Isor pora lukai kene nai. Kintu, sob khula-khuli ase aru Taike amikhan sob hisab dibole lage.

english_text: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile amikhan logote mohan moha purohit ase, kun sorgo paar kori kene ahise, Isor laga Putro, Jisu, etu nimite amikhan biswas ke dhori lobo.

english_text: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan laga komjur nabujha laga moha purohit thaka nohoi, kintu amikhan nisena, Taike bhi porikha korise, kintu Tai eku paap kora nai.

english_text: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite ahibi, amikhan mon dangor kori kene Isor laga anugraha thaka singhason usorte jabo, eneka korile amikhan daya pabo aru dukh homoi te modot kori bole anugrah pabo.

english_text: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sob moha purohit khan ke manu majot pora basi loi, aru taikhan pora sob laga bodli te Isor ke uphar khan aru paap laga bolidan dibo nimite.

english_text: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
nagamese_text: Kun manu najani kene thaki ase aru biya rasta te berai ase taikhan ke morom pora loi kene anibole nimite, kelemane Tai bhi komjur ase.

english_text: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Tai paap laga bolidan dibole lagise, Tai manu khan nimite kineka korise, etu nisena nijor nimite bhi korise.

english_text: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
nagamese_text: Tai nijor nimite kunba ke etu sonman lobole diya nai. Kintu Taike Isor pora mati loise, jineka Aaron ke mati loise le.

english_text: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
nagamese_text: Thik etu nisena, Khrista to Tai nijorke moha purohit bonai kene sonman kora nai. Kintu, Isor pora Taike basi loise aru Taike koise, “Tumi Moi laga Putro ase; aji Moi Tumi laga Baba hoise.”

english_text: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
nagamese_text: Etu nisena Isor pora Tai laga kotha te bhi koi kene ase, “Tumi hodai nimite purohit ase Melchizedek laga pichete te.”

english_text: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
nagamese_text: Jisu prithibi te jinda thaka homoi te, Tai suku pani giri jor pora kandi kene Taike mrityu pora bacha bole para ekjon ke prathana aru binti korise, aru Tai laga prathana huni loise kelemane Tai sidha mon pora mangise.

english_text: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
nagamese_text: Aru Tai Isor laga chokra thakile bhi, kineka kotha manibo lage, etu Tai laga ki dukh paise, etu pora Tai sikhise.

english_text: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
nagamese_text: Tai sob pora bhal hoi jaise, aru kun manu Tai laga kotha mani kene thake, taikhan nimite sorgote jabole laga rasta hoi jaise.

english_text: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
nagamese_text: Aru Melchizedek pora kowa nisena, Taike Isor pora moha purohit bonai dise.

english_text: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
nagamese_text: Amikhan etu nimite aru bisi kobole ase, kintu sob bujhai dibole nimite tan ase kelemane etu kotha khan sob huni kene bhi tumikhan nahuna nisena hoi jaise.

english_text: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etiya laga homoi tak te tumikhan hikhok khan hobole lagise, kintu Isor laga kotha etiya tak tumikhan ke sikhai dibole lagi ase. Tumikhan tan bhat khabo nohoi kene, etiya bhi dudh he khai ase!

english_text: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun etiya bhi dudh khai ase tai Isor laga dharmik kotha te komjur ase, kelemane tai etiya bhi chutu bacha nisena ase.

english_text: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
nagamese_text: Kintu tan bhat to dangor manu khan nimite ase, kelemane taikhan bhal aru biya to ki ase eitu khan sob bhal pora jani kene sikhi loise.

english_text: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, Khrista laga shuru kotha ki ase, etu ke paar kori kene dangor hoija manu khan nisena age te jabo. Mora kaam khan pora mon ghura bole laga aru Isor ke biswas kori bole laga kotha laga bhetimul aru nabonabo,

english_text: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
nagamese_text: baptizma laga kotha sikhai diya, manu uporte hath rakha, mora khan punoruthan hoija, aru anonto bisar laga kotha khan aru nakoribo.

english_text: This will we do, if God permits.
nagamese_text: Isor pora jodi amikhan ke eitu khan bhi koribi koile amikhan titia koribo.

english_text: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun manu poila eitu khan jani loise, kunkhan sorgo laga asirbad jani loise aru Pobitro Atma te bhag ase,

english_text: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
nagamese_text: aru kun Isor laga bhal kotha to jani loise aru ahibole thaka yug laga takot jani loise,

english_text: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
nagamese_text: hoile bhi kun giri jaise- taikhan aru bhi mon ghura bole to tan ase. Kelemane taikhan nijor pora Isor laga Putro ke aru bhi Cross te morai di ase, aru Taike manu usorte sorom khilai di ase.

english_text: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;
nagamese_text: Kelemane borkhon gira pani to mati pora khai loi, aru etu mati pora bhal kheti koribo pare, aru kheti kora ke khabole diye, etu pora Isor laga bhal asirbad to pai loi.

english_text: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun to matite kata aru jongol ulai etu mati kaam nathake aru shrap paikena sob jongol khan jola bole nimite he hoijai.

english_text: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
nagamese_text: Kintu, morom te thaka khan, amikhan eneka koi thakile bhi, apuni khan nimite amikhan bhal bhabona koridi ase, juntu ase poritran laga kotha.

english_text: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor to anyai kora Isor nohoi, apuni kaam kora khan aru Tai laga naam ke morom kora, apuni Tai laga pobitro manu khan ke sewa kora aru etiya bhi taikhan ke sewa kori thaka to kitia bhi pahori najabo.

english_text: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga etu he sob pora dangor itcha ase apuni ses tak eneka kori thakibo, etu pora apuni laga asha thik rakhibo nimite.

english_text: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob to apuni alchi nakoribole nimite ase, kintu atma te thaka khan laga biswas aru mon chutu kori kene thaka to saikene apuni bhi Isor pora ki kosom dise etu laga bhag hobo.

english_text: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
nagamese_text: Jitia Isor pora Abraham logote kosom disele, Tai nijor naam te kosom dise, kelemane Tai pora uporte thaka laga kosom khabole nimite aru kun bhi nai.

english_text: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
nagamese_text: Tai koise, “Moi tumike asirbad koribo, aru Moi tumike bisi dangor bonai dibo.”

english_text: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
nagamese_text: Aru etu nisena he, Abraham dhorjo kori kene rukha karone, Isor pora taike ki kosom dise etu tai paise.

english_text: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
nagamese_text: Kelemane manu khan to kun taikhan nijor pora dangor ase, taikhan laga naam loi kene he kosom khai. Etu pora he taikhan majote mon namili kene thaka to khotom hoijai, kelemane kosom diya to ekjon uporte bharosa kori bole nimite kowa ase.

english_text: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
nagamese_text: Jitia Isor pora Tai laga waris khan ke Tai laga kosom te eku bodla-bodli nai koi kene sapha pora dikhai dibole nimite korise, Tai etu kosom to ji hoile bhi pabo koi kene vachan dise.

english_text: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
nagamese_text: Tai duita bodla-bodli kori bole napara laga kaam pora eneka korise- Isor to kitia bhi misa kotha nokoi- amikhan, kun luka bole nimite polai jaise, Tai pora amikhan ke ki asha dise, ta te mon dangor hoi kene thik pora dhuri rakhibo nimite.

english_text: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
nagamese_text: Amikhan etu asha thaka to amikhan laga atma ke nahila jagate rakhibole aru bharosa thaka jagate rakhibo nimite ase, kun to purdah laga bhitor jagate bhi ghusi bole pare,

english_text: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
nagamese_text: kot te Jisu, amikhan age te Jisu ta te amikhan laga bodli jai kene Tai ekjon moha purohit hoi jaise, aru hodai nimite Melchizedek purohit laga niyom nisena kori ase.

english_text: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Melchizedek, Salem laga raja, aru Isor laga Moha Purohit, jitia Abraham pora raja khan ke khotom kori kene ahi thakise, titia taike lok paikena asirbad dise.

english_text: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
nagamese_text: Abraham bhi tai laga dos bhag sob to Melchizedek ke di dise. Tai laga poila naam laga motlob to hoile “dharmikta laga raja,” aru “Salem laga raja,” etu motlob thakise, “shanti laga raja.”

english_text: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
nagamese_text: Tai laga baba aru ama bhi thaka nai, tai laga khandan nai, tai nimite tai jibon laga shuru aru jibon laga anth bhi nai. Kintu, Isor laga Putro nisena bonai dise, aru taike hodai nimite ekjon purohit thaki bole rakhise.

english_text: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
nagamese_text: Kintu sabi etu manu Melchizedek to kiman dangor thakise, Abraham pora lorai kori kene ki jitise aru loi loise etu laga dos bhag taike di dise.

english_text: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
nagamese_text: Aru Levi laga chokra khan ke purohit kaam kori bole nimite basi loise, aru niyom laga niyom hisab te jai kene Yehudi khan logot pora bhi daan aru dos bhag uthabole dise, taikhan bhi Abraham laga bacha khan hoilebi.

english_text: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
nagamese_text: Kintu Melchizedek, taikhan pora bisari kene bhi tai laga khandan panai, kintu Abraham logot pora tai te dos bhag paise, aru kun logote kosom laga vachan thakise taike he Melchizedek pora asirbad dise.

english_text: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
nagamese_text: Kintu eku jhagara nakori kene, ekjon chutu manu ke dangor manu pora asirbad dise.

english_text: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, jinda thaka manu dos bhag pai, kintu etu pora Melchizedek jinda thaki ase koi kene gawahi diye.

english_text: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
nagamese_text: Aru, kotha kori thaka nisena, Levi, kun bhi dos bhag paise, tai bhi Abraham dwara dos bhag daan di thakise,

english_text: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
nagamese_text: kelemane etu homoi te Levi to tai laga khandan laga gaw pora thakise jitia Melchizedek aru Abraham lok paisele.

english_text: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
nagamese_text: Jodi Levi khandan laga purohit kaam pora he sob bhal aru thik hoise koile -juntu pora he manu khan niyom aru niyom paise-, titia Aaron laga niyom hisab te nohoikena kele Melchizedek laga niyom hisab te aru bhi kele dusra ekjon purohit ahibole nimite dorkar hoise?

english_text: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
nagamese_text: Jitia ekjon purohit bodli hoijai, titia niyom aru niyom khan bhi bodli hoijai.

english_text: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
nagamese_text: Etu kotha khan kun ekjon nimite koi ase tai dusra jat laga ase, kun manu bhi etu jat pora bedi te sewa kora nai.

english_text: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
nagamese_text: Amikhan bhal pora jani ase Probhu to Judah laga khandan pora ahise, aru Moses pora bhi etu jat nimite eku kotha kora nai.

english_text: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
nagamese_text: Aru etu ke arubi bhal pora buji bole asele, jodi kunba aru ekjon purohit Melchizedek nisena ulai.

english_text: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
nagamese_text: Tai ekjon purohit hoise, khandan saikene nohoi, kintu tai laga Tai laga namora jibon shakti saikene taike purohit bonaise.

english_text: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga kotha te bhi eneka gawahi di ase: “Tumi hodai nimite purohit ase Melchizedek laga niyom hisab te.”

english_text: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
nagamese_text: Purana niyom aru kaam khan komjur aru eku kaam nathaka hoija-a pora hatai dise,

english_text: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
nagamese_text: -niyom aru niyom pora eku kaam to bhal bonai dibole napare-, aru bhal asha laga kotha to manu khan ke koi dise, etu pora amikhan Isor usorte ahe.

english_text: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
nagamese_text: Aru etu kaam kosom nakhai kene kora nai! Kelemane dusra khan to kosom noloikene he purohit hoi jaise,

english_text: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
nagamese_text: kintu Jisu to kosom khai kene purohit hoise, Isor pora Taike koise, “Probhu pora kosom khaise aru Tai mon bodli nokorile: ‘Tumi hodai nimite purohit ase.’”

english_text: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena he, Jisu pora amikhan bhal kaam kori bole nimite rasta khuli dise.

english_text: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
nagamese_text: Prothom laga purohit khan bisi jon thakise, kintu mrityu hoija-a pora, taikhan kaam rukhi jaise.

english_text: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
nagamese_text: Kintu Jisu hodai nimite jinda ase, Tai logot pora purohit laga kaam kitia bhi naharabo.

english_text: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, kun manu pora Tai dwara Isor ke bisari kene ahe, Tai pora eitu khan ke bacha bole pare, kelemane manu aru Isor majot te Tai hodai kotha koridi thake.

english_text: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
nagamese_text: Eneka moha purohit thaka to amikhan nimite bhal ase. Tai pobitro ase, eku golti nai, sapha, paapi manu khan pora alag, aru Tai sorgo pora bhi untcha hoi jaise.

english_text: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
nagamese_text: Tai ekjon moha purohit pora hodai kora nisena, poila tai nijor laga paap nimite, etu pichete manu laga paap nimite bolidan di thaki bole eku dorkar nai. Kintu Tai nijorke bolidan dikene, hodai nimite, ekbar te bolidan kori dise.

english_text: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
nagamese_text: Kelemane niyom to komjur thaka khan majot pora he moha purohit kori bole basi thake. Kintu kosom laga kotha, kun to niyom diya pichete ahise, etu pora Putro ke basi loise, kunke sob phale pora hodai nimite thik bonai dise.

english_text: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
nagamese_text: Etiya amikhan ki kobole mon ase etu laga motlob to hoile eneka ase: Amikhan logote moha purohit ase kun singhason laga dyna hathte sorgo laga mohan jagate bohi ase.

english_text: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
nagamese_text: Tai sob pora pobitro jagate sewa kore juntu Probhu pora bonaise, manu pora nohoi.

english_text: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sob moha purohit khan ke uphar aru bolidan dibole nimite basi loise. Etu nimite tai bhi kiba anikena boli dibole dorkar hoise.

english_text: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
nagamese_text: Etiya jodi Khrista prithibi te ase koile, Tai ekjon purohit nohobole thakise, niyom laga niyom hisab te bolidan dibole nimite ta te manu khan thakise.

english_text: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan sorgote thaka laga saya ki dikhi ase etu ke sewa kora he ase, jineka Moses ke Isor pora mana korise jitia tai aradhana kora laga jaga bona bole thakise. Kelemane, Isor he koise, “Sabi tumike pahar uporte loijai kene kineka dikhai dise etu nisena he bonabi.”

english_text: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya Jisu he bisi bhal porisorja to paise, jineka Tai manu aru Isor laga majote bhal vachan thaka laga kotha kori kene milai diya ekjon hoise.

english_text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
nagamese_text: Jodi prothom laga niyom te eku golti nai koile, titia dusra niyom dibole nimite eku dorkar thaka nai.

english_text: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;
nagamese_text: Jitia Isor manu khan uporte golti dikhise, Tai pora manu khan ke koise, “Sabi, eneka din ahi ase- Probhu pora koise- Jitia Moi ekta notun niyom bonai dibo Israel laga ghor aru Judah laga ghor logote.

english_text: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
nagamese_text: Aru etu vachan to Taikhan laga baba khan logote niyom bonai diya nisena nohobo. Etu dinte jitia taikhan laga hath dhori kene Egypt pora ulaikene loi anise. Kintu taikhan Moi laga niyom to mani kene thaka nai, Aru Moi taikhan uporte khushi panai- Eneka Probhu pora koise.

english_text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
nagamese_text: Etu vachan ase Juntu Moi bonabo Israel laga ghor manu khan logote Etu din khan pichete - - Probhu koi ase. Moi laga niyom taikhan laga bhabona te rakhidibo, Aru taikhan laga monte likhi dibo. Moi taikhan laga Isor hobo, Aru taikhan Moi laga manu hobo.

english_text: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
nagamese_text: Taikhan kitia bhi nijor laga ghor usor thaka manu Aru kokai bhai khan ke nashikabo, aru kobo, ‘Probhu ke janibi.’ Kelemane taikhan Moike janibo, Sobse chutu pora loi kene sobse dangor tak.

english_text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan biya kaam kori kene thakise koile bhi Moi taikhan uporte morom thakibo, Aru taikhan laga paap Moi aru kitia bhi yaad nokorile.”

english_text: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
nagamese_text: Etu niyom ke “notun” mata nisena, Tai pora prothom niyom to bodli kori dise, aru kun to purana aru eku kaam nathake hoise, etu joldi harai jabo.

english_text: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena prothom laga vachan te bhi prithibi te aradhana kora ghor bona bole niyom thakise.

english_text: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
nagamese_text: Titia tombu ghor laga jaga taiyar korise. Poila kamra, kun jagate deevat, mez, aru Isor laga age te daan rakhi diya roti rakhe, etu kamra ke sob pora pobitro jaga matise.

english_text: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
nagamese_text: Dusra purdah laga pichete aru bhi dusra kamra thakise, aru etu ke pobitro pora bhi bisi pobitro jaga matise.

english_text: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
nagamese_text: Ta te dhuwa jolai kene aradhana kori bole laga suna pora bona pobitro bedi thakise. Etu laga bhitor te vachan laga sandook thakise kuntu suna pora pura lipai kene thakise. Etu laga bhitor te suna pora bona kolsi ekta te manna rakhi thakise, aru Aaron laga lathi pora notun pata ulaikene thakise, aru vachan likhi rakha pathor, eitu khan sob halikena thakise.

english_text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
nagamese_text: Aru etu sandook laga uporte, mohima thaka Cherubim laga chaya pora sapha kori diya dhakna ke bondh kori kene thakise, kintu etiya etu kotha koi dibole homoi huwa nai.

english_text: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
nagamese_text: Jitia eitu khan sob taiyar kori kene rakhi loise, titia he purohit khan hodai tombu ghor laga bahar kamra te taikhan laga sewa kaam khan kori thakise.

english_text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
nagamese_text: Kintu, khali moha purohit he, saal te ekbar, dusra kamra te ghusi kene, tai pora nijor nimite bolidan diya laga khun aru manu khan najani kene paap kora laga daan loi kene jai.

english_text: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
nagamese_text: Pobitro Atma pora sob pora pobitro jagate jabole nimite rasta to dikhai diya nai jitia tak prothom laga tambu ghor khara kori thakise.

english_text: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
nagamese_text: Etiya laga homoi nimite etu ekta chihna ase, juntu te uphar aru bolidan duijon dilebi aradhana kori thaka jon laga mon ekdom sapha kori bole napare.

english_text: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
nagamese_text: Taikhan khali kha luwa aru nijor gaw ke sapha rakhibole laga niyom khan, juntu poila pora thakise, eitu khan te he mon di thakise jitia tak notun niyom laga homoi aha nai.

english_text: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
nagamese_text: Kintu bhal kaam sob nimite Khrista ekjon moha purohit hoi jaise. Etiya Tai sewa kori thaka tombu ghor to dangor aru bhal ase, etu manu laga hath pora bona nohoi, aru shristi laga bhi nohoi.

english_text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
nagamese_text: Tai sob pora pobitro jagate hodai nimite jaise, saguli aru guru laga bacha khun boli kori kene nohoi, kintu Tai nijor laga khun loi kene amikhan karone anonto poritran anidise.

english_text: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
nagamese_text: Kelemane, jodi saguli aru mota goru laga khun aru bacha napa goru laga khun pora paap te giri kene letera thaka khan uporte hali diya pora taikhan Isor usorte alag rakhi diye koile,

english_text: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
nagamese_text: titia Khrista laga khun, jun anonto Atma pora nijorke Isor usorte eku golti nathaki kene Tai laga jibon to bolidan kori dise, etu pora aru bhi kiman mora laga kaam pora apuni laga bhabona ke sapha kori dibo, jivit Isor ke sewa kori bole nimite?

english_text: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
nagamese_text: Etu karone, Khrista to manu aru Isor majote notun niyom ase, etu pora kunke mati loise taikhan anonto jibon laga asirbad pabo, prothom laga niyom te paap pora maph pabole nimite ki niyom thakise etu hatai kene Tai manu khan ke paap pora bachai dibole nimite nijorke mori bole dise.

english_text: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, kitia manu itcha rakhe, tai mora pichete, etu itcha poila koi kene thaka to kaam ahe.

english_text: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
nagamese_text: Kelemane mora manu laga itcha likhi thaka to, tai mora pichete he kaam kore, kele koile jitia tak itcha likha manu jinda ase, titia tak etu itcha kaam nadiye.

english_text: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite prothom niyom bhi khun noloikena sthapit kora nai.

english_text: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
nagamese_text: Jitia Moses pora manu khan logote niyom laga hukum khan koi dise, tai saguli aru guru puwali laga khun, pani, lal suta aru hyssop logot loise aru kagos aru manu khan uporte chitai dise.

english_text: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
nagamese_text: Titia Moses pora manu khan ke koise, “Etu Isor laga vachaan mana laga khun ase aru etu apuni khan mani kene thaki bole nimite hukum di ase.”

english_text: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, tai tambu uporte khun hali dise aru ta te chola laga kiman saman thakise, sob laga uporte hali dise.

english_text: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
nagamese_text: Niom laga hisab te sob to khun pora sapha kori dise, aru khun ulaikene nadiya tak paap pora maph napabo.

english_text: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite eneka kori bole dorkar hoise aru sorgote bhi etu nisena kiman saman ase eitu khan ke bhi eneka pora he sapha kori bole lagise. Hoile bhi, sorgote thaka saman khan to etu pora bhi bhal bolidan pora sapha kori bole lagise.

english_text: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista bhi hath pora bonai kene rakha sob pora pobitro jagate ghusa nai, etu hosa ekjon laga sabole eke thaka dikhai diya he thakise. Kintu Tai nijor pora he sorgote ghusi se, aru Isor laga usorte amikhan karone etiya jaga bona bole nimite jaise.

english_text: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
nagamese_text: Khrista to ta te nijorke daan dibole nimite ghusa nai, moha purohit khan pora kora nisena, kun saal te ekbar sob pora pobitro jagate khun laga bolidan loi kene ekjon-ekjon nimite ghusi thakise.

english_text: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
nagamese_text: Jodi eneka he ase koile, Tai prithibi laga shuru pora bar-bar jai kene nijorke dukh pabole nimite dibole thakise. Kintu Tai nijor pora ahi kene etu hekh yug te nijor jibon to manu khan nimite bolidan kori dise.

english_text: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
nagamese_text: Jineka manu bhi ekbar mori bole lage, aru etu pichete bisar kora laga homoi ahibo,

english_text: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
nagamese_text: etu nisena, Khrista ke bhi manu laga paap bukhi bole nimite dise, aru ekbar ahibole ase kun manu Tai nimite pura mon pora rukhi ase, aru paap to bukhi bole nimite nohoi, kintu poritran dibole nimite ahibo.

english_text: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
nagamese_text: Kelemane niyom khan to ki bhal ahibole ase eitu khan he laga saya he ase, aru utu khan asol te kineka ase, eitu khan to asol nohoi. Etu nimite, eke bolidan juntu purohit khan pora hodai saal-saal te diye, etu pora Isor logote ahise koile, taikhan kitia bhi thik hobo na paribo.

english_text: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
nagamese_text: Nohoile, bolidan kora to rukhi jabole thaka nai nohoi? Kelemane ekbar bolidan diya pora he manu khan sapha hoise, aru paap laga bhabona eku bhi nathaka hoise.

english_text: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
nagamese_text: Kintu saal-saal pichete utu bolidan khan di thaka to taikhan laga paap thaka to yaad kori diya he ase.

english_text: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
nagamese_text: Kelemane saguli aru goru laga khun pora paap to sapha kori dibole napare.

english_text: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jitia Khrista prithibi te ahise, Tai pora Isor ke koise, “Bolidan aru daan khan apuni itcha nakore, Kintu ekta gaw Moi nimite taiyar kori diya to he itcha kore;

english_text: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
nagamese_text: Jolai kene daan kora aru paap laga daan diya pora apuni khushi napai.

english_text: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
nagamese_text: Titia Moi koise, ‘Sabi Moi yate ase- Moi nimite kitab te likha nisena- apuni laga kaam kori bole nimite, O Isor.’”

english_text: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
nagamese_text: Khrista pora Isor ke koise, “Boli, aru daan, aru jolai kene diya daan, aru paap laga daan apuni itcha nakore. Aru manu pora eneka kori thakile bhi apuni khushi napai” -niyom hisab te daan di thaka-,

english_text: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
nagamese_text: titia Tai koise, “Sabi, Moi yate apuni laga itcha kori bole nimite ase.” Tai shuru te ki niyom kori thakise etu hatai kene dusra notun niyom shuru kori dise.

english_text: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
nagamese_text: Etu laga itcha pora, amikhan ke Jisu Khrista laga gaw daan diya karone paap pora hodai nimite sapha kori dise.

english_text: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
nagamese_text: Aru sob purohit khara kori kene hodai din Isor usorte tai laga niyom kori thake. Tai bar-bar eke bolidan di thake - kintu etu bolidan kori thakile bhi paap to kitia bhi harai najai.

english_text: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia Khrista pora sob paap laga boli ekbar pora di dise, Tai Isor laga dyna hathte bohise.

english_text: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
nagamese_text: Etu homoi pora, kitia Tai laga dushman khan ke theng nichete girai dibo Tai etu rukhi ase.

english_text: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
nagamese_text: Ekta bolidan diya pora Tai sobke paap pora hodai nimite sapha kori dise.

english_text: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
nagamese_text: Aru Pobitro Atma pora bhi amikhan ke etu gawahi diye. Tai pora poila etu koise,

english_text: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
nagamese_text: “Etu laga niyom taikhan logote bonabo, Utu din pichete moi, Probhu pora koi ase. Moi laga niyom taikhan laga monte rakhibo, Aru taikhan laga bhabona te likhi dibo.”

english_text: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
nagamese_text: Aru titia, “Taikhan laga paap aru biya kaam khan aru moi yaad nokorile.”

english_text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
nagamese_text: Jun jagate eitu khan pora maph pabo, ta te aru paap laga bolidan dibole nimite dorkar nai.

english_text: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, bhai khan, Jisu laga khun dwara amikhan sob pora pobitro jagate jabole nimite pura asha ase.

english_text: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
nagamese_text: Tai pora amikhan nimite purdah paar kori kene jabole Tai laga gaw dwara, ekta notun aru jinda thaka rasta khuli dise.

english_text: and having a great priest over God’s house,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga ghor te amikhan laga ekjon dangor purohit ase,

english_text: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
nagamese_text: amikhan sapha mon aru pura biswas pora Tai logote ahibo, paap laga bhabona pora sapha koribo aru sapha pani pora nijor laga gaw dhulai lobo.

english_text: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
nagamese_text: Amikhan asha pora paap shikar kori kene thaka to hili bole nadikena jor pora dhori lobo, kelemane Isor, kun kosom dise, Tai hosa aru bhal ase.

english_text: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
nagamese_text: Aru amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke bhal kaam kori kene morom pora thaki bole nimite mon dangor kori dibo.

english_text: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
nagamese_text: Amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke lok kori thaki bole nimite bondh nokorile, kelemane kunba khan eneka kore. Hoile bhi, kineka din hekh hoi ase, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke mon dangor koridi thakibo.

english_text: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan hosa kotha to jani kene pichete bhi paap kaam kori kene jai thakile, titia hoile paap nimite bolidan diya to hoile apuni nimite eku kaam nohobo.

english_text: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
nagamese_text: Kintu, bisar laga dinte ki hobole ase etu laga olop bhoi ase, aru gorom jui pora Isor laga dushman khan ke julai dibo.

english_text: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Moses laga niyom namani kene thake, taikhan to daya napai kene duijon tinjon laga gawahi pora morai diye.

english_text: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
nagamese_text: Kun manu Isor laga Putro ke theng nichete chipai dise, junke paap pora sapha kori dise, aru tai Isor laga pobitro khun pora bonai rakha vachan ke ninda korise aru anugraha Atma ke opman kori dise, taikhan laga saja to kiman bhi dangor hobo?

english_text: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan jani ase etu kun pora koise, “Badla to Moi laga ase; Moi taikhan ki korise etu wapas dibo.” Aru bhi, “Probhu pora Tai laga manu khan ke bisar koribo.”

english_text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
nagamese_text: Jinda Isor laga hathte giribole nimite bhoi ase!

english_text: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
nagamese_text: Kintu poila laga din to yaad koribi, jitia, apnikhan Isor laga puhor puwa pichete, apnikhan laga jibon te bisi dangor dukh digdar ahise.

english_text: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
nagamese_text: Apuni ke manu usorte kitia ba sorom khilai kene dukh pabole diye, aru kunba homoi te dukh pai thaka khan logote sathi kori kene thakise.

english_text: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni bondhi ghor te thaka manu khan ke kiman morom dikhaise, aru apuni khan laga sompoti khan joborjosti pora loija bhi apuni khan khushi pora mani loise. Apuni jane apuni nimite etu pora bhi bhal kitia bhi khotom nakora laga dhun rakhi kene ase.

english_text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apuni laga bharosa kitia bhi harabole nadibi, kelemane etu te he apuni laga dangor inam rakhi kene ase.

english_text: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan nomro hobole lagi ase, etu pora apuni asirbad pabo, apuni Isor laga itcha kori luwa pichete.

english_text: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
nagamese_text: “Kelemane olop homoi te, Ekjon kun ahibole ase Tai deri nohoi kene ahijabo.

english_text: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Moi laga dharmik khan biswas pora jinda thakibo, Aru jodi tai pichete jai kene giri jai, Moi laga atma tai uporte kitia bhi khushi napabo.”

english_text: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan biya kaam pora giri kene pichete ja manu khan nohoi. Kintu, amikhan biswas pora atma ke bachai kene rakha manu ase.

english_text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
nagamese_text: Biswas to hoile, amikhan ki asha kore, juntu nadikhe, hoilebi hosa ase aru pabo koi kene jane.

english_text: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga biswas nimite he amikhan laga baba khan ke Isor pora thik ase koi dise.

english_text: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora he etu pura shristi to Isor laga hukum pora bonai dise koi kene amikhan jane, etu nimite ki saman dikhi ase eitu khan nadikha laga saman pora bona nohoi.

english_text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Abel he Cain pora bhi bhal daan Isor ke dise, etu pora taike dharmik bonai dise, aru Isor pora tai laga daan dikhi kene bhal kotha koise, aru biswas pora he aji tak Abel kotha kore, tai mori jaise hoile bhi.

english_text: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora he Enoch ke Isor logot sorgote uthaikene loi jaise aru tai mora ke dikha nai. “Taike puwa nai kele koile Isor pora taike loi jaise.” Taike loi naja age te, tai Isor ke khushi korise koi kene gawahi dise.

english_text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
nagamese_text: Etiya biswas nathakile Isor ke khushi kori bole na paribo. Kelemane kun Isor usorte ahe Tai jinda ase koi kene biswas kori bole lage aru kun manu Taike bisare taikhan ke inam dibo.

english_text: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Noah ke, ki nadikhe etu laga kotha khan janibole dise, Isor ke bhoi kori kene thaka nimite, tai laga ghor manu khan ke bachai lobole nimite pani laga jahaaj bona bole dise. Etu kori kene, tai prithibi ke ninda korise aru dharmikta laga uttoradhikari hoise, biswas pora.

english_text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Abraham, jitia Isor pora taike matise, kotha mani kene tai pabole thaka jagate jaise. Tai ulaikene jaise, kun jagate jabo lage etu bhi najani kene jaise.

english_text: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora tai Isor pora kosom diya laga jagate jai kene dusra desh laga manu nisena thakise. Ta te tai tombu ghor te Isaac aru Jacob, kun tai logot Isor pora diya uttoradhikari paise, taikhan ke loi kene thakise.

english_text: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai ekta bhal pora bhetimul dikena bona laga sheher ke sai thakise, aru etu Isor pora bona ase.

english_text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora, Sarah buri hoi jaile bhi, bacha bukhi bole parise, kelemane Isor pora ki kosom dise tai etu uporte biswas korise.

english_text: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, ekjon manu pora- juntu Abraham ase, mori bole he thakise- akas te ginti kori bole napara tara nisena tai laga khandan khan jonom hoise, aru taikhan to samundar kinar te balu thaka nisena ginti kori bole napara laga hoi jaise.
