english_text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob kosom napa age te biswas te mori jaise, kintu bisi dur te taikhan pora eitu khan sob dikhise aru khusi paise. Aru taikhan nijor pora taikhan to dusra desh te thaki ase aru prithibi te nijor manu pora dur hoi kene ase koise.

english_text: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun manu khan eneka kotha kore, taikhan nijor laga ghor bona bole bisari ase.

english_text: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
nagamese_text: Jodi taikhan kun to desh pora ulaikene jaise etu bhabi thakise koile, taikhan ta te aru bhi wapas ghurabole paribo thakise.

english_text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
nagamese_text: Kintu, taikhan etu pora bhi bhal desh nimite itcha korise, etu hoile, sorgote thaka ula. Etu nimite Isor to taikhan laga Isor ase kobole sorom nakore, kelemane Tai pora taikhan nimite ekta sheher bonai kene rakhise.

english_text: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
nagamese_text: Biswas pora he Abraham, jitia Isor pora taike porikha korise, Isaac ke bolidan dibole taiyar hoise. Tai bhi Isor pora asirbad paise aru tai laga ekjon bacha thaka ke bhi bolidan kori bole itcha thakise.

english_text: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
nagamese_text: Isor pora taike eneka koisele, “Isaac laga naam pora he tumi laga khandan laga naam matibo.”

english_text: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
nagamese_text: Abraham jani thakise Isor pora Isaac ke mora pora jinda kori bole paribo, aru bhabona nisena, tai Isaac ke etu jaga pora wapas pai loise.

english_text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora he, ki ahibole ase etu nimite, Isaac pora Jacob aru Esau ke asirbad dise.

english_text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora, jitia Jacob mori bole thakise, tai laga lathi uporte khara kori kene mohima korise, aru tai laga sob bacha khan ke tai asirbad dise.

english_text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Joseph, jitia tai mori bole thakise, tai laga chokra khan ke tai mora pichete Egypt pora tai laga hardi khan loi kene Israel te rakhibole nimite koise.

english_text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Moses, jitia jonom loise le, tai laga baba ama pora tin mohina tak taike lukai kene rakhise, kelemane tai sabole bisi sundur thakise, aru raja pora ki hukum dise etu nimite taikhan bhoi kora nai.

english_text: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Moses, jitia tai dangor hoi jaise, tai nijorke Pharoah laga chukri laga chokra kobole nimite mana korise.

english_text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
nagamese_text: Kintu, tai nijorke Isor manu khan karone dukh pabole nimite basi loise, mangso laga itcha sob chari kene Isor ke sewa korise.

english_text: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
nagamese_text: Tai koise Jisu Khrista laga dhun to Egypt laga dhun pora bhi bisi dangor ase. Kelemane tai suku to tai inam pabole thaka ke sai thakise.

english_text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Moses Egypt chari kene jaise. Tai raja laga ghusa ke eku hisab kora nai, tai dukh pa-a homoi te, nadikha ekjon ke saithaka nisena bhabona kori kene dhorjo kori loise.

english_text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora tai Israel manu khan ke Nistar aru khun hali diya din manaise, etu pora prothom jonom kora bacha khan ke morai diya laga atma ahi kene namorabo nimite.

english_text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Yehudi khan dangor samundar to ekta sukha matite jai thaka nisena paar kori bole parise. Jitia Egypt khan eneka kori bole bisarise, taikhan ke pani pora khai loise.

english_text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Jericho sheher laga dewar khan giri jaise, jitia Israel manu khan sath din tak ta te ghuri kene thakise.

english_text: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora Rahab, ekjon bebichari, tai dusra biya kaam kori kene thaka khan nisena mora nai, kelemane tai shanti pora jasus kori kene sipahi khan ke modot korise.

english_text: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
nagamese_text: Etu pora aru moi bisi ki kobo? Jodi moi Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephtath, David, Samuel aru dusra bhabobadi khan laga kotha kore titia hoile homoi pora eitu khan laga sob kotha kori bole naponchibo.

english_text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
nagamese_text: Biswas pora taikhan rajyo to jiti loise, niyai laga kaam korise, aru asirbad paise. Taikhan bagh laga mukh bhi bondh kori dise,

english_text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
nagamese_text: jui laga takot to bhujai dise, aru talwar laga dhar pora polabole parise, bemar pora bhal hoi jaise, lorai kora homoi te takot hoi jaise, aru dusra desh laga sipahi khan ke harai dise.

english_text: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
nagamese_text: Biswas pora mahila khan punoruthan pora taikhan nijor khandan morija khan paise. Kintu dusra khan ke dukh dise, taikhan ke chari dibo koi kene asha thaka nai, aru etu pora taikhan aru bhi bhal ula punoruthan pabo bhabise.

english_text: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra kunba khan to ninda kori kene pitise aru luha rusi pora bandhi kene bondhi ghor te rakhidise.

english_text: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
nagamese_text: Kunba khan ke pathor marise, aru kati kene dui tukra korise, taikhan ke porikha korise, aru taikhan ke talwar pora morai dise. Taikhan saguli aru mer laga chamra pindhise, aru bisi gorib hoi jaise, chinta bhabona bisi hoi jaise, aru manu khan pora taikhan ke biya kori thakise.

english_text: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
nagamese_text: Etu duniya to taikhan nimite eku yogya nathaka hoi jaise. Taikhan jongol aru pahar khan te berai thakise, aru mati laga nichete jai kene thakise.

english_text: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga biswas nimite manu khan pora mohima dise, hoile bhi taikhan Isor laga vachan panai.

english_text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
nagamese_text: Isor he amikhan nimite kiba ekta bhal bhabona kori kene ase, aru amikhan nathakile, taikhan sob to thik hobole na paribo.

english_text: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
nagamese_text: Etu karone, amikhan logote gawahi laga dangor badal pora sob phale rukhi kene ase, juntu paap amikhan ke aram pora bandhi loi aru juntu bhari bukhibo di ase, eitu khan sob pichete chari dibo. Amikhan nimite ki rakhi kene ase etu ke saikene polabo.

english_text: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Jisu laga kotha hunibo, jun biswas shuru kora aru thik kori diya ekjon ase. Kelemane kun pora Tai laga age te thaka khushi dikhi kene, Cross te mori bole bhi manise loise, sorom bhi khaise, aru etu pichete Isor laga singhason usorte dyna hathte bohise.

english_text: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Taike bhabi bhi, Tai ekjon kun nijor uporte paap laga sob biya kaam khan bukhi se, etu nimite apuni kitia bhi monte dukh napabo aru chari nadibo karone.

english_text: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan paap logote lorai kora to khun ulabole tak dukh pa nohoi.

english_text: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
nagamese_text: Aru apuni khan ke bacha koi kene mon dangor koridi kene mata to apnikhan pahori jaise: “Moi laga chokra, Probhu pora ki bhal rasta te jabole nimite sikhai ase etu ke dhamali nabhabi bhi, Aru jitia Tai apuni ke bhal rasta te jabole nimite sikhai titia alchi nokoribi.

english_text: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor kunke morom kore taike bhal rasta te jabole nimite sikhai, Aru kun Tai grohon kori loise, tai saja pai.

english_text: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
nagamese_text: Dukh pai thaka to hoile bhal rasta te jabole nimite ase. Isor pora apuni khan ke Tai laga bacha nisena he cholai ase. Eneka kun chokra ase tai laga baba pora bhal rasta te jabole nimite nasikhai?

english_text: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
nagamese_text: Jodi apuni khan ke bhal rasta to sikhai diya nai, jineka sob manu etu nashikai laga kaam te bhag loi kene ase, titia hoile apuni bhal niyom pora jonom nakora chokra ase aru apuni Isor laga chokra nohoi.

english_text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, amikhan laga prithibi te thaka baba pora sikhai diya kotha to amikhan bisi adar kore aru taike sonman diye. Titia hoile atma te thaka baba ke amikhan saikene kiman adar kori kene thaki bole lage?

english_text: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga baba khan pora ki bhal ase etu taikhan para tak amikhan ke sikhai dise. Kintu Isor to amikhan bhal hobole nimite sikhai diye, etu pora amikhan bhi tai laga pobitrota te bhag lobo nimite.

english_text: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
nagamese_text: Sob homoi te bhal rasta te jabole nimite sikhai diya to khushi laga nohobo bhi pare, kele koile sikhai diya to dukh he pai. Kintu kun etu pora sikhi loi, taikhan pichete etu pora dharmikta laga anondo phol dhori loi.

english_text: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apuni laga hath giri kene thaka to takot kori lobi aru apuni laga komjur theng bhi takot kori lobi.

english_text: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga theng nimite rasta to sidha bonai lobi, etu pora theng to lengera hoi kene nathakibo, kintu bhal hoi jabo.

english_text: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
nagamese_text: Sob manu logote shanti pora thakibi, aru pobitro hoi kene thaki bhi, etu nohoile kun bhi Probhu ke dikhi bole na paribo.

english_text: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
nagamese_text: Sabi Isor laga anugrah pora kun bhi komti hoi kene nathakibo nimite, aru tita laga jor kun logote pora bhi ulaikene digdar koribo nadibi, kele koile etu pora bisi manu letera hoi jabo pare.

english_text: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan majot te kunbi mangso laga itcha pora thaka nohobo lage, Esau nisena apobitro nathakibo lage, kun ekbar khabo nimite tai nijor laga naam to bikiri kori dise.

english_text: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan jane etu pichete bhi, jitia tai asirbad pabole nimite itcha korisile, taike tyag kori dise, kelemane tai mon ghura bole nimite aru homoi panai, tai kandi kene suku pani ulaile bhi eku panai.

english_text: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan kiba ekta chubole para laga, joli thaka jui, andhera, mon dukh howa, dangor mon dukh aru tufan,

english_text: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
nagamese_text: nohoile ekbar bhigul bojai diya homoi te, nohoile kuntu awaj kotha kowa hunise Israel manu khan bhik mangise aru to ekta kotha bhi taikhan ke nokobole nimite.

english_text: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan ke ki hukum dise etu mani bole para nai: “Jodi bhi ekta janwar pora etu pahar ke chui diye, titia etu ke pathor maribo lage.”

english_text: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
nagamese_text: Etu sabole bisi bhoi lagise aru Moses pora koise, “Moi bhoi lagi ase aru kapi ase.”

english_text: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, tumi Zion pahar te aru Isor laga sheher te ahise, sorgo laga Jerusalem, aru dos hajar sorgodoth khan khushi kori thaka jagate,

english_text: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
nagamese_text: aru prothom bacha jonom kori kene manu khan joma kora jagate, jun khan laga naam sorgote likhise, aru Isor, kun sob manu laga Bisar-Korta ase, aru dharmik laga atma kun pora thik koribo pare, etu usorte ahise,

english_text: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
nagamese_text: aru Jisu, notun niyom pora kotha kori diya ekjon, ulaikene utu khun hali dise juntu khun to Abel laga khun pora bhi bhal ase.

english_text: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
nagamese_text: Sabi apuni logote kun pora kotha kori ase Isor ke mana nokorile nimite. Kelemane Israel manu khan ke samjhai diya ekjon ke mana kora karone, jodi taikhan bachibo para nai koile, titia kun pora amikhan logot te sorgo pora kotha pati ase Taike mana korile, amikhan kineka bachibo.

english_text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
nagamese_text: Ekta homoi te, Isor laga awaj pora prithibi to hilai dise. Kintu etiya kosom khai kene koise, “Aru ekbar khali etu prithibi to he nohoi, kintu sorgo bhi hilai dibo.”

english_text: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu kotha, “aru ekbar,” laga motlob ase shristi kora jinis khan sob to hilai kene khotom kori dibo, titia he, ki jinis hilai dibo napare, etu he thaki jabo.

english_text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, amikhan kitia bhi hila bole napara laga rajyo to pai ase, amikhan dhanyavad dibo, aru amikhan khushi hoi kene Isor khushi howa aradhana te taike sonman dibo.

english_text: for our God is a consuming fire.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga Isor to hoile jolai diya laga jui ase.

english_text: Let brotherly love continue.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan logot ekjon-ekjon ke morom hodai thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
nagamese_text: Alohi manu ke bhal pora sai bole napahori bhi, etu pora, kunba manu najani kene sorgodoth khan ke bhi modot korise.

english_text: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
nagamese_text: Bondhi ghor te thaka khan ke yaad koribi, taikhan logote thaka nisena. Manu khan pora hinsa kori diya khan ke bhi yaad koribi, apuni tai laga gaw te thaka nisena.

english_text: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
nagamese_text: Shadi kora to sob manu pora sonman koribi, aru shadi laga bisna to sapha rakhibi, kelemane Isor pora bebichari kaam kora manu khan ke bisar koribo.

english_text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga niyom te poisa laga morom pora dur hoi kene thakibi. Apuni logote ki ase etu pora khushi thakibi, kelemane Isor Tai nijor pora koise, “Moi tumikhan ke kitia bhi nacharibo, aru Moi tumikhan ke kitia bhi biya napabo.”

english_text: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite moi khan biswas pora koi, “Moi khan ke modot kora Probhu ase; moi bhi nokorile. Manu pora moike ki kori bole paribo?”

english_text: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga cholawta khan ke mani kene thakibi, kun apuni khan ke Isor laga kotha khan koi diye, aru taikhan apuni logote kineka thake etu sai lobi, aru taikhan biswas te thaka nisena thakibi.

english_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
nagamese_text: Jisu Khrista kali, aji aru hodai nimite eke ase.

english_text: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
nagamese_text: Manu khan pora kisim-kisim notun kotha sikhai diya khan huni kene biswas na koribi. Kelemane amikhan laga bhitor atma te Isor laga anugraha pora ki takot pai, etu he asol ase, kintu dhorom niyom te kha luwa mani luwa te, kun pora etu kore taikhan eku labh napai.

english_text: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga ekta bedi ase, ta te kun manu tombu te sewa kore taikhan ta te pora khabole napare.

english_text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
nagamese_text: Kelemane paap pora maph pabole nimite janwar ke morai aru tai laga khun loi kene moha purohit khan sob pora pobitro jagate jai, kintu taikhan laga gaw to bahar te loijai kene jolai diye.

english_text: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
nagamese_text: Jisu bhi sheher laga duar bahar te jai kene dukh paisele, Tai nijor laga khun pora manu khan ke sapha kori dibole nimite.

english_text: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite amikhan ghor pora bahar te ulaikene Tai logote jabo, Tai nimite sorom bukhi bole karone.

english_text: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
nagamese_text: Kelemane yate amikhan nimite hodai thaki bole laga sheher nai. Kintu, amikhan to ki ahibole ase etu ke he rukhi ase.

english_text: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
nagamese_text: Etu karone Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan bhi Isor ke stuti bolidan narakhikena di thakibo, motlob amikhan laga mukh pora Tai Probhu ase eneka shikar kora ase.

english_text: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan manu nimite bhal kaam kori bole nimite alchi nokorile, kelemane eneka pora diya laga bolidan he Isor khushi pai.

english_text: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga cholawta pora ki koi ase etu mani kene thakibi, kelemane taikhan apnikhan laga atma nimite sikhai ase, kele koile etu sob laga hisab to taikhan nijor pora he dibole ase. Cholawta khan laga kotha manibi, tinehoile he taikhan khushi pora kaam koribo, taikhan ke biya napabi, kelemane apuni eneka korile apuni laga eku labh nohobo.

english_text: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
nagamese_text: Amikhan nimite prathana koribi, kelemane amikhan mon sapha mon hoi kene bhal kaam sob homoi te kori thaki bole itcha ase.

english_text: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi apuni khan ke etu pora bhi bisi kori bole nimite mon dangor koridi ase, etu pora moi bhi apuni khan logote joldi ahibole paribo.

english_text: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
nagamese_text: Etiya Isor laga anondo, kun pora mora pora jinda uthaise, kun sobse mohan mer rokhiya ase, anonto vachan laga khun pora,

english_text: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: sob bhal kaam te Tai laga kaam kori bole nimite apuni khan ke bhorta kori dibi, aru Jisu Khrista dwara amikhan logote Tai laga itcha kori bole dibi, Taike hodai-hodai nimite mohima hobi. Amen.

english_text: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
nagamese_text: Bhaikhan moi apuni khan laga mon dangor koridi ase, moi laga kotha khan bhal pora huni lobi, kele koile moi olop kotha apuni khan ke likhi ase.

english_text: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga bhai Timothy ke bondhi ghor pora chari diya khobor hunise, taike loi kene moi apuni khan ke joldi lok koribo.

english_text: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga cholawta aru sob pobitro manu khan ke salam dibi. Italy desh te thaka khan pora bhi apnikhan ke salam di ase.

english_text: Grace be with you all. Amen.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan sob logote anugrah thaki bole dibi.

english_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
nagamese_text: James, Probhu Jisu Khrista aru Isor laga ekjon noukar pora, baroh ta jat kunkhan alag-alag jagate ase, taikhan logote etu chithi likhi kene salam jonai ase!

english_text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
nagamese_text: Kitia dukh digdar khan lok pai, ami laga bhai khan, titia khushi koribi.

english_text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile apnikhan jani ase, kitia biswas ke porikha kore, etu pora dhorjo ulai.

english_text: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
nagamese_text: Etu dhorjo kora laga kaam pura hobole dibi, etu pora apuni khan pura hoi jabo, aru eku pora bhi komti nathakibo.

english_text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu gyaan lage, tai Isor logote mangi lobi, aru Tai kunke ki lage, etu hisab te manga khan ke Tai khushi pora diye.

english_text: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai biswas pora mangibo lage, monte eku bhabona nakori kene. Kelemane kun manu bhabona kori kene mange tai to hoile samundar laga hawa pora ekta jaga pora dusra jagate loija nisena ase.

english_text: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
nagamese_text: Eneka manu to Probhu pora kiba ekta pabo koi kene bhabona na koribi.

english_text: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
nagamese_text: Eneka manu to duita mon thaka manu ase, aru sob rasta te thik nathake.

english_text: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
nagamese_text: Kintu biswasi gorib bhai bhi jitia Isor he taike uthai dibo, titia khushi koribi,

english_text: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
nagamese_text: aru dhuni manu tai laga nomro kori diya sonman nimite khushi thakibi, kelemane tai nijor to jongol laga phul nisena ghas logote harai jabo.

english_text: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
nagamese_text: Kelemane suryo to gorom diye aru ghas khan ke bhi sukhai diye. Ghas laga phul khan giri jai, aru tai sundur dikhi thaka to harai jai. Etu nisena, dhuni manu rasta te safar kori thaka homoi te, taikhan bhi harai jai.

english_text: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
nagamese_text: Kun pora porikha te thik dhorjo kori kene khara kori thake, tai asishit ase. Kilekoile etu porikha paar huwa pichete, jibon laga mukut, kuntu Isor ke morom kora khan nimite ase, etu tai pabo.

english_text: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
nagamese_text: Kun bhi porikha aha homoi te eneka nokobi, “Moike Isor pora porikha kori ase,” kelemane Isor ke biya pora porikha nakore, aru Tai nijor bhi dusra ke porikha nakore.

english_text: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
nagamese_text: Kintu sob nijor laga itcha pora he porikha te gire, etu pora taike tani kene biya kaam kori bole nimite loijai.

english_text: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
nagamese_text: Jitia itcha khan monte ulai, etu paap ke jonom diye, aru jitia paap to pura dangor hoijai, etu mrityu ke jonom diye.

english_text: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
nagamese_text: Nijorke thogai nadibi, ami laga morom bhai khan.

english_text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
nagamese_text: Sobse bhal uphar aru sobse thik uphar upor thaka Isor pora he ahe. Eitu khan jyoti laga Baba Isor pora he ahe. Tai logot te bodla-bodli nohoile andhera chaya nathake.

english_text: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
nagamese_text: Isor pora amikhan ke hosa laga kotha pora jonom dibole basi loise, etu pora amikhan Tai bona laga shristi bhitor te prothom ula phol hobole dise.

english_text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
nagamese_text: Apuni etu jane, ami laga bhai khan: Kintu sob manu huna te joldi hobi, aste pora kotha kobi, aru khong nauthibi.

english_text: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane manu laga khong pora Isor laga dharmik kaam nacholai.

english_text: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite sob paap laga kaam khan chari dibi. Aru nomro hoi kene Isor laga kotha monte rakhibi, etu pora apuni laga atma bachai lobole paribo.

english_text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
nagamese_text: Kintu kotha huna nisena kaam bhi kori bhi, khali huni kene nathakibi, eneka kora to nijorke thogai diya he ase.

english_text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba Isor laga kotha to hune kintu kaam nakore, tai eneka ekjon ase kun ayna te nijor laga chehera ke sai.

english_text: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
nagamese_text: Tai kineka dikhe etu tai nijorke bhal pora sai loi, kintu bahar ula logote, tai laga chehera pahori jai.

english_text: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu bhal pora saikene niyom mani thake, aru hodai eneka kori thake, khali huni kene pahorija nohoi, kintu kaam bhi kore, etu manu tai laga sob kaam te asirbad pabo.

english_text: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba nijorke dhorom mani kene thaka manu ase bhabe, hoile bhi tai laga jiba to rukhai kene narakhe, aru nijor laga mon to thogai diye, titia hoile tai laga dhorom to eku kaam nai.

english_text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
nagamese_text: Baba Isor usorte sapha aru bhal dhorom etu ase: baba nathaka aru bidhowa khan dukh paikene thaka homoi te modot kori bole, aru etu prithibi pora nijorke dagi nathaki kene rakhibole nimite ase.

english_text: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
nagamese_text: Ami laga bhai kokai khan, amikhan laga mohima aru biswas to Probhu Jisu Khrista logote thaka hisab te, apuni kunke bhi pakshapat nadikhabi.

english_text: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba apuni khan joma kori thaka jagate suna aru bhal kapra lagai kene ahe, aru ta te ekjon gorib manu bhi letera kapra lagai kene ahe.

english_text: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni bhal kapra lagai kene thaka ke koi ase, “Apuni yate bhal jagate bohibi,” kintu ekjon gorib ke koi, “Apuni ta te khara koribi” nohoile “Ami laga theng niche matite bohibi,”

english_text: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
nagamese_text: apuni khan nijor majote bisar kori ase nohoi? Apuni biya bhabona loi kene bisar kora manu hoi ase nohoi?

english_text: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
nagamese_text: Huni bhi, moi laga morom bhai khan, Isor he prithibi laga gorib ke biswas te dhuni hobole diya nohoi, aru kun manu Taike morom kore taikhan ke Tai laga rajyote jaga diye nohoi?

english_text: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni gorib ke opman korise! Etu dhuni khan pora he apuni ke dukh diya nohoi? Aru taikhan he apnikhan ke bisar kori bole bisar ghor te loijai nohoi?

english_text: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
nagamese_text: Apnikhan ke kuntu sonman thaka naam Isor pora matise, etu naam ke sorom khilai dise nohoi?

english_text: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
nagamese_text: Jodi, apuni, Isor laga niyom mani kene thake, “Apuni laga ghor usorte thaka manu ke nijor nisena morom koribo,” titia apuni bhal kori ase.

english_text: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni bhal pai thaka manu ke he sai, apuni paap kori ase, aru apuni niyom bhangai diya manu ase.

english_text: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba pora niyom pura mane, hoile bhi tai chutu jaga ekta te giri jai, titia tai pura niyom bhangai diya manu hoise.

english_text: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu ekjon kun eneka koise, “Bebichari nokoribi,” tai pora etu bhi koise, “Manu ke morai nadibi.” Kintu jodi apuni bebichari nakore, kintu manu ke morai diye, titia hoile apuni niyom bhanga manu ase.

english_text: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
nagamese_text: Etu karone amikhan ke mukti diya niyom pora bisar kori bole thaka nimite, ki koi ase etu nijor pora bhi koribi.

english_text: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun pora daya nadikhai, bisar to etu manu uporte ahe. Daya he bisar uporte jiti loi.

english_text: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
nagamese_text: Ki bhal ase, moi laga bhai khan, jodi kunba manu koi tai logote biswas ase, kintu tai logote kaam to nai? Titia hoile etu biswas pora taike bacha bole paribo?

english_text: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
nagamese_text: Jodi ekjon bhai aru bhoini biya kapra lagai kene ase aru khabole nimite napai kene thaki ase.

english_text: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
nagamese_text: Etiya ekjon pora taikhan ke eneka koise, “Shanti pora jabi, bhorta hoi kene bhal pora thakibi.” Kintu jodi apuni taikhan laga gaw pora ki lage etu nadiye, titia hoile ki bhal ase?

english_text: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena biswas tai nijor pora, kaam nathakile, mora ase.

english_text: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
nagamese_text: Kunba pora eneka kobole pare, “Apuni logote biswas ase, aru moi logote kaam ase.” Apuni kaam nathaki kene biswas to dikhai dibi, aru moi laga kaam pora apuni ke biswas to dikhai dibo.

english_text: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
nagamese_text: Apuni biswas kore ki Isor ekta ase; apuni bhal pora jane. Saitan khan bhi etu jane, aru taikhan bhoi pora kape.

english_text: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni janibole mon ase, murkho manu khan, biswas logote kaam nathakile eku labh nai?

english_text: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
nagamese_text: Amikhan laga baba Abraham pora jitia tai laga chokra Isaac ke daan dibole nimite thakise, tai laga kaam pora taike thik korise nohoi?

english_text: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
nagamese_text: Apuni sabi tai laga biswas aru kaam eke logote kaam korise. Aru kaam pora he biswas to thik korise.

english_text: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
nagamese_text: Isor laga kotha eneka koi kene pura hoise, “Kintu Abraham Isor ke biswas korise, aru etu pora tai dharmik ase koi kene manise,” aru taike Isor laga sathi matise.

english_text: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
nagamese_text: Apuni sabi, ekjon manu ke khali biswas ekela pora nohoi, kintu biswas logote kaam pora he taike thik kore.

english_text: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
nagamese_text: Kintu etu nisena pora he, Rahab bhi tai laga kaam pora bisar kora nai naki, jitia tai Isor manu khan ke matise aru dusra rasta pora pathai dise?

english_text: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
nagamese_text: Jineka ekta gaw te atma nathakile gaw to mora ase, etu nisena biswas logote kaam nathakile etu biswas to mora ase.

english_text: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan sob hikhok hobole napare, ami laga bhai khan, kelemane apuni khan jani ase, amikhan kun pora manu ke hikai, bisar to amikhan uporte he bisi kara hobo.

english_text: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
nagamese_text: Amikhan sob kisim rasta pora paap te giri thake. Jodi kunba tai laga kotha pora nagirile, tai ekjon bhal manu ase, aru tai laga pura gaw to cholai kene jabole pare.

english_text: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
nagamese_text: Etiya jodi amikhan ghora laga mukh te kotha mani bole nimite rusi lagai diye, amikhan tai laga pura gaw to chola bole pare.

english_text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
nagamese_text: Aru ekta jahaaj ke bhi sabi, juntu iman dangor ase aru hawa pora etu ke loijai, kun jagate chola manu pora loi jabole mon kore, ta te loijai.

english_text: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
nagamese_text: Etu nisena jiba to gaw laga ekta chutu bhag he ase, kintu bisi dangor kotha koi kene phutani kore. Aru sabi kineka kori kene ekta chutu jui pora dangor jongol julai diye.

english_text: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
nagamese_text: Paap pora bhorta thaka duniya te, etu jiba bhi jui nisena he ase. Etu jiba to gaw laga ekta bhag ase, aru etu pora pura gaw ke letera kori diye aru jibon te jui lagai diye, aru etu jui to norok pora he ahe.

english_text: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
nagamese_text: Sob kisim laga jongol janwar, chiriya, aru matite bera pukakhan, aru samundar te thaka sob to manu pora he sikhai kene ghor te pali rakhe.

english_text: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu bhi tai nijor laga jiba ke thik rakhibole napare. Jiba to ekta aram nathaka dusto atma ase, aru jeher pora bhorta ase.

english_text: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
nagamese_text: Etu jiba pora amikhan Baba Isor aru Probhu ke dhanyavad diye, aru etu jiba pora he Isor laga protima te bona manu laga biya koi.

english_text: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
nagamese_text: Eke mukh pora he asirbad aru shrap bhi ulai. Ami laga bhai khan, eneka nohobo lage.

english_text: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
nagamese_text: Jhorna laga ekta mukh pora ula pani to ekbar te he mitha aru tita pani ulabole pare?

english_text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
nagamese_text: Ami laga bhai khan, ekta dimoru ghas pora, oliv ulabole pare naki? Nohoile, angur ghas pora khajur ulabole pare? Etu nisena, nimok laga pani pora kitia bhi mitha pani bona bole napare.

english_text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan majote kun gyaani aru bujhi bole para manu ase? Titia utu manu to bhal jibon ki ase, etu hisab te, nomro hoi kene gyaan laga kaam khan dikhai dibo lage.

english_text: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi apuni laga monte lalchi aru biya kaam khan ase, titia hosa laga kotha bhirodh te misa aru phutani nokoribi.

english_text: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
nagamese_text: Etu upor pora aha laga gyaan nohoi. Kintu, etu prithibi laga ase, atmik nohoi, aru etu bhoot laga kaam ase.

english_text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
nagamese_text: Kun jagate lalchi aru kiba pabole laga itcha thake, ta te sob biya kaam aru jhamela thake.

english_text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
nagamese_text: Kintu upor pora aha gyaan to sobse poila sapha ase, aru pichete, shanti aru morom ase, sob logote mili bole pare, daya pora bhorta aru bhal phol dhure, sob kaam te bhal aru eku chalak nakore.

english_text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
nagamese_text: Kintu kunkhan pora shanti te mil-milap kori thake, taikhan majote he dharmik laga phol to shanti pora rupai thake.

english_text: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
nagamese_text: Apuni khan majot te kot pora lorai jhagara khan ulai? Etu apuni khan majot te jhagara kori bole itcha thaka pora nohoi?

english_text: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
nagamese_text: Apuni itcha kore, kintu napai. Apuni thogai kene morai, kintu napai. Apuni lorai aru jhagara kore. Apuni etu napai kelemane apuni namange.

english_text: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
nagamese_text: Apuni mange kintu apuni napai, kelemane apuni bhal pora namange, apuni nijor laga itcha nimite he kore.

english_text: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
nagamese_text: Biswas te nathaka khan! Apuni najane naki prithibi logote sathi kori thaka to Isor laga bhirodh te ase? Etu nimite kun manu prithibi logote sathi kori kene thakibo tai Isor laga dushman ase.

english_text: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
nagamese_text: Pobitro kotha te, “Etu Atma amikhan laga bhitor te thaki bole diya to bisi lalchi kori ase” eneka likha to eku motlob nai naki?

english_text: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Isor pora anugraha bisi diye, Isor kotha te koi ase, “Phutani kora manu ke Isor pora hatai diye, kintu kun nomro hoi kene thaka, taike anugrah diye.”

english_text: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
nagamese_text: Isor logote sob rakhidi bhi. Aru bhoot ke rukhabi, titia tai apuni pora polai jabo.

english_text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
nagamese_text: Isor usorte ahibi, aru Tai bhi apuni laga usorte ahibo. Paapi manu khan, apuni khan laga hath aru duita mon thaka khan bhi nijor mon sapha kori lobi.

english_text: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
nagamese_text: Mon bhitor pora bikhai kene bisi dukh kori kene kandi bhi! Apuni laga hasi to dukh te bodli koribi aru khushi thaka to chinta te bodli kori lobi.

english_text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
nagamese_text: Probhu laga usorte nijorke chutu koribi, aru Tai apuni ke uthai dibo.

english_text: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan ekjon-ekjon laga biya kotha nokoribi. Kun manu tai laga bhai bhirodh te kotha kore aru niyom laga bhirodh te kotha kori kene, tai nijor pora niyom ke bisar kori loise. Kintu jodi apuni niyom ke bisar kore, apuni niyom mani thaka nohoi, kintu ekjon bisar kora manu ase.

english_text: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
nagamese_text: Kanun diya aru bisar kora ekjon he ase. Isor he ase kun apnikhan ke bacha bole pare aru khotom bhi kori bole pare. Kintu apuni kun ase, kun nijor laga usorte thaka manu ke bisar kore?

english_text: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
nagamese_text: Etiya huni bhi, apuni kun eneka koi, “Aji nohoile kali amikhan etu jagate jabo, aru olop saal ta te thakibo, aru kaam koribo, aru poisa kamabo.”

english_text: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan kun aha kali ki hobole ase najane, apuni laga jibon to ki ase? Kelemane apuni ekta dhuwa nisena ase kuntu olop deri nimite ulai aru pichete harai jai.

english_text: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
nagamese_text: Hoile bhi, apuni eneka kobole lage, “Jodi Probhu itcha kore, titia amikhan etu koribo.”

english_text: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya apuni ki kaam khan kori bole bhabona ase, eitu khan nimite phutani kori ase. Eitu khan sob to paap he ase.

english_text: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
nagamese_text: Kun manu bhal kaam kori bole jane, hoile bhi tai etu nakore, titia tai nimite etu paap ase.

english_text: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
nagamese_text: Etiya ahibi, apuni khan kun dhuni ase, kandi kene hala koribi kelemane apuni logote dukh din ahibole ase.

english_text: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga dhun sob puchi jaise, aru apuni laga kapra sob puka pora khai dise.

english_text: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga suna aru chandi sob biya hoi jaise aru mamor lagi kene thaka pora apuni laga bhirodh te gawahi dibo. Apuni laga gaw to jui pora jolai diya nisena hoi jabo. Apuni hekh din nimite dhun khan joma kori kene rakhi ase.

english_text: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
nagamese_text: Sabi, kaam kora khan laga hajira poisa pora kandi ase- apuni laga kheti te kaam kora khan ke hajira poisa diya nai, aru taikhan kanda to Mohan Probhu laga kan te ponchise.

english_text: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
nagamese_text: Etu prithibi laga khushi aru aram te apnikhan thakise. Kati kene morai diya laga din nimite apuni khan laga mon to mosto kori kene rakhise.

english_text: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
nagamese_text: Aru dharmik manu ke ninda korise aru morai dise. Hoilebi tai apuni khan ke eneka kori bole pora rukhanai.

english_text: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan, nomro hoi kene thakibi, jitia tak Probhu nahe. Sabi, kheti kora khan mati pora bhal phol ulabole nimite rukhi ase. Taikhan nomro hoi kene joldi nohoile hekh howa borkhon pani ke rukhi thake.

english_text: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
nagamese_text: Apuni bhi, dhorjo koribi. Apuni laga mon to takot kori lobi, kelemane Probhu wapas ahibole to usor hoise.

english_text: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
nagamese_text: Bhai khan, manu laga biya ekjon-ekjon logote nokobi, eneka nakorile he apuni logote bisar nahibo. Sabi, bisar kora ekjon dorjate khara kori ase.

english_text: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
nagamese_text: Bhai kokai khan, kosto te dhorjo hobo nimite, bhabobadi khan, kunkhan Probhu naam te prochar korise, taikhan ke namuna nisena lobi.

english_text: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
nagamese_text: Sabi, kunkhan dhorjo korise, taikhan to asishit ase koi kene amikhan biswas kore. Job kineka dukh paise etu apuni khan hunise, aru apuni khan Probhu laga ki itcha ase etu jane, Tai kiman morom kore aru kiman dayalu ase.

english_text: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
nagamese_text: Kintu ami laga bhai khan, eitu khan sob pora bhi upor, apuni sorgo aru prithibi laga naam pora kosom nakhabi, aru dusra eku naam te kosom nakhabi. Kintu, apuni laga “Hoi” to “Hoi” hobole dibi aru “Nohoi” to “Nohoi” hobole dibi, etu pora apuni khan bisar te nagiribo.

english_text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
nagamese_text: Kunba apuni khan majote dukh pai ase naki? Tai prathana koribi. Kunba khushi ase naki? Tai gana kori kene mohima dibi.

english_text: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;
nagamese_text: Kunba apuni khan majote bemar ase naki? Tai girja laga bura khan ke mati bhi, aru tai uporte prathana kori bole dibi aru Probhu laga naam te tai uporte tel lagai dibole kobi.

english_text: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
nagamese_text: Biswas laga prathana pora bemar thaka ekjon ke bhal koribo, aru Probhu pora taike uthai dibo. Jodi tai paap korise koile bhi, Isor pora taike maph koribo.

english_text: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
nagamese_text: Ekjon-ekjon logote paap shikar koribi, aru ek dusra nimite prathana koribi, etu pora apuni changai hoi jabo. Dharmik ekjon laga prathana to bisi shakti pora kaam kore.

english_text: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
nagamese_text: Elijah bhi amikhan nisena ekjon thakise. Tai mon dikene pani na giribole nimite prathana korise, aru tin saal aru choi mohina tak etu jagate pani gira nai.

english_text: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
nagamese_text: Titia Elijah aru bhi prathana korise, aru sorgo pora pani dise, aru prithibi pora phol ulaise.

english_text: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
nagamese_text: Ami laga bhai khan, jodi kunba apuni khan majote hosa to najani kene thaki ase, aru kunba pora taike loi anise,

english_text: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
nagamese_text: etu manu janibole lage kun pora paapi ekjon, kun rasta harai kene berai ase, ta te pora mon ghurai kene loi anibo, tai laga atma ke mrityu pora bachai loise, aru bisi paap thaka to maph pai loise.

english_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
nagamese_text: Peter, Jisu Khrista laga apostle, pora Isor laga basi luwa kiman dusra desh te ase, Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, aru Bithynia jaga khan te thaka khan ke likhi ase.

english_text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
nagamese_text: Etu sob to Baba Isor laga gyaan te age pora jani thaka pora hoise, aru Atma laga kotha mani bole alag kori kene rakhidise, aru Jisu Khrista laga khun pora sapha kori diya khan ase. Anugraha apuni khan logote thaki bole dibi, aru shanti hodai apuni khan uporte bisi bhorta hoi thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
nagamese_text: Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga mohima hodai hobole dibi! Tai laga dangor daya te, Tai amikhan ke notun jonom dise aru Jisu Khrista ke mora pora jinda kori kene amikhan ke biswas te jinda thaki bole nimite ekta asha rakhidise.

english_text: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
nagamese_text: Etu kitia bhi khotom nohobole, aru eku dagi nathakibole, aru kitia bhi naharabole dise. Etu amikhan nimite sorgote rakhi dikene ase.

english_text: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan ke Isor laga hokti pora roikhya kori kene rakhi ase, biswas dwara poritran pabo nimite, juntu hekh homoi te prokahit hobo.

english_text: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
nagamese_text: Apuni khan etu sob nimite bisi khushi kori ase, kintu etiya pora olop din tak, dorkar hoile, apuni khan kisim dukh aru kosto koribo lagibo.

english_text: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
nagamese_text: Etu sob to apuni laga biswas dikhai dibole nimite ase. Etu to suna, juntu harai jabole bostu ase, etu ke bhi jui pora sapha kore, etu nisena biswas, kun suna pora bhi bisi daam ase, etu ke bhi porikha kori ase. Titia Jisu ke prokahit kora dinte, apuni laga biswas to stuti, mohima, aru sonman pabo.

english_text: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
nagamese_text: Apuni khan Jisu ke dikha nai, kintu Taike morom kore. Apuni khan etiya Taike dikha nai, kintu Taike biswas kore aru kobole napara laga anond aru khushi pora Taike mohima diye.

english_text: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan etiya nijor biswas nimite parinam pai ase, juntu apnikhan atma laga poritran ase.

english_text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
nagamese_text: Sob bhabobadi khan etu poritran ki ase koi kene bhal pora bisarise, aru taikhan pora apuni khan pabole thaka kripa laga bhabobani koi dise.

english_text: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan janibole nimite bisarise kunke Khrista laga Atma pora taikhan ke ki koi ase. Atma pora taikhan ke Khrista kineka dukh pabole ase etu sob koi dise aru etu pichete ki hobole ase eitu khan sob taikhan ke age pora janai dise.

english_text: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ke prokahit kori diya kotha to taikhan nimite nohoi, kintu jitia taikhan pora utu kotha khan koi dise juntu etiya apnikhan ke Isor laga susamachar prochar kora khan pora sorgo pora aha Pobitro Atma dwara apnikhan ke koi dise - etu kotha khan sorgodoth khan bhi etu khobor janibole bisi itcha korise.

english_text: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
nagamese_text: Etu nimite apuni khan laga mon taiyar kori lobi. Nisa nahobi. Apuni khan laga asha pura Tai laga mohima te rakhibi, jitia Jisu Khrista wapas ahibo titia sob to dikhai dibo.

english_text: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
nagamese_text: Kotha mani kene thaka bacha nisena, poila najani kene thaka nisena gaw mangso itcha te nathakibi.

english_text: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
nagamese_text: Kintu kun apuni ke matise Tai pobitro thaka nisena, apuni bhi, apuni laga sob kaam te pobitro thakibi.

english_text: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane eneka likha ase, “Pobitro thakibi, kelemane Moi pobitro ase.”

english_text: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite jodi apuni Isor ke “Baba” mate, jun manu laga mukh nasai, kintu kaam saikene bisar kore, etu prithibi te homoi thaka to, ekdom bhoi kori kene thik thakibi.

english_text: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
nagamese_text: Sob murkho kaam apuni khan laga baba khan pora apnikhan sikhise. Aru apuni khan jane, harai ja laga suna chandi pora apuni khan ke udhar kora nohoi.

english_text: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
nagamese_text: Kintu, apuni khan ke Jisu Khrista laga khun pora bachai loise, aru Tai ekta jokhom aru dagi nathaka mer bacha nisena ase.

english_text: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
nagamese_text: Taike etu prithibi shuru nohua age pora basi loise, kintu Taike etu hekh homoi te apuni khan ke prokahit kori dise.

english_text: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
nagamese_text: Tai dwara apuni khan Isor ke biswas korise, kun Taike mora pora jinda kori dise aru sob mohima dise, etu pora apuni laga biswas aru asha Isor uporte hodai thaki bole.

english_text: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
nagamese_text: Hosa kotha mani kene apuni khan nijor laga atma ke sapha kori loise. Aru etu sob nijor kokai bhai ke morom kori kene thaki bole nimite; etiya ekjon-ekjon ke sapha mon pora morom kori kene thakibi.

english_text: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan notun jonom hoise, harai ja laga bijon pora nohoi, kintu kitia bhi nahara laga bijon pora, aru hodai jinda thaka Isor laga kotha pora.

english_text: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
nagamese_text: Kelemane, Isor kotha te likha ase, “Sob gaw mangso ghas nisena ase, Aru tai laga sob mohima jongol te ulai thaka phul nisena ase, Etu ghas sukhi jai, aru phul khan giri jai,

english_text: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
nagamese_text: Kintu Probhu laga kotha hodai nimite thake.” Etu he ase susamachar laga kotha juntu apuni khan nimite koi dise.

english_text: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite sob biya kaam khan chari dibi, aru sob thogai diya kaam aru manu logote dushmani kori thaka khan aru kiman biya bhabona monte rakhi ase eitu khan chari dibi.

english_text: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
nagamese_text: Ekta notun jonom kora bacha nisena, atma laga ekdom sapha thaka dudh nimite itcha koribi, etu pora apuni poritran pabole arubi bisi itcha koribo,

english_text: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
nagamese_text: Aru Isor kotha te likha nisina, jodi apuni Probhu to morom kore koi kene jani loise koile.

english_text: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
nagamese_text: Tai logote ahibi kun ekta jivit pathor ase, junke manu pora chari disele, kintu Isor he Taike basi loise aru bisi daam laga pathor bonaise.

english_text: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan bhi ekta jinda thaka pathor nisena ase kunke atma laga ghor bonai dise, etu pora amikhan Isor laga pobitro kaam koribo, jeneka purohit khan kore, aru Jisu Khrista te atma laga bolidan dikena thakibo.

english_text: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, pobitro shastro te eneka likha ase: “Sabi, Moi Zion te kinar laga pathor hali ase, “Basi luwa aru bisi daam laga. Kun manu Taike biswas kore, tai kitia bhi sorom nakhabo.”

english_text: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
nagamese_text: Apuni khan kun biswas kore tai nimite sonman pabo. Kintu jun kotha namane, “Juntu pathor ghor bona manu khan pora phelai dise, etu he kinar laga pathor matha hoi jaise”-

english_text: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
nagamese_text: Aru “Ekta rasta bondh kori diya pathor Aru kuntu taikhan ke giribole diye.” Taikhan giri thake kelemane taikhan Isor laga kotha namane- aru etu nimite he taikhan ke bachi loise.

english_text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni ekjon basi luwa manu khan ase, ekta purohit rajyo, ekta pobitro desh, Isor laga nijor manu khan, etu pora apuni khan Tai laga asurit kaam khan dusra ke koi dibo, Tai jun pora apuni khan ke andhera pora mati kene ujala te loi anise.

english_text: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
nagamese_text: Ek homoi te apuni khan Tai laga manu thaka nai, Kintu etiya apuni khan Isor laga manu hoi jaise. Apuni khan poila te daya panai, Kintu etiya to daya paise.

english_text: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, moi pora apuni khan to dusra desh laga manu thaka nisena, mangso laga itcha pora dur thaki bole nimite mati ase, kun pora apuni laga atma logot lorai kori ase.

english_text: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
nagamese_text: Porjati khan logote apuni khan bhal kaam kori kene dikhai dibi, etu pora jodi taikhan apuni pora biya kaam kori thaka nisena kotha kore, taikhan apuni laga bhal kaam to dikhibo aru Isor aha laga dinte Taike mohima dibo.

english_text: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
nagamese_text: Manu pora ki adhikar cholai ase etu Probhu nimite mani kene thakibi. Prithibi laga raja khan ke mani kene thakibi,

english_text: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
nagamese_text: Aru Governor khan ke, kun Tai pora pathaise biya kaam kora khan ke saja dibole nimite, aru kun bhal kaam kore taikhan ke prosansa koribo nimite.

english_text: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu Isor laga itcha ase, etu pora apuni ki bhal kaam kori ase etu dikhi kene kaam nathaka murkho khan laga kotha ke chup kori dibo.

english_text: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
nagamese_text: Ekjon ajad manu nisena, apuni laga ajadi ke biya kaam lukai dibole nimite nacholabi, kintu Isor laga noukar nisena thakibi.

english_text: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
nagamese_text: Sob manu ke sonman koribi. Bhai kokai khan ke morom thaki bole itcha koribi. Isor ke bhoi koribi. Aru raja ke sonman koribi.

english_text: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
nagamese_text: Nokorkhan, malik ke sob kaam pora sewa koribi. Khali bhal aru morom kora malik ke he sewa nakori bhi, kintu khechera malik hoilebi taike sewa koribi.

english_text: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu bisi asis kotha ase ekjon nimite jodi tai logote anyai hoi thaka nimite dukh digdar pai thakile bhi, tai kaam khan kori thake, kele koile tai Isor ke jani loise.

english_text: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan laga ki labh ase jodi apuni paap kori kene aru etu laga sajah bhi pai? Kintu jodi apuni bhal kaam kori kene sajah pa homoi te dukh pai, eneka korile he apuni Isor usorte mohima pabole yogya ase.

english_text: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu nimite he apuni ke matise, aru Khrista bhi apuni nimite dukh paise. Tai laga jibon pora apuni khan bhal rasta te bera bole nimite dikhai dise.

english_text: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
nagamese_text: “Tai eku paap kaam kora nai, Aru Tai laga mukh pora kitia bhi biya kotha ula nai.”

english_text: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
nagamese_text: Jitia Jisu Khrista ke biya kotha khan koisele, Tai wapas taikhan ke biya kotha koi kene jawab diya nai. Jitia Tai dukh paise, Taikhan ke wapas dukh pabole nimite dhomki diya nai, kintu Tai kun bhal pora bisar kore taike nijor jibon to di dise.

english_text: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
nagamese_text: Tai amikhan laga paap to uthaikene nijor gaw to Cross te mori bole dise, etu pora amikhan paap te eku bhag nathakibole nimite, aru amikhan dharmik jibon loi kene jinda thakibo. Tai laga ghaw pora amikhan changai paise.

english_text: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan harai ja mer nisena berai thakise, kintu etiya apuni mer rokhiya logote wapas ahi jaise aru apuni khan laga atma ke bachai diya malik usorte ahise.

english_text: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, shadi kora maiki khan nijor laga mota logote bhal kori kene thakibi. Eneka korile kunba mota kun Isor laga kotha namani kene ase, taikhan ke eku kotha nokoi kene jiti lobole paribo, taikhan maiki laga adat saikene.

english_text: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan apuni laga bhal kaam aru adat khan dikhi kene thakibo.

english_text: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
nagamese_text: Apuni laga sundur to eneka nisena bahar laga saman pora nadikha bhi, jineka chuli bandhe, suna laga mala lagai, aru bhal sundur kapra khan lagai.

english_text: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni laga bhal aru bhitor mon to he dikhai dibi, aru kitia bhi khotom nakora sundur aru shanti thaka atma to dikhai dibi, etu he Isor usorte bisi daam laga ase.

english_text: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
nagamese_text: Kelemane poila laga pobitro mahila kunkhan Isor ke mohima kore, taikhan bhi nijor mota ke eneka kori kene manise.

english_text: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena Sarah pora Abraham laga kotha mani kene taike tai laga probhu matise. Apuni khan bhi tai laga bacha ase jodi apuni khan ki bhal ase etu kore aru jodi apuni khan dukh aha to bhoi nakore.

english_text: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, shadi kora mota khan nijor maiki logote mon mili kene thaki bhi, aru taikhan komjur ase koi kene bhal pora sabi. Apuni taike sonman dibi aru jibon te asirbad ana ekjon ase koi kene tai logote bhal pora thakibi. Eneka korile apuni laga prathana te kitia bhi digdar nahobo.

english_text: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
nagamese_text: Aru hekh te, etiya pora, apuni khan sob, ekta bhabona hoi jabi, nomro koribi, kokai bhai ke morom koribi, mon to shanti rakhibi, aru chutu hoi kene thakibi.

english_text: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
nagamese_text: Manu pora biya kaam korile wapas aru biya kaam kori kene nadikhabi aru apuni ke sorom khilai diya kotha koile aru wapas taike sorom nakhila bhi. Kintu manu pora ki koile bhi, taike asirbad dibi, kelemane etu nimite apuni ke mati loise, etu pora apuni asirbad pabo.

english_text: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
nagamese_text: Kelemane, Isor kotha te likha nisina, “Kun manu jibon to morom kore aru bhal din dikhi bole mon ase Tai nijor laga jiba ke biya kotha pora rukhai kene rakhibi aru tai laga mukh pora biya kotha ulabole nadibi.

english_text: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai nijorke biya kaam pora dur hoi kene thaki bole dibi aru ki bhal kaam ase etu koribi. Taike shanti bisari bole dibi aru etu te thaki bole nimite kosis koribi.

english_text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
nagamese_text: Probhu laga suku dharmik manu ke he sai thake, aru Tai laga kan taikhan pora ki koi etu hune. Kintu kun manu Probhu laga bhirodh te biya kaam kore taikhan usor pora Tai laga chehera hatai diye.”

english_text: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
nagamese_text: Jodi apuni bhal kaam kore koile kun manu apuni ke dukh dibo?

english_text: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni dharmik aru bhal kori kene dukh pai thakile bhi, apuni asishit ase. Etu nimite taikhan apuni ke bhoi khilai le bhi, bhoi nokoribi, aru chinta nokoribi.

english_text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
nagamese_text: Kintu, hodai Probhu Khrista pobitro ase koi kene sonman dibi. Aru jodi manu khan apuni ke Isor apuni nimite ki ase eneka hudile, jowab dibole nimite taiyar thakibi.

english_text: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu sob to nomro aru manu ke sonman dikene koribi. Jitia taikhan apuni ke kotha hude, etu homoi te apuni laga bhabona sapha rakhibi, titia kun manu apuni Khrista te bhal jibon dikhi kene apuni ke sorom khilai, tai sorom hoi jabo.

english_text: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu bhal ase, jodi Isor itcha kore, apuni biya kori kene dukh pai thaka pora to bhal kaam kori kene dukh pai thaka to he bhal ase.

english_text: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Khrista bhi paap nimite bisi dukh paise. Tai ekjon dharmik thakise kintu amikhan nimite dukh paise, etu pora amikhan ke Isor usorte anibole nimite. Taike gaw mangso te morai dise, kintu Pobitro Atma pora Taike jinda kori dise.

english_text: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
nagamese_text: Aru Tai jai kene bondhi ghor te thaka atma khan logote prochar kori bole jaise.

english_text: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
nagamese_text: Kilekoile taikhan poila te, kitia jahaaj bonaise aru Noah laga yug te Isor pora dhorjo hoi kene rukhise, taikhan pora kotha mana nai, Isor pora kunba manu ke he bachai loise- etu hoile, ath-jon atma ke pani pora bachai dise.

english_text: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
nagamese_text: Etu etiya amikhan nimite bachai diya laga ekta baptizma laga chihna ase- jineka amikhan laga gaw pora moila dhulai eneka nohoi, kintu Isor usorte bhal bhabona loi kene thaki bole nimite aru etu sob to Jisu Khrista jee-utha laga naam te.

english_text: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
nagamese_text: Khrista to Jisu laga dyna hath ase. Tai sorgote jaise. Sorgodoth khan, aru adhikari khan, aru sob takot Tai nichete ahibole lage.

english_text: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, jineka Khrista mangso te dukh paise, etu nisena apuni bhi nijorke eneka bhabona pora taiyar koribi. Kelemane kun manu mangso pora dukh paise tai paap pora bachai loise.

english_text: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, eneka manu jinda thaka homoi te, manu laga itcha pora jinda nathake, kintu Isor laga ki itcha ase, etu te he jinda thake.

english_text: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni laga pura homoi to Porjati khan pora ki kori thakise eneka he korise, duniya laga khushi kori kene thakise, nisa hoi kene beraise, nisa pora khushi korise, duniya laga rong tamasha te thakise aru sob biya letera kaam kori kene thakise.

english_text: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, taikhan bhabise kele apuni taikhan logote biya kaam te mila nai, etu nimite he taikhan apuni laga biya kotha koi thake.
