english_text: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
nagamese_text: Taikhan ki kotha aru kaam korise etu laga sob hisab dibole lagibo jitia Tai mora aru jinda khan laga bisar kori bole nimite homoi ahibo.

english_text: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Isor laga susamachar ke mora khan logote bhi prochar kori dise, kelemane, taikhan ke manu laga gaw mangso hisab te bisar korise koile bhi, taikhan atma te jinda thakibo jineka Isor ase.

english_text: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu sob laga ses homoi ahi ase. Etu nimite nijor laga bhabona sapha rakhibi, aru kineka prathana kori ase etu nisena nijor laga sob kaam khan sidha rakhibi.

english_text: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
nagamese_text: Aru etu sob kotha te, nijor laga bhai kokai logote morom pora thakibi, kelemane morom pora he sob paap to bondh kori diye.

english_text: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
nagamese_text: Aru kunba manu apuni logote modot mangi kene ahile taike eku biya nokoi kene bhal pora sabi.

english_text: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
nagamese_text: Kelemane sob manu bhi asirbad paikene ase, ekjon-ekjon ke modot kori bole nimite etu chola bhi, aru Isor laga morom thaka nisena sob kaam te biswas pora koribi.

english_text: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu kotha kore, tai laga kotha to Isor laga kotha he hobole dibi. Jodi kunba sewa kore, Isor pora diya takot te he kori bole dibi. Eitu khan koribi aru etu sob kaam te Jisu Khrista dwara Isor laga mohima hobo. Jisu Khrista laga naam te mohima aru takot hodai nimite hobole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
nagamese_text: Morom bhai khan, jui te apuni khan ke porikha kora to kiba ekta alag kaam apuni logote hoi thaka nisena apuni khan etu dikhi kene alag bhabona nokoribi.

english_text: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
nagamese_text: Kintu, apuni khan kiman Khrista laga dukh te bhag lobo pare, bisi khushi koribi, kelemane eneka korile apuni khan Tai prokahit howa te Tai laga mohima saikene anondo hobo.

english_text: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
nagamese_text: Jodi apuni ke Khrista laga naam karone sorom khilai diye, apuni asirbad ase, kelemane mohima laga Atma aru Isor laga Atma apuni uporte thaki ase.

english_text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni khan kun bhi manu morai diya, chor, paap kaam kori thaka, aru manu laga majote kotha hali diya manu kori kene dukh napabi.

english_text: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi kunba Khristan hoi kene dukh pai, taike sorom pabo nadibi; hoile bhi, Isor laga naam loi kene Taike mohima koribo dibi.

english_text: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga ghor pora he bisar shuru kori bole laga homoi ahise. Jodi etu amikhan logot pora shuru hoi, tinehoile Isor laga susamachar namani kene thaka khan nimite kineka hobo?

english_text: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
nagamese_text: Aru “Jodi dharmik manu khan bachibole tan ase koile, Paapi manu aru Isor ke bhoi nakora manu logote ki hobo?”

english_text: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite kun Isor laga itcha te thaki kene dukh pai ase, taikhan nijor laga atma to Sristi-Korta ke he di ase.

english_text: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, moi pora bisi umor thaka cholawta khan mon dangor koridi ase, moi, bhi ekjon bura aru Khrista laga dukh te bhag luwa ekjon gawahi ase, aru moi bhi Taike prokahit kori diya homoi te Tai laga mohima te bhag lobo:

english_text: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
nagamese_text: Isor laga mer khan ke rokhiya koribi - aru apuni eneka kori bole lage nimite nohoi, kintu apuni nijor laga itcha pora koribo nimite, Isor pora apuni ke sewa kori bole nimite diya nisena- nijor labh nimite nohoi kintu nijor laga mon laga itcha pora.

english_text: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
nagamese_text: Kunkhan ke apuni rokhiya kori bole dise, taikhan uporte hukum nachola bhi. Kintu, taikhan ke bhal namuna he dikhai dibi.

english_text: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
nagamese_text: Aru jitia Mukhyo Mer Rokhiya ke prokahit kori dibo, titia apuni kitia bhi biya nohua mohima laga mukut pabo.

english_text: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
nagamese_text: Etu nisena, jawan manu khan, apuni khan pora dangor umor thaka manu khan laga kotha mani kene thakibi. Apuni khan sob morom laga kapra pora nijorke lagai lobi aru ekjon-ekjon laga sewa koribi. Kelemane Isor to phutani kora manu ke bhal napai, kintu kun nomro kore taikhan ke anugrah diye.

english_text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
nagamese_text: Etu nimite Isor laga hokti thaka hath nichete nijorke chutu kori lobi, etu pora apuni ke Tai thik homoi te uthaikene rakhidibo.

english_text: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
nagamese_text: Apuni laga sob dukh chinta Isor uporte di dibi, kelemane Tai he apuni nimite chinta kore.

english_text: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
nagamese_text: Shanti rakhibi, aru sai thakibi. Apuni laga dushman bhoot to ekta hala kori thaka bagh nisena rukhi ase, kunba ke khabole bisari ase.

english_text: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
nagamese_text: Tai bhirodh te khara hoi jabi. Apuni laga biswas to takot kori lobi. Apuni jani ase dusra biswasi khan bhi eneka he dukh pai ase.

english_text: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni khan olop din dukh pa pichete, sob asirbad diya laga Isor kun pora apnike Tai laga anondo jibon aru Khrista logote thaki bole nimite matise, sob bhal kori dibo, apuni ke bonai lobo, aru apnike takot dibo.

english_text: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Etu sob adhikar Isor laga hodai aru hodai nimite hobole dibi. Amen.

english_text: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
nagamese_text: Moi Silvanus ekjon biswas te thaka bhai ase koi kene mane, aru moi apuni khan nimite bhal kori kene bujhi bole likhi dise. Moi apuni khan laga mon dangor koridi ase aru moi apuni khan logote ki likhise etu he Isor laga hosa asirbad ase. Aru apuni khan etu te he khara kori bhi.

english_text: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
nagamese_text: Apuni khan logot basi kene thaka mahila jun Babylon te thake, tai bhi apuni khan ke salam di ase. Aru Mark, moi laga chokra pora apuni khan ke salam di ase.

english_text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
nagamese_text: Ekjon-ekjon ke morom laga chuma pora salam dibi. Khrista logote kun ase taikhan logote hodai shanti thaki bole dibi.

english_text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
nagamese_text: Simon Peter, ekjon noukar aru Jisu Khrista laga apostle pora, taikhan ke, jun khan bhi amikhan nisena eke biswas paise, Isor aru Tran-Korta Jisu Khrista laga dharmikta dwara.

english_text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
nagamese_text: Asirbad aru shanti apuni khan logote bisi hobole dibi Probhu Jisu aru Isor laga gyaan pora.

english_text: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
nagamese_text: Kelemane Tai laga mohan takot aru jibon laga bhal kaam khan amikhan ke dise aru etu sob Isor laga gyaan pora he hoise. Tai laga mohima aru asirbad pora amikhan ke mati loise.

english_text: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
nagamese_text: Etu dwara, Tai amikhan ke daami aru dangor kosom dise, etu nimite eitu khan saikene amikhan bhi Isor laga shakti te bhag lobo, aru etu prithibi laga biya kaam ki ase, etu pora polaikene thakibo.

english_text: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan nimite, apuni laga biswas te sob bhal kaam to he anibole bisari bhi; aru bhal kaam te gyaan bhi milai kene chola bhi;

english_text: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
nagamese_text: gyaan pora nijorke thik pora rakhibi; aru biya kaam pora thik rakhibole nimite nomro hoi kene thakibi; aru nomro hoi kene bhal rasta te jabi;

english_text: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
nagamese_text: bhal kaam kori kene nijor bhai ke bhi morom koribi; aru bhai khan ke morom koribi.

english_text: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Jodi eitu khan apuni laga bhitor te thake, apuni Probhu Jisu Khrista laga gyaan te kitia bhi khali nathakibo.

english_text: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun logote eitu khan nai, tai andha nisena he ase, tai suku komjur thaka nisena ase, tai pahori jaise tai laga poila paap kaam kori kene thaka sob to maph kori dise koi kene.

english_text: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan, apnike ki nimite matise aru basi loise, etu bhal pora sai lobi, jodi apuni khan etu kore, apuni kitia bhi nagiribo.

english_text: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Etu pora apuni laga jibon bachai diya Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anonto rajyote dhun pora bhorta hoi kene jabole paribo.

english_text: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
nagamese_text: Etu karone moi apuni khan ke etu kotha khan kobole nimite hodai taiyar thakibo, apuni khan etu janile bhi, aru etiya thaka nisena biswas te thakile bhi.

english_text: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke etu koi diya to bhal ase, moi jiman din tak etu jagate thakibo, etu kotha khan koi kene apuni ke bhabona kori bole dibo.

english_text: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi jani ase bisi joldi moi etu jaga to chari bo lagibo, moike Probhu Jisu Khrista pora eitu khan sob to dikhai dise.

english_text: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi naja age te apuni khan sob monte etu kotha khan rakhi thaki bole nimite.

english_text: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
nagamese_text: Kelemane amikhan chalak pora etu kotha khan kowa nai jitia amikhan pora apuni khan ke Probhu Jisu Khrista aru ahibole laga kotha janibole dise, kintu amikhan Tai laga mohan kaam kori diya laga gawah ase.

english_text: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane Tai Baba Isor pora sonman aru mohima paise jitia Tai logote ekta awaj ahi kene mohima pora koise, “Etu Moi laga morom chokra ase, Tai uporte Moi bisi khushi ase.”

english_text: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
nagamese_text: Moi khan nijor hunise etu awaj sorgo pora ahi thaka jitia amikhan Tai logote etu pobitro pahar te thakise.

english_text: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu Isor laga kotha amikhan nimite aru bhi bhal bonai dise, aru apuni khan etu kotha te mon dile apuni nimite bhal hoi thakibo, jitia tak rati khotom nohoi kene aru phojur laga tara apnikhan laga monte naulai.

english_text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
nagamese_text: Etu sob pora bhi upor, apuni khan janibole lage Isor laga pobitro kotha to kunba manu laga nijor itcha pora nokoi.

english_text: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga kotha khan manu laga itcha pora ana nai, kintu Isor he manu khan ke koise jitia taikhan Pobitro Atma pora bhorta thakise.

english_text: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
nagamese_text: Kintu misa bhabobadi khan bhi manu khan logote ahise, aru etu misa laga hikhok khan apuni logote bhi ahibo. Taikhan lukai kene biya kaam khan anibo, aru hosa malik ke mana koribo kun pora taikhan ke anise. Taikhan nijor uporte bhi dukh khan ani ase.

english_text: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
nagamese_text: Bisi manu taikhan laga biya kaam laga piche koribo, aru etu pora hosa laga kotha khan ke misa bonai dibo.

english_text: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga nijor labh nimite misa kotha koi kene thogai dibo. Bisi din pora taikhan uporte bodnam to alchi pora thaka nohoi, aru taikhan nuksan hobole to ghumai ja nohoi.

english_text: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
nagamese_text: Kelemane kun sorgodoth Tai laga kotha mana nai taikhan ke bhi chara nai. Kintu taikhan ke Tartarus laga nichete phelai dise aru loha pora andhera jagate bandhi dise jitia tak bisar laga din nahibo.

english_text: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
nagamese_text: Aru, Tai poila laga duniya ke bhi chara nai. Kintu, Tai Noah ke basi kene rakhise, jun dharmik manu thakise, aru tai logote sath jon thakise, jitia Isor pora biswas nakora manu khan uporte dangor ban-pani anise.

english_text: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
nagamese_text: Isor pora Sodom aru Gomorrah laga desh to jui pora jolai kene khotom kori dise, aru adharmik manu khan logote bhi eneka he hobo koi kene ekta namuna dikhai dise.

english_text: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai dharmik Lot ke bachai loise, kunke niyom nathaka manu laga biya kaam aru bhabona pora dukh disele.

english_text: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
nagamese_text: Aru dharmik khan, kun taikhan majote bisi din pora thaki ase, aru taikhan laga biya kaam khan huni kene aru dikhi kene tai laga dharmik atma te dukh pai thakise.

english_text: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
nagamese_text: Probhu jane bhal manu khan ke kineka kori kene dukh pora ulai anibo, aru biswas nakora manu khan ke bisar kora laga dinte ki saja dibo.

english_text: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan sob to hosa ase jun khan biya kaam kori thake aru taikhan mangso laga itcha thaka karone Isor laga adhikar to noloi. Taikhan laga mon dangor howa pora aru nijor itcha te thaka pora, taikhan mohima te thaka Isor laga biya kotha kobole nimite bhoi nakore.

english_text: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
nagamese_text: Kintu mohan sorgodoth khan, kun logote takot ase, taikhan uporte sorom khilai diya laga bisar Probhu logote na ane.

english_text: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
nagamese_text: Kintu eitu khan, buddhi nathaka janwar khan nisena ase, taikhan to dhori kene khotom kori dibole nimite he jonom hoise. Aru, taikhan ki nabuje etu ke he sorom khilai ase. Taikhan laga biya he taikhan ke khotom kori dibo.

english_text: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;
nagamese_text: Taikhan ki biya kaam korise etu laga inam pabo. Taikhan bhabe dinte ki moja kora to he bhal ase. Taikhan misa kowa aru dagi thaka manu ase. Apnikhan logot kha-luwa kora homoi te, dusra khan ke thogai diya kaam kori bole khushi pai.

english_text: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
nagamese_text: Taikhan suku ase hoile bhi biya pora bhorta hoi kene ase, aru taikhan kiman paap kori thakile bhi etu pora bhorta nohoi. Atma komjur thaka khan ke biya kaam kori bole nimite mate, aru taikhan laga mon to biya kaam kori bole nimite he sikhai diye. Taikhan shrap thaka bacha khan ase!

english_text: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;
nagamese_text: Taikhan bhal rasta to chari kene Balaam Beor laga chokra laga pichete jaise, kun adharmik laga labh to lobole bhal pai.

english_text: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
nagamese_text: Kintu tai nijor laga paap pora saja paise- kotha kori bole napara ekta gadha pora manu laga awaj te kotha kori kene dimag thik nathaka ekjon bhabobadi ke rukhai diya nisena ase.

english_text: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
nagamese_text: Etu manu khan pani nathaka laga khali jhorna nisena he ase aru jitia dangor hawa ahe dhuwa ke urai kene loija manu khan nisena he ase. Aru dukh laga andhera pora taikhan ke bandhi loi.

english_text: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan motlob nathaka laga kotha kore. Taikhan gaw mangso laga itcha pora manu khan ke mate. Taikhan kun manu biya aru dukh pora polabole mon kore taikhan ke prithibi laga itcha khan dikhai kene mate.

english_text: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
nagamese_text: Taikhan kosom dise taikhan ke biya pora ajad kori bole nimite, kintu taikhan nijor bhi biya kaam laga noukar khan ase. Ki pora manu khan ke bachai lobole parise, etu te tai paap laga noukar hoi jaise.

english_text: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
nagamese_text: Jodi taikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga gyaan pora etu prithibi laga biya kaam khan pora polai jabole pare, kintu aru bhi etu laga paap te phasi kene giri jai, taikhan poila te ki dukh paise, etu pora bhi bisi biya hobo.

english_text: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan pobitro niyom laga kotha khan jana pichete he namani kene thaka pora to, taikhan nimite to dharmik laga rasta najani kene thaka to he bhal thakise.

english_text: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
nagamese_text: Etu hosa kotha to taikhan logote hoise: “Ekta kutta nijor laga ulti khai, aru dhulai kene rakha gahori to aru bhi buka te wapas jai kene letera hoijai.”

english_text: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, etu ami laga dusra chithi apuni khan ke likhi ase; aru etu duita te bhi apuni khan laga bhal bhabona uthai dibole nimite aru monte rakhibole kotha likhi ase,

english_text: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
nagamese_text: Probhu jun amikhan laga Tran-Korta ase, Tai laga apostle aru pobitro bhabobadi khan ke ki hukum dise aru kotha khan koise apuni khan sob eitu khan monte rakhi kene thakibo nimite.

english_text: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
nagamese_text: Etu poila jani lobi, ses laga dinte misa kowa manu khan ahibo. Taikhan sorom khila bo aru taikhan nijor laga itcha hisab te chuli kene jabo.

english_text: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan kobo, “Tai ahibole kowa laga kosom to kote ase? Etu kotha to rukhi kene amikhan baba laga baba khan bhi mori jaise, sob to eke he ase, etu prithibi bona shuru homoi pora.”

english_text: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan nijor itcha pora etu pahori jaise, poila te sorgo thakise koi kene, aru prithibi to pani pora he bonaise aru pani to Isor laga kotha pora he bonaise,

english_text: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
nagamese_text: aru etu kaam khan pora, age laga duniya to khotom kori dise, dangor ban-pani ahi kene.

english_text: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
nagamese_text: Kintu etiya sorgo aru prithibi ke jui pora Tai laga hukum pora he bachai kene rakhi ase. Taikhan ke Isor najani kene thaka manu aru bisar kora laga din nimite he bachai kene rakhi ase.

english_text: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu ekta kotha apuni khan napahoribo lage, morom bhai khan, Probhu nimite ek din to hajar saal nisena he ase, aru hajar saal to ek din nisena he ase.

english_text: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
nagamese_text: Probhu pora ki kosom dise etu aste pora loi najai, kunba manu bisi aste ase koi thake. Kintu, Tai apuni uporte morom thaka nimite Tai apuni khan kun bhi harai najabo nimite bhabona kore, aru sob manu mon ghurai kene thaki bole nimite itcha ase.

english_text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
nagamese_text: Kintu sabi, Probhu wapas aha laga din to ekjon chor aha nisena hobo, aru titia sorgo khan dangor awaj logote harai jabo aru prithibi laga suna to jui pora goli jabo, aru prithibi aru ta te thaka jiman bhi ase sob bhi bisar laga yogya hobo.

english_text: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob to eneka he khotom hoi jabo, apuni khan kineka nisena manu hobo lage? Pobitro hoi kene aru bhal kaam kori kene,

english_text: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
nagamese_text: Isor wapas aha laga din to mon khuli kene rukhi thakibi. Kelemane sorgo khan bhi jui pora julai kene khotom kori dibo, aru sob saman jui laga gorom pora goli jabo.

english_text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai pora kosom diya nisena, amikhan notun sorgo aru notun prithibi nimite rukhi ase, kun jagate khali dharmik khan he thakibo.

english_text: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, morom laga bhai khan, apuni khan etu sob to rukhi thaka nisena, shanti pora Tai laga usorte dagi nathaki kene aru biya kaam pora dur hoi kene bhal kaam kori thakibi.

english_text: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
nagamese_text: Aru, probhu laga morom aru dhorjo moi laga anonto jibon pabole nimite ase koi kene bhabi bhi, jineka amikhan laga morom laga bhai Paul pora apuni khan ke likhise, gyaan dikene likhi bole diya nisena,

english_text: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
nagamese_text: aru tai laga sob chithi te likha nisena, etu kotha khan taikhan logote koi ase. Kunba kotha khan bujhi bole digdar ase, juntu gyaan nathaka aru biya manu khan pora etu laga motlob ke ulta kori diye, etu nisena taikhan Isor laga pobitro kotha bhi eneka kore, hoilebi taikhan nijor he dukh pabo.

english_text: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, bhai khan, apuni khan etu sob to age pora jani loise, nijorke bhal pora sai lobi aru biya manu khan laga misa kotha khan pora paap laga rasta te najabi aru apuni khan laga biswas to kitia bhi hara bole nadibi.

english_text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
nagamese_text: Kintu Tran-Korta Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugrah aru gyaan te dangor hoi kene thakibi. Sob mohima Tai laga hobole dibi etiya pora loi kene hodai tak. Amen!

english_text: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
nagamese_text: Kuntu shuru pora thakise- juntu moi khan hunise, aru suku pora dikhise, juntu moi khan saise, aru amikhan laga hath pora dhorise, eitu khan sob jibon laga kotha ase.

english_text: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
nagamese_text: Aru, etu jibon amikhan ke janibole dise, aru amikhan etu laga gawahi ase. Moi apuni khan ke anonto jibon laga kotha koi ase, jun to Baba Isor logote ase, aru etu kotha amikhan ke janibole nimite dise.

english_text: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Amikhan ki hunise aru dikhise, etu sob apuni khan ke koidi ase, etu pora amikhan sob mili kene thakibo. Aru, amikhan Baba aru Tai laga Putro, Jisu Khrista logote milikena ase.

english_text: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
nagamese_text: Aru, amikhan to apuni khan nimite etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora apuni khan khushi kori thaka to pura hoi jabo nimite.

english_text: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
nagamese_text: Amikhan etu kotha Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista logot pora hunise aru apuni khan ke koi ase: Isor to puhor ase, aru Tai logote eku andhera nai.

english_text: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan Tai logote milikena ase koi aru andhar laga rasta te berai, titia amikhan misa koi ase aru hosa laga kotha khan mani kene thaka nohoi jai.

english_text: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan ujala te berai jineka Tai ujala te thake, amikhan ekjon-ekjon logote milikena ase, aru Tai laga Putro Jisu laga khun pora amikhan laga sob paap to sapha kori diye.

english_text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan paap nai koi, titia amikhan nijorke thogai ase, aru hosa to moi khan logote nai.

english_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
nagamese_text: Kintu jodi amikhan pora Isor ke amikhan laga paapkhan shikar kore, titia Tai hosa thaka pora amikhan laga paapkhan maph kori dibo aru sob adharmikta pora sapha kori dibo.

english_text: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan paap kora nai koile, amikhan Taike misa bonai di ase, aru Tai laga kotha amikhan logote nai.

english_text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
nagamese_text: Ami laga bacha khan, moi tumikhan ke etu likhi ase tumikhan paap nokorile nimite. Kintu jodi kunba paap kore, amikhan laga Baba Isor logote kotha kori diya ekjon ase, Jisu Khrista, kun dharmik ase.

english_text: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
nagamese_text: Tai amikhan laga paap maph kori diya ekjon ase, aru khali amikhan ekla nimite nohoi, kintu pura duniya nimite.

english_text: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
nagamese_text: Etu pora amikhan Taike jani loise, jodi amikhan Tai laga adesh khan mani kene thake koile.

english_text: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
nagamese_text: Kun manu koi, “Moi Isor ke jane,” kintu kotha mani kene nathake, tai misa kowa manu ase, aru tai logote hosa nai.

english_text: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu Isor laga kotha mane, tai logot te Isor laga morom to sob phale bhal bonai dise. Etu pora amikhan jane amikhan Tai logote ase:

english_text: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
nagamese_text: kun manu tai Isor logote ase koi, Khrista jineka beraise, etu nisena tai bhi bera bole lage.

english_text: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, moi tumikhan ke notun niyom likha nohoi, hoilebi kuntu purana niyom tumikhan logote shuru pora ase, etu he koi ase. Etu purana niyom he tumikhan huni thaka laga kotha ase.

english_text: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
nagamese_text: Hoilebi moi tumikhan nimite notun niyom likhi di ase, juntu niyom Khrista aru tumikhan usorte hosa ase, kelemane andhera to jai ase, aru hosa laga puhor to juli ase.

english_text: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
nagamese_text: Kun manu ujala te ase eneka koi, aru nijor laga bhai bhoini khan ke ghin kore, tai etiya bhi andhera te ase.

english_text: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
nagamese_text: Kun manu tai laga bhai ke morom kore tai ujala te ase aru tai kitia bhi biya rasta te nagiribo.

english_text: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore tai andhera te ase aru andhera te berai ase. Tai kote jai ase tai nijor bhi najane, kelemane andhera pora tai laga suku andha kori dise.

english_text: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, morom laga bacha khan, kelemane Khrista laga naam pora tumikhan laga paap maph paise.

english_text: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
nagamese_text: Moi apuni khan ke likhi ase, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane utu ekjon kun ase, jun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan nimite likhi ase, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan biya ekjon logote jiti loise.

english_text: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke likhi dise, chutu bacha khan, kelemane tumikhan Baba Isor ke jane. Moi etu apuni khan ke likhise, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane etu ekjon ke kun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan ke likhise, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan takot ase, aru Isor laga kotha tumikhan logote ase, aru tumikhan biya uporte jiti loise.

english_text: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
nagamese_text: Etu duniya ke morom nokoribi aru etu duniya te thaka jinis khan ke morom nokoribi. Jodi kunba manu etu duniya ke morom kore, titia tai logote Baba Isor laga morom nai.

english_text: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
nagamese_text: Kelemane ki to etu duniya te ase- mangso laga itcha, aru suku laga itcha, aru jibon laga phutani- etu Baba pora nohoi kintu etu duniya laga ase.

english_text: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
nagamese_text: Etu duniya aru tai laga itcha khan khotom hoi ase. Kintu kun manu Isor laga itcha pora thake tai hodai thakibo.

english_text: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
nagamese_text: Chutu bacha khan, etu hekh laga homoi ase. Tumikhan Khrista bhirodhi ahi ase koi kene hunise, aru etiya to bisi Khrista bhirodhi jon ahi jaise. Etu pora amikhan jane hekh homoi to ahise.

english_text: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
nagamese_text: Khrista ke bhirodh kora khan to amikhan pora ulaikene jaise, kintu taikhan to amikhan pora nohoi. Jodi taikhan to amikhan pora ase koile amikhan logote thaki bole asele. Kintu jitia taikhan ulaikene jaise, etu pora jani loise taikhan kun bhi amikhan pora nohoi.

english_text: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
nagamese_text: Kintu tumikhan Pobitro Ekjon pora asirbad paise, aru tumikhan sob hosa jani ase.

english_text: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan hosa najane koi kene etu likha nai, kintu tumikhan jani ase aru hosa te eku misa nai.

english_text: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
nagamese_text: Kun misa kowa jon ase, tai ekjon, jun pora Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene mana kore? Etu manu Khrista bhirodhi ase, kelemane tai Baba aru Putro ke mana kori ase.

english_text: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Jisu ke mana kore tai laga Baba nai. Kun manu Jisu ke loi, tai logote Baba ase.

english_text: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan to, shuru pora ki kotha hunise etu tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi. Jodi tumikhan shuru pora ki hunise etu monte rakhe koile, tumikhan hodai Putro aru Baba logote thakibo.

english_text: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
nagamese_text: Etu kosom Khrista pora amikhan ke dise- anonto jibon.

english_text: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
nagamese_text: Moi etu kotha tumikhan nimite likhi ase, utu manu karone bhi kun pora tumikhan ke biya rasta te loijabo.

english_text: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
nagamese_text: Aru tumikhan to, ki asirbad tumikhan Khrista pora paise etu tumikhan logote he ase, aru dusra pora tumikhan ke sikhai dibole dorkar nai. Kintu Tai laga asirbad pora ki sikhai dise etu hosa ase aru misa nohoi, aru tumikhan ke sikhai diya nisena, Tai logote thakibi.

english_text: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
nagamese_text: Etiya, bacha khan, Tai logote thakibi, jitia Tai wapas ahibo, moi khan mon dangor koribo aru Tai aha homoi te sorom nakhabo.

english_text: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
nagamese_text: Jodi tumi jane Tai dharmik ase koi kene, titia hoile tumikhan etu bhi jani thakibo kun manu thik kaam kore tai Isor pora jonom hoise.

english_text: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
nagamese_text: Sabi Isor pora kineka morom amikhan ke dise, eneka pora amikhan Isor laga bacha ase kobole nimite, aru hosa pora bhi amikhan to Tai laga bacha khan ase. Etu karone, prithibi pora amikhan ke najane, kelemane taikhan Isor ke najane.

english_text: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan etiya Isor laga bacha khan ase aru amikhan ki hobo etu etiya bhi dikhai diya nai. Amikhan jane jitia Khrista ahibo, amikhan Tai nisena hoi jabo, kelemane Tai kineka ase etu nisena amikhan Taike dikhibo.

english_text: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Khrista uporte asha rakhe, Khrista sapha thaka nisena, etu manu khan bhi nijorke sapha kori loi.

english_text: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
nagamese_text: Kun paap kaam khan kori ase tai niyom khan mani kene thaka manu nohoi, kelemane paap te niyom nai.

english_text: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan jane Khrista ke dikhai diya to paapkhan hatai dibole nimite hoise, aru Tai logote eku paap nai.

english_text: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Khrista logote thake, tai aru paap kaam nakore. Aru kun manu paap kaam kore, tai Isor ke dikha nai, aru Taike janibole para nai.

english_text: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bacha khan, kun pora bhi tumike biya rasta te loi jabole nadibi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai dharmik ase, Khrista dharmik thaka nisena.

english_text: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
nagamese_text: Kun manu paap kaam khan kore tai saitan laga ase, kelemane saitan bhi shuru pora paap kaam kori kene ahise. Etu nimite Isor laga Putro ke dikhai dise, aru Tai pora saitan laga kaam khan khotom kori dibole.

english_text: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai biya kaam kori kene nathake kelemane Isor laga bijon tai logote ase. Tai paap kori kene thaki bole napare kelemane tai Isor pora jonom hoise.

english_text: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
nagamese_text: Etu pora Isor laga bacha khan aru saitan laga bacha khan ke dikhai diye: Kun manu dharmik kaam nakore tai Isor laga nohoi, aru kun manu tai nijor laga bhai ke morom nakore tai bhi Isor laga nohoi.

english_text: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
nagamese_text: Kelemane tumikhan shuru pora etu kotha huni kene ahise, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.

english_text: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Cain nisena nohobole lage, kun biya ekjon pora ahise aru nijor bhai ke morai dise. Ki nimite taike morai dise? Kelemane tai laga kaam khan paap laga kaam khan thakise aru tai laga bhai Abel laga kaam khan dharmik kaam khan thakise.

english_text: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan asurit nalagibi, ami laga bhai khan, jodi tumike etu duniya pora ghin kore.

english_text: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
nagamese_text: Amikhan mora pora ulaikene jibon paise, kelemane moi khan bhai ke morom kore. Kun manu morom te nathake tai mori kene ase.

english_text: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
nagamese_text: Kun manu nijor bhai ke morom nakore tai manu morai diya manu ase. Tumi jane manu morai diya manu ke kitia bhi anonto jibon tai logote thaki bole na paribo.

english_text: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
nagamese_text: Etu pora amikhan morom to jane, kelemane Khrista amikhan nimite Tai laga jibon dise. Amikhan bhi nijor laga bhai khan nimite jibon dibole lage.

english_text: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
nagamese_text: Kintu kun manu logote duniya laga sob saman ase, aru tai laga bhai dukh te thaka dikhile bhi, bhai nimite tai laga mon bondh kori kene rakhe, titia hoile tai logote Isor laga morom kote ase?

english_text: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
nagamese_text: Ami laga morom bacha khan, amikhan khali kotha aru mukh pora morom nokorile, kintu kaam aru hosa pora morom koribo.

english_text: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
nagamese_text: Etu pora amikhan jani loi amikhan hosa te ase, aru amikhan laga mon Isor usorte rakhi diye.

english_text: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan laga mon pora amikhan ke biya ase koi, Isor to amikhan laga mon pora bhi dangor ase, aru Tai sob jinis khan jani ase.

english_text: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi amikhan laga nijor mon pora amikhan ke bodnam nadiye, titia amikhan Isor uporte bharosa ase.

english_text: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
nagamese_text: Amikhan ki mange etu pai jabo, kelemane amikhan Tai laga kotha mani kene thake aru Tai ki khushi pai eitu khan kore.

english_text: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
nagamese_text: Etu Tai laga kotha khan ase: amikhan Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista ke biswas koribo aru ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, Tai pora etu kotha amikhan ke diya nisena.

english_text: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
nagamese_text: Tai laga kotha mani kene thaka manu to Tai logot thake, aru Tai bhi taikhan logote ase. Tai amikhan logote ase koi kene jane Atma dwara jane, junke Tai pora amikhan nimite dise.

english_text: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, sob atma ke biswas nokoribi. Kintu, kuntu atma Isor pora ase etu bhal pora sai lobi, kelemane bisi misa bhabobadi khan prithibi te ulaikene ase.

english_text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
nagamese_text: Etu pora tumikhan Isor laga Atma to janibo- kun manu Jisu Khrista to sharir hoi kene Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar kore,

english_text: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
nagamese_text: aru kun atma pora Jisu to Isor pora ahise koi kene shikar nakore. Etu Khrista bhirodh kora laga atma ase, jun ahibole ase koi kene tumikhan hunise, aru etiya tai prithibi te ahi jaise.

english_text: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan Isor pora ase, morom laga bacha khan, aru taikhan ke jiti loise, kelemane etu ekjon kun tumi logote ase Tai etu duniya te thaka ekjon pora bhi sobse dangor ase.

english_text: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan duniya laga ase; etu nimite taikhan ki koi etu duniya laga he ase, aru duniya laga manu khan taikhan laga kotha he hune.

english_text: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Isor pora ase. Kun manu Isor ke jane amikhan laga kotha hune. Aru kun manu Isor pora nohoi amikhan laga kotha nahune. Etu pora amikhan jane hosa laga atma aru misa laga atma.

english_text: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom koribo, kelemane morom to Isor pora he ahe, aru kun manu morom kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, kelemane Isor to morom ase.

english_text: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
nagamese_text: Kun manu morom kori bole najane tai Isor ke najane, kelemane Isor to morom ase.

english_text: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor laga etu morom amikhan ke dikhai diya nimite, Isor pora Tai laga ekjon morom thaka Putro ke duniya te pathai dise aru etu pora moi khan sob Tai logote jinda hoi jabo.

english_text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
nagamese_text: Etu laga morom to, amikhan pora Isor ke morom kora karone nohoi, kintu Tai pora amikhan ke morom korise, aru Tai amikhan ke Tai laga Putro pathaise amikhan ke paap pora bacha bole nimite.

english_text: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai khan, jodi Isor pora amikhan ke iman morom korise, titia hoile amikhan bhi ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.

english_text: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
nagamese_text: Kun manu bhi Isor ke kitia bhi dikha nai. Jodi amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kore, Isor amikhan logote thake, aru Tai laga morom to amikhan logot bhal bonai diye.

english_text: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
nagamese_text: Etu pora Isor amikhan logote ase koi kene jane, kelemane Tai laga Atma amikhan ke dise.

english_text: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
nagamese_text: Aru, amikhan dikhise aru etu laga gawahi ase Baba pora Tai laga Putro ke etu duniya laga Tran-korta hobole pathaise.

english_text: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
nagamese_text: Kun manu nijor laga mukh pora shikar kore Jisu he Isor laga Putro ase koi kene, Isor tai logote ase aru tai bhi Isor logote ase.

english_text: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
nagamese_text: Aru, Isor pora amikhan ke morom kora to janise aru biswas korise. Isor to morom ase, aru kun manu etu morom te thake tai Isor logote ase, aru Isor bhi tai logote ase.

english_text: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
nagamese_text: Etu nimite, morom to amikhan laga majote bhal bonai dise, etu pora amikhan bisar kora laga dinte bharosa kori kene thakibo, kelemane Khrista thaka nisena, amikhan bhi etu duniya te thaki ase.

english_text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
nagamese_text: Morom te eku bhoi nai. Kintu, hosa morom pora sob bhoi phelai diye, kelemane bhoi to sajai pabole nimite ase. Kintu kun manu bhoi kore, morom to tai logote nai.

english_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
nagamese_text: Amikhan morom kore kelemane Isor pora poila amikhan ke morom korise.

english_text: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu koi, “Moi Isor ke morom kore,” kintu nijor laga bhai ke ghin kore, tai misa koi ase. Kun manu tai laga nijor bhai ke morom nakore, kun tai dikhise, Isor ke kitia bhi morom kori bole na paribo, kunke tai dikha nai.

english_text: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
nagamese_text: Aru, etu he sikhai diya kotha ase kun to amikhan Khrista nimite rakhise, kun manu Isor ke morom kore tai nijor laga bhai ke bhi morom kori bole lage.

english_text: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene biswas kore tai Isor pora jonom loise, aru kun manu Isor ke morom kore, Tai jonom kora bacha ke bhi morom kore.

english_text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
nagamese_text: Etu pora jane amikhan Isor laga bacha khan ke morom kore, jitia amikhan Isor ke morom kore aru Tai laga hukum khan ke mane.

english_text: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
nagamese_text: Kelemane etu he Isor nimite morom ase: amikhan Tai laga hukum khan mani kene thaka to. Tai laga hukum khan bhari nohoi.

english_text: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai duniya ke jiti loise. Etu pora amikhan duniya ke jiti loise, aru amikhan laga biswas bhi.

english_text: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
nagamese_text: Kelemane duniya ke jiti bole para jon to dusra nohoi kintu jun pora Jisu to Isor laga Putro ase koi kene biswas kori loise.

english_text: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
nagamese_text: Etu ekjon ase kun pani aru khun pora ahise: Jisu Khrista. Tai khali pani pora aha nai, kintu pani aru khun pora ahise. Etu Pobitro Atma pora he gawahi dise kelemane Atma to hosa ase.

english_text: For there are three who testify:
nagamese_text: Kelemane ta te tinjon ase kun etu laga gawah ase:

english_text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
nagamese_text: Atma, aru pani, aru khun. Etu tinta eke logote mili kene ase.

english_text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
nagamese_text: Jodi amikhan pora manu khan laga gawahi loi, Isor laga gawahi he etu pora bhi dangor ase. Kelemane Isor laga gawahi to eneka ase, Tai pora he Tai laga Putro laga gawahi dise.

english_text: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Isor laga Putro ke biswas kore, tai nijor laga gawahi ase. Kun manu Isor ke biswas nakore Taike misa bonai dise, kelemane tai Isor pora Tai laga Putro laga gawahi diya to biswas kora nai.

english_text: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
nagamese_text: Etu gawahi ase: Isor amikhan ke anonto jibon dise, aru etu jibon Tai laga Putro Jisu logote ase.

english_text: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
nagamese_text: Kun manu logote Jisu ase tai jibon paise. Kintu kun manu logote Isor laga Putro Jisu nai tai jibon panai.

english_text: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora tumikhan anonto jibon ase koi kene janibo- tumikhan kun Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista laga naam te biswas kore.

english_text: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
nagamese_text: Aru, etu bharosa amikhan Isor logote ase koi kene jane, jodi Tai laga itcha hisab te amikhan mange, Tai amikhan ke hunibo.

english_text: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
nagamese_text: Aru, jodi Isor amikhan ke hune koi kene jane- amikhan Tai logote ki mangibo- Tai logote moi khan ki mangise etu sob paise koi kene jane.

english_text: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
nagamese_text: Jodi kunba manu tai laga bhai ke paap kaam kori thaka dikhe aru etu pora mora nai koile, tai prathana kori bole lage, aru Isor pora taike jibon dibo. Moi eitu khan ke koi ase kun paap kori kene mora to dikha nai. Kunba paap to mora dikhi pai; Moi etu nimite prathana kori bole lage koi kene kowa nai.

english_text: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
nagamese_text: Dharmik nathaka kaam khan sob paap ase, kintu kunba paap karone mora laga sajai nadiye.

english_text: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
nagamese_text: Amikhan jane kun manu Isor pora jonom hoise tai paap nakore. Kintu tai ekjon kun Isor pora jonom hoise taike bachai kene rakhe, aru dusto atma pora taike dukh dibole na paribo.

english_text: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
nagamese_text: Amikhan Isor pora ase koi kene jane, aru amikhan jane pura duniya to ekjon biya thaka laga sakti te ase.

english_text: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
nagamese_text: Kintu amikhan jane Isor laga Putro pora ahi kene amikhan ke gyaan dise, etu pora Tai hosa ase koi kene moi khan janibo. Aru, moi khan Tai logote ase kun hosa ase, Tai laga Putro Jisu Khrista. Etu ekjon hosa Isor aru anonto jibon ase.

english_text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
nagamese_text: Bacha khan, nijorke murti puja kora khan pora bachai kene thakibi.

english_text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
nagamese_text: Bura manu pora basi luwa mahila aru tai laga bacha khan ke likhi ase, kunkhan ke moi hosa te morom kore- aru moi ekla nohoi, kintu sobke kun hosa janise-

english_text: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
nagamese_text: kelemane hosa to amikhan logote thaki ase aru etu hodai nimite amikhan logote thakibo.

english_text: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
nagamese_text: Anugrah, daya, aru shanti Baba Isor aru Jisu Khrista laga asirbad tumikhan logote thakibi, jun Putro laga Baba ase, hosa aru morom te.

english_text: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
nagamese_text: Moi bisi khushi kori ase etu huni kene tumikhan laga kunba bacha khan hosa laga rasta te berai ase, jineka amikhan Baba khan pora amikhan etu hukum to paise.

english_text: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
nagamese_text: Etiya moi tumike anurodh kori ase, mahila- moi tumike notun hukum likhi kene dibole nimite nohoi, kintu shuru pora juntu thakise- amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.

english_text: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
nagamese_text: Etu morom ase, ki amikhan Tai laga hukum hisab te berai kene jabole lage. Etu hukum ase juntu shuru pora tumi hunise juntu laga rasta te tumi bera bole lage.

english_text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
nagamese_text: Kelemane manu khan ke thogai diya duniya te bisi jai kene ase, aru taikhan etu shikar nakore Jisu Khrista sharir hoi kene ahise. Tai thogai diya manu aru Khrista bhirodhi ase.

english_text: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
nagamese_text: Nijorke sai lobi, amikhan ki nimite kaam kori sele tumi etu naharabo karone, kintu etu pora tumi pura iman to pabo.

english_text: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
nagamese_text: Kun manu Jisu Khrista pora ki sikhai dise etu noloikene age jai, titia hoile tai logote Isor nai. Kun manu etu kotha khan mani kene thake, tai logote Baba aru Putro duijon bhi ase.

english_text: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
nagamese_text: Kun manu tumi laga usorte ahe aru eneka nahikai, taike ghor bhitor te namati bhi aru taike salam nadibi.

english_text: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
nagamese_text: Kun taike salam diye, tai laga biya kaam khan te tai bhi bhag loijai.

english_text: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan logote bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kagos te aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan likhi bole mon nai. Hoilebi, moi tumikhan logote ahi kene ekjon-ekjon logote kotha kori bole mon ase, etu pora tumikhan laga khushi aru bhi bisi dangor hobo.

english_text: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
nagamese_text: Tumikhan pora basi luwa bhoini laga bacha khan pora bhi tumike salam di ase.

english_text: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
nagamese_text: Bura manu pora morom thaka Gaius ekjon cholawta ke likhi ase, kunke moi hosa pora morom kore.

english_text: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai, Moi prathana kore tumi logote sob bhal thakibo aru tumi laga gaw bhi bhal thakibo, tumi laga atma bhal kori kene thaka nisena.

english_text: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
nagamese_text: Kelemane moi khushi pai jitia bhai khan ahi kene tumi hosa te berai thaka laga gawahi diye, tumi hosa te berai thaka nisena.

english_text: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
nagamese_text: Moi etu pora aru dangor khushi nai, jitia ami laga bacha khan hosa rasta te berai ase koi kene moi hune.

english_text: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai, tumi biswas pora ki kori ase etu tumi bhai khan nimite aru bahar manu khan nimite kori ase

english_text: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
nagamese_text: kun pora tumikhan laga morom kora laga gawahi girja manu khan laga usorte dise. Isor laga usorte bhal mohima hobole nimite tumi manu ke bhal pora saikene taikhan ke safar kori bole pathai dibi,

english_text: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
nagamese_text: kelemane Isor laga naam nimite taikhan ulaikene jaise, aru Porjati manu khan pora eku luwa nai.

english_text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
nagamese_text: Amikhan bhi taikhan ke mati bole lage, etu pora amikhan bhi hosa te kaam kora sathi hoi jabo.

english_text: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
nagamese_text: Moi manu khan nimite kiba likhise, kintu Diotrephes, kun manu laga age te thaki bole nimite bhal pai, tai amikhan ke swekar nakore.

english_text: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
nagamese_text: Jodi moi ahe, Moi tai ki kaam kori ase etu sabo, amikhan laga bhirodh te biya kotha kori ase. Kintu eneka kori kene bhi khushi panai, tai nijor pora bhi bhai kokai khan ke mati bole mon nai, aru kun manu ke mati bole mon kore taikhan ke rukhai diye aru girja laga bahar te ulai diye.

english_text: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
nagamese_text: Morom laga bhai, biya kaam khan nokoribi kintu ki to bhal kaam ase etu he koribi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai Isor laga ase; aru kun manu biya kaam kore tai Isor ke dikha nai.

english_text: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
nagamese_text: Demetrius ke sob manu pora aru hosa pora tai nijor laga gawahi diye. Kintu amikhan bhi gawahi diye, aru tumikhan jane amikhan laga gawahi to hosa ase.

english_text: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
nagamese_text: Moi tumikhan ke bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kolom aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan tumikhan ke likhi bole mon nai.

english_text: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
nagamese_text: Kintu moi tumikhan ke joldi lok pabole itcha kori ase, titia moi khan ekjon-ekjon logote bohi kene kotha koribo. Tumikhan logote shanti thaki bole dibi. Sathi khan bhi tumikhan ke salam di ase. Naam loi kene ta te thaka sathi khan ke salam di dibi.

english_text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
nagamese_text: Jude, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon noukar, aru moi James laga bhai, pora likhi ase kunkhan ke mati loise, Baba Isor laga morom kora khan, aru Jisu Khrista nimite rakhise:

english_text: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
nagamese_text: Daya aru shanti aru morom apuni khan logote bhorta hoi thaki bole dibo.

english_text: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
nagamese_text: Morom thaka bhai khan, moi khan laga poritran pabole laga kotha apuni khan logote likhi bole kosis korise, aru moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori dibole nimite etu bhi likhi ase pobitro manu khan nimite ki kaam kori bole dise etu biswas aru mon pora dukh uthaikene hoile bhi kori kene thakibi.

english_text: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kelemane apuni khan majot pora kunba manu khan lukai kene biya rasta te jaise, kunkhan ke poila pora letera kaam kori dibole nimite pathaise, etu biya manu khan pora mangso laga itcha loi kene Isor laga morom logot bodli kori dise, aru taikhan Jisu Khrista Probhu aru Malik ase koi kene namane.

english_text: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
nagamese_text: Etiya moi apuni khan ke etu kobole nimite itcha kori ase- apuni khan etu sob jani kene thakile bhi- Jisu pora Egypt desh pora manu khan ke bachai loise, kintu pichete kunkhan Taike biswas kora nai taikhan ke khotom kori dise.

english_text: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgodoth kunkhan nijor laga adhikar diya to bhal pora chola nai, kintu taike diya asol jaga to chari dise- Isor pora taikhan ke kitia bhi khuli bole napara laga loha rusi pora bandhi dise, andhera jagate, jitia tak Isor laga bisar laga din ahi kene napunche.

english_text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
nagamese_text: Sodom aru Gomorrah aru usorte thaka sheher dusra khan ke kora nisena he, taikhan bhi nijorke bebichari laga kaam te nijorke hali se, aru ki to Isor pora kori bole diya nai etu laga biya itcha kaam khan he korise. Taikhan dusra manu khan nimite ekta sakhi hoise kunkhan norok laga anonto jui te dukh paikene jolibo.

english_text: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
nagamese_text: Etu nisena he, sapna dikhi thaka manu khan bhi nijor laga gaw letera kori ase. Kintu taikhan Isor laga adhikar ke mana nai, aru taikhan mohima te thaka khan uporte biya kotha khan kori thake.

english_text: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
nagamese_text: Kintu prodhan sorgodoth Michael bhi, jitia tai bhoot logote lorai kori thakise aru Moses laga morija gaw nimite kotha namili kene thakise, tai uporte ekdom biya laga bisar ani diya nai. Kintu tai koise, “Probhu he tumike gali dibi!”

english_text: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
nagamese_text: Kintu etu manu khan pora taikhan bujibo napara khan laga biya kotha koi kene berai thake, aru taikhan nijor laga ki bhabona pora eneka kore, ekta bhal-biya janibo napara janwar nisena, etu pora he taikhan ke khotom kori diye.

english_text: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
nagamese_text: Hai ase taikhan ke! Kelemane taikhan Cain laga rasta te beraise aru Balaam pora galti kora nisena, kiba labh pabole nimite bisarise. Taikhan Korah pora kotha namani kene thaka logote nijorke harai dise.

english_text: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
nagamese_text: Eitu khan to hoile apuni khan morom laga kha luwa jagate lukai kene thaka ta te ulai thaka jongol nisena ase, aru apuni khan logote sorom nathaki kene eke logote kha luwa kore- taikhan mer rukha manu khan ase kun nijor he khilai. Taikhan pani nathaka badal nisena he ase, aru hawa pora loijai. Taikhan sukha mohina laga ghas te phul ulabole napara nisena he ase- duibar morise, aru jor pora ulaikene phelai dise.

english_text: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
nagamese_text: Taikhan samundar te biya hawa jai thaka nisena ase, taikhan nijor laga sorom to ulaikene dikhai ase. Taikhan eku asha nathakikena berai thaka tara nisena he ase, aru tai nimite dukh laga andhera to hodai nimite rakhidise.

english_text: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
nagamese_text: Kintu Enoch bhi, jun Adam laga piche aha ekjon ase, taikhan nimite eneka bhabobani korise, aru koise, “Sabi! Probhu Tai laga hajar-hajar pobitro khan pora thaka khan ke loi kene ani ase.

english_text: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
nagamese_text: Tai sob uporte bisar kori bole nimite ahi ase. Kunkhan Isor pora bhal napa laga sob kisim laga beya kaam kori kene thaki ase, aru kiman paapi manu jun Isor ke bhoi nakori kene tai laga uporte bisi biya kotha koise, eitu khan sob laga uporte bisar kori bole nimite Isor ahi ase.”

english_text: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
nagamese_text: Taikhan dusra logote khushi pora nathaka manu, hodai manu laga biya kotha koi thaka manu, nijor laga biya itcha te berai thaka manu khan ase. Taikhan laga mukh pora phutani laga kotha ulai thake, kun, nijor laga labh nimite dusra manu ke phusla laga kotha kori kene berai thake.

english_text: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nagamese_text: Kintu apuni, morom laga bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle khan pora age te ki koi dise eitu khan sob yaad koribi.

english_text: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan pora apnikhan ke koise, “Duniya khotom hobole thaka homoi te misa kowa manu khan ulabo aru taikhan nijor laga biya itcha pichete he jabo.”

english_text: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan nimite he sob bhag hoi kene alag hoijai ase; taikhan duniya laga ase aru taikhan logote Isor laga Atma nai.

english_text: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
nagamese_text: Kintu apnikhan, morom laga bhai khan, dangor pobitro biswas pora apnikhan nijorke bonai lobi, aru Pobitro Atma pora prathana koribi.

english_text: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
nagamese_text: Apnikhan nijorke Isor laga morom te rakhibi, aru Jisu Khrista laga anonto jibon aru daya nimite rukhi thakibi.

english_text: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
nagamese_text: Kun manu biswas nakori kene thaki ase tai uporte bhi daya koribi.

english_text: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
nagamese_text: Kintu dusra manu khan ke jui pora ulaikene bachai lobi. Isor ke bhoi koribi aru dusra khan uporte daya koribi. Aru mangso laga itcha pora letera kora kapra ke ghin koribi.

english_text: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
nagamese_text: Etiya ekjon jun apnikhan ke giribole thaka pora bachai kene rakhe aru Tai laga mohima usorte eku golti aru letera nathaki kene khushi pora khara kori bole diye,

english_text: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
nagamese_text: amikhan laga Isor aru Tran-korta Probhu Jisu Khrista ke, mohima hobole dibi, Tai laga mohanta, aru sob uporte raj kori bole dibi, aru takot, sob homoi te, etiya aru hodai tak thaki bole dibo. Amen.

english_text: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
nagamese_text: Etu kotha to Jisu Khrista laga prokahit kori diya kotha khan ase jun Isor pora tai laga noukar khan ke dise, ki joldi pura hobole ase etu jonai dibole. Etu kotha khan to sorgodoth pora Tai laga sewak John ke pathai kene janibole dise.

english_text: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
nagamese_text: John pora Isor laga kotha aru gawahi dise aru Jisu Khrista ki kaam korise etu laga gawahi bhi dise, juntu khan sob tai dikhise.

english_text: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
nagamese_text: Asirbad ase jun etu kotha untcha awaj te purey aru kun etu kotha laga bhabobani hune aru ki likha ase etu mani loi, kelemane ahibole thaka homoi to usor ahi ase.

english_text: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
nagamese_text: John, Asia te sat-ta girja thaka khan ke koi ase: Isor laga anugrah aru shanti apuni khan logote thaki bole dibi, Jun ase, Jun thakise, aru Jun ahibole ase, aru sat-ta atma jun Tai laga singhason usorte ase,

english_text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—
nagamese_text: aru Jisu Khrista pora, ekjon biswas te thaka gawahi, mora pora prothom ekjon jonom luwa, aru duniya laga raja khan ke cholai kene thaka aru ekjon kun amikhan ke morom kore aru Tai laga khun pora amikhan laga sob paap to maph kori dise -
