english_text: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
nagamese_text: Titia moi saise aru Zion Pahar te Mer bacha khara kori thaka dikhise. Tai logote 144,000 thakise aru Tai laga Baba laga naam taikhan laga matha age te likhi kene thakise.

english_text: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
nagamese_text: Aru sorgo pora ekta awaj, juntu bisi pani laga awaj nisena aru dangor pani ahibole awaj ahi thaka nisena moi hunise. Aru moi huna to hoile baja bajai thaka khan pora taikhan laga bajana te awaj ulai diya nisena hunise.

english_text: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan cholawta aru charta jinda thaka janwar aru singhason usorte notun gana gai thakise. Kun pora bhi etu gana kori bole najane, khali 144,000 jun khan ke prithibi pora kini kene anise, taikhan he etu gana kori bole pare.

english_text: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan mahila khan logote nijorke paap kaam kori kene aha manu khan nohoi, taikhan ekdom sapha ase. Aru taikhan kun jagate Mer bacha jai, Tai laga piche jai thaka khan ase. Taikhan ke manu laga majot pora daam tirai kene loi ana ase, Isor laga poila bacha khan aru Mer bacha nimite.

english_text: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga mukh te eku misa kotha panai, kelemane taikhan ekdom sapha ase.

english_text: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
nagamese_text: Titia moi aru ekjon sorgodoth ke hawa te uri thaka dikhise, aru tai logote prithibi manu khan nimite kitia bhi khotom nakora susamachar thakise- sob desh, jati, bhasha, aru manu khan nimite.

english_text: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”
nagamese_text: Tai dangor awaj pora matise, “Isor ke bhoi koribi aru Taike Mohima dibi. Kelemane bisar kora laga homoi ahise. Kun pora sorgo aru prithibi, samundar aru sapha pani bonaise.”

english_text: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
nagamese_text: Aru ekjon sorgodoth pora etu sorgodoth pichete ahise, aru koise, “Girise, dangor Babylon to girise, kun he sob desh khan ke tai laga bebichari draikha ros to khabole dise.”

english_text: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
nagamese_text: Aru dusra sorgodoth taikhan laga piche korise, aru dangor awaj pora koise, “Kunba manu etu janwar aru tai laga murti ke puja korile, aru jodi tai laga chihna matha aru dyna hathte loile,

english_text: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
nagamese_text: tai bhi Isor laga khong to dikhibo, etu ros Tai laga khong laga kup te ki logote bhi namilai kene hali dise. Taike Mer bacha aru Tai laga pobitro sorgodoth usorte kitia bhi khotom nakora laga jui te phelai kene dukh dibo.

english_text: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
nagamese_text: Aru taikhan laga dukh pa laga dhuwa uporte hodai nimite jabo aru taikhan din aru rati aram napabo- etu janwar aru tai laga murti ke puja kora manu khan, aru kun manu etu laga naam laga chihna to loi.

english_text: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”
nagamese_text: Yate dikhibo pare pobitro khan pora dukh kosto aru nomro kori kene thaka, kun manu Isor laga kotha mane aru Jisu uporte biswas kori kene thake.”

english_text: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
nagamese_text: Titia moi sorgo pora ekta awaj koi thaka hunise, “Etu likhibi: Asirbad ase etu mora manu khan kun etiya pora Probhu nimite mori bole ase.” “Hoi,” Pobitro Atma pora koi ase, “Taikhan laga dukh pora aram pabo, kelemane taikhan ki kaam korise etu taikhan laga pichete ahibo.”

english_text: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
nagamese_text: Titia moi saise aru ta te ekta boga badal thakise. Badal te bohi thaka ekjon manu laga bacha nisena thakise. Tai laga hathte ekta dhar hashua hathiar thakise aru Tai laga matha te suna laga mukut thakise.

english_text: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
nagamese_text: Titia dusra sorgodoth mondoli pora ulai ahikena badal te bohi thaka ke dangor awaj pora koise: “Tumi laga hashua lobi aru kati bole shuru koribi, kelemane kata laga homoi ahise, prithibi laga dhaan to pakki jaise.”

english_text: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
nagamese_text: Titia badal te bohi thaka pora tai laga hashua-hathiar ulaikene prithibi te cholai se, aru titia prithibi laga kata homoi pura hoise.

english_text: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
nagamese_text: Titia aru ekjon sorgodoth sorgo laga mondoli pora ulaikene ahise, tai logote bhi dhar thaka hashua hathiar thakise.

english_text: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
nagamese_text: Aru dusra ekjon sorgodoth juli thaka puja laga bedi pora ulaikene ahise aru tai logote jui laga adhikar thakise. Tai dangor awaj pora kun laga hathte dhar hashua hathiar ase taike matise, aru koise, “Tumi laga dhar hashua hathiar lobi aru prithibi pora angur khan joma koribi, kelemane taikhan laga angur khan sob pakkise.”

english_text: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
nagamese_text: Titia etu sorgodoth tai laga hashua hathiar loi kene prithibi te kiman angur pakki kene ase eitu khan ke uthaise. Tai angur joma kori kene angur mihin kora jagate Isor laga khong nimite phelai dise.

english_text: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
nagamese_text: Titia, Jerusalem sheher laga bahar te angur mihin kora laga khuri hali kene thakise, aru etu khuri pora khun ulai thakise aru etu pora khun ula to ghora laga matha tak ponchise 1,600 tak.

english_text: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete aru bhi asurit chihna sorgote dikhise: sat-ta sorgodoth sat-ta dukh loi kene- hekh laga dukh digdar khan, etu pora Isor laga khong pura hoi jabo.

english_text: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
nagamese_text: Titia moi dikhise shisa laga samundar jui te milai kene kun manu etu janwar aru murti ke jiti loise, aru tai laga naam laga ginti uporte jiti loise, taikhan etu shisa laga samundar te khara hoi thakise, Isor pora diya bajana khan loi kene khara hoi thakise.

english_text: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
nagamese_text: Taikhan Moses laga gana gai thakise, Isor laga noukar aru Mer bacha laga gana gai thakise, “Dangor aru asurit ase Apuni laga kaam Probhu Isor, sobse Mohan. Apuni laga rasta bhal aru hosa ase, Oh dharmik manu laga raja.

english_text: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
nagamese_text: Kun manu apnike bhoi nokoribi, Probhu, aru Apuni laga naam ke mohima nadibo? Kelemane Apuni pobitro ase. Sob desh khan ahibo Aru Apuni usorte mohima koribo Kelemane Apuni laga bhal kaam khan sob dikhai dise.”

english_text: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
nagamese_text: Etu sob huwa pichete moi saise, aru mondoli te gawah khan laga tambu sorgote khuli jaise.

english_text: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
nagamese_text: Aru mondoli bahar te ulai ahi kene sat-ta sorgodoth sat-ta dukh digdar khan dhori kene thakise. Taikhan laga kapra sapha thakise, mihin kapra aru taikhan laga chati te suna pora bonai kene thaka huru kapra khan lagai kene thakise.

english_text: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
nagamese_text: Charta janwar majot pora ekjon he sat-ta sorgodoth khan ke sat-ta bati Isor laga khong pora bhorta thaka, taikhan ke dise, Tai jun hodai aru hodai nimite jinda ase.

english_text: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
nagamese_text: Titia Isor laga Mohima aru takot pora mondoli to dhuwa pora bhorta hoi jaise. Kun bhi ta te jabole napare jitia tak sat-ta dukh sat-ta sorgodoth khan pora pura nakore.

english_text: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”
nagamese_text: Titia moi hunise ekta dangor awaj mondoli pora sat-ta sorgodoth khan ke koi thaka, “Jabi aru sat-ta bati pora Isor laga khong to prithibi te hali dibi.”

english_text: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
nagamese_text: Titia poila sorgodoth jai kene tai laga bati pora prithibi te hali dise. Titia biya aru bikhai thaka ghaw kun manu khan janwar laga chihna loi kene thakise taikhan uporte ahise aru kun manu etu murti ke puja kori thakise taikhan uporte ahise.

english_text: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
nagamese_text: Aru dusra sorgodoth pora tai laga bati pora samundar te hali dise. Etu khun hoi jaise, ekta mora manu laga khun nisena, aru kiman jinda saman samundar te thakise sob mori jaise.

english_text: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
nagamese_text: Titia tisra sorgodoth tai laga bati sapha pani aru nodi te hali dise aru etu khun hoi jaise.

english_text: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.
nagamese_text: Aru pani laga duth pora koi thaka moi hunise, “Apuni dharmik ase-Ekjon kun ase aru kun thakise, Pobitro ekjon- Kelemane Apuni etu sob bisar korise.

english_text: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
nagamese_text: Kelemane taikhan pobitro khan aru bhabobadi khan laga khun hali dise, Apuni taikhan ke khun khabole nimite dise; Taikhan etu pabole nimite yogya ase.”

english_text: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
nagamese_text: Titia moi bedi pora koi thaka hunise, “Hoi, Mohan Probhu Isor, Apuni laga bisar dharmik ase.”

english_text: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
nagamese_text: Titia choutha sorgodoth tai laga bati suryo te hali dise, aru manu khan ke jui pora jolai dibole nimite koise.

english_text: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.
nagamese_text: Etu pora manu kobo napara gorom pora julise, aru taikhan Isor laga naam ke hinsa koise, kun sob dukh digdar uporte adhikar ase. Taikhan mon ghura nai aru Taike aradhana kora nai.

english_text: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
nagamese_text: Titia pansta sorgodoth pora tai laga bati loi kene janwar laga singhason te hali dise, aru etu para tai laga rajyo andhar hoi jaise. Taikhan bikhai kene nijor laga jiba kamuribole shuru hoise.

english_text: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.
nagamese_text: Etu pora taikhan sorgote thaka Isor ke biya koise, taikhan bikhai thaka aru ghawkhan nimite, kintu eneka korile bhi taikhan laga biya kaam pora mon ghura nai.

english_text: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
nagamese_text: Titia choi-ta ula sorgodoth pora tai laga bati dangor nodi te hali dise, juntu Euphrates ase. Etu laga pani sukhi jaise, purab pora ahibole taiyar kori thaka raja khan nimite.

english_text: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
nagamese_text: Titia moi tinta dusto atma khan ke dikhise, bengh khan ajgar janwar laga mukh pora bahar te ulai thaka nisena, aru janwar laga mukh pora ulaise, aru misa bhabobadi khan laga mukh pora ulai thaka dikhise.

english_text: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
nagamese_text: Taikhan dusto atma khan thakise kunkhan asurit chihna dikhai thakise. Mohan Isor laga dangor dinte lorai kori bole nimite duniya laga raja khan ke joma kori thakise.

english_text: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
nagamese_text: -“Sabi! Moi kun pora bhi najana homoi te, chor nisina, achanak ahibo! Asirbad ase etu manu kun tai laga kapra lagai kene sai ase aru rukhi ase, kelemane taikhan kapra nalagai kene berai nathakibo aru taikhan laga sorom khan to nadikhibo.”-

english_text: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.
nagamese_text: Titia taikhan sobke eke logote anise ekta jaga juntu laga naam Ibrani bhasa te Armaggedon koi.

english_text: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
nagamese_text: Titia sat-ta ula sorgodoth tai laga bati hawa te hali dise. Titia mondoli laga bahar pora dangor ekta awaj ulaise, aru singhason pora koise, “Etu sob hoise!”

english_text: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
nagamese_text: Titia ta te bhijili laga ujala marise, awaj dise, aru bhijili korise, aru dangor mati hili se- jineka kitia bhi huwa nai jun to din pora manu ke prithibi te bonaise, etu mati hila iman dangor thakise, ekdom dangor thakise.

english_text: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
nagamese_text: Dangor sheher tinta bhag hoi jaise, aru desh laga sheher khan khotom hoi jaise. Titia Isor usorte mohan Babylon ke yaad korise, aru Tai laga khong laga kup taike dise.

english_text: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
nagamese_text: Titia sob majuli khan polaise, aru pahar khan napa-a hoise.

english_text: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.
nagamese_text: Aru manu khan uporte dangor borop pathor, ekdom bhari, sorgo pora ahikena taikhan uporte girise. Titia manu khan Isor laga naam ke hinsa korise kelemane etu borop pathor khan taikhan uporte girise, aru etu dukh to bisi biya thakise.

english_text: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
nagamese_text: Titia sat-ta sorgodoth khan majote ekjon kun laga hathte sat-ta bati thakise, ahi kene moike kotha korise, aru koise, “Ahibi, Moi tumike dikhai dibo ekjon bebichari ke, jun laga bisar hoise aru jun bisi pani uporte bohi ase.

english_text: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell on the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
nagamese_text: Etu prithibi laga raja khan tai logote biya kaam korise, aru etu prithibi te thaka khan ke tai laga bebichari laga draikha-ros to khabole dise.”

english_text: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth pora moike pobitro Atma te ekta jongol te loi jaise, aru moi dikhise ekjon mahila ke, kun ekta lal rong kutta janwar uporte bohi thakise jun laga uporte Isor ke bodnam kora laga naam khan bhorta thakise. Etu janwar laga sat-ta matha aru dosta seing thakise.

english_text: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
nagamese_text: Etu mahila to begoni rong kapra lagai kene thakise aru moti, suna aru daam laga pathor lagai kene sabole sundur dikhi thakise. Tai laga hathte suna laga kup dhuri thakise juntu te tai laga bebichari kaam pora bhorta hoi kene thakise.

english_text: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga matha age te naam likhi kene thakise, bujhi bole napara ekta: “Mohan Babylon, bebichari khan laga ama aru prithibi ke letera kori diya ekjon.”

english_text: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.
nagamese_text: Moi dikhise etu mahila to biswasi, pobitro aru Jisu laga gawah khan laga khun khai thakise. Jitia moi taike dikhise, moi bisi asurit hoise.

english_text: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
nagamese_text: Kintu sorgodoth pora moike koise, “Kile tumi asurit lagi ase? Moi etu mahila laga lukai kene thaka khan kobo aru etu sat-ta matha aru dosta seing thaka janwar laga bhi kun taike bukhi ase.

english_text: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.
nagamese_text: Etu janwar tumi pora dikha to hoile jinda thakise, tai etiya jinda nai, kintu tai aru bhi khotom nathaka mati niche pora ulaikene ahibole ase. Titia etu pora pura sob bhangai dibo. Kun manu etu prithibi te thaki ase, kun manu laga naam duniya bona homoi pora Jibon laga Kitab te naam likha nai- taikhan etu janwar ke dikhi kene asurit lagibo, kelemane tai poila te thakise, aru etiya nai, hoile bhi tai ahibole ase.

english_text: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
nagamese_text: Etu gyaan thaka khan nimite bhabona kori bole laga ase: etu sat-ta matha khan sat-ta pahar ase kun uporte te mahila pora bohi ase. Aru eitu khan sat-ta rajakhan bhi ase:

english_text: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
nagamese_text: pansta rajakhan giri jaise, ekjon ase aru dusra ekjon aha nai. Kintu jitia tai ahibo, tai olop homoi nimite he thaki bole lagibo.

english_text: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
nagamese_text: Etu janwar kun thakise, kintu etiya nai, tai nijor bhi ath ginti laga raja thakise; kintu tai bhi sat-ta raja majote ekjon thakise, aru tai sob khotom kori dibole nimite jai ase.

english_text: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
nagamese_text: Dosta seing thaka to hoile dosta rajakhan ase, kintu taikhan ek ghanta janwar logote raja hobole nimite adhikar pabo.

english_text: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
nagamese_text: Eitu khan sob ekta bhabona ase, aru taikhan laga adhikar aru takot sob janwar ke di dibo.

english_text: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
nagamese_text: Taikhan Mer bacha logote lorai koribo. Kintu Mer bacha pora taikhan uporte jiti lobo, tai he Probhu laga Probhu aru Raja laga Raja ase- aru Tai logote thaka khan ke bachi luwa aru biswasi luwa khan mate.”

english_text: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth pora moike koise, “Etu pani kuntu tumi dikhise, kun jagate bebichari bohe, eitu khan sob manu laga bhir khan, desh khan aru alag bhasa kowa manu khan ase.

english_text: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.
nagamese_text: Tumi kuntu dosta seing aru janwar dikhise- taikhan bebichari ke ghin koribo. Taikhan pora tai laga kapra khuli kene sorom khilai dibo, tai laga gaw mangso ke kamuribo, aru jui pora taike pura julai dibo.

english_text: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Isor pora taikhan laga monte eneka kori bole koi dise, aru ekta kaam he kori bole dise, aru taikhan laga rajyo ke janwar ke dibole nimite koi dise, jitia tak Isor laga kotha to pura nohoi jai.

english_text: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
nagamese_text: Etiya kun to mahila ke tumi dikhise, tai he utu dangor sheher ase, juntu pora prithibi laga raja khan uporte raj cholai.”

english_text: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete moi aru ekjon sorgodoth ke sorgo pora ahi thaka dikhise. Tai logote adhikar thakise, aru pura prithibi Tai laga Mohima pora bhorta hoi jaise.

english_text: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!
nagamese_text: Tai kandi kene dangor awaj pora koise, “Mohan Babylon giri jaise! Tai bhoot khan thaka jaga hoi jaise, Sob biya atma laga ghor, Aru sob biya aru letera chiriya laga ghor.

english_text: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
nagamese_text: Sob desh khan tai laga bebichar laga draikha ros khaikena nisa hoise. Sob prithibi laga raja khan tai logote bebichar kaam korise. Prithibi laga vyapari manu khan bhi tai kineka mangso laga itcha te thaki ase, etu saikene dhun hoise.”

english_text: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
nagamese_text: Titia moi sorgo pora aru ekta awaj koi thaka hunise, “Tai pora ulaikene ahibi, Moi laga manu khan Tumikhan tai laga paap te bhag nolobole nimite, Aru etu pora tai pabole thaka dukh tumi uporte nahibo nimite.

english_text: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
nagamese_text: Kelemane Babylon laga paapkhan sorgo tak ponchise, Aru Isor pora tai laga paap kaam khan sob yaad kori ase.

english_text: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
nagamese_text: Tai ki dise etu wapas taike di dibi Aru tai laga kaam saikene taike aru bisi dibi; Aru tai milai kene rakha kup te, tai nimite aru bisi milai kene taike di dibi.

english_text: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
nagamese_text: Kelemane tai nijorke dangor kori kene aram pora thakise, Taike bisi dukh chinta aru mon dukh dibi. Kelemane tai nijor laga monte koi, ‘Moi rani nisena bohi ase; Moi bidhowa mahila nohoi, Aru moi kitia bhi kanda nadikhibo.’

english_text: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
nagamese_text: Etu karone ek dinte he tai laga dukh ahibo: Mora, kanda, aru akaal ahibo. Taike jui pora khai dibo, Kelemane Probhu Isor Mohan ase, aru Tai he taike bisar koribo.”

english_text: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
nagamese_text: Prithibi laga raja khan kun tai laga pichete jai kene sob bebichar korise, tai juli kene dhuwa ulai thaka to dikhi kene kandi kene hala koribo.

english_text: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
nagamese_text: Taikhan dur te khara koribo, aru tai dukh pa to dikhi kene kobo, “Oh, oh mohan sheher, Babylon takot thaka ekta sheher! Kelemane ek ghanta bhitor te tumi laga bisar hoi jaise.”

english_text: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:
nagamese_text: Titia prithibi laga dhun manu khan taike saikene kandise, kelemane tai laga saman khan kun bhi nakina hoise-

english_text: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
nagamese_text: bahar pora ana suna, chandi, daam laga pathor, moti, mihin kapra, begoni rong kapra, resham kapra, lal rong laga kapra, sob kisim laga bhal aru daam citron laga khuri, bhal para bona bati khan, pitol, luha, aru marble,

english_text: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
nagamese_text: masala khan, mitha sugandh tel, angur ros, kisim laga tel, mihin pora sapha kori rakha atta, saguli aru goru, ghora aru ghora gari, noukar aru manu laga atma khan.

english_text: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.
nagamese_text: Tumi laga pakki juwa phol, tumi laga atma laga itcha, sob tumi pora jai jaise. Sob aram aru dikhawa tumi pora jai jaise, aru etu kitia bhi wapas napabo.

english_text: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
nagamese_text: Etu saman laga malik khan kun taike saikene dhuni hoisele etiya tai pora dur hoi jaise, kelemane tai laga dukh paikene thaki thaka to saikene bhoi lagise aru dur te jai kene khara hoi jaise.

english_text: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
nagamese_text: Taikhan kobo, “Oh, oh etu mohan sheher Kun bhal kapra lagai kene thakise, Begoni rong te, aru lal rong kapra lagai kene thakise, Aru suna pora bhorta hoi kene, Daam laga heera, aru moti khan lagaikena thakise!

english_text: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,
nagamese_text: Ek ghanta bhitor te tai laga sob dhun to khotom hoi jaise.” Sob jahaaj laga henedhikari khan ta te safar kora khan, aru cholai thaka aru kiman manu etu samundar pora kamai thakise, dur te khara hoi jaise.

english_text: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
nagamese_text: Taikhan kandise jitia tai juli thaka laga dhuwa to dikhise. Taikhan koise, “Mohan sheher nisena aru kuntu sheher ase?”

english_text: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.
nagamese_text: Taikhan laga matha pora dhula jharise, aru jor pora kandise, mon dukh korise, aru koise, “Oh, oh etu mohan sheher Kun logote taikhan laga jahaaj ase Samundar te tai laga dhun pora dhuni hoise Kelemane ek ghanta te taike khotom kori dise.”

english_text: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”
nagamese_text: “Tai uporte khushi koribi, O sorgo, Aru tumi pobitro khan, apostle khan, aru bhabobadi khan, Kelemane Isor pora he tumikhan laga bisar tai uporte kori dise!”

english_text: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
nagamese_text: Titia ekta mohan sorgodoth pora dangor pathor uthaikene samundar te phelai dise, aru koise, “Etu nisena, Babylon, mohan sheher ke bhi, Dukh te phelai dibo Aru taike kitia bhi nadikha hoi jabo.

english_text: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
nagamese_text: Gana baja manu khan, Aru bhigul baja manu khan laga gana aru Tumi kitia bhi nahunibo. Bhal saman bona manu aru tumi Khan kitia bhi napabo. Dhaan khunda laga awaj aru Tumikhan kitia bhi nahunibo.

english_text: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
nagamese_text: Saaki laga ujala Tumikhan ke kitia bhi ujala nadibo. Shadi kora mahila aru mota laga awaj aru Kitia bhi nahunibo, Kelemane tumikhan laga vyaparikhan to prithibi laga raja khan thakise, Aru pura desh tumikhan laga jadu-tona pora thogai dise.

english_text: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
nagamese_text: Bhabobadi aru pobitro manu khan laga khun tai uporte paise, Aru taikhan sob laga khun, kunkhan ke etu prithibi te morai dise.”

english_text: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;
nagamese_text: Etu pichete sorgo pora manu laga dangor bhir laga awaj ulaikena koi thaka hunise, “Hallelujah. Poritran, mohima, aru takot moi khan laga Isor ke.

english_text: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”
nagamese_text: Tai laga bisar hosa aru bhal ase, Kelemane Tai mohan bebichar ke bisar korise Kun bebichar kaam kori kene prithibi ke letera kori dise. Tai laga noukar khan laga khun ulai diya ke badla loise, Tai laga hath pora.”

english_text: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
nagamese_text: Titia bhir khan aru dusra bar hala korise: Hallelujah! Tai pora ulai thaka dhuwa hodai aru hodai nimite thakibo.”

english_text: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
nagamese_text: Titia choubees bura manu khan aru charta janwar athukari kene Isor kun singhason te bohi thakise taike aradhana korise aru koise, “Amen. Hallelujah!”

english_text: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
nagamese_text: Titia singhason pora ekta awaj ahi kene, koise, “Moi khan laga Isor ke dhanyavad ase, Tai laga sob noukar, Aru Kun Taike bhoi kore, chutu aru dangor sob.”

english_text: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
nagamese_text: Titia moi bisi manu laga awaj nisena hunise, aru nodi te pani jai thaka nisena, aru akas te bhijili mara nisena aru koise, “Hallelujah! Moi khan laga Mohan Probhu Isor raj kore.

english_text: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
nagamese_text: Moi khan naam untcha uthaikene khushi koribo Aru Taike mohima dibo Kelemane Mer bacha laga shadi kori bole homoi ahise, Aru Taike shadi kori bole thaka maiki taiyari hoi kene rukhi ase.

english_text: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
nagamese_text: Tai nijorke taiyari kori kene thaki bole koi dise Ujala aru mihin kapra lagai kene.” -Kelemane mihin kapra lagai kene thaka to hoile pobitro manu khan laga dharmik kaam khan ase.-

english_text: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth pora moike koise, “Etu likhibi: Asirbad ase kunkhan ke Mer bacha laga shadi te matise.” Tai eneka aru moike koise, “Eitu khan sob Isor laga hosa kotha khan ase.”

english_text: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”
nagamese_text: Titia moi Tai laga theng te giri kene aradhana korise, kintu tai moike koise, “Eneka nokoribi! Moi bhi tumi nisena Isor laga ekjon noukar ase tumi aru biswasi bhai khan logote Jisu laga gawahi dhori kene ase. Isor ke mohima dibi. Kelemane Jisu laga gawahi to atma laga bhabobani ase.”

english_text: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.
nagamese_text: Titia moi sorgo khula dikhise, aru ta te ekta boga ghora thakise, aru etu uporte bohi thaka ke bhal aru hosa matise, aru Tai bisar kore aru dharmik pora lorai kore.

english_text: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.
nagamese_text: Tai laga suku juli thaka jui nisena ase, aru Tai laga matha te bisi mukut thakise. Tai laga naam likha thakise aru etu naam kun bhi najane khali tai pora he jane.

english_text: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
nagamese_text: Tai lagai thaka kapra khun te hali kene thaka nisena ase, aru tai laga naam to Isor laga kotha ase.

english_text: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.
nagamese_text: Sorgo laga sipahi khan sob boga ghora te uthi kene tai laga pichete jai thakise, aru taikhan sundur, aru boga mihin kapra lagai kene thakise.

english_text: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
nagamese_text: Aru tai laga mukh pora dhar talwar ulaise, etu pora desh khan ke mari dibo, aru rokhiya khan pora tai laga mer khan ke lathi pora mara nisena, taikhan ke bhi eneka koribo. Tai angur laga ros uporte chipai diya nisena Mohan Isor laga khong bhi taikhan uporte ahibo.

english_text: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”
nagamese_text: Tai laga kapra aru tai laga theng te naam likhi kene ase: “Raja laga raja aru Probhu laga Probhu.”

english_text: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,
nagamese_text: Titia moi ekjon sorgodoth ke suyro te khara hoi thaka dikhise. Tai jor awaj pora matise, kiman chiriya akas te uri thakise taikhan koise, “Ahibi! Isor laga dangor khana khan din nimite sob eke logote joma kori lobi,

english_text: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”
nagamese_text: titia tumikhan pora raja khan laga mangso khabole nimite, aru senapoti khan laga, aru mohan manu khan laga, aru ghor khan aru taikhan laga uporte bohi thaka khan laga, sob manu laga, khuli kene berai thaka aru noukar khan laga, chutu aru dangor khan laga mangso khabole nimite.”

english_text: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.
nagamese_text: Titia moi janwar aru prithibi laga raja khan, aru taikhan laga sipahi khan dikhise. Taikhan etu ghora uporte bohi thaka aru tai laga sipahi khan logote lorai kori bole nimite joma kori thakise.

english_text: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
nagamese_text: Titia janwar ke dhori loise, aru tai logote kiman misa bhabobadi khan kun tai usorte chihna khan dikhai thakise, juntu pora tai janwar laga chihna thaka bisi jonke thogai dise aru kun tai laga murti ke puja korise. Duijon ke jui juli thaka te jinda pora phelai dise kun to kitia bhi khotom nohoi.

english_text: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
nagamese_text: Aru sipahi kiman bachi kene thakise, taikhan sobke ghora te bohi thaka laga mukh pora ula talwar pora morai dise, aru chiriya khan sob laga pet to taikhan laga mangso pora bhorta hoi jaise.

english_text: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
nagamese_text: Titia moi ekjon sorgodoth sorgo pora ahi thaka dikhise. Tai logote khotom nathaka mati niche laga chabi thakise, aru tai laga hathte luha laga rusi dangor dhori kene thakise.

english_text: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
nagamese_text: Tai ajgar janwar ke dhori loise, poila pora thaka saph ke, kun to bhoot, aru Saitan ase, aru hajar saal tak tai bandi loise.

english_text: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
nagamese_text: Titia taike khotom nathaka mati nichete phelai dise, aru bondh kori kene tai uporte mohor mari dise, aru etu pora tai hajar saal khotom nohua tak aru desh khan ke thogai nadibole nimite. Etu pichete, taike olop homoi nimite chari dibo.

english_text: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
nagamese_text: Titia moi singhason khan dikhise. Ta te taikhan bohise- sob atma khan kun laga matha khan Jisu laga gawahi aru kotha nimite kati dise, aru kunkhan janwar aru tai laga murti ke puja kora nai aru matha age te aru hathte tai laga chihna luwa nai- taikhan ke bisar korise. Taikhan jinda hoi jaise, aru Khrista logote hajar saal raj korise.

english_text: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
nagamese_text: -Aru dusra khan jinda huwa nai aru jibon panai jitia tak hajar saal to pura huwa nai-. Etu prothom punoruthan ase.

english_text: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
nagamese_text: Etu manu asirbad aru pobitro ase kun poila punoruthan laga bhag ase! Etu te dusra bar mora laga eku takot nai, kintu taikhan Isor aru Khrista laga purohit khan hobo, aru Tai logote hajar saal raj koribo.

english_text: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison
nagamese_text: Kintu jitia hajar saal pura hoi jabo, Saitan ke tai laga bondhi ghor pora chari dibo.

english_text: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
nagamese_text: Aru tai prithibi laga charta kinar laga desh te jai kene bisi manu khan ke thogai dibo- Gog aru Magog- manu khan ke lorai kori bole nimite joma koribo. Aru taikhan balu aru samundar nisena bisi manu thakibo.

english_text: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
nagamese_text: Taikhan prithibi laga bhoyam jagate jabo aru pobitro manu aru taikhan morom kora sheher ke gheri lobo. Kintu sorgo pora jui ahi kene taikhan ke khotom kori dibo.

english_text: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
nagamese_text: Titia Saitan he, kun taikhan ke thogai dise, jui laga nodi te phelai dise, kun jagate janwar aru tai laga misa bhabobadi khan ase. Taikhan ke din aru rati hodai nimite dukh dibo.

english_text: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.
nagamese_text: Titia moi dangor boga singhason dikhise aru ta te bohi thaka ekjon, Tai laga usor pora prithibi aru sorgo polai jai thakise, kintu taikhan jabole nimite kot te bhi jaga panai.

english_text: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
nagamese_text: Aru titia moi mora khan ke dikhise- chutu aru dangor- singhason usorte khara kori thakise, aru kitab khan khuli jaise. Titia aru dusra kitab ekta khuli se, kun to Jibon laga Kitab ase. Mora khan ke kitab te ki likha ase etu pora bisar korise, taikhan laga kaam hisab te.

english_text: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
nagamese_text: Samundar bhitor te mori kene thaka khan bhi uthise. Mora aru Hades pora mori kene thaka khan sob uthise, aru sob manu khan ke taikhan laga kaam hisab te bisar korise.

english_text: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
nagamese_text: Titia Mora aru Hades ke jui laga nodi te phelai dise. Etu dusra bar mora ase- jui laga nodi.

english_text: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
nagamese_text: Kun laga naam Jibon laga Kitab te likha nai, taike jui laga nodi te phelai dise.

english_text: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
nagamese_text: Etu pichete moi notun sorgo aru notun prithibi dikhise, prothom prithibi aru prothom sorgo to harai jaise, aru samundar khan nathaka hoi jaise.

english_text: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
nagamese_text: Aru moi pobitro sheher dikhise, notun Jerusalem Isor laga sorgo pora ahi thakise, ekjon shadi kora mahila tai laga mota ke taiyari kori kene lok pabole aha nisena.

english_text: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
nagamese_text: Aru titia moi dangor awaj singhason pora koi thaka hunise, “Sabi! Isor laga ghor to manu khan logote ase, aru Tai Nijor he taikhan logote thakibo. Taikhan he Tai laga manu hoi jabo, aru Isor Tai nijor bhi taikhan logote thakibo.

english_text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
nagamese_text: Isor pora taikhan laga suku pani mussi dibo, aru ta te mora nathakibo, aru mon dukh, kanda, aru bikha khan eku nathaki jabo. Eitu khan aru kitia bhi nahobo kelemane age laga sob to harai jabo.

english_text: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
nagamese_text: Titia ekjon kun singhason te bohi thakise Tai koise, “Sabi! Moi sob to notun kori dise.” Tai moike koise, “Etu likhibi kelemane etu kowa khan sob hosa aru biswas kori bole laga kotha ase.”

english_text: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
nagamese_text: Tai aru bhi moike koise, “Etu sob kaam pura hoise! Moi alpha aru omega ase, shuru aru ses ase. Kun manu pyaas lagi ase moi taike eku daam noloikene sapha jibon laga pani dibo.

english_text: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
nagamese_text: Kun manu sob jiti lobo tai etu sob pai jabo, aru moi Tai laga Isor hobo, aru tai Moi laga bacha hobo.

english_text: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
nagamese_text: Kintu mon chutu khan, biswas nathaka khan, ghin kaam kora khan, manu ke morai diya khan, bebichar kaam kora khan, jadu montor kora khan, murti puja kora khan, aru sob kisim misa koi thaka khan, taikhan laga jaga jui para hodai juli thaka nodi te hobo. Etu duibar mora to ase.”

english_text: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
nagamese_text: Titia sat-ta sorgodoth khan majote ekjon sorgodoth moi usorte ahise, etu ekjon kun logote sat-ta bati te hekh dukh pora bhorta kori kene dhori thakise, aru tai moi logote kotha korise, aru koise, “Yate ahibi. Moi tumike shadi kora maiki to dikhai dibo, jun Mer bacha laga maiki ase.”

english_text: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
nagamese_text: Titia tai moike uthaikene atma pora dangor aru untcha pahar te loi jaise aru moike pobitro Jerusalem sheher Isor laga sorgo pora ahi thaka dikhise.

english_text: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
nagamese_text: Isor laga mohima ta te thakise, aru etu to ekta daam aru sapha sundur pathor pora chamki thaka nisena dikhise.

english_text: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te dangor, untcha diwar aru baroh ta dorja thakise, aru baroh ta sorgodoth khan dorjate thakise. Dorjate naam khan likhi kene thakise, aru etu naam khan Israel laga baroh ta chokra laga jati laga naam thakise.

english_text: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
nagamese_text: Purab te tinta dorja thakise, uttor te tinta dorja, dakshin te tinta dorja, aru paschim te tinta dorja thakise.

english_text: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
nagamese_text: Aru sheher laga diwar te baroh ta mojbut bhetimul thakise, aru eitu khan te Mer bacha laga baroh ta apostle khan laga naam thakise.

english_text: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
nagamese_text: Kun pora moi logote kotha korise tai logote naap luwa laga suna pora bona laga lathi thakise aru etu pora sheher, aru tai laga dorja, aru diwar khan naap kori bole nimite.

english_text: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.
nagamese_text: Etu sheher laga jaga bisi dangor thakise; aru etu sheher laga lamba phale aru untcha phale eke thakise. Tai naap kora laga khuri pora naapi se aru etu baroh hajar laga dangor thakise -aru etu laga lamba, dangor, aru untcha sob eke thakise.-

english_text: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
nagamese_text: Tai diwar khan bhi napi loise, 144 manu laga naap hisab te thakise -aru etu sorgodoth laga naap logot eke thakise-

english_text: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
nagamese_text: etu laga diwar khan daam laga pathor pora bonaise aru sheher to asli suna laga thakise, aru gilas nisena sapha thakise.

english_text: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
nagamese_text: Aru etu sheher laga diwar laga bhetimul khan bisi sundur aru sob kisim laga daam pathor pora bonai kene rakhise. Prothom bhetimul to jasper asele, dusra bhetimul to sapphire laga thakise, tinta ula to agate, aru charta ula to emerald laga thakise,

english_text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
nagamese_text: pansta ula oynx thakise, choita ula to carnelian, sat-ta to hoile chrysolite laga thakise, anth ta to hoile beryl, nou ta to topaz, aru dosta to hoile chrysoprase, egaroh to hoile jacinth aru baroh ta to hoile amethyst eneka thakise.

english_text: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
nagamese_text: Aru baroh ta dorja to hoile baroh moti laga thakise; ekta dorja khan ekta moti pora bonai kene thakise. Sheher laga rasta khan asli suna laga thakise, ekdom sapha gilas nisena thakise.

english_text: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
nagamese_text: Aru moi etu sheher te ekta bhi mondoli dikha nai, kelemane Mohan Probhu Isor aru Mer bacha he ta te laga mondoli ase.

english_text: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.
nagamese_text: Etu sheher te suryo aru chand laga ujala eku dorkar thaka nai. Kelemane Isor laga mohima ta te ujala diye, aru tai laga saaki to Mer bacha he ase.

english_text: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
nagamese_text: Aru desh khan etu sheher laga ujala te berabo, aru prithibi laga raja khan sob mohima ta te he ani kene dibo.

english_text: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
nagamese_text: Aru ta te dorja khan dinte kitia bhi bondh nohobo, ta te aru rati kitia bhi nathakibo.

english_text: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.
nagamese_text: Taikhan sob desh laga adar aru mohima ta te he anibo,

english_text: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
nagamese_text: kintu eku letera saman ta te jabole na paribo, aru kun chalak aru biya kaam kore, taikhan ta te jabo na paribo, kintu khali kun laga naam Mem bacha laga jibon laga kitab te likhi kene ase taikhan he ta te jabole paribo.

english_text: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth pora moike jibon laga pani dikhai dise, crystal nisena sapha thakise. Aru etu Isor laga singhason aru Mer bacha laga singhason pora giri thakise.

english_text: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
nagamese_text: Sheher laga rasta majot pora aru nodi laga duita kinar te jibon laga ghas thakise, aru etu ghas te baroh ta alag-alag phol ulaikene dikhise aru baroh mohina te ekta phol dhori thakise. Aru ghas laga pata khan desh ke changai kori bole karone thakise.

english_text: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
nagamese_text: Aru ta te eku biya paapkhan nai. Isor aru Mer bacha laga singhason etu sheher te thakibo, aru tai laga noukar khan taike sewa koribo.

english_text: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
nagamese_text: Taikhan pora Isor laga chehera dikhibo, aru Tai laga naam taikhan laga matha age te likhibo.

english_text: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
nagamese_text: Ta te aru rati kitia bhi nohobo, aru taikhan saaki laga ujala aru suryo laga puhor nalagibo kelemane Isor he taikhan ke ujala dibo, aru taikhan Isor logote hodai aru hodai nimite raj koribo.

english_text: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
nagamese_text: Titia sorgodoth pora moike koise, “Etu sob kotha khan hosa aru biswas kori bole laga ase. Etu Probhu, bhabobadi khan laga atma khan laga Isor pora Tai laga sorgodoth ke tai laga noukar usorte pathai dise aru dikhai dise ki to joldi hobole ase.”

english_text: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
nagamese_text: “Sabi! Moi joldi ahi ase! Asirbad ase etu manu kun etu kitab laga bhabobani aru kotha mani kene thake.”

english_text: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
nagamese_text: Moi, John, etu sob kotha dikhise aru ki hobole ase etu sob moi hunise. Jitia moi etu hunise aru dikhise, moi nichete aradhana kori bole nimite girise etu sorgodoth usorte kun he moike etu sob to dikhai thakise.

english_text: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
nagamese_text: Kintu Tai moike koise, “Tumi eneka nokoribi! Moi bhi tumi nisena ekjon noukar ase, tumi laga bhai bhabobadi khan nisena aru taikhan kun etu kitab laga kotha mani thake. Isor ke mohima dibi!”

english_text: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
nagamese_text: Titia Tai moike koise, “Etu kitab laga bhabobani aru kotha khan ke mohor lagaikena bondh na koribi, kelemane sob pura hobole laga homoi to ahi ase.

english_text: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
nagamese_text: Kun manu biya adharmikta te ase, taike eneka he biya pora thaki bole dibo. Kun manu mon letera kori kene thaki ase, taike eneka he thaki bole dibi. Kun manu bhal pora thaki ase, tai aru bhi bisi bhal pora thakibi. Aru kun manu pobitro hoi kene ase, tai aru bhi bisi pobitro hoi kene thakibi.”

english_text: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
nagamese_text: “Sabi! Moi joldi ahi ase, aru moi laga inam moi laga hathte ase, kun ki kaam korise etu hisab dibole nimite.

english_text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
nagamese_text: Moi he alpha aru omega ase, prothom aru hekh bhi moi he ase, shuru aru ses bhi moi ase.

english_text: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
nagamese_text: Asirbad ase kun tai laga kapra dhulai kene rakhi ase etu pora taikhan moi logote jibon laga ghas pora khabole paribo aru etu sheher laga dorja pora ghusi bole paribo.

english_text: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
nagamese_text: Bahar te kutta khan ase, mangso laga itcha kori thaka khan, manu morai diya khan, murti puja kora manu, aru sob manu kun misa to mani kene morom kori kene thake.

english_text: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
nagamese_text: Moi, Jisu, pora sorgodoth khan ke etu kotha khan kobole nimite aru gawahi dibole nimite girja khan te pathai dise. Moi jor ase aru David laga khandan ase, ujala thaka phojur laga tara.”

english_text: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
nagamese_text: Pobitro Atma aru shadi kori bole thaka mahila pora koi, “Ahibi!” Etu nimite kun huni ase, “Ahibi!” Kun pyaas lagi ase, taike ahibole dibi kun itcha kori ase, tai khushi pora etu jibon laga pani lobole dibi.

english_text: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
nagamese_text: Moi etu kitab laga bhabobani sob manu kun etu kotha hunibo taikhan ke gawahi di ase: Jodi kunba etu kotha te aru bisi kotha dhale, Isor he tai uporte sob dukh khan hali dibo kun to etu kitab te likhi kene ase.

english_text: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
nagamese_text: Aru jodi kunba bhabobani laga kitab te ki likhi kene ase etu hatai diye, Isor he jibon laga ghas pora aru etu pobitro sheher pora bhi tai laga bhag hatai dibo, kuntu laga kotha etu kitab te likhi kene ase.

english_text: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
nagamese_text: Kun manu etu sob kotha laga gawahi dibo kobi, “Hoi! Moi joldi ahi ase.” Amen! Ahibi, Probhu Jisu!

english_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
nagamese_text: Probhu Jisu laga anugrah Tai laga manu khan sob logote thaki bole dibi. Amen.
